quests.summary: Your qi thickens by the day. Elder Mo says you're nearly ready for the cliff edge.

objectives.text: See what Elder Mo wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate progress. Don't let it go to your head. There isn't room in there for both.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Elder Mo said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lu Ping. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Refine your cultivation at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The world goes quiet. Your meridians hum, a little wider than yesterday.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough, Xiao Man. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Qi Condensation
quests.summary: Your meridians are ready. With a pill from Elder Hua and the view from the cliff edge, it is time to condense your first qi.

objectives.text: Receive a Qi Gathering Pill from Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Mo says you're ready. He said it grumpily, which means he's proud.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: This is a Qi Gathering Pill. Swallow it at the cliff edge. The sea of clouds will steady your mind.

objectives.text: Break through at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill dissolves into fire. Qi floods your meridians like a spring thaw, cold, then burning, then clear.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sea of clouds churns below. The scattered spark in your dantian draws tight and becomes a bright, steady pearl of qi.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: So this is Qi Condensation. I can hear the mountain breathing.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Qi Condensation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sky over you darkens and turns, slow as a millstone. Heaven has noticed a mortal becoming something else.

objectives.text: Present yourself to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yun Qingyao. Sect Master of the Azure Cloud. I felt your breakthrough from the hall. It was very... loud.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo tells me the formation array answered you, and that wolves with red eyes came to our wall.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Omens come in pairs, they say. I would rather they didn't. Rest well, {player}. Tomorrow the sect needs you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I will not disappoint you, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. A loud breakthrough, but a clean one. Adequate, Sect Master. Adequate.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Measured. Sensible.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Beyond the Mountain Gate
quests.summary: Elder Gu of the Law Hall has assigned you your first mission outside the sect: gather moonshadow grass in the Whispering Bamboo Forest with Wei Tong.

objectives.text: Receive your mission from Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Medicine Hall needs moonshadow grass. It grows in the Whispering Bamboo, beyond the wolf dens.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Wei Tong will go with you. Take the teleport array outside the gate. Be back within three days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The wolf dens? After what we saw in the pines?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A cultivator who fears wolves should have stayed a farmer. Go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Three days, Elder. I'll pack for four. In case the wolves are hungry and we have to share.

objectives.text: Watch your arrival in the bamboo forest
Join Wei Tong on the forest path

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Smell that? Bamboo shoots. Wild mushrooms. Freedom. I packed twelve buns, in case of emergencies.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Moonshadow grass grows in the sunny grove ahead. We pick it, we go home, nobody gets eaten.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why do I feel like you've said that before?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Because I have. Twice. Once somebody got eaten. Only a little bit, though.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Moonshadow Grass
quests.summary: Gather moonshadow grass in the herb grove. Something in the bamboo is watching.

objectives.text: Find the sunny herb grove

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There! Moonshadow grass. See how it glows? Pick the silver ones. The blue ones make you sneeze for a week.

objectives.text: Gather moonshadow grass in the herb grove
Fight off the spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Wolves! In broad daylight? Back to back, {junior}!

objectives.text: Regroup with Wei Tong by the stream

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves don't hunt at noon. And they don't hunt cultivators. We taste of pills and bad temper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: These weren't red-eyed, at least.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Not yet. Something's driving them out of their den. Let's find out what, then eat. Or eat, then find out.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The wolves are running from something, disciples. Follow them, and be ready to be sorry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Who said that? Did a bamboo just talk? {junior}, tell me a bamboo just talked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Fangs in the Dark
quests.summary: The spirit wolves are fleeing their own den. Find out what drove them out.

objectives.text: Scout the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hollow reeks of old blood. Bones lie in neat rows, far too neat for wolves.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the cave wall, someone has painted a crescent moon swallowing a sword. The paint is still wet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's not wolf art. Wolves can't hold brushes. I checked once.

objectives.text: Slay the corrupted wolves
Collect fangs from the corrupted wolves
Show the fangs to Wei Tong in the clearing

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Look at the roots of those fangs, disciples. That is not wolf blood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The roots are black. Somebody fed these wolves blood, cultivator blood, and on purpose.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Hua can study these. And the den is not empty. Something bigger is still in there.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: The King of the Den
quests.summary: The wolf king, a spirit beast of great age, has been driven mad by blood qi. End its suffering.

objectives.text: Return to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A howl shakes the bamboo. Something the size of an ox pads out of the cave, eyes like two red lanterns.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted wolf king

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's the wolf king! Its fur used to be silver... they've turned it into a monster!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then let's give it peace.

objectives.text: Lay the wolf king to rest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press a purifying talisman to the great beast's brow. The red drains from its fur, leaving it silver again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Rest easy, old king. It wasn't your fault.

objectives.text: Confront the masked stranger in the clearing

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean work. The wolf king was old when your sect master was a child. It deserved a better death.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Who are you? Did you do this?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: If I had, you would be dead. The wolves were fed blood. Someone is testing an old recipe.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {junior}, the scary masked man is praising us. Do we say thank you, or do we run?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go home, little disciple. Keep that pendant under your robe. There are eyes in this forest older than mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: The Hermit of the Bamboo
quests.summary: The wolf king's claws left Wei Tong with a festering wound. A hermit is said to live in a quiet clearing nearby.

objectives.text: Carry Wei Tong to the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If I die, tell my mother I died heroically. And tell the kitchen to stop making the bitter melon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're not dying. You're just heavy.

objectives.text: Beg the hermit for help

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Wolf king claws. Blood-soaked, too. Put him down on the mat, not on my tea.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (weakly) Speaking of tea... is there any? If I'm dying, I'd like to die holding tea.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The wound drinks qi. It needs water from the spirit spring, drawn by someone with a clean heart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll go. Where is it?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Follow the sound of the frogs. They are loud and very proud of it.

objectives.text: Draw water from the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The water glows where your gourd touches it. The lotus pads turn slowly toward you, then toward your pendant.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: For a moment the spring shows a reflection that is not yours: a woman in green robes, holding a lotus. Then it is gone.

objectives.text: Pick lotus leaves by the spring for the poultice
Bring the spring water to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The spring gave you water. It usually just gives people wet boots.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your friend will live, and complain, which is how you know he is alive.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That jade you carry... no. Old men see ghosts everywhere. Mind the ruins to the north, child. They remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

quests.title: Smoke on the Ridge
quests.summary: Wei Tong, recovered and ravenous, smells campfire smoke. Someone is camped deep in the forest.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong on the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm alive! And I smell roast pork. Either I've died and gone somewhere nice, or there's a camp nearby.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bandits, probably. The rogue cultivator kind. Let's take a look from the ridge before we do anything stupid.

objectives.text: Scout the camp from the lookout

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below: tents, a fire, crates stamped with a merchant guild's seal. And cages. Cages full of mortals.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Those are townsfolk. Look at their clothes. Qingshi, maybe. What do bandits want with farmers?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nothing good. We free them tonight.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Twenty guards. Two cages. Go at the second watch, when the fool with the torch falls asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Tonight. Right. After dinner. Kidding! Mostly kidding.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

objectives.text: Wait for nightfall and steady your breath

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fire burns low. The guards trade places. Inside the cages, a child is crying very quietly.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Camp
quests.summary: Raid the bandit camp and free the caged mortals.

objectives.text: Raid the bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Sect brats! On your feet, you drunks! Iron-Fang Tie Hu doesn't lose cargo!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They're people, not cargo.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang himself! Dumpling, we're going to be famous!

objectives.text: Free the caged mortals

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock snaps. The prisoners stumble out, blinking, too frightened to cry.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: An old farmer grips your sleeve. They took us from Qingshi, he whispers. Every new moon, more of us vanish.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go
Hand him over to face the law
End it. He would have killed you.
Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

objectives.text: Cover the prisoners' escape

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Kill them! The buyer pays for heads, whole or not!

objectives.text: Recover the stolen spirit stones

quests.title: The Blood-Red Token
quests.summary: Iron-Fang fled, leaving his strongbox behind. Search it for clues about his mysterious buyer.

objectives.text: Search the bandit chief's strongbox

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Silver, forged papers, and at the bottom a token of blood-red jade, carved with a moon swallowing a sword.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It is cold as a corpse. Your pendant flares green, and the token hisses like a burnt insect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The same mark as the den. This is no ordinary bandit's loot.

objectives.text: Show the token to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: A moon eating a sword. My grandmother used to scare me with that. Be good or the Blood Moon takes you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The hermit's old. Older than old. If anyone knows what this is, he does.

objectives.text: Ask the hermit about the token

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Put that thing down. Not on my tea! Not on anything I love.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That is a Blood Moon Sect command token. Three hundred years ago, one of those could order a city to bleed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I said it looked bad. I said so on the ridge. I'm saying it again, for the record.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon Sect was destroyed. Everyone says so.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Everyone says a great many things. The dead are rarely consulted. Take it to your elders. Quickly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Ambush at the Old Bridge
quests.summary: Iron-Fang wants his token back, and he has brought friends.

objectives.text: Survive the ambush on the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That token isn't yours, brat. Hand it over and I'll leave you both your legs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Come and take it, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Brave. I like brave. Brave screams louder.

objectives.text: Search the fallen bandits for clues
Speak with the masked wanderer at the stream

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang ran again. He is a coward with good instincts, which is the most dangerous kind.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You found a Blood Moon token. Do you know how many people will kill for that? Now more will.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then help me. Tell me what's happening.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon rises. That is all you need to know. Tell your sect master, and trust fewer people than you'd like.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people. Right. I trust {player} and my buns. That's two. Very exclusive.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Seeing the Prisoners Home
quests.summary: The freed mortals from Qingshi are too frightened to travel alone. Someone has to walk them to the forest edge.

objectives.text: Investigate the hidden valley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the hidden valley the air is so still you can hear petals land on the grass.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted wolves at the hidden valley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: One foot in front of the other, that's all. Nobody's chasing you now. Well. Probably nobody.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Iron-Fang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the corrupted wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Farmer's Thanks
quests.summary: One of the freed farmers presses a keepsake into your hand before the others hurry him along.

objectives.text: Light incense at the offering table at the carved buddhas

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It isn't much, he says, pressing a carved wooden bird into your palm. My daughter made it. Find her a name to hate.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The dust on the offering table has been disturbed. Beneath the incense bowl lies a folded note.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The carved buddhas is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Hermit.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the carved buddhas

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the carved buddhas. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the tiger ridge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the tiger ridge.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Stragglers of the Camp
quests.summary: Not every bandit fled with Iron-Fang. A few stayed behind for the crates nobody carried off.

objectives.text: Study the map table at the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Drive the bandits from the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The bandits have found you first.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the smugglers' trail
Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Wei Tong's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Ye Wuming, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: The bandits left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: What the Camp Left Behind
quests.summary: Amid the trampled tents, useful things remain: medicine, rope, a bandit's half-eaten dinner.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Waste not. Iron-Fang isn't using it anymore, and my dinner is a distant memory.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Hermit.

objectives.text: Find the blood lotus at the poison marsh
Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the blood lotus you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Den, One More Time
quests.summary: Wei Tong wants to check the wolf king's den once more, to be sure nothing else was left to fester there.

objectives.text: Search the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sunken courtyard before the buried temple is cold and dim. Water drips from the roots overhead.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Just a look. In and out. I have said that before and been wrong, but I mean it more this time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Wolves Still Restless
quests.summary: A few corrupted wolves remain, confused and dangerous without their king to answer to.

objectives.text: Head to the waterwheel

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Water spills from the paddles of the waterwheel in bright ribbons, and moss grows thick on its axle.

objectives.text: Clear the waterwheel of corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Recover rune fragments from the waterwheel
Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: No argument here.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

quests.title: Breath Among the Bamboo
quests.summary: Before the long walk back, Wei Tong insists on a proper rest and a proper breathing exercise.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo would skin me if I marched you home exhausted. Sit. Breathe. I'll guard, and eat, in that order.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Ye Wuming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the giant banyan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your pendant warms against your chest as the qi settles, strand by strand.

objectives.text: Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ah. The kettle can stop worrying. It has been worrying since you left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: The Hermit's Parting Word
quests.summary: Before you leave the forest, the hermit has one more thing to say about the token and the mask.

objectives.text: Make your way to the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the village shrine is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Leave an offering at the offering table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You leave an offering on the offering table and bow. The candle flames bow back.

objectives.text: Talk it over with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That wanderer isn't lying to you. He also isn't telling you everything. Neither, child, am I.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Will you, one day?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One day. Not today. Today, just walk carefully.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Twelfth Bun
quests.summary: Somehow, impossibly, Wei Tong still has one bun left. He shares it, which is how you know it's serious.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Last one. I was saving it for an emergency. This feels like the end of an emergency, so: here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Ye Wuming agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the mushroom ring

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: The Long Walk Back
quests.summary: The forest thins toward the road, and your cultivation has thinned with it too, into something steadier.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're breathing different. Deeper. Elder Mo's going to notice and pretend he doesn't care.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Hermit. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

objectives.text: Temper your realm at the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe in for four, hold for four. Qi gathers below your navel like water in a cupped hand.

objectives.text: See Wei Tong again

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Ye Wuming. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: Report to the Law Hall
quests.summary: Return to the sect with the Blood Moon token and report to the Law Hall.

objectives.text: Return to the Azure Cloud Sect

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Home! I can smell the kitchens from here. Tell Elder Gu about the token, I'll tell the cook about my stomach.

objectives.text: Present the token to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A Blood Moon command token. Where did a bandit get this?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: His buyer, I think. They're kidnapping mortals from Qingshi. And a masked man warned us the Blood Moon is rising.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Rumours and masks. The Law Hall will take this into custody and investigate. Properly. Hand it over.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You did well, disciple. Now forget you ever saw it. That is an order.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Mo about the mission

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu took the token? Well, it is his right. The Law Hall handles matters of the demonic path.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Still. Kidnapped mortals, fed wolves, command tokens. I don't like the shape of this.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I'll speak to the Sect Master. Wei Tong says you carried him on your back. Hmph. Good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Like a sack of rice, Elder. A heroic sack of rice. With legs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He ate twelve buns on the way home. I felt every one of them.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Town That Whispers
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you and Han Xue to Qingshi Town, where the freed captives say people vanish every new moon.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's orders

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The captives you freed are from Qingshi. They say someone takes people every new moon, and nobody stops it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall is investigating the token. I want eyes in the town. Han Xue will go with you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mortals are not our subjects, {player}. They are our reason. Remember that.

objectives.text: Watch your arrival at Qingshi Town
Speak with the constable at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Cultivators. Finally. I sent three petitions to the yamen and two to the gods. You're the first to answer.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Eleven people in four months. Farmers, a fisherman's boy, a young man from your sect visiting his mother.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: From our sect?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Said his name was Xiao Shi. Asked too many questions. Then one morning he didn't come back from the river.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Constable Du, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Drunken Crane
quests.summary: Every rumour in Qingshi passes through the Drunken Crane Inn. Then pay your respects to the magistrate.

objectives.text: Walk the main street of Qingshi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shutters close as you pass. A mother pulls her son indoors. The town looks at your sect robes like a sick man at a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're afraid. Not of us. Of whatever makes people disappear.

objectives.text: Ask Madam Fang for gossip at the inn

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Immortals in my inn! Sit, sit. Wine is ten coppers, noodles are five, gossip is free but you must tip.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: People vanish at the new moon, yes. And the temple keeper buries whoever the river gives back.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Poor Keeper Hong. Such a gentle old man. He cries at every funeral, even the dogs'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The river gives some of them back?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Only bits, dear. Only bits. More wine?

objectives.text: Pay respects to Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Ah, the immortals. Welcome, welcome. As you can see, the yamen has matters entirely in hand.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: People wander off. Mortals are like that. Gambling, debts, pretty widows in other towns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Eleven of them, Magistrate?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: A rounded number! Bring me proof, and the yamen will act. Until then, please don't frighten the tax base.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: A Mother's Grief
quests.summary: A widow at the town well lost her son to the new moon. The ferryman may have seen something on the river.

objectives.text: Comfort the widow at the well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My Liu Er went to fetch the nets at dusk. The river was calm. He swam like a fish, my boy.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: They say he drowned. His body never came back. The river gives back everyone eventually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll find out what happened to him. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Don't promise, young immortal. Promises are heavy. Just look. That's enough.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we'll look, Madam Liu. Both of us. Very carefully.

objectives.text: Question the old ferryman at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Seen something? Forty years on this water, I've seen everything twice.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: New moon, two months back. Lanterns moving on the far bank, toward the hill graves. Pale folk, carrying sacks.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Sacks that wriggled. I told the magistrate. He told me to drink less. I drink exactly the right amount.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

objectives.text: Search the river bank

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among the reeds: a broken sandal, a torn net, and footprints leading uphill, pressed deep, as if carrying weight.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Five people. One dragged. Toward the graveyard.

objectives.text: Test the well water for blood qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The well water is clean. Whatever took the townsfolk did not poison them. It wanted them healthy.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Healthy blood. That's worse, somehow.

quests.title: Market of Rumours
quests.summary: Blood lotus is a demonic herb, yet someone in Qingshi is buying it by the crate. Follow the money.

objectives.text: Listen to the gossip in the market square

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Smell that? Beneath the fried dough. Blood lotus. It's used in demonic pills.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's coming from the guild carts. They're heading to the warehouse.

objectives.text: Question Merchant Jin at the warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Jin Baoshan, master of the merchant guild. What an honour. Buying? Selling? Leaving?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Blood lotus? Never heard of it. Is it a flower? We deal in silk, tea and entirely legal things.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your crates are dripping red, Master Jin.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Imported beets. Very juicy. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a pressing appointment elsewhere. Anywhere.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

objectives.text: Search the guild's crates

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the silk bolts: dried blood lotus, bundled by the dozen, and a ledger.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every entry is paid in silver by a buyer who signs with a crescent moon. Deliveries: the hill graves, at the new moon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The graveyard again. Jin knows exactly who he's selling to.

quests.title: The Back Alley
quests.summary: A scream in the night. Somebody is being taken right now.

objectives.text: Follow the scream into the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Masked figures in black and crimson drag a struggling woman toward the town wall.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Demonic cultivators. Inside the town walls. {player}, left side. I'll take the right.

objectives.text: Rescue the woman from the demonic cultivators
Pick up the talismans the attackers dropped
Regroup with Han Xue on the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sleep talismans. Blood-ink. These people know the town, the patrols, even which windows don't lock.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And I saw someone on the rooftops, watching. A masked man. He didn't help. He didn't run either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I've met him. In the bamboo forest. He warned me about the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A man who knows that much about demons... either hunts them, or is one.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Cultivators! The woman is home, shaking but whole. I'm doubling the night watch. Tell me what else to do.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's... not in the book. I'll invent a page.

quests.title: The Masked Stranger
quests.summary: Han Xue suspects the masked wanderer. Madam Fang says a masked guest has been renting her top room.

objectives.text: Ask Madam Fang about the masked guest

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The mask? Pays in old coins, never eats, never drinks, never smiles. My ideal guest, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: He goes up the watchtower every night and stares at the fields. Romantic, or murderous. Could be both.

objectives.text: Climb the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the tower, the terraced fields shine under a thin moon. A lone figure stands among the rice, looking up at you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He knows we're here. He wants us to come.

objectives.text: Confront the masked wanderer in the fields

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've been talking about me. I'm flattered. Also, you're wrong.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then explain why you're always near demons.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Because I hunt them. I've tracked this nest for a year. Ask who tends the dead in this town.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The temple keeper? Everyone says he's gentle.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Everyone said I was gentle once, too. Look beneath his graves. Then decide who to trust.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Ye Wuming) That was cold.

quests.title: Lanterns Among the Graves
quests.summary: Search the hillside graveyard, where the ledger's deliveries and the ferryman's lanterns both lead.

objectives.text: Search the hillside graveyard at night

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fresh graves, far too many. Each mound is marked with a neat temple tablet and a sprig of dried blood lotus.

objectives.text: Examine the rune circle beneath the graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush the soil aside. The graves are empty, and beneath them runs a circle of blood-ink runes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A blood-gathering formation. Whoever's buried here never died here. They were taken somewhere, alive.

objectives.text: Gather the blood-ink rune stones as proof
Decide what to do with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The tablets are temple tablets. Only Keeper Hong carves these.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Madam Fang said he cries at every funeral.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Some people cry at funerals because they're sad. Others because they're hungry. Let's pay him a visit.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Visit him in daylight. A man who wears a kind face is weakest when he has to keep smiling.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rune fragments came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Temple Keeper
quests.summary: Visit Keeper Hong at the town temple, and watch his hands.

objectives.text: Visit Keeper Hong at the temple

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Young immortals! Come in, come in. Tea? It's a special blend. Very calming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It smells of blood lotus, Keeper.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't drink it, {player}. Keeper, put the cup down. Slowly.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Does it? Old nose, old tea. Such strong young cultivators. Such... vigorous blood.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: And that pendant. Green jade, lotus-carved. Oh, the Patriarch will be so very pleased with me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: keeper_hong
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: keeper_hong
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: keeper_hong
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

objectives.text: Watch the temple keeper reveal himself
Fight through Hong's acolytes on the main street

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Hold them, my children! I must prepare the graves!

quests.title: Blood Beneath the Graves
quests.summary: Keeper Hong, a deacon of the Blood Moon, has fled to his blood formation in the graveyard. The magistrate can no longer look away.

objectives.text: Rally the magistrate

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The temple keeper? I had tea with him every week! He blessed my house! He... he blessed my house.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I was a fool and a coward. The yamen guards are yours. Tell me what to do.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Twelve guards, Magistrate. Twelve spears, and one very old drum. We're ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep the townsfolk indoors. We'll end this tonight.

objectives.text: Storm the graveyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune circle burns red. Keeper Hong stands at its centre, his kindly face peeling away like wet paper.

objectives.text: Defeat Deacon Hong of the Blood Moon

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Three hundred hearts I have gathered for the Patriarch. Yours will make it three hundred and one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your patriarch is dead.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Dead? Oh, child. He is only hungry.

objectives.text: Follow the dying deacon to his temple

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Too late. The taken are already in the Abyss. The Blood Moon Abyss. Their blood drips on the seal as we speak.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: You think your sect protects you? The Patriarch has friends in high halls. Very high.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_hong
dialogue.text: Lotus-bearer... he is coming for you. He has always been coming for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: keeper_hong
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: keeper_hong
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: keeper_hong
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Wounded of the Watch
quests.summary: Constable Du's guards took wounds fighting Hong's acolytes. The Medicine Hall's supplies are thin this far from the mountain.

objectives.text: Scout the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lower docks smell of fish, tar and river mud. Gulls argue over everything.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Look for Constable Du at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Three men down, none dying, all complaining. I'll take that trade. Can you spare anything for them?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Captain Lei.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Kindly done. The town remembers kindness.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Unlawful, strictly. Effective, though.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Hong's Temple, By Daylight
quests.summary: By daylight, the temple looks smaller, sadder, and full of things Keeper Hong never wanted found.

objectives.text: Hurry to the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind a false wall: robes, a second set of temple seals, and a stack of letters written in a crescent-marked hand.

objectives.text: Taste the wine jars

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The smell from the wine jars is sweet and strong. Beneath it is something sharper, and not wine at all.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Han Xue. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: What the Graves Gave Up
quests.summary: The rune circle is broken, but its stones still hum faintly. Han Xue wants every fragment collected and studied.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Every piece. Elder Bai will want to compare them to the archive, if the archive still remembers anything useful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk at the dye yard
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Constable Du. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Last of Hong's Acolytes
quests.summary: A handful of Hong's masked acolytes scattered into the fields rather than fight. They haven't gone far.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the terraced fields
Tell Madam Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Not now, Huo Da. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Names? Faces? Anything I can write down, cultivator?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wipe your boots! This floor has seen a tax collector.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Magistrate Zhou's Accounting
quests.summary: Zhou insists on personally accounting for every silver coin Hong ever accepted from the yamen's coffers.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Every donation, every blessing fee, all of it laundered piety. I should have smelled it. I only smelled the incense.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Magistrate Zhou thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Han Xue. {player} has never let us down.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Captain Lei. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Hear what Constable Du has to say

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Magistrate Zhou.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Ferryman's Second Story
quests.summary: Old Pan remembers something else about the lantern-bearers, now that he isn't afraid of being called a drunk.

objectives.text: See what Old Pan wants

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: There was a barge, once. Heavier than it looked, riding low in the water. I thought it was grain. It wasn't grain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Old Pan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the humpbacked bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Madam Fang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Merchant Jin's Ledger, Fully Open
quests.summary: With Hong exposed, Merchant Jin suddenly remembers every detail of the blood lotus trade, eager to be the first to confess.

objectives.text: Go to the examination cells

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Graffiti of despair covers the examination cells. 'Third attempt' reads one. 'Fourth' reads the next.

objectives.text: Sort the scroll rack

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You work along the scroll rack scroll by scroll. One is shelved in the wrong place, on purpose.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I kept records! Excellent records! Dates, amounts, a little map. Innocent people keep excellent records, yes?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Merchant Jin) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Steadying the Town's Qi
quests.summary: The graveyard's blood formation left the land itself uneasy. Han Xue asks you to help settle it.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Land remembers fear the way people do. Sit with it a while. Let it feel something else for a change.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Magistrate Zhou.

objectives.text: Circulate your qi at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The world goes quiet. Your meridians hum, a little wider than yesterday.

objectives.text: Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Merchant Jin. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Widow Liu's Question
quests.summary: Widow Liu asks, carefully, whether the Blood Moon Abyss is a place a person could still be found alive.

objectives.text: Speak with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You said he might be alive. I need to know if that was kindness or truth. I can live with either. I need to know which.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Pan. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.text: Find Madam Fang at the temple fair

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: actress_yu
dialogue.text: Tonight I die of heartbreak. Tomorrow, of poison. Sundays I rest.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Not now, Yu Hongxiu. Later. Over wine.

objectives.text: Join Old Pan at the watermill

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: What Qingshi Taught You
quests.summary: Before the road home, Han Xue says your qi has changed here, hardened by something more than training.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You didn't just get stronger in this town. You got sure of something. That matters more, usually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Madam Fang.

objectives.text: Consolidate your cultivation at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
