dialogue.text: Your pendant warms against your chest as the qi settles, strand by strand.

objectives.text: Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Widow Liu. Widow Liu won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Fair's fair.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: A Debt of Qingshi
quests.summary: Qingshi is safe for now. Keep your word to the town before you return to the sect.

objectives.text: Tell Widow Liu the truth

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your son didn't drown. He was taken. To a place called the Blood Moon Abyss. He may still be alive.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Alive? Don't... don't give me hope unless you mean it, immortal.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We saw his formation, Madam Liu. They wanted the taken alive. That hope is real.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I mean it. I'll look for him. For him and for everyone they took.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Then I'll keep the water sweet until you do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu has nothing left for her son's memorial.

choices.text: Give her your whole allowance

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Promise the sect will keep searching for him

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: You've done enough. Leave.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Widow Liu) That was cold.

objectives.text: Accept Madam Fang's thanks

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The heroes of Qingshi! Free noodles for life. Well, for a year. Well, one bowl. Today. Eat quickly.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Truly, dear. Thank you. That old snake served me tea for ten years. I'll be checking my teeth for a month.

objectives.text: Cleanse the defiled temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You burn clean incense and let your qi wash through the hall. The smell of blood lotus fades, and a sparrow returns to the eaves.

objectives.text: Head home with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He said the Patriarch has friends in high halls. Very high.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You think someone in our sect...

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I think we should say it only to the Sect Master. And we should find out where Xiao Shi is before his sister does.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Sealed Doors
quests.summary: The main hall is shut and sealed with gold paper. Elder Mo says the Sect Master entered seclusion the night you left.

objectives.text: Report at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The doors of the main hall are shut and sealed with a strip of gold paper. Behind them, the Azure Eye hums louder than you remember.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: She went into seclusion the night you left for Qingshi. The Azure Eye has been flickering, and she won't say why.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder, the deacon said the Patriarch has friends in high halls.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Mo is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Then we tell her and no one else. Write your report. I'll slip it under her door myself.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Meanwhile you'll do what disciples do. Work, eat, stay out of trouble. Two out of three will do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Mo) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Points on the Stele
quests.summary: Outer disciples earn contribution points by doing the sect's chores. Your name on the stele has a very lonely zero beside it.

objectives.text: Investigate the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The contribution stele lists every outer disciple and their points. Beside your name, a single zero sits like an egg.

objectives.text: Read the contribution stele

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang: four hundred and twelve. Wei Tong: nine, and a note in Steward Qian's hand that says 'dumplings are not a contribution'.

objectives.text: Show Lu Ping what you found

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Points buy pills, manuals, a better bunk. Or you can do what I do and earn them by being charming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: How many points has charm earned you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You've got mud to the knees and a grin to the ears. Wipe off one of them.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Mo. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Three. But they were very charming points. Go see Steward Qian, he's handing out chores.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Missing Spirit Stones
quests.summary: Steward Qian swears the treasury is short by eleven spirit stones and that somebody in this sect is a thief.

objectives.text: Answer Steward Qian's summons

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Eleven spirit stones! Gone! I count them every night and every morning, and twice at lunch.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Hua. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Are you certain, Steward Qian? I've seen {them} trip over a doorstep.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: No lock broken, no seal touched. A thief who walks through walls. Find them, and I'll write you ten points.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Ten? For eleven stones?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Nine, then. Don't haggle with a steward, disciple. We're born haggling.

objectives.text: Follow the glinting trail through the plum garden
Bring word to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Under a plum tree? In a nest? Lined with my stones? Show me the thief.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: A spirit ferret, Steward. It likes shiny things. It has also stolen three hairpins and somebody's spectacles.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: We all were, Han Xue. We all were.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Elder Bai's spectacles! He's been reading with his nose for a week. Ten points. No, eleven. I'm generous.

objectives.choice_prompt: The ferret's nest also holds a jade hairpin that nobody has reported missing.

choices.text: Hand it to Steward Qian's lost-and-found

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Ask around quietly and return it yourself

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Keep it. Nobody's looking for it.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Puppets Before Breakfast
quests.summary: Wei Tong has taken on a class of brand-new disciples and would like a demonstration that does not end in tears.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: New disciples! Twelve of them, and they all looked at the puppets like they were ghosts.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Old Bao. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Show them it can be done. Politely. With your feet, not your elbows. You know the speech.

objectives.text: Demonstrate on the training puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Watch the stance, everyone! Look how bored the puppet looks. That's how you know it's losing.

objectives.text: See Wei Tong again

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Twelve disciples, twelve dropped jaws. One of them asked if you were an elder. I said yes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Senior Brother!

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha. Old Bao's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It got them to stand up straight! Here, a steamed bun. Contribution points are nice, buns are nicer.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Dust in the Fourth Floor
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants the Blood Moon War chronicles copied before anything else goes missing from his shelves.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: My spectacles are back, and I can see again, which means I can see how much work there is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai, you've been in the pagoda for three days. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I had a very nourishing scroll.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I want every scroll that mentions the Blood Moon War copied, twice, and hidden in two places. Humour an old man.

objectives.text: Sort the scroll rack at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pagoda's fourth floor smells of dust and camphor. A gap on the east shelf shows where something was taken.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The scroll rack creaks under a century of learning. The scroll you need is behind the scroll everyone takes.

objectives.text: Copy the war chronicles in the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You copy until your wrist aches. The chronicles praise the Azure Cloud's founder, and mention an ally only once, as 'our green friends'.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: 'Our green friends.' Always that phrase. Someone went to great trouble to make a whole sect into a footnote.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Well? Did you keep your guard up, or did you just get lucky?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Answer Elder Mo, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Put your copy behind the turtle soup recipes. Nobody ever reads those. Except me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Wolves Under the Wall
quests.summary: Howling again, beyond the outer pines. The wolves are thin, frightened, and closer to the sect than wolves should be.

objectives.text: Search the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the outer pines, three wolves watch you with ordinary grey eyes. Not red. Only hungry, and afraid of something behind them.

objectives.text: Stop the spirit wolves at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Drive them off, don't kill them if you can. Their eyes are clean. Something chased them here.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They came from the bamboo forest. Whatever was feeding the wolf king blood, the rest of the pack remembers it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The deacon's dead. Who's still doing it?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the right question. Keep asking it quietly. Some people in this sect dislike questions.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Contribution by Kindness
quests.summary: The sect is short-handed with the Medicine Hall's apprentice away on the herb caravan. Chores pile up in odd places.

objectives.text: See what Elder Hua wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Xiao Man has gone south with the herb caravan for the season, and I've discovered she did the work of three.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Elder, the third kiln sneezed again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then feed it less charcoal and more patience, Hongyu.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I need the drying racks turned. I need the moonbell fed. Please don't ask what moonbell eats.

objectives.text: Meet Lu Ping at the medicine valley

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're doing Xiao Man's chores? She waters the gate lanterns, you know. I never asked why. Now you can.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why does she water the lanterns?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Luck, she says. And nothing's attacked the gate since she started. Mostly nothing.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the medicine valley

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eleven points for a ferret, four for puppets, six for the Medicine Hall. You're climbing the stele.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Don't grin. The stele is stone. It doesn't care, and neither do I.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: ...I'm told I'm grinning. I'm not. Go away.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Elder Mo, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: A Letter Under the Door
quests.summary: Someone else slid a letter under the Sect Master's sealed door. Elder Mo found it, and does not like the handwriting.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Mo out

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Your report went under her door. So did another, this morning. Unsigned, and folded in the Law Hall's way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I don't read other people's letters. I read the envelopes. This one smelled of blood lotus.

objectives.text: Head to the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Faint footprints lead from the sealed doors toward the scholar rock and the Law Hall beyond, then vanish on swept stone.

objectives.text: Examine the sealed hall doors

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gold seal is intact. Your pendant warms as you pass it, as if the doors were breathing on the other side.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Law Hall folding and blood lotus. Might mean nothing. The Law Hall handles evidence, and evidence smells.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Look at that stance. A strong wind would file a complaint.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Elder Mo. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Might mean something. Tell no one but Elder Mo. And me. You've told me, so that's done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Bell Nobody Rang
quests.summary: At midnight the gate bell sounds once, then stops. Lu Ping swears he didn't touch it. Something is testing the wall.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I didn't ring it! I was asleep. I mean, meditating. The bell rang itself, once, and then the pines went quiet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Lu Ping said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: See? Even Wei Tong agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Quiet like a held breath. I hate that kind of quiet.

objectives.text: Ring the gate bell to wake the watch

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell booms. Lanterns flare along the wall, and in the pines something that was creeping forward stops, and turns.

objectives.text: Defeat the spirit wolves at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey wolves come out of the dark, and behind them, a pair of eyes the colour of old blood that does not come closer.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Those eyes at the back. Red. Like the wolf king's. It didn't fight. It watched.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It counted us. Like Hong counted graves.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Lu Ping. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I didn't need that thought tonight. I'm going to sleep with Dumpling under my pillow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: By the precepts! I know those! Well, most of them!

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: The Weapon Rack's Complaint
quests.summary: Wei Tong swears someone keeps nicking the good practice swords and returning them blunt.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Blunt! Every one! Either a very lazy thief or a very dedicated one. I need to know which.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

objectives.text: Make your way to the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the weapon rack, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Join Steward Qian at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Steward Qian is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Steward Qian, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is not a well. It is a very small cup.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: A Blunted Sword
quests.summary: The training swords are dulled the same way every time: one long, deliberate scrape, not a fight.

objectives.text: Scout the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The nicks run the same direction on every blade. Someone is sharpening something else against them, carefully, at night.

objectives.text: Sound the bronze bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: We're done at the hall steps. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Did anything bite you? Sting you? Look at you strangely? Tell me everything.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Lu Ping's Theory
quests.summary: Lu Ping has a theory about the blunted swords involving ghosts, romance, or possibly both.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A ghost polishing its own sword on ours! Or a secret lover sharpening a gift! I have several theories and no evidence.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find a book with turtle soup stains on it, it's mine. Return it.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Old Qiu has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Elder Hua, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Something in the Armoury at Night
quests.summary: Whatever is using the training swords for a whetstone comes back after dark. Time to catch it in the act.

objectives.text: Hurry to the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Straw dummies lean at tired angles across the training ground. One of them is wearing a hat.

objectives.text: Drive the training puppets from the training ground

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Training puppets! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the training ground
Tell Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Oil for the Locks
quests.summary: Steward Qian wants the armoury's old locks oiled before he'll believe anyone stopped breaking in.

objectives.text: Report to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: New locks cost money. Oil costs less. Guess which one the treasury prefers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steward, I need a new lantern for the gate.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You needed a new lantern last month, Lu Ping. What did you do with it?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the outer dormitories
Go back to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a scratch? Let me check. Hm. One scratch. I'll allow it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Elder Hua. Heaven bless {them}.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Sparring Zhao Kang's Attendants Again
quests.summary: Zhao Kang's attendants want a rematch, on the theory that the first loss was luck.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They insist. I told them it was unwise. They never listen to the wise one among us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Clear the summit of Sword Peak of sparring disciples

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sparring disciples spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Fan Rui. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (beaming at Zhao Kang) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Zhao Kang) Oh.

quests.title: The Cloud-Step, Slower
quests.summary: Elder Mo says you're rushing the Cloud-Step Breathing. Slower, he insists, is faster in the end.

objectives.text: See what Elder Mo wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You're gathering qi like you're late for dinner. Slow down. The mountain isn't going anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Deacon Shen. I asked who would go.

objectives.text: Meditate at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe in for four, hold for four. Qi gathers below your navel like water in a cupped hand.

objectives.text: Bring word to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Recorded, sealed and posted. Three hundred points, and my personal nod.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we trained in the snow. Uphill. With buckets.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Elder Bai's Missing Bookmark
quests.summary: Elder Bai has lost a bookmark somewhere in the pagoda, and refuses to keep reading until it's found.

objectives.text: Go to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the spirit beast garden not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It's not the bookmark. It's the principle. A man who loses his place loses his argument.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Letter, Finally
quests.summary: A letter arrives from Xiao Shi at last, and Xiao Man wants someone to read it with her before she does.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Man out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: What if it's bad news? What if it's good news and I've been worrying for nothing? Just... stand here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Ignore Wei Tong. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the weapon rack. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Tang Ling. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

objectives.text: Talk with Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the incense cauldron.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Come back with all your fingers. I've grown used to counting ten.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: A Door Still Sealed
quests.summary: The main hall's doors remain shut. Elder Mo says the wait itself is a kind of training, and a poor one.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Patience is a virtue. So is not saying 'patience' to someone who's run out of it. Sit. Breathe. Again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Mo is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.text: Refine your cultivation at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The world goes quiet. Your meridians hum, a little wider than yesterday.

objectives.text: See Elder Mo again

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Steward Qian says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Back straight. I won't say it again. I will say it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Fair. Fair's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Stele Remembers You
quests.summary: Your points are enough for a cultivation manual and an hour at the formation's edge. Qi gathers faster than it did in spring.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough points for a manual. Choose the Cloud-Step Breathing. It is boring. Boring is how you get strong.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Mo says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go and sit on the stone bridge. Don't come back until your breath is longer than your excuses.

objectives.text: Temper your realm at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Cloud-Step Breathing is boring, exactly as promised. Your qi does not care. It gathers, and gathers, and rises a level.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: When you open your eyes, the pond is full of stars, and your meridians feel like rivers after rain.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Middle stage. Adequate. Back straight, though. The pond saw you slouching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (nods slowly to Elder Mo) A careful answer.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Baskets for the Bamboo
quests.summary: Elder Hua is taking the Medicine Hall to the bamboo forest for the autumn harvest, and you have been volunteered as a mule.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Twelve baskets, three disciples, one forest. The moonbell sprouts are ripe and they won't pick themselves. They bite, remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Wei Tong has gone ahead to 'scout'. That means he's found somewhere to eat. Find him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: And if he's eaten the baskets?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then you'll carry the herbs in your robe. Go on.

objectives.text: Investigate the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest path is carpeted in gold leaves. It is almost peaceful, if you forget the last time you walked it.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I scouted. The mushrooms by the stream are delicious. Well, one was. The other was educational.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Elder Hua. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The grove's further in. I didn't want to go alone. Not after last time. Let's go together.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Ash on the Moonbell
quests.summary: The herb grove's moonbell is spotted with grey ash that smears like blood when you touch it.

objectives.text: Search the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Half the moonbell in the grove is spotted grey. When you rub the spots, your fingers come away red.

objectives.text: Pick the healthy moonbell
Join Elder Hua at the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Blood qi, in the soil. The grove is drinking it up from somewhere deeper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Qu Wanqing. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Healthy ones in this basket, sick ones in that one. Don't eat either. Wei Tong, I'm looking at you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to Elder Hua, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Tea With the Hermit
quests.summary: The hermit of the bamboo is expecting you. He has poured three cups, which is one more than there are of you.

objectives.text: Head to the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three cups of tea steam on the hermit's step. He looks at your baskets, then at the grey ash on your fingers.

objectives.text: Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ash on the moonbell. Ah. The den still bleeds, then. Old wounds in the earth close slower than in people.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The wolf king's den? The wolf king is dead.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Han Xue says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The wolf is. The blood they poured into him is not. It soaked down, and down, and is still looking for a way up.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The third cup is for your Elder Hua. She never drinks it. I keep pouring. That is what hope looks like at my age.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The bamboo bends. So did you. It is not always wrong.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: The Den Still Bleeds
quests.summary: Down in the old wolf den, the rock weeps red. Something has moved in to drink from it.

objectives.text: Make your way to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wolf den breathes warm air. Red water seeps from cracks in the rock and pools in the hollows.

objectives.text: Fight off the corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Wolves. Red-eyed ones. I thought we'd seen the last of these. Dumpling, wake up!

objectives.text: Collect the blood-soaked earth for Elder Hua
Talk it over with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They weren't a pack. They were just... drinking. Like moths at a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we put out the lamp.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Hermit. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Roots in the Red Rock
quests.summary: The blood seeps from a seal carved deep in the den, far older than the wolf king and nothing like Keeper Hong's work.

objectives.text: Scout the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the back of the den a round seal is carved into the rock: a moon swallowing a sword, ringed with runes worn nearly smooth.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Look carefully. Old places keep their secrets in the corners.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Let's not stay long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let me look first.

objectives.text: Gather the loose rune chips around the seal
Scrub the blood-rune seal with the hermit's salt

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The salt hisses. Red runs out of the grooves. For a moment the seal glows green at its edges, answering your pendant.

objectives.text: Break the corrupted wolves at the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somewhere in the grove behind you, the last of the drinking wolves howl, and come.

objectives.text: Hurry to the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the clearing the air smells clean for the first time today. Even the bamboo seems to stand up straighter.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts
Take it to the elders as evidence
Keep it. It could be useful.

quests.title: Salt, Sutras and Silence
quests.summary: The hermit says the seal must be quieted with a still heart, not a sword. He means yours.

objectives.text: Report to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon carved that seal three centuries ago, to bleed this forest slowly. Somebody has been feeding it again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: If anything smells sweet in there, hold your breath. Sweet is how poison says hello.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A sword would crack it. A quiet heart will close it. Go and sit beside it, and be very dull for an hour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Wei Tong says I'm good at being dull.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your friend is wise in unexpected directions.

objectives.text: Still your heart beside the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe with the spring. Far off, deep in the den, a knot in the earth loosens, and the red in the water thins to nothing.

objectives.text: Go back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Closed. For now. The forest thanks you. It thanks you by not trying to eat you tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Answer Han Xue, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Bandits at the Harvest
quests.summary: Scavengers from Iron-Fang's broken gang have smelled the Medicine Hall's baskets. Rare herbs sell well in the lowlands.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Senior Sister Han Xue, reporting for basket duty. Elder Mo sent me. He said you'd find trouble within the hour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, did you eat? You never eat. Here, half a bun. The bigger half.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...Thank you. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bandits on the path. Six. They want the herbs. I want them to leave. Let's see who's more persuasive.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

objectives.text: Stop the bandits at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The bandits come on in silence.

objectives.text: Defeat the bandits at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: More on the bridge! These ones have Iron-Fang's red headbands. The gang didn't scatter as far as we hoped.

objectives.text: Polish the bronze mirror at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bandits flee downstream, leaving one sandal and a very small, very old basket of stolen herbs.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back of the bronze mirror is carved with a lotus. The front shows the room behind you, and one extra shadow.

quests.title: What the Bandit Said
quests.summary: One bandit was too slow to run. He is young, frightened, and says something about families that nobody in the sect wants to hear.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: This one was too slow to run. He's younger than you. He keeps saying the chief made them do it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Hermit. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ask him. He won't talk to me. I apparently look like I bite.

objectives.text: Go to the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The young bandit won't meet your eyes. They took my mother, he whispers. Iron-Fang says if we don't pay, she doesn't eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Who took her? Iron-Fang?

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Not him. Them. The ones with the red moon. He shakes and says no more, and Han Xue lets him run home.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Families held against good behaviour. That is how they did it three hundred years ago, too. Some recipes never change.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Take your herbs home, child. And your questions. Keep the questions somewhere safer than the herbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: The young bandit is still tied up outside the hut, waiting to learn what you'll do with him.

choices.text: Let him go to warn his family

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Deliver him to the magistrate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Beat the rest of the truth out of him

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Moonbell Wine
quests.summary: The harvest is in. Elder Hua allows exactly one cup of moonbell wine, and the hermit finally drinks his tea.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Hua out

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The grove is healing, the baskets are full, and not one of my disciples was bitten. By moonbell. I count wolves separately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: No, Headman Kuang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Fetch the spring water for the wine. One cup each. I will be counting, and so will the moonbell.

objectives.text: Fill the flasks at the spirit spring
Pour the first cup at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You pour a cup onto the stones of the old shrine. A breeze turns the bamboo toward you, and the shrine's cracked lotus carving seems to lean closer.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She drank the tea. Forty years I've poured that cup. She drank it and called it bitter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is that good?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Hua. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It's a beginning. The bitter ones always are.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to the hermit, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Carry It Home
quests.summary: The Medicine Hall returns with full baskets and one worried Elder. On the road back, Elder Hua asks what the bandit said.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Han Xue says one of those bandits spoke to you. Families held hostage. By the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I've mended bandits before. They always said they had reasons. I never listened. I wonder now how many were true.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We'll tell Elder Mo, and the Sect Master when she comes out.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the fishing jetty

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I carried four baskets. Four! Elder Hua gave me one dried persimmon for my trouble.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Hua. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It was a very good persimmon. I'd carry four more. Don't tell her.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Drying the Harvest
quests.summary: The moonbell harvest needs turning on the drying racks before it spoils, and Elder Hua trusts exactly nobody else to do it right.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Turn them every hour, gently, like you'd turn a sleeping child. Wei Tong is not permitted near the racks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Hua says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

objectives.text: Recover wolf fangs from the buried temple
Report back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the wolf fangs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Wei Tong, Banned From the Racks
quests.summary: Banned from the drying racks, Wei Tong sulks with real dedication.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: One time! I turned them roughly one time! They were fine! Mostly fine!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If he offers you a bun before a fight, refuse. He'll share it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone fights better with a bun, Senior Sister. It's science.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the far forest gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll light the watch lantern for you. If you see it go out, run.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Pei Yuan, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Drink this. No, it doesn't taste good. That's how you know it works.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the mushroom ring

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I'll brew something for the road. It tastes like boiled boots, but it works.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to the hermit) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to the hermit) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (grinning at the hermit) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Hermit's Second Cup
quests.summary: The hermit still pours a third cup out of habit. This time he asks about the ruins to the north instead of drinking it himself.

objectives.text: Investigate the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mouth of the echo cave throws your footsteps back at you, a heartbeat late.

objectives.text: Snuff the soul lantern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The soul lantern hums with a trapped voice. You break the rune, and the flame goes out, gently.

objectives.text: Share your findings with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The ruins remember more than I let on. One day I'll take you there myself. Not today.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

quests.title: The Den's Last Echo
quests.summary: A few corrupted wolves still linger near the purified den, confused by the quiet.

objectives.text: Examine the soul lantern at the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You open the soul lantern. A breath of cold escapes, and a whisper that sounds like thank you.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs at the echo cave
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the forest crossroads isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the corrupted wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Guarding the Grove at Dusk
quests.summary: With the grove healing, Elder Hua wants a watch kept until the moonbell is safely dried and stored.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: One more night. If nothing else, it will teach you patience. If something does happen, it will teach you speed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Qu Wanqing?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

objectives.text: Beat the war drum

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The skin of the war drum is tight and ancient. One beat, and your heart falls into step with it.

objectives.text: Clear the charcoal kilns of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Finish the spirit wolves at the giant bamboo grove
Join the hermit at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Han Xue. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Breathing With the Bamboo
quests.summary: The hermit teaches a breathing pattern matched to the bamboo's own creak and sway.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends and does not break. Breathe like that. In, and bend. Out, and bend back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your pendant warms against your chest as the qi settles, strand by strand.

objectives.text: Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There you are! I was about to go looking with a torch and a very large spoon.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Wei Tong. We were attentive.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Han Xue's Quiet Watch
quests.summary: Han Xue takes a night watch alone and says little, which Wei Tong insists means she's thinking about something serious.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: She goes quiet before she says something important. Or before she's hungry. It's a coin flip, honestly.
