dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These training puppets fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Clean run! Zhao Kang did it faster, but he knocked one puppet's head into the lotus pond. Points off for littering.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Well? Is it true what they're saying? Which part? All the parts. I need all the parts.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're neck and neck. Elder Hua's pill test is next. That one I can't help you with. I once made a pill that exploded.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: A Pill Worth Passing
quests.summary: Elder Hua's test is simple: refine one Qi-Gathering Pill that doesn't explode. You'll need the right herbs first.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: One Qi-Gathering Pill. Three kinds of herb, one clean fire, and a hand that doesn't shake. Gather your own herbs.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Last year three disciples picked moonbell instead of mountain sage. They're fine now. They can almost whistle again.

objectives.text: Pick mountain sage on the terraces
Report back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mountain sage. Correct. Now the fire. Breathe. The cauldron can hear panic.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Elder Hua, have you seen my spectacles?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: On your head, Elder Bai. As they were yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill rolls out round and pale green, and smells faintly of rain. Elder Hua sniffs it and nods once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Pass. Zhao Kang's pill was perfect. Also, it had his clan's crest pressed into it. Show-off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your pill cracked a little at the edge, and Elder Hua didn't notice.

choices.text: Point out the crack yourself

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Say nothing. A pass is a pass.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Swap it for a spare from Zhao Kang's tray

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: The Night Before the Bout
quests.summary: The bout is at dawn. Han Xue gives advice, Elder Mo gives none, and Zhao Kang gives you a look you can't read.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang favours his left. He was taught by expensive masters, and they all had the same bad habit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Also, get some sleep. You look like a ghost that's worried about exams.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Advice? No. You know how to fight. The question is whether you know how to lose. Everyone should, once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't intend to lose, Elder.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nobody intends to. Hmph. Sleep.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard what Elder Gu said to you. About the ninth precept. He passed you. He's never passed anyone on the ninth.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Take a cup first. Tea steadies the hand and cools the head.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Auntie Ruo. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My brother was the last one who came close. Never mind. Tomorrow I'll beat you properly. Sleep well. I mean it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Zhao Kang at Dawn
quests.summary: The final bout of the examination: you and Zhao Kang, on the formation plaza, in front of every outer disciple.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bout of the outer examination! Zhao Kang against {player}! Wooden swords, clean strikes, no clan politics!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Wooden swords. How quaint. Don't cry when I win.

objectives.text: Win the examination bout

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang's attendants insist on 'assisting their young master'. Fine. Beat them too. Begin!

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Draw. Elder Mo called it a draw. A draw! I had you at the second exchange.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You had me at the fourth. I had you at the fifth.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Fine. A draw. The first time a draw hasn't felt like losing. Don't read anything into that.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (nods slowly to Zhao Kang) A careful answer.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Results on the Stele
quests.summary: The results are carved at the gate, and your name sits where nobody expected it to sit.

objectives.text: Make your way to the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A crowd at the stele. Your name is carved third from the top, level with Zhao Kang's. Lu Ping is weeping into his betting book.

objectives.text: Read the examination results

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: First: a quiet girl from Cloud Peak who nobody bet on. Joint second: Zhao Kang, and you.

objectives.text: Tell Lu Ping what you found

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Six to one! I had three stones on you and two on Zhao Kang. I've won and lost at the same time. Is this enlightenment?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a scratch? Let me check. Hm. One scratch. I'll allow it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: And the Cloud Peak girl! Nobody bet on her. Nobody even knew her name. It's Qiu Ling, by the way. I asked. Late.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Is that allowed? It is now, I suppose!

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Gu Hanshan's Question
quests.summary: Elder Gu summons you to the Law Hall after the results. He wants to know about your pendant, and about Qingshi.

objectives.text: See what Elder Gu wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Third place, and the ninth precept. You interest me, disciple. So does your report on Qingshi. It reached me too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Elder Gu thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Noted, Han Xue. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The deacon spoke of your pendant before he died. What did he say? Exactly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That the Patriarch would be pleased with him. Then that he is coming for me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Dying men say many things. Keep that jade close, and your mouth closer. The Law Hall will see to the rest.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He asked about the pendant? Before he asked about the deacon?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's nothing. It's his job. I'll keep telling myself that until it stops being true.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: Lanterns for the Passing
quests.summary: Every disciple who passed floats a lantern from the cliff edge. It is tradition, and slightly dangerous.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai out

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Lantern of Passing. Write what you want from your cultivation on the paper, then let the wind take it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Elder Bai said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lu Ping. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mine said 'more shelves'. Sixty years ago. Heaven has a slow delivery service.

objectives.text: Collect paper lanterns from the plaza
Release your lantern over the sea of clouds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your lantern drifts out over the sea of clouds with a hundred others. You wrote: to be strong enough to protect people.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside you, Zhao Kang's lantern says: to beat you. Beneath it, in smaller writing: and to make my brother proud.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't read other people's lanterns. It's the worst manners in the sect. What did yours say? No. Don't tell me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the lantern oil you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Late Autumn, Late Stage
quests.summary: Examination over, you have earned a month in the cultivation caves. Elder Mo walks you there himself.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A month in the caves. Your first. No food, no talk, no Wei Tong. Heaven's gift to you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Mo is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: If you open your eyes before the month is out, you'll find me outside, disappointed.

objectives.text: Cultivate in seclusion above the clouds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Days fold into each other. Your qi wears smooth grooves in your meridians, and deepens them, and deepens them again.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the last morning you open your eyes. Elder Mo is outside, asleep sitting up, a blanket on his knees.

objectives.text: Bring word to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I was not sleeping. I was guarding. Late stage of Qi Condensation? Adequate.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: What did you see? Leave nothing out. Small things matter most.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a long story. The short version: yes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Splendid. A footnote in history, at the very least. Possibly a whole paragraph.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Sect Master stirs, they say. Not yet. Soon. Go and eat something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Elder Mo, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Qiu Ling of Cloud Peak
quests.summary: The examination's surprise winner turns out to be quiet, unassuming, and mortified by all the attention.

objectives.text: Light the spirit lamp at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qiu Ling ducks behind a pillar rather than accept another compliment. I just breathed correctly, she mutters. Everyone's making it strange.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit lamp burns without oil and without smoke. It has been burning for someone for a very long time.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Old Qiu. A poor master.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Lu Ping. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Elder Bai agrees. It must be true.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The Law Hall's going to write you a very long letter.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Zhao Kang Wants a Rematch
quests.summary: A draw isn't good enough for Zhao Kang. He wants a decider, unofficial, no elders watching.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The draw doesn't count. Nothing was decided. I demand a decider. Quietly. No elders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Lu Ping. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: An outer disciple, for this? I will note it. The Law Hall notes everything.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Fight off the sparring disciples

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: More sparring disciples? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Still in one piece. I wasn't worried. I was sharpening things.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Betting Book's Aftermath
quests.summary: Lu Ping's betting book has made him either rich or the outer court's most hated disciple, and possibly both.

objectives.text: Scout the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great pill kilns glow in their yard like sleeping dragons, and the air shimmers with heat.

objectives.text: Tend the pill furnace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'm rich! I'm despised! Both at once! Is this what success feels like? I don't love it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Zhong Ming.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: What did you see? Leave nothing out. Small things matter most.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Restocking the Medicine Hall
quests.summary: The examination emptied Elder Hua's herb stores. She wants them replenished before winter.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Gu's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the medicine valley
Return to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Answer Tang Ling, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Puppets Left Overtuned
quests.summary: Wei Tong's 'mildly offended' puppet setting seems to have stuck on 'furious' after the gauntlet.

objectives.text: Read the rim of the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three legs, two handles, and a rim of ancient script: the bronze ding is older than the hall that shelters it.

objectives.text: Break the training puppets at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The training puppets come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather jade slips at the outer dormitories
Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I have read everything in the pagoda twice, and the recipes three times.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

quests.title: Elder Gu's Continued Interest
quests.summary: Elder Gu asks, again, to see the pendant, this time framing it as routine Law Hall record-keeping.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A formality. Every artifact within the sect's walls is catalogued. Yours, oddly, never was.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Elder Gu, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Join Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the gate post. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nobody tells the gate disciple anything. So I listen. Constantly.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the quiet pavilion.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: An outer disciple, for this? I will note it. The Law Hall notes everything.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Han Xue said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Han Xue's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Sitting With the Ninth Precept
quests.summary: Elder Gu's question about the seal lingers. Elder Mo suggests sitting with it rather than chasing an answer.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Not every question wants solving today. Sit with it. Let it season, like Wei Tong's terrible stew.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: No, Lu Ping. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe in for four, hold for four. Qi gathers below your navel like water in a cupped hand.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Adequate. Don't look so pleased.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Elder Bai's War Chronicles, Continued
quests.summary: Elder Bai has found another mention of 'our green friends' and wants a second pair of eyes on it.

objectives.text: Hurry to the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Disciples crowd the mission hall's boards, arguing over which chores pay the most contribution for the least mud.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Here! Again! Whoever wrote this really did not want the Verdant Lotus remembered. Curious, for allies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: What did you see? Leave nothing out. Small things matter most.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: (to Elder Bai) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: A Quiet Word From Han Xue
quests.summary: Han Xue asks, carefully, whether you plan to tell Elder Gu everything he asks for.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You don't owe every elder every truth. Even good ones. Especially the ones who keep asking twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Elder Hua. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: The third kiln sneezed again. I lost an eyebrow. It'll grow back. Last time it did.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Kiln-Mistress Tao. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold out your wrist. Hm. Your pulse is stubborn. Like you.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Winter Sets In
quests.summary: The first frost dusts the sect's roofs. Your cultivation has grown as steady as the season is cold.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Mo out

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Late Qi Condensation, holding firm. Winter's a good teacher. It doesn't care about your excuses either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Elder Mo does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Han Xue?

objectives.text: Temper your realm at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The world goes quiet. Your meridians hum, a little wider than yesterday.

objectives.text: Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eat something. You look like a boiled noodle with ambitions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Invitation From the Yamen
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou writes to the sect: Qingshi holds its Ghost Festival for the lost, and the town would like its heroes there.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The magistrate's written. The town's holding the Ghost Festival for everyone the new moon took. They want us there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I said yes. Then I realised I have to be polite for a whole day. Come with me. You're better at polite.

objectives.text: Go to the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Paper lanterns hang from every eave in Qingshi. Children fold boats from red paper. The whole town smells of incense and fried dough.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The heroes of Qingshi! Welcome, welcome. I have prepared a speech. It is only nine pages.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Constable Du says I should cut it to one. Constable Du has no poetry in his soul.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Paper Boats and Names
quests.summary: Widow Liu is folding a paper boat for her son, and asks you to write his name on it. She can't bring herself to.

objectives.text: Go and see Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Every boat carries a name down the river to the ones we lost. I've folded one for Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Constable Du. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Widow Liu) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I can't write it. My hand won't. Will you? You found out what happened to him. You should.

objectives.text: Buy lantern oil in the market for the boats
Launch Liu Er's boat on the river

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You write Liu Er in your neatest hand. The boat turns once in the current, as if looking back, then drifts away.

objectives.text: Bring word to Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He's not dead. I know you think he's not. I only let the boat go because the town expects it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then let it carry a message instead. We're coming.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Light some incense tonight, Han Xue. For luck.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: ...Yes. That's better. That's a much better boat.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more lantern oil than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The River Won't Take Them
quests.summary: The paper boats are drifting back to shore, upstream, against the current. Old Pan has never seen anything like it.

objectives.text: Answer Old Pan's summons

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water and I've never seen boats come back. Upstream. Against the current.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Old Pan says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The river's refusing the names. Or something under it is.

objectives.text: Investigate the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dozens of paper boats bob against the bank, pressed there by a current that runs the wrong way.

objectives.text: Touch the backward current with your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Cold, and a pull downward. A thread of old blood qi runs along the riverbed toward the hill graves.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hong's circle. We broke it. We didn't dig it out. Some of its roots must run under the river.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There you are. The noodles were getting cold, and so was my temper.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Madam Fang. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Festival or not, we have to look. Quietly. Nobody wants a panic at a funeral.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Things in the Reeds
quests.summary: Something drags itself out of the reeds after dark, drawn by the festival lanterns and the living warmth of the town.

objectives.text: Search the watermill

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The festival lanterns reflect on black water. Among the reeds, eyes. Many eyes, low to the ground.

objectives.text: Stop the spirit wolves at the watermill

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wolves! Soaked, starving, and blood-drunk. Keep them away from the boats, the children are still out!

objectives.text: Gather the lanterns the wolves scattered
Tell Constable Du what you found

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Wolves, in town, during the festival. I'm going to have to write a very long report.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Han Xue! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Thank you. The children didn't see. Well, they saw. They think it was a play. They want it again tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Constable Du) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Roots Under the Graves
quests.summary: Beneath the hill graves, the blood-ink circle you broke is dry. But something new has been dug beside it.

objectives.text: Head to the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old rune circle is grey dust. Beside it, fresh earth, and a new trench running downhill toward the river.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Heavens. Nobody comes out here any more. Now I know why.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Heavens preserve us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We'll go carefully.

objectives.text: Collect the fresh blood-ink stones
Break the new rune trench

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your palm meets the runes and they fizz like wet fuses. The trench goes dark, and far below you the river sighs.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Robed figures rise from behind the tombs, masks painted with red moons. They were waiting for someone to come.

objectives.text: Make your way to the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The street is bright with lanterns again. Nobody noticed. Somewhere behind you, the river begins to flow the right way.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother
Bring him to the sect to be judged
Make him carry your gear, unpaid

quests.title: The Mask That Stayed Behind
quests.summary: One of the masked cultivators dropped a mask as he fled. Inside it, someone has written a name, and a date.

objectives.text: Scout the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A cracked red mask lies among the graves. Inside, in neat brush strokes: the next new moon. Qingshi. Again.

objectives.text: Study the dropped mask

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ink is fresh. Not Hong's hand; this writer is younger, and in a hurry. Beneath the date, a crescent.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're not finished with this town. Hong was one deacon. There are others, and they have calendars.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then the town needs more than a festival. It needs watchers.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It needs the Sect Master to open that door. I'm going to write her another letter. A rude one.

objectives.choice_prompt: The dropped mask names its owner, a Qingshi fishmonger. The constable hasn't seen it.

choices.text: Take it to Constable Du

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Warn the fishmonger first; maybe he was forced

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Keep it, and make the fishmonger work for you

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Watchers for Qingshi
quests.summary: Qingshi needs its own eyes. The ferryman, the innkeeper and the constable volunteer. So, surprisingly, does Merchant Jin.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Watchers. Yes. I can put men on the gate and the tower. The river is harder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The river? I'm on it day and night anyway. I'll watch. Fare's free for this one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

objectives.text: Join Madam Fang at the brewery

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Everybody tells me everything eventually. It's the wine. I'll send word up the mountain if anyone new asks about the graves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Merchant Jin.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Madam Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Speak with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, Master Jin.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Listen to Constable Du. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't thank me. It makes me nervous. People only thank me before bad news.

choices.text: Help hide them

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: I'll write it down. I write everything down, cultivator.

quests.title: The Night of Lanterns
quests.summary: On the festival's last night the whole town walks to the river with lanterns. The masked cultivators choose that moment.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: My speech! I'm about to give my speech! Nine pages! Why are there men with swords on the rooftops?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Han Xue. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Sound the watchtower bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings out over the river. Lantern-bearers scatter to the doorways, just as masked figures drop into the street.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the night market

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Clear the market square of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're after the crowd! Keep them in the square. Nobody gets dragged anywhere tonight!

objectives.text: See Magistrate Zhou again

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I gave my speech. All nine pages. Behind a barricade. To seven people and a goat. It was my finest hour.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Han Xue. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Thank you, immortal. The town saw you stand in the square. They'll remember that longer than my speech.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Incense for the Lost
quests.summary: When the lanterns are gone, Widow Liu asks you to burn incense at the temple for everyone still missing.

objectives.text: See what Widow Liu wants

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Burn one for Liu Er, and one for every name the scarred bandit wrote down. There's a lot of names.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: actress_yu
dialogue.text: That's right, that is.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: There. Yu Hongxiu agrees. Settled.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. So do I. So should you, I think.

objectives.text: Burn incense for the missing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty-one names from Gou's list, and eleven from Qingshi. You burn one stick for each. The temple fills with slow grey smoke.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi settles into the silence like a stone into deep water.

objectives.text: Hear what Madam Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: You look like you need wine. You're getting tea. Tea is for people who have more work tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: Wipe your feet when you come back. Heroes track in the worst mud.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Back Up the Mountain
quests.summary: The festival is over. Han Xue walks you to the town gate with a letter for the Sect Master and a very long face.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Word from the sect, too. The outer disciples are being sent into the Moonlit Grotto. It opens once a decade.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: A secret realm? Now?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Elder Mo says it's exactly now. The sect needs strong disciples, and the grotto makes them. Or eats them. Mostly makes them.

objectives.text: Meet Constable Du at the post station

dialogue.speaker: player

dialogue.speaker: constable_du

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han

reply.text: (to Han Xue, nervously) Should we... say something?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Matron Bi.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Widow Liu) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine.

dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Constable Du. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang

objectives.text: Hurry to the temple orphanage

dialogue.text: (nervously, to Han Xue) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Old Pan, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Ready for the Mountain
quests.summary: Qingshi behind you, the road up feels shorter than it did the first time. Your cultivation agrees.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Seventh layer. You've grown into this town almost as much as it's grown into you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

objectives.text: Consolidate your cultivation at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe in for four, hold for four. Qi gathers below your navel like water in a cupped hand.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Constable Du's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Anything on the far bank? Lanterns? Faces? I still dream about the lanterns.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Once a Decade
quests.summary: Elder Mo gathers the chosen disciples at the teleport array: the Moonlit Grotto opens tonight, beneath the old wolf den.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Moonlit Grotto opens once a decade, under the bamboo. Disciples go in, disciples come out stronger. Usually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Han Xue, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Han Xue leads. Wei Tong carries the food. Zhao Kang carries his mouth. You carry that pendant, and bring it back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why the pendant, Elder?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Because it glows when it's near old things, and the grotto is very old. Go.

objectives.text: Investigate the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the blood seal once wept, the rock has split, and silver light pours out of the crack like water from a jar.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the rope bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: In we go. Stay together. The grotto moves its rooms around. Last decade a disciple came out two weeks late and very confused.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to the hermit. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Tablet of Rules
quests.summary: Just inside the grotto a tablet lists its rules. Most of them are warnings. One of them is a joke. You hope.

objectives.text: Search the tiger ridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside, the forest is the forest, but silvered, as if the moon had soaked into every leaf. The sky is a stone ceiling.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: My grandmother told stories about this place. I thought she made them up.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I see it. Stay close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Quietly, then.

objectives.text: Read the grotto tablet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Take nothing that is not offered. Harm nothing that does not harm you. Do not eat the silver peaches. We mean it.

objectives.text: Tell Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Silver peaches? There are silver peaches? Where? Just to know where not to go.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He's going to eat the peaches.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He's going to eat the peaches.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Moonlit Herbs
quests.summary: The grotto's herbs grow in minutes and fade in hours. Han Xue wants a basket before the light changes.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Moon-sage. It only grows here. Elder Hua would give a year of her life for a basket of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhao Kang. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Pick fast. They wilt when the grotto shifts, and it shifts often.

objectives.text: Pick moon-sage in the silvered grove
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A full basket. Good. Did Wei Tong eat a peach?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Half a peach.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we have about an hour before something very large comes to complain.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Peach Keepers
quests.summary: Something very large comes to complain about the peach.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It was half a peach! Half! It was mostly pit! Who's coming? Why is the ground shaking?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about food, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about your clan, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

objectives.text: Break the stone golems at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stone golems. Wonderful. Wei Tong, next time, starve.

objectives.text: Stop the stone golems regrouping
Head to the poison marsh

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last golem crumbles. From its rubble rolls a single silver peach, which Wei Tong looks at, then very bravely does not touch.

quests.title: Rivals Among the Silver
quests.summary: You are not the only sect in the grotto. Rogue cultivators have slipped in through the crack, and they are not following the rules.

objectives.text: Make your way to the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tents in the silver forest. Rogue cultivators, a dozen of them, digging up everything that glows.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I don't like this. It's too quiet. Quiet means someone is listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Right. Eyes open, everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I see it too. Let's find out what it means.

objectives.text: Search the rogues' spoils

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sacks of moon-sage torn up by the roots. Carved tablets smashed for their jade. A map, with the grotto's heart marked in red.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Tomb raiders. Grave robbers with swords. They'll strip this place bare.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're heading for the heart. So are we. Now it's a race.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Rules of the Grotto
quests.summary: The rogue cultivators have found the grotto's guardians too, and are losing badly. They'd like to take you down with them.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They woke the guardians and ran toward us. That's a tactic. A cowardly, effective tactic.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the rogues who woke the guardians is pinned under fallen stone, begging.

choices.text: Free him and send him out

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Free him, and tie him up for the wardens

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave him for the guardians

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

objectives.text: Stop the rogue cultivators at the poison marsh

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Hold the smugglers' trail against more stone golems

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Rogues on the left, golems on the right. I'll take the rogues. They're uglier.

objectives.text: Scout the tiger ridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: When the dust settles, the surviving rogues are gone, and the path to the grotto's heart stands open beneath a silver arch.

quests.title: Around a Silver Fire
quests.summary: The grotto's night is short and bright. Around the fire, your companions say things they wouldn't say in daylight.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: When I was small, I wanted to be a cook. My father said cultivators eat better. He was wrong. Cultivators eat faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you have crumbs on your sword.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're lucky crumbs. Dumpling likes them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Wei Tong is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm still going to open a noodle shop one day. The Dumpling. Named after my sword. Or the other way round.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the carved buddhas

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My brother came to this grotto ten years ago. He came out first. My father had it carved on a stone in our hall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm going to come out first too. Not for my father. For the stone. It looks lonely.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the cliff path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't have a story. I have a sword and a senior sister's responsibilities. Go to sleep, all of you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, you're smiling.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Zhao Kang. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's the fire. Silver fire. Very misleading. Sleep.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: The Silver Arch
quests.summary: Beyond the arch the grotto grows old: carved pillars, faded murals, and a green that is not quite moonlight.

objectives.text: Hurry to the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The arch is carved with flowers so worn you can't tell what they were. Your pendant warms. Just slightly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Over there. See? Someone tried to hide their tracks and did it badly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Then we'd better be quick.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Stay close. Both of you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

objectives.text: Gather the fallen tiles of the arch
Set the tiles back into the arch

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last tile clicks home. For a heartbeat every carved flower flushes green, then fades back to silver.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone golems at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The floor shivers, and the grotto's stone keepers rise to see who has touched their arch.

objectives.text: Check the seals of the sealed coffin at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the keepers lies a quiet courtyard, silver on green, and a sound like distant water.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Paper seals cross the sealed coffin, written in blood gone brown. One of them has been torn and pasted back.

quests.title: The Flower Nobody Remembers
quests.summary: A mural in the grotto's heart shows a sect in green robes. The paint has been scraped from every face.

objectives.text: Go to the mushroom ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
