dialogue.text: A mural covers the wall: cultivators in green robes, holding flowers. Every face has been scraped away, carefully.

objectives.text: Study the scraped mural

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Only one flower remains untouched in the corner: a lotus, carved exactly like the jade at your belt. Your pendant is warm as a hand.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone came in here with a knife and took their time. Why scrape faces off a painting?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: So nobody remembers them.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Qu Wanqing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's what I'm afraid of. Don't touch it. We tell Elder Mo. Keep your pendant under your robe.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: The Grotto's Shifting Rooms
quests.summary: The grotto rearranges itself when nobody's looking. Han Xue wants a map before you go any further.

objectives.text: Investigate the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Children in the bamboo village stop their game to stare at your robes, then bow all at once and giggle.

objectives.text: Examine the loom

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run your fingers along the threads of the loom. One colour runs through every bolt, like a signature.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Mark every turn. If the grotto moves the walls again, at least we'll know it happened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Silver-Eyed Wolves
quests.summary: A pack of wolves touched by the grotto's silver light guards the path deeper in, calm but unmoving.

objectives.text: Search the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the forest path. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Drive the spirit wolves from the forest path

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the forest path
Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Wei Tong. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Silver Bamboo Shoots
quests.summary: The grotto's bamboo grows shoots that glow faintly silver, prized by the Medicine Hall above.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me spirit herbs from the hidden valley. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs at the hidden valley
Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Confession
quests.summary: Away from the sect's eyes, Zhao Kang admits something about his brother he's never said aloud.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He wanted to come back a hero. He came back a stone in our hall instead. I don't want to be a stone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Zhao Kang says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Pei Yuan. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Second Mural
quests.summary: A second mural, less scraped than the first, shows the same green-robed sect planting something in a courtyard.

objectives.text: Head to the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fewer faces are scraped here, as if the vandal grew tired, or ran out of time. One figure still holds a small green seed.

objectives.text: Read the map table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Tell the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the hermit's hut isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Rogues at the Silver Stream
quests.summary: The rogue cultivators have found the grotto's stream and are poisoning it to drive off the wildlife guarding deeper rooms.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Deal with the rogue cultivators at the far forest gate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Wei Tong. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

objectives.text: Clear the far forest gate of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Rogue cultivators ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Face the next wave of rogue cultivators
Make your way to the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stream chatters over its stones, too busy to notice you.

quests.title: The Grotto's Patience
quests.summary: Han Xue has everyone meditate by the silver stream, letting the grotto's strange calm seep in before pressing on.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: This place isn't in a hurry. Neither should we be. Rushing a secret realm is how people don't come back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Meditate at the misty lake

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The world goes quiet. Your meridians hum, a little wider than yesterday.

objectives.text: Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Tally of Peaches
quests.summary: Wei Tong has taken to counting the silver peaches he has NOT eaten, as evidence of great personal growth.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Four! Four peaches, unmolested! Elder Hua would be so proud. I'm proud. Someone should be proud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan would have sent a servant for this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan's servants would have eaten my lunch.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, did you eat? You never eat. Here, half a bun. The bigger half.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...Thank you. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Stone Keepers, Counted
quests.summary: Zhao Kang insists on counting the stone keepers guarding the inner ruins, for tactical reasons he can't quite explain.

objectives.text: Scout the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Pelts dry on racks outside the hunter's lodge, and a row of traps hangs by the door like teeth.

objectives.text: Read the map table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Knowing the number matters! It's strategy! ...Fine, I just like counting things. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: The Threshold of the Heart
quests.summary: At the edge of the grotto's deepest chamber, your cultivation settles one last time before the door itself.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Whatever's past this point, you're as ready as sitting still can make you. The rest is just walking forward.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Wei Tong agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Refine your cultivation at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your pendant warms against your chest as the qi settles, strand by strand.

objectives.text: Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Hermit. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Han Xue) That was cold.

quests.title: Moonlight in the Marrow
quests.summary: At the edge of the grotto's heart a spring of silver qi bubbles up. Han Xue stands guard while each of you takes a turn.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One at a time. The spring is strong. Too much and you'll be seeing silver for a week. Wei Tong goes last.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The village is grateful. The village is also very nervous. Mostly nervous.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Han Xue is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Han Xue) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Why me last?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Because you ate the peach.

objectives.text: Bathe your meridians in silver qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Silver qi floods your meridians, cool as moonlight on water. Everything you have gathered this year settles, and brightens.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind your eyes the green lotus from the mural opens, once, and closes, like a door you are not yet allowed through.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ninth layer of Qi Condensation. I can see it in the way you're standing. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The earth god will hear of this. Loudly. We'll light the big incense.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Headman Kuang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The heart is ahead. Something is guarding it. It has been guarding it for a very long time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Rogues Come Back
quests.summary: The rogue cultivators have regrouped with friends, and they have brought picks for the grotto's heart.

objectives.text: Wake the guardian lion at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Torches at the silver arch. The rogues are back, twice as many, with picks and chains and one very large hammer.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The eyes of the guardian lion follow you. You decide that is the stonemason's skill, and nothing else.

objectives.text: Fight off the rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're going to break the arch! Barbarians! That's at least a thousand years of carving!

objectives.text: Recover the jade the rogues pried loose
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They ran. Again. They're very good at running. I should learn it. Tactically.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The one with the hammer said something about the warden's treasure being worth a city. What treasure?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the rogue cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at Zhao Kang) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: A Question in Stone
quests.summary: Carved over the heart's door is a single question, repeated in seven scripts. Only one of them you can read.

objectives.text: Hurry to the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A door of green stone, and above it one question carved in seven scripts. You can read only the last.

objectives.text: Read the question over the door

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Who carries the flower? And beneath, smaller: if no one, go home. If someone, wake me gently.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Who carries the flower. It means you, doesn't it. Your pendant hasn't stopped glowing since the arch.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know what it means. But it's the same flower.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Pei Yuan. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we don't wake it. Not yet. Not until we know what gently means to a stone.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Counsel From Outside
quests.summary: A paper crane flies in through the grotto's crack, carrying a note from the hermit, who seems to know where you are.

objectives.text: Inspect the sealed coffin at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A paper crane circles your head and lands on your hand. It unfolds into a note in a spidery, ancient hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The warden asks a question. Answer it honestly, and it will test you. Lie, and it will bury you. Bring tea. The Hermit.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sealed coffin is heavier than any coffin should be. The seals are sound. For now.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring tea? To a fight? The hermit is very strange. I respect it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Walk upwind. Whatever's out there has a better nose than you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Meng Sanniang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I have tea. I have everything. I packed for a war and a picnic, just in case.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: How does a hermit know where we are? How does a hermit send cranes into a secret realm?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang's scared. Look, his ears are red.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My ears are red because it's cold, you boiled dumpling.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Zhao Kang thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The older I get, the less I understand old people.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Stones for the Door
quests.summary: The door to the heart has seven empty sockets. The seven stones are scattered where the grotto last shifted.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Seven sockets. Seven stones, and the grotto moved them around to be difficult.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Find the seven door-stones in the clearing
Break the spirit wolves at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey wolves with silver-tipped fur lope out of the long grass, guarding the stones like shepherds.

objectives.text: See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Seven stones. The wolves only wanted to see if we were polite. We were. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Tea for a Giant
quests.summary: You set the stones and pour a cup of Wei Tong's tea at the door, feeling ridiculous. The door opens anyway.

objectives.text: Go to the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You set the seventh stone and pour a cup of tea at the threshold. It feels ridiculous. The door opens.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That's not something you see every day. I'd rather not see it again.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I see it. Stay close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Whatever happens, we stay together.

objectives.text: Pour tea at the warden's door

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside, a giant of green stone kneels with its head bowed over a sword. Moss has grown over its shoulders like a cloak.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It's asleep. It's very big and very asleep. Can we leave it like that? I vote we leave it like that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Whatever it guards, the rogues will be back for it. We can't leave it like that.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The Law Hall's going to write you a very long letter.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (grinning at Wei Tong) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: The Grotto Warden
quests.summary: The warden wakes, and asks its question with its fists.

objectives.text: Investigate the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The warden lifts its head. Moss sloughs away. A voice like millstones: who carries the flower?

objectives.name: The Grotto Warden
objectives.text: Bring down The Grotto Warden

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I do. I don't know what it means. But I carry it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Honest. Good. Show me the flower has roots.

objectives.text: Accept what the warden offers

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The warden kneels again, and opens its stone hand. In it lies a slip of green jade, warm, and a single seed of a lotus.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Not yet, it grinds. The rest when you are ready. It closes its eyes, and is moss again.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the cliff path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It gave you a seed and a slip, and went back to sleep. That's the strangest treasure I've ever heard of.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The slip is blank. The seed is just a seed.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Hermit. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then they're for later. Put them with your pendant. Everything strange seems to belong together.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemy's belongings: a manual of a forbidden blood technique.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Seal it in the Scripture Pagoda

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep it. Study it. Quietly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Grotto Begins to Close
quests.summary: With the heart given up, the grotto starts to fold shut. The rogues make one last grab on the way out.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The walls are moving! The grotto's closing! Everyone to the crack, now!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Big Shu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

objectives.text: Stop the rogue cultivators at the tiger ridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rogues burst out of the silver trees, desperate, hammers raised, grabbing at anything that glows.

objectives.text: Finish the rogue cultivators at the smugglers' trail
Search the giant bamboo grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tumble out of the crack into ordinary bamboo, ordinary daylight. Behind you the rock closes like a mouth.

quests.title: Who Came Out First
quests.summary: Out in the bamboo, the other teams are waiting, counting heads. Zhao Kang wants to know who came out first.

objectives.text: Head to the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The other teams wait on the forest path, counting heads. The monitor elder is marking a list with great ceremony.

objectives.text: Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Who came out first? I need to know. For the stone. Tell me it was me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was you, Zhao Kang. By a whole step. I saw it.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows faster than I cut. I've made my peace with it. The bamboo hasn't.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Big Shu. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...You're lying. You were in front of me. You stepped back. Why would you do that?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your brother's stone looked lonely.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...Don't. Don't be kind to me. It's unbearable. Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The grotto's prize token is in your pocket. By rights it's Zhao Kang's.

choices.text: Give him the token

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand it to the elders to decide

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Keep it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: The Hermit's Tea, Returned
quests.summary: On the way back you stop at the hermit's hut to return his cup. He looks at the seed in your hand for a long time.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The warden gave you a seed. Three hundred years it held that seed. It never gave it to anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Do you know what it is?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Wei Tong, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I know what it will be. Not what it is. Plant it when you have a home that deserves it. Not before.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: And go home, child. Your Sect Master is waking. Even I can feel it, all the way out here.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I left the rest of the tea with the hermit. He cried. Just a bit. I think it was the tea. It's very strong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The Law Hall's going to write you a very long letter.

quests.title: Counting the Outer Disciples
quests.summary: The monitor elder wants every team accounted for before anyone celebrates the grotto's closing.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Take a look at the bamboo village. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Hermit.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom at the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The monitor elder ticks off names on a long scroll, muttering, and starts over twice out of sheer nerves.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shuttle of the loom has stopped mid-row. The half-finished pattern is a map, if you know how to read it.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: What Fell Out on the Way Home
quests.summary: In the scramble out of the closing grotto, several disciples dropped gear worth recovering from the forest floor.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me jade slips from the waterwheel, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Wei Tong. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

objectives.text: Pick up jade slips near the waterwheel
Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more jade slips than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Rogues Who Didn't Make It Out
quests.summary: A few rogue cultivators, slower or greedier than the rest, are still stumbling around the bamboo, half-blind from the grotto's closing light.

objectives.text: Make your way to the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stilt houses of the bamboo village stand over the mud on long legs. Chickens patrol beneath them like guards.

objectives.text: Defeat the rogue cultivators at the giant bamboo grove

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Rogue cultivators! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Collect blood lotus around the poison marsh
Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's New Respect
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, uncharacteristically, thanks you properly for the lie about who came out first.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I know you lied. I'm choosing to accept it as truth. Don't make this weird by mentioning it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the old battlefield

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the old battlefield. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, Hermit. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we trained in the snow. Uphill. With buckets.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the forest crossroads.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Seed, Examined
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants a careful look at the warden's seed before you decide where, or whether, to plant it.

objectives.text: Scout the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the alchemist's cottage is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Search the medicine cabinet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The medicine cabinet is almost bare. Someone has been emptying it faster than it can be filled.

objectives.text: Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Not spirit herb. Not anything catalogued. Whatever it grows into, it hasn't grown in three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Elder Bai does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Han Xue?

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The chronicles are full of cruelty. Thank you for a better page.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Settling the Grotto's Silver
quests.summary: The grotto's silver qi lingers strangely in your meridians. Han Xue wants it properly integrated before it causes trouble.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Silver qi and sect qi don't always mix politely. Sit. Let them introduce themselves properly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe in for four, hold for four. Qi gathers below your navel like water in a cupped hand.

objectives.text: Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Grotto Stories
quests.summary: Wei Tong has already told the peach story four times, each version slightly more heroic than the last.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: In this version I fought the golem WHILE holding the peach. It's basically what happened. Basically.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Hermit. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the giant banyan

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Do as the hermit says. For once, someone is making sense.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the far forest gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Elder Mo said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. Now, where was I.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Warden's Slip, Blank No Longer
quests.summary: The blank jade slip from the warden's hand has begun, faintly, to show the ghost of characters.

objectives.text: Hurry to the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Held to the light, one word surfaces on the milky jade, then fades: soon. Nothing more, however long you wait.

objectives.text: Talk it over with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at the hermit) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Sect Waits Too
quests.summary: Word has spread that the Sect Master has emerged. The whole mountain seems to be holding its breath alongside you.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Everyone's acting normal and nobody is normal. I've never seen so many people pretend to sweep the same step.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll light the watch lantern for you. If you see it go out, run.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Pei Yuan. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: I'll carry anything heavy. Heavier than a tree, I'll need a friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Lu Ping. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: One Night Before the Hall
quests.summary: The last night before you're summoned, your cultivation settles into its final shape for this stage of the journey.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Great Perfection, held steady overnight. That's the real test, you know. Not reaching it. Keeping it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Temper your realm at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The world goes quiet. Your meridians hum, a little wider than yesterday.

objectives.text: Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: The Door Opens
quests.summary: Home at last, you find the gold seal torn from the main hall doors. The Sect Master has emerged, and she has read every letter.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: She's out. This morning. She read your report and Han Xue's four pages of please.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Before you see her, sit. The grotto shook your qi loose. Settle it, or you'll wobble in front of the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Settle the grotto's qi on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The silver qi of the grotto settles into your meridians like snow into a valley. Great Perfection of Qi Condensation, clear and full.

objectives.text: Bring word to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Better. She'll send for you tomorrow. She has questions about Qingshi, and the deacon, and friends in high halls.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Tonight, eat. Sleep. Tomorrow you'll need both.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Missing Pages
quests.summary: The Sect Master wants to know everything about the Blood Moon Sect. Elder Bai's records should help. Should.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A Blood Moon deacon, three hundred stolen hearts, and a hint of friends in high halls. I will not sleep tonight.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Three centuries ago our founder and the Verdant Lotus Sect sealed the Blood Moon Patriarch beneath the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Bai keeps the records. Learn how the seal was made, {player}. If it is failing, I must know why.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Bai for the Blood Moon records

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon War chronicles? Fourth floor, east shelf, beside the recipes for turtle soup. Do not ask.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Here... hm. Hm! The pages on the Azure Heaven Seal are gone. Cut out. With a very sharp, very tidy blade.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Only elders and the Law Hall may enter the fourth floor. Whoever did this had a pass, and patience.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Elders and the Law Hall. That is not a long list, Elder Bai.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: And not one we can say out loud. Not yet.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus built the seal. Their ruins lie in the Whispering Bamboo. Stones cannot be cut out of a book.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The elders will hate that. I love it.

objectives.text: Watch the journey to the forgotten ruins
Find the gate of the ancient ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A stone archway rises from the bamboo, choked with vines. Carved lotus flowers climb its pillars.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At its keystone is a single lotus, exactly the shape of the jade at your belt.

quests.title: The Hermit's Secret
quests.summary: The archway will not open for you. The hermit who warned you about the ruins knows more than he admits.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hermit sits outside with two cups of tea already poured. He does not look surprised to see you.

objectives.text: Ask the hermit about the ruins

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You went to the ruins. Of course you did. The young never listen and the old never stop talking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The keystone matches my pendant. You knew. The first time you saw it, you knew.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I did. Sit down. This tea has waited three hundred years. It can wait for one more story.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit's story
Accept the hermit's charge

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My name is Lan Jue. Last disciple of the Verdant Lotus Sect. I ran when my masters died. I have been running ever since.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your pendant is the Lotus Key, half of what binds the Azure Heaven Seal. Your mother was of our blood.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The ruins will test you. Gather the rune stones scattered at the gate, and the arch will know its heir.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could have come with me.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I could have done many things for three hundred years. Go. I will follow when my shame lets me.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He speaks true, lotus-bearer. I have watched those ruins for a year. They are waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You again. You walk too quietly for an honest man.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Stones That Remember
quests.summary: Gather the lotus rune stones and read the old stele at the shrine. Someone has followed you from the sect.

objectives.text: Gather the lotus rune stones around the gate
Deal with Zhao Kang on the forest path

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look so surprised. You're not the only one who can walk through bamboo.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You followed me? From the sect?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Gu ordered me to keep an eye on you. He said you carry something the sect must protect.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Personally, I think it's a waste of my talents. But a Zhao obeys the Law Hall. So. Lead on, village brat.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the rune fragments you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

objectives.text: Read the stele in the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Here the Verdant Lotus gave its heart. With the Azure Cloud we bound the Patriarch Xue Wuji beneath the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seal has two keys. The Lotus Key, which binds. The Azure Eye, which watches. Never let both fall to one hand.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Azure Eye... that's the formation array at home. And the Lotus Key is... your trinket?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Apparently my trinket is older than your clan.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Never both to one hand. Remember that line, lotus-bearer. Someone in your sect has forgotten it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Who said that? Show yourself! ...He's gone. I hate this forest.

quests.title: Stone Guardians
quests.summary: The ruins' stone sentinels wake at the sound of footsteps. Get past them and open the archway.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone sentinels at the gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stone men! Wonderful. My sword was freshly polished, too.

objectives.text: Set the rune stones into the archway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune stones slide into place one by one. The carved lotus on the keystone opens its petals.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: With a sound like a sigh, the vines fall away and the gate of the Verdant Lotus opens for the first time in three centuries.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It... opened. For you. Fine. FINE. I'm not impressed. I'm slightly impressed.

objectives.text: Step through the opened archway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the arch lies a courtyard of green stone. At its centre kneels a giant statue, head bowed, hands resting on a sword.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please tell me that one doesn't move.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It moves, young man. Only when it must. I would not stand quite so close.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Where did you come from? Does everyone in this forest walk like a ghost?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He's the hermit. He's... a friend of the lotus.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: The Guardian of the Lotus
quests.summary: The inner courtyard is watched by the last guardian of the Verdant Lotus. It will not accept an heir without a trial.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the shrine

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I followed. My shame is slower than my feet, it turns out.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The guardian in the courtyard was carved by my master. It asks one question with its fists: are you worthy?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Do not fear it. It is not cruel, only very, very thorough.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thorough. Wonderful. My favourite kind of stone monster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll be thorough too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

objectives.text: Stop the sentinels reforming at the gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The sentinels are reforming. Break them again, quickly, before the guardian wakes!

objectives.text: Pass the trial of the ancient guardian

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great statue lifts its head. Moss sloughs from its shoulders. A voice grinds like millstones: who bears the lotus?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I do. {player}, of the Azure Cloud. And of the Verdant Lotus.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then show me that the lotus has not wilted.

quests.title: Legacy of the Lotus
quests.summary: The guardian kneels. The Verdant Lotus left something for its heir.

objectives.text: Open the Verdant Lotus reliquary

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside lies a jade slip carved with lotus roots: the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra, and a letter in an elegant hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: To whoever carries my key. I am sorry for the burden. It was always meant to be shared. Do not carry it alone.

objectives.text: Comprehend the Heart Sutra at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sutra unfolds in your mind like a flower opening underwater. Roots, stem, blossom. Patience, strength, compassion.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi begins to settle, layer upon layer, like silt forming bedrock.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You read it. I can see it in your breathing. The lotus grows in mud and is not stained.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred years I waited for someone to open that box. I thought I would feel relief. I feel... old.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Come back to the sect with me. Tell them what you know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One day. Not yet. First I must forgive a coward, and he is very stubborn.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Forgive him quickly, old man. There's a tournament coming, and my rival is sitting in a forest.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Blood in the Shrine
quests.summary: Blood Moon scouts have followed your trail to the ruins and are defacing the stele.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon scouts from the shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're smashing the stele! Barbarians! That's at least a thousand years of calligraphy!

objectives.text: Check on Zhao Kang at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a scratch. Don't fuss. A Zhao doesn't bleed. We... tactically leak.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You stepped in front of that blade for me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't be sentimental. Nobody gets to defeat you except me. I've been planning it for months.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tactically leak. I shall remember that one. Hold still, boy. This will sting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

objectives.text: Gather herbs to treat Zhao Kang's wound

quests.title: The Law Hall's Interest
quests.summary: Back at the sect, everyone wants to see the Heart Sutra. Some want it more than others.

objectives.text: Return to the sect with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Home. I'm going to bathe for three days. Don't tell anyone I helped you. I have a reputation for being unbearable.

objectives.text: Show the Heart Sutra to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra. I have waited my whole life to see this. I may cry. Don't look.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Keep it. It is bound to the Lotus Key and would only sulk in my shelves.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: And the missing pages... the fourth-floor log shows a Law Hall seal. The Law Hall borrows everything. It's how they keep us honest.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Gu's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
