dialogue.text: Zhao Kang tells me you found a Verdant Lotus relic. The Law Hall will take custody of it. For safekeeping.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I only told the Law Hall what I saw, Elder. As I was ordered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: With respect, Elder, the Sect Master ordered me to keep it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Did she. Then keep it, disciple. Keep it very close. Things kept close are the easiest to lose.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu wanted the sutra? Don't take it to heart. He's been cold ever since his daughter died. Twenty years now.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu Lan. A bright girl. Meridian sickness. No pill could save her. He searched the whole world.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Grief is a heart demon that never stops whispering. Be patient with him, {junior}. For my sake.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Preparing the Foundation
quests.summary: Establishing a foundation takes pills, spirit stones, and a clear conscience. You have one of three.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Hua for a Foundation Pill

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A Foundation Pill needs lotus root from the pond, gathered at dusk, and five spirit stones to fire the cauldron.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The stones come from the treasury. Good luck with that.

objectives.text: Negotiate with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Five spirit stones? Five? Do you know what five spirit stones could buy? Five spirit stones!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's for a Foundation Pill. The Sect Master approved it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Approved it. Everyone approves things. Nobody counts things. Fine. Take them. Sign here. And here. And here.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Sign it quickly, Steward, or I'll brew you something for your nerves. You won't enjoy it.

objectives.text: Gather lotus root at the pond at dusk
Tell Xiao Man what you learned in Qingshi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're back! Did you go through Qingshi? Did you see my brother? Did he say why he hasn't written?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Xiao Man... Xiao Shi was taken. By the same people who took the townsfolk. I think he's alive.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Taken? But he... he's so bad at fighting. He faints at the sight of needles.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Promise me you'll bring him back. No. Don't promise. Just... do it. Please.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Tactical Leak
quests.summary: Zhao Kang's wound is healing, loudly and with great commentary, in the sect's infirmary.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I am recovering with dignity. The dignity is mostly silent screaming, but it is dignified screaming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Elder Bai. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Elder Bai is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: The Fourth-Floor Log
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants a second opinion on the fourth floor's borrowing log, now that a Law Hall seal is involved.

objectives.text: Go to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit beast garden smells of hay and ozone. Something in the far pen is chewing on a thunderbolt.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Someone signed for the missing pages properly, which is almost worse than if they'd stolen them outright.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Xiao Man says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (tugging Elder Bai's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Lotus Root, Properly This Time
quests.summary: Elder Hua wants more lotus root gathered at dusk; the last batch went into a pill, and a second pill is safer than one.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the spirit peach orchard. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Tang Ling has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell. It bites, and it holds grudges.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the spirit peach orchard
See Elder Hua again

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hm. Fan Rui is not wrong. Fan Rui is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. The heart heals slower than bones. Look after yours.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Hua) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

quests.title: Scouts Near the Ruins Again
quests.summary: A few more Blood Moon scouts have been seen circling the Verdant Lotus ruins since the stele was defaced.

objectives.text: Investigate the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Carp rise to the surface of the lotus pond, hoping you are someone with crumbs.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Recover jade slips from the medicine valley
Tell Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The outer sect hall is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we did this uphill. Both ways. In the snow. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Elder Mo. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (to Elder Gu) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Gu Lan's Old Room
quests.summary: Elder Mo mentions, carefully, that Gu Hanshan still keeps his daughter's old room exactly as she left it.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Twenty years, and not a single thing moved. Grief keeps strange houses. Don't mention I told you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Mo says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Feet first, then eyes, then sword. In that order. Every time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The bamboo bends. So did you. It is not always wrong.

quests.title: Steward Qian's Second Thoughts
quests.summary: Steward Qian, having signed away five spirit stones, now wants an itemised account of exactly how they were spent.

objectives.text: Search the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Notice boards cover every wall of the mission hall, sect tasks pinned three deep and fluttering in the draught.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run the beads of the abacus desk. The accounts come out one sum short, every month, for years.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Receipts! I need receipts! A pill without a receipt is just an expensive rumour!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Steadying Before the Leap
quests.summary: Han Xue insists on one more careful meditation before the actual breakthrough attempt, foundation pill or not.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A pill isn't a shortcut around readiness. Sit. Let's be sure, not just hopeful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Cultivate at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Breath by breath the foundation widens, until it feels like standing on bedrock.

objectives.text: Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Old Qiu's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (nods slowly to Han Xue) A careful answer.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Sleepless Night
quests.summary: Xiao Man hasn't slept properly since learning her brother was taken. She asks for company more than answers.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Man out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I don't need you to fix it tonight. I just don't want to sit with it alone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You've got mud to the knees and a grin to the ears. Wipe off one of them.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Mo. That's my job.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Man. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Mo has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhong Ming. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Hermit's Warning, Again
quests.summary: A paper crane arrives from Lan Jue with a warning about breakthroughs attracting more than heart demons.

objectives.text: Head to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the refectory, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Light incense in the bronze ding

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the rim of the bronze ding by touch. It lists the names of those who made an oath around it.

objectives.text: Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Blood Moon scouts near a fresh foundation is not a coincidence. Guard the garden well.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Elder Bai. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the hermit) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Guarding the Plum Garden
quests.summary: Before the breakthrough, the plum garden itself needs clearing and warding against anything that might sense it.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Take a look at the tea terraces.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Hermit. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Clear the sunrise terrace of stone golems

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Cut down the stone golems that follow
Meet the hermit at the ancestral tombs

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Fan Rui?

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to the hermit) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (tugging the hermit's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Foundation Establishment
quests.summary: With the Foundation Pill in hand and Han Xue standing guard, build the foundation of your dao.

objectives.text: Ask Han Xue to guard your breakthrough

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breakthroughs attract trouble. Heart demons, jealous juniors, very curious elders. I'll stand guard.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The plum garden is quiet at night, and Zhao Kang is too injured to sulk there. Go.

objectives.text: Establish your foundation in the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi pours downward like a waterfall into your dantian, and there it hardens, layer upon layer, into a foundation of jade.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the plum blossoms, a single green lotus flickers into being around you, and slowly sinks into your heart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I can feel every blossom on every branch. Is this what the elders feel all the time?

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Foundation Establishment

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Clouds pile up over the mountain, black at the heart. A foundation must be tested before anything is built on it.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's news

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Foundation Establishment, and a Verdant Lotus sutra. You grow faster than my worries, {player}. Barely.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In one month the sect holds the Inner Sect Tournament. The winner earns a place at my side, and the Azure Eye's trust.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I want you to enter. And I want whoever cut those pages to watch you win.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'll train {them} myself, Sect Master. Morning and evening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then whoever cut those pages will have a very good view.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Banners on the Mountain
quests.summary: The Inner Sect Tournament begins. Register with the Treasury Steward, then catch up on the gossip at the gate.

objectives.text: Watch the opening of the Inner Sect Tournament
Take in the tournament stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Banners of every peak ring the plaza. Disciples crowd the walls and railings. Someone is selling roasted chestnuts at twice the price.

objectives.text: Register with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Registration fee: two spirit stones. Non-refundable. Especially if you lose. Particularly if you die.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The Sect Master told me to enter. Personally.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Then the Sect Master can pay. Fine, fine. Waived. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Waived? He charged me four. And a seal fee. And a fee for the ink on the seal.

objectives.text: Hear the gossip from Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The betting pool is open! Yan Tie, three-time champion, two to one. Zhao Kang, five to one.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're at nine to one. I put three stones on you. Don't tell Steward Qian. Actually, win, then tell him.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Oh, and Elder Gu is supervising the pill supplies this year. First time ever. Very thorough man.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Sharpening the Blade
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on one last training session before the preliminary round.

objectives.text: Train with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Right. Foundation Establishment. So the puppets need to be angrier. I've had them tuned up.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Four at once. If you get hit, you buy lunch. If you don't get hit, I buy lunch. Either way, lunch.

objectives.text: Defeat four enhanced training puppets
Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Not a scratch. I'm buying lunch. I'm always buying lunch. How did this happen to me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen. Yan Tie is strong, but he fights like a landslide, all at once. Make him chase you and he'll tire.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He's right, for once. Make Yan Tie chase you. Then make him regret it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Lunch it is, then. Your treat, Senior Brother.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: The Preliminary Round
quests.summary: Three opponents on the formation plaza. Elder Mo is referee, and he does not believe in mercy.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo, the referee

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Rules: no killing, no crippling, no weeping on the formation. Last one standing advances.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: And {junior}? Don't embarrass me. I told the other elders you were adequate.

objectives.text: Win the preliminary round

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Begin!

objectives.text: Win the deciding bout of your bracket

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Two more from Cloud Peak who think they were robbed. Settle it.

objectives.text: Receive Elder Mo's verdict

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Hmph. Don't let it go to your head. Heads are heavy enough already.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Was that a compliment, Elder Mo?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: It was an observation. Go and eat something. You look like a boiled noodle.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Adequate! Did everyone hear that? Adequate! That's practically poetry from him!

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Whispers at Night
quests.summary: Zhao Kang slipped out through the moon gate after curfew. Follow him.

objectives.text: Follow Zhao Kang to the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A figure in gold-trimmed robes slips through the moon gate, carrying a bundle of incense sticks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sneaking out the night before the second round? What are you up to, Zhao Kang?

objectives.text: Confront Zhao Kang at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go ahead. Report me to the Law Hall. It's what they're for.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My elder brother Zhao Ming died a year ago tonight. A Law Hall mission. Bandits, they said, in the bamboo forest.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I burn incense here because he liked the view. That's all. That's all it is.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Zhao Ming liked the sunrise more. Stay for it, boy. I'll square your curfew with the Law Hall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, Zhao Kang. Who assigned his mission?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Gu. Same as yours. Why does that matter?

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Ming. I remember him. He was kind. He was also ambushed in exactly the place you were ambushed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Elder Gu assigned both missions. The Law Hall held the Blood Moon token. Law Hall seals are on the missing pages.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That isn't proof. It's a pattern. I'll watch the Law Hall. You win the tournament. Don't let him see you suspect.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Hundred-Disciple Melee
quests.summary: The second round is a melee on the plaza. Wei Tong was knocked out early and is taking it well. Mostly.

objectives.text: Console Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Eliminated. By a girl half my size who hid behind a banner and poked me in the kidney. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Honestly, it was brilliant. I'm going to learn it. Go on. Avenge my kidney.

objectives.text: Survive the melee

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Second round! Everyone against everyone! Try not to hit the audience!

objectives.text: Help Lu Ping gather his scattered winnings
Collect Lu Ping's thanks

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're into the semifinal! I've won eleven stones! I'm rich! I'm going to buy a hat!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Also, a Law Hall disciple told me to stop betting on you. Rude, right? I bet more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Eleven stones and a hat? My kidney deserves a share, Lu Ping.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Buy the hat. Then stop betting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping's winnings came from betting on you. Gambling is forbidden in the sect.

choices.text: Tell him to give them to the Medicine Hall

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Report him to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take a cut

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

quests.title: The Poisoned Cup
quests.summary: Elder Hua has found something wrong with the tournament pills.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's urgent summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Frenzy Pills. Blood lotus and wolf's bane, hidden inside Vitality Pills. They burn a cultivator from the inside.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Three boxes were meant for the finalists' quarters. I need four moonbell herbs to brew an antidote. Hurry.

objectives.text: Gather moonbell herbs for the antidote
Ask Xiao Man what she saw

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The pill boxes? A disciple in Law Hall grey carried them in. He said Elder Gu approved them personally.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: One box went to Yan Tie's room. He's the champion. He's so strong already, why would he need pills?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe he doesn't know what's in them.

objectives.text: Deliver the herbs to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Good. I'll brew the antidote tonight. If Yan Tie has taken a Frenzy Pill, he will not know friend from foe.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Tell no one about the Law Hall yet. An accusation without proof is just a very loud way to die.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I'll help you brew, Elder! I won't drop anything. I'll drop almost nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we'd better hurry. Yan Tie fights at dawn.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (stops mixing) I don't have a pill for that, {player}.

quests.title: Partners in the Semifinal
quests.summary: The semifinal is a paired bout, and fate has a sense of humour: your partner is Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Find your partner in the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Of all the disciples in all the peaks. Fine. Stay on my left. Don't slow me down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're still limping from the shrine.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Then stay on my right. Whatever. Just win.

objectives.text: Win the paired semifinal with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Five of them? Good. I was worried this would be boring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On your left, Zhao Kang!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I SEE them!

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You fight like a farmer. Stubborn, unpolished, impossible to knock over.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was a compliment. Don't get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Win the final. If anyone is going to beat Yan Tie, it should be the person who's going to lose to me someday.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Did Zhao Kang just pay a compliment? Somebody carve it on the stele.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll hold him to it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Zhao Kang) That was cold.

quests.title: Eve of the Final
quests.summary: The night before the final, Elder Gu summons you. It is not about the tournament.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Gu's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Congratulations on reaching the final. An unlikely journey for a village orphan.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tournament rules forbid external artifacts. Bring your pendant to the Law Hall tonight for inspection.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's not an artifact, Elder. It's a family keepsake.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Then you have nothing to fear. The Law Hall. Tonight. Do not make me ask again.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Mo about the rule

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Inspection? There's no such rule. There never has been. I wrote half the tournament rules myself.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He did. Badly. I had to fix the grammar. There is no inspection rule, disciple.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then why does Elder Gu want it so badly?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu... no. He is grieving, not wicked. Still. Don't go. If he asks, tell him I forbade it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go and clear your head. You've a champion to face at dawn.

objectives.text: Steady your dao heart on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pond is still. The moon lies in it, whole. You breathe until your heart lies as still as the water.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue in the pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu asked for the pendant? Then he's run out of patience. That makes him dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Win tomorrow. I'll be watching the pagoda. If the Law Hall moves while everyone watches the final, I'll know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Final Bout
quests.summary: Face Yan Tie, three-time champion of the Inner Sect Tournament. Something is wrong with his eyes.

objectives.text: Step up for the final

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The final! {player} of the Outer Court against Yan Tie of Thunder Peak, champion three years running!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bow to your opponent. Bow to the Sect Master. And for heaven's sake, bow to me.

objectives.text: Defeat the tournament champion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Yan Tie bows, and when he straightens, his eyes are the colour of blood. Veins crawl black up his neck.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Frenzy qi! Stop the bout... no, he won't stop now. {player}, bring him down without killing him!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll try. Stay back, everyone!

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's judgement

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yan Tie will live. Elder Hua's antidote reached him in time. You fought to save him, not to win. I saw that.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The victory is yours, and with it, a place at my side. But someone fed him that pill.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wait. The pagoda bell... someone is ringing the pagoda bell. Where is Han Xue?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The pagoda? Han Xue was watching it. Sect Master, I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No, Elder. I'm faster. Let me go.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Crowd's Roar
quests.summary: For a few minutes, the whole plaza is chanting your name, and it is stranger than any fight you've won.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Champion! CHAMPION! I bet on you at nine to one, I'm never letting you forget this!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore Lu Ping. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Talk with Lu Ping at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the mountain road. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Give me an hour.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the herb terraces.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Mind the smoke from the east kilns. It's thicker than it looks and ruder than it smells.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Kiln-Mistress Tao. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Yan Tie, Waking Slowly
quests.summary: Yan Tie stirs in the Medicine Hall, the black veins fading from his neck, confusion in his cleared eyes.

objectives.text: Make your way to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the pill kiln yard not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The antidote worked. He'll ache for days and remember none of the frenzy. Small mercies.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Good. I'll fire a pill in your honour. Well, in the honour of whoever eats it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Grudging Toast
quests.summary: Zhao Kang raises a cup to the champion, which is either genuine or the most elaborate insult he's attempted yet.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: To the farmer who beat a champion. Don't let it go to your head. I'm still better dressed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Lu Ping.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Hua.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever the Sect Master said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Ha! I'd have lost money on that. Nobody saw it coming!

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Lu Ping Collects, Loudly
quests.summary: Lu Ping's betting book has made him the outer court's least popular and most cheerful disciple.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nine to one! I'm going to buy that hat. Two hats. A hat for every day you don't lose.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: No, Wei Tong. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Zhong Ming said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Kidney, Avenged
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on a rematch against the disciple who eliminated him with a banner and a well-placed poke.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Deal with the sparring disciples at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Zhong Ming. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I was meditating. With my eyes closed. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

objectives.text: Fight off the sparring disciples

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Go back to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Zhong Ming.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you, by the way. I always bet on you. I've bought four hats.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

quests.title: A Strange Quiet in the Pagoda
quests.summary: Han Xue notices the pagoda is unusually dark for this hour, even accounting for everyone watching the final.

objectives.text: Scout the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit deer lift their heads in the beast garden's pens. A fat golden carp watches you from its pond.

objectives.text: Open the cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No lamps. Elder Bai always keeps a lamp lit. Something's wrong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Sect Master. You said so. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Private Word
quests.summary: Before the celebrations properly begin, Sect Master Yun pulls you aside for one quiet, careful sentence.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Whoever poisoned that pill is still inside these walls. Enjoy tonight. Watch tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Tang Ling. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Zhao Kang) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Zhao Kang's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Prizes From the Treasury
quests.summary: Steward Qian, cornered by tradition, hands out the tournament's prizes with visible pain.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me spirit stones from the laundry stream.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Lu Ping said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nobody tells the gate disciple anything. So I listen. Constantly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the laundry stream
Report back to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Give me an hour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Hm. I'll bet even on that one.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm... not going to tell anyone about that one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Lu Ping) That was cold.

quests.title: A Champion's Breath
quests.summary: Even champions need to settle their qi after a fight like that one. Han Xue insists, as always.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Frenzy qi is contagious if you let it rattle you. Breathe it out properly before it becomes yours.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Elder Hua. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Mud, root, blossom. The Heart Sutra turns in you, slow and patient.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Bell Begins to Ring
quests.summary: Just as the celebration reaches its warmest, the pagoda's alarm bell begins to toll across the mountain.

objectives.text: Hurry to the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell's first note cuts through the laughter like a blade. Every head on the plaza turns toward the pagoda at once.

objectives.text: Tell the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Later. Over tea. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Law Hall's Shadow
quests.summary: While the whole sect watched the final, someone broke into the scripture pagoda.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}! Elder Bai's been hurt. It's Gu. Gu is in the pagoda. The seal diagram, he's taking the seal diagram!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Stay here. I'll stop him.

objectives.text: Confront the traitor
Defeat the traitor's Blood Moon accomplices

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Hold them. The pendant can wait. The diagram cannot.

objectives.text: Check on the wounded Elder Bai on the plaza

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I'm fine. I've been hit harder by falling bookshelves. Gu Hanshan... forty years we've shared tea.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He took the Azure Heaven Seal diagram. The master copy. The one we would need to repair the seal.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Without it, if the seal breaks, we cannot remake it. Go to the Sect Master. Quickly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't move, Elder. Your arm is broken, whatever you say about bookshelves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We'll get it back, Elder Bai. I swear it.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master at the teleport array

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He fled through the teleport array. Its last destination was the Blood Moon Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty years I trusted him with our law. I trusted him with our children.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest tonight, {player}. Tomorrow we go into the Abyss after him.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Slag Where the Array Stood
quests.summary: The Sect Master promised to follow Gu into the Abyss at dawn. At dawn, she finds out why that is impossible.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I said tomorrow we go after him. I was angry, and I was wrong. Look at the array.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The Sect Master thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Han Xue. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He burned the Abyss route behind him. The jade is slag. It will take weeks to lay it again.

objectives.text: Examine the burned teleport array

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The array's outer ring is melted glass. Scorched into the stone, still faintly warm, is a single character: Lan.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: His daughter's name. He signed his escape with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Whatever he was promised, he believes it. That makes him more dangerous, not less.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Han Xue) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Empty Chairs of the Law Hall
quests.summary: The Law Hall's disciples are being questioned one by one. Han Xue wants you there, to watch their faces.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Eleven Law Hall disciples. One of them carried the Frenzy Pills. Maybe more. I want you to watch their faces while I ask.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Fan Rui. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Go to the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the scholar rock, the Law Hall's chairs stand in a neat row. Only ten of the eleven are occupied.

objectives.text: Search the empty Law Hall desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The eleventh desk has been cleared in a hurry. Wedged behind a drawer: a Frenzy Pill box, and a crescent drawn in ink.

objectives.text: See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Pei Rong. The one who carried the boxes. He ran in the night, toward the outer pines.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The pines are thick and he doesn't know them. We do. Let's go and introduce ourselves.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Grey Robes in the Pines
quests.summary: The runaway Law Hall disciple has friends waiting beyond the wall. They wear grey by day and crimson by night.

objectives.text: Investigate the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey robes flutter between the pines. Too many for one runaway. They have been waiting for him.

objectives.text: Break the Law Hall turncoats at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Law Hall grey on the outside, Blood Moon red underneath. Take them alive if you can!

objectives.text: Recover the letters they scattered
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Pei Rong's alive. Barely. He's crying and saying it was for his family. Everyone has a family, apparently, except the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They hold families. That's how they own people. Gou's list said the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Back, and breathing evenly. That's all a healer asks for, and so rarely gets.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somewhere in Qingshi, Gou the Scarred is teaching carters to read their own names. You spared him for this.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You think of Gou's broken hand, and wonder whose family he couldn't fight for after.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

quests.title: Bai Qiu Counts His Scrolls
quests.summary: Elder Bai is back among his shelves, bandaged and furious, counting everything Gu touched.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Forty years we shared tea. He took the master diagram of the seal, and my second-best inkstone. I miss the inkstone more today.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Be careful, {senior}!

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Fan Rui. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: That's a lie. I miss the tea. Help me count, disciple. Counting stops me thinking.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Bai won't rest. I've given him a sleeping draught three times. He reads the label and puts it on a shelf.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Xiao Man. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Keep him company. Grief is easier to mend when someone else holds the other end of the bandage.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Man has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Is it true? Elder Gu? The man who carried those pill boxes was his. And my brother... Is it all connected?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I think so, Xiao Man. And I think it all leads to the same place.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Then go there. Please. Before it's too late. I'll keep the herbs ready. I won't even drop them.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Gu Hanshan's Study
quests.summary: The Sect Master orders the traitor's rooms opened. Nobody has been inside in twenty years but him.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Open his rooms. I want every letter, every note, every lie. Han Xue has the key. Bring me what you find, not what you feel.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Elder Bai. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.text: Search the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Gu's study is spotless and bare. One brush, one inkstone, one portrait of a smiling girl with ink on her fingers.

objectives.text: Read the letters in Gu's desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hundreds of letters, all addressed to Gu Lan, all unsent. Today you learned the ninth precept. You would have liked it.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Twenty years of letters to a dead girl. I wanted to hate him. It's harder now. I'm still going to try.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Splendid. A footnote in history, at the very least. Possibly a whole paragraph.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Elder Bai. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among Gu's letters: names of disciples who took Blood Moon silver once, then refused it.

choices.text: Give every letter to the Sect Master

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Burn the names of the ones who refused

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Keep the letters. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Fire in the Pagoda
quests.summary: In the dead of night someone tries to burn what is left of the seal records. The pagoda bell wakes the mountain.

objectives.text: See what Lu Ping wants

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Fire! In the pagoda! I saw them go in, three shadows, and I rang the bell twice, which is once more than required!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhong Ming. Probably. Mostly.
