objectives.text: Beat out the fire on the pagoda steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Oil burns on the lowest steps. You smother it with your robe and your qi. Above, glass breaks on the fourth floor.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Masked figures drop from the pagoda's eaves, blades out, oil flasks in their belts.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The Blood Moon cultivators have found you first.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The fourth floor survived. My turtle soup recipes did not. I will never forgive them. Truly, this is war.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Lu Ping, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: They came for what's left of the seal records. Gu must have told them what he couldn't carry.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (beaming at Elder Bai) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Elder Bai's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Why We Wait
quests.summary: The Sect Master explains why she will not march on the Abyss today, or tomorrow, and it costs her to say it.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Every disciple wants to charge into the Abyss after him. So do I. But the Azure Eye is cracked, and I am its keeper.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you should be resting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And you should be retired, Mo. We both make sacrifices.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If I leave the mountain, the Eye goes dark. If the Eye goes dark, the seal has only one key left. Yours.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then how do we follow him?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Slowly. We rebuild the array. We find a way down on foot. We grow strong enough to survive the bottom.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: She's right, and she hates it. So do I. So: we get strong. You first. You're behind schedule.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Mo is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Foundation Establishment, and still sloppy on the left side. Tomorrow, dawn.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Elder Mo's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Jade for a New Road
quests.summary: Laying a teleport route to the Abyss again needs raw jade, and the treasury is suddenly careful with its stones.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The array masters need raw jade to lay the Abyss route again. The treasury has some. Steward Qian has opinions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

objectives.text: Find Steward Qian at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Raw jade! For a road to the worst place in the world! Do you know what that costs?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhong Ming. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: ...Fine. Fine. But you dig the rest yourself. There's a seam in the herb terraces. Elder Hua will pretend not to see you.

objectives.text: Dig raw jade from the terrace seam
Join Elder Hua at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You're digging up my terraces for a road to the Abyss. I'm pretending not to see. Dig faster; my pretending has limits.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Are you certain, Elder Hua? I've seen {them} trip over a doorstep.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: A Place at Her Side
quests.summary: The tournament's prize was a place at the Sect Master's side. She shows you what that means: the Azure Eye, from the inside.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You won a place at my side. Here is what it means. Sit on the Eye with me. Feel what I feel every day.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Man. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Sit within the Azure Eye beside the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The formation rises around you like water. Somewhere deep in its pattern a thin crack runs, and through it, very faint, something is breathing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It is patient. It is hungry. It knows your name.

objectives.text: Return to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You felt him. Three hundred years under the earth and he still breathes through a crack in my formation.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm standing right here, you know.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That is what I carry. Now you know why I don't sleep. Go and sleep for both of us.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: A Promise Without the Word
quests.summary: Xiao Man has packed a bag. She intends to go to the Abyss herself. Somebody has to talk her out of it.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Man's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I packed a bag. Medicine, rope, a knife I don't know how to use. I'm going to the Abyss. Don't stop me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Xiao Man, you faint when Elder Hua lances a boil.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Hua. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Then I'll faint in the Abyss! At least I'll be closer!

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Let her cry. Then give her something to do. I'll have her make medicine bundles for whoever goes. Hundreds.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Elder Hua is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Grief with work is survivable. Grief with nothing is a cliff edge.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Man has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Hundreds of bundles. For whoever goes. You're going, aren't you? Don't promise. I hate promises now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm going. I won't promise. I'll just bring him back.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Ash From the Fire
quests.summary: The pagoda fire left ash worth sifting, in case anything survived that the intruders wanted destroyed.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Sift it carefully. Paper survives ash more often than you'd think, if the fire was rushed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the spirit peach orchard
Go back to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Wei Tong. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Elder Bai, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Pei Rong's Testimony
quests.summary: The captured turncoat Pei Rong has more to say, if someone is willing to sit with him and listen properly.

objectives.text: Head to the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He talks fast and low, eager to be useful now that usefulness is all he has left to trade.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Wei Tong. Wei Tong won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I was meditating. With my eyes closed. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Watchers on the Road
quests.summary: Someone has been watching the mountain road since the fire. Han Xue wants them found before they report back.

objectives.text: Make your way to the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mountain road winds down toward the valley, cart ruts cut deep by three centuries of supplies.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Collect jade slips around the mountain road
Share your findings with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Well? Did you keep your guard up, or did you just get lucky?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Is that allowed? It is now, I suppose!

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Elder Bai's Second-Best Inkstone
quests.summary: Against all odds, Elder Bai's second-best inkstone turns up in the pagoda rubble, and he is unreasonably moved.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It survived! Cracked, but it survived! I take back everything unkind I thought about this morning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai, you've been in the pagoda for three days. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I had a very nourishing scroll.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Old Bao. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Talk with Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Bai.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: By the precepts! I know those! Well, most of them!

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Foundation Under Pressure
quests.summary: Elder Mo wants your new foundation tested under real strain, not just praised.

objectives.text: See what Elder Mo wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A foundation that's never been pushed is a guess, not a foundation. Sit. I'm going to make it harder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo, you're scowling again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I'm thinking, Sect Master. It looks the same from outside.

objectives.text: Circulate your qi at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation drinks in the qi and hardens, layer on layer, like jade forming in the dark.

objectives.text: Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hm. Elder Bai is not wrong. Elder Bai is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Back straight. I won't say it again. I will say it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Rebuilding the Array, Stone by Stone
quests.summary: The array masters need extra hands hauling jade and rubble as they begin repairing the burned teleport array.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Look at that stance. A strong wind would file a complaint.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Mo. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Lu Ping's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (thinks very hard) Yes. I agree.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

quests.title: A Second Crescent
quests.summary: A second crescent mark turns up, this time scratched into a beam in the outer sect's grain store.

objectives.text: Scout the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The long refectory smells of rice, ginger and a hundred disciples who trained since dawn.

objectives.text: Read the rim of the bronze ding

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense smoke curls out of the bronze ding. Beneath the ash, something that is not incense glints.

objectives.text: Tell Steward Qian what you found

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: In MY grain store! Under MY nose! I am never trusting a beam again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: We all were, Elder Bai. We all were.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Recorded, sealed and posted. Three hundred points, and my personal nod.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Third Hundred
quests.summary: Xiao Man starts her third hundred medicine bundles before anyone asks her to stop the first two hundred.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I know. I know. But if I stop, I have to think about him instead. So: bundle two hundred and one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Come back with all your fingers. I've grown used to counting ten.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Elder Mo. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Adequate. Don't look so pleased.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Drink this. No, it doesn't taste good. That's how you know it works.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: The Mountain's New Watch
quests.summary: With the Law Hall hollowed out, someone has to walk its old patrol routes until new watchers are trained.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Deal with the Law Hall turncoats at the crane roost.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Xiao Man, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Sect Master. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

objectives.text: Clear the crane roost of Law Hall turncoats

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Law Hall turncoats fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Stop the Law Hall turncoats regrouping
Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Lu Ping is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: See? Even Elder Hua agrees. It must be true.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: By the precepts! I know those! Well, most of them!

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: What the Sect Master Doesn't Say
quests.summary: Sect Master Yun says little about how she feels, but Han Xue has learned to read the silences.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She hasn't slept properly since the array burned. She won't say so. Someone should say it for her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Xiao Man.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the formation hall. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Fan Rui. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: No precedent for that at all. How exciting.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Blue Robes, Heavy Sleeves
quests.summary: The Sect Master names you an inner disciple before the whole sect. The robes are blue, and the sleeves are very long.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: By the tournament's law and my own wish, you are an inner disciple of the Azure Cloud. Kneel. Now stand. Don't trip on the sleeves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you should be resting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And you should be retired, Mo. We both make sacrifices.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

objectives.text: Trace the seal at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A hundred disciples watch from the plaza. Some clap. Some don't. Lu Ping cheers loud enough for the ones who don't.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the lines of the seal with your qi until they glow clean.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Blue suits you. Don't let it go to your head; the sleeves are there to hide how much your arms shake.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Listen to Steward Qian. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Inner disciples get a peak, a master and a thousand new ways to be embarrassed. Go and find out which peak wants you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Elder Mo, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Every Peak Wants You
quests.summary: Frost Sword, Thunder, Cloud and Cinder Peak all send letters. Every letter is very polite and slightly threatening.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Four letters! Four peaks want you! Frost Sword, Thunder, Cloud and Cinder. Cinder's letter is on fire. Literally, a bit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: What Yan Tie said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Read the peaks' invitations

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Frost Sword: discipline. Thunder: strength. Cloud: patience. Cinder: we have the best food. The last line is underlined twice.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Frost Sword Peak is my peak. I'm not going to tell you to choose it. I'm going to stand here and look disappointed until you do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Can I choose the Sect Master's side and visit all four?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Yan Tie. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the most diplomatic cowardice I've ever heard. She'll love it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Debt
quests.summary: Yan Tie, the champion you saved from the Frenzy Pill, is on his feet again. He has come to repay a debt he cannot measure.

objectives.text: See what Yan Tie wants

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Yan Tie. You know me. You broke my ribs to save my life. I've come to say thank you, and to ask for a rematch.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhao Kang. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Not now. When I've forgotten the taste of that pill. Some nights I still wake with red at the edges of my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says it passes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says a lot of kind things. I'd rather hear them from someone who's been through it. So, you, eventually.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The great Yan Tie, thanking a village brat. The world's gone upside down. I suppose I'll have to get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Zhao Kang said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell him I said he fought well in the final. Before the pill. He did.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm... not going to tell anyone about that one.

quests.title: Thunder Peak Trials
quests.summary: Yan Tie invites you to Thunder Peak's morning trials, where the puppets are heavier and the disciples are louder.

objectives.text: Hear Yan Tie out

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak trains at dawn. We shout. It helps the qi. It also annoys Frost Sword Peak, which helps morale.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Face Thunder Peak's heavy puppets

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Louder! If the puppet can't hear you, it won't respect you!

objectives.text: See Yan Tie again

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good. Your foundation is solid. Heavy, like a river stone. Most new inner disciples float. You sink. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Lu Ping. Lu Ping won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

quests.title: The Inner Sect Allowance
quests.summary: Inner disciples draw a real allowance. Steward Qian regards this as a personal tragedy.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Inner allowance: twelve spirit stones a month. Twelve! When I was an inner disciple it was six, and we were grateful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Do as Steward Qian says. For once, someone is making sense.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: There. Elder Mo agrees. Settled.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Steward Qian says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (to Steward Qian) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Collect them from the donation boxes yourself. I refuse to hand over that many stones with my own hands. It's bad for my heart.

objectives.text: Collect your allowance from the donation boxes
Return to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Twelve. Count them in front of me. Slowly. I want to say goodbye to each one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Envy Wears Blue Too
quests.summary: Not every inner disciple is pleased that a village orphan skipped the line. Three of them want to test the new robes.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Three inner disciples from Cloud Peak are waiting at the training ground. They say you bought your victory with luck.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't break anything that belongs to the sect. I will know. I always know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Steward Qian. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I said it was stubbornness, which is much worse to fight. They didn't listen. Go on. I'll hold your sleeves.

objectives.text: Answer the Cloud Peak challenge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three Cloud Peak disciples bow with exaggerated courtesy, and then do not wait for you to bow back.

objectives.text: Go back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Three. Hm. I would have beaten four. But you didn't use your elbows once, which Elder Mo will be pleased about.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Zhao Kang will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan has always said envy is a compliment with a knife in it. Congratulations. You're being complimented.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The three inner disciples who ambushed you are nursing bruises, afraid you'll report them.

choices.text: Forgive them

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Report them to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Humiliate them in front of the inner court

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Duties of a Champion
quests.summary: Your first task at the Sect Master's side: carry her orders around the mountain, and learn how a sect is actually run.

objectives.text: Answer the Sect Master's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take these to every peak master. Read them first. If you understand why I wrote each one, you'll understand the sect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.text: Hurry to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One order about rice, one about roof tiles, one about a disciple's mother who is ill. And one that says only: watch the Abyss road.

objectives.text: Read the Sect Master's orders

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every order is signed the same way, in small plain characters: Yun Qingyao, who is tired, and grateful.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She signs them like that? Every one? ...I never read the signatures. I should have.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Zhao Kang.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Stone Guardians Wake
quests.summary: The cracked Azure Eye leaks qi, and the old stone guardians of the peaks wake confused and angry.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The peak guardians are awake! The big stone ones! One of them sat on Cinder Peak's kitchen! Nobody's getting lunch!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

objectives.text: Calm the leaking formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qi spills from the crack in the Azure Eye like steam from a kettle. You press your palm to it until the hiss softens.

objectives.text: Fight off the peak guardians

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stone guardians lumber across the training ground, eyes glowing a confused and furious blue.

objectives.text: Break the peak guardians at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The peak guardians come on in silence.

objectives.text: Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They went back to sleep! Mostly. One of them is still sitting on the kitchen. Cinder Peak says they're used to it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Different Eyes
quests.summary: The mountain looks at you differently now. Some of the looks are warm. Some are measuring. One is Elder Mo's.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The outer disciples have started bowing to you. I bowed to you this morning. It felt weird. Let's never do that again.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Also, I've started a fan club. It has four members. Three of them are me under different names.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Some of the inner disciples think you're the Sect Master's pet. Some think you're a Blood Moon spy. Nobody thinks you're ordinary.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we did this uphill. Both ways. In the snow. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Elder Mo. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ordinary was nice while it lasted. Walk straight. They're watching.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I watched your spar with the Cloud Peak three. Adequate. The blue is heavy. It's supposed to be.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Lu Ping?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Don't let it bend you. Let it hold you up. That's the only trick to wearing it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Fan Club's Fifth Member
quests.summary: Lu Ping's fan club gains a genuine member who isn't Lu Ping in a hat, and he doesn't know what to do with the sincerity.

objectives.text: See what Lu Ping wants

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A real member! Not me! I don't know how to handle this. I may have to take it seriously now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Zhong Ming.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the sunrise terrace.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you should be resting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And you should be retired, Mo. We both make sacrifices.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever the Sect Master said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Mo has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Sect Master. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eat something. You look like a boiled noodle with ambitions.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Peak Guardian Repairs
quests.summary: The peak guardian that sat on Cinder Peak's kitchen needs its cracked foot mended before it wakes up cranky.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian out

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Steward Qian is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Steward Qian, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name, and all of them are mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard
Bring word to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Do you know what that costs? I do. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Frost Sword's Quiet Test
quests.summary: Frost Sword Peak sends no letter this time, just a single disciple who watches you train and says nothing.

objectives.text: Go to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash drifts across the pill kiln yard. A kiln door opens with a roar, and a disciple ducks a gout of flame.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's Peak Master Shen's way of testing you. If you ask what he wants, you've already failed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Fan Rui. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Guardians Still Wandering
quests.summary: A few peak guardians remain confused and loose around the mountain, in need of a firm but gentle hand.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sword in the stone is cold and humming. For a moment you hear its last owner's oath, word for word.

objectives.text: Stop the peak guardians at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: More peak guardians? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the summit of Sword Peak
Share your findings with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: We're done at the spirit peach orchard. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Not now, Tang Ling. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Sign here. And here. And here. No, the other here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (hiding behind Steward Qian) Oh.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Steward Qian) That was amazing.

quests.title: Cinder Peak's Cooking Fire
quests.summary: Cinder Peak challenges you to keep a cooking fire steady through a full sparring bout, on the theory that skill shows in small things.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Deal with the inner disciples at the Sword Peak path, would you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Steward Qian is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

objectives.text: Defeat the inner disciples at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: See Steward Qian again

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is not a well. It is a very small cup.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Backhanded Praise
quests.summary: Zhao Kang has apparently been telling other inner disciples that you fight adequately, which from him is a parade.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I said adequately. I did not say well. Do not repeat this as praise. It was practically an insult.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhong Ming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we trained in the snow. Uphill. With buckets.

objectives.text: Talk with Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Yan Tie) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Second Order
quests.summary: A second batch of the Sect Master's orders needs delivering, this one heavier with worry than the first.

objectives.text: Investigate the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One order concerns grain. One concerns the Law Hall's replacements. One, unsigned even in small characters, simply reads: watch each other.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Steward Qian's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Between Puppets and Peace
quests.summary: Yan Tie shows you Thunder Peak's trick for cultivating in the noisy gaps between training bouts.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You don't need silence to breathe right. You need to stop waiting for it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: No, Lu Ping. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Meditate at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Breath by breath the foundation widens, until it feels like standing on bedrock.

objectives.text: Return to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Sect Master. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart first, fist second. Just like the peak teaches!

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Envy, Reconsidered
quests.summary: One of the Cloud Peak disciples who challenged you earlier comes back alone, to apologize badly.

objectives.text: Study the jade screen at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He mumbles something about pressure and expectations, refuses to make eye contact, and leaves before you can answer properly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Light passes through the jade screen and throws a pattern on the floor: a map, if you stand just right.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the inner sect gate isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Yan Tie. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Mo. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Spare Parts
quests.summary: Thunder Peak's forge needs star-grade charcoal fetched from the treasury stores before the next trial.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me spirit stones from the laundry stream.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Fan Rui. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the laundry stream
Go back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Tang Ling?

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Foundation Like River Stone
quests.summary: Yan Tie called your foundation a river stone. Elder Mo agrees, and sends you to the cliff to prove it.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: River stone, Yan Tie says. River stones get smooth by sitting in the current for a very long time. Go and sit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Lu Ping. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

objectives.text: Temper your foundation at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wind off the sea of clouds pours over you like a river. Your foundation does not move. Layer by layer, it grows.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: When you rise, you are heavier and lighter at once. Middle stage of Foundation Establishment.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You were sitting in my spot. I let you. That is the biggest thank you Thunder Peak knows how to give.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Feet first, then eyes, then sword. In that order. Every time.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Red at the Edges
quests.summary: Disciples on three peaks have red at the edges of their eyes. Elder Hua knows exactly what that means.

objectives.text: See what Elder Hua wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Nine disciples, three peaks, the same red ring around the iris. Frenzy residue. Gu salted our rations, not just the tournament.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Elder Hua said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Elder Hua, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: It sleeps in the meridians until anger wakes it. We need a Clear-Heart Pill. We've never needed one before.

objectives.text: Browse the scroll rack at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the pavilion, a Cloud Peak disciple sits very still, fists clenched, humming to drown out something only he can hear.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dust lies thick on the scroll rack, except on one shelf, where a hand has been reaching often and recently.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I know that humming. I did it for a week after the final. It's what you do so you don't hit anyone.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Did you spend anything? Lose anything? Borrow anything from anyone who writes things down?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: More or less. Mostly less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Whatever Elder Hua needs, I'll help. Nobody should have to hum through that.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Recipe From the Fourth Floor
quests.summary: Elder Bai finds a Clear-Heart recipe in a book about turtle soup. Of course he does. It calls for herbs the sect doesn't grow.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Man out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (steps back half a pace) {senior}... people say things about you. I don't believe them. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Bai found the recipe! In a turtle soup book! He says it's where he hides everything important. We need calm-root and red-veined sage.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Yan Tie. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.
