dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: We have the sage. Calm-root only grows in the bamboo, near water. I'll draw you a map. It'll be a bad map.

objectives.text: Gather red-veined sage on the terraces
Report back to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That's the sage. Now the calm-root. Take my map. The squiggle is a stream. The other squiggle is also a stream.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Steward Qian.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Calm-Root by the Stream
quests.summary: The calm-root grows along the forest stream, where the wolves have started drinking again.

objectives.text: Search the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Pale calm-root trails in the stream like hair. On the far bank, wolves lift their heads, water dripping from their jaws.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wolves have red at the edges of their eyes too. Whoever salted the sect's rations salted the forest's water.

objectives.text: Harvest calm-root from the stream
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came to help carry. I ate one calm-root. I feel incredibly calm. I may never move again.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Clean tracking. You'd make a decent hunter, if you ever stop being a hero.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Meng Sanniang. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Wei Tong) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The wolves had the red too. Poor things. They didn't hum. They just bit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Hermit's Correction
quests.summary: The hermit reads the recipe over your shoulder and tuts. The Verdant Lotus made Clear-Heart Pills three centuries ago.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Turtle soup. Of course. Bai Qiu's grandmother taught him that trick. Your recipe is wrong, by the way. One line.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Add a lotus petal, from the spring, picked by the heir. The Heart Sutra does the rest. That is how we made them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Picked by me? Why me?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Because the lotus listens to you. It never listened to me. I ran from it, and it remembers.

objectives.text: Pick a lotus petal from the spirit spring
Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One petal is enough. Don't take more; the spring is generous, not stupid.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Holding the Fire
quests.summary: Refining a Clear-Heart Pill takes a fire held perfectly steady for an hour. Elder Hua has you practise on ordinary pills first.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The fire must not flicker for one hour. Not for a sneeze, not for a thought. Practise on these Vitality Pills first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Xiao Man. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If the cauldron starts to sing, step back. If it starts to scream, run.

objectives.text: Hold the cauldron fire steady

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi flows into the flame. It gutters, steadies, gutters. The cauldron begins to sing, very softly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then scream. You run. Behind you, a small green explosion, and a rain of slightly singed Vitality Pills.

objectives.text: See Elder Hua again

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Singed, not ruined. Better than my first attempt. I lost my eyebrows for a season.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Answer Yan Tie, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Again. And this time, when it sings, sing back. The fire likes company.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. The heart heals slower than bones. Look after yours.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Frenzy on Cinder Peak
quests.summary: Before the pill is ready, three disciples on Cinder Peak lose the fight with their residue.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Cinder Peak! Three of them snapped at once. They're tearing up the training ground. Don't hurt them. Much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Man. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Clear the martial stage of frenzied disciples

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Red-eyed disciples swing practice swords like woodcutters, weeping as they do it.

objectives.text: Fight off the frenzied disciples

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Another two on the plaza! Pin them, don't break them!

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Five more in my infirmary. We need that pill. Tonight. Whatever it takes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Hua is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Hua) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: One Hour Without Flicker
quests.summary: The real refinement: calm-root, red-veined sage, a lotus petal, and one hour in which your fire must not waver.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Everything's in the cauldron. The rest is you. One hour. I'll stand by with a bucket.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Two leaves and a bud, disciple. Take only what you need, whatever you're picking.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Elder Hua, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: And I'll stand by with a second bucket. For Elder Hua.

objectives.text: Refine the Clear-Heart Pills

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cauldron sings. You sing back, a nonsense song Wei Tong taught you. The fire steadies. An hour passes like a breath.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine pills roll out, white as milk, each with a faint green lotus in its heart.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Nine. Nine perfect pills. I'm not crying. The smoke is very strong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A gentle hand. That's the best medicine there is.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Hua) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Nine Pills, Nine Disciples
quests.summary: Nine pills for nine disciples. Some of them are in the infirmary; some are hiding their red eyes around the mountain.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Five in my infirmary, four still out there pretending they're fine. Find them. They won't come to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Tang Ling has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Find the hiding disciples in the plum garden
Talk with Yan Tie at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That's all nine. The humming's stopped. You don't know how quiet the world is when it stops.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak owes you another debt. We'll have to invent a bigger bow.

objectives.choice_prompt: One pill is left over. A tenth disciple, too proud to admit his red eyes, hides at the cliff.

choices.text: Give it to him, quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Report him so the Medicine Hall can treat him

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Sell it to him

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (tugging Yan Tie's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Where the Residue Came From
quests.summary: The pills are working. But how did the residue get into the rations? Steward Qian keeps the grain ledgers.

objectives.text: See what Steward Qian wants

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The grain ledgers? Every sack in, every sack out. I keep them under my pillow. Don't ask why.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

objectives.text: Check the treasury's grain ledgers

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every grain delivery for two years came through Qingshi, and every one was approved by the Law Hall. Gu's seal, on every page.

objectives.text: Go back to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: He approved the rice. I thought he was being thorough. I thought, how kind, the Law Hall checking our rice.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I count stones. I never counted what was in the sacks. I'm going to count everything now. Everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Medicine Bundles
quests.summary: Elder Hua was right: work helps. Xiao Man has made two hundred medicine bundles and is starting on the third hundred.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Man out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Two hundred bundles! For whoever goes to the Abyss. I've only dropped eleven. Well, eleven that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Each one has a note inside. Most say 'get well soon'. One says 'Xiao Shi, you idiot, write to me'. In case.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: She'll make a healer yet. Not because of her hands. Because of the notes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Wei Tong, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take one bundle. For luck. And for when you find him.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Risky. Like my better remedies.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at Elder Hua) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Restocking the Cauldron
quests.summary: The Clear-Heart recipe used up the Medicine Hall's calm-root reserves. Elder Hua wants them replenished before the next crisis.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Fan Rui. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the medicine valley
Report back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Tang Ling. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (beaming at Yan Tie) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Yan Tie's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Who Else Ate the Rice
quests.summary: Steward Qian's ledger audit turns up more grain shipments that need tracing before anyone trusts the pantry again.

objectives.text: Head to the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Disciples crowd the mission hall's boards, arguing over which chores pay the most contribution for the least mud.

objectives.text: Check the notice board

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Slips flutter on the notice board, three deep. Under a request for firewood, one note is newer, and written in a hurry.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every sack. I'm checking every sack now. My back hurts. My trust issues are thriving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Wolves Still Drinking Red
quests.summary: A handful of wolves along the stream still carry frenzy residue in their blood, dangerous until it fades.

objectives.text: Make your way to the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey robes flap on lines above the laundry stream. The water runs cold enough to wake a sleeping core.

objectives.text: Break the corrupted wolves at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the laundry stream
Share your findings with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Oh thank heavens. I was so nervous I watered the lanterns twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sorry I worried you.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold out your wrist. Hm. Your pulse is stubborn. Like you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Yan Tie Teaches the Hum
quests.summary: Yan Tie teaches younger disciples the humming trick that got him through his own frenzy residue.

objectives.text: Go and see Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hum badly. Hum loudly. It doesn't matter if it's music. It matters that it's yours.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Man. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Steward Qian thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name, and all of them are mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The Lotus Petal's Lesson
quests.summary: The hermit's trick with the lotus petal works too well not to study further. Han Xue wants to understand why.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A petal that listens to you specifically. That's not alchemy. That's something else. Sit with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Mud, root, blossom. The Heart Sutra turns in you, slow and patient.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Steward Qian's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Turtle Soup Diplomacy
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants his turtle soup recipes properly reshelved, separate from anything actually important, this time with a lock.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me jade slips from the outer dormitories.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: Xiao Man, stop feeding the golden carp.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He looked hungry! He always looks hungry!

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Recover jade slips from the outer dormitories
See Xiao Man again

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three herbs today! Well. Three that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The jade slips came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: The Grain Route, Mapped
quests.summary: With Qian's ledgers cross-referenced, a rough map of the tainted grain's route through Qingshi starts to form.

objectives.text: Scout the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every road on the map ends at the same warehouse. Merchant Jin's warehouse. Again.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Tell Steward Qian what you found

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Wei Tong. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a scratch? Let me check. Hm. One scratch. I'll allow it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Do you know what that costs? I do. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Calm-Root Regret
quests.summary: Wei Tong is still recovering from eating an entire calm-root and would like everyone to stop mentioning it.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I was helping! Tasting for quality! I have never felt so at peace and so humiliated at the same time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even the hermit agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The hermit is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to the hermit) That was amazing.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Guarding the Cauldron Room
quests.summary: With frenzy pills proven real, the Medicine Hall's cauldron room needs a proper watch until trust is rebuilt.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Take a look at the sword tomb. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Steward Qian. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You close your hand on the hilt of the sword in the stone. It hums, weighs you, and decides to stay where it is.

objectives.text: Stop the frenzied disciples at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The frenzied disciples have found you first.

objectives.text: Hold the medicine valley against more frenzied disciples
Talk with Steward Qian at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Steward Qian does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Steward Qian's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: What the Cure Cost
quests.summary: Between the pill, the residue and the ledgers, your cultivation has hardened around a new, harder patience.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Hua out

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You didn't just help make a cure. You watched what carelessness costs. Carry that. It's worth more than the pill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Wei Tong. That was very... something.

objectives.text: Consolidate your cultivation at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation drinks in the qi and hardens, layer on layer, like jade forming in the dark.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Xiao Man says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That makes sense. I think.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Every Bird at Once
quests.summary: At dawn every bird in the bamboo forest takes flight at once. Elder Mo does not need a scout to know what that means.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Every bird in the bamboo took off at dawn. All at once. That's not weather. That's a tide.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu kept the forest wards. We thought. Take Han Xue, Wei Tong and Yan Tie. Get the hermit out, or dig in beside him.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the far forest gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest is loud with running things. Deer, foxes, a family of boars, all fleeing past you toward the sect.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the far forest gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everything's running this way. Which means whatever they're running from is that way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Zhao Kang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The hermit's hut is that way too. Of course it is.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Leashes, Not Wards
quests.summary: The ward-stones Gu planted along the forest path are cracked from the inside. They were never keeping beasts out.

objectives.text: Hurry to the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A ward-stone stands by the path, split down the middle. The runes inside are not warding runes.

objectives.text: Examine the split ward-stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Summoning runes. Gu planted leashes and called them wards. Every beast within a day's walk has been waiting for them to break.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: He planted a trap and waited for his own flight to spring it. Twenty years of patience. That's frightening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we're the ones who have to be faster.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Hermit. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

quests.title: The First Wave
quests.summary: The first wave comes through the herb grove: wolves, dozens of them, red-eyed and running.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Wolves! A river of wolves! Dumpling, I'm sorry, you're going to get very dirty today.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the corrupted wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted wolves at the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold the bridge! If they cross the stream, they're at the hut!

objectives.text: Go to the poison marsh

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The first wave breaks on the bridge and scatters. Across the water, the bamboo is still shaking.

quests.title: The Hermit Won't Leave
quests.summary: The hermit refuses to leave his hut. He says he ran once, three hundred years ago, and has only just stopped.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I will not leave. I ran from the Verdant Lotus's last stand. I have only recently stopped running. I will not start again for wolves.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: But you may stay and help, if you like. I'll make tea.

objectives.text: Wake the old shrine's ward

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine's stele answers your pendant with a low green hum. For the first time in three centuries, a real ward rises over the forest.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves hit the edge of the ward and recoil, snarling. Some of them find the gaps.

objectives.text: Go back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A true ward. Verdant Lotus work, woken by Verdant Lotus blood. It won't hold forever. Nothing does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There you are! I was about to go looking with a torch and a very large spoon.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Stones That Walk
quests.summary: The tide has woken the ruins' stone sentinels, and they cannot tell friend from wolf.

objectives.text: Examine the guardian lion at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the ruins gate, stone sentinels stagger out, swinging at wolves and trees and anything that moves.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The guardian lion stares down at you, one paw on a carved ball. Something is wedged beneath the paw.

objectives.text: Clear the ruins gate of stone golems

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stone men again! I came to help! Nobody told me it was stone men again!

objectives.text: Collect the sentinels' rune-stones
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me after you. He said you'd need someone to complain at. I'm very good at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Those stones were your family's, weren't they. The Verdant Lotus. I'm sorry I broke them. Slightly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) We should talk about that. Later.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

quests.title: The Eye of the Storm
quests.summary: The ward holds for now. In the lull, the hermit tells you to rest, because the next wave has a king.

objectives.text: Report to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The ward holds. For an hour, perhaps two. Sit. Breathe. The next wave will have a king at its head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what the hermit says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.text: Rest your qi by the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spring is still while the forest howls. Your foundation drinks from it, slow and deep, like roots in dry season.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: There's something huge in the deep forest. The wolves part for it. It's coming this way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Yan Tie, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying. The bigger they are, the louder you shout. I intend to shout very loudly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Wolves Before the King
quests.summary: The king's pack comes first, circling to find the gaps in the ward.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're circling. Looking for the weak side. Wei Tong, left. Yan Tie, right. You, wherever it's worst.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

objectives.text: Fight off the corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The corrupted wolves spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Finish the spirit wolves at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the old den pour wolves with silver-tipped fur, larger than any you've seen. The king's own pack.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I've stopped counting wolves. I'm counting teeth now. It's a bigger number but it feels more manageable.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about food, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about your clan, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Bloodmaw, Lord of the Tide
quests.summary: At the head of the tide comes Bloodmaw, a wolf king older than the one you buried, gorged on twenty years of Gu's blood.

objectives.text: Investigate the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends aside. A wolf the size of a cart pads into the clearing, fur black with old blood, eyes like coals.

objectives.name: Bloodmaw, Lord of the Tide
objectives.text: Defeat Bloodmaw, Lord of the Tide

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's not a wolf. That's twenty years of someone's patience with teeth. Together!

objectives.text: Lay the wolf king to rest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press a purifying talisman to the great brow. The red drains from its eyes. For a moment it is only an old wolf, very tired.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Rest easy, old king. I'm saying that to all of them now. It seems right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Hermit. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's followers throw down their weapons and kneel.

choices.text: Let them go home

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Bring them to face the sect's judgement

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make an example of them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: After the Tide
quests.summary: The tide has broken. The forest is torn and quiet, and the hermit wants every one of the leash-stones dug up.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Dig up every leash-stone Gu planted. Every one. I want this forest to belong to itself again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: If anything smells sweet in there, hold your breath. Sweet is how poison says hello.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

objectives.text: Dig up the leash-stones in the grove
Break the spirit wolves at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A few stragglers still guard the old den, confused and frightened now that no one is calling them.

objectives.text: Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you. It is a strange thing, to be protected. I had forgotten how it feels.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Qu Wanqing?

objectives.choice_prompt: The dug-up leash-stones would fetch a fortune from any beast-tamer, and leash beasts again.

choices.text: Smash them

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Give them to the sect to study

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Sell them to a beast-tamer

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to the hermit) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Beasts Toward Qingshi
quests.summary: Not every beast ran into your ward. The hermit's birds say a second tide turned east, toward the river and the town.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My birds say half the tide turned east. Toward the river. Toward your town with the good noodles.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Yan Tie. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Qingshi. Of course. The town's always in the way of something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Pei Yuan. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We go now. The magistrate will make a speech. We'll have to fight through it.

objectives.text: Talk with Yan Tie at the charcoal kilns

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak goes where the thunder goes. Lead the way.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows faster than I cut. I've made my peace with it. The bamboo hasn't.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Big Shu.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: What the Tide Left Behind
quests.summary: The forest floor is scattered with things the fleeing beasts dropped or trampled, some of it worth recovering.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me wolf fangs from the tiger ridge. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Hermit. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

objectives.text: Gather wolf fangs at the tiger ridge
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more wolf fangs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Ward-Stones, Mapped
quests.summary: The hermit wants every leash-stone's original position marked, to be sure none were missed in the dig-up.

objectives.text: Search the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Axes ring through the woodcutters' camp, and the smell of green sap is sharp enough to sneeze at.

objectives.text: Mark the map table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Talk it over with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Gu was thorough. I want to be more thorough. Mark every hole, even the empty ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Tide's Last Stragglers
quests.summary: A handful of beasts never rejoined the tide and now wander the forest, lost and easily startled.

objectives.text: Beat the war drum at the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the war drum. The boom rolls out across the land and comes back from the hills, twice.

objectives.text: Stop the spirit wolves at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the smugglers' trail
Share your findings with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The village shrine is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The earth god will hear of this. Loudly. We'll light the big incense.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. Headman Kuang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Yan Tie) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Apology to the Stones
quests.summary: Zhao Kang insists on personally apologizing to the ruins for the sentinels he 'slightly' broke, out loud, to the stone.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I know it can't hear me. I'm apologizing anyway. My mother says half of manners is doing them uselessly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You've got mud to the knees and a grin to the ears. Wipe off one of them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Elder Mo. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Are you certain, Yan Tie? I've seen {them} trip over a doorstep.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the ruins gate. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: No, Yan Tie. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Steady After the Tide
quests.summary: Yan Tie insists everyone sit and breathe properly before marching anywhere else, tide or no tide.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak shouts, but even we know when to stop and breathe. Sit. Just for a minute.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Zhao Kang. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Cultivate at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Breath by breath the foundation widens, until it feels like standing on bedrock.

objectives.text: See Yan Tie again

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Yan Tie) That was cold.

quests.title: The Hermit's Tea, Restocked
quests.summary: With his hut still standing, the hermit needs his tea stores restocked before he'll properly relax.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the hidden valley. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Han Xue is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the hidden valley
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Wei Tong. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Bloodmaw's Collar
quests.summary: Among the fallen wolf king's things is a second collar, unused, meant for something even larger.

objectives.text: Head to the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A bored sentry leans over the watchpost railing, straightening hurriedly when he sees your robes.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A spare collar. Meant for what, if Bloodmaw needed one that size? I don't like the answer I'm imagining.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Wolf Count
quests.summary: Wei Tong has been keeping an official tally of wolves fought since the beginning, and insists on sharing the final number.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Forty-one wolves, personally! Not counting the ones you got. I'm calling it a career milestone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Look at that stance. A strong wind would file a complaint.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Mo. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the misty lake.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Mo has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Elder Mo said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. Now, where was I.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Watching the Forest Heal
quests.summary: The bamboo forest needs a quiet watch kept while it recovers, in case anything else wakes up confused.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Deal with the corrupted wolves at the sunken courtyard. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted wolves at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Cut down the corrupted wolves that follow
Meet Yan Tie at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Yan Tie thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll prove you wrong. Politely.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: What the Tide Taught
quests.summary: Facing a tide of beasts and a king twenty years fed on stolen blood has settled something new into your foundation.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You held a forest together today. That's not a small thing, even for someone your age. Especially for someone your age.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Zhao Kang, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

objectives.text: Refine your cultivation at the giant banyan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Mud, root, blossom. The Heart Sutra turns in you, slow and patient.

objectives.text: Go back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Before Nightfall
