quests.summary: You reach Qingshi at noon. The tide will reach it at dusk. Constable Du is already stacking carts across the road.

objectives.text: Read the notice board at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Carts are stacked across the road. Farmers carry children and chickens through the gate in a steady, frightened stream.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the notice board from corner to corner. Someone has crossed out a name and written a warning beside it.

objectives.text: Talk with Constable Du at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Beasts, the birds say. A whole forest's worth. I've got carts, spears and the magistrate. The magistrate's making a speech.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Tell me what to do and I'll do it. Tell the magistrate and he'll do it louder.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: Everyone Has a Job
quests.summary: A town can be saved by everyone doing one small thing. Madam Fang, Old Pan and Widow Liu already know theirs.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The inn's cellar holds forty. I've put the children in it with the wine. The children are guarding the wine. We'll see who wins.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Madam Fang, your gossip is faster than my runners.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My gossip is paid in wine, Constable. Your runners aren't.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Madam Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Ferry's running both ways. Farmers across, fish back. If the beasts come by water, I'll ring the dock bell. Twice. With feeling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Pan. More sense there than in half this town.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: There. Widow Liu agrees. Settled.

objectives.text: Join Widow Liu at the dye yard

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Water. Fighters need water. I'll carry it to the wall. I carried it for a year looking for my son. I can carry it one more night.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: My weavers are frightened to walk home after dark. Please, make it stop.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Qiao Niang.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: weaver_qiao
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Widow Liu, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Oil for the Braziers
quests.summary: Beasts fear fire. The town's braziers need oil, and the only oil is in the guild warehouse.

objectives.text: Go and see Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Oil? For the braziers? Take it! All of it! Well, most of it. Some of it is imported. Fine! All of it!

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then come and watch.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I'd like it noted that I was helpful. By someone. In writing.

objectives.text: Carry oil from the warehouse
Light the gate braziers

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The braziers catch one by one along the wall. A ring of fire rises around Qingshi as the sun touches the hills.

objectives.text: Speak with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Fire's up. Beasts are coming. Merchant Jin asked me to write down that he was helpful. I wrote it down. In pencil.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

objectives.choice_prompt: The lantern oil came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Reasonable. Written down.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The Tide Arrives
quests.summary: At dusk the fields fill with eyes.

objectives.text: Answer Magistrate Zhou's summons

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Citizens of Qingshi! Fear not! The Azure Cloud is here, and I have written a very short speech! It is one word! Hold!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Ring the town bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Across the fields a hundred pairs of red eyes turn toward the sound, and begin to run.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Keep them off the fields! Every wolf on the rice is a winter without bread!

objectives.text: Clear the east gate of corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Report back to Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: One word! Hold! And they held! I have never given a better speech. I may never speak again. It can't be topped.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: Remarkable. I'll set it as an essay question. The students will hate you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Scholar Ouyang.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Wolves on the Water
quests.summary: Some of the wolves took the river. Old Pan rings the dock bell twice, with feeling.

objectives.text: Report to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Wolves in the water! Swimming! I didn't know wolves swam! Nobody tells a ferryman anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

objectives.text: Fight off the spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Stop the corrupted wolves regrouping

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're in the market! Keep them away from the inn cellar!

objectives.text: Bring word to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. First time I've hit a wolf with an oar. Won't be the last, I'd wager. It felt wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Old Pan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Not now, Han Xue. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Old Pan) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Stone in the Graveyard
quests.summary: Something heavy is walking among the hill graves. Deacon Hong's old circle has woken a stone guardian meant for the dead.

objectives.text: Read the ancestral tablets at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grave tablets topple one by one. Among them lumbers a stone guardian, blood-ink still smeared on its chest.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ancestral tablets stand in silent rows. You read the names aloud, softly, because someone should.

objectives.text: Break the stone golems at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It swings at the tombs as if the dead had wronged it personally.

objectives.text: Gather the fallen grave tablets
Compare notes with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You put the tablets back. All of them. People will cry when they see that in the morning. Good crying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: apothecary_wang
dialogue.text: Good. My drawers will sleep easier. So will I.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Wang Pu. Heaven bless {them}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: apothecary_wang
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: apothecary_wang
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The Longest Hour
quests.summary: The tide throws everything left at the town gate in one last push.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Everything they've got, right at the gate. My spear's broken. I'm using the magistrate's proclamation board.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Wei Tong. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

objectives.text: Reinforce the gate ward with your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation pours into the gate like water into cracks. The old timbers stop groaning.

objectives.text: Stop the corrupted wolves at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The corrupted wolves come on in silence.

objectives.text: Hold the night market against more spirit wolves
Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I followed you down from the sect. Elder Mo said stay. I said Qingshi has noodles. He understood.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: actress_yu
dialogue.text: Look at that brooding face. I could use you in the second act. You'd die beautifully.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look. Dawn. They're running back to the forest. We did it. The noodle shop is safe.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

reply.speaker: actress_yu
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: actress_yu
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Morning in the Market
quests.summary: The town wakes up alive. Madam Fang opens the cellar. The children have not drunk the wine. Mostly.

objectives.text: See what Madam Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The children guarded the wine. Heroically. One of them guarded it into his stomach. He's asleep in a barrel.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Free noodles for everyone who stood on that wall. Which is everyone. I'm going to be poor and happy.

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I was helpful. Everyone saw. The constable wrote it in pencil, but it's written.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: It felt... strange. Good strange. I didn't charge anyone for anything all night. I may be ill.

objectives.text: Talk with Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My arms hurt. I carried water all night. I kept thinking, Liu Er would have carried twice as much and complained the whole way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie, but it's cultivator's work.

objectives.choice_prompt: A water-seller at the well is charging ten times the price to the families who carried water all night.

choices.text: Make him sell at a fair price

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Report him to the magistrate

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take a cut of his profits

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Widow Liu, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: What Drove Them
quests.summary: Among the beasts you find a collar of blood-red jade, still humming. Someone didn't just release the tide. Someone steered it.

objectives.text: Make your way to the east gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among the fallen beasts lies a wolf wearing a collar of blood-red jade, carved with a crescent. It still hums faintly.

objectives.text: Break the humming collar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The collar cracks. For a moment you hear a voice from very far and very deep, counting, as if it were keeping score.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steered. Not released. Someone pointed this tide at Qingshi on purpose.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone who knows the town. Someone who's been here. Gu, or his friends. We need to know where they come and go.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Rebuilding the Wall
quests.summary: Qingshi's wall took a beating from the tide. Constable Du wants timber and stone gathered before the next threat, whatever it is.

objectives.text: Hear Yan Tie out

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me spirit stones from the pottery kilns.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Merchant Jin. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Yan Tie) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the pottery kilns
See Yan Tie again

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a long story. The short version: yes.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Collar's Maker
quests.summary: The cracked jade collar bears a maker's mark, faint but readable, that Han Xue wants traced.

objectives.text: Scout the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The open-air opera stage is hung with painted cloths. A drum waits at its side for the next performance.

objectives.text: Repair the puppet frame

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Someone has scratched a tally of defeats into the puppet frame. The puppet is winning.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Not Hong's work, and not crude bandit forging either. Someone skilled made this. Someone we haven't met yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, did you eat? You never eat. Here, half a bun. The bigger half.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...Thank you. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A fine piece of business. I mean that as the highest praise I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Beasts Still in the Fields
quests.summary: A few beasts never made it back to the forest and now hide, frightened and dangerous, in the terraced fields.

objectives.text: Hurry to the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back alley is narrow and damp, and every window in it is watching you.

objectives.text: Defeat the spirit wolves at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the back alley
Share your findings with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: The little ones will want the story at bedtime. Keep it short. Keep the blood out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The water's sweet this season. Take a cup.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Zhou's Second Speech
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou, emboldened by his one-word triumph, attempts a second speech. It does not go as well.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Citizens! Once again! I have prepared remarks! ...Someone's already sweeping. Never mind. Carry on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Scholar Ouyang.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Find Constable Du at the post station

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Old Pan. The immortal always is. Mostly.

objectives.text: Join Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Madam Fang, your gossip is faster than my runners.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My gossip is paid in wine, Constable. Your runners aren't.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Madam Fang offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Old Pan's Oar, Replaced
quests.summary: Old Pan's wolf-tested oar finally splintered. He refuses any replacement that isn't exactly the same weight.

objectives.text: Go and see Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Bring me lantern oil from the brewery. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Madam Fang. More sense there than in half this town.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There. Widow Liu agrees. Settled.

dialogue.speaker: actress_yu
dialogue.text: Tonight I die of heartbreak. Tomorrow, of poison. Sundays I rest.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the brewery
Return to Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Madam Fang, your gossip is faster than my runners.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My gossip is paid in wine, Constable. Your runners aren't.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wipe your boots! This floor has seen a tax collector.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the lantern oil you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Breathing With the Town
quests.summary: Yan Tie suggests meditating right on the repaired wall, letting the town's returning noise settle your qi instead of fighting it.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak trains in noise on purpose. Try it. Let Qingshi's morning market be your test.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: apothecary_wang
dialogue.text: Half my shelves are empty since the trouble began. Medicine doesn't grow on shelves.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Wang Pu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation drinks in the qi and hardens, layer on layer, like jade forming in the dark.

objectives.text: Go back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: apothecary_wang
dialogue.text: Good. My drawers will sleep easier. So will I.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. Wang Pu's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: apothecary_wang
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Merchant Jin's New Ledger
quests.summary: Merchant Jin, still glowing from a night of genuine helpfulness, insists on showing off his newly honest accounts.

objectives.text: Go to the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Children chase each other round the temple orphanage courtyard, shrieking like happy sparrows.

objectives.text: Leave an offering at the offering table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The dust on the offering table has been disturbed. Beneath the incense bowl lies a folded note.

objectives.text: Tell Merchant Jin what you found

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Look! Real numbers! I don't know what to do with myself. It's terrifying. I recommend it to no one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Light some incense tonight, Han Xue. For luck.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Widow Liu's Rest
quests.summary: For one evening, Widow Liu is convinced to sit down and let someone else carry the water.

objectives.text: Report to Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Strange, sitting still. I've carried water so long I forgot my arms could just... hang there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Merchant Jin. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Widow Liu) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Speak with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Madam Fang! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

objectives.text: Hear what Merchant Jin has to say

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Merchant, your barges keep scraping my ferry.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Old Pan, your ferry keeps being in the way of my barges.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: One More Watch on the Wall
quests.summary: Before the road home, Constable Du asks for one last night's watch, just to be sure the tide is truly done.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Deal with the corrupted wolves at the boat yard, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Madam Fang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the boat yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of corrupted wolves
Meet Yan Tie at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: No, Wei Tong. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Yan Tie, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the corrupted wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Yan Tie) That was cold.

quests.title: Fang's Free Bowl, Reconsidered
quests.summary: Madam Fang tries to walk back her 'free bowls for heroes forever' promise before the whole town takes advantage.

objectives.text: See what Madam Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: I said heroes! Not everyone who once stood near a hero! I need to write better promises.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Listen to Widow Liu. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Magistrate Zhou says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the boat yard

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Merchant Jin. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Old Pan) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Standing on the Wall
quests.summary: You watch the sun rise over the fields from the town wall, and something in your foundation settles into a new shape.

objectives.text: Investigate the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the watchtower, the fields are trampled but green. Smoke rises from a hundred chimneys, all of them breakfast.

objectives.text: Cultivate on the town wall at sunrise

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe in a town that did not die. Your foundation settles, and deepens, and grows quiet. Late stage.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the humpbacked bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You look like someone who's just understood something. Thunder Peak usually just shouts at that point. Go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I think I'm fighting for the wrong reasons. Not the wrong people. The wrong reasons.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Merchant Jin.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. That's too deep for me before breakfast. Tell me after noodles.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart first, fist second. Just like the peak teaches!

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Fair. Fair's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Letter in Spidery Hand
quests.summary: A paper crane lands on your windowsill at the sect: the hermit wants you in the forest. He does not say why.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Mo out

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A paper crane landed on my head this morning. For you. From the hermit. He writes like a spider fell in ink.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One day I'll think of a comeback. Today is not that day.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go. Take Han Xue. The sect can spare its champion for a few days. The puppets will be relieved.

objectives.text: Search the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hermit is waiting outside his hut. There are no cups of tea. That has never happened before.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No tea today. Today we do something difficult, and tea would only make me feel better than I deserve.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Roots, Stem, Blossom
quests.summary: The hermit explains the Heart Sutra's three verses, and why he never finished learning the second.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root: patience. You learned it at the ruins. Stem: forgiveness. Blossom: compassion. Nobody reaches the blossom without the stem.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Han Xue. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I have been stuck on the stem for three hundred years. I cannot forgive a boy who ran while his masters died.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You were that boy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. That is what makes it hard.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I didn't know sutras could be that personal. The Frost Sword manuals are mostly about angles.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhao Kang. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Reliquary Below
quests.summary: Beneath the reliquary where you found the first verse, a second chamber has opened, answering the ward you woke during the tide.

objectives.text: Head to the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the reliquary stood, a stair now leads down into green-lit stone. The ward you woke opened more than one door.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't like this. It's too quiet. Quiet means someone is listening.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Right. Eyes open, everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let me look first.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

objectives.text: Gather the stair's scattered lotus tiles
Read the reliquary stele below

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stem, the stele says. To forgive is not to forget. It is to put the burden down long enough to pick up someone else's.

objectives.text: Clear the ruined shrine of stone golems

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chamber's guardians wake behind you, stone and patient, and bar the way out.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Outside, the shrine is warm with late sun. The hermit is sitting on a broken pillar, not looking at you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

quests.title: What Zhao Kang Can't Forgive
quests.summary: Zhao Kang has followed you into the forest again. The stele's words have found a raw place in him too.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look surprised. I followed you again. I'm very good at following. It's a clan skill.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Zhao Kang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Put the burden down long enough to pick up someone else's. My brother died on a mission Gu gave him. How do I put that down?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe you don't have to put it down all at once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...That's the least helpful helpful thing anyone's ever said to me. Thank you.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He'll be all right. He's stubborn. Stubborn people forgive slowly, but they forgive all the way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Zhao Kang said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Robbers at the Shrine
quests.summary: Word of the ruins' second chamber has spread. Rogue cultivators have come with sacks and crowbars.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Rogues again. They heard the ruins opened. They want everything that glows, including you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Yan Tie. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: One rogue, caught with a sack of the shrine's lotus tiles, is barely more than a boy.

choices.text: Let him go with a warning

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand him to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry the tiles back, then beat him

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

objectives.text: Fight off the rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Finish the rogue cultivators at the spider hollow
Make your way to the poison marsh

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rogues scatter into the bamboo, dropping crowbars and one very expensive-looking lantern.

quests.title: The Stem
quests.summary: The hermit asks you to sit with him at the spirit spring and try to forgive something. Anything. He will try too.

objectives.text: Report to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Find one thing you have not forgiven. It needn't be big. Big ones are for later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Gu. For the pendant, for Qingshi, for everything.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Yan Tie. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That is a big one. Well. We'll both fail together, then. That's something.

objectives.text: Meditate on forgiveness at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit with your anger at Gu the way you'd sit with a fire, watching it without feeding it. It doesn't go out. It gets smaller.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside you the hermit weeps without a sound, and the lotus on the spring turns, very slowly, toward him.

objectives.text: Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It turned to me. After three hundred years. Not forgiveness. Not yet. But it turned.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Zhao Kang. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Wolves at the Spring
quests.summary: The spring's new light has drawn wolves from the deep forest. Not red-eyed ones. Curious ones. And a few that are neither.

objectives.text: Examine the spirit fountain at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves ring the spring, drinking the light. Most are grey and calm. Three are thin and wild, and they are not here to drink.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Coins and petals glint in the spirit fountain. The water hums faintly, a note just below hearing.

objectives.text: Break the spirit wolves at the tiger ridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wild ones break from the pack and come for the hermit.

objectives.text: Gather herbs for the hermit's bitten arm
Compare notes with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One bite. Old men are chewy; the wolf will have regretted it. Thank you for the herbs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Yan Tie?

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Letter in the Reliquary
quests.summary: In the lower chamber lies a second letter in the elegant hand that wrote the first. This one is addressed to Lan Jue.

objectives.text: Scout the old battlefield

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On a shelf in the lower chamber lies a letter, sealed with green wax, addressed: to Lan, when he stops running.

objectives.text: Bring the letter to the light

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You don't open it. It isn't yours. But the seal is warm, as if someone had just pressed it.

objectives.text: Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's my master's hand. She knew. Three hundred years ago she knew I'd run, and she left me a letter for when I stopped.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I'm not ready to read it. Keep it for me. Give it to me when I am. You'll know. I won't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Carrying Someone Else's
quests.summary: Yan Tie arrives with news from the sect, and finds three people sitting in silence around a spring. He sits too.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me. The array masters say the Abyss route will be ready in a month. Also, why is everyone crying?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We're not crying. We're forgiving. It's different. It's wetter.

objectives.text: Talk with Yan Tie at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Forgiving. Hm. I've been angry at the pill for a year. Not at Gu. At the pill. As if the pill chose.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The village is grateful. The village is also very nervous. Mostly nervous.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Headman Kuang. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll sit with you. Thunder Peak doesn't usually sit. But I'll try.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: The Hermit's Parting Gift
quests.summary: Before you go, the hermit gives you seeds from the spring's lotus, and asks you to plant one at the sect.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Take these seeds. Plant one at your sect, by the water. When the Verdant Lotus grows beside the Azure Cloud again, I'll visit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The hermit thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Noted, Han Xue. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Not before. I'm not ready to see your Sect Master. She'll ask me why I ran. I'll have to say.

objectives.text: Gather lotus seeds from the spring
Find Han Xue at the hidden valley

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He'll come. People who give seeds always come to see if they grew.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Hermit. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Herbs for the Road Back
quests.summary: Before leaving the forest, Elder Hua's standing request for fresh herbs still needs filling.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the mushroom ring. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to the hermit, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the mushroom ring
Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: The Second Letter's Weight
quests.summary: Carrying Lan Jue's unopened letter feels heavier than its size. Han Xue notices you keep checking it's still there.

objectives.text: Hurry to the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the bamboo village the air changes, heavy with qi and something older underneath.

objectives.text: Examine the loom

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The loom clacks once as you touch it, as if the weaver had only stepped out for a moment.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You keep touching your satchel. It's still there. Letters don't run off, whatever they weigh.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Yan Tie. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Forgiven Wolves
quests.summary: A few of the spring's calmer wolves have taken to following at a distance, curious rather than hostile.

objectives.text: Drink from the spirit fountain at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You cleanse the spirit fountain. Dark threads rise out of the water like smoke and dissolve.

objectives.text: Stop the spirit wolves at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The spirit wolves have found you first.

objectives.text: Collect rune fragments around the sacred spring
Share your findings with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Small Progress
quests.summary: Zhao Kang admits, grudgingly, that sitting with the stem verse helped more than he expected.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm not forgiving anyone today. But I thought about it without wanting to hit something. Progress, I suppose.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Yan Tie does enough for three.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Bamboo's Patience, Practiced
quests.summary: The hermit's bend-and-not-break breathing pattern is worth practicing properly before you leave.

objectives.text: Go and see the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Practice it on the mountain too. The bamboo doesn't own patience. It just remembered it first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Zhao Kang. I asked who would go.

objectives.text: Circulate your qi at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Breath by breath the foundation widens, until it feels like standing on bedrock.

objectives.text: See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I missed you too.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Rune Fragments for Elder Bai
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants every rune fragment from the lower chamber catalogued before the forest reclaims the stair.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me rune fragments from the buried temple.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

objectives.text: Find the rune fragments at the buried temple
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Yan Tie. You said so. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the rune fragments you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: What the Guardians Guard Now
quests.summary: With the lower chamber open, the ruins' remaining guardians have settled into a new, calmer pattern of watching.

objectives.text: Go to the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stone sentinels stand at ease now, as if satisfied that the right questions have finally been asked.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Tell the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Yan Tie's Quiet Sitting
quests.summary: Yan Tie tries sitting in silence again, and manages almost a full minute before he has to say something.

objectives.text: Report to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Forty-three seconds. A new record. Thunder Peak is technically capable of quiet. Technically.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Big Shu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: If anything smells sweet in there, hold your breath. Sweet is how poison says hello.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Qu Wanqing. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the rope bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the rope bridge. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fair. I have my doubts too.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Escorting the Letter Home
quests.summary: The road back to the sect isn't fully safe yet. A few stragglers test the party on the way.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Take a look at the hunter's lodge. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Yan Tie, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Read the map table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Defeat the rogue cultivators at the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These rogue cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Cut down the rogue cultivators that follow
Talk with Han Xue at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the forest crossroads. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll light the watch lantern for you. If you see it go out, run.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.
