objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Carrying the Stem
quests.summary: The second verse of the Heart Sutra settles into you slowly, the way forgiveness does: not all at once, but not undone either.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You won't finish forgiving today. Neither will I. But we're carrying it properly now, instead of dragging it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.text: Temper your realm at the misty lake

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Mud, root, blossom. The Heart Sutra turns in you, slow and patient.

objectives.text: Go back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Yan Tie. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Carts That Leave at Night
quests.summary: Constable Du has been watching the guild's carts. Some of them leave at night, heading west, and come back empty.

objectives.text: Hear Constable Du out

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I've been watching the guild's carts, like you asked. Three a week leave after dark, heading west. Come back empty. Wheels muddy red.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Constable Du says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Nothing grows red to the west. Nothing but bad luck.

objectives.text: Investigate the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A cart stands loaded in the warehouse yard, tarpaulin tied tight. It smells of silk, and underneath, of blood lotus.

objectives.text: Search the cart's false bottom

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the silk: blood lotus, dried and bundled, and a map of a road that follows the river west, then turns down.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Down. Toward the Abyss. There's a road. There's been a road all along.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: Remarkable. I'll set it as an essay question. The students will hate you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Han Xue, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Merchant Jin Sweats
quests.summary: Merchant Jin swears the carts aren't his. His hands say otherwise. So do his daughters' shoes, which are new.

objectives.text: Speak with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Those carts aren't mine! They're the guild's! I'm only the master of the guild! That's completely different!

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: ...They pay in silver. A lot of silver. My daughters have new shoes. Do you know what shoes cost?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Who pays?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A man with a crescent on his seal. I never see his face. I don't want to. Please. I have daughters.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the guild master's manor

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave him. For now. A frightened merchant is more useful than a dead one. The road is what matters.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Han Xue) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin begs you to keep his guild's part in the night carts quiet.

choices.text: Promise silence if he testifies

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Tell him the magistrate will hear everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Charge him for your silence

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Old Pan's River
quests.summary: Old Pan knows every bend of the river. He knows where the carts cross, and where the lanterns wait on the far bank.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: West bank, past the third bend. There's a ford nobody uses, and lanterns on the far side on moonless nights. Bone lanterns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Old Pan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I'll take you as far as the ford. Not a step past. I'm brave, not stupid.

objectives.text: Search the fishing boat at the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Pan's ferry noses into the current. The town slides away behind you, and the river turns quiet and dark.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You search the fishing boat. It smells of fish, tar and, faintly, of blood lotus.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Bone lanterns. Wonderful. I love a road with decorations.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted. Written down. Now it's official.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart first, fist second. Just like the peak teaches!

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Guards at the Ford
quests.summary: At the ford the carts meet their escort: bandits in borrowed armour and two runners in crimson.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Cart guards at the ford. And two in crimson behind them. Blood Moon runners. Don't let the runners get away.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Captain Lei. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

objectives.text: Drive the cart guards from the tannery

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: More cart guards? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon runners regrouping

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crimson runners break for the fields, fast as hares, blood-talismans burning at their ankles.

objectives.text: Search the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One runner falls, and a satchel spills open. Letters, a lantern of carved bone, a pouch of red soil.

quests.title: Letters in the Satchel
quests.summary: The runner's satchel is full of letters. They are addressed to Qingshi's watchers, and they are not friendly.

objectives.text: Head to the east gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The satchel's letters are orders. Names of Qingshi's watchers. Old Pan. Madam Fang. Constable Du. Beside each: when.

objectives.text: Read the runner's orders

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last line says: the heir must not reach the road. Beneath it, in a different, older hand, someone has written: yet.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They know about the watchers. They know about you. Yet. What does yet mean?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It means someone wants me on this road. Just not yet.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Yan Tie. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I hate that. I hate that more than the rest of it put together.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Protecting the Watchers
quests.summary: If the Blood Moon has names, it will come for them. You and Han Xue split up to guard Qingshi's watchers.

objectives.text: Report to Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My name's on a list? Mine? I'm flattered. I'm terrified. I'm going to hide behind the wine and hit people with a ladle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Magistrate Zhou.

objectives.text: Set a ward over the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You draw a ward on the inn's lintel in cinnabar. Madam Fang watches, then adds a small cat of her own for luck.

objectives.text: Clear the main street of Blood Moon runners

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: They come at midnight, masked and quiet, toward the inn, the docks and the yamen at once.

objectives.text: Hold the tannery against more Blood Moon runners
Speak with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: All three watchers alive. My name was on the list and I'm still here. I'm going to frame the list.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Captain Lei.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Bone Lanterns
quests.summary: The last runner flees west along the Crimson Road. You follow the bone lanterns as far as you dare.

objectives.text: Pay respects at the ancestral tablets at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Past the hill graves the road runs west, lit at every hundred paces by a lantern carved from a single bone.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You bow before the ancestral tablets. Names in gold and faded red go back further than anyone alive can count.

objectives.text: Fight off the rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rogues guarding the road step out from the lanterns' shadows. Hired swords, cheap and many.

objectives.text: Read the map table at the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn back before the road turns down. Far to the west, the sky is a faint red smudge that never fades.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That red smudge. That's where the road goes. That's where Gu went. That's where Xiao Shi is.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We tell the Sect Master everything. And then, I think, we finally go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Magistrate's Seal
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou insists on writing an official report of the Crimson Road for the Sect Master. It is sealed with his best seal.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An official report! From the yamen of Qingshi to the Sect Master of the Azure Cloud! My best seal! My second-best brush!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I have described you as 'valiant'. I have described myself as 'present'. I feel that's fair.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Took the ferry to the third bend and back. Didn't see any bone lanterns. Saw a heron. Very judgemental heron.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Not now, Magistrate Zhou. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Old Pan) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Evidence for the Mountain
quests.summary: The Sect Master will want proof. You gather what the runners dropped along the road.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Sect Master will want proof, not stories. Pick up everything they dropped. Even the unpleasant things.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Yan Tie agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Gather the runners' dropped evidence
Take a rubbing of the road's first lantern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bone lantern's carving is a crescent over a sword. The same mark as the token. The same mark as everything.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the market square

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak will march with you when you go down. All of us. We shout very loudly in dark places.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Fair! Fair and loud!

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Home With the Map
quests.summary: You leave Qingshi with a map, a satchel of letters and a magistrate's report. The town waves you up the mountain.

objectives.text: Hear Constable Du out

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Go on. We're watched now, but we're watching back. Bring the missing home. All of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Talk with Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Bring Liu Er home. Bring the Xiao boy home. Bring yourself home. That's three bowls I'm keeping hot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Madam Fang, your gossip is faster than my runners.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My gossip is paid in wine, Constable. Your runners aren't.

objectives.choice_prompt: Madam Fang offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: One More Pass Along the River
quests.summary: Before leaving Qingshi, Old Pan wants one more careful pass along the riverbank for anything the runners dropped.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me rune fragments from the county granary.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

objectives.text: Recover rune fragments from the county granary
Report back to Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Magistrate, the guild's accounts are open to you. All of them. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Truly, Jin? Even the second set?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen is open to all petitions. Between the second and fourth bell.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more rune fragments than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: The Crescent Seal, Compared
quests.summary: Han Xue wants the crescent seal from the road compared against every mark the sect has catalogued so far.

objectives.text: Make your way to the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wine fumes and river fog mix at the tavern door. A drunk salutes you with a chicken leg.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Same crescent as the token, the collar, the mask. Whoever signs with it isn't hiding. They're proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Runners Who Doubled Back
quests.summary: A pair of crimson runners circle back toward Qingshi rather than fleeing all the way to the Abyss.

objectives.text: Scout the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back alley looks exactly as it should, which is what makes you uneasy.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon runners at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon runners spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather rune fragments at the back alley
Tell Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Names? Faces? Anything I can write down, cultivator?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Constable Du. Constable Du won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Jin's Daughters
quests.summary: Merchant Jin's daughters, unaware of their father's dealings, thank you shyly for keeping the town safe.

objectives.text: Read the ledgers at the abacus desk at the guild master's manor

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: They curtsy with the careful seriousness of children imitating adults, and one presses a folded paper flower into your hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The abacus desk is covered in neat figures. Between them, in a smaller hand, someone has written a name.

objectives.text: Find Madam Fang at the guild master's manor

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the guild master's manor isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There. Magistrate Zhou agrees. Settled.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Immortals drink like fish and tip like cats.

objectives.text: Join Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the yamen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Constable Du. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I have not slept since spring.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Magistrate Zhou. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Fang's Last Bowl
quests.summary: Madam Fang insists on packing one more meal for the road, on top of the three she's already promised to keep hot.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me medicine bundles from the dye yard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Yan Tie. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the dye yard
Bring word to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Steadying for the Climb
quests.summary: The road up the mountain is long. Han Xue insists on a proper meditation before starting it.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Long climbs go easier with a settled heart. Sit first. Climb after.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Madam Fang said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Meditate at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation drinks in the qi and hardens, layer on layer, like jade forming in the dark.

objectives.text: See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Zhou's Second-Best Brush
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou frets over which brush to use for the official copy of his report, as if the ink itself might be judged.

objectives.text: Hurry to the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Looms clack in the silk workshop like a hundred patient crickets. Colour runs through every hand.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The Sect Master will notice the brush. I know she will. I've decided on the second-best. Confidence, but modesty.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Yan Tie. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Du's Standing Watch
quests.summary: Constable Du outlines, in careful detail, exactly how he intends to watch the Crimson Road from now on.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Every cart, checked. Every night shipment, logged. I should have started this years ago. I'm starting now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Thank you, Captain Lei, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

objectives.text: Hear what Merchant Jin has to say

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Magistrate Zhou.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Mind the crates. The stamps are imported.

objectives.text: Meet Madam Fang at the temple fair

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wine, noodles or gossip? The gossip is free. The rest, you pay for.

objectives.choice_prompt: Madam Fang confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Last Mile Home
quests.summary: The road up the mountain isn't entirely safe yet. A final skirmish tests the party before the sect gate.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Deal with the cart guards at the lower docks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: The classics say a wise man walks around a river. The classics never had to cross this one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Scholar Ouyang. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Stop the cart guards at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of cart guards
Talk with Constable Du at the post station

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Constable Du thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Han Xue.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Constable Du, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: What the Road Revealed
quests.summary: Between the burned array, the beast tide and the Crimson Road, your foundation has grown into something the mountain itself seems to recognize.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're not the disciple who climbed the nine thousand steps anymore. Good. That one was adequate. This one isn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Merchant Jin.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

objectives.text: Consolidate your cultivation at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Breath by breath the foundation widens, until it feels like standing on bedrock.

objectives.text: Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Report Read Twice
quests.summary: The Sect Master reads the Crimson Road report twice, then Magistrate Zhou's description of himself as 'present', and almost smiles.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A road. All this time, a road, and our own Law Hall approving the carts. Thank you for bringing this home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you should be resting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And you should be retired, Mo. We both make sacrifices.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: An army would be seen for a hundred miles. I'll decide by morning who goes. Go and rest. You won't.

objectives.text: Go to the teleport array

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The array masters kneel around the teleport array, laying the last jade of the new route. It glows faintly red at its edge.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The new route only reaches the rim. After that, it's feet. Whoever goes, goes carefully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: It'll be you. Don't pretend you don't know. Go and say your goodbyes, and don't make them sound like goodbyes.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Two Hundred Bundles
quests.summary: Xiao Man's medicine bundles are finished: three hundred of them. She wants you to carry as many as you can.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Three hundred bundles! I only dropped twenty. Take as many as you can carry. Take more than you can carry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Xiao Man is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The one with the red string is for my brother. Don't give it to anyone else. Promise. No, don't. Just don't.

objectives.text: Pack Xiao Man's medicine bundles
Go back to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You'll find him. I know it. I dreamed it. I also dreamed I was a carp, so. But I know it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Steward Qian. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Xiao Man) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: One Last Lesson
quests.summary: Elder Mo insists on one last lesson before the descent. It is about falling down, and getting up.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Last lesson. Not about winning. About falling. In the Abyss you will fall. The question is how fast you get up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Tang Ling?

objectives.text: Spar with Elder Mo's puppets

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Fall! Up! Fall! Up! Faster! The puppet doesn't care how you feel about it!

objectives.text: Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Hmph. I've said that twice now. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Lessons From the Shelves
quests.summary: Elder Bai has something for you: everything the pagoda knows about the Abyss, which is not much, copied very small.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Bai's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Everything the pagoda knows about the Abyss. It fits on one slip. That's how little we know. Copied very small.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Abyss has a heart, the old books say. A black pool that shows you yourself. Do not look into it. Or do. The books disagree.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Pills for pain, pills for poison, pills for when you're sure you can't go on. The last ones are sugar. They work anyway.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Elder Hua, have you seen my spectacles?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: On your head, Elder Bai. As they were yesterday.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

quests.title: Planting the Seed
quests.summary: Before you go, you plant one of the hermit's lotus seeds in the sect's pond. Just in case you don't come back to do it.

objectives.text: Investigate the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus pond is still. The carp gather, curious, as you kneel at the edge with a seed in your palm.

objectives.text: Plant the Verdant Lotus seed

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seed sinks. For a moment a green light spreads under the water like a breath, and every carp in the pond turns to face it.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Planting things before a journey. My grandmother did that. She said it gives you a reason to come back.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Well? Is it true what they're saying? Which part? All the parts. I need all the parts.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've got plenty of reasons. You're one of them. Don't make it weird.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Farewell
quests.summary: Zhao Kang won't say goodbye. He challenges you to a spar instead, which is how the Zhao clan says goodbye.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm not saying goodbye. The Zhao clan doesn't say goodbye. We spar. Loudly. Pick up a sword.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Zhao Kang said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

objectives.text: Spar with Zhao Kang's attendants first

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My attendants insist on going first. They say it's tradition. It's not. They just want to hit you.

objectives.text: Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If you find out what happened to my brother down there... anything... tell me. Even if it's bad.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll tell you everything, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Splendid. A footnote in history, at the very least. Possibly a whole paragraph.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Elder Bai's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Good. Now go away before I say something I'll regret. Like 'be careful'. Be careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Shadows at the Array
quests.summary: On your last night, someone tries to sabotage the new array. Gu's friends are still on the mountain.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Someone's at the array! In the dark! I'm pretty sure it's not the array masters, they snore!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Yan Tie. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The saboteurs flee toward the pines. One of them drops a crescent seal and doesn't stop to pick it up.

objectives.text: See Lu Ping again

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The array's safe. I stood on it all night after that. I'm very cold. I'm very proud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Did you see any rare herbs? Any at all? Even ugly ones? Especially ugly ones?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm telling the whole gate! Twice! With improvements!

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Dumplings
quests.summary: Wei Tong has made dumplings for the journey. Forty of them. He says it's for luck. He says a lot of things when he's worried.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Forty dumplings. For the journey. They're wrapped in lotus leaves so they'll stay fresh in the Abyss. I asked Elder Hua.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: She said nothing stays fresh in the Abyss. So I made extra.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Senior Brother, you're crying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It's the onions. I put a lot of onions in. For luck. Come back and eat the rest.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Xiao Man said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says I'm improving. She said it with her eyes closed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

quests.title: Steward Qian's Ledger
quests.summary: Steward Qian stops you at the gate with a ledger. He has opened an account in your name. It is empty. That's the point.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian out

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've opened an account in your name. Contribution points for the descent. It's empty. You'll fill it when you come back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to Steward Qian) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I don't open accounts for people who don't come back. It's a very bad investment. So come back.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak will be at the rim when you come out. Shouting. You'll hear us before you see us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Steward Qian. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qian's empty account in your name can draw on the treasury for the descent. Nobody would check.

choices.text: Take only what's allotted

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Draw extra for the town's wounded

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Draw extra for yourself

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Bai's Copied Slip
quests.summary: Elder Bai presses a second copy of his Abyss notes into your hands, in case the first is lost.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: One copy for you, one for Han Xue. Redundancy is a librarian's love language.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Wei Tong has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: What Ling Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the outer dormitories

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Elder Bai agrees. It must be true.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Provisions Beyond Dumplings
quests.summary: Forty dumplings is generous, but the Medicine Hall insists on real provisions too: rope, salve, dry tinder.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the shelves. They're older than your grandmother and less forgiving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Collect medicine bundles around the medicine valley
Return to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai, you've been in the pagoda for three days. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I had a very nourishing scroll.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Guide at the Gate
quests.summary: Word spreads that someone claiming to know the way into the Abyss is waiting at the sect gate, and nobody trusts him yet.

objectives.text: Search the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tea pickers move along the terraces with baskets on their backs, singing a song about a lazy dragon.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Masked. Quiet. Says he's done this before. Elder Mo hasn't decided whether to let him in or throw rocks at him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ignore the Sect Master. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Lu Ping does enough for three.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's going in my stories. The good ones.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Is that allowed? It is now, I suppose!

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Last Sweep of the Pines
quests.summary: Before the descent, the outer pines get one final sweep for any lingering saboteurs.

objectives.text: Head to the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the wall the pines grow close and dark, and the wind in them sounds like distant surf.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Moon cultivators come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Xiao Man.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering to Zhao Kang) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Han Xue's Own Farewell
quests.summary: Han Xue says her goodbyes quietly, to fewer people, in a way that somehow says more than Wei Tong's forty dumplings.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. I just wanted you all to know I noticed you. That's all. That's the whole speech.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Han Xue has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Sect Master. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: One Foundation, Fully Settled
quests.summary: Elder Mo wants your foundation checked one final time, properly, before he lets you anywhere near the Abyss.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Last check. If there's a crack in this, I want to know now, not at the bottom of the world.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Mo is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Mud, root, blossom. The Heart Sutra turns in you, slow and patient.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Fan Rui. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: The Array Masters' Blessing
quests.summary: The array masters who rebuilt the teleport route offer a small blessing-charm for the journey, half tradition and half superstition.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me spirit stones from the outer dormitories, would you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Take a cup first. Tea steadies the hand and cools the head.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: No, Auntie Ruo. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the outer dormitories
Report back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Back safe. Sit. Your face needs a cup more than your cultivation does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell. It bites, and it holds grudges.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A gentle hand. That's the best medicine there is.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

quests.title: What Zhao Kang Really Wants Known
quests.summary: Away from the others, Zhao Kang admits there's a second thing he wants found in the Abyss, besides answers about his brother.

objectives.text: Make your way to the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great bell hangs silent in its tower on the east ridge, green with age and heavy as a promise.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If there's anything of his down there. Anything at all. I don't care how small. Bring it up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Lu Ping. Lu Ping won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: The Whole Mountain, Briefly Quiet
quests.summary: For one strange hour before the descent, the entire sect seems to hold its breath together.

objectives.text: Scout the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Even the training ground stands empty. Even Steward Qian's abacus is silent. The mountain waits with you.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Fan Rui. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
