dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Masked Guide's Name
quests.summary: Elder Mo finally gets a name out of the masked stranger waiting at the gate, though it may not be his real one.

objectives.text: Hurry to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rolls out of the refectory kitchens. Somewhere inside, a ladle strikes a pot like a gong.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: He says call him Ye Wuming. 'Nameless.' Descriptive, if nothing else. He knows the Abyss like his own hand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhao Kang?

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Night Before
quests.summary: The night before the descent, you sit on the cliff edge and let your foundation settle one last time.

objectives.text: Go to the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sea of clouds is silver under the moon. Somewhere to the west, below the edge of the world, the sky is faintly red.

objectives.text: Sit in the moon gate's quiet before dawn

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. Patience you have. Forgiveness you are trying. The blossom will have to wait for the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation reaches its peak, solid as the mountain under you.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You're awake. So am I. I've chosen: you and Han Xue. And someone is waiting at the gate who says he knows the way down.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sleep an hour. Then come and find me. We'll talk about guides, and traitors, and coming home.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Measured. Sensible.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: An Unlikely Guide
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you and Han Xue after the traitor. A masked stranger waits at the gate with an offer.

objectives.text: Receive your orders from the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Abyss is a wound in the world. A sect army would be seen for a hundred miles. Two disciples might not.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Find Gu. Find the captives. Do not face the Patriarch's servants alone if you can help it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And {player}... come back. That is not a request.

objectives.text: Meet the masked wanderer at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You'll need a guide. The Abyss eats people who don't know where to step.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why should we trust you?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You shouldn't. But I know the Abyss. I was born to it. I'll show you the way down, and you decide the rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

objectives.text: Descend into the Blood Moon Abyss
Enter the crimson canyon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The air is warm and wet, and tastes of copper. Somewhere far below, a drum beats slowly, like a heart.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's not a drum.

quests.title: The Field of Bones
quests.summary: Cross the plain of bones, where the Blood Moon's sentries hunt.

objectives.text: Cross onto the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bones crunch underfoot, bleached white under the red moon. Dead trees claw at the sky.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The sentries listen for the crack of bone.

objectives.text: Clear the sentries on the field of bones
Collect the sentries' demon cores
Talk with Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You fight well. You hesitate before the killing blow. That will get you killed here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They were people once, weren't they?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Children stolen from villages. Raised on blood and fear. I was one. The Patriarch took my name when I was six.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming. It means nameless night. I chose it myself. It is the only thing here I ever chose.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A name you chose yourself. That's worth more than most names, Ye Wuming.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: The Blood Pools
quests.summary: The miasma from the blood pools eats at your qi. Blood lotus growing there can neutralise it, if you can stand the smell.

objectives.text: Harvest blood lotus from the steaming pools
Drive off the blood-fed wolves drinking at the pools
Purify the lotus and steady your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus hisses in your palm. You draw on the Heart Sutra. Mud, root, blossom. The red fades to a clean, pale pink.

objectives.text: Share the purified lotus with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It tastes like rust and flowers. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't trust him. But he hasn't led us into a trap yet. That's either honesty or patience.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Or both. People can be both.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I can hear you, Han Xue. Patience. I've had a great deal of practice at it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the corrupted wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Ambush at the Obelisks
quests.summary: A ring of obelisks pulses with stolen blood. Investigate it, carefully.

objectives.text: Examine the demonic obelisk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl across the black stone like beetles. Thin threads of blood run from the obelisks down into the dark.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They pull the life out of the prisoners and pour it into the altar. Every drop weakens your seal.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guard ambush

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: Little lambs from the Azure Cloud. And one lost puppy, come home at last. Hello, Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Xue Mei. Crimson Elder. Stay close to me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Crimson Elder or not, she bleeds like anyone. {player}, watch the left!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I see them. Back to back!

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: I'll take the pretty ice sword for the cages. Kill the rest.

objectives.text: Regroup with Ye Wuming by the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They took Han Xue. Xue Mei wanted her alive. Her blood is pure. They'll put her in the cages.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we go to the cages. Now.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not now. The obelisks will sense you. Break them first, or the cages will drain her before we arrive.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Shattering the Obelisks
quests.summary: Ye Wuming knows a counter-rune. Gather the rune fragments and break the obelisk ring.

objectives.text: Collect rune fragments around the obelisks
Shatter the heart obelisk with the counter-rune

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press the fragments to the obelisk in Ye Wuming's pattern. Your pendant blazes. The black stone cracks like ice.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one, the obelisks crumble. Far off, in the dark, many voices gasp at once, like people breathing for the first time in days.

objectives.text: Deal with the guards drawn by the noise

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: You broke my ring, little lamb. Your ice-sword friend screams so prettily for you. Kill them, my dears.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She won't fight us herself. Not yet. She likes to watch. Break the guards.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Where is Han Xue, Xue Mei? Where is she?

objectives.text: Confer with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The cages are past the war camp. They'll be expecting us now. Good. Expecting and ready are different things.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You could have left me at your sect gate. Why didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because you've never lied to me. Not once. That's rare.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

quests.title: The War Camp
quests.summary: The Blood Moon war camp stands between you and the cages. Its command tent may hold answers.

objectives.text: Approach the war camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crimson banners, black tents, and drums. Hundreds of warriors drill in silent rows.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The command tent is at the centre. Where there are orders, there are answers.

objectives.text: Break through the Blood Moon war camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The sect brat? Here? Don't look at me like that. They have our families in those cages.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang. So the Abyss owns you too. Stand aside, or stand with them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then help us free them, Tie Hu.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not today. Today I didn't see you. Run, before I remember that I did.

objectives.text: Seize the sealed letters from the command tent
Read the letters with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This one is orders. A siege on Qingshi Town, with Iron-Fang's bandits, before the next blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This one is in Gu's hand. To the Patriarch. The diagram is delivered. Remember your promise. Remember Lan.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Lan? Gu Lan was his daughter. She died twenty years ago.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Patriarch makes many promises to grieving fathers. He keeps very few.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: The Iron Cages
quests.summary: The prison cages hold every missing soul from Qingshi, and Han Xue.

objectives.text: Reach the prison cages

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron cages hang over a pit, each one crowded with pale, silent people. Somewhere a man is singing a lullaby, badly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The guards change at the red hour. That's now. Go.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

objectives.text: Defeat the cage wardens
Break open the cages

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: About time. I was starting to compose my death poem. It was very good. Nobody will ever hear it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Senior Sister! Can you stand?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She can stand. She can also complain, which is better.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Farmers, fishermen, disciples of three sects. A young man with Xiao Man's eyes. And a boy who says his name is Liu Er.

quests.title: What the Prisoners Saw
quests.summary: The prisoners are free, but weak. Some of them have seen the altar.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You're from the sect? My sister... is Xiao Man all right? Is she eating? She forgets to eat.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I followed the lanterns from the river. They caught me at the graves. They've been bleeding us for weeks.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: An elder from our sect was here. Gu. He stood by the altar and talked to the blood like it was a person.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu. At the altar. Then he's already there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your sister is well, Xiao Shi. She'll be better when she sees you.

objectives.text: Recover stolen medicine for the prisoners
Send the prisoners home with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'll lead them out. Ye Wuming marked the path. You two go to the altar.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And {player}? If Gu is there... don't hesitate. He won't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Get them home safe, Senior Sister. We'll be right behind you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Altar of Blood
quests.summary: At the great altar, the stolen blood flows into the seal. The traitor is there, and he is not alone.

objectives.text: Witness the ritual at the Altar of Blood
Defeat Crimson Elder Xue Mei

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: You broke my obelisks and stole my lambs. I'll wear your skin to the Patriarch's awakening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You'll have to catch me first.

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: Oh, I love it when they run.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Nameless remembers you, Xue Mei. He remembers everything you ever did to him.

objectives.text: Disrupt the blood ritual

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You drive the Lotus Key against the altar. Green light floods the channels of blood, and the ritual chokes and dies.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Far below, something vast roars in frustration. The whole abyss shudders.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Gu is gone. Fled deeper. But you've bought the seal time. Months, maybe.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

quests.title: Stragglers From the Cages
quests.summary: A few prisoners, too weak to walk with Han Xue's group, were left behind in the confusion of the ritual's collapse.

objectives.text: Investigate the ghost village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Empty houses line the ghost village street. Doors stand open, bowls wait on tables, and nobody is home.

objectives.text: Clear the ghost village of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Kneel before the ancestral tablets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense ash lies fresh before the ancestral tablets. One name has been touched so often its gilding is gone.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not everyone made it out with your senior sister. Some couldn't stand. We go back for them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Ku the Broker.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Xue Mei's Remaining Guard
quests.summary: Word of the Crimson Elder's defeat hasn't reached every corner of the Abyss. Some of her guards still hold their posts.

objectives.text: Study the jade screen at the palace of the elders

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade screen is carved with a mountain, a river and a very small figure climbing. Behind it, a hidden niche.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Blood Guards ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Gather demon cores at the palace of the elders
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The wailing cliffs is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: What the Altar Left Behind
quests.summary: The broken altar's chamber holds fragments worth recovering before the Abyss reclaims them.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me demon cores from the soul forge.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Ku the Broker. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

objectives.text: Pick up demon cores near the soul forge
Bring word to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more demon cores than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Old Cell
quests.summary: Deeper in the war camp, Ye Wuming finds the cell where he was raised, and stops walking for a long moment.

objectives.text: Search the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the sacrificial pit. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I haven't seen this door in thirty years. I thought it would be smaller.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Ku the Broker.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: What Xue Mei Called Him
quests.summary: Ye Wuming says little about being called 'lost puppy,' but it clearly cost him something to hear.

objectives.text: Hear Ye Wuming out

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: She knew your name. Your real one.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She gave it to me. Before I chose Wuming, I had a name she picked. I don't use it. I don't remember why she did.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll prove you wrong. Politely.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the ruined sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the ruined sect gate. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Down here everything has a price. Especially directions. These ones are free. Once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the ruined sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the ruined sect gate.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then come and watch.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: The Last Sentries
quests.summary: A final knot of demonic cultivators, cut off from orders, still guards the road back toward the canyon entrance.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Collect medicine bundles around the canyon mouth
Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Ring
quests.summary: Elder Bai will want every fragment of the shattered obelisks studied once you're home.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me rune fragments from the obelisk ring.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fair. I have my doubts too.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Find the rune fragments at the obelisk ring
See Ye Wuming again

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Ku the Broker.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the rune fragments you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Steadying Before the Depths
quests.summary: Before attempting the golden core, Ye Wuming insists on a proper rest, however impatient you are.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The sect hasn't tamed you. Good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The depths don't forgive an unsteady foundation. Sit. I'll watch. I'm good at watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

objectives.text: Cultivate at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The core burns hotter. Impurities rise like smoke and are gone.

objectives.text: Return to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: A Question for Ye Wuming
quests.summary: Before you go deeper, you ask Ye Wuming outright whether he intends to keep helping past this point.

objectives.text: Answer Ye Wuming's summons

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could leave. You've paid whatever debt you thought you owed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I stopped counting debts a long time ago. I'm not doing this for a debt anymore.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Ku the Broker. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Down here everything has a price. Especially directions. These ones are free. Once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Medicine for the Walk Out
quests.summary: The freed prisoners' path back to the canyon entrance is long. Extra medicine won't go to waste.

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me medicine bundles from the corpse forest.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Down here everything has a price. Especially directions. These ones are free. Once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the corpse forest
Go back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Ku the Broker.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Core Formation
quests.summary: The battle has pushed your qi to its limit. In the deepest part of the abyss, forge your golden core, then bring the news home.

objectives.text: Decide the fate of the captured acolytes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: These three surrendered. Children, really. Blood Moon trained. The sect would execute them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They were stolen, like you. Take them. Teach them their own names.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...You are a strange cultivator, {player}. Very well. I will try.

objectives.choice_prompt: The captured acolytes wait on your word.

choices.text: Send them home, and trust them

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring them to the sect's Law Hall

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave them to the Abyss

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

objectives.text: Form your golden core in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Killing intent presses from every side. Your foundation cracks, and from the crack rises light.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi spins, tightens, and condenses into a golden core, bright as a small sun in the dark of the abyss.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The darkness can't touch it. I can feel it burning.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Core Formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The clouds come down low and heavy. Somewhere inside them, heaven weighs the core you are forging.

objectives.text: Return Xiao Shi to his sister

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Brother! Brother, you idiot, you absolute idiot, you never wrote!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: There were no brushes in the cage, Man Man.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}, I... thank you. I'll pick herbs for you for a hundred years. I'll only drop some of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He counted the bars every night, Xiao Man. He never stopped thinking of you.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A golden core, the captives freed, and the ritual broken. You went down a disciple and came back a pillar.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: But Qingshi is next. If the letters are true, the Blood Moon marches before the next blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest one night. Then we defend the town. We will not let it bleed a second time.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Smoke on the Horizon
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you to Qingshi with Zhao Kang and Wei Tong. The Blood Moon will arrive within days.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's orders

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take Zhao Kang and Wei Tong. The sect must hold the mountain in case this is a feint, so you three are the vanguard.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hold Qingshi until the moon wanes. Whatever it costs, don't let them turn the town into another graveyard.

objectives.text: Watch the Blood Moon host approach Qingshi
Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The immortals! Good. I have forty guards, three hundred farmers and one very old ballista.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I was a coward once, and a monster fed on my town while I drank his tea. Not twice. Tell me where to stand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right here, Magistrate. People need to see you standing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Forty guards and a ballista. The Zhao clan has held worse walls with less. ...Not many. But some.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Walls and Wards
quests.summary: The walls are old, the guards are few, and Merchant Jin's warehouse is full of lamp oil he refuses to share.

objectives.text: Plan the defence with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The gate will hold for an hour against cultivators. Maybe. Fire will buy us more. We need oil for the wall braziers.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Jin's warehouse has barrels of it. He says it's for export. I say it's for not dying.

objectives.text: Persuade Merchant Jin to open his warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: My oil? That's six months' profit! Who compensates me? The yamen? The yamen owes me for the ballista!

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Six months' profit, Jin, or no town left to sell it in. Pick one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You sold blood lotus to the people who took eleven of your neighbours. You owe this town more than oil.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: ...That was business. I didn't know. I didn't want to know.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Take it. Take all of it. Maybe it will weigh a little less on the scales in the next life.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more lantern oil than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

objectives.text: Carry the oil barrels to the wall
Paint warding talismans on the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You paint the gate posts with cinnabar wards. Constable Du watches, then quietly paints a few crooked ones of his own.

quests.title: The Watchtower
quests.summary: Climb the watchtower and sound the alarm when the host arrives.

objectives.text: Climb the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Torches, thousands of them, flow over the far hills like a burning river. Blood Moon banners, and bandit flags beside them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's... a lot of torches. I'm going to need a bigger lunch.

objectives.text: Ring the alarm bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Doors slam. Children are carried to the temple. Old men pick up hoes and stand in the street.

objectives.text: Take your positions with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'll hold the east wall. Wei Tong takes the south. You go wherever it's worst. That's what you're good at.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And if I die, tell my clan I died beautifully. Specify beautifully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nobody's dying today, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nobody's dying before dinner, anyway. After dinner, we'll see.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. From your lips to heaven's ears.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Raiders in the Fields
quests.summary: The bandits strike the farmland first, to burn the harvest and scatter the farmers.

objectives.text: Ask Old Pan to ferry the farmers to safety

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Ferry the farmers across? At night, with bandits shooting at us? Double fare.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I'm joking. No fare. Forty years on this river, and the first time anyone needed me. Go, I'll bring them over.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

objectives.text: Drive the raiders from the fields

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Burn the rice! Burn the barns! Nobody eats this winter unless Iron-Fang says so!

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong at the market kitchens

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The farmers are across? Good. I've been guarding the kitchens. Strategically. Armies march on their stomachs.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here, a dumpling. Eat it. Then go and hit something. Elder Mo would want you fed and angry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Strategically guarding the kitchens. Wei Tong, you are a genius and a disgrace.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Save me two dumplings. I'll be back for them.

quests.title: The Graveyard Flank
quests.summary: Demonic cultivators are trying to wake Deacon Hong's old blood formation beneath the graves.

objectives.text: Break the demonic cultivators at the graves
Slay the blood-fed wolves they brought
Seal the blood formation for good

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press your palm to the rune circle. The Heart Sutra flows from your golden core, and the blood-ink fades to grey dust.

objectives.text: Check on Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The east wall held. Barely. I may have set my own sleeve on fire. It was a tactical fire.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They didn't push the graveyard to take the town. They wanted blood on those runes. Why?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Blood on the runes. Like the old deacon's circle. Somebody is still collecting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: And somebody is still paying for it. Let's find out who.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: The Riverside Assault
quests.summary: Blood Guards come up the river on rafts. Old Pan's ferry is still out on the water.

objectives.text: Race to the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Black rafts slide down the river under the red moon. Out on the water, Old Pan's ferry is still crossing, packed with farmers.

objectives.text: Repel the Blood Guards at the docks
Save the medicine crates washed up on the bank
Bring the medicine to Widow Liu at the well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My Liu Er came home three days ago. Thin as a reed, but home. He talks about a sect disciple who broke his cage.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: And every farmer's across the river, Madam Liu. My third plank complained the whole way.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You didn't promise. You just did it. Now I'll carry water to your wall until my arms fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell Liu Er to stay inside tonight. And give him an extra bowl of rice from me.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: Treachery at the Warehouse
quests.summary: Bandits are pouring out of a tunnel under the guild warehouse. Merchant Jin knows why.

objectives.text: Catch Merchant Jin in the back alley

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't kill me! I dug that tunnel years ago for smuggling tea! Iron-Fang found out. He threatened my daughters.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I opened it for him tonight. Then I saw you give away my oil to people who'd spat at me. I couldn't...

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang threatened my runners too, Jin. You should have come to me.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Turn me in. I deserve it. But close the tunnel first. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fear made you do it. What you do next is your choice. Go help Constable Du, Master Jin.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

objectives.text: Stop the bandits in the warehouse yard
Collapse the smugglers' tunnel

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A talisman flares. The earth groans, and the tunnel folds in on itself with a satisfying thump.

quests.title: Iron-Fang Tie Hu
quests.summary: Iron-Fang himself leads his men into the market square. End this.

objectives.text: Cut down Iron-Fang's lieutenants
Defeat Iron-Fang Tie Hu

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You again! The sect brat who took my token. I've dreamed about this, you know. Every night.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I've heard your men talk, Iron-Fang. The Blood Moon holds their families. Holds yours too.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut up! Shut up and fight!

objectives.text: Decide Iron-Fang's fate at the temple

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, then. Finish it. That's what you sect types do to trash like me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Where are your people's families, Tie Hu?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: In the Abyss. Behind the black gate. I burned villages so they'd keep breathing. Does that make it better? It doesn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Kneel at this temple and swear to fight for the town you tried to burn. Then help me bring your families home.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Swear it here, Iron-Fang, and I'll write it down. In ink. The permanent kind.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...You're a fool. Fine. Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang kneels at the temple. The town wants blood.

choices.text: Spare him, as you promised

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Spare him, and bind him to the magistrate's justice

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: Spare him, and make him your servant

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Last Wave
quests.summary: The final wave hits the town gate, and a familiar figure watches from the graveyard hill.

objectives.text: Hold the town gate against the last wave

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They're at the gate! Everyone with a spear, with me! For Qingshi!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: For Qingshi! And for the Zhao clan, who will hear about this in great detail!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Hold the line! They're breaking!

objectives.text: Confront Gu Hanshan on the graveyard hill

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Well fought, disciple. Truly. You were always the most stubborn of the new ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why, Elder Gu? Why betray the sect? Why feed children to the Blood Moon?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Patriarch holds my daughter's soul. When the seal breaks, he will give her back. A new body. A new life.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: This siege was never about the town. Every drop spilled here soaks down to the seal. You've helped him, you know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You would do the same for someone you loved. Don't pretend you wouldn't.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Mercy. I forgot how it looks.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

objectives.text: Chase Gu into the graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where Gu stood there is only a scorched talisman and the smell of blood. He is gone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. I wouldn't. Not like this.

quests.title: The Wounded at the Temple
quests.summary: The temple has filled with wounded faster than Elder Hua's borrowed supplies can stretch.

objectives.text: Head to the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rows of townsfolk and disciples lie on borrowed mats. A healer from Thunder Peak moves between them, humming to keep her hands steady.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Search the medicine cabinet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A hundred little drawers line the medicine cabinet, each labelled. One label is in a different hand.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: The little ones will want the story at bedtime. Keep it short. Keep the blood out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Madam Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wipe your boots! This floor has seen a tax collector.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Bandits Still in the Fields
quests.summary: Not all of Iron-Fang's men surrendered when he did. A few still hide among the burned rice paddies.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Defeat the bandits at the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The bandits have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the dye yard
Show Madam Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Names? Faces? Anything I can write down, cultivator?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's First Scrubbed Pot
quests.summary: Iron-Fang, true to his word, has started washing dishes at the Drunken Crane, and is oddly good at it.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty years of terrorizing this river valley, and it turns out I'm excellent with a scrub brush. Nobody tell my old men.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

objectives.text: Meet Widow Liu at the City God temple

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine.

objectives.text: Talk with Constable Du at the post station

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Constable. I've come to report myself for being useful.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted, Iron-Fang. You're still on my list.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Constable Du. More sense there than in half this town.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Gate closes at dusk. Always has. Always will.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Constable Du, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Salvage From the Warehouse
quests.summary: The collapsed smuggling tunnel left the warehouse in disarray. Merchant Jin wants an honest inventory this time.

objectives.text: See what Iron-Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: (grins without warmth) You've been busy. The wrong kind of busy.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Kind, and still breathing. You're rarer than spirit stones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Bring me lantern oil from the brewery. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Widow Liu.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Pick up lantern oil near the brewery
Report back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Will there be a report? A written one? With dates? I love a report with dates.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Go on.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the lantern oil you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Gu's Scorched Talisman
quests.summary: The talisman Gu left behind on the graveyard hill still holds a trace of the pattern that carried him away.

objectives.text: Make your way to the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The scorch mark isn't random. It's a partial teleport rune, torn off mid-use. Someone should study it properly.

objectives.text: Test the puppet frame

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The puppet frame creaks as you test it. The joints are oiled, the wood is new, and the runes are older.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Later. Over tea. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Qingshi owes you again. I'm running out of ways to write that in the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Immortals drink like fish and tip like cats.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Widow Liu's New Worry
quests.summary: With Liu Er home safe, Widow Liu has found a new thing to worry about: that he'll do something reckless to prove himself.

objectives.text: Hear Widow Liu out

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He wants to guard the wall now. Sixteen years old and he wants to guard the wall. I don't know whether to be proud or furious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Not now, Madam Fang. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Find Madam Fang at the market square

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wine, noodles or gossip? The gossip is free. The rest, you pay for.

objectives.text: Join Merchant Jin at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Merchant Jin. More sense there than in half this town.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Merchant Jin) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm trying to learn which things shouldn't.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Counting the Dead, Gently
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou wants every name recorded properly for the stele, and asks for help going door to door.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (nervously) W-what can I do for you, immortal? Anything. Anything at all.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the pottery kilns. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: The classics say a wise man walks around a river. The classics never had to cross this one.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Listen to Scholar Ouyang. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Order! Ah. It's already orderly. Carry on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the pottery kilns
Bring word to Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: Remarkable. I'll set it as an essay question. The students will hate you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen is open to all petitions. Between the second and fourth bell.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Sensible. My mother would've done the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Demonic Stragglers by the River
quests.summary: A handful of demonic cultivators, cut off from the retreat, still lurk near the docks.

objectives.text: Check the chain anchor at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chain anchor is bolted into the living rock. Old blood has rusted into its links.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the lower docks
Share your findings with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A fine piece of business. I mean that as the highest praise I know.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Every face that passes, I look twice. Old habit.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

quests.title: Constable Du's Ledger of Debts
quests.summary: Constable Du has started keeping a very different ledger: who helped, and how, so the town remembers properly.

objectives.text: Go and see Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Not for punishment this time. For thanks. I've never kept a ledger that felt this good to write.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

objectives.text: Speak with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Constable Du. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Hear what Magistrate Zhou has to say

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted. Written down. Now it's official.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Breath Before the Dawn
quests.summary: Before the town properly wakes, you take a last quiet moment to settle your core after the night's fighting.

objectives.text: Answer Constable Du's summons

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Go and meditate at the county academy. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Thank you, Merchant Jin, but it's cultivator's work.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The market square is finally still. Your golden core turns over once, slow and warm, like something finally allowed to rest.

objectives.text: See Constable Du again

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Iron-Fang. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed in town, cultivator. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Works.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

quests.title: Dawn over Qingshi
quests.summary: The siege is broken. Mourn the fallen, share a meal with the living, and report to the sect.

objectives.text: Accept the magistrate's thanks

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Qingshi stands. Nineteen dead, which is nineteen too many and ten thousand too few for what they intended.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I'm having a stele carved at the gate. Your name will be on it. The yamen will not forget. I will not forget.

objectives.text: Celebrate at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Free wine for the heroes! One cup each. Immortals drink like fish and I'm not a lake.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang is washing dishes in my kitchen, by the way. He's surprisingly good. Very thorough scrubber.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Very thorough. Tell them very thorough. Iron-Fang does nothing by halves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One cup, then. To the nineteen.

objectives.text: Mourn the fallen at the temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nineteen tablets. Farmers, a guard, a boy who carried arrows. You burn incense for each, and say each name aloud.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You held the town. But Gu was right about one thing: the blood reached the seal. It has cracked again.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We cannot patch it any longer. We must build a new one. The Great Azure Formation, a seal for ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: It needs star iron, thunder crystal and phoenix feathers. They exist in one place: the Celestial Sky Isles.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.
