bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Green Banners on the Steps
quests.summary: Green banners are climbing the nine thousand steps: the Iron Scale Sect, unannounced and in full armour.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Green banners on the steps! Thirty of them! In armour! Do we have an appointment? I don't think we have an appointment!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Lu Ping is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: See? Even Zhao Kang agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Scout the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale disciples line the processional way, green scale armour polished to a shine. None of them bow.

objectives.text: Meet Sect Master Ruan at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Ruan Hai, master of the Iron Scale. I have climbed nine thousand steps to say one thing to your Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Your traitor armed the Blood Moon. The Blood Moon took eleven of my children. I want the Lotus Key under a council's guard.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (tugging Sect Master Ruan's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: An Audience Without Tea
quests.summary: The Sect Master receives the Iron Scale in the main hall. Nobody is offered tea, which in the Azure Cloud is a declaration.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan. Your grief is real, and our shame is real. The Lotus Key is not ours to give. It belongs to its bearer.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Then the bearer will come with me, under guard, to a council of the orthodox sects.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The bearer will do no such thing. You may stay as our guests. Without tea.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: No tea. She's furious. I haven't seen her refuse tea since the Cinder Peak incident. Nobody talks about the Cinder Peak incident.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Keep away from the green armour. Especially the young one. He's been glaring at you since the gate.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Mo) That was amazing.

quests.title: The Young Master's Glare
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao, the Iron Scale's heir, does not keep away from you. He brings friends.

objectives.text: See what Ruan Jingtao wants

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: So you're the famous Lotus heir. You look like a farmer. My cousin died on the Crimson Road. What did you ever lose?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My mother. My village. Nearly my senior sister. I'm sorry for your cousin.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: No, Sect Master. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Sorry. Everyone on this mountain is sorry. My friends want to see if you're sorry with a sword.

objectives.text: Defend yourself against the Iron Scale disciples

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Return to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Fine. You can fight. That doesn't make you right.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Lu Ping. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My cousin could fight too. It didn't help him. Remember that, farmer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Theft in the Guest Hall
quests.summary: In the night the Iron Scale's gift chest is broken open, and an Azure Cloud robe is found beside it.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Their gift chest was forced in the night. An Azure Cloud outer robe was left beside it. Neatly folded. Too neatly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Han Xue is right.

objectives.text: Hurry to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The guest hall is a storm of green armour and shouting. The chest lies open, and beside it, a folded blue robe.

objectives.text: Examine the forced gift chest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock was cut with a blade that leaves a curved mark. There are traces of blood lotus in the cut. No Azure Cloud blade smells like that.

objectives.text: Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone wants us fighting. Someone who carries blood lotus and knows where our laundry is kept.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu had friends here. Some of them are still here. I'm starting to hate folded robes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The envoys demand that someone be punished for the broken chest before they leave.

choices.text: Stand surety for the sect yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Insist on a proper Law Hall inquiry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Point at an Iron Scale servant to end it quickly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Folder of Robes
quests.summary: Footprints in the dew lead from the guest hall to the outer pines, where someone has been folding robes for a living.

objectives.text: Go to the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In a hollow under the pines: a stack of stolen robes, blue and green, and a blade with a curved edge still wet.

objectives.text: Clear the outer pines of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two of the sect's own servants turn from the hollow with knives. Their eyes flash red at the edges.

objectives.text: Gather the stolen robes as proof
Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know them. They carried food to the Law Hall cells. I saw them once in the Abyss too, bringing sacks. I didn't say. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You didn't know what it meant, Xiao Shi.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know now. I'll say everything I remember. Everything. Even the parts I'd rather keep in the cage.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Xiao Shi) That was amazing.

quests.title: Evidence Before the Envoys
quests.summary: The Sect Master lays the stolen robes and the curved blade before Ruan Hai. He looks at them for a long time.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your chest was opened by the Blood Moon. The robe was ours, and stolen. They want our sects at each other's throats.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...And they very nearly had it. My son had his sword half drawn at breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I do not withdraw my demand. But I withdraw my accusation. There will be a duel of banners instead. By the old law.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Nine Banners. Nine duels, nine champions a side. Nobody's done that in eighty years. We'll need nine people who can fight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You're one. Pick the other eight. Choose well; the loser's sect gives up the question.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Nine Banner Poles
quests.summary: The old law requires nine banner poles cut from the sect's own pines. Nobody remembers how tall. Lu Ping guesses.

objectives.text: Go and see Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nine banner poles! From our own pines! The law says 'as tall as honour'. I've decided honour is about four men tall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Yan Tie. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

objectives.text: Cut banner poles in the outer pines
Report back to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Perfect. Very honourable poles. I've also started a betting book. The Iron Scale are betting too. Business is booming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Still in one piece. I wasn't worried. I was sharpening things.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Lu Ping, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Lu Ping, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Choosing Nine
quests.summary: Nine champions for the Azure Cloud. Everyone wants to be chosen. Not everyone should be.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak volunteers. All of Thunder Peak. We've been practising shouting in green. Pick me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: See? Even Sect Master Ruan agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm on your list. Don't argue. The Zhao clan has fought in every duel of banners since the sect was founded. All two of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Yan Tie. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And Han Xue. And Wei Tong, because he'll sulk otherwise, and a sulking Wei Tong eats the whole kitchen.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'm not on the list. Good. I'll hold the banners. I'm good at holding things. I held on for weeks in that cage.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Ling Qiu. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

quests.title: Night Before the Banners
quests.summary: The night before the duel, someone rings the gate bell and sets fire to the Iron Scale's camp.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Fire at the Iron Scale camp! And I didn't ring the bell this time, someone else did, which is very rude!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Sect Master Ruan. And the time before.

objectives.text: Ring the bell to wake both sects

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell booms. Blue robes and green armour pour out together, buckets in hand, as masked figures slip toward the pines.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow
Hear what Ruan Jingtao has to say

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You... carried water to my camp. You fought the arsonists beside my disciples. Why?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because it was on fire, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Deacon Shen.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: ...That's a stupid reason. It's the best reason I've heard in a year. The duel's still on tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Rules of Banners
quests.summary: Elder Bai reads the old rules of the Nine Banners aloud, with commentary nobody asked for.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Rule one: no killing. Rule two: no crippling. Rule three: no insulting the other sect's grandmother. Rule three was added later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Noted, Sect Master. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The last duel of banners, eighty years ago, ended when both champions fell in love. Rule nine was added after that.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Win if you can. Lose if you must. But whatever happens, make them see we are not their enemy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon is laughing at us. Let's give it less to laugh at.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Banners, Properly Dressed
quests.summary: Nine raw poles aren't banners yet. Someone has to dye and hang the cloth before morning.

objectives.text: See what Sect Master Ruan wants

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me spirit stones from the outer dormitories. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Xiao Shi. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly. I am too old for riddles and too tired for lies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the outer dormitories
Bring word to Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Ruan Jingtao is not wrong. Ruan Jingtao is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Scales do not rust. Neither do grudges. I am trying to let mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Curved Blade's Owner
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants the curved blade from the forced chest traced to whoever forged it, before the duel settles anything.

objectives.text: Investigate the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the sword tomb the rusted blades hum faintly as you pass, as if some of them still remember a name.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A blade like that isn't common. Whoever carries it wanted to be traceable, or didn't think anyone would try.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Oh good, you're back. I had a story ready about your tragic death. It was very moving.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Lu Ping. We were attentive.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (beaming at Elder Bai) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Arsonists, Regrouping
quests.summary: A few of the fire-starters from the Iron Scale camp attack scattered rather than fled outright.

objectives.text: Tend the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill furnace breathes out heat like a sleeping beast. Inside, a batch of pills turns slowly in the glow.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Moon cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
Show Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: We're done at the outer dormitories. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Old Bao.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart first, fist second. Just like the peak teaches!

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Second Look
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao watches you carry water to his camp's wounded and says nothing, which for him is a great deal.

objectives.text: Hear Ruan Jingtao out

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You didn't have to do that. I'm not thanking you. I'm just... noting it happened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Zhao Kang. And the time before.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang. Your clan's banner is crooked.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ruan Jingtao. Your sect's mountain is short.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: What Zhong Ming said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you, by the way. I always bet on you. I've bought four hats.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (grinning at Lu Ping) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Steady Hands for Nine Duels
quests.summary: Elder Mo wants every one of the sect's nine champions meditating properly before the duel, no exceptions.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nine duels tomorrow. Nine steady hands tonight. Sit. All of you. Yes, you too, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.text: Circulate your qi at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core spins, bright and steady, and every turn draws the world a little closer.

objectives.text: See Elder Mo again

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (muttering, to Elder Mo) That was cold.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Full Account
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, true to his word, gives the Sect Master everything he remembers from the cages, however small.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Names, faces, which guards were kind. I used to think none of it mattered. Elder Mo says all of it does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Listen to Yan Tie. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the chain bridge. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Yan Tie knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the main hall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Xiao Shi, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Chestnuts and Commerce
quests.summary: The chestnut seller tripling his prices for the crowd needs a word before both sects riot over snacks.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (steps back half a pace) {senior}... people say things about you. I don't believe them. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Three times the price! For chestnuts! I'd rather watch the duel hungry out of principle!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Lu Ping says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Return to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Yan Tie. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (muttering, to Lu Ping) That was cold.

quests.title: Rule Nine, Explained
quests.summary: Elder Bai finally explains why rule nine of the Nine Banners exists, and it is exactly as strange as promised.

objectives.text: Search the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Notice boards cover every wall of the mission hall, sect tasks pinned three deep and fluttering in the draught.

objectives.text: Search the notice board

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Most of the notice board is chores and grudges. One slip, pinned upside down, is meant for someone who knows to look.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Two champions, eighty years ago, fell in love mid-duel. Rule nine: no proposing marriage before the ninth banner. Wise, in hindsight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder, I finished copying the third annal.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Adequately? ...No. Well. Very well.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Bai) That was amazing.

quests.title: Han Xue's Practice Bout
quests.summary: Still stinging from an old loss, Han Xue wants one more practice bout before facing Iron Scale tomorrow.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hit me properly. I don't want a kind opponent tonight. I want a good one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

objectives.text: Hear what Lu Ping has to say

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Xiao Shi. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Do as Lu Ping says. For once, someone is making sense.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nobody tells the gate disciple anything. So I listen. Constantly.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Sometimes the rules are the cage. I know.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (grinning at Xiao Shi) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Guarding the Banner Poles
quests.summary: With sabotage already attempted once, the nine finished banner poles need a watch kept overnight.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Take a look at the refectory.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Listen to Sect Master Ruan. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Read the rim of the bronze ding

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three legs, two handles, and a rim of ancient script: the bronze ding is older than the hall that shelters it.

objectives.text: Stop the sparring disciples at the medicine valley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sparring disciples spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Stop the sparring disciples regrouping
Talk with Zhao Kang at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Banners Around the Plaza
quests.summary: Nine banners ring the formation plaza. Both sects fill the walls. Lu Ping's betting book is thicker than the rules.

objectives.text: Charge the rune pillar at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine banners, blue and green, ring the plaza. Both sects crowd the walls. Somebody is selling roasted chestnuts at three times the price.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You lay your palm on the rune pillar. It drinks your qi, hums a note, and passes it to its neighbours.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: First banner: Wei Tong. He insisted on going first. He said he wants to finish before lunch.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Stand with me and watch. A champion watches before he fights. Otherwise he's just a man with a sword.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: The First Three Banners
quests.summary: Wei Tong wins the first banner. Yan Tie shouts his way through the second. Han Xue loses the third, and is furious about it.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: First banner! I won! He was very big and I was very hungry! Hunger wins!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Elder Bai said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Wei Tong said. I was listening. Mostly.

objectives.text: Help the heralds clear the rowdy crowd

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale supporters vault the wall after the second banner. Azure Cloud disciples vault after them. The heralds look at you.

objectives.text: Hold the arena stands against more sparring disciples
Join Han Xue at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I lost the third. He was better. I'm going to go and be angry in the pavilion. Win yours.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Wei Tong agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Be careful, {senior}!

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Iron Scale disciples: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Eye Is Listening
quests.summary: Between banners you feel the cracked Azure Eye stir under the plaza, drinking the qi of every duel.

objectives.text: Head to the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every clash on the plaza sends a ripple through the stone. Beneath your feet, the Azure Eye's crack drinks the ripples in.

objectives.text: Press your palm to the formation between bouts

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Faint, beneath the stone: the breathing you felt beside the Sect Master. Slower now. Pleased.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You felt it too? The Eye is feeding on the duel. Fighting on the formation was always a strange tradition.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I'll note it. I note everything. I'm noting that you look pale. Go and eat something before your banner.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Bai) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (hiding behind Elder Bai) Oh.

quests.title: Fourth to Sixth
quests.summary: Zhao Kang takes the fourth banner with style. The fifth is a draw. The sixth, Iron Scale. The plaza holds its breath.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fourth banner, mine. Did you see the second exchange? Tell me you saw the second exchange. It was beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang. Your clan's banner is crooked.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ruan Jingtao. Your sect's mountain is short.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fifth was a draw. Sixth went to them. Three all. Your banner's the ninth. Of course it is. Everything important falls on you.

objectives.text: Speak with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ninth banner. You and me. I asked for it. My father said I was being childish. I said yes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My cousin used to say the Azure Cloud were soft. I want to know if he was wrong.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Salve Between Bouts
quests.summary: Both sects' fighters are battered. Elder Hua has sent salve, and someone has to carry it round both camps.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Salve for every fighter. Both sides. A bruise doesn't care what colour the robe is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Zhao Kang. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Gather salve jars from the Medicine Hall
Hear what Sect Master Ruan has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: You brought salve to my disciples. Before your own bout. Hm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: My son thinks the Azure Cloud is soft. I'm beginning to think he means kind, and doesn't know the word.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Sect Master Ruan's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Seventh and Eighth
quests.summary: The seventh banner goes to Yan Tie. The eighth to the Iron Scale. The ninth is yours. Elder Mo gives you one minute of advice.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Four all. Ninth banner. One minute of advice. The boy fights with his grief. Don't fight his grief. Fight him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Mo is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Elder Mo is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

objectives.text: Steady your golden core before the ninth banner

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your core turns slowly, gold and steady. The plaza's noise falls away until there is only breath, and the next breath.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Answer Tang Ling, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Ninth Banner
quests.summary: The ninth banner: you against Ruan Jingtao, heir of the Iron Scale, with both sects' fate on the plaza.

objectives.text: Trace the seal at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The plaza falls silent. Ruan Jingtao draws a blade of green steel and salutes, stiffly, correctly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press your palm to the seal. Green light answers the pendant at your chest.

objectives.name: Ruan Jingtao
objectives.text: Face Ruan Jingtao at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: For my cousin! For the eleven!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: For them too, Ruan Jingtao. Come on.

objectives.text: Meet Ruan Jingtao at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You could have ended it at the third exchange. You didn't. You let me fight until I'd said everything I needed to say with my sword.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My cousin was wrong. You're not soft. You're something worse. You're kind on purpose.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's hoard holds spirit stones stolen from Qingshi.

choices.text: Return every stone to Qingshi

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering to Ruan Jingtao) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Give it all to the sect treasury

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

choices.text: Keep a share for yourself

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Question Given Up
quests.summary: Five banners to four. By the old law the Iron Scale gives up the question of the Lotus Key. Ruan Hai does it with dignity.

objectives.text: Answer Sect Master Ruan's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale gives up the question, by the old law. The key stays with its bearer. We will not raise it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. The Sect Master is not wrong. The Sect Master is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we did this uphill. Both ways. In the snow. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Sect Master Ruan, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: And we will ask for something else. When you go after the Blood Moon, send word. The Iron Scale will stand with you.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master Ruan. Now there will be tea. A great deal of tea.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Cinder Peak incident started with tea. Let us hope this ends with it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao, humiliated by the loss, stands alone among the banners.

choices.text: Go and offer him your hand

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Leave him to his own sect's customs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Mock the Iron Scale where he can hear

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Tea for Two Sects
quests.summary: The Azure Cloud serves tea to the Iron Scale on the plaza. It is awkward. Then it is less awkward. Then Wei Tong sings.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (steps back half a pace) {senior}... people say things about you. I don't believe them. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Tea for everyone! I'm pouring! I've won nineteen stones and lost eighteen. I'm up one stone and I feel like an emperor.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Lu Ping is right.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Carry tea cups around the plaza
Raise a cup to the fallen of both sects

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two sects raise their cups together, to eleven Iron Scale dead and to everyone the Blood Moon has taken. Then Wei Tong sings, badly.

objectives.text: Find Ruan Jingtao at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your senior brother is a terrible singer. He's wonderful. We don't have anyone like that. We should get one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Ruan Jingtao said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ruan Jingtao is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Packing Up the Plaza
quests.summary: Nine banners, nine stands, a great deal of chestnut litter. Someone has to help clear it before nightfall.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the mountain road. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the mountain road
Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: What the Eye Remembers
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants to know if the Azure Eye's strange feeding during the duel left any lasting mark on the formation.

objectives.text: Make your way to the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old blades stand in the rock of the sword tomb like a field of iron grass, each one a disciple's last oath.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rust flakes from the sword in the stone as you touch it. The blade beneath is still bright, and still sharp.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Formations don't usually remember specific fights. I'd like to know if this one does. For notes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Han Xue says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: The Last Arsonist
quests.summary: One of the fire-starters from the night before the duel is still loose, hiding in the outer pines.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Moon cultivators come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the outer dormitories
Compare notes with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the outer dormitories isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Yan Tie, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Sect Master. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Question
quests.summary: Before the Iron Scale departs, Ruan Jingtao asks, quietly, whether the offer to stand together against the Blood Moon was genuine.

objectives.text: See what Ruan Jingtao wants

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father doesn't offer things he doesn't mean. I wanted to hear it from you too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was genuine from me the moment you first drew your sword. You just didn't ask then.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Ruan Jingtao is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Old Qiu. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Yan Tie) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Speak with Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Sect Master Ruan asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: The Ninth Banner's Echo
quests.summary: The ninth banner's duel still echoes in your core, a rhythm you can't quite shake. Han Xue suggests sitting with it instead of fighting it.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let it finish echoing on its own terms. Fighting an echo just makes more of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Xiao Shi agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Meditate at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You circulate qi through the core nine times. On the ninth, it rings like a struck bell.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Han Xue will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: More or less. Mostly less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Victory Lap
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on a full, dramatic retelling of his first-banner win, complete with sound effects.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: And then I went WHOOSH, and he went AAAH, and I went HA! It's basically exactly how it happened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If he offers you a bun before a fight, refuse. He'll share it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone fights better with a bun, Senior Sister. It's science.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Salve, Restocked Again
quests.summary: Elder Hua's salve supplies need restocking yet again after the duel emptied half the Medicine Hall's shelves.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me spirit herbs from the spirit peach orchard, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Fan Rui.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the spirit peach orchard
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Tang Ling. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (beaming at Han Xue) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Fourth Banner, Replayed
quests.summary: Zhao Kang wants a second, more technical opinion on his fourth-banner victory, mostly so he can hear it praised again.

objectives.text: Scout the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The long refectory smells of rice, ginger and a hundred disciples who trained since dawn.

objectives.text: Examine the bronze ding

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the rim of the bronze ding by touch. It lists the names of those who made an oath around it.

objectives.text: Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Objectively. Technically. Was it not one of the finer exchanges you've witnessed? Be honest. Be very honest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Lu Ping. Lu Ping won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (beaming at Zhao Kang) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Lu Ping's Final Tally
quests.summary: Lu Ping's betting book closes at exactly one stone of profit, which he treats as a historic achievement.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Up one stone! After nineteen wins and eighteen losses! I've decided this makes me a professional.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Bai.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Iron Scale's Parting Gift
quests.summary: Before departing, the Iron Scale leaves a gift chest of its own this time, unforced and openly given.
