objectives.text: Report to Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Return to Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Enough, Fan Rui. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly. I am too old for riddles and too tired for lies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (beaming at Sect Master Ruan) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Five Banners to Four
quests.summary: When the plaza empties, you sit where the ninth banner stood and let the duel settle into your core.

objectives.text: Settle your core on the empty plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your core spins, and each turn remembers a blow you didn't strike. It grows denser, and quieter. Middle stage of Core Formation.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath you the Azure Eye breathes. Slower now, and patient, like something that can wait a long time for what it wants.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I lost the third banner. I'm going to train until I never lose another. You're going to help. Tomorrow. Dawn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Ruan Jingtao. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And... you did well. That's all. Don't look at me like that.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The elders will hate that. I love it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Groves on Fire
quests.summary: Smoke rises from the forest's eastern groves. The hermit sends a crane: green armour, burning herbs, and something wrong.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The eastern groves are burning. The best moonbell in the province. The hermit's crane says green armour.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale swore peace a week ago. Either they lied, or someone is wearing their armour. Find out which.

objectives.text: Hurry to the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The herb grove is ash and smoke. Among the burned moonbell, a scrap of green scale armour, still hot.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They came at dawn, in green. They burned the grove and left the wolves alone. Bandits burn everything. These chose.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Ruan Jingtao. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Raiders in Green
quests.summary: The raiders are still in the forest, burning their way toward the spirit spring.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're heading for the spring. If they burn the spring, the whole forest sickens.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Iron Scale disciples is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

objectives.text: Drive the green-armoured raiders from the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Green-armoured raiders spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of green-armoured raiders

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Green-armoured raiders turn at the spring, torches raised. Their eyes are red at the edges.

objectives.text: Go to the waterwheel

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The raiders fall back into the bamboo. One leaves his helmet in the mud. It's too big for him.

quests.title: Armour Too Big
quests.summary: The fallen raider's armour is genuine Iron Scale work, but made for a larger man. Stolen, or taken from the dead.

objectives.text: Investigate the poison marsh

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The helmet is real Iron Scale steel. The name scratched inside is not the raider's.

objectives.text: Read the name inside the helmet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ruan Mingyu. Crimson Road. The Iron Scale's dead cousin, whose armour went into the Abyss with him.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: That's my cousin's helmet. They took it off his body. They're wearing our dead to start a war.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale will hunt them with you. Not for peace. For him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Ruan Jingtao) That was cold.

quests.title: Following the Ash
quests.summary: The raiders leave a trail of ash and red-eyed wolves. Ruan Jingtao insists on walking in front.

objectives.text: Pry open the chest at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A trail of burned bamboo leads north. Ruan Jingtao walks ahead of you, jaw tight, sword drawn.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You pry open the chest. Whoever packed it did so in a hurry, and in fear.

objectives.text: Clear the spider hollow of corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Wolves with red eyes! Is everything in your forest trying to eat us?

objectives.text: Gather the raiders' dropped orders
Share your findings with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Orders. In Blood Moon script. They're camped in the old bandit camp. Of course they are. Everyone camps there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ha. The hermit's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Ruan Jingtao, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Balanced, like a good kettle.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Camp of Borrowed Armour
quests.summary: The old bandit camp is full of green armour on red-eyed men. And in a pen at the back, three real Iron Scale disciples.

objectives.text: Read the map table at the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the camp below: green armour on red-eyed men, and in a pen at the back, three young disciples in torn green robes.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Those are ours! In the pen! Taken on the Crimson Road! Alive! Get them out!

objectives.text: Break open the pen

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pen's lock breaks. Three Iron Scale disciples stumble out, thin and dazed, and throw themselves on Ruan Jingtao.

objectives.text: Tell Ruan Jingtao what you found

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Three of the eleven. Alive. My father thought... we all thought...

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a long story. The short version: yes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I owe you, Azure Cloud. The Iron Scale doesn't like owing. We're going to have to become friends to pay it off.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: What the Captives Saw
quests.summary: The rescued Iron Scale disciples were held in the Abyss before they were brought here. They saw things.

objectives.text: Hear Ruan Jingtao out

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They were in the Abyss. Near the cages. They say someone was talking about you. By name.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

objectives.text: Study the map table at the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The eldest captive speaks haltingly. An old man in Law Hall grey, he says. He said the heir must grow strong first. Strong enough to be worth it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Worth what?

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He didn't say. He only said it the way you'd say a crop needs to ripen.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu. Waiting for you to grow. Like a farmer. I'm going to be sick.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Han Xue is right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Ruan Jingtao agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we grow faster than he can plan for. That's all we can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A captured raider offers the camp's cache in exchange for his freedom.

choices.text: Agree, and keep your word

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Refuse any deal with raiders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Agree, then hand him in anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Healing the Burned Grove
quests.summary: The hermit asks you to help him heal the burned grove with the sutra. Fire is fast; roots are patient.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Fire is fast. Roots are patient. Sit in the ash with me and remind the roots they're still alive.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what the hermit says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

objectives.text: Heal the burned grove with the Heart Sutra

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe the sutra into the ash. Root. Stem. Beneath your palms, something green stirs in the black.

objectives.text: Go back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Seedlings by morning. The forest is better at forgiving than we are. We could learn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Ruan Jingtao is not wrong. Ruan Jingtao is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to the hermit) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Red Eyes Come Back
quests.summary: The raiders who escaped come back at night for the rescued captives, and bring more wolves than men.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me. He said you'd need someone to complain at. Also, there are about thirty wolves behind you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.text: Break the corrupted wolves at the giant bamboo grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The corrupted wolves have found you first.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the far forest gate
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale boy fought well. Don't tell him. I've just got used to one rival; I can't handle two.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Raiders' Cache
quests.summary: Under the bandit camp's firepit the raiders buried a cache: stolen armour, Frenzy Pills and a list.

objectives.text: Search the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The firepit is cold. Beneath the ash, a hatch of rotten boards, and beneath that, a pit.

objectives.text: Dig out the raiders' buried cache
Open the cache's iron box

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Frenzy Pills, forty of them. Iron Scale armour from nine dead disciples. And a list of sects: Iron Scale, Azure Cloud, Moon-Well, Zhao.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Four names. Four sects to set against each other. We were just the first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then the other three need to know. Before the pills reach them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Letters to Four Sects
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao and you write to the sects on the list, together. It is the first letter the Iron Scale has co-signed in a century.

objectives.text: Answer Ruan Jingtao's summons

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father will faint. An Iron Scale letter, co-signed by an Azure Cloud disciple. We'll need to invent a new seal.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Moon-Well, Zhao clan... they'll listen to two sects where they'd laugh at one.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Two sects writing together. That's how the Verdant Lotus and the Azure Cloud started, the hermit says.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Ruan Jingtao. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It ended with a seal under the earth. Let's hope ours ends better.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Seedlings From the Ash
quests.summary: The hermit's overnight seedlings need careful transplanting before the grove's soil settles back to normal.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me spirit herbs from the mushroom ring.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: I'll carry anything heavy. Heavier than a tree, I'll need a friend.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: No, Big Shu. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the mushroom ring
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows faster than I cut. I've made my peace with it. The bamboo hasn't.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Big Shu.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: The Cache's Last Guard
quests.summary: One raider stayed behind to guard the buried cache's approach, and didn't notice it had already been found.

objectives.text: Compare the stone tablets at the buried temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stone tablets are carved with names and dates. The last one is blank, waiting.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the buried temple

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: More Blood Moon cultivators? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Collect rune fragments around the buried temple
Show Elder Hua what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Hua) That was amazing.

quests.title: Ruan Mingyu's Effects
quests.summary: Among the recovered armour is more of the dead cousin's gear. Ruan Jingtao wants it catalogued properly, not just returned.

objectives.text: Head to the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Children in the bamboo village stop their game to stare at your robes, then bow all at once and giggle.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run your fingers along the threads of the loom. One colour runs through every bolt, like a signature.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Everything of his, listed and cleaned. My father will want it exactly as it was. As much as anything can be.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The earth god will hear of this. Loudly. We'll light the big incense.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Headman Kuang. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Rescued Disciples, Settling In
quests.summary: The three freed Iron Scale disciples aren't ready to travel yet and are, awkwardly, guests of the Azure Cloud's forest camp.

objectives.text: Make your way to the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: They flinch at loud noises and thank you for things that don't need thanking. It will take longer than a night to undo the cages.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Noted, Hermit. Overruled, but noted.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Roots Remembering
quests.summary: The hermit wants to check the healed grove again the next morning, to be sure the sutra's work held overnight.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Roots remember slower than leaves forget. Let's make sure what we planted stayed planted.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Han Xue. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The core burns hotter. Impurities rise like smoke and are gone.

objectives.text: See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ruan Jingtao says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Letters Need Wax
quests.summary: Four sects, four letters, and Elder Bai insists each needs its own proper seal, which means more wax than anyone packed.

objectives.text: See what Yan Tie wants

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the spirit spring. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the spirit spring
Return to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. The hermit's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Wolves Near the Camp Ruins
quests.summary: A few of the tide's stray wolves have taken up residence in the abandoned bandit camp's ruins.

objectives.text: Mark the map table at the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted wolves at the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the poison marsh
Share your findings with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to the hermit, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Zhao Kang and Ruan Jingtao, Almost Friends
quests.summary: Zhao Kang and Ruan Jingtao spend an entire evening arguing about swordsmanship, which for both of them counts as bonding.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He's wrong about footwork. Completely wrong. I respect him enormously.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the smugglers' trail. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Pei Yuan. A poor master.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the old bridge.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yan Tie, lower your voice. The mountain is asleep.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: THE MOUNTAIN LIKES ME, ZHAO KANG.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Wild! I like it. Don't tell the elders I said so.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: The List's Fourth Name
quests.summary: The buried list's fourth sect, simply marked 'Zhao,' raises an uncomfortable question about Zhao Kang's own clan.

objectives.text: Scout the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sect's forest watchpost stands on stilts above the bamboo, a lantern hung at every corner.

objectives.text: Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Zhao. Your clan, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...I noticed. I'm choosing to be calm about it. Loudly. While pacing.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ah. The kettle can stop worrying. It has been worrying since you left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sorry I worried you.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Any Iron Scale colours among them? Tell me honestly. I would rather know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: What the Border Taught
quests.summary: Between the burned grove, the rescued captives and the list of four sects, your core has grown heavier with purpose.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: This isn't just about you anymore. It hasn't been for a while. I think you're finally starting to feel that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Refine your cultivation at the giant banyan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core spins, bright and steady, and every turn draws the world a little closer.

objectives.text: Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: And your heart, while you did it? Still? Or thrashing like a fish?

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: What Bai Wants to Know
quests.summary: Elder Bai needs to know how the Sky Isles open. The pagoda's books say sixty years; they don't say when the sixty began.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Sky Isles open once in sixty years. Every book says so. No book says which sixty. We could wait a week or a lifetime.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Fan Rui?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus went to the isles for the first seal's star iron. If anyone recorded the cycle, they did. Beneath their ruins.

objectives.text: Touch the guardian lion at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus archway stands open, as it has since the day it opened for you. Below the courtyard, water shines in the dark.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You touch the mane of the guardian lion. The stone is warm, as if it had been sitting in the sun, or breathing.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The archive. Flooded when the sect fell. I never went down. Some of my masters are still down there. Their bones, at least.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhao Kang. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Breath Stones
quests.summary: The hermit says the Verdant Lotus used breath stones to walk the flooded halls. There are still some in the shrine.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Breath stones. Hold one under your tongue and the water forgets you're not a fish. There should be some left at the shrine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Xiao Shi has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The hermit thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

objectives.text: Find breath stones in the ruined shrine
Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Five stones. Enough for three of you, twice. Don't swallow them. My master swallowed one once. She was a fish for a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Zhao Kang. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: Into the Flooded Halls
quests.summary: Under the courtyard the Verdant Lotus archive lies drowned: shelves of jade, halls of green water, and silence.

objectives.text: Hurry to the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Green water, still and clear. Shelves of jade slips glimmer on the bottom like fish scales.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Over there. See? Someone tried to hide their tracks and did it badly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I've got the lantern!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We'll go carefully.

objectives.text: Gather drowned jade slips
Read the flooded stele

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The first seal's star iron came from the isles, in the sixtieth year after the Patriarch's first ascent. The isles keep his count.

objectives.text: Drive the stone golems from the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The archive's stone keepers rise from the water, streaming, to see who reads their stele.

objectives.text: Go to the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You surface, gasping. The breath stone tastes of mint and old tears.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate
Give the names to the magistrate
Keep the silver

quests.title: The Patriarch's Count
quests.summary: Elder Bai does the arithmetic by the ruins gate, on a flat stone, with a stick, muttering.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Sixty years after the Patriarch's first ascent. He climbed three hundred and... carry the nine... The isles open this winter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Elder Bai is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The village is grateful. The village is also very nervous. Mostly nervous.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: This winter! We have months, not years! I need to sit down. I am sitting down. I need to sit down more.

objectives.text: Check Elder Bai's arithmetic against the shrine stele

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine's stele confirms it, in a Verdant Lotus hand: they open when the Patriarch's stars are low. This winter, they will be.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Months. We need the materials, the design, the people. And the isles are guarded, the books say. By what?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Bai. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Bones in the Archive
quests.summary: In the lower hall you find what the hermit feared: the Verdant Lotus elders who stayed to guard the archive.

objectives.text: Charge the rune pillar at the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the lowest hall lie seven skeletons in green-stained robes, seated in a circle, hands still joined.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl up the rune pillar like ivy made of light. One of them is carved backward.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the old battlefield

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Seven. My teachers' teachers. They stayed. They held the water back so the archive would survive. I ran past this door.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I ran past this door. I heard them singing. I ran.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the charcoal kilns

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I heard singing in the cages, too. Other prisoners. It helped. I don't think they minded that I didn't sing back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: What Big Shu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Xiao Shi) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I think they just wanted someone to hear.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Robbers in the Water
quests.summary: Rogue cultivators have followed the rumour of Verdant Lotus treasure, and they're diving without breath stones.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Rogues again. Diving for the archive. Half of them are drowning and the other half are drowning slower.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Headman Kuang. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Clear the sunken courtyard of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rogue cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Cut down the rogue cultivators that follow
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I pulled three of them out of the water before I hit them. The Zhao clan has standards. Low ones, but standards.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The earth god will hear of this. Loudly. We'll light the big incense.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Headman Kuang. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: The Drowned Librarian
quests.summary: The archive's last guardian is a stone librarian that has been reshelving the same drowned slips for three hundred years.

objectives.text: Investigate the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A stone figure moves through the water, slow and precise, lifting slips from the floor and placing them on shelves that are no longer there.

objectives.name: The Drowned Librarian
objectives.text: Bring down The Drowned Librarian

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It turns. Its eyes glow green. It does not ask who carries the flower. It asks: have you returned your books?

objectives.text: Return the drowned slips to the librarian

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The librarian takes the slips, places them on a shelf that isn't there, and kneels. Its work is finished.

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It asked if you'd returned your books. A librarian after my own heart. I want it carved over the pagoda door.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Elder Bai knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Thank you, Xiao Shi. Now, where was I.

objectives.choice_prompt: The stone librarian won't let one slip leave: a forbidden technique it has guarded for centuries.

choices.text: Leave it with its guardian

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Distract the librarian and take it for Elder Bai

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A reasonable reading of the situation.

choices.text: Take it for yourself

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Song for Seven
quests.summary: The hermit goes down to the seven skeletons at last, and asks you to sit with him while he sings the song he ran from.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They sang the Heart Sutra while the water rose. I ran. Now I'm going to sing it back to them. Sit with me. I may not finish.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. The hermit does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Han Xue?

objectives.text: Sit with the hermit while he sings

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: His voice cracks on the first line, steadies on the second. By the third verse the water in the lower hall is glowing faintly green.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: When he finishes, the seven skeletons are gone. Only seven lotus flowers float where they sat.

objectives.text: See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They heard. I don't know how I know. They heard. Three hundred years late, and they heard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Slips for the Sect
quests.summary: The archive's surviving slips are Verdant Lotus lore: sealing arts, star charts, recipes. Bai wants every one dried.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai out

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Every surviving slip. Dry them in the shade, never the sun. Jade sulks in the sun. So do I.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Carry the surviving slips up from the archive
Return to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Star charts! Sealing diagrams! A recipe for turtle soup! The Verdant Lotus understood what matters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Hermit. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: The jade slips came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) That makes sense. I think.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Hermit Stops Running
quests.summary: On the way out, the hermit says something he has not said in three hundred years.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I think I have stopped running. I don't know what to do now. Running was a very time-consuming hobby.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could come to the sect. The seed you gave me is growing in the pond.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Is it? ...Not yet. But I'll come and look at it. From a distance. That's a beginning.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Months until the isles open. We'd better go home and tell the Sect Master to start packing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Drying the Slips Properly
quests.summary: Elder Bai's newly recovered slips need a second, more careful drying pass before they're fit to shelve.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me jade slips from the echo cave.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Bai says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Knowledge is like tea. Too hot, and it scalds. Too cold, and nobody wants it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Gather jade slips at the echo cave
Go back to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find a book with turtle soup stains on it, it's mine. Return it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more jade slips than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Turtle Soup Recipe, Verified
quests.summary: Elder Bai insists on personally verifying the archive's turtle soup recipe against his own, for scholarly reasons he won't elaborate on.

objectives.text: Search the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Jars of pickled roots line the alchemist's windowsill. One of them appears to be pickled back at you.

objectives.text: Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Different from mine. Better, possibly. I will not be saying that last part again.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Last Rogue Diver
quests.summary: One rogue cultivator, more stubborn than the rest, is still trying to dive for archive treasure without a breath stone.

objectives.text: Beat the war drum at the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The war drum speaks in a voice like thunder. Every head turns. Somewhere, someone starts running.

objectives.text: Fight off the rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Pick up wolf fangs near the tiger ridge
Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The misty lake is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ah. The kettle can stop worrying. It has been worrying since you left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Singing Lesson
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, moved by the hermit's song for the seven, asks quietly to be taught the Heart Sutra's melody himself.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'm terrible. Truly terrible. I'd like to learn anyway. Some things are worth being bad at.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the hidden valley

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Zhao Kang. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Archive's Quiet
quests.summary: Han Xue wants one more meditation session in the now-empty lower hall, to be sure whatever lingered there has truly gone.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It feels different. Lighter. I want to be sure that's real and not just relief.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

objectives.text: Cultivate at the giant banyan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You circulate qi through the core nine times. On the ninth, it rings like a struck bell.

objectives.text: Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: And your heart, while you did it? Still? Or thrashing like a fish?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Star Charts for Elder Bai
quests.summary: The recovered star charts need cross-referencing against the pagoda's own records before the isles open.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me jade slips from the echo cave.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Han Xue. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Walk upwind. Whatever's out there has a better nose than you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Collect jade slips around the echo cave
Bring word to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Zhao Kang. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the jade slips you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: What Guards the Isles
quests.summary: Han Xue's question lingers: what guards the Sky Isles, if the Verdant Lotus thought it worth recording?

objectives.text: Head to the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One slip, half-ruined, mentions only a serpent of flood and cloud, and a warning not to wake it hungry.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I have read everything in the pagoda twice, and the recipes three times.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Diving Lessons
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, having pulled three rogues from the water, decides he should probably learn to swim properly himself.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I can swim! Adequately! Badly! Fine, teach me. Quietly. Where nobody's watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to the hermit. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Hermit. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Xiao Shi is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.
