dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the mushroom ring

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: If anything smells sweet in there, hold your breath. Sweet is how poison says hello.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (grinning at the hermit) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Provisions for the Isles
quests.summary: Preparing for a months-away expedition to the Sky Isles means stocking supplies now, however early it feels.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me spirit stones from the spirit spring.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Xiao Shi, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the spirit spring
See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

quests.title: What the Archive Left You
quests.summary: Between the drowned elders, the librarian's question and the hermit's stopped running, your core has settled into something new.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You carry more of us now than you did this morning. The Verdant Lotus, the Iron Scale, all of it. That's what a core is for, I think.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Headman Kuang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

objectives.text: Temper your realm at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The core burns hotter. Impurities rise like smoke and are gone.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The earth god will hear of this. Loudly. We'll light the big incense.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to the hermit) Fair's fair.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Neutral Ground
quests.summary: Madam Fang has agreed to host four sects at the Drunken Crane. She has also raised her prices, on principle.

objectives.text: Make your way to the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four sects' banners hang outside the Drunken Crane. The whole town has found reasons to walk past very slowly.

objectives.text: Join Madam Fang at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Four sects in my inn! Four! I've hidden the good wine and brought out the diplomatic wine. It's the same wine. The cups are nicer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Ancestor Zhao.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My dishwasher is very excited. Well. He's very quiet. That's excited, for him.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Dishwasher
quests.summary: Iron-Fang is washing dishes behind the inn. He has been since the siege. He is surprisingly good at it.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Sect brat. You're here for the big meeting. I'm here for the big pile of cups. We all have our battles.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men are working the farms. My family's still in the Abyss. Every plate I wash, I count. It's a very long count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We'll bring them out, Tie Hu. I haven't forgotten.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Neither have I. Now move, you're standing in my rinse water.

objectives.text: Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang lets me dry. He says I'm the best dryer in Qingshi. I'm the only dryer in Qingshi.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Liu Er thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Han Xue. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Liu Er) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Four Chairs, Five Guests
quests.summary: The meeting table is set for four sect leaders. Someone has quietly added a fifth chair.

objectives.text: Scout the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The upstairs room is set for four: Azure Cloud, Iron Scale, Zhao clan, Moon-Well. A fifth chair stands in the corner, facing the window.

objectives.text: Inspect the fifth chair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the seat, a crescent scratched into the wood, and fresh. Someone is expected who wasn't invited.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A fifth chair. A crescent. Someone thinks they're coming to this meeting. I'm going to be very rude to them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There you are. The noodles were getting cold, and so was my temper.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Madam Fang. You said so. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

quests.title: The Zhao Ancestor
quests.summary: Zhao Kang's great-grandfather arrives for the Zhao clan, and is exactly as warm as a gold bar left out in winter.

objectives.text: Answer Ancestor Zhao's summons

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: So you're the village child my great-grandson writes about. He writes about you more than he writes to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Old Pan. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: He says you're insufferable. From him, that's a love letter. The Zhao clan will listen. Once.

objectives.text: Hear what Sect Master Ruan has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Ancestor Zhao. Still alive, I see. Still counting gold, I hear.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan. Still losing duels, I hear. To children.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...It was a very good child.

objectives.choice_prompt: Sect Master Ruan mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The First Cup
quests.summary: Madam Fang pours the first cup. Han Xue knocks it out of Sect Master Ruan's hand. It hisses on the floor.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't drink! The tea smells of blood lotus! Somebody's in the kitchen!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Scholar Ouyang.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Han Xue) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Seal the inn's kitchen door

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The kitchen door bangs shut under your ward. Behind it, something heavy hits the wood and snarls.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the market square

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Servers throw off their aprons. Crimson robes underneath. Knives come out of the noodle baskets.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards regrouping
Meet Constable Du at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Six of them, dressed as servers. Madam Fang hired them yesterday. She's mortified. She's hitting one with a ladle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Captain Lei. {player} has never let us down.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: By the law. That's all I ever ask.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's... not in the book. I'll invent a page.

quests.title: Where the Poisoner Went
quests.summary: The poisoner slipped out of the kitchen's back window. Iron-Fang saw which way. He's already running.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Look at you. Wearing the sect's robes and the bandit's heart. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Kind, and still breathing. You're rarer than spirit stones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Pale man, no apron, out the back window. I threw a pot at him. I missed. I never miss. He's quick.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Magistrate Zhou. Magistrate Zhou's survived worse.

objectives.text: Hurry to the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back alley is empty. Too empty. A pot lies dented on the stones. Above, a shutter swings shut.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: More crimson servers wait at the docks, blocking the ferry. The poisoner's escape route.

objectives.text: Talk with Old Pan at the watermill

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Pale fellow jumped in the river. Swam like an eel. Didn't come up. I've seen that before. The Blood Moon ones swim under.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: He'll come up at the graves. They always do. Always the graves.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Pale Assassin
quests.summary: The poisoner comes up at the graves, as Old Pan said. He is pale as fish-belly, and he has been waiting for you, not the sect masters.

objectives.text: Read the ancestral tablets at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among the tombs stands a man so pale he seems carved from candle wax. He smiles. His teeth are red.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ancestral tablets stand in silent rows. You read the names aloud, softly, because someone should.

objectives.name: The Pale Assassin
objectives.text: Defeat The Pale Assassin

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The heir, he says. I was told to test you, not kill you. But I've always been bad at following orders.

objectives.text: Find Ruan Jingtao at the humpbacked bridge

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You chased him alone? Into a graveyard? The Iron Scale would call that brave. The Azure Cloud would call it stupid.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I call it the reason my father is still alive. Thank you. Again. I'm running out of ways to say it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The pale poisoner lies beaten among the graves, offering his employer's name for his life.

choices.text: Let him go for the name

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Hand him to the four sects' tribunal

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kill him before he can lie to you

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Four Seals on One Page
quests.summary: Over a second pot of tea, one that everyone watches Madam Fang pour, four sects put their seals on one page.

objectives.text: See what Sect Master Ruan wants

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Four sects. One page. Mutual warning, mutual aid, against the Blood Moon. My seal first. I nearly died for this one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Join Ancestor Zhao at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao seal. Gold, naturally. My great-grandson will pretend not to be proud of me. He's very bad at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Sect Master Ruan has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: And the yamen of Qingshi as witness! My best seal! My only seal! I am a witness to history! I'm going to cry!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Noodles for Four Sects
quests.summary: Peace is signed. Madam Fang makes noodles for four sects, and everyone eats from the same pot, watching each other.

objectives.text: Hear Madam Fang out

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Noodles! From one pot! If anyone poisons this pot, they poison themselves, which is the most honest diplomacy I know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Carry bowls from the market stalls
Serve the first bowl at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four sect masters eat from the same pot, watching each other over the rims. Iron-Fang washes their bowls, and nobody notices him smile.

objectives.text: Hear what Widow Liu has to say

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My son dried every bowl. He's asleep in a barrel. He says it's the best day of his life. He says that every day now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Not now, Magistrate Zhou. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Widow Liu, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Cleaning Up After Four Sects
quests.summary: Four sects' worth of celebration leaves a great deal for Madam Fang's inn to clean up, dishwasher or no.

objectives.text: Speak with Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me spirit stones from the watermill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Ancestor Zhao is right.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Ancestor Zhao. More sense there than in half this town.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the watermill
Go back to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (beaming at Ancestor Zhao) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Fifth Chair, Removed
quests.summary: Constable Du wants the crescent-marked chair destroyed properly, not just set aside, in case it's more than furniture.

objectives.text: Go to the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The riverside tavern is loud even at noon. Someone is arm-wrestling a boatman and losing money on it.

objectives.text: Taste the wine jars

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tap the wine jars one by one. Full, full, full, and one that answers hollow.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Burn it, break it, whatever makes it stop being a chair. I don't trust furniture with opinions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We all were, Widow Liu. We all were.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Crimson Servers, Unaccounted For
quests.summary: Not every fake server was caught in the inn's brawl. A few scattered into the town and need rounding up.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shuttle of the loom has stopped mid-row. The half-finished pattern is a map, if you know how to read it.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Guards come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs at the dye yard
Show Sect Master Ruan what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Ancestor Zhao is not wrong. Ancestor Zhao is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Well? Was it who I said it was? I'm always right. I'm just not always paid.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Ancestor Zhao's Verdict
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu corners you privately for his own assessment of the village child his great-grandson writes about.

objectives.text: Go and see Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: You're not what I expected. Good. Expected things are boring. Keep surprising him. It's good for his character.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Old Pan?

objectives.text: Meet Widow Liu at the town temple

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The water's sweet this season. Take a cup.

objectives.text: Talk with Old Pan at the boat yard

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Huo Da.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Old Pan) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Final Count
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's dish count has reached a number he considers worth marking, and he wants it recorded somewhere.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: (grins without warmth) You've been busy. The wrong kind of busy.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Kind, and still breathing. You're rarer than spirit stones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: One thousand plates since the siege. Write it down somewhere. Not for me. For counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Probably, Ancestor Zhao. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the pottery kilns
Report back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'm watching you, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good. Somebody should. I'm very watchable now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Iron-Fang does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Reasonable. Written down.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: What the Assassin Left
quests.summary: The pale assassin dropped something at the graveyard in his hurry to test rather than kill you.

objectives.text: Investigate the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A small vial, empty, smelling faintly of blood lotus and something colder. Whatever it held, it wasn't meant for tea.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: Remarkable. I'll set it as an essay question. The students will hate you.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ha. Scholar Ouyang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It... reconsiders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Liu Er's Question
quests.summary: Liu Er asks, with the bluntness only a sixteen-year-old can manage, whether he's old enough to fight yet.

objectives.text: Report to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I dried bowls. I can fight too, probably. Iron-Fang says I hit like a startled goose. I'm working on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Er, stand up straight. You're talking to an immortal.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, it's only {player}!

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

objectives.text: Find Ancestor Zhao at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Sect Master Ruan. I asked who would go.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the north gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Captain Lei. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

quests.title: Digesting a Long Day
quests.summary: Han Xue insists on a proper meditation before sleep, after a day with this many near-poisonings in it.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Days like this sit badly if you don't process them. Sit. Breathe. Let today actually end.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Ancestor Zhao. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core spins, bright and steady, and every turn draws the world a little closer.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine. You're well in credit, child.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Letters to Carry Home
quests.summary: Four sects' worth of correspondence needs organizing before the journey back up the mountain.

objectives.text: See what Liu Er wants

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me sealed letters from the back alley, would you?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the back alley
See Liu Er again

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Excellent. I shall mention you in my monthly letter. It is very long. You'll be in paragraph nine.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ancestor Zhao. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more sealed letters than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Liu Er, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Thanks, Once More
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao finds one more moment before the sects part ways to say what he couldn't fit into the first ten thank-yous.

objectives.text: Hear Ruan Jingtao out

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father says the Iron Scale owes debts for centuries and forgets none of them. Yours, we won't forget either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Han Xue. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Speak with Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Ruan Jingtao, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Han Xue) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The Test, Not the Kill
quests.summary: The assassin said he was sent to test you, not kill you. You sit in the clean temple and wonder who wanted to know.

objectives.text: Sit with the assassin's words in the temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Test you, not kill you. Someone is measuring your core the way a farmer measures a crop. You let the thought pass, and your core grows anyway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Late stage of Core Formation. You're stronger. That's exactly what they want. It's also exactly what you need.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Test, not kill. Gu, waiting for you to ripen. The assassin just confirmed it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Fine. We ripen. We ripen so hard it breaks their teeth.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Qi Like a Blade
quests.summary: Elder Mo's first lesson in sword qi: cut a falling leaf in half without touching it. He demonstrates. Four times.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sword qi. The core throws what the hand cannot reach. Watch. Leaf falls. Qi cuts. Leaf is two leaves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: ...That was a gust of wind. Watch again. Leaf falls. There. Two leaves. Your turn.

objectives.text: Cut falling plum petals with sword qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thousand petals fall. You cut none. Then one. Then, as the sun sets, every petal that falls near you drifts down in halves.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Halves. Adequate. Tomorrow, stone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Mo) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Elder Mo) Oh.

quests.title: Stone Tomorrow
quests.summary: Tomorrow is stone: sparring golems that only sword qi can scratch.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sparring golems. Palm strikes bounce. Qi cuts. Don't punch them, you'll break your hand and I'll have to fill in a form.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

objectives.text: Drive the sparring golems from the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sparring golems spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Hold the martial stage against more sparring golems
Talk with Wei Tong at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You cut a golem in half! With your mind! I've been punching them for six years. I feel betrayed by technique.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Feet first, then eyes, then sword. In that order. Every time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Elder Mo said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Nights
quests.summary: Xiao Man comes to you at night. Her brother still wakes up counting bars. She doesn't know what to do.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Man's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He wakes up counting. Every night. One, two, three, up to forty. The cage had forty bars.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Ling Qiu. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I sit with him. It doesn't help. You were in the Abyss. Maybe he'd talk to you.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Forty bars. I know it's silly. I know I'm home. My body doesn't know. My body is still counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mine counted too, after the Abyss. I count breaths instead now. It's the same counting, pointed somewhere better.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Listen to Ling Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: ...Breaths. Four in, four out. Like Han Xue says. I'll try. Stay till I fall asleep? Just tonight.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks you not to tell anyone her brother still counts bars at night.

choices.text: Keep it between the three of you

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Put his name on Elder Hua's list

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Tell him to toughen up

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (muttering, to Xiao Shi) That was cold.

quests.title: Counting Breaths
quests.summary: You sit with Xiao Shi on the stone bridge and count breaths until he stops counting bars.

objectives.text: Count breaths with Xiao Shi on the bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four in, four out. Xiao Shi's shoulders drop by the twentieth breath. By the fortieth he is asleep against the railing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You keep counting. Your core counts with you, steady and gold, and settles a little deeper.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He slept! All night! Without counting! I'm going to make you a pill. It'll probably be a pill.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You've got mud to the knees and a grin to the ears. Wipe off one of them.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Mo. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Iron From the Pines
quests.summary: Elder Mo wants to forge you a practice blade, one that can hold core-qi without shattering. It needs iron from a lightning-struck pine.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Lightning-struck pine. The iron in the sap holds qi. Find me enough and I'll forge you a practice blade. An ugly one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Xiao Man. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Collect iron sap from the lightning-struck pines
Go back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough. It'll be ugly. Ugly blades live longest. So do ugly elders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Wolves Want the Sap
quests.summary: Iron sap draws wolves. They like the taste. So does Wei Tong, apparently.

objectives.text: Search the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pines are full of grey wolves licking the sap. Wei Tong is among them, also licking the sap.

objectives.text: Clear the outer pines of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It tastes like pine and lightning! Don't judge me! Wolves! Wolves are judging me!

objectives.text: Gather what's left of the sap
Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I've learned something about myself today. I don't like it. I'm going to go and lie down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Ugly Blade
quests.summary: Elder Mo forges the practice blade himself, at the formation's edge, at midnight, with a hammer older than the sect.

objectives.text: Head to the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sparks fly at the plaza's edge. Elder Mo works bare-armed, hammering iron sap into a blade by the formation's light.

objectives.text: Quench the blade in the formation's light

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blade drinks the formation's light and cools grey and plain. When you lift it, your core answers it like an old friend.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Ugly. Perfect. My master forged mine the same way. It's in my room. I'm too old for it. Don't argue. Take care of yours.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Answer Yan Tie, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Mo Remembers His Master
quests.summary: Elder Mo is in a talking mood, which happens once a decade. He tells you about his master.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: My master was a terrible teacher. Shouted. Threw things. Made me climb the steps on my hands.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Shi. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Then one day he put his hand on my head and said adequate, and I would have died for him. That's all a teacher is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Mo. Adequate.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: ...Don't. Don't you dare. Hmph. Go to bed. My eyes are tired. It's the smoke.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the stone bridge. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Man. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Man has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the lotus pond.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Xiao Man is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The carp know my name now. They're very polite about it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Sword Qi in Earnest
quests.summary: Blood Moon scouts are caught mapping the sect's walls. Your new blade gets its first real test.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Scouts on the wall, mapping it. Gu wants to know our defences. Let's teach them a few new ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Hua.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators

quests.title: Winter Coming
quests.summary: The first snow falls on the mountain. Elder Bai looks at the sky and says the isles will open soon.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai out

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: First snow. The Patriarch's stars are sinking. The isles will open within the month. I've written to the Sect Master in capitals.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak wants to go to the isles. All of Thunder Peak. I said you'd pick. You'll pick me. You'll pick me, right?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Xiao Shi said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Sect Master will choose soon. Whatever she chooses, you're ready. Adequately ready. More than adequately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Yan Tie. A poor master.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Sap for a Second Blade
quests.summary: Elder Mo, pleased with the first blade, wants enough iron sap gathered for a spare, just in case.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me spirit stones from the laundry stream.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the laundry stream
Report back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. Xiao Man's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Scouts on the Second Wall
quests.summary: More Blood Moon scouts test the sect's defenses from a different angle this time.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the outer dormitories
Compare notes with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Blade's First Nick
quests.summary: The new practice blade takes its first nick in a sparring match, and Elder Mo insists on inspecting it personally.

objectives.text: Make your way to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great pill kilns glow in their yard like sleeping dragons, and the air shimmers with heat.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Show Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A nick already? Good. A blade that's never nicked has never been used properly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Did anything bite you? Sting you? Look at you strangely? Tell me everything.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Second Night
quests.summary: Xiao Shi asks for company again, though this time he makes it through the count on his own.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Twenty-eight breaths. I didn't need you to count with me. I just wanted to know you were there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Are you certain, Xiao Shi? I've seen {them} trip over a doorstep.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Elder Mo. And the time before.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Look at that stance. A strong wind would file a complaint.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Elder Mo. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Elder Bai. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Sword Qi at Rest
quests.summary: Elder Mo insists sword qi needs a resting form too, not just a cutting one, to keep it from wearing down the core.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Mo's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Draw it in as carefully as you throw it out. Otherwise you'll cut yourself hollow from the inside.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Elder Mo knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you, Xiao Shi. Now, where was I.

objectives.text: Circulate your qi at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You circulate qi through the core nine times. On the ninth, it rings like a struck bell.

objectives.text: Bring word to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hm. Wei Tong is not wrong. Wei Tong is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Back straight. I won't say it again. I will say it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Isle Supplies
quests.summary: Thunder Peak, hoping to be chosen for the isles expedition, starts stockpiling supplies well ahead of the decision.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the spirit peach orchard
See Xiao Shi again

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Sap Confession
quests.summary: Wei Tong, having recovered his dignity, admits he'd lick the iron sap again given the chance.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It was really good sap! I stand by my choices! Mostly! Sometimes!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Mo says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Come back with all your fingers. I've grown used to counting ten.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Elder Bai's Capitalized Letter
quests.summary: The Sect Master's reply to Elder Bai's all-capitals letter arrives, considerably calmer than the letter that prompted it.

objectives.text: Scout the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit beast garden smells of hay and ozone. Something in the far pen is chewing on a thunderbolt.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
