dialogue.text: She says 'noted, proceeding as planned' in perfectly normal handwriting. I feel a little foolish. Only a little.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Xiao Shi says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: No precedent for that at all. How exciting.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: The Last Scouts Before Snow
quests.summary: A final probe from Blood Moon scouts comes just as the first heavy snow closes the mountain roads.

objectives.text: Hurry to the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Porters puff up the mountain road with baskets of rice. One of them waves at you, then regrets the effort.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The Blood Moon cultivators have found you first.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the mountain road
Share your findings with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Still in one piece. I wasn't worried. I was sharpening things.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Snow on the Blade
quests.summary: The first real snowfall settles on your new blade where it rests by the window, and your core settles with it.

objectives.text: See what Elder Mo wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sword qi and a quiet mind. That's the whole lesson, in the end. Everything else was just cutting leaves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Wei Tong, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

objectives.text: Consolidate your cultivation at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The core burns hotter. Impurities rise like smoke and are gone.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Message From the Rim
quests.summary: A child in patched black robes climbs the nine thousand steps with a message from Ye Wuming. She has chosen her own name, too.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A little girl in black robes at the gate! She says her name is Spring, she chose it herself, and Ye Wuming sent her.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: She's very serious. She's frightening. I gave her a bun. She saluted the bun.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming waits at the canyon mouth with three children in black. They watch you with old eyes in young faces.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You came. Good. The Blood Moon has begun to dig on the bone field. I don't know what for. I'd like to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Zhao Kang's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Picks on the Bone Field
quests.summary: Blood Guards are digging on the bone field, very carefully, as if the bones might break something they want.

objectives.text: Go to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Guards dig in careful rows among the bones. Crates stand nearby, each stamped with seven small dots.

objectives.text: Search the miners' crates

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder-struck bone, and chips of crystal that hum. Seven dots on every lid, arranged like a ladder.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Seven dots. I've seen the mark before. On the Patriarch's own door, long ago. I never knew what it meant.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I was six. I thought it was stars. Maybe it was.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Breaking the Dig
quests.summary: Whatever they're digging for, they shouldn't have it. Ye Wuming's children watch from the rocks as you break the dig.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Break the dig. My children will watch. They need to see that the Blood Guards can fall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not the time, Yan Tie.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the bone throne

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Blood Guards! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the obsidian spires
Investigate the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The children cheer when the last guard falls, then stop, embarrassed, and cheer again more quietly.

quests.title: Children With Names
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children have chosen their names. They want to tell you, one by one, very formally.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They want to tell you their names. They chose them. Please be... very serious about it. It matters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Worry later, Xiao Shi. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Check the chain anchor at the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring. River. Small Mountain. Each child bows and says the name as if handing you something breakable.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Spring, River, Small Mountain. Thank you for telling me. I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The links of the chain anchor are thick as your arm. One has been filed almost through.

objectives.text: Go back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Nobody ever said their names back to them before. You did it without thinking. That's why I asked you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I still haven't found mine. I will. I'm told these things take time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The children of the rim have names now, but nowhere to live. The sect has no rule for them.

choices.text: Petition the Sect Master to take them in

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Take them down to Qingshi yourself, tonight

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Leave them. They're not your problem.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Crystals in the Pools
quests.summary: The miners hid their finds in the blood pools. The pools are guarded by wolves who drink the stolen blood.

objectives.text: Search the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crates bob in the steaming pools, tied with red rope. Wolves circle them, fat and slow and red-eyed.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Recover the hidden crystals from the pools
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals. Why would the Blood Moon want thunder crystals? They're only good for one thing: calling lightning.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why would anyone down here want to call lightning?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the corrupted wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That makes sense. I think.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Obelisk Stumps
quests.summary: The obelisks you broke have stumps, and someone has been re-carving them. Not with blood runes. With stars.

objectives.text: Head to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The obelisk stumps have been re-carved. Not blood runes: seven stars, over and over, climbing each stump like a ladder.

objectives.text: Collect fragments of the new carvings
Break the re-carved stump

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stump cracks. A thin thread of red light rises from it, straight up, toward where the stars would be if the Abyss had a sky.

objectives.text: Clear the sulphur vents of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The light draws Blood Guards from the camp, running.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: A ladder of stars. They're building something that climbs. Your sect should know. Your old librarian especially.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Last Cage on the Rim
quests.summary: One cage still hangs at the rim, forgotten by everyone except the girl inside it.

objectives.text: Make your way to the bone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Near the rim hangs a single cage, rusted. Inside, a girl in Moon-Well white is singing to herself.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Guards spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Open the forgotten cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock breaks. The girl stops singing. I'm from the Moon-Well Nunnery, she says. Nobody came. I kept singing so I'd know I was here.

objectives.text: Show Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'll take her home. I know what it's like when the door opens. You need someone to walk with you for the first hour.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

quests.title: Letters for the Sect
quests.summary: Ye Wuming asks you to carry everything you found back to the sect. He also asks for something he has never asked for before.

objectives.text: Answer Ye Wuming's summons

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Take the crystals, the carvings, the crates. Your sect will know what they mean better than I.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: And... when the time comes to march on this place, send for me. My children will help. They know every path.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You've never asked for anything before.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've never had anything to protect before. It changes a person. Go. Winter's coming, and so is your sky.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the ash plains

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the Blood Moon shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Ye Wuming said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Pursuit to the Array
quests.summary: The Blood Guards are not letting the crystals go. They chase you all the way to the cracked teleport array.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me to bring you home. He didn't mention the forty Blood Guards. He never mentions the important things.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go. I'll hold the rim with Ye Wuming's children. I've been told they bite. I respect that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang! When do we fight again?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Never, Yan Tie. You shout during duels.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Seven Dots, Explained Badly
quests.summary: Back at the sect, Elder Bai stares at the seven dots for an hour and declares that he has no idea, very loudly.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Seven dots! Arranged like a ladder! Thunder crystals! I have no idea! I have read ten thousand books and I have no idea!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Elder Bai thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Noted, Han Xue. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: But the star charts from the drowned archive. There is a seven-star pattern on the one for the Sky Isles. Red. Unlabelled.

objectives.text: Compare the carvings with the drowned star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The same seven points. On the Verdant Lotus chart, drawn in red, over the highest of the Sky Isles. Someone has written beside it: never again.

objectives.text: Bring word to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Never again. Whatever it was happened before. On the isles. We're going to the isles in a month. Wonderful. Wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Zhao Kang is not wrong. Zhao Kang is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Crystals for the Formation
quests.summary: The recovered thunder crystals need sorting before Elder Bai can work out which are safe for the new formation.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me thunder crystals from the forbidden library.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Collect thunder crystals around the forbidden library
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Han Xue. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the thunder crystals you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Spring's First Question
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's daughter Spring sends a letter of her own this time, with one careful, formal question.

objectives.text: Scout the seal stones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Written in a child's careful brush strokes: does the ladder mean the Patriarch is climbing back? Please answer honestly.

objectives.text: Study the tortoise stele

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tortoise stele has outlived the dynasty that raised it. Its last line has been deliberately chiselled away.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the seal stones. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Very funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Rim, Watched Closer
quests.summary: With the digging exposed, Elder Mo wants the Abyss rim watched more closely than a single patrol allows.

objectives.text: Hurry to the palace of the elders

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Jade screens line the elders' palace, painted with scenes you look away from.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the palace of the elders

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Find the rune fragments at the palace of the elders
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Zhao Kang. You said so. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Zhao Kang and the Biting Children
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, true to his word, spends an afternoon with Ye Wuming's children and comes back oddly fond of them.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They do bite. Also they're terrifyingly good with knives. Also I bought them sweets. Don't tell my clan.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Xiao Shi. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering to Ye Wuming) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Rope for the Cages
quests.summary: Ye Wuming asks for proper rope and tools sent down, in case more forgotten cages turn up on future patrols.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the deep mine shaft. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Shi. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the deep mine shaft
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Moon-Well Girl's Recovery
quests.summary: The rescued Moon-Well disciple needs help settling her qi before Xiao Shi can safely walk her home.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Breathe like I taught you. Four in, four out. I promise it gets easier to believe you're really out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

objectives.text: Meditate at the cave of echoes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core spins, bright and steady, and every turn draws the world a little closer.

objectives.text: Go back to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Xiao Shi does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Han Xue. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm! Sensible! Loudly sensible!

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

quests.title: The Never Again Note
quests.summary: Elder Bai obsesses over the drowned star chart's handwritten warning, trying to identify whose hand wrote it.

objectives.text: Go to the poison garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The poison garden hums with fat flies. Every leaf here has killed somebody.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Not Verdant Lotus script. Older. Whoever wrote 'never again' wasn't one of Lan Jue's teachers. Someone even earlier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Answer Ye Wuming, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Thanks, Unspoken
quests.summary: Ye Wuming doesn't say thank you before you leave the rim again, but he stands and watches until you're out of sight.

objectives.text: Investigate the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He doesn't wave. He never waves. But he stays at the canyon mouth long after you've started up the path, and that is its own kind of thank you.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the watch spire isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Han Xue is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Zhao Kang) That was cold.

quests.title: Provisions for the Watch
quests.summary: The rim patrol needs proper winter provisions now that the watch has become permanent rather than occasional.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the beast pens. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the beast pens
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Ye Wuming. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: What the Rim Confirmed
quests.summary: Between the ladder of stars, the children's names and the warning three sects deep in history, your core has grown grimly certain of what's coming.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Whatever's climbing, we'll be ready. We've been getting ready since the tournament. Since before that, really.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

objectives.text: Refine your cultivation at the cave of echoes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You circulate qi through the core nine times. On the ninth, it rings like a struck bell.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Stair Made of Cloud
quests.summary: At dawn a stair of cloud unrolls from the sky above the cliff edge. The whole sect comes out in its nightclothes to stare.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: There's a staircase in the sky! Made of cloud! Everyone's out in their pyjamas! Elder Bai's are covered in turtles!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Do as Lu Ping says. For once, someone is making sense.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: See? Even Elder Mo agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Search the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A stair of white cloud descends from the sky, step by step, stopping just above the sea of clouds. It is not solid yet.

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The isles are opening! In a week the stair will hold weight. In a week! I haven't finished the design!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Fan Rui?

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (beaming at Elder Bai) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

quests.title: The Archive Copy
quests.summary: Elder Bai must finish the Great Azure Formation's design from the only complete copy left: the Law Hall's archive.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The master diagram is gone with Gu. The Law Hall kept an archive copy, sealed and certified. It's all we have.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Head to the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Law Hall archive is a locked room of sealed boxes, each stamped with Gu Hanshan's seal. The dust on them is thick.

objectives.text: Unseal the Law Hall's archive copy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The diagram is complete, certified, beautiful. Ten thousand runes. You couldn't tell a single one was wrong. Nobody could.

objectives.text: See Elder Bai again

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Complete. Certified. I'll need a week to rebuild the formation from it, and a month of Elder Mo's life to build it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: No precedent for that at all. How exciting.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

quests.title: What the Formation Needs
quests.summary: The design is done. The list of materials is short and impossible: star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feathers.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Mo out

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feathers. None of them grow on this mountain. All of them grow up there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Ling Qiu. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Meanwhile, the frame. Spirit stones. Lots of them. Steward Qian has already fainted once.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones for the formation frame
Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Two hundred spirit stones! For a frame! A frame! I'm going to faint again. Catch me this time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Elder Hua. The immortal always is. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Who Goes Up
quests.summary: The Sect Master chooses three for the isles. Everyone pretends they don't want to be chosen. Everyone wants to be chosen.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The isles allow few. Three will go. You. Han Xue. And Zhao Kang, who has asked me eleven times, in writing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Bai. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Eleven times. With a seal. I'm not ashamed. I'm going to the isles. Try not to fall off anything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Hua.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak was not chosen. Thunder Peak will shout from the bottom of the stair. Very loudly. You'll hear us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Yan Tie. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: HA! Thunder Peak would do exactly that!

quests.title: Cloud Silk for the Climb
quests.summary: Elder Hua insists everyone who climbs wears cloud silk sashes, so the wind knows you're guests.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Cloud silk sashes. The wind on the isles is rude to strangers. It's polite to guests. This makes you guests.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Elder, the third kiln sneezed again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then feed it less charcoal and more patience, Hongyu.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

objectives.text: Collect cloud silk from the drying racks
Return to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Three sashes, one extra. For whoever falls first. It'll be Zhao Kang. Don't tell him I said that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: The third kiln sneezed again. I lost an eyebrow. It'll grow back. Last time it did.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Kiln-Mistress Tao. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Visitors Before the Stair
quests.summary: The stair has attracted more than sightseers. Blood Moon scouts try to climb it first.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Moon on the stair! They want to reach the isles before us. Why does everyone always want the same things we want?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Moon cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping
Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They wanted the isles. Crystals, dots, ladders. We'll find out why up there. I'm tired of finding out after.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: One Blood Moon scout survived the fall from the stair. He offers what he knows for his life.

choices.text: Heal him and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Bring him to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Push him off again

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging Han Xue's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Dumplings for the Sky
quests.summary: The whole sect sends you off with gifts. Most of them are edible. One of them is a hat.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumplings for the sky. Wrapped in cloud silk, which Elder Hua says is a waste of cloud silk. She's wrong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan would have sent a servant for this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan's servants would have eaten my lunch.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Man at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Medicine. Also a hat. For the wind. My brother says the hat's ridiculous. He's wearing one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Ling Qiu.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It's a very good hat. Bring it back. Bring yourself back under it.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping at the ancestral tombs

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I've made a betting book on how many days you'll be gone. The Iron Scale are betting too. So is the Zhao ancestor. By letter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Sect Master. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

quests.title: Last-Minute Supplies
quests.summary: Steward Qian, having fainted twice over spirit stones, insists on personally checking the expedition's final supply list.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Zhong Ming has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Adequate. Don't look so pleased.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the spirit peach orchard
Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhong Ming?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Back, and breathing evenly. That's all a healer asks for, and so rarely gets.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eat something. You look like a boiled noodle with ambitions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: The Formation's First Rune
quests.summary: Elder Mo lays the very first rune of the rebuilt Great Azure Formation before you even leave, so you can see the beginning.

objectives.text: Make your way to the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the mission hall is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: First rune. Ten thousand to go. I'll have the rest laid by the time you're back with the materials. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: One More Scout
quests.summary: A final Blood Moon scout is spotted near the cliff edge, watching the stair with open curiosity.

objectives.text: Scout the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the cliff edge, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: More Blood Moon cultivators? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the outer dormitories
Show Elder Hua what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Old Bao says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Elder Hua, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Elder Hua) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Hua, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Packing List
quests.summary: Zhao Kang has packed for the isles as if for a formal state visit, and refuses to leave anything behind.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A clan disciple represents his clan even at altitude. Yes, I need three changes of robe. Don't argue with tradition.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the weapon rack. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wei Tong has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the contribution pavilion.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Sign here. And here. And here. No, the other here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Silk for the Spares
quests.summary: Elder Hua wants a spare set of cloud silk sashes packed, on the grounds that someone always loses something.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Man out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me cloud silk from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Ignore Yan Tie. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Find the cloud silk at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Bring word to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Did you spend anything? Lose anything? Borrow anything from anyone who writes things down?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Steward Qian. Steward Qian won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Do you want a pill? I made it. It's probably a pill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the cloud silk you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Breathing Before the Sky
quests.summary: Han Xue leads one last group meditation at the cliff edge before anyone sets foot on the stair.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Whatever's up there, we go up steady, not eager. Eager people fall off staircases.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The core burns hotter. Impurities rise like smoke and are gone.

objectives.text: See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Han Xue will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. A careful choice.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Goodbye Dumpling
quests.summary: Wei Tong, unable to go himself, presses one more dumpling into your hand at the very last moment.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: This one's not for the road. This one's just because I'll miss you. Eat it now. In front of me. I need to see it happen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Elder Bai. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the shelves. They're older than your grandmother and less forgiving.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: The Betting Book Closes
quests.summary: Lu Ping closes his betting book on the expedition's length just before the stair solidifies, with characteristic ceremony.

objectives.text: Hurry to the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the cave behind the waterfall not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Refill the spirit lamp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The flame of the spirit lamp leans toward you as if it knew your name, then steadies, clean and white.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Final odds locked! I've bet on 'exactly right on time,' which is either very clever or very stupid. We'll find out together!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha. Fan Rui's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Last Frame Stones
quests.summary: Steward Qian's two hundred spirit stones for the formation frame need one final count before the climb.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhong Ming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Return to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Fair! Fair and loud!

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Charm
quests.summary: Xiao Man presses a small carved charm into your hand, awkwardly, insisting it isn't medicine so Elder Hua won't confiscate it.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: It's not medicine! It's just a charm! Elder Hua can't take it! ...Please don't lose it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Lu Ping. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
