dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Xiao Man.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Shi. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging Lu Ping's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Core at the Peak
quests.summary: The night before the climb, Elder Mo sits with you at the cliff edge beneath the stair of cloud.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sit. Your core's full. Too full. It'll crack soon, into something new. Probably on the isles. They're good at cracking people.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Bai. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Cultivate beneath the stair of cloud

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core burns at its peak, so bright it almost hums. Above you the stair of cloud solidifies, step by step, in the moonlight.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Great Perfection of Core Formation. Adequate. I've said that word more to you than to anyone. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bring me star iron. I'll build the formation while you're gone. I'll check every rune. Twice. Go.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) That makes sense. I think.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Last Word
quests.summary: Before the climb, the Sect Master says the thing she always says, and one thing she never has.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Look at the sky while you're up there. It's good for the soul. I never have time.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what the Sect Master says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And... you were an orphan who climbed nine thousand steps with a letter and a pendant. Now you climb into the sky. I'm proud of you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you've never said that.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sect masters don't. Tell no one. Go.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Bai. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

quests.title: The Stair Holds
quests.summary: At dawn the stair of cloud holds weight. Three disciples stand at its foot with dumplings, silk and a hat.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair of cloud is solid under your foot. Cold, and faintly springy, like fresh snow. It climbs out of sight.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That's a staircase to the sky. Zhao Kang is already complaining about the lack of railing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we did this uphill. Both ways. In the snow. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Elder Mo. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let's go. Before the Sect Master says anything else nice and we all start crying at the bottom of a staircase.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Stairway of Clouds
quests.summary: The Sky Isles have opened. The Sect Master sends you, Han Xue and Zhao Kang to gather materials for the Great Azure Formation.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's orders

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Bai has rebuilt the formation design from the Law Hall archive copy. Elder Mo will build it. You will supply it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Five star iron, five thunder crystals, three phoenix feathers. The isles close again at the next full moon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take Han Xue and Zhao Kang. And {player}? Look at the sky while you're up there. It's good for the soul.

objectives.text: Ascend to the Celestial Sky Isles
Meet the star-gazer at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Visitors. Sixty years, and they still come puffing up the stairs like it's a surprise.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I am Qing Luan. I was a sage of these isles, once. Now I'm mostly a very persistent memory.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The isles test those who cross. Your heart must be clear, your sword sharp, and your shoes sturdy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Two out of three is usually fine. Go on, lotus child. I'll be in my pavilion, watching.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A persistent memory? Is she a ghost? {player}, is she a ghost? Nobody said ghosts.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bow to the sage, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sage. We'll keep our shoes sturdy.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars disagree. The stars often disagree. I side with you.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Jade Bridge
quests.summary: Cross the long jade bridge to the second isle. The winds are strong, and you are not alone.

objectives.text: Cross the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's very high. Isn't it very high? Why is there no railing? Who builds a bridge with no railing?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Immortals who can fly, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well, that's elitist.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep walking, Zhao Kang. And don't look down.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon pursuers on the bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Moon! They followed us through the array. Gu must have told them where we were going.

objectives.text: Catch your breath with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why follow us here? What do demons want with the materials for a sealing formation?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: To stop us building it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then why did they only watch us, and not attack until we reached the bridge? Something is wrong. I don't know what yet.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Isle of Winds
quests.summary: The wind-swept isle is thick with cloud silk, and thick with sword intent for those who can listen.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk from the wind-swept pines
Listen to the wind

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wind has no shape, and so nothing can break it. It bends around every obstacle and arrives anyway.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang among the pines

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've been thinking. It happens occasionally. I've been an insufferable brat to you for two years.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My brother would have liked you. He always said pride is a wall you build to keep yourself small.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: So. I'm sorry. There. Never tell anyone. I'll deny it with my last breath.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Apology accepted, Zhao Kang. Friend.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I heard all of that, Zhao Kang. I'm telling no one. I'm writing it down.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Star-Gazer's Riddle
quests.summary: Qing Luan will point you to the star iron, if you can answer her riddle. And read her chart. And listen to her complain.

objectives.text: Visit Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A riddle! I've waited sixty years to ask someone. What climbs higher the more you take away?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: A hole? No... a debt? Wait. A cultivator. The more attachments we let go, the higher we rise.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Wrong, but I like your answer better than mine. It was a staircase with the bottom steps removed. Read my chart.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A staircase? That's not a riddle. That's carpentry.

objectives.text: Study the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Constellations drift across the jade. The star iron fell with the palace. The thunder grows where the vein runs.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the chart's corner, a seven-star pattern glows red. It is labelled: the Patriarch's Ladder.

objectives.text: Ask Qing Luan about the red stars

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Three hundred years ago a man called Xue Wuji came here. Very charming. He wanted the Ascension Stair.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He meant to ride the heavenly tribulation into the heavens and take them. Your founders stopped him, barely.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The star iron lies in the fallen palace. Watch out for the guardians. They're rude.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Star Iron of the Fallen Palace
quests.summary: The celestial palace fell ten thousand years ago. Its guardians did not get the message.

objectives.text: Reach the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Broken columns tower into the clouds. Among them lie lumps of dark metal, still faintly warm from falling out of the sky.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed
Turn stones and straggler over to the sect
Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

objectives.text: Defeat the palace guardians
Gather the star iron
Read the palace inscription

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Whoever climbs the stair must carry nothing that is not theirs. Not a stolen body. Not a stolen name. Not a stolen heaven.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stolen body? What kind of warning is that?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A warning for thieves. The Blood Moon would ignore it on principle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Or for someone who means to steal a body. Remember it.

quests.title: The Spirit Vein
quests.summary: Thunder crystals grow where the spirit vein breaks the surface. Someone else is already mining them.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon miners from the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Guards, with picks and sacks. They're mining thunder crystals!

objectives.text: Gather thunder crystals
Examine the miners' cache

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crates of thunder crystals, carefully packed, each stamped with the same seven-star mark as the red stars.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals are only good for one thing: channelling heavenly lightning into a formation.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Our formation needs them too. Why would the Blood Moon build the same thing we're building?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Same stamp as the red stars. I don't like coincidences. They're never coincidences.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Garden of Immortals
quests.summary: Phoenix feathers fall in the overgrown garden, where the Jiao serpent hunts.

objectives.text: Enter the overgrown garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blossom trees taller than pagodas. Petals fall like warm snow. High in the branches, something golden rustles its wings.

objectives.text: Gather phoenix feathers in the immortal garden
Heed Qing Luan in the garden

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You have the feathers. Good. Now you have a problem. The Jiao smelled them. It smells everything.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It was a noble beast, guardian of these isles for a thousand years. Then the Blood Moon fed it their blood.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It is suffering. It will kill you because it is suffering. Please free it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Free it, not kill it. That's harder, Sage.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we do the harder thing.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the phoenix feathers you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: The Jiao's Lair
quests.summary: The corrupted flood dragon will not let you leave the isles alive. Face it in its lair.

objectives.text: Enter the serpent's lair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isle shudders. Scales the colour of storm clouds slide past, and a head the size of a house rises over the edge.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Nobody told me the serpent was THAT big.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone told you, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Stay behind me, both of you. It's hurting, not hunting.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted Jiao serpent

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Its heart is still in there, lotus child. Strike the blood from it, not the life!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you. Hold on, great one. I'll set you free.

objectives.text: Tend to your wounds with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It looked at you before it sank into the clouds. Not like a beast. Like someone saying thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're shaking. Sit. That's an order from your senior sister, and I rarely give them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You give them constantly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I rarely give them nicely.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Stars Disagree
quests.summary: The Jiao left something behind in its lair, and Qing Luan has something to show you before you go.

objectives.text: Search the Jiao's hoard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among bones and coins lies a heart of star iron the size of a fist, humming with stored lightning.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Its weight settles into your hands like it has been waiting for you.

objectives.text: Prepare to leave with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feather, and a dragon heart. We're rich. We're heroes. We're rich heroes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come on. Wei Tong promised a banquet. I'm told he's been practising dumplings for a month.

objectives.text: Say farewell to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Show me the design your sect intends to build. Hm. Hmm. The stars disagree with it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Here, where it should turn inward, it turns outward. As if it were meant to open rather than close.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Like a door instead of a lock. {player}, that archive belonged to the Law Hall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was rebuilt from the sect's Law Hall archive.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Then ask who kept the archive. Go carefully, lotus child. Heaven is watching you now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: One More Load of Star Iron
quests.summary: The formation's frame will need more star iron than first estimated. Elder Bai's second letter says so, apologetically.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me star iron from the dragon bones. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

objectives.text: Gather star iron at the dragon bones
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: May I record it? Every life is a line in a book. Yours is getting rather long.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Scribe Shu. Scribe Shu won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: The star iron came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Who Kept the Archive
quests.summary: Qing Luan's parting question won't leave Han Xue alone: who kept the Law Hall archive copy all these years?

objectives.text: Go to the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rune pillars stand on the storm plateau, drinking the lightning that crawls up from below.

objectives.text: Trace the rune pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune pillar is cracked along one rune. Whoever did it knew exactly where to strike.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu kept it. Thirty years. Plenty of time to change one line and reseal the box.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Guardians Still Angry
quests.summary: A few of the fallen palace's stone guardians remain active, confused by visitors after ten thousand years of solitude.

objectives.text: Look behind the jade screen at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the carving of the jade screen. One panel has been replaced, and the new jade is a shade too green.

objectives.text: Clear the palace court of stone golems

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Pick up thunder crystals near the palace court
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Qingyi. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Sky Habit
quests.summary: Zhao Kang has taken to actually looking at the sky, as the Sect Master suggested, and finds he rather likes it.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone. But she was right. It is good for something. I don't know what yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Qing Luan. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the temple of the four winds

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes circled the wrong way this morning. They know weather before heaven does.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the mirror lake

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Qing Luan.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Thunder Crystals, the Honest Way
quests.summary: With the Blood Moon miners driven off, the spirit vein can be mined properly, without anyone dying for it.

objectives.text: Go and see Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me thunder crystals from the crystal isle, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: Walk slowly on the isles. Haste offends the cranes, and the cranes carry grudges for centuries.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Warden He has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It's restful, mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

objectives.text: Collect thunder crystals around the crystal isle
Bring word to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes bowed to you. They bowed to the last immortal once, then took it back.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars do not lie. They merely exaggerate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more thunder crystals than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

reply.speaker: warden_he
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Miners' Reinforcements
quests.summary: A second wave of Blood Moon miners arrives, unaware their first attempt already failed.

objectives.text: Investigate the floating forest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Trees float above their isle, roots dangling in the air like the beards of old men.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Find the thunder crystals at the floating forest
Compare notes with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit. Look up. Try not to fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Qing Luan) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Ladder in the Chart
quests.summary: Qing Luan's star chart marked a seven-star pattern as 'the Patriarch's Ladder.' Han Xue wants to know what climbs it.

objectives.text: Search the Southern Gate of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Southern Gate of Heaven stands closed, as it has for an age. Its guardians have moss on their shoulders.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A ladder needs someone to climb it. Or something. I don't like either answer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Zhao Kang. Zhao Kang won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Qing Luan's Loneliness
quests.summary: Before you go, Qing Luan admits, in her roundabout way, that visitors are the only thing that makes sixty years bearable.

objectives.text: Answer Qing Luan's summons

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A memory doesn't get lonely, they say. They're wrong. Come back next time. I'll have new complaints ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Qing Luan thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Han Xue. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the Tree of Ages

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the peach garden

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (hiding behind Han Xue) Oh.

quests.title: Cloud Silk, One Last Bundle
quests.summary: Elder Hua's request for cloud silk turns out to have been an underestimate. One more bundle won't hurt.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.text: Recover cloud silk from the cloud harbour
See Qing Luan again

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Han Xue says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the cloud silk you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Breathing at the Cloud Gate
quests.summary: Before attempting the breakthrough, Han Xue insists on one last careful meditation at the cloud gate.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul isn't a fight you win. It's a door you open carefully. Sit. Get it right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhao Kang. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Cultivate at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tiny figure of light in your chest breathes when you breathe. It is getting stronger.

objectives.text: Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

quests.title: Nascent Soul
quests.summary: The winds of the isles have tempered you. At the cloud gate, give birth to your nascent soul, then bring the materials home.

objectives.text: Form your nascent soul at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core cracks, and from it unfolds a tiny figure of light, cross-legged, with your face and a lotus in its hands.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It opens its eyes. For the first time, you see the world twice: with your eyes, and with your soul.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul. Even the clouds look different. They look like they're breathing.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Nascent Soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The clouds split into a slow spiral. The first beasts of lightning drop out of it, eyes crackling.

objectives.text: Deliver the materials to Elder Mo at the formation array

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Star iron. Thunder crystal. Phoenix feathers. And a dragon's heart, you show-off. The formation will be finished in a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder, the star-gazer said the design is wrong. That it opens instead of closing. It was taken from the Law Hall archive.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bai checked it against the archive copy, sealed and certified. The Law Hall... hm. Gu kept that archive for thirty years.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Certified by me. But I only checked the copy against itself, Mo. A forger's favourite kind of scholar.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Leave it with me. I'll check every rune myself. Go, see the Sect Master. You've earned your cake.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A nascent soul at your age. The elders are furious with envy. It's wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo told me about the design. He is checking it himself. If anyone can find a hidden flaw, it is him.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest, {player}. For the first time in months, I think the sect can breathe.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That is the sect I want. Thank you for being it.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Crane From the Clouds
quests.summary: A paper crane made of cloud lands on your windowsill and dissolves into Qing Luan's voice.

objectives.text: See what Elder Mo wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A crane made of cloud flew into my tea. It said your name and then it was rain. I'm choosing to be calm about this.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The star-gazer wants you. Nascent souls can walk the cloud road, apparently. Go. The pillars can wait a week.

objectives.text: Test the chain anchor at the chain isles

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road holds under a soul's weight, if not a body's. The isles are silent and closed, and utterly beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You test the chain anchor. It holds, groaning, and rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You came! Through a closed gate, on a road made of your own soul. Sixty years, and you're my first repeat visitor.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit down. You have a soul now. Nobody ever teaches people what to do with it. I'm going to.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Seeing With the Soul
quests.summary: Qing Luan's first lesson: close your eyes and look anyway.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Close your eyes. Now look. Not with those. With the little one inside, with your face and the lotus.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Zhao Kang. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Qing Luan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: See the isle with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind your eyelids the isle glows: every pine a green flame, every crystal a blue one. And far off, beneath the clouds, a red smear.

objectives.text: Go back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The red smear is the Abyss. You'll always see it now. Sorry. Soul sight doesn't have a way to not look.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Qing Luan) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Stepping With the Soul
quests.summary: The second lesson: let the soul step where the body can't, and the body will follow.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Soul step. Your soul goes first, one pace, and your body follows before it notices. Try it on my sentinels. They're very forgiving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Soul-step through the palace sentinels

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They're not forgiving at all. I lied. Step faster!

objectives.text: Report back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You're a pace ahead of yourself now. Everyone will think you're very quick. You're just early.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Zhao Kang is not wrong. Zhao Kang is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Seven Red Stars
quests.summary: Qing Luan brings out her star chart again. The seven red stars have moved, and she doesn't like where.

objectives.text: Head to the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the jade floor of the pavilion, the seven red stars have shifted since you last saw them. Lower. Closer to the Abyss.

objectives.text: Study the moving red stars

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Each red star is tied to a point on the earth below by a thread only soul sight can see. Seven threads. Seven places.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Patriarch's Ladder. Last time, he had seven servants, each holding one star. Rungs, they called themselves.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The rungs are held again. Seven someones, somewhere. Each one a step toward the sky for a soul that shouldn't climb.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Storm Wolves on the Vein
quests.summary: Storm wolves have found the spirit vein, drawn by the crystals the Blood Moon left behind.

objectives.text: Make your way to the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves with lightning in their fur prowl the spirit vein, licking the crystals until sparks run down their jaws.

objectives.text: Break the storm wolves at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The storm wolves come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather the crystals the wolves were guarding
Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Storm wolves. They used to be ordinary. The Blood Moon's crystals changed them. Everything they touch changes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Soul Knows Its Friends
quests.summary: Han Xue and Zhao Kang have followed you up the cloud road. With nascent souls you can see them for the first time.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Mo said you'd gone up alone. So we came. Obviously. Stop staring at me like that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your soul is a sword, Senior Sister. A very small, very straight sword.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's the nicest thing anyone's ever said to me. Don't say it again.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What's mine? No. Don't tell me. It's a peacock, isn't it. It's a peacock.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a lantern, Zhao Kang. A gold one. With a crack in it that lets the light out.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Zhao Kang says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: See? Even Han Xue agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...I need a moment. On the other side of this pine. Alone.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Pursuers on the Cloud Road
quests.summary: Blood Guards who couldn't take the cloud road took the jade bridge instead, the long way. They are very tired and very angry.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Guards on the bridge. They came the long way round. They look exhausted. Good.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The isles have been restless. Even the rice leans away from the wind now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Qingyi. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Hold the dragon bones against more Blood Guards
Meet Qing Luan at the Immortal Palace gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They're following your soul now, not your footprints. You shine, lotus child. Everyone can see you coming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: A Blood Guard slips from the jade bridge and clings to the edge by his fingertips.

choices.text: Pull him up

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Pull him up in chains, for questioning

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Step on his fingers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: The Soul Crystal
quests.summary: Qing Luan has one more thing: a crystal in the ruins that holds a soul's first memory. She wants you to see hers.

objectives.text: Scout the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the ruins, a crystal the height of a man stands in a ring of broken columns, lit from within.

objectives.text: Gather the fallen crystal shards
Touch the soul crystal

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A girl on these isles, ten thousand years ago, watching a man in red climb the Ascension Stair. Watching seven stars go red behind him.

objectives.text: Defeat the celestial sentinels at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystal's guardians wake, offended that anyone saw.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the chain isles

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That was me. That was him. That was the first time. He fell. Your founders pushed. He'll try again.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhao Kang. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Qing Luan) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Back Down the Cloud Road
quests.summary: Qing Luan walks you to the cloud gate. She says she'll watch the red stars. She says to watch the earth.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I'll watch the stars. You watch the earth. Find the seven. Each one you break, the ladder loses a rung.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Feet first, then eyes, then sword. In that order. Every time.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Elder Mo has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And lotus child? Take care of that formation of yours. The stars still disagree with it.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo at the golden lotus lake

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You're back! Your body's been sitting in the pavilion for three days. Wei Tong fed it soup. It ate the soup.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Rungs. Ladders. Stars. Fine. Help me with the pillars and tell me about it while we lift.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Mo Checks a Rune
quests.summary: Elder Mo has started checking the formation's runes one by one, as he promised, before a single pillar goes up.

objectives.text: Hurry to the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sits cross-legged on the plaza with the archive copy spread before him, running a finger down ten thousand runes.

objectives.text: Help Elder Mo check the first ring of runes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rune after rune after rune. All correct. All certified. Your eyes water long before his do.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Four hundred checked. All correct. Nine thousand six hundred to go. The star-gazer said the stars disagree. So I check.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go to bed. I'll do the next four hundred. My eyes are older, but they're more stubborn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Elder Mo) That was cold.

quests.title: Ink for the Checking
quests.summary: Checking ten thousand runes by hand burns through marking ink faster than anyone budgeted for.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me spirit stones from the crystal isle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Han Xue is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the crystal isle
Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Sentinels Loosed by the Checking
quests.summary: Disturbing the formation's runes wakes a few dormant celestial sentinels that guarded the old design.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

objectives.text: Drive the celestial sentinels from the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Celestial sentinels ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Pick up thunder crystals near the celestial ruins
Compare notes with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The star pavilion is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: The Second Ring of Runes
quests.summary: Elder Mo moves to the formation's second ring, slower now, more careful after Qing Luan's warning.

objectives.text: Go to the elixir spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spring of the elixir of life bubbles softly, and the moss around it is greener than green.

objectives.text: Drink from the spirit fountain

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit fountain bubbles clear and cold. Your qi steadies the moment the water touches your hands.

objectives.text: Show Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Second ring. Slower this time. If the star-gazer's right, the flaw won't announce itself. It'll hide in plain sight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Lantern Soul
quests.summary: Zhao Kang keeps bringing up his soul being a cracked lantern, unable to decide if he's offended or delighted.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A lantern with a crack that lets the light out. I've decided that's poetic. I've decided I like it. Don't ruin this for me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the lantern isle

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the lantern isle. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Elder Mo is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the mirror lake.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Qing Luan thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You've got mud to the knees and a grin to the ears. Wipe off one of them.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Crystals for the Cloud Road
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks for a small tribute of thunder crystals left at the cloud gate, for reasons she won't fully explain.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me thunder crystals from the thunder isle. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Collect thunder crystals around the thunder isle
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more thunder crystals than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Soul Sight, Practiced
quests.summary: Han Xue wants to practice soul sight together, on the theory that two souls looking are safer than one.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If we both see the red thread, we can be sure it's real and not just nerves. Sit with me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Qing Luan. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You let your soul drift a hand's breadth from your body, then gently call it home.

objectives.text: Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, Once More
quests.summary: A second pack of storm wolves has drifted toward the spirit vein, drawn by the crystals' lingering charge.

objectives.text: Investigate the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The plateau floats above a sea of storm clouds that flash and grumble beneath your feet.

objectives.text: Clear the storm plateau of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Storm wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Find the thunder crystals at the storm plateau
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: What the Crystal Showed
quests.summary: The soul crystal's memory of the Patriarch's first ascent lingers. Elder Bai wants every detail written down while it's fresh.

objectives.text: Search the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit servants tend the jade rice terraces, their sleeves rolled, their feet never quite touching the water.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ten thousand years, and a memory that clear. Write everything. Heaven's watching, but so is the Scripture Pagoda.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.
