objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Qing Luan's Second Crane
quests.summary: A second paper crane arrives with an addendum to Qing Luan's lesson: the seven threads move faster when watched too closely.

objectives.text: Examine the crane statue at the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crane's message, in Qing Luan's dry hand: don't stare at the stars so hard you forget to watch the ground.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Cranes circle the crane statue and settle on it one by one, as if it were their elder.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the waterfall isle

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Are you certain, Zhao Kang? I've seen {them} trip over a doorstep.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Elder Mo. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the hermit's isle

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we trained in the snow. Uphill. With buckets.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Pillar Ink, Delivered
quests.summary: The star-iron ink for the pillars needs carrying up from the pagoda before the inscribing can properly begin.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me spirit stones from the crystal isle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Qing Luan. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the crystal isle
Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Qing Luan. Qing Luan won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The First Pillar-Stone
quests.summary: Elder Mo needs nine pillar-stones cut from the mountain's heart. He wants the first one today.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Mo's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nine pillars. Each one cut from the mountain's heart, below the herb terraces. Then each one inscribed by a nascent soul. That's you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The mountain's heart is guarded by old stone. It'll want to know why we're cutting it. Tell it the truth.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below the terraces the mountain opens into a cave of grey-blue stone that hums when you breathe near it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm carrying the stones. Elder Mo said I'm the strongest back on the mountain. I've never been so proud of my back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Two leaves and a bud, disciple. Take only what you need, whatever you're picking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Auntie Ruo said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Wei Tong) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

quests.title: The Mountain's Old Stone
quests.summary: The mountain's heart has guardians older than the sect. They do not like the sound of chisels.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The heart's guardians. Older than the sect. Don't break them. Convince them. Firmly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Noted, Steward Qian. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

objectives.text: Fight off the stone golems

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of stone golems
Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Convinced. The mountain's letting us cut. It remembers the founder. It remembers the Verdant Lotus too. It liked them better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Elder Mo's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Stone by Stone
quests.summary: Nine pillar-stones, each the size of a cart. Wei Tong carries two at once to prove a point.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (guarded) {player}. People are saying things. I'm not asking. Yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nine stones! I'll carry two at a time! Watch! No, don't watch! Watch later!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

objectives.text: Mark the pillar-stones for cutting
Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nine stones on the plaza! My back has never been happier. My back is going to hate me tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Oh thank heavens. I was so nervous I watered the lanterns twice.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Wei Tong's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Treasury Weeps
quests.summary: Steward Qian has seen the bill for nine pillars' worth of inscribing ink. He has locked himself in the treasury.

objectives.text: See what Lu Ping wants

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steward Qian has locked himself in the treasury. He says he's not coming out until the formation's cheaper. It won't get cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't break anything that belongs to the sect. I will know. I always know.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Steward Qian. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Join Steward Qian at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Star-iron ink! Ground phoenix feather! Do you know what that costs? It costs everything! Everything I've ever saved!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It keeps the mountain safe for ten thousand years, Steward.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Look at that stance. A strong wind would file a complaint.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: ...Ten thousand years. That's... that's actually very good value. Fine. I'm coming out. Nobody look at my eyes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Inscribing With the Soul
quests.summary: Each pillar must be inscribed by a nascent soul. Yours steps out of your body, a hand's breadth, and writes.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Mo out

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Your soul holds the brush. Your body holds the soul. Don't let go of either. If the soul wanders, the rune wanders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

objectives.text: Inscribe the first pillar with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul leans out of your chest like someone leaning out of a window, and writes in light on the stone. It takes all day.

objectives.text: See Elder Mo again

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: One pillar. Eight to go. You look like a boiled noodle again. It's a good look on you. It means you worked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: A Merchant's Donation
quests.summary: A cart arrives at the gate from Qingshi: star-iron ink, bought at cost, from a merchant who wants no thanks.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A cart from Qingshi! Ink, lots of ink! There's a note. It says 'at cost'. There's a second note. It says 'no thanks needed'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Open Merchant Jin's crates

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Twelve jars of star-iron ink, packed in straw. At the bottom, a third note: For the town I nearly sold. Jin Baoshan.

objectives.text: Tell Merchant Jin what you found

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I came with the cart, to make sure. Not for thanks. For... the feeling. I've started liking the feeling. It's dreadful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Lu Ping.

objectives.choice_prompt: Jin asks, very quietly, whether the sect could forget his old part in the night carts.

choices.text: Forgive him. He's paid.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (beaming at Merchant Jin) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: The Law Hall remembers everything

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Name a price for forgetting

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Night Raid on the Pillars
quests.summary: Someone tries to smash the first pillar in the night. Whoever it is knows exactly where it stands.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone went for the first pillar. With a hammer. They knew exactly which one was finished.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Come back with all your fingers. I've grown used to counting ten.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Mo. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Ward the finished pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward flares blue over the pillar just as shapes drop from the plaza wall.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the inner sect gate
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Moon again. On our mountain, again. How are they still getting in?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Later. Over tea. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone's leaving a door open. I'm going to find out who, and close them.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Open Door
quests.summary: Xiao Shi remembers something: in the Abyss, the guards talked about a way into the sect that didn't need the gate.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: In the cages, the guards used to laugh about 'the back door of heaven'. A way into the sect. I thought it was a joke.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Lu Ping. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Do as Xiao Shi says. For once, someone is making sense.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Below the cliff edge, they said. Where the clouds are thickest.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Below the cliff. There's an old path down there, from before the sect had walls. Nobody uses it. Nobody watches it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Xiao Shi agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. Somebody uses it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Back Door of Heaven
quests.summary: Below the cliff edge, an old path winds down into the clouds. It has been swept recently.

objectives.text: Head to the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the cliff, hidden by cloud, a path of old steps winds down the mountain. The moss on them has been scraped away by feet.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the path's foot, where it meets the outer pines, masked figures are waiting for their next climb.

objectives.text: Make your way to the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the bottom, the path ends at a rusted gate in the outer wall. The lock is new. Very new.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak will guard the back door. All of Thunder Peak. Nobody gets past us. We're very loud and very awake.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Did you see any rare herbs? Any at all? Even ugly ones? Especially ugly ones?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

quests.title: Eight More Pillars
quests.summary: With the back door shut, the work goes faster. Elder Mo checks runes by night and builds by day, and doesn't sleep.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eight pillars to go. I check runes at night, I build by day. Sleep is a habit. I've broken worse habits.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Elder Mo does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Han Xue. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Four thousand runes checked. All correct. All certified. I'm beginning to think the star-gazer is wrong. I'll keep checking.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Man has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Mo hasn't slept in four days. I left soup outside his door. He ate the soup and left a note. 'Adequate soup.'

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Xiao Man is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I'm framing the note.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Xiao Man's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Second Pillar-Stone
quests.summary: With the mountain's guardians convinced, cutting the remaining pillar-stones goes faster, but Wei Tong still insists on carrying two.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me spirit stones from the mountain road.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Steward Qian. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Han Xue) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the mountain road
Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Xiao Man.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Guardians, Still Adjusting
quests.summary: A few of the mountain's old stone guardians haven't fully settled with the cutting, and test the workers' resolve.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone golems at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stone golems spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Pick up star iron near the mountain road
Show Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Back straight. I won't say it again. I will say it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Second Pillar, Inscribed
quests.summary: The second pillar takes less time than the first, though your soul still aches afterward like an overused hand.

objectives.text: See what Elder Mo wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Faster. Good. Seven to go. Don't rush it just because it's faster. Rushed runes are wrong runes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Deacon Shen?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Circulate your qi at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul opens its eyes within you and looks around, curious as a child.

objectives.text: Report back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Recorded, sealed and posted. Three hundred points, and my personal nod.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Deacon Shen says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (nods slowly to Elder Mo) A careful answer.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Jin's Second Cart
quests.summary: Merchant Jin sends a second cart of supplies, again at cost, again with a note explaining he wants no thanks.

objectives.text: Hear Merchant Jin out

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I keep sending carts and keep not wanting thanks. I don't understand myself anymore. It's very uncomfortable. Send more work.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Listen to Deacon Shen. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Zhong Ming. A poor master.

objectives.text: Talk with Steward Qian at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Merchant Jin. {player} has never let us down.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Back Door, Tested Again
quests.summary: With the old cliff path sealed, Blood Moon agents test the sect's other quiet corners for another way in.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Deal with the Blood Moon cultivators at the long stone stairway.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is not a well. It is a very small cup.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The Blood Moon cultivators have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow
Find Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Steward Qian. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Third Stone
quests.summary: Wei Tong, undeterred by a sore back, attempts carrying three pillar-stones at once. Elder Hua is called.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me spirit stones from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Steward Qian has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the medicine valley
Bring word to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Steward Qian's New Ledger
quests.summary: Steward Qian, having accepted the formation's cost, now insists on tracking it with obsessive, oddly cheerful precision.

objectives.text: Answer Steward Qian's summons

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've made a chart! With colours! Watching the money leave is less painful when it's colour-coded. Slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Not now, Lu Ping. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Join Merchant Jin at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we did this uphill. Both ways. In the snow. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Mo.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Inscribing the Fourth Pillar
quests.summary: The fourth pillar's inscription goes smoothly, which after three difficult ones feels almost suspicious.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Smooth is good. Smooth is not suspicious. Stop looking for problems. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Elder Mo said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

objectives.text: Meditate at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tiny figure of light in your chest breathes when you breathe. It is getting stronger.

objectives.text: See Elder Mo again

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hm. Xiao Man is not wrong. Xiao Man is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Map of the Path
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, remembering more of the cages' talk, sketches out everything he can recall about the sect's hidden weaknesses.

objectives.text: Scout the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Disciples crowd the mission hall's boards, arguing over which chores pay the most contribution for the least mud.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ledgers on the abacus desk balance to the last copper, which is exactly what makes them suspicious.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I don't remember much. But I remember enough to be useful, finally. That feels better than it should.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: Nice work.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. Ling Qiu's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Oh thank heavens. I was so nervous I watered the lanterns twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Sometimes the rules are the cage. I know.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering to Xiao Shi) That was amazing.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Nine Stones, Nine Stories
quests.summary: As the pillars near completion, Wei Tong insists each one deserves a name and a story, mostly involving himself.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: This one's 'The Wei Tong Special'. I carried it uphill. Backwards. On purpose. For the story.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Lu Ping. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Feet first, then eyes, then sword. In that order. Every time.

objectives.text: Hear what Lu Ping has to say

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Man. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Give me an hour.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Adequate. Don't look so pleased.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Honest Merchant, Worried Merchant
quests.summary: Merchant Jin writes to the sect in his own hand: crates with seven stars, passing his docks, paid in silver he won't take.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The guild warehouse is neat and honest now, which makes the three seven-starred crates in the corner look very out of place.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run the beads of the abacus desk. The accounts come out one sum short, every month, for years.

objectives.text: Talk with Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Seven stars on the lids. A man paid me in silver to store them. I refused the silver. He left the crates anyway.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Honesty is terrifying. Nobody tells you. Please take them away.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: What the Crates Hold
quests.summary: The crates are heavier than crystals should be, and one of them is humming a tune.

objectives.text: Pry open a seven-star crate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals, packed in blood-lotus straw. And at the bottom, sewn into the lining, a letter signed with ash.

objectives.text: Hurry to the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letter reads: first rung holds. Deliver to the rim at the new moon. Luo Hui, of the Ladder.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Luo Hui. First rung. Qing Luan's seven. One of them is in this town, or was.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The new moon is in three days. So we wait, and we watch the docks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Watchers Watching
quests.summary: Qingshi's watchers have been busy. Old Pan, Madam Fang and Constable Du all saw the pale man. None of them liked him.

objectives.text: See what Old Pan wants

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Pale fellow. Came in on a raft, not my ferry. Didn't pay a fare. Didn't cast a reflection in the water. I noticed that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Find Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: He took a room. Paid in old coins. Never ate. Left ash in the bed. Ash! I had to burn the sheets!

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Old Pan.

objectives.text: Join Constable Du at the execution ground

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I followed him to the old guild warehouse by the river. The one nobody owns. He went in. He didn't come out. I wrote it down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Captain Lei.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Constable Du) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: The Warehouse Nobody Owns
quests.summary: The old guild warehouse by the river has no owner, no door, and fresh footprints in ash on its floor.

objectives.text: Search the fishing boat at the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old warehouse leans over the river on rotting stilts. Ash footprints lead in, and none lead out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fishing boat rocks at its rope. Under the nets lies a bundle that no fisherman would need.

objectives.text: Clear the back alley of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The alley behind it is guarded by men in crimson who have been told to let no one near the river.

objectives.text: Read the ledgers at the abacus desk at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside: nothing. Empty. And yet the ash footprints stop in the middle of the floor, as if someone went straight down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The abacus desk is covered in neat figures. Between them, in a smaller hand, someone has written a name.

objectives.text: Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me. He said you'd need someone to complain at. I see you've found a haunted warehouse. Of course you have.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Scholar Ouyang. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Under the Floorboards
quests.summary: Beneath the ash footprints, a trapdoor. Beneath the trapdoor, a tunnel toward the graves. The Blood Moon loves a tunnel.

objectives.text: Pry open the chest at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The trapdoor opens on stairs. Down there it smells of river mud and burning, and of blood lotus.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chest is heavier than it looks. So is what's inside.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tunnel comes up among the hill graves, where Blood Guards are loading crates onto a cart.

objectives.text: Seize the crates from the cart
Compare notes with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Seven stars on those crates. I've seen them before. On the black gate, back when the Blood Moon had my family. Same stars.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this river and I've never seen it look so pleased.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Whatever this is, it's big. They were scared of it. People like that are never scared of anything.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The New Moon
quests.summary: On the night of the new moon, the pale man comes back for his crates.

objectives.text: Hear Constable Du out

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: New moon. Every watcher's out. The town's asleep, or pretending to be. Old Pan's on the river with a lantern.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Captain Lei. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Signal the watchers from the tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You swing a lantern twice. Across the dark town, lanterns answer: river, inn, yamen, gate. Qingshi is awake.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the boat yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rafts slide out of the dark. Blood Guards, and among them a pale figure who leaves ash on the water.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping
Return to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: He's gone to the warehouse. The one with the crates. Alone. He wants them badly enough to come himself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Captain Lei. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's... not in the book. I'll invent a page.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

quests.title: Luo Hui, the First Rung
quests.summary: In the guild warehouse, among his crates, stands the First Rung of the Patriarch's Ladder. He is made mostly of patience and ash.

objectives.text: Read the ledgers at the abacus desk at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pale man sits on a seven-starred crate, turning a handful of ash in his fingers. He looks up and smiles with grey teeth.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ledgers on the abacus desk balance to the last copper, which is exactly what makes them suspicious.

objectives.name: Luo Hui, the First Rung
objectives.text: Face Luo Hui, the First Rung at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: The heir. The Patriarch said you would come. He says a lot of things about you. He's very fond of you, in his way.

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: I am Luo Hui, the First Rung. One rung is nothing. Seven is a road to heaven. Shall we see if you can climb?

objectives.text: Go to the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui staggers, laughs, and comes apart into ash that blows out through the cracks in the warehouse wall. His crates stay behind.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He ran. Like smoke. But he left his crates, and his crates are the point. One rung, shaken. Six to go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: apothecary_wang
dialogue.text: Half my shelves are empty since the trouble began. Medicine doesn't grow on shelves.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Wang Pu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: apothecary_wang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemy's belongings: a manual of a forbidden blood technique.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Seal it in the Scripture Pagoda

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: apothecary_wang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Keep it. Study it. Quietly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Liu Er Wants to Help
quests.summary: Liu Er, now fourteen and very tall, followed the fight from a rooftop and would like to become a cultivator immediately.

objectives.text: Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I saw everything! From the roof! The pale man turned into ash! I want to learn that! Not the ash part. The fighting part.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Ignore Madam Fang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I climb the nine thousand steps? Mother says I have to ask you. She says you'll say no.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When you're sixteen. Train with Constable Du until then. And ask your mother again.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Sixteen! That's forever! ...Fine. Constable Du. I'll be the best constable's apprentice there's ever been.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Listen to Madam Fang. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Old Pan) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. It has opinions.

objectives.text: Meet Madam Fang at the brewery

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Not now, Liu Er. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wipe your boots! This floor has seen a tax collector.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er begs you to teach him a sword form tonight, before his mother finds out.

choices.text: Teach him, then walk him home

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (thinks very hard) Yes. I agree.

choices.text: Tell him to ask his mother first

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Laugh at him

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Crates Still Unclaimed
quests.summary: Luo Hui's remaining crates need proper sorting before they can safely go up the mountain.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me thunder crystals from the dye yard, would you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Liu Er, but it's cultivator's work.

objectives.text: Find the thunder crystals at the dye yard
Go back to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Sensible, that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Ash Footprints, Traced
quests.summary: Constable Du wants the ash footprints from the warehouse traced to see if they lead anywhere else in town.

objectives.text: Investigate the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Weavers glance up from their looms in the silk workshop, then back down. The thread waits for no one.

objectives.text: Show Constable Du what you found

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Ash doesn't usually walk twice. I want to know everywhere these particular footprints have been.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Liu Er. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Unlawful, strictly. Effective, though.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

quests.title: Crimson Stragglers by the Docks
quests.summary: A handful of crimson-robed guards, cut off when Luo Hui fled, still linger near the river docks.

objectives.text: Examine the fishing boat at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hull of the fishing boat has been patched in a hurry. Something scraped it, hard, from below.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the lower docks
Talk it over with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Han Xue! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Fang's Burned Sheets, Twice Over
quests.summary: Madam Fang recounts, with mounting outrage, the full saga of burning the pale man's bedsheets not once but twice.

objectives.text: Answer Madam Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Twice! The ash came back! I don't know how ash comes back from a fire, but it did, and I burned it again!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Merchant Jin.

objectives.text: Talk with Old Pan at the watermill

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the watermill. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the tannery.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Old Pan's Careful Count
quests.summary: Old Pan insists on personally counting every crate before they cross the river, twice, out loud.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me spirit stones from the temple fair.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Captain Lei. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the temple fair
Report back to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Trouble? Tell me. I'll write it down. Then I'll deal with it.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

quests.title: Tie Hu's Old Memory
quests.summary: Iron-Fang remembers more about the seven-star mark from his years serving the Blood Moon, if reluctantly.

objectives.text: Search the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the temple orphanage the air changes, heavy with qi and something older underneath.

objectives.text: Leave an offering at the offering table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You leave an offering on the offering table and bow. The candle flames bow back.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Saw it on a banner once, at the black gate. Nobody explained it. Nobody explained anything to men like me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Anything on the far bank? Lanterns? Faces? I still dream about the lanterns.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Liu Er's Training Begins
quests.summary: True to his word, Liu Er starts training with Constable Du the very next morning, with more enthusiasm than technique.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: He's enthusiastic. Enthusiasm is a start. I'll have opinions about his footwork in a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Constable Du says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: There. Han Xue agrees. Settled.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'm watching you, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good. Somebody should. I'm very watchable now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Captain Lei. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Han Xue, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Steadying After the Rung
quests.summary: Han Xue insists on a proper meditation session after facing the First Rung, shaken loose or not.
