objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He came apart into ash and you're treating it like nothing happened. Sit down. Something happened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Pan said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You let your soul drift a hand's breadth from your body, then gently call it home.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I missed you too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Provisions for the Mountain Road
quests.summary: Before the crates travel up to the sect, the party restocks for the climb itself.

objectives.text: Hear Merchant Jin out

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me medicine bundles from the pottery kilns.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Business is business. I'm told friendship is also business, but warmer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the pottery kilns
See Merchant Jin again

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: More or less. Mostly less.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Mind the crates. The stamps are imported.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Noodle Promise
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, true to his earlier offer, insists on treating everyone to noodles before the crates head up the mountain.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I said noodles, I meant noodles. Sit. Eat. Let someone else worry about ash for one meal.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Zhao Kang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Hear what Liu Er has to say

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (hiding behind Merchant Jin) Oh.

quests.title: Ash on the River
quests.summary: Luo Hui's ash drifts on the river. You sit on the dock and let the fight settle into your nascent soul.

objectives.text: Settle your soul in the town temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul turns the fight over like a stone in its hands, and learns from it, and grows. Middle stage of Nascent Soul.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the red thread from Qingshi to the sky has thinned. Not broken. Thinner.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One rung shaken, six to go, and you're meditating in a temple like an old monk. You should celebrate. With noodles. My treat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Han Xue. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look at me like that. I've apologised for two years of being awful. Now I'm being nice. It's very tiring.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Acceptable.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Crates Up the Mountain
quests.summary: The seized crates go up the mountain to Elder Bai. Old Pan ferries them across the river himself, at no fare.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: No fare. For crates that nearly helped a monster climb to heaven, no fare. Mind the third plank.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Find Madam Fang at the temple fair

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Tell the Sect Master Qingshi says hello. And that we burned the pale man's sheets. Twice. For good measure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: actress_yu
dialogue.text: Look at that brooding face. I could use you in the second act. You'd die beautifully.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Yu Hongxiu. Let the immortal work.

objectives.choice_prompt: Madam Fang offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: actress_yu
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: actress_yu
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, nervously) Should we... say something?

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Hermit Forgets
quests.summary: A crane arrives from the hermit. It is blank. The hermit has forgotten how to write.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A blank crane from the hermit. Blank. He's never sent a blank crane. He wouldn't know how.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Go. Take Xiao Shi, he knows how to be patient with confused people. And take this. Smelling salts. For whoever needs them.

objectives.text: Inspect the sealed coffin at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest is grey and silent. Birds sit on branches, staring at nothing. The stream is not moving.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Something shifts inside the sealed coffin when you touch it. Then it is still again, very deliberately.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hello. Do I know you? You look like someone who drinks my tea. I have tea. I think. What is tea?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Soul Sight in the Fog
quests.summary: With ordinary eyes the fog is only grey. With soul sight it has threads, and the threads are pulling.

objectives.text: Look at the fog with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight the fog is a web, and every strand runs to something living, sipping at it. Every strand also runs north, toward the ruins.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I can't see the threads. But the hermit keeps asking me my name. I keep telling him. It seems to help, a bit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: In the cages, people forgot things too. We told each other our names every morning. It's a good habit.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Fog With Hands
quests.summary: The fog has thickened into shapes that walk, and the shapes have hands.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fog's standing up. It's got hands. I really didn't need the fog to have hands.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

objectives.text: Defeat the fog wraiths at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Hold the forest path against more fog wraiths
Head to the poison marsh

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the wraiths fall, the fog thins, and a bird somewhere remembers one note of its song.

quests.title: Telling the Hermit Who He Is
quests.summary: The hermit has forgotten three hundred years. Somebody has to tell him who he is. It's harder than it sounds.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your name is Lan Jue. You were the last disciple of the Verdant Lotus. You ran, and then you stopped running.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ran? I don't run. My knees are terrible. Did I really run? From what?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: From a flood. From a song. You went back and sang it. You were very brave.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: ...I think I remember a song. Tell me again. The part where I was brave. I like that part.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Every hour. We'll tell him every hour until the fog's gone. That's what we did in the cages. It works if you keep doing it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Hermit. And the time before.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

quests.title: Wolves Who Forgot
quests.summary: The forest's wolves have forgotten they were ever tame, or wild, or anything. They only remember hunger.

objectives.text: Make your way to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves stand in the fog outside the den, swaying, eyes blank. When you step closer, they remember one thing: teeth.

objectives.text: Drive the fog-lost wolves from the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The fog-lost wolves come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather the fog-shards the wolves shed
Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fog shards. They taste of nothing. I licked one. Don't ask. I've been told I have a curious tongue.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Hermit. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: A fog-struck wolf pup follows you, remembering nothing, not even to be afraid.

choices.text: Carry it to the hermit

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give it to the sect's beast pens

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Sell it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Anchor at the Ruins
quests.summary: The fog's threads all run to the ruins gate, where someone has planted a stone that drinks memories.

objectives.text: Scout the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the ruins gate stands a black stone the fog pours out of like steam from a kettle. Seven dots are carved on it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Mind where you step. This ground has seen worse than us.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we'd better be quick.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Quietly, then.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

objectives.text: Chip the seven-dot runes from the stone
Break the fog's anchor-stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stone cracks. The fog screams without a mouth, and pulls back into the crack, and then there is only the forest, and birds.

objectives.text: Clear the ruins courtyard of fog wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last of the fog-wraiths boil out of the courtyard, desperate, grabbing at anything that still remembers.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine is green again. From somewhere behind you comes the sound of a kettle, and an old man cursing it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

quests.title: Tea, Remembered
quests.summary: The hermit remembers everything, all at once, including that he has run out of tea.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I remember. All of it. Three hundred years at once. It's very loud. Also I've run out of tea. That's unforgivable.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Xiao Shi. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The hermit thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You told me I was brave. I heard it, through the fog. Nobody's ever told me that. I'm going to remember it on purpose.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the stream

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: He remembered my name before he remembered his own. He said it first. Xiao Shi. I'm going to go and cry by the stream.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Sometimes the rules are the cage. I know.

quests.title: Seven Dots on the Stone
quests.summary: The anchor-stone's seven dots match the crates. The Ladder didn't just want the forest's memories. It wanted a map.

objectives.text: Hurry to the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the broken anchor-stone's heart lies a slip of jade, full of stolen memory: every path, every stream, every door in the forest.

objectives.text: Read the stolen memory-slip

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins. The archive. The spring. The path to the sect's back door. The Ladder is mapping everything the Verdant Lotus ever touched.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They wanted a map of the Verdant Lotus. Of everything that's yours. Why would a ladder need to know where you've been?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe to know where I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: Giving Back the Forest's Memories
quests.summary: The memory-slip holds the forest's stolen memories. The hermit says they should go back where they came from.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Give them back. Every birdsong, every stream's direction. Open the slip at the spring and let them go home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I'll brew something for the road. It tastes like boiled boots, but it works.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Qu Wanqing, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Release the forest's memories at the spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Memories pour out of the slip like fireflies: a stream remembering downhill, a bird remembering its song, an old man remembering his teacher's voice.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My teacher's voice. It was in there. I'd forgotten it long before the fog. Thank you for giving back more than was taken.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: What the Ladder Wants
quests.summary: On the way home, Han Xue says what you are both thinking: the Ladder is studying you.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The first rung tested you. The fog mapped you. The assassin in Qingshi measured you. Someone is studying you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A ladder for one soul to climb. I don't like where my thoughts go when I put those together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Neither do I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we both keep thinking. Separately. Loudly. And we tell Elder Mo, because he's building a thing that touches the sky.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the charcoal kilns

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Herbs the Fog Left Sick
quests.summary: Even cleared, parts of the forest still need tending after the fog's long presence.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me spirit herbs from the hidden valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll light the watch lantern for you. If you see it go out, run.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: No, Pei Yuan. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the hidden valley
Go back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Balanced. Like a good tonic.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

quests.title: The Last Fog Wraiths
quests.summary: A few wraiths, cut off from the anchor-stone, wander the forest in confused, harmless-looking loops until provoked.

objectives.text: Stoke the pill furnace at the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill furnace breathes out heat like a sleeping beast. Inside, a batch of pills turns slowly in the glow.

objectives.text: Fight off the fog wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fog wraiths spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Find the void shards at the poison marsh
Show Elder Hua what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: We're done at the poison marsh. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Drink this. No, it doesn't taste good. That's how you know it works.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Elder Hua) That was cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: The Memory-Slip's Blank Corner
quests.summary: One corner of the recovered memory-slip stayed blank, as if something refused to be stolen in the first place.

objectives.text: Go to the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blank patch resists every attempt to read it, warm to the touch, faintly green, exactly like your pendant used to feel.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The loom clacks once as you touch it, as if the weaver had only stepped out for a moment.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. The hermit's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's New Habit
quests.summary: Xiao Shi has started introducing himself to people he already knows, a habit from the fog he can't quite shake.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Hello, I'm Xiao Shi. Sorry. Old habit. I know you know that. It just feels good to say.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Xiao Shi does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Han Xue.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the carved buddhas

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Xiao Shi, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the rope bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: The Hermit's Full Memory
quests.summary: Lan Jue, memory restored, wants to sit with you and properly finish the story the fog interrupted.

objectives.text: Report to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Where was I. Ah. Brave. Yes. Let me tell it properly this time, with all three hundred years attached.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Cultivate at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul opens its eyes within you and looks around, curious as a child.

objectives.text: Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to the hermit, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Restocking the Hermit's Tea
quests.summary: True to his word, the hermit's tea stores are unforgivably empty and need restocking immediately.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the mushroom ring. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the mushroom ring
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Wolves Remembering Themselves
quests.summary: The forest's wolves, memories restored, are skittish and unpredictable as they relearn who they are.

objectives.text: Read the map table at the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Break the fog-lost wolves at the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These fog-lost wolves fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Gather wolf fangs at the tiger ridge
Share your findings with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the carved buddhas isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Xiao Shi. We were attentive.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering to the hermit) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to the hermit) That makes sense. I think.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (hiding behind the hermit) Oh.

quests.title: What the Anchor-Stone's Runes Meant
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants the seven-dot runes from the anchor-stone compared against the ones on Luo Hui's crates.

objectives.text: Investigate the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hunter's lodge looks exactly as it should, which is what makes you uneasy.

objectives.text: Mark the map table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Same hand. Same seven dots, every time. Whoever carves these for the Ladder is consistent, at least.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Curious Tongue
quests.summary: Zhao Kang refuses to explain further what possessed him to lick a fog-shard, but Wei Tong will not let it go.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You licked a MYSTERIOUS FOG ARTIFACT. I have questions. I have so many questions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Hermit. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm standing right here, you know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: What the Forest Remembered
quests.summary: Between the hermit's restored memory and the fog's stolen map, your soul has grown wary in a new, useful way.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're watching things more carefully now. Good. Someone's been watching you carefully for a while.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

objectives.text: Temper your realm at the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tiny figure of light in your chest breathes when you breathe. It is getting stronger.

objectives.text: See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (beaming at Han Xue) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Palanquin on the Steps
quests.summary: A gold palanquin is coming up the nine thousand steps, carried by eight very tired men.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, then a fourth to be safe) {senior}! Sorry. You're very high up now. It's hard not to bow.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A gold palanquin! On the steps! Eight bearers! They've been climbing since yesterday! One of them is crying!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Lu Ping is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The palanquin sets down at the gate. The curtain parts. The ancestor of the Zhao clan steps out, frowning at the height of the steps.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Meet Ancestor Zhao at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I have come for my great-grandson. The clan requires its heir. He has played at cultivation long enough.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Where is he? Hiding, no doubt. He hides from me the way his father did. It's a family tradition.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Zhao Kang Hides
quests.summary: Zhao Kang is, in fact, hiding. In the pagoda. Behind the turtle soup books.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm not hiding. I'm researching. Turtle soup. It's fascinating. Go away.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He wants me to go home and marry a merchant's daughter and count gold. I'm good at counting gold. I hate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then tell him.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Tell him? He's a hundred and twelve. He's never been told anything. It would kill him. Or me. Probably me.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He's been behind my turtle soup shelf for three hours. He's reorganised it. Alphabetically. I'm furious. It's very well done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Fan Rui is not wrong. Fan Rui is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: Zhao Ming's Stone
quests.summary: In the Zhao clan hall, Zhao Kang's great-grandfather says, there is a stone for his dead brother. The ancestor carries a copy.

objectives.text: Answer Ancestor Zhao's summons

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Zhao Ming's stone. I had it copied, small, to carry. First out of the grotto, ten years ago. Dead on a mission two years later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Ancestor Zhao says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I will not lose another heir to this mountain. Tell him that. He won't hear it from me.

objectives.text: Look at Zhao Ming's stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The small stone is carved: Zhao Ming, first out of the Moonlit Grotto. Beneath it, newer, in a clumsy hand: and his brother, first out after.

objectives.text: Return to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Someone carved that line last year. A servant, I assumed. It's his hand, isn't it. He's been visiting home. Secretly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Answer Tang Ling, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Ancestor Zhao will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: The Clan's Test
quests.summary: The Zhao ancestor proposes a test: if his guards can't take Zhao Kang home by force, the boy can stay. He means it kindly. Probably.

objectives.text: Report to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The old way. My guards will escort him home. If he can refuse them, he can refuse me. That is the Zhao clan's test.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Of course it is. Everything's a test. Will you stand with me? Not for me. Beside me. There's a difference.

objectives.text: Stand beside Zhao Kang against the clan guards

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't hurt them! They carried me on their shoulders when I was four! Hurt them a little!

objectives.text: Go back to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Refused. By force. With a friend. Hm. His brother did the same, once, with a different friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ancestor, please, not the letters again.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The letters are a family tradition, boy.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: What Zhao Kang Says
quests.summary: Zhao Kang finally says it: to his great-grandfather, in front of the whole sect, with his voice shaking.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm not coming home. Not because I don't love the clan. Because Ming would have stayed, and I'm finishing what he started.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Ancestor Zhao.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And because I have a friend here who's going to do something stupid and heroic, and somebody has to complain about it.

objectives.text: Find Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: ...Your brother said almost the same words. Minus the complaining. You're more honest than he was.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay, then. The clan will manage. The clan managed before gold. It'll manage without you. Write to me. Monthly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Gifts From the Clan
quests.summary: The Zhao ancestor does not leave empty-handed or leave anyone else empty-handed. The palanquin was full of gifts.

objectives.text: See what Ancestor Zhao wants

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The palanquin was full of gifts in case he came home. Take them. Spirit stones for the formation. Gold for the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Steward Qian. I asked who would go.

objectives.text: Unload the Zhao clan's gifts
Join Steward Qian at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Two hundred spirit stones. From the Zhao clan. For free. I think I'm going to faint. Somebody catch me. Anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Ancestor Zhao! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Steward Qian) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: Two hundred spirit stones from the Zhao clan. Steward Qian asks how to spend them.

choices.text: Medicine for Qingshi

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Into the treasury ledger, by the rules

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: A little for yourself first

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Uninvited Escort
quests.summary: The palanquin is ambushed on its way down the steps. Somebody wants the Zhao clan to blame the Azure Cloud.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The palanquin's under attack! On the steps! Masked men! The bearers are throwing gold at them! It's not working!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore Lu Ping. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The Blood Moon cultivators have found you first.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators
Speak with Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Blood Moon. Trying to kill me on your steps, so the clan would blame you. They don't know the clan. We blame precisely.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Ancestor Zhao said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan will stand with the Azure Cloud when you go after them. That's not gratitude. It's accounting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Monthly Letters
quests.summary: Zhao Kang writes his first monthly letter home before the palanquin has even reached the bottom of the steps.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Dear Great-Grandfather. It's been an hour. I'm fine. The food is terrible. Wei Tong made dumplings. They were fine. Love, Kang.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Too much? It's too much. I've never written 'love' to him. He's going to die of shock.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Send it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...Fine. If he dies, it's your fault. I'll carve it on your stone.

objectives.text: Hear what Ancestor Zhao has to say

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You've got mud to the knees and a grin to the ears. Wipe off one of them.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries, and in gold.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the sunrise terrace. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Zhong Ming has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Brothers' Stone
quests.summary: Zhao Kang asks you to sit with him at the cliff edge where he used to burn incense for his brother.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I burned incense here for Ming. Every year. You found me here, once, and asked who assigned his mission. Remember?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Zhao Kang said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Burn incense with Zhao Kang at the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two sticks of incense, side by side, their smoke twisting together over the sea of clouds.

objectives.text: Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Gu assigned it. He's in the Abyss. When we go after him, I'm going to ask him why. Just ask. I think that's what Ming would do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Sect Master. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Well? Did you keep your guard up, or did you just get lucky?

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Accounting
quests.summary: The Sect Master notes that in one year the Azure Cloud has gained the Iron Scale, the Zhao clan and a very honest merchant as allies.

objectives.text: Answer the Sect Master's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. The Zhao clan. Qingshi's yamen and its merchants. A year ago we had none of them. You collect allies like Wei Tong collects buns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you should be resting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And you should be retired, Mo. We both make sacrifices.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon keeps trying to set us against each other, and keeps pushing us together instead. Someone there is very bad at accounting.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Pillar six is up. Seven thousand runes checked. All correct. I'm starting to hate the word correct. It sounds smug.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Noted, Deacon Shen. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Gold for the Kitchen
quests.summary: Wei Tong wants the Zhao clan's gifted gold spent immediately, specifically on kitchen upgrades.

objectives.text: Report to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Lu Ping. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the spirit peach orchard
Bring word to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Enough, Sect Master. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Guards Scattered on the Steps
quests.summary: A few of the ambush's attackers scattered rather than fled and still lurk near the nine thousand steps.

objectives.text: Search the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rolls out of the refectory kitchens. Somewhere inside, a ladle strikes a pot like a gong.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: More Blood Moon cultivators? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the outer dormitories
Compare notes with Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Old Bao. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Ancestor Zhao) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: The Ancestor's Second Letter
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu's reply to Kang's monthly letter arrives faster than anyone expected, and is uncharacteristically warm.

objectives.text: Head to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit deer lift their heads in the beast garden's pens. A fat golden carp watches you from its pond.

objectives.text: Break open the cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He wrote back in a week! He never writes back in a week! It says 'proud, don't tell anyone I said so.' I'm framing it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Dumpling Review
quests.summary: Wei Tong demands a formal, detailed critique of the dumplings Zhao Kang mentioned in his letter.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: 'Fine'? My dumplings are 'fine'? I want a full report. In writing. With diagrams if necessary.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Find Ancestor Zhao at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the core disciples' court.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Wei Tong. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Settling After the Ambush
quests.summary: Han Xue insists everyone meditate properly after the ambush on the steps, nerves or not.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: An assassination attempt on a palanquin is not a normal Tuesday. Sit. Let it actually pass through you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Tang Ling said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You let your soul drift a hand's breadth from your body, then gently call it home.

objectives.text: See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Fan Rui. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: Spirit Stones, Properly Logged
quests.summary: Steward Qian wants the Zhao clan's two hundred spirit stones logged with his usual excessive, colour-coded care.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Mo out

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo, you're scowling again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I'm thinking, Sect Master. It looks the same from outside.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eat something. You look like a boiled noodle with ambitions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Return to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
