dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Mo, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Who Told the Blood Moon
quests.summary: Someone knew exactly when the Zhao palanquin would be on the steps. Han Xue wants to know who.

objectives.text: Make your way to the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the bell tower you can see every roof of the sect, and the long road winding down to the world.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Only a handful of people knew the timing. I don't like any of the answers I'm considering.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Ancestor Zhao. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Third Letter
quests.summary: Buoyed by his great-grandfather's reply, Zhao Kang writes a third letter, considerably less nervous than the first.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Dear Great-Grandfather. Pillar six is up. I helped carry stones. My back hurts. I'm oddly proud of that. Love, Kang.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Zhong Ming. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Speak with Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My grandson has your stubbornness. Regrettably, he had it first.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Incense for Two
quests.summary: Zhao Kang wants a fresh supply of incense kept at the cliff edge, for himself and for whoever needs it next.

objectives.text: Go and see Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me incense bundles from the laundry stream. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Look at that stance. A strong wind would file a complaint.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I was meditating. With my eyes closed. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Recover incense bundles from the laundry stream
Go back to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Lu Ping, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Sect Master.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm telling the whole gate! Twice! With improvements!

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm... not going to tell anyone about that one.

quests.title: A Year of Allies
quests.summary: Looking at how much has changed in a year, your soul settles into something that feels, for once, like hope instead of dread.

objectives.text: Answer the Sect Master's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Allies instead of enemies. That's rarer than any formation. Don't let anyone tell you it happened by accident.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Consolidate your cultivation at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul opens its eyes within you and looks around, curious as a child.

objectives.text: Report back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Excellent. I shall mention you in my monthly letter. It is very long. You'll be in paragraph nine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Hmph. Still in one piece. I wasn't worried. I was sharpening things.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Rust on the Vein
quests.summary: Qing Luan's cloud crane is spotted with rust. It dissolves into her voice, and her voice is worried.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Another crane. It's rusty. How does a cloud rust? Don't answer. Go and find out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Scout the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the cloud gate, rust creeps along the stone in orange veins, like something slowly bleeding.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The vein is rusting. Crystals that were blue for ten thousand years are turning orange. Someone is praying over them.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Praying. With a rosary made of rusted nails. I watched from my pavilion. I don't usually feel sick. I felt sick.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart first, fist second. Just like the peak teaches!

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Storm Wolves in Rust
quests.summary: The storm wolves on the spirit vein are rusting too. They are in pain, and pain makes them fast.

objectives.text: Hurry to the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves limp across the vein, rust in their fur where lightning used to be. They snap at anything that moves.

objectives.text: Drive the storm wolves from the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The storm wolves spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather the crystals that haven't rusted yet
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's spreading. Every crystal the rust touches dies. If it reaches the heart of the vein, the isles will fall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Yan Tie. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Prayer Beads of Nails
quests.summary: At the vein's heart a string of rusted nails lies coiled on a crystal like a sleeping snake.

objectives.text: Go to the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A rosary of rusted nails lies on the largest crystal. Where it touches, the crystal is orange and crumbling.

objectives.text: Lift the nail rosary from the crystal

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rosary is warm. Somewhere on the isles, someone feels it lifted, and stops praying.

objectives.text: Tell Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He felt that. The Rust Monk. Tie Shan. He was a monk once, in a temple that burned. Now he's the Second Rung.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He'll come for his beads. He'll be polite about it. That's the worst part.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: The Monk's Acolytes
quests.summary: The Rust Monk's acolytes come first, bowing before they strike.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They bowed. Then they tried to stab me. I don't know how to feel. I bowed back. Then I stabbed them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.text: Clear the rainbow bridge of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Guards come on in silence.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Guards at the chain isles
Talk with Yan Tie at the Immortal Palace gate

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came up the cloud road! My soul is very small, but it's very loud! Where's the monk?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The isles have been restless. Even the rice leans away from the wind now.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Qingyi. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Rust Monk's acolytes lie beaten: villagers he twisted. Slowly, they could still be healed.

choices.text: Take them to Elder Hua

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (beaming at Yan Tie) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Imprison them until the war is over

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

choices.text: Cut them down. It's quicker.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Soul Against Rust
quests.summary: Qing Luan says rust eats iron, not souls. If you can hold your soul outside your body, the rust can't touch it.

objectives.text: See what Qing Luan wants

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Rust eats iron. Iron is body. Soul is not iron. Step your soul out, a hand's breadth, and let the rust find nothing to bite.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

objectives.text: Hold your soul outside your body

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul steps out a hand's breadth and stays there, shining. The wind of the isle blows through it like light through a window.

objectives.text: Bring word to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Good. Now fight like that. It's exhausting. That's why nobody does it. You're going to do it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Balanced, like a scale nobody is watching.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hmph. Reasonable. Annoyingly.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

quests.title: Tie Shan, the Rust Monk
quests.summary: The Second Rung comes for his beads. He is huge, polite, and rotting, and he bows before every blow.

objectives.text: Draw qi from the spirit stone at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A huge monk in rotting orange robes kneels at the vein's heart, hands pressed together. Rust flakes from his fingers like snow.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit stone drinks your qi and glows, then gives it back doubled, like an honest merchant.

objectives.name: Tie Shan, the Rust Monk
objectives.text: Bring down Tie Shan, the Rust Monk

dialogue.speaker: rung_shan
dialogue.text: Tie Shan, Second Rung. Forgive me. All iron rusts. All vows rust. Yours will too. Let me show you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My soul isn't iron, monk.

dialogue.speaker: rung_shan
dialogue.text: Ah. Luo Hui said you were clever. Pray with me, then. It won't help.

objectives.text: Investigate the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The monk bows one last time and crumbles into a heap of rust that the wind carries off the edge of the isle. His laughter goes with it.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan at the dragon bones

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He's not dead. Rungs don't die easily; they're tied to their stars. But his star dimmed. I saw it from here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Qing Luan thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Han Xue. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's followers throw down their weapons and kneel.

choices.text: Let them go home

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Bring them to face the sect's judgement

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Make an example of them

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Healing the Vein
quests.summary: The vein can heal if the rusted crystals are cleared away. Qing Luan wants every one gone before it spreads.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Clear away the dead crystals. The vein will grow new ones. It's patient. It's ten thousand years patient.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Zhao Kang, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Clear the rusted crystals from the vein
See Qing Luan again

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Blue again. Look at that. Ten thousand years, and it still manages to surprise me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Crystals for the Formation, Once More
quests.summary: The newly cleared vein yields fresh crystals worth bringing home for the Great Azure Formation's final ring.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me thunder crystals from the thunder isle.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It's restful, mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Gather thunder crystals at the thunder isle
Return to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Qing Luan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Han Xue. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: The Rosary's Ash
quests.summary: The Rust Monk's fallen rosary leaves behind a residue Qing Luan wants studied before it's discarded.

objectives.text: Search the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Scroll racks in the hall of heavenly records climb into the clouds, each tagged with a star.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Rust, ground fine, mixed with something older. Keep a sample. I want to compare it to the Patriarch's old wards.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (grinning at Qing Luan) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, Healing
quests.summary: The storm wolves, freed from rust, are still dangerous as they relearn their own strength.

objectives.text: Trace the rune pillar at the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You lay your palm on the rune pillar. It drinks your qi, hums a note, and passes it to its neighbours.

objectives.text: Fight off the storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Pick up thunder crystals near the storm plateau
Show Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Yan Tie's Soul, Loudly
quests.summary: Yan Tie insists on describing his own soul in exhaustive, enthusiastic detail to anyone who'll listen.

objectives.text: Go and see Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Mine's a drum, apparently. A very large, very loud drum. Thunder Peak approves enormously.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ignore Qing Luan. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars do not lie. They merely exaggerate.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Cloud Silk From the Isle of Winds
quests.summary: With the vein secured, there's time to gather more cloud silk before heading back down the cloud road.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yan Tie, lower your voice. The mountain is asleep.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: THE MOUNTAIN LIKES ME, ZHAO KANG.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Collect cloud silk around the cloud harbour
Go back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Han Xue. Han Xue won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Holding Steady
quests.summary: Before attempting to let your soul grow, Qing Luan insists on one careful, unhurried meditation first.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't rush growing. A soul that grows too fast forgets to check its own edges. Sit properly first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Circulate your qi at the waterfall isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tiny figure of light in your chest breathes when you breathe. It is getting stronger.

objectives.text: Report back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. The stars shrug.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Two Dim Stars, Watched
quests.summary: Qing Luan keeps a careful watch on the two dimmed red stars, worried they might brighten again without warning.

objectives.text: Head to the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the hall of records, a brush writes by itself on a scroll that never ends.

objectives.text: Study the stone tablets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rows of stone tablets stand in order. One is out of its place, and the gap is the message.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Dim isn't gone. I'll watch them the way I watch everything: for sixty years, if I have to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes bowed to you. They bowed to the last immortal once, then took it back.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Warden He says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: warden_he
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

reply.speaker: warden_he
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Growing Patience
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, of all people, is the one who suggests waiting a day before pushing your soul further.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I know. Shocking. Me, patient. Ming would laugh. But rushing got the monk his rust. Let's not rush.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yan Tie is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you, Qing Luan.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Yan Tie has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

quests.title: Star Iron, One Last Piece
quests.summary: A final, stubborn piece of star iron in the ruins resists collection until someone digs it out properly.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me star iron from the sky ship wreck, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak always says hello loudly, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Find the star iron at the sky ship wreck
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hm. Clean work. I'd have been faster. Not by much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Han Xue's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the star iron you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Cloud Road, Quiet for Once
quests.summary: For one evening, nobody attacks, nobody rusts, and the cloud road is simply beautiful to walk.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enjoy it. Quiet doesn't last on this road. I should know — I've walked it for longer than your sect has existed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Qing Luan says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the rainbow bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: The Soul Grows Tall
quests.summary: After holding your soul outside your body through a whole fight, it doesn't want to go back in. It wants to grow.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your soul is bigger than it was this morning. That happens when you make it do something stupid. Sit. Let it settle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

objectives.text: Let your nascent soul settle at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul settles back into your body like a cat into a basket, turning twice. It is taller. Late stage of Nascent Soul.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You glowed. The whole fight. Like a lantern with a person in it. Don't do that again without warning me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Qing Luan. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Two Rungs Shaken
quests.summary: Two Rungs shaken, neither broken. Qing Luan's chart shows five red stars bright, and two dim.

objectives.text: Go and see Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Two dim. Five bright. The Ladder can't climb with dim rungs. But dim isn't broken. They'll heal, like the vein.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You need to break them, not shake them. For that you'll need to be stronger than a nascent soul. Much stronger.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the hermit's isle

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stronger than a nascent soul. We only just got here. Is there always a next stage? Doesn't it ever end?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Qing Luan says it ends at the top of a staircase.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Qing Luan. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Of course it does. Everything ends with stairs. I hate stairs.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Back to the Pillars
quests.summary: Back at the sect, Elder Mo has raised eight pillars and checked nine thousand runes. He is thinner, and very pleased with himself.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Mo's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eight pillars. Nine thousand runes. All correct. One ring left. Then we light it, and the sect is safe for ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The star-gazer can disagree all she likes. I've checked. Twice.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He's so thin. I've been making him soup. He says 'adequate soup' and eats three bowls. He's going to be fine. Right?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Do as Wei Tong says. For once, someone is making sense.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Elder Mo agrees. It must be true.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: One Last Visit
quests.summary: The isles are going to close to souls too, soon. Qing Luan wants to show you one more thing before they do.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road is thinner than last time, almost transparent. Below, the sea of clouds is very far away.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The isles are closing, even to souls, for another sixty years. I want you to see something first. Something I saw.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The palace doesn't like visitors to see it. The palace is going to have to live with that.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Palace Says No
quests.summary: The palace sentinels bar the way. Qing Luan tells them to move. They don't.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Move. I was a sage of this palace when your stone was still gravel. Move! ...Fine. Hit them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.text: Break the celestial sentinels at the sun altar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial sentinels spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Cut down the celestial sentinels that follow
See Qing Luan again

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They'll reform by morning. They always do. They're very loyal and very stupid. I used to find it charming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

objectives.choice_prompt: The palace sentinels will reform by morning. You could shatter their cores so they never do.

choices.text: Leave them be

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Ask Qing Luan's leave first

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Shatter the cores

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: The Mural of the First Climb
quests.summary: Inside the palace, a mural shows a man in red climbing the stair, seven stars behind him, and two sects pulling at his robe.

objectives.text: Make your way to the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A mural on a broken wall: a man in red on a stair of light, seven red stars behind him, two figures at his heels, one blue, one green.

objectives.text: Study the palace mural

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The figure in green holds a lotus. The figure in blue holds a sword. Both are pulling. Both are falling with him.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your founders. They pulled him down, and fell with him, into the earth. The Abyss is the hole they made landing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The blue one lived. The green one... there's a reason the Verdant Lotus gave its elders to the seal. They'd already lost their founder.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Qing Luan Remembers
quests.summary: Qing Luan tells you what she was, before she was a memory.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I was the palace's youngest sage. I watched him climb. I didn't stop him. I didn't know I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: When he fell, the palace fell with him. I stayed. As a memory. Watching the stair. Waiting for someone to do what I didn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're doing it now. You're teaching me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: ...Yes. I suppose I am. Ten thousand years late, but teaching. That's something.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The isles have been restless. Even the rice leans away from the wind now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Star-Shadows
quests.summary: Where the red stars shine on the isles at night, their light casts shadows that walk.

objectives.text: Touch the crane statue at the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the blossom trees, shadows move without anything to cast them. The red stars are directly overhead.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You touch the neck of the crane statue. It is cool and smooth, polished by generations of wishes.

objectives.text: Stop the star-shadows at the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The star-shadows have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather phoenix feathers the shadows scattered
Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows with nothing to cast them. I've fought wolves, stone men, monks and fog. Now shadows. I want a holiday.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Zhao Kang does enough for three.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

quests.title: The Memory Crystal
quests.summary: Qing Luan leads you to a crystal where the isles keep their oldest memory: the night of the fall.

objectives.text: Scout the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Deep in the ruins, a crystal hangs in the air, turning slowly. Inside it, very small, a man in red is falling forever.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well. That's not something you see every day. I'd rather not see it again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I see it. Stay close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I see it too. Let's find out what it means.

objectives.text: Gather star iron from the crystal's base
Touch the memory of the fall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hear him as he falls. Not screaming. Laughing. Next time, he says, I'll bring a body heaven can't refuse.

objectives.text: Defeat the celestial sentinels at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystal's keepers stir in the serpent's old isle, disturbed by the memory, and come to see who woke it.

objectives.text: Hurry to the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the cloud gate, the wind is cold. A body heaven can't refuse. The words sit in your chest like a stone.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread
Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.
Sell it to the highest bidder

quests.title: A Body Heaven Can't Refuse
quests.summary: Han Xue heard it too. So did Zhao Kang. Nobody wants to say what everyone is thinking.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A body heaven can't refuse. A clean one. With the Verdant Lotus in it. I'm going to say it, because nobody else will.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He wants you. Not to kill. To wear.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the golden lotus lake

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Then he'll have to get through me. And her. And the entire Zhao clan, who've recently become very emotional about you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Qingyi said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Also I'll complain. Loudly. Forever. Nobody wants to wear a body that has me complaining at it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Watching the Stair
quests.summary: Before the isles close, Qing Luan asks you to sit with her and watch the Ascension Stair, the way she has for ten thousand years.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit with me. Watch the stair. I've done it alone for ten thousand years. Tonight I'd like company.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhao Kang. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.text: Watch the Ascension Stair with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair climbs into cloud, faint, made of light. It is not for you. Not yet. But for the first time, it looks back.

objectives.text: Return to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It looked at you. I saw it. Ten thousand years and it has never looked at anyone. Heaven is starting to notice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Balanced, like a scale nobody is watching.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) That makes sense. I think.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Gifts for the Formation
quests.summary: Qing Luan fills your arms with star iron and cloud silk for Elder Mo. The isles are generous when they're closing.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: For your formation. Star iron from the palace floor, cloud silk from the pines. The isles are generous when they close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Zhao Kang has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk for Elder Mo
Go back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And lotus child. When you light it... be careful. I still don't like its shape. But I'm a memory, and memories worry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Han Xue. We were attentive.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, One Last Hunt
quests.summary: Before the road closes, the storm wolves need clearing one final time, or they'll trouble the next visitor in sixty years.

objectives.text: Read the rune pillar at the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl up the rune pillar like ivy made of light. One of them is carved backward.

objectives.text: Drive the storm wolves from the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Recover cloud silk from the storm plateau
Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A star just blinked. It was about you. I'm almost certain.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Qing Luan. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: The Stair, Measured
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to measure the Ascension Stair's light with your soul, so she has something new to remember it by.

objectives.text: Go to the peach garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The peach garden smells so sweet it makes your eyes water. A sign reads 'Counted every thousand years.'

objectives.text: Show Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Measure it. Tell me what it feels like now, so that in sixty years I have something new to compare it to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: Star Iron, For the Road Ahead
quests.summary: The palace floor still holds star iron, worth taking before the road that leads to it dissolves.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me star iron from the sword isle. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Qingyi. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather star iron at the sword isle
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Qingyi's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more star iron than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (beaming at Zhao Kang) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Farewell to the Isles
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, uncharacteristically solemn, says goodbye to a place that tried to kill him several times.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Goodbye, isles. You rusted me, dropped things on me, and grew a monk out of moss at me. I'll miss you, somehow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Scribe Shu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the star pavilion. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the rainbow bridge.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Zhao Kang. And the time before.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: The Last Star-Shadows
quests.summary: A final cluster of star-shadows gathers under the dimming red stars, as if reluctant to let the isles close.

objectives.text: Align the armillary sphere at the star observatory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The armillary sphere creaks as its rings align. The stars they point to are the ones the Blood Moon watches.

objectives.text: Clear the star observatory of star-shadows

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Pick up star iron near the star observatory
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The floating forest is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Qing Luan. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Phoenix Feathers, Before the Gate Shuts
quests.summary: The immortal garden's phoenix feathers are worth one more careful gathering before the gate closes for good.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me phoenix feathers from the phoenix nest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Collect phoenix feathers around the phoenix nest
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the phoenix feathers you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Mural, One More Look
quests.summary: You return to the mural of the founders' fall for one last, careful look before the palace fades from reach.

objectives.text: Investigate the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the jade terraces. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look again. Memory changes what it wants to. I want you to see it once more, honestly, before you can't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hm. Clean work. I'd have been faster. Not by much.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Han Xue says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Han Xue's Question
quests.summary: Han Xue asks Qing Luan something she's clearly been holding back for the whole visit.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: When the isles open again, will you still be here? Or does a memory eventually finish remembering?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I don't know. Ask me in sixty years. I intend to be difficult about disappearing, if it comes to that.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Qing Luan.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Zhao Kang says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Han Xue. A poor master.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Unruly! Like a comet. Comets are my favourite.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Cloud Silk, the Last Bolts
quests.summary: The pines give up their last bolts of cloud silk before the cloud road dissolves behind you.

objectives.text: See what Qing Luan wants

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit. Look up. Try not to fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Find the cloud silk at the cloud harbour
See Qing Luan again

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One day I'll think of a comeback. Today is not that day.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It's restful, mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: star_sage
