reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

quests.title: One More Lesson
quests.summary: Qing Luan insists on one final lesson before the isles close, cramming sixty years of patience into a single evening.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: One more lesson. Sit. I have sixty years of things to say and one evening to say them. Sit down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhao Kang?

objectives.text: Meditate at the waterfall isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You let your soul drift a hand's breadth from your body, then gently call it home.

objectives.text: Return to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars do not lie. They merely exaggerate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: The Isles Close
quests.summary: The cloud road dissolves behind you as you step onto the mountain. Above, the isles fade until they are only clouds.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road dissolves behind your last step. Above, the isles fade into ordinary cloud, and then into sky.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sixty years until they open again. We'll be old. Well. You won't be. You'll be something else by then.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let's go and give Elder Mo his silk. He'll say adequate. He'll mean wonderful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (beaming at Han Xue) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Ninth Pillar
quests.summary: The ninth pillar is ready to raise. Elder Mo wants you to inscribe it, and Wei Tong wants to carry it alone.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The ninth pillar. Last one. You inscribe. Wei Tong carries. Nobody helps him carry. He's been looking forward to it for a month.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Activate the seal at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eight pillars ring the plaza, humming faintly blue. The ninth lies on the stones, waiting.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seal flares, then settles, as though it had been waiting for your hand.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Alone! I'm carrying it alone! Stand back! Stand further back! That's too far, I want an audience!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Yan Tie. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Final Inscription
quests.summary: You inscribe the ninth pillar with your soul while the whole sect watches from the walls.

objectives.text: Inscribe the ninth pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul writes the last rune in light. Nine pillars hum together, one long note that you feel in your teeth. The whole mountain sighs.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nine. It's done. The frame of the Great Azure Formation. Ten thousand years of safety, and I built it. I built it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Yan Tie. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: ...With help. Adequate help. More than adequate. Somebody hand me a chair.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Lanterns for Nine Pillars
quests.summary: The Sect Master declares a festival. Nine pillars, nine lanterns, and every disciple on the mountain gets a night off.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A festival. Nine lanterns for nine pillars. Every disciple gets a night off. Even Steward Qian. Especially Steward Qian.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't break anything that belongs to the sect. I will know. I always know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Steward Qian. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

objectives.text: Collect lanterns for the pillars
Hang the first lantern on the ninth pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine lanterns, one on each pillar. The formation glows gold and blue, and the whole mountain comes out to see it.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: A night off. I don't know what to do with a night off. I counted my spirit stones. It was very relaxing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Not now, Tang Ling. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more lantern oil than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Voices at the Festival
quests.summary: The festival is loud and bright. Everyone you love is there, and most of them want to talk to you.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mo ate. At the festival. Two bowls. I watched him. I've never been so relieved to watch a man eat noodles.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Man has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: My brother laughed. Out loud. At Wei Tong falling off a bench. First time since the cages. I'm going to remember it forever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: What Elder Hua said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It was a very good fall. He fell with dignity. Then without.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The formation's glow makes the pagoda look beautiful. I'm going to read by it. All night. Nobody stop me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Tribute
quests.summary: Thunder Peak insists on a tribute: a shouting contest against the training puppets. Everyone must participate.

objectives.text: Report to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's tribute! Everyone fights a puppet! Everyone shouts! The loudest wins nothing! It's tradition! I invented it tonight!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Shout at puppets for Thunder Peak

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Training puppets ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Go back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You shouted beautifully. Elder Mo shouted too. He said 'adequate' very loudly. The whole peak cheered.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Old Qiu. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Yan Tie, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Uninvited to the Festival
quests.summary: In the middle of the festival, Thunder Peak's guard at the back door rings its bell. Someone is climbing.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The back door bell! Thunder Peak's ringing it! Someone's climbing up from the clouds! During the festival! How rude!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Lu Ping does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Han Xue.

objectives.text: Ring the alarm at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings over the sea of clouds. Below, on the hidden path, masked figures freeze, then climb faster.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping
Talk with Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They came for the formation. On festival night, when everyone was drunk on noodles. They're learning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: The climber you caught is a Blood Moon deserter who wanted food, not the formation.

choices.text: Feed him and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Hold him for the Law Hall

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Throw him back down the mountain

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: One Ring Left
quests.summary: Elder Mo leaves the festival early. He has one ring of runes left to check, and he wants to finish before the lighting.

objectives.text: Search the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: While the festival roars on, Elder Mo sits alone at the edge of the formation, lamp in hand, bent over the outer ring.

objectives.text: Sit with Elder Mo as he checks the outer ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rune by rune. He mutters each one. Correct. Correct. Correct. His finger pauses once, then moves on. Correct.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nearly done. The outer ring's fiddly. Some of these runes are written backwards to look forwards. Bai's copying is very precise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go back to the festival. Eat something. I'll be done in a few nights.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Peaches for Elder Hua
quests.summary: Elder Mo gives you a basket and asks you to pick peaches from the outer pines' old orchard. For Elder Hua. Don't tell her who sent them.

objectives.text: See what Elder Mo wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Peaches. From the old orchard past the pines. For Hua. Every autumn I leave them on her doorstep. I'm busy this year. You do it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo, you're scowling again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I'm thinking, Sect Master. It looks the same from outside.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Don't tell her who they're from. She knows. We both pretend. It's been forty years. It works.

objectives.text: Pick peaches in the old orchard
Find Elder Hua at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Peaches on my doorstep. From an anonymous admirer. Who has been anonymous for forty years. Tell him thank you. No. Don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, Fleeing
quests.summary: The masked climbers scatter into the outer pines rather than fight. Thunder Peak wants them run down before they report back.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sword in the stone is cold and humming. For a moment you hear its last owner's oath, word for word.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Recover lantern oil from the summit of Sword Peak
Compare notes with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Lantern Oil, Restocked
quests.summary: The festival burned through the sect's lantern oil. Steward Qian wants the stores refilled before the next night's lighting.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian out

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me lantern oil from the outer pines.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name, and all of them are mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the outer pines
Report back to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steward, I need a new lantern for the gate.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You needed a new lantern last month, Lu Ping. What did you do with it?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Steward Qian will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Do you know what that costs? I do. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The lantern oil came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Steward Qian's Very Relaxing Night
quests.summary: Steward Qian corners you to describe, at length, exactly how he spent his night off counting spirit stones.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I sorted them by year. Then by weight. Then by year again, to check my work. It was the best night of my decade.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we did this uphill. Both ways. In the snow. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Elder Mo.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Feet first, then eyes, then sword. In that order. Every time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Mo. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Xiao Shi has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we trained in the snow. Uphill. With buckets.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Rematch
quests.summary: Wei Tong demands a rematch against the training puppets, insisting his festival fall doesn't count.

objectives.text: Go and see Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Deal with the training puppets at the training ground.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Xiao Shi. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Stop the training puppets at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Bring word to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

quests.title: The Golem in the Outer Ring
quests.summary: A stone golem, disturbed by the festival's noise, wanders into the formation's outer ring and must be gently redirected.

objectives.text: Head to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash drifts across the pill kiln yard. A kiln door opens with a roar, and a disciple ducks a gout of flame.

objectives.text: Tend the pill furnace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Show Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Don't fight it here! One wrong swing and you'll crack a rune I haven't checked yet! Herd it, don't hit it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Sect Master says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Lighting
quests.summary: The formation's coming lighting will need spirit stones in reserve, and Elder Mo wants a buffer beyond the minimum.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me spirit stones from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the medicine valley
See Xiao Shi again

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Old Bao. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

quests.title: Han Xue's Toast
quests.summary: Han Xue proposes a toast to the ninth pillar, and to everyone who carried a piece of it up the mountain.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: To the ninth pillar. And the eight before it. And everyone who carried stone, ink, or worry up this mountain to build them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Shi. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't break anything that belongs to the sect. I will know. I always know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Steward Qian. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Meet Steward Qian at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Stone Golem, Again
quests.summary: The golem from the outer ring wanders back overnight, drawn by the formation's hum, and needs herding a second time.

objectives.text: Read the rim of the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense smoke curls out of the bronze ding. Beneath the ash, something that is not incense glints.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone golems at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Collect lantern oil around the outer dormitories
Talk it over with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Elder Bai. You said so. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Peaches, a Second Basket
quests.summary: Elder Hua, in an unusual burst of directness, asks for a second basket of peaches, this time to share with Elder Mo openly.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Tell him — no. Just bring a second basket. I'll decide what to say with it when it's in my hands.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Find the peaches at the medicine valley
Return to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold out your wrist. Hm. Your pulse is stubborn. Like you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Hua) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Bai Ling Reads by Lamplight
quests.summary: Bai Ling, true to her word, reads by the formation's glow all night and reports what she found in an old text.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I found a line about the outer ring in an old sect record. 'The last ring remembers what the others forget.' I don't like that line.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Xiao Shi has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Brother, did you eat? You didn't eat. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I ate twice, Man. You watched me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

objectives.text: Find Steward Qian at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Steward Qian is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Sign here. And here. And here. No, the other here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Night Off
quests.summary: The Sect Master finds you at the cliff edge after the festival. She is not wearing her crown. She looks much younger without it.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I took my crown off. First time in eleven years. My neck doesn't know what to do.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In a few days Mo finishes checking. Then we light it. Ten thousand years, and I can sleep. Do you know how long it's been?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Since you became Sect Master?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Since I was a child, I think. Sit. Watch the formation glow. We've earned one night of looking at something beautiful.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: The Morning After
quests.summary: The morning after the festival, the sect is quiet and hungover on noodles. Elder Mo is still at the formation's edge.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo didn't come to bed. He's still out there checking runes. I brought him soup. He said adequate. He didn't look up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Wei Tong knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Xiao Shi agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Wei Tong says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He looked... worried. Elder Mo doesn't look worried. He looks annoyed. This was different.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave him. He's doing what he promised. When he finds something, he'll tell us. That's Elder Mo.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Setting the Star Iron
quests.summary: The star iron you brought from the isles goes into the formation's heart. Elder Mo wants your soul to guide it in.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Star iron in the heart. Guide it with your soul. It remembers the sky. It'll want to go back. Don't let it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Elder Bai?

objectives.text: Guide the star iron into the formation's heart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The star iron sinks into the heart of the formation like a stone into a pond. The whole plaza shivers once, and settles.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In. The heart's set. Now the crystals. Then the feathers. Then... then I finish the outer ring, and we're done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (hiding behind Elder Mo) Oh.

quests.title: Charging the Crystals
quests.summary: The thunder crystals must be charged at the cliff edge, where lightning strikes the mountain in storms.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Mo's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals charge where lightning strikes. The cliff edge, in the storm tonight. Don't stand too close. Stand exactly close enough.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Elder Mo said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.text: Set the thunder crystals on the cliff
Meet Yan Tie at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I watched from Thunder Peak! The lightning hit every crystal! You didn't even flinch! Thunder Peak is very proud of you!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Fan Rui. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm! Sensible! Loudly sensible!

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Yan Tie) Oh.

quests.title: Storm Visitors
quests.summary: The storm brings more than lightning. Blood Moon cultivators use the thunder to cover their climb.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Under the thunder! They're climbing under the thunder so nobody hears them! Thunder Peak can't hear anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Han Xue said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lu Ping.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Moon cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Hold the inner sect gate against more Blood Moon cultivators
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They want the formation damaged before it's lit. Or... no. They didn't touch it. They went around it. Why go around it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Feathers in the Outer Ring
quests.summary: The phoenix feathers go into the outer ring, the ring Elder Mo hasn't finished checking.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Phoenix feathers in the outer ring. Mo says wait. He's not done checking. I've told him the copy is certified. He says 'so was Gu'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Lay the phoenix feathers in the outer ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The feathers settle into the outer ring's grooves. Where they touch one particular rune, they curl, very slightly, as if from heat.

objectives.text: Bring word to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Curled? Feathers don't curl. Mo. MO! ...He's asleep. At last. I'll tell him in the morning. It's probably nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Sect Master. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Elder Bai) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Irregular! Marvellously irregular. Unrecordable, even.

quests.title: Mo Asleep
quests.summary: Elder Mo is asleep at the formation's edge for the first time in weeks. Nobody has the heart to wake him.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He's asleep. Sitting up. With his lamp still lit. I put a blanket on him. He said 'adequate blanket' in his sleep.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Yan Tie. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Let him sleep. He's been awake for weeks. He'll find whatever he's looking for with fresh eyes. Or he won't, and it's nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Take a cup first. Tea steadies the hand and cools the head.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I left peaches by his lamp. Anonymous. It's our tradition.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo's last order was to wake him if the runes flickered. They are flickering, a little.

choices.text: Wake him, as ordered

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Let him sleep and watch the runes yourself

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Fix the runes yourself and take the credit

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Last Spar Before the Lighting
quests.summary: Zhao Kang wants a spar. He says it's to celebrate. He's nervous. Everyone is nervous and nobody knows why.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Spar. Now. I'm nervous and I don't know why. When I'm nervous, I hit things. Better you than the formation.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Bai. That's my job.

objectives.text: Spar with Zhao Kang's practice puppets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The training puppets spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Better. Still nervous. The whole mountain's nervous. The birds are nervous. Wei Tong only ate one breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Xiao Man.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Acceptable.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: The Whole Mountain Waits
quests.summary: Lu Ping has a theory about why everyone is nervous. Xiao Shi has a better one.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: My theory: everyone's nervous because nobody's had a disaster in weeks and we're out of practice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Lu Ping, did you hear about the Refectory?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I heard it first, Fan Rui. I always hear it first.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: In the cages, before something bad, the guards would go quiet. Everyone felt it. Nobody knew what it was.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It feels like that. I'm sorry. I'm probably wrong. I hope I'm wrong.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He's not wrong. The carp are all at the bottom of the pond. They never go to the bottom. Not even in winter.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: No, Lu Ping. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at Xiao Man) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Blood Moon Scouts, Circling
quests.summary: The demon cultivators who went around the formation are still out there, circling the mountain instead of leaving.

objectives.text: Light the spirit lamp at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trim the spirit lamp. The light spreads, and the shadows it drives back were hiding marks on the wall.

objectives.text: Clear the cave behind the waterfall of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Moon cultivators come on in silence.

objectives.text: Recover phoenix feathers from the cave behind the waterfall
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Old Qiu's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Star Iron, the Reserve
quests.summary: Elder Mo wants a reserve of star iron set aside, separate from the formation's heart, in case repairs are needed later.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me star iron from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Gather star iron at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Return to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ignore Xiao Man. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more star iron than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Wei Tong Guards the Lamp
quests.summary: Wei Tong appoints himself guard of Elder Mo's lamp while he sleeps, and takes the job with total seriousness.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nobody touches the lamp. Nobody. Not even to refill the oil. I refill the oil. That's my job now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

objectives.text: Fight off the training puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: More training puppets? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Old Bao. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Wei Tong, I'm only listening.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Golem, Restless
quests.summary: The stone golem from the festival wanders near the formation again, agitated by something in the air.

objectives.text: Make your way to the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit tea terraces curve around the southern slope, glossy leaves catching the light in green waves.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Tell Xiao Man what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The golem's pacing. It never paces. Something's got it nervous too, and it doesn't even have nerves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Ling Qiu. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (grinning at Xiao Man) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Watch
quests.summary: Xiao Shi volunteers to keep watch through the quiet nights, saying she trusts her own instincts about danger more than most.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'll watch. I know what quiet-before-bad feels like better than anyone here. Let me use that for something good.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Zhao Kang. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Listen to Ling Qiu. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the plum garden.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Lu Ping. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Thunder Crystals, a Second Charging
quests.summary: A second batch of thunder crystals needs charging at the cliff edge before the lighting, as a reserve against the red thread.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, then a fourth to be safe) {senior}! Sorry. You're very high up now. It's hard not to bow.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me thunder crystals from the spirit peach orchard, would you?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you, by the way. I always bet on you. I've bought four hats.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Pick up thunder crystals near the spirit peach orchard
Report back to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Don't make me say it twice.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha. Elder Mo's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Lu Ping will leave out. There is always a part.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the thunder crystals you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: (to Lu Ping, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: The Circling Scouts, Driven Off
quests.summary: The circling demon cultivators finally make a move, testing the mountain's watch in the dark before dawn.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Meet Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Driven off. Again. They're not trying to win. They're testing. Someone's collecting information on us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Sleepless Night
quests.summary: Bai Ling can't sleep, rereading the certified archive copy for anything Elder Mo might have missed.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I've read it eleven times. It's certified. Gu's seal is on every page. I don't understand how it could be wrong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Zhao Kang is not wrong. Zhao Kang is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the medicine valley

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Noted, Zhao Kang. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell. It bites, and it holds grudges.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Hua. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Steadying the Nerves
quests.summary: With the whole mountain on edge, Elder Yan organizes one more round of drills, insisting steady hands make steady soldiers.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Man out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Deal with the training puppets at the mountain road.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Xiao Man is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: See? Even Elder Hua agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Stop the training puppets at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Bring word to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three herbs today! Well. Three that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's going in my stories. The good ones.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

quests.title: The Night Before the Peak
quests.summary: The night before you bring your soul to its peak, Han Xue sits with you and says nothing useful, which is exactly what you need.

objectives.text: Scout the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the mission hall is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run the beads of the abacus desk. The accounts come out one sum short, every month, for years.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't have anything wise to say. I just didn't want you sitting up here alone tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Xiao Shi. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
