dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Soul at the Peak
quests.summary: You sit on the stone bridge and let your nascent soul reach its peak, as if something in you knows you'll need it soon.

objectives.text: Bring your nascent soul to its peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul sits cross-legged in your chest, lotus in its hands, and opens its eyes very wide. Great Perfection of Nascent Soul.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the formation behind you glows blue. In one place, in the outer ring, the blue has a thread of red in it.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You look like you saw something. Did you see something?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: A red thread in the outer ring. Very thin. I'll tell Elder Mo when he wakes.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Telling Mo
quests.summary: Elder Mo wakes at dawn. You tell him about the red thread and the curling feathers. He goes very still.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Red thread. Outer ring. Curling feathers. Hm.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bai's copy is certified. Gu kept that archive for thirty years. ...Thirty years. Leave it with me. Three more nights.

objectives.text: Show Elder Mo where the red thread runs

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You point. He looks. For a long moment he says nothing at all, and his hand, holding the lamp, is not quite steady.

objectives.text: See Elder Mo again

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go and rest. Tell no one yet. Not the Sect Master, not Bai. Not until I'm sure. Three nights. I'll check every rune on that ring.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Elder Mo, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go on, {junior}. Adequate work. More than adequate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Mo) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Three Nights
quests.summary: Elder Mo begins his three nights. The mountain goes quiet around him, and waits.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo's asked for three nights before the lighting. He won't say why. Forty years I've known him. He's never asked for anything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Wei Tong has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'll give him three nights. And you. Rest. Whatever Mo finds, we'll need you rested.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Three nights. I'll bring him soup every night. He'll say adequate. I'll say you're welcome. That's our tradition now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhong Ming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Great Azure Formation
quests.summary: The Great Azure Formation is nearly complete. Elder Mo has been checking its runes for three nights without sleep.

objectives.text: Watch Elder Mo inspect the Great Azure Formation
Inspect the Great Azure Formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ten thousand runes glow a calm blue. Only in the outer ring, one branch seems to twist, like a signature written backwards.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Three nights, ten thousand runes. My eyes feel like two boiled dumplings. Don't tell Wei Tong I said that.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I found something. A turn in the outer ring that shouldn't be there. I need one more night to be certain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Here. My old sword tassel. My master gave it to me when I formed my core. It's yours now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder, why give it to me now?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Because I'm old, and I forget things. Better to give it too early than too late. Go on, {junior}.

objectives.text: Spend an evening with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're back! You're taller. Are you taller? Nascent Soul makes people taller, I read it somewhere. Maybe.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo's been in a strange mood. Keeps patting my shoulder. He gave me his tea set. His good tea set.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old men do that before long journeys. He's not going anywhere, is he?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He gave me his whetstone. Elder Mo never gives anyone anything. I didn't like it either, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He's checking the runes. That's all. He'll be fine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: A Letter from the Abyss
quests.summary: A crow has brought a letter to the sect gate, addressed to you, in the traitor's hand.

objectives.text: Collect the letter from Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A crow brought this. A crow! It bit me. Twice. It had opinions.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: It's addressed to you. The seal is the Law Hall's. I thought about burning it. Then I thought, you'd want to know.

objectives.text: Break the Law Hall seal on the letter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Come to the Heart Mirror, alone. I will tell you how to save your sect. Bring anyone, and I will tell you nothing. Gu Hanshan.

objectives.text: Show the letter to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's a trap. Obviously. Everything Gu does is a trap wrapped in a lesson.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: But if he knows something about the formation... Elder Mo found a flaw. I can't ignore this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Then take Dumpling. Take two Dumplings. Take me. Nobody said anything about swords.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I know. That's what worries me. Go. If you're not back by dawn, I'm telling Elder Mo, and then I'm coming to drag you home.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Mirror Pool
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan waits in the depths of the Blood Moon Abyss, alone and unarmed.

objectives.text: Slip past the scavengers on the field of bones
Hear the traitor out in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You came alone. Good. Then listen, because there is no time. The formation your sect built is a key, not a lock.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Twenty years ago I altered the archive copy. Seven runes. When it is lit, it will pour the sect's qi into the Abyss and break the seal from above.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I did it for Lan. The Patriarch swore he held her soul. He did. He fed it to the Heart Mirror long ago. I heard her screaming there.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I cannot face the mirror. It shows me what I am. You can. Free her. Then run home before they light it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He speaks the truth, for once. I watched him at the mirror. He never looks into it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The nameless one. So you did not come alone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I didn't bring him. He brings himself.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Careful. I know where that road ends.

objectives.text: Approach the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pool of black water, perfectly still. Your reflection looks back at you. Then it smiles, a moment before you do.

quests.title: The Heart Demon
quests.summary: The mirror has let something out. It wears your face and knows all your fears.

objectives.text: Face the reflection in the Heart Mirror
Defeat your heart demon

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: You were never chosen, {player}. You were only unlucky enough to be born holding the key.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Everyone you love will die because of that pendant. Mo. Han Xue. That silly girl by the pond. Give it to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're not me. You're only the part of me that's afraid.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Then why are your hands shaking?

objectives.text: Still the mirror and free the trapped souls

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit at the water's edge. Your hands stop shaking. The mirror ripples, and light rises from it like fireflies.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hundreds of souls, drifting upward. One stops in front of you: a girl with Gu's eyes, who bows once, and is gone.

objectives.text: Return to Gu Hanshan

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I saw her. She bowed to you. She always had better manners than her father.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Go. Now. The formation... I can feel it waking even from here. Run, {player}, run!

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll get him out of the Abyss. Go, {player}. Faster than you have ever run.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then run with me, both of you!

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Burning Sky over Azure Cloud
quests.summary: The sky above the sect has turned red. The Great Azure Formation has been lit.

objectives.text: Race back to the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}! The formation lit itself at midnight. Blood Moon disciples came out of nowhere, in our robes!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Elder Mo went into the array. He told everyone to stay back. The light's gone red. It's gone all red!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Where's the Sect Master? Where's Han Xue?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue's at the array! I'm holding the gate! Go!

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: By the precepts! I know those! Well, most of them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

objectives.text: Cut through the infiltrators at the gate
Clear the demonic cultivators guarding the array

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're protecting the array! They want it to keep burning. {player}, get to Elder Mo!

quests.title: Elder Mo's Choice
quests.summary: At the heart of the burning formation, Elder Mo makes his last decision.

objectives.text: Witness Elder Mo's last stand
Stand with the Sect Master at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He poured his whole life into the array's eye and turned the flow back. Seventy years of cultivation, in one breath.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The seal holds. The sect lives. And Mo Changfeng is gone.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He asked me to tell you something. He said, adequate. More than adequate.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He gave me his tea set. I thought he was being nice. He was saying goodbye, and I didn't even notice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I was going to make him dumplings. Proper ones, for his birthday. I've been practising for a month.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Make them anyway, Senior Brother. We'll eat them for him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We'll all eat them, Wei Tong. Every one. Even the burnt ones.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The Law Hall's going to write you a very long letter.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Ashes and Incense
quests.summary: The sect mourns Elder Mo Changfeng.

objectives.text: Toll the great bell nine times

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine strokes. Across the mountain, every disciple stops what they are doing and bows toward the hall.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I've mended a thousand broken bones for that stubborn old man. He never once said thank you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: He'd leave peaches on my doorstep instead. Every autumn, for forty years. I'll miss the peaches.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I brought plum blossoms. Elder Mo pretended he didn't like flowers, but he always smelled them when he thought no one was looking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Are you all right? You don't have to be. My brother says being all right is overrated.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I said overrated. I also said it's allowed. Sit with us a while, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Both of you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (thinks very hard) Yes. I agree.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering to Xiao Man) That was amazing.

objectives.text: Remember Elder Mo at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sea of clouds, where you first condensed your qi. Elder Mo's tassel flutters in your hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Back straight. A crooked spine makes a crooked meridian. You straighten your back, and weep, and breathe.

quests.title: What the Patriarch Wants
quests.summary: With the altered formation in pieces, Elder Bai can finally read what it was meant to do.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai's findings

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I've read the seven altered runes. The formation would open the Abyss upward, like a stairwell, for one soul to climb.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Patriarch cannot survive the heavenly tribulation in his own body. Too much blood, too much sin. Heaven would erase him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He needs a body with a clean dao and the Verdant Lotus in its veins. The mirror was meant to crack your heart so he could step in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He wants to wear me. To ascend in my skin.

objectives.text: Compare the altered runes with the Heart Sutra

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Laid beside the Heart Sutra, the seven altered runes are plain as day: a lotus drawn upside down, a door drawn inside out.

objectives.text: Face Gu Hanshan in chains at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I surrendered at your gate an hour after you left the mirror. The Sect Master says my fate is yours to decide.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Execute me. It's what the precepts demand. I wrote half of them.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The precepts are mine to keep now, Gu. And I have given this choice away.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. Come with us to the Abyss. Fight as an elder of the Azure Cloud. If you must die, die as one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...Mo would have said the same. Very well. I will show you the way through the black gate.

objectives.choice_prompt: Gu Hanshan asks you for nothing. You could give him something anyway.

choices.text: A cup of tea

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Nothing. He's a traitor.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Spit at his feet

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Five Oaths
quests.summary: Before the final assault, gather your allies and hear their oaths.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang's oath

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan sent me a letter telling me to come home where it's safe. I used it to light incense for Elder Mo.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I swear on my brother's name, I'll be at your side at the black gate. Try not to steal all the glory.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Shi's oath

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I can't fight like you. But I know the Abyss. I was there for weeks. I'll draw every path I remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Man Man is making medicine bundles. Hundreds of them. She's only dropped a few.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian's oath

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is open. All of it. Take whatever you need. Spirit stones are useless to the dead.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I have counted every stone in this sect for thirty years. Tonight I will count nothing. Just come back.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steward Qian, counting nothing. Somebody paint this moment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back, Steward. I'll even bring you a receipt.

objectives.text: Collect Xiao Man's medicine bundles for the army
Meet Ye Wuming at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The blood moon rises in three days. On that night the Patriarch will break free with or without your formation.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The children you let me take are with me. And Iron-Fang, with his men. We will open the way.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I owe you a name, {player}. I intend to pay.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note
Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Spirit Stones From Every Disciple
quests.summary: Steward Qian asks every disciple, not just you, to give what spirit stones they can spare for the march.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Bai's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me spirit stones from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Elder Hua, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the medicine valley
Return to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Knowledge is like tea. Too hot, and it scalds. Too cold, and nobody wants it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

quests.title: Blood Guard Scouts on the Mountain Road
quests.summary: Blood Moon scouts test the mountain's defenses one last time before the blood moon rises.

objectives.text: Hurry to the gate post

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the gate post, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the outer dormitories
Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Dumplings, Finally
quests.summary: Wei Tong finishes the dumplings he'd been practicing for Elder Mo's birthday, and insists on sharing them before the march.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're not perfect. He'd have said adequate. I'll take adequate. Eat one. For him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Tang Ling.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhong Ming. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Mind the smoke from the east kilns. It's thicker than it looks and ruder than it smells.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Medicine Bundles, the Second Batch
quests.summary: Xiao Man's medicine bundles run short of the army's need. Elder Hua asks for a second batch before dawn.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The Sect Master thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Han Xue. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the medicine valley
Go back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Map of the Abyss
quests.summary: Bai Ling, working from Xiao Shi's memory and the Law Hall's oldest scrolls, draws a map of the Abyss for the march.

objectives.text: Go to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The long refectory smells of rice, ginger and a hundred disciples who trained since dawn.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Shi's memory and Gu's old scrolls, together. I think this is close. I hope it's close. Lives depend on close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Fan Rui. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The chronicles are full of cruelty. Thank you for a better page.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Corrupted Wolves at the Mountain's Foot
quests.summary: Corrupted wolves gather at the mountain's foot, drawn by the blood moon's coming light.

objectives.text: Read the rim of the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three legs, two handles, and a rim of ancient script: the bronze ding is older than the hall that shelters it.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The corrupted wolves have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the corrupted wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Sect Master's Address
quests.summary: Before the army departs, the Sect Master speaks to every disciple gathered in the plaza, crown on, voice steady.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ten thousand years our founders held this seal with what they had. Tonight we hold it with everything we are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo Changfeng bought us three days with his whole life. Let's not waste a single hour of them.

objectives.text: Talk with Lu Ping at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nobody tells the gate disciple anything. So I listen. Constantly.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, One Last Skirmish
quests.summary: A final skirmish breaks out at the outer gate as demon cultivators probe the sect's readiness.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Clear the sect gate of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the sect gate
Tell Elder Hua what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: We're done at the herb terraces. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Did you spend anything? Lose anything? Borrow anything from anyone who writes things down?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (hiding behind Elder Hua) Oh.

quests.title: Lu Ping's Ledger of the Dead
quests.summary: Lu Ping insists on reading, aloud, the names of everyone the sect has lost since the seal first cracked.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Someone has to say their names before we march. I volunteered. I didn't know it would be this long a list.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhong Ming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Steadying Every Heart
quests.summary: Before the army departs, you walk the ranks and steady whichever hearts need steadying, including your own.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You don't have to be steady for all of us. Just walk with us. That's steady enough.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Old Qiu. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soul and body blur at the edges. The wind feels like part of your own breath.

objectives.text: Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (beaming at Han Xue) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Soul Transformation
quests.summary: The Great Azure Formation has been repaired, its seven runes turned true. Use its power to transform your soul.

objectives.text: Set spirit stones into the repaired formation
Transform your soul at the heart of the formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where Elder Mo gave his life, you sit. The formation rises around you, blue and clean. It feels like being held.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul grows, merges with your body, and the boundary between you and heaven and earth thins like mist.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Mo. I'll carry it from here.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Soul Transformation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Heaven's eye opens over you. Your soul is changing, and heaven wants to know into what.

objectives.text: Receive the Sect Master's blessing

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Soul Transformation. Heaven itself will notice you now. So will the Patriarch.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In three days we march on the Abyss, every disciple who can hold a sword. We end this, as our founders could not.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo believed in you before any of us. Let's prove him right, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We march together. All of us. He would have called that adequate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then let's be adequate, Sect Master. For him.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Three Days Later
quests.summary: The blood moon rises in three days, Ye Wuming said. On the third day the vanguard of the Azure Cloud stands at the Abyss.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The vanguard goes first. You, Han Xue, Zhao Kang, Wei Tong. Ye Wuming's people. Iron-Fang's men. Gu, in chains, to show the way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Ye Wuming. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'll hold the formation from the mountain. If the seal holds tonight, we finish this. If not, we finish it anyway.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The canyon rim is crowded with blue robes and black ones. Above, the moon is rising, and it is the colour of a wound.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The moon's rising. He'll try to break the seal tonight. With or without your formation. We'll see which.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not this time, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Ye Wuming, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: The Traitor in Chains
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan walks in chains beside the vanguard. Some of the disciples spit as he passes. Zhao Kang doesn't.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Gu's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: They spit. They're right to. I would have, once. I wrote the precept about treason myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Zhao Kang. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The black gate is past the obelisk ring. I'll show you. After tonight you'll have no use for me.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I promised myself I'd ask you one thing. Why did you send my brother to the bamboo forest?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...Because he was asking about the Law Hall's grain. He was clever. I was afraid. I'm sorry. It's worth nothing. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: No. It's worth something. Not much. Something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Gu Hanshan, in chains, asks for water. The guards' orders: nothing until the trial.

choices.text: Give him water

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Follow the order

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Pour it out in front of him

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Bone Field Holds
quests.summary: The Blood Moon's last army waits on the bone field. It does not expect the Iron Scale's banners behind yours.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty of my men, and the Iron Scale's banners on the left! Didn't know they were coming! Nobody tells a bandit anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Blood Guards ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: For Elder Mo! Hey, Elder, are you watching? I'm doing the stance right! Mostly!

objectives.text: Investigate the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The line breaks. Across the steaming pools the black gate stands open, and beyond it, something vast is waking.

quests.title: The Moon Rises
quests.summary: At the obelisk ring, you feel the blood moon reach its height, and the whole Abyss pulls upward at the seal.

objectives.text: Search the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blood moon stands overhead. The earth heaves. Every obelisk stump lights red at once, pulling upward, pulling at the seal.

objectives.text: Press your palm to the shuddering earth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Through your soul you feel it: the Azure Eye on the mountain, blue and whole, and beneath you the seal, holding. Holding. Holding.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's holding. The seal's holding. Elder Mo's formation is holding. He can't get out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Sect Master. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: The Fortress Folds
quests.summary: Then the Patriarch does something nobody expected. The black gate, the fortress and the altar fold into nothing.

objectives.text: Head to the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the pools the black fortress creases like paper. It folds, and folds again, smaller and smaller, into a seam of purple dark.

objectives.text: Reach into the fold with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing. Not darkness, not stone. Nothing. The void, between one place and another. The black gate is in there somewhere, very far away.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's gone where no army can follow. Folded his home into the void and taken it with him. Behind that fold are my... Iron-Fang's family.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Xiao Shi.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He won't come out tonight. He'll come out when he's ready. He's always been very good at waiting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: What the Fold Leaves Behind
quests.summary: The fold leaves a wound in the air, and things come out of it: shapes of purple dark with hands.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Things coming out of the nothing! With hands! Why does everything bad have hands?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the bone throne
Talk with Han Xue at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Void wraiths. The fold is leaking. The Abyss is going to be dangerous in a completely new way. Wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

quests.title: Iron-Fang at the Fold
quests.summary: Iron-Fang stands at the edge of the fold with his hand pressed flat against nothing.

objectives.text: See what Iron-Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They were behind that gate. My sister. My men's children. I came to bring them home. Now there isn't a gate.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Down here everything has a price. Especially directions. These ones are free. Once.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. I don't know how to pay this one. There's nothing to hit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: There will be, Tie Hu. He'll open it again. He has to. And we'll be there.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...You're a fool, sect brat. I keep saying that. I keep believing you.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the soul forge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: What Iron-Fang said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Xiao Shi, I'm only listening.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the obsidian spires

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hm. Iron-Fang is not wrong. Iron-Fang is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The sect never did tame {them}.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Choice
quests.summary: The Sect Master arrives at the rim through the array. She listens, looks at the fold, and makes the hardest choice of her life.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We came to finish it. He's folded himself into nothing. I can't march an army into nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Wei Tong, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: So we go home. We get strong enough to walk into nothing. We break whatever he's waiting for. And we come back.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He's waiting for you, Lotus heir. For your tribulation. That's the only door heaven will open for him. You're his key and his ladder both.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Gu has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. That's all I seem to say now. I'm sorry.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it started, for me.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Collecting the Wounded
quests.summary: The retreat is orderly. Xiao Shi, who knows every path, leads the wounded to the array. You carry what he can't.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know every path down here. I'll lead the wounded. You carry the medicine. My sister made eight hundred bundles. Eight hundred.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Gather Xiao Man's medicine bundles for the wounded
Bring word to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Everyone out. Nobody left behind. That's the rule I made in the cages. I'm keeping it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Han Xue. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Void Wraiths, Cleaning the Rim
quests.summary: The wound in the air keeps leaking void wraiths even after the retreat begins. The rim needs clearing before it's safe to leave.

objectives.text: Read the ledgers at the abacus desk at the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The abacus desk is covered in neat figures. Between them, in a smaller hand, someone has written a name.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the corpse forest

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Collect demon cores around the corpse forest
Talk it over with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Bone Field
quests.summary: The fallen demon cultivators leave behind cores worth harvesting before the Abyss reclaims the field.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me demon cores from the forbidden library. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't mind Zhao Kang. He says rude things when he's fond of people.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I say rude things when they're true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Find the demon cores at the forbidden library
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the demon cores you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Fold, Measured
quests.summary: Before leaving, you study the fold's edge with your soul, trying to learn its shape for whenever it opens again.

objectives.text: Make your way to the training pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the training pit not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Examine the puppet frame

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tighten the cords of the puppet frame. It twitches, tries a stance, and looks at you expectantly.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Memorize it. Every crease. If it opens again, even for a second, we need to know exactly where.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha! Now you're talking like the old road.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Silence
quests.summary: Wei Tong, usually the loudest voice in any retreat, says nothing at all on the walk back to the array.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He hasn't said a word. Wei Tong. Not one word. That scares me more than the wraiths did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Sect Master. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the lava falls. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. The Sect Master is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. The Sect Master does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the obsidian spires

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the obsidian spires.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Blood Guard, the Last Stragglers
quests.summary: A handful of Blood Moon stragglers, cut off by the fold, must be dealt with before the retreat is complete.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the beast pens

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the beast pens

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Guards spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the beast pens
Tell Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the burned hall isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Answer Ye Wuming, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Wound
quests.summary: The wound in the air sheds strange void shards, unlike anything the sect's collectors have catalogued before.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Bring me void shards from the ash plains. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut it, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the ash plains
Return to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: No argument.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging Iron-Fang's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Men, Steadied
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's men, shaken by the fold swallowing their families' hope, need steadying before the long march home.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Steady, all of you. We came for a door. We'll come back when there's a door again. Until then, we march.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Han Xue.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the ruined sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the blood river

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.
