objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Mercy. I forgot how it looks.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Elder Gu) That was cold.

quests.title: Gu's Chains, Loosened
quests.summary: The Sect Master orders Gu Hanshan's chains loosened, not removed, in recognition of his help at the fold.

objectives.text: Scout the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lanterns of human skin light the shadow market. The haggling is quiet and very polite.

objectives.text: Taste the wine jars

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jars are sealed with clay and stamped. One seal is fresh, though the jar is very old.

objectives.text: Compare notes with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Loosened. Not removed. You are still a traitor, Gu Hanshan. You are also, tonight, useful. Both things are true.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging the Sect Master's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Silence
quests.summary: Ye Wuming watches the fold long after everyone else has turned to leave, saying nothing until you join him.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've hunted this man for longer than you've been alive. Tonight is the closest I've come. It doesn't feel like close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Shi at the ash plains

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Ye Wuming. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Heh. Knew it.

quests.title: The Wound's Last Guardians
quests.summary: A final cluster of things-with-hands guards the wound itself, reluctant to let the vanguard leave unbothered.

objectives.text: Snuff the soul lantern at the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pale flame flickers inside the soul lantern, and in the flame, for an instant, a face.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Pick up demon cores near the skull tower
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about food, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about your clan, Zhao Kang?

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Wei Tong) That was cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Long War
quests.summary: On the rim, as the blood moon sets, Ye Wuming tells you the war has just changed shape.

objectives.text: Hear Ye Wuming out

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It was going to be one night. Now it's a long war. Against a patriarch who isn't here, and seven servants who are.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Zhao Kang's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Ladder. The rungs. Break them and he has nothing to climb when he comes out. I'll hunt with you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Still no name, Ye Wuming?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not yet. It's close. I can feel it, like a word on the tip of the tongue. I'll tell you when I have it.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Coming Home to an Empty Step
quests.summary: The vanguard comes home. At the hall steps, where Elder Mo always stood, there is nobody to tell you you're late.

objectives.text: Hurry to the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hall steps are swept and empty. Somebody has left a cup of tea where Elder Mo used to stand. It has gone cold.

objectives.text: Meet Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I keep expecting him to come out and shout at me. I've started standing up straight in case. It doesn't help.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Wei Tong hasn't left the training ground since you got back. He's just sitting with the puppets. Not training. Sitting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm... not going to tell anyone about that one.

quests.title: Wei Tong With the Puppets
quests.summary: Wei Tong is sitting among the training puppets, the way Elder Mo sat among his runes.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He used to bet me buns on how many puppets the new ones could break. I lost every bet. On purpose. He knew.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Sect Master. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I made his birthday dumplings. We ate them. You said we'd eat them for him. We did. It didn't help.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't supposed to help, Senior Brother. It was supposed to hurt a little less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...It hurts exactly the same. But I'm eating again. That's something, right? Tell me that's something.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Wei Tong. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Drink this. No, it doesn't taste good. That's how you know it works.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Man at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Xiao Man said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: See? Even Wei Tong agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says I'm improving. She said it with her eyes closed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at Xiao Man) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Red at the Edges Again
quests.summary: Elder Hua has three disciples in the infirmary with red at the edges of their eyes. No pill caused it this time.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Red at the edges. No Frenzy Pill this time. They're grieving, and something is feeding on the grief.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: If it's hot, don't touch it. If it's glowing, don't even look at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Kiln-Mistress Tao has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Go to the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the pavilion a disciple sits hugging his knees, whispering to someone who isn't there, and the someone whispers back.

objectives.text: Look at the grieving disciple with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soul sight shows a shadow on his shoulder, small and grey, feeding. Heart demons. Dozens of them, all over the mountain.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Heart demons. The void fold at the Abyss loosened something. Grief is an open door, and things are walking through it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Answer Tang Ling, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Shades on the Mountain
quests.summary: At dusk the grief-shades gather, more than anyone can count, drawn to the sect like moths to a lamp.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're coming out at dusk. Everywhere there's someone grieving. Which is everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Clear the long stone stairway of grief-shades

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Cut down the grief-shades that follow
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They scatter when you strike them. They come back when people remember. We can't strike grief.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Xiao Shi's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: What You Did at the Mirror
quests.summary: You faced your own heart demon at the Heart Mirror. Elder Hua asks you to teach the grieving how.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You faced yours at the mirror. What did you do? Not the fighting. Before.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I said it out loud. What I was afraid of. It's smaller when it's said.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Old Qiu. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then teach them to say it. I'll bring them to the stone bridge. You sit with them.

objectives.text: Sit with the grieving on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one they say it. I miss him. I'm afraid I'll die too. I should have said thank you. The shades on their shoulders shrink.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: It's working. The shades are getting smaller. My brother said his, too. He said he misses the cages. He hates that he does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Elder Hua. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Biggest Shade
quests.summary: One shade isn't shrinking. It has grown so large it walks on its own, and it is walking toward Wei Tong.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: There's a shade at the training ground as big as a man. It looks like... it looks like you. But it's following Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Zhong Ming said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Investigate the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the weapon rack, a shadow shaped like you stands behind Wei Tong, bent close, whispering in his ear.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It says it was your fault. That you went to the mirror and left Elder Mo alone. It sounds like you. It uses your voice.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I know it's not true. I know. But it's so loud. Make it stop. Please make it stop.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering to Wei Tong) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Despair
quests.summary: The heart demon feeding on Wei Tong has taken the shape of the person he'd least like to blame. You.

objectives.text: Repair the puppet frame at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shade steps away from Wei Tong and turns. It has your face, your stance, your sword. Its eyes are Wei Tong's grief.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Someone has scratched a tally of defeats into the puppet frame. The puppet is winning.

objectives.name: Wei Tong's Despair
objectives.text: Defeat Wei Tong's Despair

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't hold back because it looks like you! It's not you! You're... you're my friend! Hit it!

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It's gone. It's quiet. For the first time since the formation lit, it's quiet in my head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Bai. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Wei Tong said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It wasn't your fault. I knew that. I just needed someone to hit the part of me that didn't. Thank you. I'm hungry.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you never to tell anyone what his heart demon looked like.

choices.text: Promise

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering to Wei Tong) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Tell Elder Hua, so she can help him

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Laugh about it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Tea for the Empty Step
quests.summary: Wei Tong wants to do something for Elder Mo. Something he'd grumble at. He decides on tea, at the hall steps, every morning.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Every morning. A cup of tea on the hall steps, where he stood. He'd hate it. He'd say tea is for people who've finished training.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you have crumbs on your sword.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're lucky crumbs. Dumpling likes them.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: So we'll train first. Then tea. Help me carry the pot.

objectives.text: Pick tea leaves from the terraces
Pour the first cup at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rises from the cup on the empty step. Nobody drinks it. Everybody who passes bows to it. Then goes to train.

objectives.text: Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd hate it so much. It's perfect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Xiao Shi. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Grief
quests.summary: The Sect Master has not wept for Elder Mo. Elder Bai asks you to go and see her. He says she won't see him.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai out

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: She won't see me. She won't see Hua. She's in the main hall with the doors shut, and she's not in seclusion. She's hiding.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty years. He argued with every decision I made. I'd give the sect to hear him argue with one more.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Be careful, {senior}!

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Fan Rui. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I can't weep. If I weep, I'll stop, and I can't stop. There's too much to do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He'd say you're being stubborn, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: ...He would. He'd say it exactly like that. Close the door on your way out. I'm going to be stubborn in private for an hour.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Grief-Shades, the Training Ground
quests.summary: A few grief-shades linger at the training ground even after Wei Tong's shade is gone, feeding on smaller sorrows.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Fight off the grief-shades

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These grief-shades fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the outer dormitories
Share your findings with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Old Bao. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a scratch? Let me check. Hm. One scratch. I'll allow it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Incense for Every Hall
quests.summary: Elder Hua asks for incense to be lit in every hall on the mountain, a small steady thing while the shades thin.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Bring me incense bundles from the mountain road. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Wei Tong. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Give me an hour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Find the incense bundles at the mountain road
See Lu Ping again

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Did you see any rare herbs? Any at all? Even ugly ones? Especially ugly ones?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I was meditating. With my eyes closed. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the incense bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Lu Ping's Small Grief
quests.summary: Lu Ping admits, quietly, that his grief is smaller than everyone else's, and that this makes him feel guilty.

objectives.text: Go and see Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I barely knew him. Not like you, or Wei Tong. But I still feel it. Is it wrong to grieve someone you barely knew?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhong Ming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: No. A mountain misses its own weather. You don't have to have loved him best to miss him.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

objectives.text: Talk with Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yan Tie is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Wild! I like it. Don't tell the elders I said so.

quests.title: Wei Tong Teaches the Stance
quests.summary: Wei Tong, still raw, starts teaching Elder Mo's favorite stance to whoever will stand still long enough.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (guarded) {player}. People are saying things. I'm not asking. Yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Feet like this. He corrected mine four hundred times. I'm only going to correct yours forty. I'm being generous.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Elder Hua. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Break the training puppets at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: More training puppets? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore the Sect Master. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Right. That works.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (thinks very hard) Yes. I agree.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Question
quests.summary: Bai Ling asks you something she's clearly been afraid to ask: whether the heart demon told you anything true.

objectives.text: Search the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the spirit beast garden the air changes, heavy with qi and something older underneath.

objectives.text: Break open the cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Did it? Say anything true? You don't have to answer. I just — I want to know if grief lies about everything or just some things.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It lied about blame. It didn't lie about how much it would hurt.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Oh thank heavens. I was so nervous I watered the lanterns twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Xiao Man. We were attentive.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Irregular! Marvellously irregular. Unrecordable, even.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for Elder Hua's Tonic
quests.summary: Elder Hua brews a calming tonic for the grieving and needs fresh spirit herbs from the terraces.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, then a fourth to be safe) {senior}! Sorry. You're very high up now. It's hard not to bow.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me fresh spirit herbs from the spirit peach orchard. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Recover fresh spirit herbs from the spirit peach orchard
Go back to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. Old Bao's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (thinks very hard) Yes. I agree.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Shade That Looks Like Wei Tong
quests.summary: A smaller shade, shaped like Wei Tong himself, appears near a grieving junior disciple who blames himself for surviving.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Stop the grief-shades at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Han Xue) That was amazing.

quests.title: Elder Yan's Loud Grief
quests.summary: Elder Yan grieves the only way Thunder Peak knows how: loudly, and by making everyone else train harder.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I shout so I don't have to feel it quietly! It's a valid technique! Elder Mo would call it excessive! HE'D BE RIGHT!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Bai. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the ancestral tombs

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the ancestral tombs. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Xiao Shi. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find a book with turtle soup stains on it, it's mine. Return it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Medicine for the Last of the Infirmary
quests.summary: A handful of disciples remain in the infirmary, their shades stubborn. Elder Hua wants more medicine on hand.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Man. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the medicine valley
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

quests.title: Han Xue's Watch
quests.summary: Han Xue has taken to sitting with you in the evenings, not talking, just present, the way you once did for her.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'm not going to say anything wise. I'm just going to sit here. You did that for me once. I remember.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Han Xue has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the martial stage.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Wei Tong says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Han Xue agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Two leaves and a bud, disciple. Take only what you need, whatever you're picking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Auntie Ruo has earned the right to say it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Unorthodox treatment. It may even work.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Shades Thin
quests.summary: Night by night, the grief-shades thin. Not gone. Grief never goes. But smaller, and quieter, and no longer hungry.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The infirmary's empty. The shades are small now. They'll never be gone. Grief isn't a wound. It's a scar. Scars are fine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Ling Qiu. A poor master.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I told my sister I miss the cages. She didn't laugh. She held my hand. The shade on my shoulder is the size of a sparrow now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Xiao Shi is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I don't mind a sparrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Twelve at the Gate
quests.summary: Twelve new disciples climbed the nine thousand steps this spring. None of them know who Elder Mo was.

objectives.text: Go and see Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Twelve new ones! At the gate! Mud and hope, like always. One of them fainted on my boots. It felt like old times.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Yan Tie. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Twelve candidates stand at the gate, muddy and shaking. One clutches a letter. One clutches a chicken. Nobody knows why.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The outer court needs an elder. I have no elder to give it. I have Wei Tong. I'm going to ask him. Come with me. He'll say no.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Lu Ping. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging the Sect Master's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Wei Tong Says No
quests.summary: Wei Tong says no. Then no again. Then, at the hall steps, next to the cup of tea, he says something else.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No. I'm not an elder. I'm a senior outer disciple with a sword called Dumpling. Elder Mo was... he was Elder Mo.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He wrote your name in his notes. Under 'if I'm gone'. He wrote: Wei Tong. He'll say no. Ask twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...He wrote that? He wrote 'ask twice'?

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fine. Fine. I'll teach them. Not as an elder. As a senior brother who's very, very stubborn. He'd want stubborn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Sect Master. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: The First Lesson
quests.summary: Wei Tong's first lesson with the new disciples. He asks you to demonstrate, the way you did for him years ago.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Right! New disciples! This is {player}. Soul Transformation. Very scary. Watch the stance. Not the face. The face is distracting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Steward Qian said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Demonstrate on the puppets for the new disciples

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! Your sword follows your body! That's what he said to me. Now I'm saying it to you!

objectives.text: Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They stood up straight. All twelve. One of them saluted the puppet. I cried a bit. Don't tell them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Lu Ping. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Chickens and Contribution Points
quests.summary: The new disciple with the chicken has lost the chicken. It is somewhere on the mountain, being a chicken.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The girl with the chicken lost the chicken. It's her only family. Well, it's a chicken. But it's hers. Find it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Han Xue. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Search the plum garden for the lost chicken
See Wei Tong again

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You found it! In the plum garden! Eating plums! Qiu Hua is crying. The chicken is not. Chickens are very calm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering to Wei Tong) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Elder Mo's Notes
quests.summary: Elder Mo left notes on every outer disciple he ever taught. Wei Tong asks you to read them with him.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: His notes. On every disciple. Forty years of them. I found them under his bed. With his old tea set. The good one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Hua. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Read Elder Mo's notes with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wei Tong: eats too much, laughs too loud, heart the size of the mountain. Will make a better teacher than me. Do not tell him.

objectives.text: Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He said I'd be better than him. He never told me. He told the paper. Why do old men tell paper things?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because paper doesn't argue back.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The New Ones Test the Teacher
quests.summary: The new disciples challenge Wei Tong to a spar, all twelve at once. He asks you to stand beside him, just in case.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: All twelve at once! They think I'm soft because I cried at the salute! Stand next to me. I'm not soft. I'm... medium.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Wei Tong said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Stand beside Wei Tong against the new disciples

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The sparring disciples come on in silence.

objectives.text: Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Twelve on the floor, laughing. Nobody hurt. That's how you do it. You make them fall, then you make them laugh.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

quests.title: The Budget for Buns
quests.summary: Wei Tong asks Steward Qian for a budget for buns. For the new disciples. For morale. Steward Qian has opinions.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Buns! A budget for buns! Elder Mo never asked for buns!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He bet me buns every week for six years. I lost every bet. On purpose. That's three hundred buns. Consider it back pay.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: ...That's actually a very good argument. Fine. Buns. A small budget. Very small. Medium.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: He's going to be a wonderful teacher. He's already the only one who's ever beaten Qian in an argument.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian refused the bun budget. The treasury would never notice a few coppers.

choices.text: Pay from your own purse

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A gentle hand. That's the best medicine there is.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: File a proper request

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take it from the treasury

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Wolves at the Wall
quests.summary: Spring wolves come down from the snowline to the outer wall, hungry and young. Wei Tong takes the new disciples to watch.

objectives.text: Head to the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Young wolves nose along the outer wall, grey and thin. Twelve new disciples watch from the gate, frightened and thrilled.

objectives.text: Defeat the spirit wolves at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Watch how you drive them off. Not kill. Drive. They're only hungry. Hungry isn't a crime. Elder Mo taught me that.

objectives.text: Leave meat scraps for the wolves at the treeline
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They'll go back to the snowline now, fed. The new ones think we're heroes. We're just people who feed wolves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Standing Where He Stood
quests.summary: Wei Tong asks you to meditate at the hall steps, where Elder Mo stood every morning. He says someone should.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Someone should stand where he stood. Not me. I'd cry. You. Sit there. With the tea. Be grumpy at the sunrise.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Meditate at the hall steps at sunrise

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sun comes up over the sea of clouds. Your soul settles, deeper than it has since the formation. Middle stage of Soul Transformation.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Back straight, you think, and straighten it, and smile.

objectives.text: Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You straightened your back at the end. I saw. He'd have said adequate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Did you spend anything? Lose anything? Borrow anything from anyone who writes things down?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering to Wei Tong) That was amazing.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Outer Court
quests.summary: The outer court's twelve new disciples need spirit stones for their first formations. Wei Tong asks you to help gather them.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Tang Ling has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the spirit peach orchard
Bring word to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Tang Ling. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold out your wrist. Hm. Your pulse is stubborn. Like you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Elder Hua's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Tuned-Up Puppets
quests.summary: Wei Tong has Elder Bai tune the training puppets harder, insisting Elder Mo would want the new batch tested properly.

objectives.text: Light incense in the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the rim of the bronze ding by touch. It lists the names of those who made an oath around it.

objectives.text: Drive the tuned-up puppets from the training ground

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the outer pines
Talk it over with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The herb terraces is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Girl With the Chicken
quests.summary: Qiu Hua, the disciple with the chicken, asks Wei Tong shyly if the chicken can stay in the outer court permanently.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The chicken stays. I've decided. It's outer court morale now. Its name is Elder Drumstick. Don't tell Elder Yan.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Shi. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Xiao Shi said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Xiao Shi's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Jade Slips for the New Curriculum
quests.summary: Wei Tong, copying Elder Mo's method, wants jade slips prepared for the twelve new disciples' first lessons.

objectives.text: Find Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me jade slips from the laundry stream, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Not now, Fan Rui. Later. Over wine.

objectives.text: Recover jade slips from the laundry stream
See Steward Qian again

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more jade slips than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The Second Lesson
quests.summary: Wei Tong's second lesson goes worse than the first: one disciple hits herself in the face with her own sword.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Sword goes THAT way, not this way! Nobody panic, she's fine, she's laughing, see, she's fine!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

objectives.text: Clear the summit of Sword Peak of training puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Steward Qian. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Right. That works.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Lu Ping's Unsolicited Advice
quests.summary: Lu Ping, despite having never taught anyone anything, gives Wei Tong extensive unsolicited advice on teaching.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You should be stricter! Or gentler! One of those! I read a book about it once! I forget which one it recommended!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Hua.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Elder, the third kiln sneezed again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then feed it less charcoal and more patience, Hongyu.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

objectives.text: Talk with Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
