dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Spirit Wolves, a Second Pack
quests.summary: A second, larger pack of spirit wolves tests the outer wall, drawn by the scent of the first pack's fed retreat.

objectives.text: Test the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You close your hand on the hilt of the sword in the stone. It hums, weighs you, and decides to stay where it is.

objectives.text: Fight off the spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the outer pines
Share your findings with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Steward Qian's Bun Audit
quests.summary: Steward Qian insists on personally auditing the bun budget, suspicious that Wei Tong is overselling how few buns cost.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Three hundred buns is not a small budget! I have receipts! I have OPINIONS about these receipts!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Steward, the mission hall needs brushes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The mission hall needed brushes last year, Deacon.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Steward Qian is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Listen to Ling Qiu. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell. It bites, and it holds grudges.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the Chicken
quests.summary: Qiu Hua asks, very seriously, for spirit herbs to supplement Elder Drumstick's diet, insisting a sect chicken deserves better feed.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Bring me chicken feed from the medicine valley. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

objectives.text: Pick up chicken feed near the medicine valley
Go back to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Ling Qiu. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Xiao Shi Watches the New Ones
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, who remembers being new and frightened somewhere much worse than a sect gate, watches the twelve with quiet approval.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: They're scared the good way. The way you're scared of something worth being scared of. I like watching that heal into confidence.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Xiao Shi, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Sect Master.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: The third kiln sneezed again. I lost an eyebrow. It'll grow back. Last time it did.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Kiln-Mistress Tao?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Adequate
quests.summary: At the end of the first month, the twelve new disciples give Wei Tong a gift: a plaque for the weapon rack.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The new ones made a plaque for Wei Tong. They asked me what to carve. I said one word. They carved it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: What Wei Tong said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It says 'Adequate'. Just that. On the weapon rack. In terrible calligraphy. I'm never taking it down. Never.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Very funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Somebody bring me a bun. I'm having a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Wei Tong's sleeve) Is that allowed?

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Judge Wanted
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou needs a judge from the sect. The Sect Master sends you, and suggests you ask the last judge for advice.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Qingshi needs a judge. You're the closest thing to a judge I have who isn't in chains. Ask the one who is, before you go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Iron-Fang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You want advice. From me. The man who wrote half the precepts and broke all of them.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Gu has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Elder Gu) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Very well. Listen to everyone twice. Decide once. And never, ever judge someone for what you'd have done in their place. That was my mistake.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Rules broke me too. From the other side.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

objectives.text: Search the notice board at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The yamen courtyard is full. Petitioners, witnesses, three goats and one very loud rooster. Magistrate Zhou looks relieved to see you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Slips flutter on the notice board, three deep. Under a request for firewood, one note is newer, and written in a hurry.

quests.title: The Case of the Ferry
quests.summary: The first case: Old Pan and Merchant Jin both claim the old ferry landing. Both have documents. Both are shouting.

objectives.text: See what Old Pan wants

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years I've used that landing! Forty! My father used it! His father probably fell off it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Listen to Iron-Fang. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.text: Find Merchant Jin at the pawnshop

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild bought it! Twelve years ago! I have the deed! I'm not asking him to leave! I'm asking him to pay rent! Small rent! Tiny!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Iron-Fang. Let the immortal work.

objectives.text: Join Merchant Jin at the pawnshop

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The guild owns the landing. Old Pan rows people for free when the town needs him. The guild will charge him the same: nothing.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: ...Nothing? That's... hm. That's exactly what I'd have done if I were a better man. Fine. Nothing. I'm getting good at nothing.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted. Written down. Now it's official.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Merchant Jin) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Case of the Stolen Chickens
quests.summary: Somebody is stealing chickens from the terraced fields. The farmers blame Iron-Fang's reformed men. Iron-Fang is furious.

objectives.text: Hear Iron-Fang out

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Look at you. Wearing the sect's robes and the bandit's heart. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Kind, and still breathing. You're rarer than spirit stones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They say my men took the chickens. My men haven't stolen anything in two years. They've been farming. Badly. But honestly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Worry later, Widow Liu. Move now.

objectives.text: Make your way to the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chicken coops on the terraces stand empty. Feathers lead not to the bandits' huts but uphill, toward the graves.

objectives.text: Follow the feathers from the coops

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The feathers lead to a fox den under a grave tablet. A very fat fox. And a very small pile of bones.

objectives.text: Report back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: A fox. Two years honest, and they blame us for a fox. Well. The fox is very clever. I respect the fox.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this river and I've never seen it look so pleased.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Well! That's one way to do it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Case That Isn't Simple
quests.summary: Widow Liu brings a case she doesn't want to bring. Her son wants to climb the nine thousand steps. She wants a judge to forbid it.

objectives.text: Speak with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He's sixteen now. He wants to climb the steps. To become a cultivator. Like you. I want a judge to say no.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: The children ask about you, you know. Don't make me tell them anything sad.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Matron Bi. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I lost him once. I won't lose him to the Abyss. I won't.

objectives.text: Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, I won't go to the Abyss. I want to learn to protect the town. Like Constable Du. Like the immortal.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: See? Even Magistrate Zhou agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Hear what Widow Liu has to say

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No judge should decide this. He'll climb in spring, with your blessing, or not at all. That's between you.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: ...Coward. That's a coward's judgement. It's also correct. Spring. Not before. And he writes every week.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: Wipe your feet when you come back. Heroes track in the worst mud.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er, listening at the well, asks you to put in a word with the sect for spring.

choices.text: Promise to vouch for him

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell him the gate is the same for everyone

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Ask what it's worth to him

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Widow Liu, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Justice With Swords
quests.summary: Rogue cultivators have heard the Law Hall is empty and decided the law no longer applies to them. They are wrong.

objectives.text: Go and see Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Rogues on the river road, robbing travellers. They say there's no Law Hall anymore, so no law. I've written them a very firm letter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Not now, Iron-Fang. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Break the rogue cultivators at the boat yard

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Rogue cultivators! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Stop the rogue cultivators regrouping
Bring word to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Letter delivered. By you. With your fist. That's the kind of letter they understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Constable Du) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

quests.title: The Case of the Old Temple
quests.summary: Someone has been leaving offerings at Keeper Hong's old temple. Offerings to the Blood Moon.

objectives.text: Answer Magistrate Zhou's summons

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Someone is leaving offerings at the temple at night. Red candles. Crescents. Hong's old altar. The town is frightened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Iron-Fang. {player} has never let us down.

objectives.text: Scout the town temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Red candles burn on the old altar, arranged in a crescent. Beside them, a child's drawing of a man with a kind face.

objectives.text: Examine the offerings on Hong's old altar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the back of the drawing: Grandfather Hong. He was kind to me. Nobody else was. A child's hand.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A child. Grieving a monster who was kind to her. That's... I don't know what that is. Not a crime.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Will there be a report? A written one? With dates? I love a report with dates.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Magistrate Zhou. Magistrate Zhou won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The Child at the Temple
quests.summary: You find the child who left the offerings. She is nine, an orphan, and she knew Keeper Hong only as someone who fed her.

objectives.text: Hurry to the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the back alley, a girl of nine sits hugging her knees, a red candle stub in her hand. She looks at your sword, then your face.

objectives.text: Meet Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Little Mei. Orphan. Hong fed her every day for three years. He was a monster, and he fed her. People are complicated.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll prove you wrong. Politely.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: I'll take her. The inn needs someone to dry the cups. Iron-Fang's getting old. Don't tell him I said that.

objectives.choice_prompt: Little Mei still wears the pendant Keeper Hong gave her. It is a Blood Moon token.

choices.text: Let her keep it, and say nothing

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Take it to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take it from her and sell it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Night Court
quests.summary: Blood Moon cultivators come for the child. Hong's old followers think she belongs to them.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Masked men at the inn! Asking for the orphan! Madam Fang hit one with a ladle and he's very upset!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Constable, you owe me for three bowls of noodles.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Put it on the magistrate's account, Madam Fang.

objectives.text: Ward the Drunken Crane's door

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward flares on the inn door. Inside, Madam Fang stands in front of the child with a ladle and an expression like thunder.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the market square

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Hold the back alley against more Blood Moon cultivators
Talk with Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Nobody takes a child from my inn. Not the Blood Moon, not the yamen, not heaven itself. She dries cups now. She's mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Listen to Widow Liu. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, nervously) Should we... say something?

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: The Law Tablet
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou wants your judgements carved on the yamen's law tablet. He says it's how Qingshi remembers.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Your judgements. On the law tablet. The ferry, the fox, the boy, the child. Qingshi remembers its judges.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Gather carving stones from the market
Watch the judgements carved on the tablet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the four judgements the carver adds a line nobody asked for: judged by one who listened twice.

objectives.text: See Magistrate Zhou again

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Listened twice. I told him to carve it. It's the finest thing I've ever said about anyone. I'm going to weep now.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: Remarkable. I'll set it as an essay question. The students will hate you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Scholar Ouyang.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Sensible, that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Bandits on the River Road
quests.summary: A separate band of bandits, unrelated to the rogue cultivators, tests the river road while the Law Hall is distracted.

objectives.text: Sound the war drum at the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The skin of the war drum is tight and ancient. One beat, and your heart falls into step with it.

objectives.text: Defeat the bandits at the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the dye yard
Compare notes with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Qingshi owes you again. I'm running out of ways to write that in the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: I'll weave it into the autumn bolt. A little gold line, for you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Constable Du's Backlog
quests.summary: Constable Du confesses the yamen has a backlog of small disputes too minor for a judge but too sharp for him alone.

objectives.text: See what Constable Du wants

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Boundary stones. Borrowed goats. A dispute about a rooster's crowing hours. I need a judge for none of it and all of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Han Xue! Manners!

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the examination cells

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Constable Du, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Elder Gu) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the humpbacked bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the humpbacked bridge. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (tugging Han Xue's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Medicine for the Widow Liu
quests.summary: Widow Liu, still shaken from the temple offerings, needs medicine for a cough that worry has made worse.

objectives.text: Hear Liu Er out

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me medicine bundles from the temple fair.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: No, Merchant Jin. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says I have to be polite to immortals. Hello, immortal!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the temple fair
Return to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Han Xue. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: The little ones will want the story at bedtime. Keep it short. Keep the blood out.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: matron_bi
reply.text: (to Liu Er, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Little Mei's First Week
quests.summary: Little Mei, drying cups at the Drunken Crane, asks you shyly whether the monster who fed her was really a monster.

objectives.text: Go to the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He did terrible things to a great many people. He was also kind to you. Both are true. You're allowed to grieve one and not excuse the other.

objectives.text: Speak with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Merchant, your barges keep scraping my ferry.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Old Pan, your ferry keeps being in the way of my barges.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the watermill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Pan. More sense there than in half this town.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

objectives.text: Meet Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Widow Liu, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: The Case of the Borrowed Goats
quests.summary: Constable Du's backlog starts with a genuinely baffling case: three goats, two farmers, and no clear owner.

objectives.text: Investigate the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Wang pharmacy looks exactly as it should, which is what makes you uneasy.

objectives.text: Show Magistrate Zhou what you found

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Nobody remembers whose goats they were originally. They've just been borrowed back and forth for six years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Split them three ways: one each, and the third takes turns by season. Nobody loses a goat forever.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Light some incense tonight, Widow Liu. For luck.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, a Second Letter
quests.summary: The rogue cultivators' friends come looking for them, and receive Constable Du's kind of letter too.

objectives.text: Test the puppet frame at the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The puppet frame creaks as you test it. The joints are oiled, the wood is new, and the runes are older.

objectives.text: Drive the rogue cultivators from the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rogue cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the dye yard
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: I'll weave it into the autumn bolt. A little gold line, for you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Qiao Niang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Letters for the Law Tablet's Record
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou wants copies of every judgement written up as letters, sent to neighboring towns as precedent.

objectives.text: Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, then a fourth to be safe) {senior}! Sorry. You're very high up now. It's hard not to bow.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Bring me sealed letters from the brewery. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Listen to Madam Fang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the brewery
Go back to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Liu Er) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says I have to be polite to immortals. Hello, immortal!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Testimony
quests.summary: Iron-Fang, cleared of the chicken theft, offers to testify on behalf of his men in every future dispute, unasked.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I'll vouch for my men in writing, in blood if you want it. Two years honest ought to count for something in a court.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Huo Da.

objectives.text: Talk with Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted. Written down. Now it's official.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: There. Constable Du agrees. Settled.

objectives.text: Find Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Widow Liu. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Madam Fang confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Demon Cultivators at the Temple
quests.summary: A few Blood Moon stragglers try to reclaim Keeper Hong's old temple as a shrine. The town wants them gone.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table at the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fruit, rice and a cup of wine wait on the offering table. Someone set out one bowl more than there are gods.

objectives.text: Clear the temple fair of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the temple fair
Share your findings with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Liu Er does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Han Xue. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Liu Er, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

quests.title: Han Xue's Verdict
quests.summary: Han Xue, watching you judge case after case, offers her own opinion on what makes a good judge.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're good at this because you'd rather understand someone than punish them. Gu was the opposite, once. He's trying to learn from you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Widow Liu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Join Old Pan at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Not now, Merchant Jin. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. It has opinions.

objectives.text: Speak with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Han Xue. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Report to the Chains
quests.summary: Back at the sect you tell Gu Hanshan how it went. He listens twice, as he said to.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A fox, a ferry, a boy and a child. You judged none of them for what you'd have done. Good.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Liu Er. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Law Hall is empty. It should stay empty until someone kinder than me sits in it. That may be a long time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe it's you, after all this.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No. I'll never sit there again. But thank you for saying it. It's a strange thing to be forgiven by the person you wronged most.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Liu Er. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Old Pan) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Green in the Pond
quests.summary: Xiao Man comes running: the lotus in the pond has opened, and it is green, and the carp are bowing to it.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The lotus! The one you planted! It opened this morning and it's green! Green and gold! The carp are bowing! Carp can't bow!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Xiao Man says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Search the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A lotus the colour of new jade floats in the pond, gold at its heart. Every carp in the water faces it, perfectly still.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's been sitting here since dawn. She says the hermit promised to come. She's sent him six cranes. They were very bad cranes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Brother, did you eat? You didn't eat. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I ate twice, Man. You watched me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Sometimes the rules are the cage. I know.

quests.title: The Nine Thousand Steps
quests.summary: At noon, Lu Ping runs up from the gate: an old man in a straw hat is climbing the steps, very slowly, and complaining the whole way.

objectives.text: See what Lu Ping wants

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (steps back half a pace) {senior}... people say things about you. I don't believe them. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: An old man on the steps! Straw hat! He's complaining about every single step! He says they were lower three hundred years ago!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Hermit.

objectives.text: Head to the gate post

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Up the last steps comes the hermit, straw hat, walking stick, bad knees, and an expression of profound betrayal toward staircases.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Nine thousand steps. Your founder was a sadist. I told her so three hundred years ago. She laughed. I'm still right.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The hermit is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Where's the lotus? I came to see the lotus. Not the steps. Definitely not the steps.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to the hermit) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging the hermit's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Hermit Meets the Sect Master
quests.summary: The Sect Master comes to the gate herself. The last disciple of the Verdant Lotus bows to the master of the Azure Cloud.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Lan Jue of the Verdant Lotus. Welcome to the Azure Cloud. Three hundred years late. Better late.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sect Master. I ran when your founder and mine needed me most. I've come to say I'm sorry. And to look at a flower.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your sect gave everything to the seal. Ours forgot your name. We're both sorry. Come and look at the flower.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Sect Master. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Man. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The carp know my name now. They're very polite about it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

quests.title: Two Sects at One Pond
quests.summary: The hermit and the Sect Master sit at the pond together. They ask you to sit between them.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit between us. You're the only thing both our sects have in common now. Humour two old people.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Sect Master. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Sit between the two sects at the pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blue on one side, green on the other. The lotus turns toward you. For a moment the pond reflects two founders, side by side, and then only the three of you.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He'll stay a few days. He says the pagoda needs someone who knows how to read Verdant Lotus script. Bai is ecstatic.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Elder Hua, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Lotus ruins' pond is your family's. The Azure Cloud wants it registered as sect land.

choices.text: Share it with both sects

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Register it properly

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Claim it for yourself alone

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Bai Meets Lan
quests.summary: Elder Bai has waited his whole life to meet a Verdant Lotus scholar. The hermit has waited three hundred years to meet a good librarian.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You read the old script! You read it fluently! Do you know what the third character on the drowned stele means? I've guessed for forty years!

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It means 'turtle'. It was a soup recipe. We hid everything important in soup recipes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: ...I knew it. I knew it! My grandmother! She learned it from you! From your sect! Oh, sit down, sit down, have some tea!

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Finally. Someone who pours for me. Three hundred years I've been pouring my own.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Peach Trees for the Old Man
quests.summary: Elder Hua has an idea: plant Elder Mo's peach trees beside the lotus, so there's something of him by the water too.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Peach saplings from the old orchard. Mo's orchard. Plant them by the pond. He left me peaches for forty years. I'm leaving him trees.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Noted, Sect Master. Overruled, but noted.

objectives.text: Dig peach saplings from the old orchard
Plant Elder Mo's peach trees by the pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three peach saplings beside the green lotus. Elder Hua pats the earth around each one, and doesn't say anything for a long time.

objectives.text: Report back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: In five years they'll fruit. I'll leave a peach on my own doorstep every autumn, and pretend. That's our tradition.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd have grunted and looked away. That's how he said proud. I'll just say it. Proud!

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Wolves Follow the Hermit
quests.summary: The hermit's old friends from the forest have followed him up the mountain: grey wolves who don't understand stairs either.

objectives.text: Examine the crane statue at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey wolves pace at the outer wall, whining. They followed the hermit's scent up nine thousand steps and are very confused.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crane statue stands on one leg, its bronze feathers green with age. Its beak points somewhere specific.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Some of the wolves are not his. Some have purple in their eyes, and came up with the hermit's scent to hide their own.

objectives.text: Calm the hermit's wolves with meat
Tell the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My wolves. And void-touched ones pretending to be my wolves. The fold at the Abyss is leaking all over the world. I felt it in the forest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. The Sect Master is not wrong. The Sect Master is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Oh thank heavens. I was so nervous I watered the lanterns twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: The Letter for Lan
quests.summary: You still have the letter from the reliquary, addressed to Lan when he stops running. You think he has.

objectives.text: Give the hermit his master's letter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lan Jue breaks the green wax with trembling fingers. He reads it twice. Then he laughs, and cries, and laughs.

objectives.text: Compare notes with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She wrote: Lan, you idiot, stop running and go and teach someone. That's all. Three hundred years. That's all it said.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Back, and breathing evenly. That's all a healer asks for, and so rarely gets.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sorry I worried you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I'll teach. The sutra. Here, in the pagoda, if your Sect Master allows. Somebody has to, and it seems I'm the only one left.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to the hermit) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Incense for the New Shrine
quests.summary: Elder Hua wants incense for a small shrine beside the peach saplings, one for both founders, planted by the pond.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me incense bundles from the spirit peach orchard.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Xiao Shi, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Collect incense bundles around the spirit peach orchard
Bring word to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There you are! I was about to go looking with a torch and a very large spoon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I missed you too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Lan Jue's First Night's Sleep
quests.summary: Lan Jue admits he hasn't slept indoors in three hundred years and finds the sect's guest quarters almost unbearably comfortable.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A bed. Walls. A roof that isn't leaves. I don't know if I can sleep like this. I might have forgotten how to be comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Wei Tong. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If he offers you a bun before a fight, refuse. He'll share it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone fights better with a bun, Senior Sister. It's science.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Hua. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Void-Touched Wolves, Culled
quests.summary: The void-touched wolves among Lan Jue's pack are dealt with before they can lead more of the fold's leakage up the mountain.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These void wraiths fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Find the incense bundles at the mountain road
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We're done at the drum tower. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Tang Ling. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Jade Slips for the Pagoda's New Shelf
quests.summary: Elder Bai clears a shelf in the pagoda for Verdant Lotus texts and needs jade slips to copy Lan Jue's memory onto.

objectives.text: See what Xiao Man wants

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me jade slips from the laundry stream.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Xiao Man, put that down before it explodes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: It won't explode, Elder! ...Will it?

objectives.text: Recover jade slips from the laundry stream
See Xiao Man again

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the jade slips you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Question for the Hermit
quests.summary: Xiao Man asks Lan Jue whether the lotus in the pond will ever bloom the way the Verdant Lotus's own gardens once did.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Given three hundred years and a little luck, yes. I won't see it. You might. Water it anyway. That's the whole secret.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The hermit has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.
