objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the Cliff of Reflection. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm standing right here, you know.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the ancestral tombs

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the ancestral tombs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The Sect Master thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Han Xue. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Wei Tong's First Sutra Lesson
quests.summary: Wei Tong shows up early to the pagoda for his first Heart Sutra lesson, mostly hoping the soup rumors are true.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Deal with the training puppets at the sunrise terrace.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Stop the training puppets at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: More training puppets? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to the hermit) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to the hermit) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Turtle Soup
quests.summary: Bai Ling, inspired by Lan Jue's stories, attempts to recreate the ancient turtle soup recipe from half-remembered fragments.

objectives.text: Make your way to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the pill kiln yard. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I got the broth right, I think. The sealing diagram part is trickier. Please don't let this soup accidentally ward anything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Elder Bai will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Elder Hua and the Hermit
quests.summary: Elder Hua and Lan Jue, both keepers of old traditions, compare notes on what it means to outlive the people you loved.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Forty years of peaches for a man who never said thank you. Three hundred years of soup for a sect that's gone. We're a matched pair.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A matched pair of stubborn old fools. I'll drink to that. With soup, since apparently that's tradition now.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Xiao Shi is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: See? Even Tang Ling agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai, you've been in the pagoda for three days. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I had a very nourishing scroll.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I have read everything in the pagoda twice, and the recipes three times.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: The Last of the Wolves
quests.summary: A final stray wolf, neither Lan Jue's nor void-touched, simply likes the sect's peach orchard and refuses to leave.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Defeat the spirit wolves at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Gather jade slips at the spirit peach orchard
Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the Lotus's Roots
quests.summary: Xiao Man asks for spirit herbs to feed the lotus's roots, hoping to help it bloom a little sooner than nature intends.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me root feed from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhong Ming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Pick up root feed near the medicine valley
Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Wei Tong Is Jealous
quests.summary: Word spreads that the hermit will teach the Heart Sutra in the pagoda. Wei Tong wants to know if there's lunch.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He's going to teach? In the pagoda? Every morning? Is there lunch? The Verdant Lotus must have had lunch.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: We had tea. And a turtle soup. Very famous. Very secret. The recipe was also a sealing diagram.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...I'm going to learn the Heart Sutra. For the soup. Mostly for the soup. A bit for the sutra.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone's happy. I'm suspicious. It's been a week without an attack. Something's wrong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Something's Wrong
quests.summary: Han Xue is right. A crane arrives from Qingshi, spotted with ash: the outer villages are burning, one each night.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A crane from Constable Du. Villages burning in the lowlands. One a night. Each one leaves a pile of ash in the shape of a ladder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Shi. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ash. Luo Hui. The First Rung is back, and he wants you to know it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Go. I'll be in the pagoda, being taught to use your terrible modern brushes by your excitable librarian. Come back.

objectives.text: Scout the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the sword tomb the rusted blades hum faintly as you pass, as if some of them still remember a name.

objectives.text: Grip the sword in the stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rust flakes from the sword in the stone as you touch it. The blade beneath is still bright, and still sharp.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the cave behind the waterfall isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the hermit) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Ladders in the Ash
quests.summary: Constable Du takes you to the latest burned village. In the ash, someone has drawn a ladder with seven rungs.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the fields a village smoulders. In the ash of the largest house, a ladder has been drawn with a finger. Seven rungs. The first rung is circled.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Seven villages. Nobody killed. Everyone woken, marched out, then the houses burned. Like he wants us to count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Constable. I've come to report myself for being useful.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted, Iron-Fang. You're still on my list.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: And every time, a letter nailed to the well. Addressed to you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Kindly done. The town remembers kindness.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The First Letter
quests.summary: The letters are in a beautiful hand. They are polite. They are very, very specific about you.

objectives.text: Read the letter nailed to the well

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dear heir. You shook me in the warehouse. I have healed. My star is bright again. Come and shake me properly. Luo Hui, the First Rung.

objectives.text: Hurry to the town well

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a second page. A map of Qingshi's outer villages. Seven of them crossed out. The eighth circled. Tonight.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He's telling you where he'll be. That's either arrogance or a trap. It's both. It's always both.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ye Wuming. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: The Eighth Village
quests.summary: The eighth village is on the river. You get there before the ash does.

objectives.text: See what Old Pan wants

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The eighth village is across my river. I'll ferry you over. No fare. I'll wait. I'll pray. I'll hit anyone who comes near with an oar.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

objectives.text: Ring the dock bell to wake the village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell clangs across the water. Lamps flare in the village. Families pour out of their houses, just as figures in grey ash pour in.

objectives.text: Drive the ash-cultists from the east gate

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Guards
Join Zhao Kang at the main street

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Nobody burned tonight. That's one village he didn't get. He'll be angry. Good. Angry people write worse letters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Pan. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: Letters Back
quests.summary: Zhao Kang suggests writing back. Rudely. Han Xue suggests writing back politely. You write back honestly.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Write back. Tell him he's a pile of ash with ideas above his station. Rungs are for climbing on. Tell him that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Zhao Kang does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Han Xue.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Write back politely. Politeness makes arrogant people careless. He'll underestimate you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll write back honestly. Dear Luo Hui. I'm coming. I won't burn anything. Stop burning things. That's all.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's worse. That's much worse. He'll hate that. Send it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

objectives.choice_prompt: The ash letters threaten the eighth village unless the heir comes alone.

choices.text: Go alone, as asked

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell the Sect Master everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Send a decoy in your robes

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Ash on the Wind
quests.summary: Luo Hui's answer comes as ash on the wind, blowing north toward the bamboo forest.

objectives.text: Sound the bronze bell at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the watchtower you see it: a thin grey line of ash in the sky, blowing north, toward the forest, like a finger pointing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Clear the hill graves of ash-cultists

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists wait in the hill graves to slow you down. They've been told to die slowly. They're good at following orders.

objectives.text: Gather the ash-cultists' letters
Compare notes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I followed the ash from the rim. He's been moving between the Abyss and the forest. He's building something in the ruins.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Will there be a report? A written one? With dates? I love a report with dates.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go on.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus ruins. He's using your family's stones. For his rung.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: The Burning Bamboo
quests.summary: The bamboo forest's edge is burning. Luo Hui wants you to come through fire.

objectives.text: Check the seals of the sealed coffin at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bamboo at the forest's edge is burning in a perfect line, like a fence. Through the smoke, a ladder of ash hangs in the air.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Paper seals cross the sealed coffin, written in blood gone brown. One of them has been torn and pasted back.

objectives.text: Fight off the ash-cultists

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists stand in the burning grove, feeding the fire, chanting a single word over and over: climb.

objectives.text: Touch the guardian lion at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins gate is black with soot. On the archway, over the carved lotus, someone has painted a red rung.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The eyes of the guardian lion follow you. You decide that is the stonemason's skill, and nothing else.

objectives.text: Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I followed you. My men are putting out the fire. We're very good at fire. We used to start them. Now we stop them. It's better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut it, Liu Er.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Rung in the Ruins
quests.summary: Inside the ruins, Luo Hui has built an altar of Verdant Lotus stones, tied to his star. He's using your family to hold up his ladder.

objectives.text: Go to the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the courtyard, lotus stones have been piled into an altar. A thread of red light rises from it, up through the canopy, toward a star.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Is it supposed to look like that? It doesn't look like it's supposed to look like that.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Right. Eyes open, everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Stay close. Both of you.

objectives.text: Pull the stolen lotus stones from the altar
Cut the red thread to the star

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The thread snaps. Far above, a red star flickers. Somewhere in the forest, someone screams in rage, and the ash stops falling.

objectives.text: Break the ash-cultists at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui's cultists pour out of the bamboo, too late to save the altar, just in time to be angry about it.

objectives.text: Investigate the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine is quiet. The lotus stones are back where they belong. Luo Hui is gone. His ash trail leads south. Toward the Abyss.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go
Hand him over to face the law
End it. He would have killed you.
Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

quests.title: He'll Be at the Abyss
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the ash trail. Luo Hui has gone home to the Abyss rim, to heal. It's where he'll be strongest.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's gone to the rim. Near the fold. That's where the rungs draw power now. He'll be strongest there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not this time, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Which is where you should fight him. Because there, if you win, his star doesn't come back.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the bell pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we rest. We heal. We go to the rim when we're ready, not when he wants us. Everyone agree? Good. Nobody argue.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Ye Wuming. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Ash and Soul
quests.summary: Before the hunt you sit in the ruined shrine and let the week settle into your transformed soul.

objectives.text: Meditate in the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul and body blur at the edges, like ink in water. The ruins hum with your family's old patience. Late stage of Soul Transformation.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the giant bamboo grove

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You glow when you meditate. Did you know that? My men think you're a god. I told them you're a very stubborn orphan. They prefer god.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: I'll carry anything heavy. Heavier than a tree, I'll need a friend.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Big Shu.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Ash-Cultists, the Stragglers
quests.summary: A handful of ash-cultists, cut off from Luo Hui's retreat, still haunt the bamboo forest's burned edge.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run your fingers along the threads of the loom. One colour runs through every bolt, like a signature.

objectives.text: Stop the ash-cultists at the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Collect medicine bundles around the dye yard
Talk it over with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Iron-Fang. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I have not slept since spring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Altar
quests.summary: The broken altar in the ruins sheds rune fragments worth studying before the forest reclaims the site.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me rune fragments from the brewery, would you?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Listen to Constable Du. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Find the rune fragments at the brewery
Report back to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more rune fragments than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Old Pan) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (tugging Old Pan's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Elder Bai's Alarm
quests.summary: Elder Bai, hearing that Blood Moon cultists used lotus stones as an altar, demands an inventory of every remaining ruin.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Bai's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If he can build an altar from loose stones, imagine what he could do with an intact shrine. We ward every ruin. Today.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the canal walk

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

objectives.text: Join Constable Du at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Not now, Old Pan. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Letters From the Burned Villages
quests.summary: Constable Du collects the surviving letters from each burned village, hoping a pattern in Luo Hui's hand reveals his plans.

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me sealed letters from the brewery.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not this time, Captain Lei.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the brewery
Bring word to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Captain Lei.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Blood Guard, Watching the Rim
quests.summary: Scouts confirm blood guard sentries have begun watching the Abyss rim, expecting the sect's return.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shuttle of the loom has stopped mid-row. The half-finished pattern is a map, if you know how to read it.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The Blood Guards have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk at the dye yard
Share your findings with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Ledger
quests.summary: Ye Wuming keeps a private ledger of everything he's learned about Luo Hui, and shares a page of it with you.

objectives.text: Search the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: An actor in half his face paint practises a death scene on the opera stage. It is very long.

objectives.text: Examine the puppet frame

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tighten the cords of the puppet frame. It twitches, tries a stance, and looks at you expectantly.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Seven rungs, seven servants. Luo Hui is the first and the weakest. That should worry you more than it comforts you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Did you fly? Did you use a sword? Can I hold the sword? Just for a moment?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hunted.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Medicine for the Burned Villages
quests.summary: The burned villages need medicine to rebuild, and Elder Hua sends a supply run before the hunt for Luo Hui begins.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me medicine bundles from the night market.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Magistrate Zhou says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Order! Ah. It's already orderly. Carry on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the night market
See Magistrate Zhou again

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this river and I've never seen it look so pleased.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Sensible, that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Letter, Unsent
quests.summary: Zhao Kang writes a furious reply to Luo Hui's letters and, at Han Xue's insistence, never sends it.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I wrote four pages. Han Xue read it and said 'no.' Just no. She's probably right. It felt good to write, though.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Constable Du.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Ye Wuming is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Liu Er, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. It has opinions.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: The Watchtower's Warning
quests.summary: A final ash-cultist scout is caught signaling from the watchtower, confirming Luo Hui knows the sect is coming.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Drive the ash-cultists from the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Collect void shards around the watchtower
Compare notes with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Anything on the far bank? Lanterns? Faces? I still dream about the lanterns.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

quests.title: Resting Before the Rim
quests.summary: In the last quiet days before the hunt, Han Xue insists everyone actually rest, no training, no letters, just rest.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No training today. No letters. Rest means rest. I will personally sit on anyone who disobeys, starting with you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Pan said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the guild master's manor

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One day I'll think of a comeback. Today is not that day.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Liu Er's Steps
quests.summary: Back in Qingshi, Liu Er is packing. It's spring. He's climbing the nine thousand steps tomorrow, with his mother's blessing.

objectives.text: Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Tomorrow! The nine thousand steps! Mother blessed me. She cried. Then she packed me eleven meals. For one day.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: No, Captain Lei. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Will you be at the gate? You don't have to. But if you were. That would be... that would be very good.

objectives.text: Find Widow Liu at the town temple

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He writes every week. That's the deal. And if he fails the test he comes home and carries water. That's also the deal.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Liu Er.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Mirror Calls
quests.summary: You wake with the Heart Mirror humming in your soul. Han Xue says no. Then says she's coming.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The mirror's calling you? Absolutely not. Last time it let out a monster wearing your face.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...You're going anyway. I can see it. Fine. I'm coming. I'll stand at the edge and glare at it.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The canyon is quieter since the fold. The wind comes up from below carrying the smell of nothing at all.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You're going to the mirror. Don't look surprised; I can see it on you. I'll guide you. The paths have changed since the fold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Han Xue.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Wraiths on the Old Paths
quests.summary: The fold's leak has filled the old Abyss paths with void wraiths, and they are drawn to souls like yours.

objectives.text: Answer Ye Wuming's summons

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Wraiths. They smell transformed souls. You're a feast to them. Stay close, and hit first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

objectives.text: Clear the bone throne of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the poison garden
Head to the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the bottom of the Abyss the darkness is thicker than you remember, as if the fold had poured some of itself down here.

quests.title: Gu's Warning
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan insisted on coming, chained, to the depths. He says there is something about the mirror you need to hear.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I couldn't face the mirror. You could. Now it wants to finish what it started. It will show you something new.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Not your fear of dying. You've faced that. Your fear of living. Of going on when everyone else stops.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: How do you know?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Because I watched my daughter die and went on living. That was my mirror. Yours will be the same, only higher.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Worry later, Zhao Kang. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Ye Wuming, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.choice_prompt: Gu Hanshan offers what he knows of the Mirror in exchange for a softer cell.

choices.text: Grant it. Information saves lives.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

choices.text: Promise nothing, and listen

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hmph. Reasonable. Annoyingly.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Threaten him instead

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: The Mirror's Surface
quests.summary: The Heart Mirror is still, black and patient. When you look into it, it doesn't show you. It shows everyone else.

objectives.text: Make your way to the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mirror shows Han Xue, old, grey-haired. Zhao Kang, bent over a cane. Wei Tong's grave. The sect, and you above it, young and alone.

objectives.text: Look deeper into the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You climb the Ascension Stair, and every step, someone you love grows older and falls away, until there's no one left to wave.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop looking. {player}, stop. You've gone white. What did you see?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You. Old. Everyone, gone. And me, still climbing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Fear of Leaving
quests.summary: The mirror lets out a new shade. This one wears your face too, but older, sadder, and it doesn't want to hurt you. It wants you to stop.

objectives.text: Study the bronze mirror at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A figure steps out of the water, wearing your face, but older, with eyes that have watched everyone die. It raises its sword, and weeps.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze mirror is dark with age. When you breathe on it, words appear in the mist and fade.

objectives.name: The Fear of Leaving
objectives.text: Face The Fear of Leaving at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Stay. Don't climb. Stay with them. Grow old with them. Heaven is lonely, {player}. I've seen it. I'm what you become.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe. But they'd tell me to climb. Every one of them would tell me to climb.

objectives.text: Still the mirror once more

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mirror calms. Your reflection is only you again, tired, not alone. Behind you, in the water, Han Xue is scowling. It's very comforting.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the lava falls

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd tell you to climb. And then come back down and visit. Weekly. Like Zhao Kang writes to his grandfather.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's hoard holds spirit stones stolen from Qingshi.

choices.text: Return every stone to Qingshi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Give it all to the sect treasury

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep a share for yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Everyone Would Say Climb
quests.summary: On the way back up, Zhao Kang, who came to find you, says the thing the mirror couldn't argue with.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard what you said to it. That we'd all tell you to climb. Of course we would. And then complain about it forever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Zhao Kang thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Heaven's lonely? Then take us with you. In here. The complaints especially. Heaven could use some complaints.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the ghost village

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When you reach the top, remember us down here. That's all anyone who stays behind wants. To be remembered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I remembered a name down there. Not mine. My mother's. It's a start.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Blood Guards at the Rim
quests.summary: Luo Hui's Blood Guards are waiting at the rim. He knows you went to the mirror. He knows you're tired.

objectives.text: Scout the sulphur vents

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Guards line the rim, and behind them ash drifts upward, toward one flickering red star.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Guards spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather demon cores from the fallen guards
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's watching. He wanted you tired. You're not tired. You're something else. I don't know the word.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Rest Before the Rung
quests.summary: Han Xue orders you to rest one night before facing Luo Hui. You don't argue. You're learning.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One night. You rest. That's not a suggestion from your senior sister. That's an order from the person who'll carry you home if you don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Zhao Kang. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Rest your soul in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the stillness at the bottom of the world, your soul rests. The fear of leaving is still there, but small, and folded, like a letter kept for later.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I came to bring you medicine. My sister made more. It says 'eat this, idiot' on the label. That's how she says I love you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Fair. I think.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Flickering Star
quests.summary: In soul sight, the thread from the rim to Luo Hui's star is thick and bright. His rung is at the obelisk ring.

objectives.text: Hurry to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, a red thread rises from the obelisk ring to the sky, thick as a rope, humming. The First Rung is there.

objectives.text: Trace the red thread with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the thread's root, among the obelisk stumps, a pale man sits in a ring of ash, waiting. He waves.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He waved. The First Rung waved at you. I'm going to enjoy this more than a senior sister should.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, Guarding the Ring
quests.summary: A cluster of void wraiths, drawn by the obelisk ring's power, must be cleared before the assault on Luo Hui begins.

objectives.text: Look into the bronze mirror at the cave of echoes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You look into the bronze mirror. Your face looks back, then, a moment later, a face that is not quite yours.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the cave of echoes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The void wraiths come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find the void shards at the cave of echoes
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The blood river is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (hiding behind Han Xue) Oh.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Void Shards, One More Batch
quests.summary: The ring's leaking void energy sheds shards worth gathering for Elder Bai's study before the fight begins.

objectives.text: Hear Ye Wuming out

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me void shards from the obsidian spires.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Ye Wuming is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the obsidian spires
Return to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Ye Wuming does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Nerves
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, facing the man responsible for his brother's fate, admits to being more nervous than he's ever let on.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He's the reason my brother went to the bamboo forest. I've waited years for this and now I just feel sick.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Feel sick. Then fight anyway. That's not weakness. That's everyone who's ever done anything that mattered.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the Blood Moon shrine

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the Blood Moon shrine. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the ghost village.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Zhao Kang's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Gu's Last Advice
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, still chained, offers one last piece of advice before you face the First Rung.

objectives.text: Go to the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Cold air rises from the mine shaft, carrying the faint sound of picks that nobody is swinging.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Luo Hui fears being forgotten more than being beaten. Beat him, and let him know you'll remember his name. It will hurt him more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. The Law Hall would have your hide.
