choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it started, for me.

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Final Watch
quests.summary: A final watch of blood guards tests the approach to the obelisk ring before the main assault.

objectives.text: Study the map table at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the watch spire
Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Demon Cores, the Last Harvest
quests.summary: The fallen watch leaves demon cores behind, worth gathering before the ring itself becomes the battlefield.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me demon cores from the corpse forest. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Shi. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Pick up demon cores near the corpse forest
Go back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a long story. The short version: yes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the demon cores you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Map of the Ring
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, remembering her time as a captive near the obelisks, sketches the ring's layout from memory one last time.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I used to count the stumps to stay sane. Nine of them. I still remember every one. Use it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Xiao Shi says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: See? Even Han Xue agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Ye Wuming. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the ash plains

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhao Kang. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Steadying Before the Rung
quests.summary: You sit once more at the canyon entrance, letting your soul settle before the fight that ends the First Rung.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady your soul before the assault. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Xiao Shi said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Steady your soul before the assault

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fear of leaving, folded small, sits quiet in your chest. Tonight it doesn't need to speak. Tonight there is only the fight ahead.

objectives.text: Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Ye Wuming. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

quests.title: Han Xue's Promise
quests.summary: Han Xue makes you promise something before the fight: that whatever happens, you'll come back down to tell her about it.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Promise me. Win or lose, you come back and tell me everything. I don't care how it happened. I care that you're here to say it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Xiao Shi. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the red moon terrace

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Elder Gu knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the bone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Rung, One Last Look
quests.summary: You look once more at the red thread rising from the ring, memorizing its shape before the fight that will cut it.

objectives.text: Investigate the bone throne

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Skulls grin from the arms of the bone throne. The seat is worn smooth by a long-dead weight.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Look well. Tomorrow it's ash, or it's you climbing it yourself. I know which one I'm betting on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (beaming at Ye Wuming) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: The Night Before the Rung
quests.summary: At the rim, before the fight, Ye Wuming tells you the name he remembered. His mother's name.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her name was Ye Qing. Evening Clear. I remembered it in the mirror. I think she named me something like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When this is done, I'll find the rest. Tomorrow, break the first rung. For the children in the cages. For her.

objectives.text: Search the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sacrificial pit breathes out a warm, sweet stink. Something at the bottom is still moving.

objectives.text: Test the chain anchor

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chain anchor is bolted into the living rock. Old blood has rusted into its links.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Ash Circle
quests.summary: Luo Hui's last followers form a circle of ash around the obelisk ring. Breaking it means breaking them.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A circle of ash, and people standing in it chanting. I'm not going to ask. I'm just going to hit them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

objectives.text: Defeat the ash-cultists at the training pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Guards that follow
Study the old stele at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ash circle breaks. At the obelisk ring, the pale man stands up and dusts himself off, politely.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

quests.title: The Last Letter
quests.summary: Before the fight, Luo Hui sends one last letter by a trembling cultist. It's very short.

objectives.text: Kneel before the ancestral tablets at the burned hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cultist hands you a letter and runs. It says: Dear heir. Thank you for writing back. Nobody ever writes back. Luo Hui.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He's lonely.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You bow before the ancestral tablets. Names in gold and faded red go back further than anyone alive can count.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He burned seven villages. Lonely isn't an excuse. But... yes. He's lonely. That's what makes it sad.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Han Xue is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Zhao Kang.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Seven Anchors
quests.summary: The First Rung's star is tied to seven anchor-stones around the obelisk ring. Cut them, and his star can't heal him.

objectives.text: Head to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seven anchor-stones glow red among the obelisk stumps. Each one sings a single note up to a flickering star.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Keep your voice down. Voices carry out here.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Then we'd better be quick.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Whatever happens, we stay together.

objectives.text: Pry loose the seven anchor-stones
Break the last anchor

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last anchor cracks. Overhead, the red star stops flickering and holds, steady and small. It can't send him anything now.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Guards from the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui's guards charge from the bone field, too late. The pale man doesn't join them. He's waiting for you.

objectives.text: Make your way to the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Everything is quiet. The ash has stopped falling. Across the pools, the First Rung stands alone in his circle.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go
Hand him over to face the law
End it. He would have killed you.
Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

quests.title: The First Rung Falls
quests.summary: The First Rung of the Patriarch's Ladder stands in his circle of ash and bows. One rung is nothing. Seven is a road to heaven.

objectives.text: Scout the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui bows. Ash drifts from his sleeves. His star is overhead, cut off. He knows. He smiles anyway.

objectives.name: Luo Hui, the First Rung
objectives.text: Bring down Luo Hui, the First Rung

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: You wrote back. Nobody ever writes back. I was a scribe once, before the moon took me. I wrote a thousand letters. No answers.

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: Come, heir. Test me properly. One rung is nothing. But I'd like to be something, just once.

objectives.text: Stand over the fallen First Rung

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui lies in his ash, smiling. Thank you for the letter, he says, and becomes ash, and the wind takes him, and his star goes out.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: One star out. On Qing Luan's chart, one red star is dark now. Six left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. Wei Tong's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He thanked you. The Blood Moon never taught anyone to thank. He learned it somewhere. That's almost worse.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemy's belongings: a manual of a forbidden blood technique.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Seal it in the Scripture Pagoda

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep it. Study it. Quietly.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Ye Wuming) That was cold.

quests.title: One Star Out
quests.summary: The Sect Master comes through the array to see for herself. Above the fold, one of seven red points of light is gone.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One star. Out. I saw it from the mountain; Qing Luan's crane arrived five minutes later, shouting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Six left. Each one harder. But the Ladder can be broken. You've proved it. The long war has its first victory.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the war camp

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I brought dumplings to the Abyss. For the victory. They're a bit ashy. Everything's a bit ashy here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Sect Master. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

quests.title: The Scribe's Letters
quests.summary: In Luo Hui's camp you find crates of letters. Thousands of them. All written by him. None of them sent.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Crates. Letters. Thousands. All in his hand. All addressed to people. None sent.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Gather the unsent letters
Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: To his mother. To a friend called Bo. To a girl he met once at a market. Forty years of letters to people he never saw again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Like Gu's letters to his daughter.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Han Xue) That was cold.

quests.title: What the Letters Say
quests.summary: Among the unsent letters, one is addressed to the Patriarch. It's the only one that's been opened.

objectives.text: Read the letter addressed to the Patriarch

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Master. The heir grows. When the seventh rung is set and the heir's lightning comes, the ladder will hold your weight. Your faithful first.

objectives.text: Hurry to the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath, in a different, older hand, a single word in red: Good.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When the heir's lightning comes. Your tribulation. They're waiting for it. All seven rungs, to hold him while he climbs your lightning.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Six to go. Break them before your sky breaks. That's the whole war, in one sentence.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Question
quests.summary: Iron-Fang asks the question everyone has been avoiding: if the fold opens only for the tribulation, how long will his family wait?

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If he only comes out for your lightning, how long's that? Years? My sister's behind that fold. Years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming says the void holds them still. Like flies in amber. They won't age. They won't know how long.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Iron-Fang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...Then I'll wait for them. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he waits. Get strong, sect brat. Get strong faster.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the lava falls

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The Sect Master thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then come and watch.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the lava falls

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The sect never did tame {them}.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Void at the Rim
quests.summary: With the first rung gone, the fold shudders, and more void wraiths spill out at the rim, angry and lost.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fold's upset. More wraiths. They don't know what they are. They just know something broke.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Clear the poison garden of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths regrouping
Join Zhao Kang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've counted. That's one Rung, forty guards, sixty wraiths and one very ashy dumpling. Best week of my life.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Blood Guard, the Camp's Remnant
quests.summary: A remnant of Luo Hui's blood guard, leaderless now, is rounded up from the ruined demon camp.

objectives.text: Read the ancestral tablets at the burned hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense ash lies fresh before the ancestral tablets. One name has been touched so often its gilding is gone.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Collect void shards around the burned hall
Tell Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Iron-Fang, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Sect Master.

objectives.choice_prompt: Before they burn, you see Luo Hui's letters name the villages that paid him. Some paid in children.

choices.text: Let them burn, as the villages ask

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Keep a copy for the Law Hall

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: Copy the names, and make those villages pay you

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Anchors
quests.summary: The seven broken anchor-stones leave rune fragments behind, worth studying to understand how the rungs draw power.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring me rune fragments from the deep mine shaft. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Ye Wuming. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Find the rune fragments at the deep mine shaft
See Wei Tong again

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Wei Tong will leave out. There is always a part.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more rune fragments than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Ashy Dumplings
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists everyone eat his ash-dusted victory dumplings, on principle, even Zhao Kang, who complains the whole time.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Eat the dumpling. It's tradition now. Ash and all. Elder Mo would have eaten two and complained about a third.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Iron-Fang. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Iron-Fang said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fair. I have my doubts too.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: Gu Reads the Ledger
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, given a page of Luo Hui's unsent letters, recognizes the handwriting from decades ago.

objectives.text: Go to the corpse forest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the corpse forest is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Examine the soul lantern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The soul lantern hums with a trapped voice. You break the rune, and the flame goes out, gently.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I trained scribes once, before I turned traitor. This hand — I taught this hand. He was one of mine, long before the moon took him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Mercy. I forgot how it looks.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Rules broke me too. From the other side.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) The sect never did tame {them}.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Last Circle
quests.summary: A last circle of demon cultivators, still loyal to Luo Hui's memory, must be cleared from the bone field.

objectives.text: Check the seals of the sealed coffin at the bone throne

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sealed coffin is heavier than any coffin should be. The seals are sound. For now.

objectives.text: Break the ash-cultists at the bone throne

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These ash-cultists fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Recover rune fragments from the bone throne
Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Shuddering Fold
quests.summary: The fold's shudder after the First Rung's fall sheds void shards worth studying before they dissolve.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me void shards from the obsidian spires. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Noted, Ku the Broker. Overruled, but noted.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the obsidian spires
Return to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ku the Broker says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Report Home
quests.summary: The Sect Master dictates a letter to the wider cultivation world: the Ladder can be broken. The war has a shape now.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Word will spread. Some will help. Some will want the glory. All of them will finally believe the threat is real.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Iron-Fang?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the war camp

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, did you eat? You never eat. Here, half a bun. The bigger half.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...Thank you. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the ghost village

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Very funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's First Smile
quests.summary: For the first time since you've known him, Ye Wuming smiles, small and brief, at the sight of the dark star.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That's the first star I've watched go out instead of watching one light up. I could get used to that feeling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the red moon terrace

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the red moon terrace. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the Blood Moon shrine

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the Blood Moon shrine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Sect Master. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Fold's Aftermath
quests.summary: The fold continues shedding wraiths through the night, restless from the rung's breaking.

objectives.text: Open the cage at the beast pens

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the beast pens

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: More void wraiths? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Pick up rune fragments near the beast pens
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. The road taught you that.

quests.title: Counting the Letters
quests.summary: Before burning them, Han Xue insists on counting Luo Hui's unsent letters, so at least someone knows the number.

objectives.text: Investigate the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The deepest shaft drops into blackness. A winch creaks above it, its chain disappearing into the dark.

objectives.text: Check the chain anchor

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The links of the chain anchor are thick as your arm. One has been filed almost through.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Nine hundred and twelve. Nine hundred and twelve people he never got to say anything to. That's not a monster's number. That's a lonely man's.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Burning the Letters
quests.summary: At dusk, Han Xue asks what to do with Luo Hui's thousand unsent letters. You know what he'd want.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A thousand letters. We can't deliver them. Most of the people are dead. What do we do?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We send them. The only way we can.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Burn the unsent letters at the rim

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letters burn, and the ash rises, and for the first time it doesn't form a ladder. It just goes up, into the dark, like it's finally being delivered.

objectives.text: Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the kindest thing anyone's ever done for a monster. I'm not crying. It's the ash.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Han Xue will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell the Sect Master. The Sect Master won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Locked Box
quests.summary: The Sect Master gives you a box of plain wood, locked, with your name on it in Elder Mo's square handwriting.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He left this for you. With instructions: 'give it when the first rung falls, not before'. He knew about the rungs. Of course he did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Wei Tong. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Open Elder Mo's box

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside: a sword manual in Elder Mo's hand, a folded letter, and a single dried peach blossom, pressed flat.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: His handwriting. That's his handwriting. I'd know those square characters anywhere. He wrote like he talked. Like a wall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Sect Master. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Letter
quests.summary: You read Elder Mo's letter on the hall steps, where he stood every morning.

objectives.text: Search the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letter is short. Elder Mo's letters are always short. You read it twice.

objectives.text: Read Elder Mo's letter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Junior. If you're reading this, I found the flaw too late. Don't blame yourself. I'd have gone anyway. Back straight. Adequate. More than. Mo.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Back straight. Even in his last letter. Of course. He'd have written it on his own gravestone.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Xiao Man's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Sword Manual
quests.summary: Elder Mo's sword manual is thirty pages of diagrams and one page of advice. The advice is: stop overthinking.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The manual! Thirty pages! Diagrams! And the last page just says: stop overthinking, you overthinker. That's you. That's definitely you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Man. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Practise Elder Mo's forms on the puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's his stance! The low one! He only did it when he was really angry! You do it better! Don't tell him! He can't hear! Tell him anyway!

objectives.text: Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: His forms, in your hands. It's like watching him. Younger, and less grumpy. And better looking. Don't tell him that either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Elder Bai. You said so. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: The Peach Blossom
quests.summary: The dried peach blossom in the box has a note on its back. It's not for you.

objectives.text: See what Elder Hua wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A blossom from his orchard. The note on the back. Let me see. ...It says 'for Hua'. In his hand. Forty years.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Forty years of anonymous peaches, and he signs a blossom when he's gone. That stubborn, stubborn old man.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I'm going to press it in my herbal. Between moonbell and mountain sage. He'd hate that. It's perfect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Old Bao. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (stops mixing) I don't have a pill for that, {player}.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Cleaning His Room
quests.summary: Somebody has to clean Elder Mo's room. Wei Tong can't. Elder Hua won't. So you do, with Xiao Man, who drops everything.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Man out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I'll help! I'll only drop the unimportant things! Probably! Is a teapot important? It's his good teapot. I'll hold it very carefully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Shi. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Pack up Elder Mo's belongings
Bring word to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I didn't drop the teapot. I dropped the lid. It's fine. It's fine! It bounced! Wei Tong's keeping the teapot. For the tea on the steps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: In Elder Mo's room: his savings, and a note. 'For the orphans.'

choices.text: Give it to the orphans yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Give it to the treasury to distribute

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Keep it. He'd want you strong.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Xiao Man, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Hermit Reads the Manual
quests.summary: The hermit reads Elder Mo's sword manual in the pagoda and declares it the most irritating document he's ever loved.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: This is the most irritating sword manual I've ever read. Every diagram has a note. 'Back straight.' 'No.' 'Again.' 'Adequate.'

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Elder Bai. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The hermit is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I wish I'd met him. I'd have liked to argue with him. People who write 'no' in the margins are wonderful to argue with.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I'm making a copy for the pagoda. Every note. Every 'no'. The Verdant Lotus hid everything in soup. The Azure Cloud hides it in grumbling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Hermit. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: No precedent for that at all. How exciting.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Guarding His Grave
quests.summary: At night, void wraiths gather at the cliff edge where Elder Mo's ashes were scattered. The fold's leak is drawn to grief.

objectives.text: Go and see Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Wraiths at the cliff! Where we scattered his ashes! They're just... standing there! Like they're mourning! Or feeding!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Lu Ping. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

objectives.text: Ward the cliff edge where his ashes lie

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises blue over the cliff, and the wraiths flinch back. For a moment in the blue light you'd swear someone was standing very straight.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

objectives.text: Hold the Hundred-Chi Waterfall against more void wraiths
Talk with Wei Tong at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nobody feeds on his grave. Nobody. I'll stand guard here every night if I have to. With Dumpling. And tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Wei Tong said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: By the precepts! I know those! Well, most of them!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Liu Er at the Gate
quests.summary: Liu Er reaches the top of the nine thousand steps, muddy and shaking and triumphant. Lu Ping lets him faint on his boots.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: He made it! Liu Er! He fainted on my boots! It's tradition! I'm so proud! I've known him since he was in a cage!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Lu Ping is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Bai.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I made it. Nine thousand. I counted. I'm going to write to Mother right now. Can I write to Mother right now?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Welcome to the Azure Cloud, Liu Er. Tomorrow you learn how little you know.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: No, Lu Ping. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: ...That's what Elder Mo said to you, isn't it? Wei Tong told me. I'm going to try very hard to be adequate.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Liu Er) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Liu Er's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for Liu Er's Welcome
quests.summary: The outer court prepares a welcome for its newest disciple, and Wei Tong wants spirit herbs for a proper first meal.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the medicine valley
See Elder Bai again

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Later. Over tea. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the shelves. They're older than your grandmother and less forgiving.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. Measured. Like a good index.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (thinks very hard) Yes. I agree.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Liu Er's First Stance
quests.summary: Wei Tong teaches Liu Er his first stance, the same one Elder Mo once taught Wei Tong, passed down one more generation.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Deal with the training puppets at the summit of Sword Peak. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai, you've been in the pagoda for three days. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I had a very nourishing scroll.

objectives.text: Drive the training puppets from the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Xiao Man is not wrong. Xiao Man is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Knowledge is like tea. Too hot, and it scalds. Too cold, and nobody wants it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, a Second Night
quests.summary: The wraiths at the cliff edge return a second night, testing the new ward Wei Tong insists on maintaining personally.

objectives.text: Sound the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Clear the Sword Peak path of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the outer pines. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Elder Hua. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Incense for Elder Mo's Shrine
quests.summary: A small shrine takes shape near the peach orchard, and Elder Hua asks for incense to keep it lit properly.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me incense bundles from the spirit peach orchard, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Bai.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Recover incense bundles from the spirit peach orchard
Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Copy, Finished
quests.summary: Bai Ling finishes her copy of Elder Mo's sword manual, margin notes and all, for the pagoda's permanent collection.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai out

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Every 'no'. Every 'again'. Every 'adequate'. Preserved exactly. Future disciples will learn sword forms and grumbling together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Xiao Man, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Man) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Do you want a pill? I made it. It's probably a pill.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The bamboo bends. So did you. It is not always wrong.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, Testing the Mountain
quests.summary: A small band of demon cultivators, hearing of Luo Hui's fall, probes the sect's defenses out of pure opportunism.

objectives.text: Stoke the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill furnace breathes out heat like a sleeping beast. Inside, a batch of pills turns slowly in the glow.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
