dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Jade Slips for the Pagoda Archive
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants Elder Mo's forty years of disciple notes properly archived on jade slips before they fade.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Bring me jade slips from the sect gate. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Lu Ping says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: See? Even Han Xue agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

objectives.text: Pick up jade slips near the sect gate
Report back to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Wei Tong. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you, by the way. I always bet on you. I've bought four hats.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the jade slips you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: By the precepts! I know those! Well, most of them!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Teapot Lid
quests.summary: Xiao Man, still guilty about the dropped teapot lid, presents Wei Tong with a replacement she made herself.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a new lid! It's a little lopsided! Like me! Please don't be sad about the old one anymore!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Listen to Ling Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It's perfect. Lopsided things are the best kind. He'd have said the same, probably while complaining about it.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The hermit is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Hermit. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Lu Ping's Boots
quests.summary: Lu Ping, having now had two disciples faint on his boots, considers it a personal tradition worth formalizing.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Two fainting disciples on these boots. I'm never washing them. They're historic now. Historic boots.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Xiao Man.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Man at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Sect Master. And the time before.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Brother, did you eat? You didn't eat. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I ate twice, Man. You watched me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Sometimes the rules are the cage. I know.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: One Year Later
quests.summary: On the anniversary of the formation's lighting, the whole sect gathers quietly at the hall steps, without being asked to.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Nobody organized this. They just came. That's what a good teacher leaves behind: people who show up without being told.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Cultivate at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit with your grief instead of fighting it, and your soul settles deeper for it.

objectives.text: Bring word to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: More or less. Mostly less.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That is the sect I want. Thank you for being it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Standing Straight
quests.summary: On the last night of the first year without him, you sit at the cliff edge with Elder Mo's manual and straighten your back.

objectives.text: Meditate where Elder Mo's ashes lie

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Back straight. Breath long. Your soul and body settle into one shape, like a sword into its sheath. Great Perfection of Soul Transformation.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wind off the sea of clouds sounds, just for a moment, like someone saying hmph.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Great Perfection. Next you sever what binds you, and walk in the void. Qing Luan's crane says the isles are tearing open with rifts. She needs you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo would say go. So go. Adequately.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. A careful choice.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Tea on the Steps
quests.summary: In the morning, Wei Tong pours tea on the hall steps for Elder Mo. Today, twelve new disciples pour with him.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Twelve new ones, and me, and a cup for him. Every morning. Train first. Then tea. That's the rule now. His rule. Our rule.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you have crumbs on your sword.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're lucky crumbs. Dumpling likes them.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The void, next. Rifts in the sky. We'll need everything he taught us. Straight backs included.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Liu Er. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Crane Full of Holes
quests.summary: Qing Luan's cloud crane arrives full of holes, and her voice keeps skipping words.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A crane from the star-gazer. It's full of holes. Her voice skips. 'Rifts. Isles. Come. Forgetting.' That's all we have.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Old Qiu has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The isles are closed for sixty years. If something's tearing them open, it's the fold. Go. Take Han Xue and Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Wake the guardian lion at the Southern Gate of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road is torn. Where the jade bridge should be, a rift of purple nothing hangs in the air, silently eating a pine.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The guardian lion stares down at you, one paw on a carved ball. Something is wedged beneath the paw.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You came. Good. I'm... what was I saying. The rifts. They're eating the isles. And me. I'm a memory. Memories are easy to eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. The Sect Master is not wrong. The Sect Master is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: Nothing Where the Bridge Was
quests.summary: The jade bridge is half gone, bitten off by a rift. Beyond it, the Isle of Winds floats alone.

objectives.text: Head to the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade bridge ends in mid-air. Where the rest should be, the rift hums, a colour that isn't a colour.

objectives.text: Touch the rift's edge with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing. Not dark. Not cold. Your soul slides off it the way water slides off oil. Something on the other side notices you.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It noticed you. I saw your face. What noticed you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know. Something that lives in nothing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Han Xue, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: Things That Live in Nothing
quests.summary: The things that live in nothing come out to see who touched their door.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Wraiths again. Purple ones. The Abyss's fold must connect to every rift. It's one big nothing with a lot of doors.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Qing Luan. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the rainbow bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Void wraiths ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths
Meet Qing Luan at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I remember you. Good. I forgot for a moment. Don't let me forget again. Tell me your name every hour. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhao Kang. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A void creature, cornered, is only trying to go home through the rift.

choices.text: Let it pass

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Kill it. Orders are orders.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Trap it and sell it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: Standing on Nothing
quests.summary: Qing Luan's first lesson in the void: stand on it. Not beside it. On it.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Void walking. Your soul steps first, like before. But this time, step onto the nothing, and let the nothing hold you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Han Xue. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It will, if you don't argue with it. Nothing is very polite if you don't argue.

objectives.text: Stand on the void with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You step onto the rift. It doesn't hold you. Then, when you stop expecting it to, it does, soft as snow, silent as a held breath.

objectives.text: See Qing Luan again

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You stood on nothing. Most cultivators take ten years. You took an afternoon. You're very bad at arguing with things you don't understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Qing Luan will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Unruly! Like a comet. Comets are my favourite.

quests.title: Storm Wolves in the Rift
quests.summary: The storm wolves of the isles have fallen into the rifts and come back wrong: half lightning, half nothing.

objectives.text: Make your way to the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves pace the spirit vein, their hind legs fading into purple nothing. They snap at the air, at crystals, at each other.

objectives.text: Stop the storm wolves at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Storm wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Gather void shards from the fallen wolves
Share your findings with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came up the torn road! It was very scary! We shouted the whole way! Where are the wolves? Oh. You did them.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. The Sect Master's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Rift's Heart
quests.summary: All the rifts on the isles lead back to one wound, in the celestial ruins, where the memory crystal used to hang.

objectives.text: Scout the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the memory crystal hung, a rift yawns like a mouth. The crystal is gone. Its memory is leaking into nothing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Someone was here before us. Not long ago, either.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I see it. Stay close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let me look first.

objectives.text: Gather the memory crystal's shards
Hold the rift's heart closed with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hold the rift like you'd hold a wound, soul pressed to it. It pushes back. Then, slowly, grudgingly, it narrows.

objectives.text: Defeat the celestial sentinels at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The palace sentinels, half-eaten by the void, stagger out of the ruins to defend a palace that is barely there.

objectives.text: Hurry to the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rifts across the isles shrink to hairlines. Qing Luan is sitting on the cloud gate, saying her own name over and over.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing
Report the poachers to the sect
Take it for its feathers

quests.title: Qing Luan Remembers Herself
quests.summary: Qing Luan is whole again, mostly. She says one thing slipped through the rift, and she wants it back.

objectives.text: Go and see Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I'm Qing Luan. I was the palace's youngest sage. I watched him climb. I'm... mostly here. One memory slipped through.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The memory of my own face. I can't remember what I looked like. Isn't that silly? Ten thousand years, and that's what I lose.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the sword isle

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have a star on your forehead and you frown at everyone like they've disappointed a constellation. That's what you look like.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: ...That's the nicest thing anyone's said to me in ten thousand years. Thank you, sword girl.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Stitching the Isles
quests.summary: The hairline rifts need stitching with cloud silk and qi. Every pine on the isle needs it. You have one afternoon.

objectives.text: Answer Qing Luan's summons

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Cloud silk, and your qi, stitched through the hairlines. Like mending a robe. A very large robe made of sky.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhao Kang?

objectives.text: Stitch the hairline rifts with cloud silk
Find Zhao Kang at the Immortal Palace gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've never sewn anything. I've sewn the sky. My great-grandfather is going to faint. I'm writing to him tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang! When do we fight again?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Never, Yan Tie. You shout during duels.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Void Beneath the Soul
quests.summary: Qing Luan says you're ready. Not for more tricks. For the thing beneath your soul, where cultivators go to refine it.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You've stood on nothing. Now go into it. Not a rift. The nothing beneath your own soul. Every cultivator has one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Refine your soul there, and you'll never fear a rift again. Or a fold. Or a patriarch hiding in one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What's down there?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Nothing. Exactly nothing. It's the hardest thing in the world to be alone with. Go on. I'll say your name every hour.

objectives.text: Go to the thunder isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lightning walks on the thunder isle. Every hair on your arms stands up and salutes it.

objectives.text: Read the rune pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune pillar is cracked along one rune. Whoever did it knew exactly where to strike.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the thunder isle

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the thunder isle isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Qing Luan. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: HA! Thunder Peak would do exactly that!

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Rift's Guardians
quests.summary: The hairline rifts, even stitched, still leak a few last void wraiths before they close for good.

objectives.text: Investigate the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial cranes stalk the shallows of their isle, white as snow, their crowns red as a seal.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Collect star iron around the elixir spring
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Star Iron From the Ruined Palace
quests.summary: The ruined celestial palace, half-eaten by rifts, still holds star iron worth gathering before it's stitched shut.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me star iron from the sky ship wreck.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yan Tie, lower your voice. The mountain is asleep.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: THE MOUNTAIN LIKES ME, ZHAO KANG.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

objectives.text: Find the star iron at the sky ship wreck
Return to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Han Xue. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more star iron than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart first, fist second. Just like the peak teaches!

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (beaming at Yan Tie) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Qing Luan's Missing Face
quests.summary: Han Xue and Zhao Kang try, between them, to describe Qing Luan's face well enough that she can picture it again.

objectives.text: Search the peach garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Peaches of immortality hang in the heavenly garden, glowing like little suns. Nobody is watching them. Supposedly.

objectives.text: Tie a wish to the wishing tree

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tie your own wish to the wishing tree. The branches rustle, though there is no wind.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sharp. Like a decision you regret making. I mean that kindly. Mostly kindly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore the Sect Master. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let me. She has a star between her brows and eyes like she's already disappointed in you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, Fully Healed
quests.summary: The half-lightning wolves, freed from the rifts, need one more careful pass before they can be trusted near disciples.

objectives.text: Charge the rune pillar at the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You lay your palm on the rune pillar. It drinks your qi, hums a note, and passes it to its neighbours.

objectives.text: Clear the storm plateau of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Recover thunder crystals from the storm plateau
Show Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Qing Luan, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Sect Master. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Zhao Kang Writes to His Great-Grandfather
quests.summary: Zhao Kang makes good on his promise and writes home about sewing the sky, and gets a reply faster than expected.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He wrote back. One line. 'Your grandmother sewed clouds once too. Ask her about it when you visit.' I didn't know that. I'm visiting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Cloud Silk, the Stitching's Reserve
quests.summary: A reserve of cloud silk is set aside in case the hairline rifts reopen before the isles fully heal.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me cloud silk from the sky ship wreck. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Han Xue has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk at the sky ship wreck
Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the cloud silk you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Cloud Gate's New Quiet
quests.summary: With the rifts stitched, the cloud gate falls unusually quiet, and Qing Luan admits she isn't sure what to do with quiet.

objectives.text: Head to the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade terraces shine green and white. Each grain of rice glows like a tiny pearl.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ten thousand years of watching a stair. Sixty years of visitors. Now quiet. I don't remember what quiet is for. Remind me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Last Nest
quests.summary: A last nest of void wraiths hides beneath the immortal garden, missed in the first sweep of the rifts.

objectives.text: Make your way to the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blossom trees taller than pagodas drop petals like warm snow on the immortal garden.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The void wraiths come on in silence.

objectives.text: Pick up cloud silk near the immortal garden
Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Qing Luan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: Void Shards for Elder Bai's Study
quests.summary: Elder Bai has requested every void shard the isles can spare, hoping to understand the fold's nature better.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me void shards from the elixir spring.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Collect void shards around the elixir spring
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Han Xue's Question About Nothing
quests.summary: Before you attempt the breakthrough, Han Xue asks what it's actually like, down in the nothing beneath the soul.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Is it scary? Down there?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know yet. Qing Luan says it's the hardest thing to be alone with. I believe her.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then I'll be at the gate. Saying your name isn't just Qing Luan's job.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Spirit Severing
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, with Qing Luan saying your name every hour, you sink past qi and soul into the nothing beneath, and sever.

objectives.text: Answer Qing Luan's summons

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit at the gate. Sink. I'll say your name. When you hear it, come back up. If you don't hear it, keep going. Either is fine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Sect Master, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

objectives.text: Gather the stitched rift-silk for the breakthrough
Sever your spirit in the void

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Past qi. Past soul. Past the place where the Heart Mirror found you. Down to the stillness beneath, where there is nothing at all.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing, and nothing, and in the nothing, your name, said by a memory who never forgets it now. You rise, and the void rises with you.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Spirit Severing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The storm reaches down with long fingers, feeling for every thread you have not cut.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came up the torn road myself. I felt it from the mountain. Spirit Severing. Every thread cut. You can walk where he's hiding now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Qing Luan has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Not yet. Not alone. But you can. For the first time since the fold, we have a way in.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Into the Fold
quests.summary: Ye Wuming meets you at the rim. He wants to know if his children's families are still behind the gate. So does Iron-Fang.

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You can walk in the void now. So look. Into the fold. Tell me if the gate's still there. Tell me if they're still there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

objectives.text: Scout the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the blood pools the fold hangs in the air, a seam of purple dark. It hums at your refined soul like a cat that wants to be let in.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's here too. Look for my sister. She'll be the one shouting. She was always the one shouting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Zhao Kang's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Drifting Fortress
quests.summary: You step your soul a hand's breadth into the fold. The black fortress is there, drifting in nothing, very far away and very near.

objectives.text: Hurry to the poison garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul steps in. Nothing. And in the nothing, the black fortress, drifting like a ship with no sea, its gate shut tight.

objectives.text: Look through the fold with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind the walls, in the cages: people. Not moving. Not breathing. Held, mid-breath, mid-word, like flies in amber. A woman mid-shout.

objectives.text: Tell Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Mid-shout? Was she mid-shout? ...That's her. That's my sister. She's alive. She's frozen, and she's alive.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's going to cry now. Everybody look at the wall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: The Fold Pushes Back
quests.summary: The fold doesn't like being looked into. It pushes back with everything it has.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fold's spitting wraiths at us. It didn't like you looking. Nobody likes being looked at in the bath.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Iron-Fang. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Void wraiths spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the sulphur vents
Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It knows you now. The fold. The Patriarch inside it knows you walked to his door. He'll send something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi's survived worse.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hunted.

quests.title: Gu in the Void
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, has come to the rim. He says he knows what the Patriarch will send. He sent it himself, once.

objectives.text: See what Elder Gu wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He'll send the Rust Monk. Tie Shan. The Second Rung. He always sends the monk when he wants something taken apart slowly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I delivered messages to Tie Shan. Before. He was a monk in a temple that burned. He prayed to the Patriarch for rain. He got rust.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Where will he go?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Where there's iron. And prayers. Qingshi. The temple. Hong's old temple. He'll want to pray in it.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the burned hall. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Ye Wuming. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the chain bridge.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll prove you wrong. Politely.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Blood Guards Out of Nothing
quests.summary: Blood Guards step out of the fold, wrapped in purple nothing, the first of the Patriarch's soldiers to cross since it closed.

objectives.text: Shatter the obelisk at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Guards step out of the air at the obelisk ring, purple mist streaming off their armour. They've come to see who looked.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl across the obelisk. You set your palm against it and push your qi in, and it cracks.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Gather void shards from their armour
Compare notes with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: They came out of nothing. They can come out of nothing anywhere. The sect. The town. Anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. Ye Wuming's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'm going to draw a map of where the fold touches the world. Every place. Somebody has to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Looking for Faces
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children want you to look into the fold for their families. One by one. You can't say no.

objectives.text: Hear Ye Wuming out

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They want you to look for their families. One by one. I told them you might not find them. They said look anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the faces in the fold: the Blood Guard who once beat you. He's lost, pleading.

choices.text: Pull him out

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Pull him out, in chains

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave him to the nothing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Careful. I know where that road ends.

objectives.text: Go to the blood river

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring asks for her father. You look. A tall man, frozen mid-step, holding a cup. River asks for his grandmother. Small Mountain asks for nobody.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Small Mountain, is there anyone you want me to look for?

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Small Mountain shakes his head. Just look for Ye Wuming's mother, he says. He never asks for himself.

quests.title: Ye Qing
quests.summary: You look into the fold for a woman named Ye Qing, Evening Clear. You don't find her. You find something else.

objectives.text: Investigate the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: No Ye Qing in the cages. But in the fortress's lowest room, a wall of names, scratched by the children the Blood Moon stole.

objectives.text: Read the wall of names through the fold

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thousands of names. Near the bottom, small, in a six-year-old's hand: Ye Qing's son. And a name, half-scratched out. Ye Chen—

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ye Chen. Half a name. Mine. I scratched it there when I was six. I'd forgotten I'd done it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Ye Wuming, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Half a name. It's more than I had this morning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Holding the Rim
quests.summary: The fold opens wider after you look. The Blood Moon wants to know how much you saw.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The rim's crawling with them. I've counted forty. I've stopped counting. I'm just hitting now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow
Talk with Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Rust Monk. Gu said Qingshi. The temple. If he's praying there, the whole town's iron is going to rot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

quests.title: Maps of the Touching Places
quests.summary: Xiao Shi starts his map: every place the fold touches the world. He needs samples from each one.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Every place the fold touches leaves a shard. I need shards from the rim, the pools, the obelisks. Then I can map the rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Gather fold-shards for Xiao Shi's map
Bring word to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Twelve shards. Twelve places. I'll ask Elder Bai for the rest of the map. He'll be so excited he'll forget to eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Han Xue. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, Watching the Wall of Names
quests.summary: A cluster of demon cultivators guards the fold's edge near the wall of names, as if the Patriarch values it.

objectives.text: Sort the scroll rack at the forbidden library

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You work along the scroll rack scroll by scroll. One is shelved in the wrong place, on purpose.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the forbidden library

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Moon cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Find the jade slips at the forbidden library
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The ruined sect gate is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't make a habit of it, Xiao Shi.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Rim's Guard
quests.summary: The fallen guards at the rim leave demon cores behind, worth gathering before the fold's watch is renewed.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me demon cores from the corpse forest.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhao Kang. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Recover demon cores from the corpse forest
See Xiao Shi again

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the demon cores you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: River's Question
quests.summary: River, one of Ye Wuming's rescued children, asks if grandmothers can be found even after their names are half-scratched away.

objectives.text: Search the blood river

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: River asks quietly if a name has to be whole to count. You tell him no name is ever too small to count.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the blood river

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm standing right here, you know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the blood river

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Blood Guards, a Second Wave
quests.summary: A second wave of blood guards crosses the fold's edge, testing how many soldiers the rim's defenders can hold off.

objectives.text: Search the wine jars at the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
