dialogue.text: The smell from the wine jars is sweet and strong. Beneath it is something sharper, and not wine at all.

objectives.text: Clear the cave of echoes of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: More Blood Guards? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Gather blood lotus at the poison garden
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Obelisk Ring
quests.summary: The obelisk ring, disturbed by the fold's activity, sheds rune fragments worth studying before the next crossing.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me rune fragments from the sulphur vents.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Listen to Iron-Fang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Pick up rune fragments near the sulphur vents
Return to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rune fragments came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it started, for me.

quests.title: Small Mountain's Silence
quests.summary: Small Mountain, who never asks for himself, finally admits why: he's afraid of what looking would show him.

objectives.text: Head to the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Small Mountain says if you looked and found nothing, that would be worse than never looking at all. You promise to look anyway, someday.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ledgers on the abacus desk balance to the last copper, which is exactly what makes them suspicious.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Growing Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi's map of the fold's touching places grows longer every day, and he shows you the pattern he's starting to see.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It's not random. The fold touches places that already had a wound in them. Old battles. Old griefs. It follows scars.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Ku the Broker. And the time before.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Down here everything has a price. Especially directions. These ones are free. Once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the slave mines

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Wall's Guardians
quests.summary: A cluster of void wraiths guards the wall of names from the inside, as if the fold itself wants the names kept.

objectives.text: Test the puppet frame at the training pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Someone has scratched a tally of defeats into the puppet frame. The puppet is winning.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Collect demon cores around the training pit
Compare notes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Xiao Shi.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (beaming at Ye Wuming) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Void Shards for Xiao Shi's Final Count
quests.summary: The last shards needed for Xiao Shi's map come from the deepest part of the rim, near the fold's thinnest point.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me void shards from the obsidian spires.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.text: Find the void shards at the obsidian spires
Go back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Iron-Fang. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Gu's Quiet Apology
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, watching Iron-Fang speak to the fold, apologizes to Ye Wuming for every child he never managed to save.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Gu out

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I delivered messages that stole children. I can't undo that. I can only help find the ones still frozen behind that wall.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Help, then. That's the only apology that means anything now.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the bone bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the ghost village

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Ye Wuming says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Promise at the Fold
quests.summary: Before you leave, Iron-Fang puts his hand on the fold and says something to a sister who can't hear him.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Mei. It's me. Tie Hu. I'm washing dishes now. And farming. Badly. I'll get you out. Iron-Fang pays his debts.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...She's mid-shout. I bet she's shouting at me. She always was. Come on. The monk won't wait.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Shi at the Blood Moon shrine

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ignore Iron-Fang. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Everything Rusts
quests.summary: Qingshi is turning orange. Constable Du meets you at the gate holding a spear that crumbles as he salutes.

objectives.text: Search the notice board at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The town gate's hinges are orange and weeping. Every nail in every house is rusting. The air smells of old blood and wet iron.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the notice board from corner to corner. Someone has crossed out a name and written a warning beside it.

objectives.text: Speak with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My spear. Twenty years I've had it. It crumbled when I saluted. The gate won't close. The bell won't ring.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Constable Du is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: There's a monk in the old temple, praying. Every time he finishes a prayer, something else rusts.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Unlawful, strictly. Effective, though.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Town Without Iron
quests.summary: Without iron, a town falls apart in small ways first. Everybody has a small way.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: My ferry chain's gone. Rusted through. I'm pulling the ferry by hand. Forty years. My arms are older than the chain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Merchant Jin. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Hear what Madam Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My pots! My ladle! I hit a man with my ladle and it snapped! I've never been so insulted!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Old Pan. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Madam Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild's scales. Rusted. I can't weigh anything. I've had to trust people. It's been a terrible week. It's been a wonderful week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Madam Fang.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: The Rusted Bell
quests.summary: The town bell hangs rusted solid in the watchtower. If it can ring once, the monk will hear it and come out.

objectives.text: Make your way to the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The town bell is a lump of orange. When you touch it, flakes fall like autumn leaves. Inside it, the clapper is fused.

objectives.text: Burn the rust from the bell with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul sinks into the bell and finds the iron underneath the rust, and reminds it. The rust falls away. The bell rings once.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He heard it. The prayers stopped. He'll come out to see who unrusted his bell. Good. Let him come out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: apothecary_wang
dialogue.text: Good. My drawers will sleep easier. So will I.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: apothecary_wang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Acolytes in Orange
quests.summary: The monk sends his acolytes first, orange-robed and bowing, rust flaking from their blades.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They bow before they stab. I remember these. I still bow back. Then I stab. It's a whole ritual now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Madam Fang said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Break the rust acolytes at the market square

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Stop the rust acolytes regrouping
Talk with Constable Du at the east gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Six of them. They bowed to me first. I didn't know what to do. I bowed back. Then I hit one with a chair.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Captain Lei.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Constable Du. More sense there than in half this town.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: The Well Rusts
quests.summary: The monk's next prayer reaches the town well. If the water turns to rust, the town has nothing to drink.

objectives.text: Report to Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The well's turning orange! The water tastes of iron! If it goes, the whole town goes thirsty!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Seal the well against the rust

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press your palm to the well's stones. Your soul steps into the water and holds it, clean, while the rust beats on it like rain.

objectives.text: Stop the rust acolytes at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Hold the back alley against more Blood Guards
Report back to Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The water's clear. You held it. I carried water for a year looking for my son. I can't tell you what clean water means to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Tie Shan's Temple
quests.summary: Gu said the Rust Monk was a monk whose temple burned. Old Pan remembers the fire. He remembers the monk.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I remember. Thirty years back. A temple upriver burned in a drought. The monk prayed for rain for forty days. No rain. The village left him.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Listen to Huo Da. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Last I heard he'd gone to the Abyss to ask the Patriarch for rain instead. I suppose the Patriarch sent rust. That's what the Patriarch does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He prayed for forty days, and nobody answered.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Aye. That'll turn a man to rust quicker than water.

objectives.text: Find Merchant Jin at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the town temple

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Probably, Merchant Jin. Doesn't change anything.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Rust in the Graves
quests.summary: The monk's rust has reached the hill graves, where the old iron grave markers are crumbling into the soil.

objectives.text: Scout the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The iron grave markers on the hill are crumbling into orange dust. Among them, rust wraiths drift, feeding on the prayers the dead can't finish.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather the crumbling grave markers
Talk it over with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men are recasting the markers at the forge. The forge is rusting too. We're working fast. We're very good at fast now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There you are. The noodles were getting cold, and so was my temper.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Good.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

quests.title: Rain for a Monk
quests.summary: You have an idea. The monk prayed for rain and got none. What if, before you fight him, somebody gave him rain?

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Rain. You want to make it rain? For the monster who's rusting the town? ...That's the strangest plan you've ever had.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He prayed for forty days. Nobody answered. I want to answer. Then I want to fight him.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Magistrate Zhou. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Call rain over the temple with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your refined soul reaches up into the sky over Qingshi and finds the clouds, and asks. It takes an hour. Then it rains.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Rain! Over the temple! Only over the temple! The monk has come out and is standing in it with his face turned up! He's weeping!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: The classics say a wise man walks around a river. The classics never had to cross this one.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Listen to Scholar Ouyang. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Second Rung Kneels
quests.summary: The Second Rung stands in the rain he prayed for thirty years ago. He is weeping, and rusting, and he is still the Patriarch's.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table at the town temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Rust Monk stands in the temple courtyard, face up, rain running down his orange robes. He turns to you, and bows.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The dust on the offering table has been disturbed. Beneath the incense bowl lies a folded note.

objectives.name: Tie Shan, the Rust Monk
objectives.text: Defeat Tie Shan, the Rust Monk

dialogue.speaker: rung_shan
dialogue.text: Rain. You gave me rain. Thirty years too late. Forgive me. My vows are rusted through. I can only do what I was made to do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll answer that too, monk.

objectives.text: Pray with the Rust Monk as he falls

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tie Shan kneels in the rain. His rust washes away, and underneath there is only an old man, very tired. Thank you, he says. His star goes out.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Two stars out. You gave him rain first. I'm going to be thinking about that for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Rust Monk kneels in the rain and asks to atone rather than die.

choices.text: Accept his penance

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Deliver him to the alliance's court

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Refuse him

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Rust Wraiths, the Last of the Graveyard
quests.summary: A few rust wraiths linger in the graveyard even after the monk's fall, feeding on old unfinished prayers.

objectives.text: Study the map table at the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Void wraiths ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Recover cloud silk from the dye yard
Share your findings with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Gate closes at dusk. Always has. Always will.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the New Bell
quests.summary: The town wants a proper new bell cast, and Steward Qian, reached by crane, sends spirit stones to fund it.

objectives.text: Hear Magistrate Zhou out

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me spirit stones from the brewery, would you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not now, Scholar Ouyang. Later. Over wine.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the brewery
Bring word to Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: Remarkable. I'll set it as an essay question. The students will hate you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Scholar Ouyang. Heaven bless {them}.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Old Pan's Confession
quests.summary: Old Pan admits he was in the crowd that left the monk's village during the drought, and has carried the guilt for thirty years.

objectives.text: Speak with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I was young. I was scared. We all left him praying alone. I've thought about it every dry season since.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You gave him a memory that led us to rain for him. That's not nothing, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Huo Da.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm trying to learn which things shouldn't.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the lower docks. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Rust Acolytes, Surrendering
quests.summary: A handful of rust acolytes, seeing their master weep and fall, surrender rather than fight on.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk at the guild master's manor

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run the beads of the abacus desk. The accounts come out one sum short, every month, for years.

objectives.text: Clear the guild master's manor of rust acolytes

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Rust acolytes! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the guild master's manor
Tell Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: We're done at the lower docks. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Grave Markers, Recast
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's men finish recasting the graveyard's markers, and ask for help placing them back correctly.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me recast markers from the back alley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Merchant Jin. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Zhao Kang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Collect recast markers around the back alley
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Widow Liu. Widow Liu won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Monk's Old Vows
quests.summary: Among Tie Shan's rusted robes, Constable Du finds a scrap of his original monastic vows, still legible.

objectives.text: Hurry to the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the Wang pharmacy, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Check the medicine cabinet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You open drawer after drawer of the medicine cabinet. Ginseng, liquorice, and one drawer that smells of blood lotus.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: 'To bring rain, or to bring none, and love the land regardless.' He broke that vow the day he asked the Patriarch for rain instead.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We all were, Widow Liu. We all were.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Anything on the far bank? Lanterns? Faces? I still dream about the lanterns.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Constable Du) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Madam Fang's New Ladle Ceremony
quests.summary: Madam Fang insists on a small ceremony for her new iron ladle, complete with Iron-Fang as reluctant guest of honor.

objectives.text: Answer Madam Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Every ladle deserves a proper welcome. This one's going to hit a great many people. It should know its purpose early.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Not now, Huo Da. Later. Over wine.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the north gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the north gate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Madam Fang said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the guild master's manor

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Madam Fang. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Retreating Watch
quests.summary: A last watch of blood guards, left behind when the Rust Monk fell, retreats toward the Abyss and must be turned back.

objectives.text: Read the map table at the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Guards spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the brewery
Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Old Pan.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Medicine for the Rain-Soaked
quests.summary: Half the town caught cold standing in the rain to watch the monk's fall. Elder Hua's medicine runs short.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me medicine bundles from the pottery kilns.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Magistrate Zhou. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the pottery kilns
Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Zhou's Letter of Thanks
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou writes a formal letter of thanks to the sect, and a much less formal one to you personally.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The formal one goes in the town archive. The other one just says: you gave a dying man rain before you gave him a fight. I won't forget that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: The classics say a wise man walks around a river. The classics never had to cross this one.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: No, Merchant Jin. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Iron Again
quests.summary: With the monk gone, the rust stops. Qingshi spends a week rebuilding its iron, and complaining happily.

objectives.text: See what Constable Du wants

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: New spear! Forged by Iron-Fang's men. It's ugly. It's the best spear I've ever had.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Magistrate Zhou.

objectives.text: Meet Madam Fang at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: New ladle. Iron. Heavy. I tested it on Iron-Fang's head. Gently. He said it was very good iron. I'm keeping him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Constable Du. {player} has never let us down.

objectives.text: Talk with Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The scales are fixed. I can weigh things again. I've decided not to. I've got used to trusting people. It's cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Listen to Constable Du. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: An Abbess at the Gate
quests.summary: A woman in white climbs the last of the nine thousand steps without breathing hard. She is the Abbess of the Moon-Well.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A nun! An abbess! She climbed the steps without sweating! Nobody climbs the steps without sweating! I'm in love!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Fan Rui. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: An abbess in white robes stands at the gate, very straight, very calm, with rain-grey eyes that have not slept in days.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Jing Xuan, abbess of the Moon-Well. My nuns are vanishing into rifts. Eleven, so far. One of them told me you answer when asked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The girl you freed from the cage at the Abyss rim. Her name is Lian. She sings every morning so she knows she's here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: The Sect Master and the Abbess
quests.summary: The Sect Master and the abbess sit in the main hall. They have met once before, forty years ago, and neither of them liked it.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Abbess Jing. Forty years ago you called the Azure Cloud 'a sword with a sect attached'.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: And you called the Moon-Well 'a well with opinions'. We were both young and correct. I need your help, Yun Qingyao.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Then you'll have it. The heir walks in the void now. Rifts are nothing to the heir. Literally.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Abbess Jing. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Hermit.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm telling the whole gate! Twice! With improvements!

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

quests.title: Where Nuns Go
quests.summary: One of the Moon-Well's rifts has opened on the sect's own mountain, in the pavilion. A nun's prayer beads lie beside it.

objectives.text: Go to the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the pavilion, a hairline rift hangs in the air. Beneath it, a string of white prayer beads, and the smell of incense and nothing.

objectives.text: Reach through the rift with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the other side: white robes, drifting in nothing. Eleven nuns, praying in the void, not frozen. Awake. Singing, very faintly.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Singing. They're singing. Lian taught them. So they'd know they're still here. Bring them back. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Lu Ping?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Walking Into Nothing
quests.summary: To bring the nuns back, you have to walk into the rift, all the way, body and soul. Qing Luan never taught you that part.

objectives.text: Go and see the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The star-gazer taught you to stand on nothing. Walking into it is different. I ran through a rift once. Three hundred years ago.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Han Xue. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The trick is to hold on to something on this side. A name. A voice. I held on to my master's. I didn't know I was doing it.

objectives.text: Walk into the rift holding a name

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You step in holding a name: Wei Tong's, for some reason, loud and warm. The nothing closes around you. You follow the singing.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You were gone an hour. You came back with eleven nuns and your robe on backwards. What happened in there?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nothing. Exactly nothing. And some singing.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Hermit.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The bamboo bends. So did you. It is not always wrong.

quests.title: What Followed the Nuns
quests.summary: Something followed the nuns out of the rift. Several somethings, with hands.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Things followed you out. Of course they did. Things always follow you out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The void wraiths come on in silence.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths
Meet Abbess Jing at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: My nuns are safe. The Moon-Well owes the Azure Cloud a debt. We are very bad at debts. We'll learn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Medicine for the Nuns
quests.summary: The nuns are cold and dazed from the void. Elder Hua wants warming medicine brewed before they go home.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Void-chill. They're cold in a way fire doesn't touch. Warming herbs, and a lot of them. And tea. Lots of tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Noted, Sect Master. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Gather warming herbs for the nuns
Go back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: They're warming up. One of them asked for a second cup and then apologised for being greedy. Nuns. I've never been so charmed.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Answer Lu Ping, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi's map of the fold's touching places now covers a whole wall of the pagoda. The rifts aren't random.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Look. Every rift, on the map. The isles, the Abyss, the Moon-Well, the town, our pavilion. They're not random.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Elder Bai. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Study Xiao Shi's map of the rifts

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rifts form a spiral, tightening, and at its centre, the fold. And at seven points around it, seven old red dots: the Rungs.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Rungs anchor the rifts. The rifts feed the fold. Break the rungs, and the rifts close. Xiao Shi, you're a genius. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Abbess Stays a Week
quests.summary: The abbess stays a week, to rest her nuns. She spends most of it arguing theology with the hermit, and winning.

objectives.text: See what Abbess Jing wants

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Your hermit says compassion is the blossom of the Heart Sutra. I say compassion is the root. We've been arguing for three days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Abbess Jing, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: It's the most fun I've had in forty years. Don't tell him.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She's wrong. It's the blossom. She's very clever about being wrong. I'm going to lose, aren't I. I'm going to lose to a nun.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. The hermit is right.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Abbess Jing. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Abbess asks if the Azure Cloud would shelter her nuns for good, against custom.

choices.text: Yes. Custom be damned.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Put it to the elders' council

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Only if the Moon-Well pays

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: Rifts on the Mountain
quests.summary: On the abbess's last night, three rifts open at once on the sect's mountain, and things pour out of all of them.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Three rifts! Three! At once! On our mountain! I'm ringing every bell I can find!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

objectives.text: Pour your soul into the formation to hold the rifts

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sink your refined soul into the Great Azure Formation. Its blue light spreads over the mountain like a hand closing over a wound.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Finish the celestial sentinels at the arena stands
Find Abbess Jing at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The formation answered you. The mountain answered you. The Moon-Well will stand with the Azure Cloud. Not for the debt. For that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Hm. Lu Ping is not wrong. Lu Ping is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Abbess Jing is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, the Last of Them
quests.summary: A few stray celestial sentinels, pulled through by the rifts, wander the outer pines confused about which century they're in.

objectives.text: Examine the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense smoke curls out of the bronze ding. Beneath the ash, something that is not incense glints.

objectives.text: Defeat the celestial sentinels at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial sentinels spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the outer pines
Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the stone bridge isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Back, and breathing evenly. That's all a healer asks for, and so rarely gets.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Elder Hua. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Warming Herbs, the Second Batch
quests.summary: Elder Hua asks for a second batch of warming herbs, this time for the disciples who fought the rifts all night.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Elder Hua, have you seen my spectacles?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: On your head, Elder Bai. As they were yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the medicine valley
Report back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Wei Tong Meets the Abbess
quests.summary: Wei Tong, thrilled to meet nuns who fought void wraiths and won, asks the abbess for training tips.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You fought nothing! With prayer beads! I have a sword and I still get scared! Teach me the prayer bead trick!

dialogue.speaker: player
