dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to the hermit. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The trick is the singing, young man. Fear is quieter when you're not the only voice in the dark.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the ancestral tombs

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: What Abbess Jing said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nobody tells the gate disciple anything. So I listen. Constantly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Pavilion's Echo
quests.summary: A faint echo of void wraiths lingers in the pavilion where the nuns' rift first opened, drawn by leftover incense.

objectives.text: Investigate the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great bronze cauldron smoulders. Someone has written 'donations welcome' on it in chalk.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the outer dormitories
Compare notes with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Abbess Jing, I'm only listening.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Jade Slips for Xiao Shi's Wall Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi's growing wall map needs jade slips to preserve a proper copy before disciples wear the original thin with tracing.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bring me jade slips from the laundry stream. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Elder Bai. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

objectives.text: Find the jade slips at the laundry stream
Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part the hermit will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more jade slips than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to the hermit) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Abbess's Theology, Written Down
quests.summary: Bai Ling begs the abbess and the hermit to let her transcribe their theological argument before either side forgets a point.

objectives.text: Search the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Notice boards cover every wall of the mission hall, sect tasks pinned three deep and fluttering in the draught.

objectives.text: Check the accounts at the abacus desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The abacus desk is covered in neat figures. Between them, in a smaller hand, someone has written a name.

objectives.text: Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Three days of arguing and neither of you has written a word down! This is priceless! Let me copy it before you both die of old age!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Fan Rui is not wrong. Fan Rui is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (beaming at Elder Bai) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (tugging Elder Bai's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Lu Ping and the Nuns
quests.summary: Lu Ping, terrified of the eleven nuns at first, discovers they're delighted by his gate-keeping stories.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: They laughed at my chicken story! Nuns! Laughing! I've never felt so respected by a religious order!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Sect Master. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Hear what Abbess Jing has to say

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Abbess Jing said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Abbess Jing. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Spirit Wolves, Drawn by the Formation's Glow
quests.summary: The formation's blue light after holding the rifts draws curious spirit wolves down from the snowline.

objectives.text: Tend the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Clear the sunrise terrace of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the outer dormitories
Talk it over with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Han Xue says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Elder Hua) That was cold.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Held Rifts
quests.summary: The three rifts the formation held leave rune fragments behind, worth studying for Elder Bai's growing archive.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Bring me rune fragments from the laundry stream. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Zhong Ming has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Gather rune fragments at the laundry stream
See Abbess Jing again

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhong Ming?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Abbess Jing does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the rune fragments you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Abbess Jing) That was cold.

quests.title: The Abbess's Farewell
quests.summary: Before leaving, the abbess and the hermit finally agree on one thing: neither of them is winning the argument, and both enjoyed losing.

objectives.text: See what Abbess Jing wants

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: We'll continue this by letter. Compassion as root or blossom. I expect a very long correspondence.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: As do I. Losing to you weekly sounds like an excellent use of what's left of my three hundred years.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the summit of Sword Peak. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (hiding behind Han Xue) Oh.

quests.title: Void in the Marrow
quests.summary: When the abbess leaves, you sit on the formation plaza where you held the rifts and let the void settle into your marrow.

objectives.text: Refine your soul on the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void you walked through settles into you like cold water into a well. Your soul is deeper, stiller. Middle stage of Spirit Severing.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. The Iron Scale. The Zhao clan. Qingshi. The sects are coming to us now, not the other way round.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Han Xue is right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Abbess Jing agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Sect Master says it's because of you. I say it's because you keep saying yes. Stop saying yes. No. Don't.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Hermit Goes Home
quests.summary: The hermit has been teaching in the pagoda for a season. This morning he packed his bag in a hurry. The spring is draining.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The spring. I felt it in my sleep. It's draining. Into nothing. Three hundred years it's been there. I'm going home.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Come with me. Please. I don't know how to fight nothing. You do.

objectives.text: Examine the spirit fountain at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit spring is half gone. At its bottom, a rift swirls like a drain, and the lotus pads are sinking toward it one by one.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Coins and petals glint in the spirit fountain. The water hums faintly, a note just below hearing.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Half. Half the spring gone in a night. The lotus is dying. My masters planted that lotus.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering to the hermit) That was amazing.

quests.title: The Drain
quests.summary: The rift at the spring's bottom is small, and pulling hard. Something on the other side wants the water.

objectives.text: Head to the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Water spirals down into the rift at the spring's bottom. On the other side, something vast is drinking, very slowly.

objectives.text: Look through the drain with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the other side: the fold. The black fortress, drifting. And a thin stream of spring water, pouring into the altar of blood.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He's drinking the Verdant Lotus spring. Through the fold. Feeding his altar with your family's water.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Wraiths Guard the Drain
quests.summary: The drain is guarded. The Patriarch doesn't want his water cut off.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came! Elder Hua sent soup! It's cold! There are wraiths! Why is there always something?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Ye Wuming. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The soup survived. I'm very proud of the soup. Eat it. It's cold but it's brave.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha. The hermit's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Stones for a Dam
quests.summary: The hermit says the Verdant Lotus once dammed the spring to build the shrine. The old dam stones are still in the ruins.

objectives.text: Go and see the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The dam stones. My masters dammed the spring to build the shrine, then unmade it. The stones are in the ruins. Bring them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Headman Kuang, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Gather the old dam stones from the ruins
Break the stone golems at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins' stone keepers don't want the dam stones moved. They were told to guard them three hundred years ago.

objectives.text: Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The keepers let you take them. They recognise you now. They used to recognise me. I ran past them. They remember that too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Answer Wei Tong, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rune fragments came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Damming Nothing
quests.summary: You can't dam a rift with stone. But you can dam it with stone and a refined soul, the hermit says. He'll help.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Stones around the rift. Your soul across the gap. My sutra holding it all together. Together. Like my masters did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Xiao Shi. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The village is grateful. The village is also very nervous. Mostly nervous.

objectives.text: Dam the rift with stone and soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stone, soul, sutra. Root, stem, blossom. The rift pulls. You hold. The hermit sings. The drain slows, stops, and closes like an eye.

objectives.text: Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It closed. We closed it. Together. Three hundred years ago I ran from this. Today I sang it shut.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The dam will flood a demonic cultivator's hideout downstream. His family is inside.

choices.text: Warn them first

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Follow the plan exactly

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Let it flood without warning

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Wolves at the Low Water
quests.summary: With the spring low, the forest's wolves have come down to drink the last of it, and some of them are void-touched.

objectives.text: Make your way to the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves crowd the stream below the spring, lapping at the trickle. Some of them have purple mist trailing from their fur.

objectives.text: Stop the spirit wolves at the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit wolves spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather void shards from the touched wolves
Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Another touching place for my map. The spring. The Patriarch's reaching into everything the Verdant Lotus made.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Clean tracking. You'd make a decent hunter, if you ever stop being a hero.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Meng Sanniang. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That makes sense.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Fair's fair.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

quests.title: The Spring Refills
quests.summary: Slowly, over a night, the spring refills. The hermit sits at its edge the whole time, and talks to it.

objectives.text: Report to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I told it about the sect. About the lotus in your pond. About the nun who beat me at theology. It seemed interested.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The hermit knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Springs are good listeners. Better than people. They don't interrupt. They just fill up.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The lotus pads are rising. The herbs by the stream are greening. It's healing. I came to see. I'm staying to watch.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A gentle hand. That's the best medicine there is.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Other Half
quests.summary: Ye Wuming arrives, drawn by the dam. He has news: the Third Rung is hunting his children.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Third Rung. Jiu Rong. Madam Ninefold. She wants my children back. She was the one who raised them. Trained them. Bled them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Hermit.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

objectives.text: Scout the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming stands in the clearing, very still, holding a torn black ribbon. It's River's.

objectives.text: Examine River's torn ribbon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ribbon is torn, not cut. There's powder on it that smells of nine different perfumes. One of them is blood lotus.

objectives.text: See Ye Wuming again

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She took River. Last night. She left the ribbon so I'd know. She wants me to come to her. She wants you to come with me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: The Hermit Says Go
quests.summary: The hermit tells you to go with Ye Wuming. The spring is safe, and a child is not.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Go. The spring's safe. I'll sit with it. A child is worth more than a spring. Even a Verdant Lotus spring.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My masters would say so. I say so. Go.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Thank you. I've never had anyone come with me. Not once. Not in forty years of hunting them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Ye Wuming) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: Void-Touched Wolves, the Last of the Stream
quests.summary: A last few void-touched wolves linger at the stream, reluctant to leave now that the water runs clean again.

objectives.text: Hurry to the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the stream not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Defeat the spirit wolves at the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The spirit wolves come on in silence.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the stream
Compare notes with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Drink this. No, it doesn't taste good. That's how you know it works.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A gentle hand. That's the best medicine there is.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (stops mixing) I don't have a pill for that, {player}.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs From the Healing Forest
quests.summary: As the spring refills, the forest's herbs green again, and Elder Hua wants a fresh harvest before you leave for Qingshi.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the hidden valley. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If he offers you a bun before a fight, refuse. He'll share it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone fights better with a bun, Senior Sister. It's science.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the hidden valley
Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Worry
quests.summary: Xiao Man, hearing River was taken, worries aloud about Small Mountain, the quietest of Ye Wuming's rescued children.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Small Mountain never asks for anything. What if she takes him and he doesn't even call for help? He wouldn't. I know he wouldn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Xiao Man, put that down before it explodes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: It won't explode, Elder! ...Will it?

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the smugglers' trail.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Wei Tong. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold out your wrist. Hm. Your pulse is stubborn. Like you.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the fishing jetty

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Hua. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Stone Keepers, Still Guarding
quests.summary: The ruins' stone keepers, unsettled by the dam's construction, need calming before they mistake help for theft again.

objectives.text: Go to the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A bored sentry leans over the watchpost railing, straightening hurriedly when he sees your robes.

objectives.text: Drive the stone golems from the charcoal kilns

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These stone golems fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Find the blood lotus at the poison marsh
Show Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The poison marsh is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. Ye Wuming's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Dam
quests.summary: The newly built dam sheds rune fragments where the hermit's sutra met the stone, worth studying by Elder Bai.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me rune fragments from the buried temple. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Xiao Shi says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Recover rune fragments from the buried temple
Go back to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the rune fragments you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Nine Perfumes, Catalogued
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, ever methodical, catalogues the nine perfumes on River's ribbon before the trail can fade.

objectives.text: Investigate the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the woodcutters' camp the air changes, heavy with qi and something older underneath.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Blood lotus, night jasmine, seven others I don't recognize. If she wears different faces, maybe she can't change her perfumes as easily.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Wei Tong. Wei Tong won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Wei Tong Volunteers
quests.summary: Wei Tong, hearing a child was taken, volunteers to come along, soup and all.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm coming. I'll bring soup. Soup helps. It helped with the wraiths. It'll help with whatever Madam Ninefold is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the carved buddhas

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Dam's Aftershock
quests.summary: The newly closed drain shudders once, releasing a last handful of void wraiths before settling for good.

objectives.text: Sound the war drum at the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the war drum. The boom rolls out across the land and comes back from the hills, twice.

objectives.text: Clear the old bandit camp of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: More void wraiths? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Gather star iron at the old battlefield
Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Treasure From the Ruins' Old Vault
quests.summary: While gathering dam stones, the sect disciples find a small sealed vault the stone keepers had forgotten to guard.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me vault contents from the spider hollow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Wei Tong knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Xiao Shi agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Pick up vault contents near the spider hollow
Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Ye Wuming. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Han Xue's Plan
quests.summary: Han Xue, no stranger to hunting people who hide in plain sight, sketches a plan for finding Madam Ninefold in Qingshi.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Nine faces means nine mistakes eventually. We watch for patterns, not faces. Everyone slips eventually. Even her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Shi. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows faster than I cut. I've made my peace with it. The bamboo hasn't.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell. It bites, and it holds grudges.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Following Nine Perfumes
quests.summary: Madam Ninefold's trail smells of nine perfumes, and they lead toward the river, and the town.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Nine perfumes. Nine faces. She always wears a different one. She'll be in the town. Hiding in plain sight. She loves plain sight.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Qingshi. Again. The town's going to start charging us rent.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Pei Yuan. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Children in the Clearing
quests.summary: Ye Wuming has brought the rest of his children to the clearing, where the hermit's wards are strongest.

objectives.text: Hear Ye Wuming out

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: (grins without warmth) You've been busy. The wrong kind of busy.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Kind, and still breathing. You're rarer than spirit stones.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Spring, Small Mountain and the others. Here. The hermit's wards are strongest here. She'll come for them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi's survived worse.

objectives.text: Search the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A dozen children in black robes sit in a ring in the clearing, very quiet, very straight. Spring is holding Small Mountain's hand.

objectives.text: Bring word to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've never been afraid before. I've been angry, and cold, and patient. Never afraid. I don't like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we'll be afraid together, and do something about it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Zhao Kang.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. The road taught you that.

quests.title: Ninefold's First Face
quests.summary: At dusk a kindly old woman walks into the clearing with a basket of buns for the children. Spring screams.

objectives.text: Head to the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring screams. The kindly old woman's face slips like a mask, and underneath there's another face, younger, smiling, cold.

objectives.text: Raise the hermit's ward around the children

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ward flares green around the ring of children. The woman's buns hit it and burn. She laughs, and walks backward into the bamboo.

objectives.text: Fight off the Ninefold's acolytes

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards regrouping
Find Ye Wuming after the fight

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her first face. She'll try all nine. She has patience. So do I. So, apparently, do you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go on.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: What the Children Remember
quests.summary: The children tell you what Madam Ninefold was like. They say it very quietly, one sentence each, taking turns.

objectives.text: Examine the spirit fountain at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She sang to us, Spring says. Then she bled us. She told us we were special, River used to say. Small Mountain says nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then, very quietly: she said she was our mother. She said it every day. Some of us believed her.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You cleanse the spirit fountain. Dark threads rise out of the water like smoke and dissolve.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I believed her. Forty years ago. She told me too. She's the reason I don't have a name. She said I didn't need one. I had her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Ye Wuming thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Buns
quests.summary: The buns the old woman brought are laced with something. Elder Hua would know what. The hermit thinks he does.

objectives.text: Examine the poisoned buns

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sweet bean paste, and under it, a sleeping draught and a thread of blood qi. Eat it, and you'd follow whoever called your name.

objectives.text: Make your way to the hidden valley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One bun has a note baked into it. Come home, River says. Mother misses you. It's in River's handwriting.

objectives.text: Tell the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She made River write it. She's using the children she has to call the children she doesn't. That's very old. That's very cruel.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

objectives.choice_prompt: The old woman who brought the laced buns is only a hired carrier. She's terrified.

choices.text: Let her go home

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

choices.text: Give her to the constable

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Use her as bait for Ninefold

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Following River's Letter
quests.summary: The note says where River is. Madam Ninefold wants you to find her. You go anyway.

objectives.text: Scout the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the lookout, a light in the old bandit camp. A child's voice singing, very small. The song Lian taught the nuns.

objectives.text: Break the Ninefold's acolytes at the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather River's scattered belongings
Compare notes with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men watched the camp all night. The child's alive. Singing. The woman went away and came back with a different face. Three times.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Clean tracking. You'd make a decent hunter, if you ever stop being a hero.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: River in the Cage
quests.summary: River is in a cage in the old bandit camp, singing so she knows she's there. Madam Ninefold has left her as bait.

objectives.text: Hurry to the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: River sits in a cage in the middle of the camp, singing. She stops when she sees Ye Wuming, and starts crying instead.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Guards spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Break open River's cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock breaks. River runs to Ye Wuming. He holds her the way you'd hold something that might break, or might break you.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She's safe. River's safe. She wasn't hurt. Madam Ninefold didn't touch her. She wanted her whole. As bait. For me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Hermit.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Is Afraid
quests.summary: With River back, Ye Wuming sits apart from everyone, shaking. You sit with him. You don't say anything.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've hunted them for forty years. I've never shaken. Now I can't stop.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Worry later, Xiao Shi. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She was my mother, she said. She lied. She raised me. Both are true. How do I fight someone who's both?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Together. You don't have to decide what she was. Only what she isn't allowed to do.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...What she isn't allowed to do. Yes. I can hold on to that.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the carved buddhas

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The hermit knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Xiao Shi. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Ninefold's Soldiers
quests.summary: Madam Ninefold's acolytes come for the children at midnight, wearing faces the children know.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're wearing faces. People the children knew. Guards, cooks, a teacher. Don't look at the faces. Look at the hands.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Defeat the Ninefold's acolytes at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Hold the forest path against more void wraiths
Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know what it's like to see faces from the cages. I'll sit with them. All night. We'll count breaths. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Zhao Kang. And the time before.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Counting Breaths With Children
quests.summary: Xiao Shi teaches Ye Wuming's children to count breaths. You sit in the circle too. So, eventually, does Ye Wuming.

objectives.text: Count breaths with the children

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four in, four out. A dozen children, Xiao Shi, Ye Wuming and you. By the fortieth breath, Small Mountain is asleep on Ye Wuming's shoulder.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's never slept on anyone. Not once. He sleeps sitting up, with his back to a wall. He's asleep on me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Zhao Kang's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'm going to find her. Madam Ninefold. In the town. And end this. Not for revenge. So they can sleep.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Ninefold's Acolytes, the Camp's Remnant
quests.summary: A remnant of Madam Ninefold's acolytes still lingers near the old bandit camp, watching for stragglers.

objectives.text: Read the map table at the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Drive the Ninefold's acolytes from the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ninefold's acolytes ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Collect star iron around the old battlefield
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One day I'll think of a comeback. Today is not that day.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: Medicine for the Frightened Children
quests.summary: Elder Hua sends medicine and calming tonics for the dozen children still shaken by the midnight attack.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the misty lake. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Iron-Fang. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the misty lake
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Spring's Question
quests.summary: Spring, the boldest of the children, asks you directly whether it's normal to miss someone who hurt you.

objectives.text: Examine the spirit fountain at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring asks if it's normal to miss her, sometimes, even knowing what she did. You tell her yes, and that missing isn't the same as forgiving.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit fountain bubbles clear and cold. Your qi steadies the moment the water touches your hands.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the tiger ridge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Hermit.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the rope bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Hermit.
