dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The village is grateful. The village is also very nervous. Mostly nervous.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Headman Kuang. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, Drawn by the Children's Fear
quests.summary: Fear draws a small cluster of void wraiths to the clearing's edge, feeding at the wards' weak points.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom at the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The loom clacks once as you touch it, as if the weaver had only stepped out for a moment.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the poison marsh
Share your findings with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Letters From River's Cage
quests.summary: Among River's scattered belongings in the bandit camp, more forced letters turn up, addressed to other lost children.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me sealed letters from the smugglers' trail, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the smugglers' trail
Return to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Heaven bless you!

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: The Old Coins
quests.summary: Xiao Shi examines a coin left behind by one of Ninefold's acolytes, tracing its mint to a specific era of the Blood Moon's reach.

objectives.text: Go to the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hunter's lodge looks exactly as it should, which is what makes you uneasy.

objectives.text: Read the map table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Forty years old. From the same batch as the coins in the cages. She's been carrying the same purse for forty years. That's almost sad.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Iron-Fang. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Zhao Kang Sits With Ye Wuming
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, who understands complicated family feelings better than most, sits with Ye Wuming through a long night.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My own family sent my brother to his death out of fear. Yours raised you out of cruelty dressed as love. Neither one earns forgiveness. Both still hurt.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to the hermit. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the lake pavilion. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the echo cave.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

quests.title: Blood Guards, Testing the Wards
quests.summary: A patrol of blood guards tests the hermit's wards around the clearing, probing for a way through before retreating.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks at the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the poison marsh
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Ward's Edge
quests.summary: The ward's clashes with the night's attackers leave void shards scattered at the clearing's edge.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me void shards from the buried temple. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Hermit. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Collect void shards around the buried temple
Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Small Mountain Speaks
quests.summary: For the first time since you've known him, Small Mountain says something unprompted: a single sentence about what he wants.

objectives.text: Sound the war drum at the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Small Mountain says, very quietly, that he wants to learn your name properly, so he has something of his own to hold onto.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's yours now, Small Mountain. Use it whenever you need to.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The war drum speaks in a voice like thunder. Every head turns. Somewhere, someone starts running.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the rope bridge. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Zhao Kang said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Nine Faces in Qingshi
quests.summary: The hermit's cranes say a woman with too many faces has taken a room at the Drunken Crane, and paid in old coins.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A woman with nine faces at the inn. She paid in old coins, and she's been asking about the children. She's waiting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She wants you to come to her. Everyone always wants you to come to them. We'll come. On our terms.

objectives.text: Investigate the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stilt houses of the bamboo village stand over the mud on long legs. Chickens patrol beneath them like guards.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the giant bamboo grove

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Room at the Inn
quests.summary: Madam Fang shows you the room the nine-faced woman rented. It's empty. There's a mirror on every wall.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: She paid for a week. She's been out every day. She never came back to the room. Just left the mirrors. Nine of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There. Ye Wuming agrees. Settled.

objectives.text: Search the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine mirrors on nine walls. In each one, your reflection is slightly different. In the ninth, it's smiling.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the market square

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her mirrors. She practises faces in them. She's somewhere in the town wearing one of them. We have to look at everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Merchant Jin. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Looking Twice
quests.summary: Widow Liu is good at looking twice. She's been doing it for years.

objectives.text: Go and see Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I look at every face twice. I did it for a year, looking for my son. There's a new woman at the market who looks back too quickly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Iron-Fang, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Speak with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: New passenger on my ferry, three days running. Paid in old coins. Never looked at the water. The Blood Moon ones never do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

objectives.text: Hear what Constable Du has to say

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: New cook at the yamen. Very good cook. Came with no references. The magistrate hired her because her dumplings were perfect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Captain Lei.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: By the law. That's all I ever ask.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Constable Du) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Three Suspects
quests.summary: Three strangers: a market woman, a ferry passenger and the yamen's new cook. One is Madam Ninefold. Maybe all three.

objectives.text: Head to the market square

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The market woman sells embroidered ribbons, black ones, exactly like River's. She sees you and smiles too quickly.

objectives.text: Examine the black ribbons at her stall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Each ribbon smells of a different perfume. Nine perfumes. Nine ribbons. And a tenth, blood lotus, tucked under the counter.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her. Or one of her. She leaves parts of herself in every face. The ribbons are a message. She wants me to know she's close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this river and I've never seen it look so pleased.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Old Pan.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the three suspects must be Madam Ninefold. Arresting all three would be safest.

choices.text: Investigate until you're sure

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

choices.text: Arrest all three

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, nervously) Should we... say something?

choices.text: Threaten them until one breaks

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Faces Come Off
quests.summary: When you approach the ribbon stall, the market woman is gone, and nine people in the square pull off their faces.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Nine people just pulled their faces off! That's not a sentence I ever wanted to say!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

objectives.text: Stop the faceless acolytes at the market square

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The faceless acolytes have found you first.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of faceless acolytes
Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen cook! The cook was one of them! Her dumplings were so good! I'm devastated on several levels!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Ferry Passenger
quests.summary: Old Pan's passenger is on the ferry right now, halfway across the river, not looking at the water.

objectives.text: Report to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: He's on my ferry! Middle of the river! Not looking at the water! I'll turn it round! Get to the docks!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Constable Du. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Make your way to the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ferry swings back to the dock. A passenger in grey stands very still, not looking at the water. He smiles. It's a woman's smile.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Report back to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. First time I've carried a monster. First time I've thrown one in. Didn't come up. They never do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Old Pan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

quests.title: Nine Faces at the Well
quests.summary: Madam Ninefold's last trick: she wears Widow Liu's face and walks to the well at dawn, where everyone gathers.

objectives.text: Find Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: There's a woman at the well wearing my face! My face! And she's drawing water with my bucket! How dare she!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Merchant Jin, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

objectives.text: Seal the well before she poisons it

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your seal flares over the well just as the false widow tips a vial into the water. The vial shatters on the seal instead.

objectives.text: Drive the faceless acolytes from the town well

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The faceless acolytes come on in silence.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Guards at the back alley
Bring word to Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Nobody wears my face. Nobody. I've spent too long making it look this tired.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Will there be a report? A written one? With dates? I love a report with dates.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Finds Her
quests.summary: Ye Wuming doesn't look for faces. He looks for the thing that never changes: the way she held him when he was six.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Faces change. Hands don't. She always held your wrist, not your hand. So you couldn't let go. I remember.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then come and watch.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There's a woman in the market square holding a child's wrist. The child is crying. The woman is smiling. It's her.

objectives.text: Talk with Old Pan at the canal walk

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the night market

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: apothecary_wang
dialogue.text: Half my shelves are empty since the trouble began. Medicine doesn't grow on shelves.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Worry later, Wang Pu. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Jiu Rong, Madam Ninefold
quests.summary: In the market square, holding a stranger's child by the wrist, the Third Rung turns, and all nine faces smile at once.

objectives.text: Scout the market square

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The woman lets go of the child's wrist. Her face flickers through nine others, then settles on one: young, beautiful, and cold as a well.

objectives.name: Jiu Rong, Madam Ninefold
objectives.text: Face Jiu Rong, Madam Ninefold at the market square

dialogue.speaker: rung_rong
dialogue.text: Wuming. My little nameless. You brought a friend. How lovely. Come home. Mother misses you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You're not my mother. My mother was Ye Qing. You're what took me from her.

dialogue.speaker: rung_rong
dialogue.text: Fold, and fold, and fold again. Which face shall I die in? You choose, heir. I'll wear it for you.

objectives.text: Watch the ninth face fall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Madam Ninefold falls, and her faces fall away one by one, until the last one underneath is only an old, tired woman. Her star goes out.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the main street

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Three stars out. She's gone. The children can sleep. I can... I don't know what I can do. I've never been without her to hunt.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's followers throw down their weapons and kneel.

choices.text: Let them go home

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring them to face the sect's judgement

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Make an example of them

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Stillness After
quests.summary: You sit in the town temple after Madam Ninefold falls, and let your soul refine in the stillness she left behind.

objectives.text: Refine your soul in the temple's stillness

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three stars out, four left. The void in you is quiet and deep as a well at night. Late stage of Spirit Severing.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The children want to meet you. All of them. River wants to sing you the song. Spring wants to give you a bun. Don't eat the bun.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: Faceless Acolytes, the Last of Them
quests.summary: A handful of Madam Ninefold's faceless acolytes remain in the town, aimless without her direction.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table at the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You leave an offering on the offering table and bow. The candle flames bow back.

objectives.text: Clear the temple fair of faceless acolytes

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Find the cloud silk at the dye yard
Talk it over with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the dye yard isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming! Manners!

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Medicine for the Market Square
quests.summary: The market square's fight left several townsfolk shaken and bruised. Elder Hua's traveling stock needs restocking.

objectives.text: Hear Constable Du out

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me medicine bundles from the night market.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Captain Lei. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed in town, cultivator. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the night market
See Constable Du again

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Captain Lei. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: By the law. That's all I ever ask.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Widow Liu's Reclaimed Face
quests.summary: Widow Liu, furious that her face was worn by a monster, insists on a small ceremony to reclaim it at the well.

objectives.text: Speak with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I'm washing my face at this well in front of everyone. It's mine again. Nobody borrows it without asking. Ever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: The children ask about you, you know. Don't make me tell them anything sad.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Matron Bi. The immortal always is. Mostly.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Old Pan) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, Left Behind
quests.summary: A few void wraiths, drawn by Madam Ninefold's death throes, linger near the market square.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run your fingers along the threads of the loom. One colour runs through every bolt, like a signature.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the night market
Share your findings with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Light some incense tonight, Widow Liu. For luck.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Old Pan) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Old Pan) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

quests.title: Letters From the Nine Mirrors
quests.summary: The inn room's nine mirrors, examined closely, reveal letters tucked behind their frames, addressed to faces she never got to wear.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Bring me sealed letters from the county granary. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the county granary
Return to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Yamen Cook's Recipe
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou, still mourning the loss of perfect dumplings, asks if anyone salvaged the false cook's recipe.

objectives.text: Hurry to the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Washing hangs across the orphanage courtyard, dozens of tiny tunics in a row.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fruit, rice and a cup of wine wait on the offering table. Someone set out one bowl more than there are gods.

objectives.text: Tell Magistrate Zhou what you found

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: If evil can cook that well, I have questions about the universe. Also, does anyone have the recipe? Asking for the yamen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Old Pan Makes Peace With the Water
quests.summary: Old Pan, having thrown a Blood Moon soldier into his river, spends an evening making peace with the water again.

objectives.text: Answer Old Pan's summons

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years and I never had to do that before. The river doesn't judge. It just carries. I'm grateful for that, tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Iron-Fang. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen is open to all petitions. Between the second and fourth bell.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Blood Guards, Fleeing the Town
quests.summary: A handful of blood guards, cut loose by Madam Ninefold's fall, try to flee Qingshi before the sect catches them.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shuttle of the loom has stopped mid-row. The half-finished pattern is a map, if you know how to read it.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the execution ground

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Guards fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Collect cloud silk around the dye yard
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Madam Fang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Han Xue, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Fallen Faces
quests.summary: Madam Ninefold's fallen faces leave void shards behind, strange residue of forty years of stolen identities.

objectives.text: Report to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me void shards from the temple fair.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ye Wuming, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. It has opinions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Find the void shards at the temple fair
Go back to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine. You're well in credit, child.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Widow Liu. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Fair's fair.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Old Pan, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: River's Song, in Full
quests.summary: Before the bun, River sings you the whole song Lian taught the nuns, start to finish, without stopping once.

objectives.text: Mark the map table at the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: River's voice is small and clear. By the end, half the market square has stopped to listen, and nobody claps, because it doesn't need it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Merchant Jin.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

objectives.text: Hear what Merchant Jin has to say

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Listen to Magistrate Zhou. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: A Bun From Spring
quests.summary: Spring gives you a bun. It's slightly squashed and entirely safe. Ye Wuming watches you eat it, and almost smiles.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She made it herself. With Madam Fang. It's the first thing she's ever made that wasn't a weapon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Thank you. For coming with me. For the rain you gave the monk. For looking into the fold for my name. For all of it.

objectives.text: Meet Madam Fang at the brewery

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: That child has flour everywhere. My kitchen looks like a snowstorm. I've never been happier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

objectives.choice_prompt: Madam Fang confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Map on the Ceiling
quests.summary: Xiao Shi's map has spread to the pagoda ceiling. Elder Bai is lying on the floor looking at it, very happy.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Look at it! A map of nothing! On my ceiling! I'm lying on the floor like a student! I haven't been this happy in years!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Elder Bai knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Bai. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

objectives.text: Sort the scroll rack at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pagoda's fourth floor is covered in ink: walls, shelves, ceiling. A spiral of rifts, and at seven points, red marks. Three crossed out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The scroll rack creaks under a century of learning. The scroll you need is behind the scroll everyone takes.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Four red marks left. Four Rungs. The map shows where they touch the world. It doesn't show where they are. Not yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

quests.title: Shards for the Ceiling
quests.summary: To finish the map, Xiao Shi needs a void shard from every rift that's opened on the mountain.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Shi out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: One shard from every rift. On the mountain. There are nine. I've marked them. Elder Bai says I'm not allowed on the roof.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Brother, did you eat? You didn't eat. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I ate twice, Man. You watched me.

objectives.text: Collect void shards from the mountain's rifts
Stop the void wraiths at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Some of the rifts are still open, and still hungry. Wraiths drift out, curious about the person stealing their shards.

objectives.text: Report back to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Nine shards. The map's nearly done. I'm going to sleep for a day. Then map the ceiling of the ceiling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Lu Ping. Lu Ping won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm telling the whole gate! Twice! With improvements!

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Spiral's Centre
quests.summary: With every shard placed, the map shows something new: the rifts spiral toward the fold, and the fold spirals toward the sky.

objectives.text: Place the last shard on the map

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last shard clicks into place. The ink spiral glows faintly. At its centre, the fold. From the fold, a thin line going straight up.

objectives.text: Go to the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The line points at the Sky Isles. At the tribulation peak. At the place where heaven's lightning falls.

objectives.text: Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The fold leads up. He's not just hiding. He's aiming. At the peak. At the lightning. At your lightning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Han Xue. We were attentive.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Everyone Looks at the Ceiling
quests.summary: The whole sect comes to look at the ceiling. Most of them don't understand it. All of them understand the line going up.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A line from the fold to the tribulation peak. He's waiting for your tribulation, like Gu said. Now we know where.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I don't understand the map. But I understand the line. It points at you. I don't like it. I'm going to stand near you more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: My brother drew that. My brother. Who counted bars for a year. He drew a map that can see the sky. I'm going to cry on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

quests.title: Reading Nothing
quests.summary: The hermit teaches you to read the map with your soul: not the ink, the nothing between the lines.

objectives.text: Go and see the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Don't read the ink. Read the nothing between. The void shows its shape in what isn't there. Sit. Look at the gaps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Elder Bai. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

objectives.text: Read the map's gaps with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the gaps between the lines, four faint red threads. Two point to Qingshi and the bamboo, one far to the east, one straight down, into the Abyss.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Four threads! East! That's beyond the Iron Scale's lands. Nobody goes east. There's nothing east. Nothing. Oh. Nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Hermit. I asked who would go.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Map Has Visitors
quests.summary: The finished map glows at night, and the glow draws things. Things that don't want to be mapped.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The pagoda's glowing! And there are shapes climbing it! Nine of them! No, ten! I'm ringing the bell! I'm ringing all the bells!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: More void wraiths? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: They wanted to erase the map. On my ceiling. In my pagoda. I'm going to sleep here now. With a sword. I don't know how to use a sword.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Xiao Man. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: A Letter From the East
quests.summary: A letter arrives from the Iron Scale, from Ruan Jingtao, in a shaking hand: rifts in the east are eating their lands.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A letter from the Iron Scale! Ruan Jingtao! The handwriting's awful! Worse than usual! He must be scared!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhong Ming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rifts in the east. Villages vanishing. The Iron Scale's southern peak is gone. Gone. Into nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ruan Hai asks for the heir. Personally. He says: we stood with you at the banners. Stand with us now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering to the Sect Master) That was amazing.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Supplies for the East
quests.summary: The Iron Scale needs medicine, food and void shards for wards. The whole sect helps pack.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Medicine for a sect I used to glare at across a duel. Pack it all. The Iron Scale needs it more than our grudges do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Elder, the third kiln sneezed again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then feed it less charcoal and more patience, Hongyu.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

objectives.text: Pack medicine for the Iron Scale
Talk with Steward Qian at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Supplies for the Iron Scale. At our cost. I've costed it. It's a lot. I don't care. Don't tell anyone I don't care.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Not now, Tang Ling. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Iron Scale needs supplies, but your sect's winter stores are thin.

choices.text: Send them half our stores

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Send what the elders approved

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Send nothing. Charity starts at home.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Wei Tong's New Disciples Help
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve new disciples insist on helping load the carts. They also insist on a demonstration first.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (guarded) {player}. People are saying things. I'm not asking. Yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My twelve want a demonstration before you go east. Spirit Severing. They want to see you walk on nothing. Show-off. Please show off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Sect Master.

objectives.text: Give Wei Tong's disciples a demonstration

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Training puppets spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You walked on nothing and hit a puppet from above. Qiu Hua fainted. The chicken did not. The chicken has seen everything now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Xiao Man. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (beaming at Wei Tong) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Pagoda's Second Night
quests.summary: A second wave of wraiths tests the pagoda's ward before the map is safely copied and stored.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the medicine valley
Talk it over with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The medicine valley is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Good. I'll fire a pill in your honour. Well, in the honour of whoever eats it.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (hiding behind Xiao Man) Oh.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Map's Attackers
quests.summary: The things that tried to erase the map leave rune fragments behind, worth studying for clues about their nature.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me rune fragments from the spirit peach orchard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Man. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
