dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

objectives.text: Gather rune fragments at the spirit peach orchard
See the Sect Master again

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Very funny.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the rune fragments you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Sleepless Vigil
quests.summary: Elder Bai, true to his word, sleeps in the pagoda with a sword he can't use, and Wei Tong takes pity and teaches him one stance.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: One stance. Just one. Point the sharp end at the scary thing. That's step one. Step two is optional.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Wei Tong said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lu Ping.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the Cliff of Reflection. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the Sword Peak path.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Sect Master. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, Drawn to the Glow
quests.summary: The finished map's glow draws a pair of confused celestial sentinels down from the Sky Isles' old wards.

objectives.text: Open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Clear the arena stands of celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The celestial sentinels have found you first.

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the outer dormitories
Share your findings with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, the hermit, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Sect Master. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Jade Slips for the Copied Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi needs jade slips to make a proper travel copy of the map before the journey east.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me jade slips from the laundry stream.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

objectives.text: Collect jade slips around the laundry stream
Return to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.choice_prompt: The jade slips came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (hiding behind the Sect Master) Oh.

quests.title: The Fourth Thread, Traced Further
quests.summary: Bai Ling traces the fourth red thread, the one pointing straight down into the Abyss, and finds it thinner than the others.

objectives.text: Investigate the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rolls out of the refectory kitchens. Somewhere inside, a ladle strikes a pot like a gong.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: This one's fainter. Either it's furthest away, or it's weakest. Or it's not a Rung at all. It might be him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Fan Rui is not wrong. Fan Rui is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (tugging Elder Bai's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Xiao Man's Farewell to Her Brother's Work
quests.summary: Xiao Man asks to keep a small copy of the map for herself, just the part her brother drew with his own hand.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Man's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Just this corner. The one he did first, before he got confident. I want to keep it. It's his, and it's beautiful, and it's mine now too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Bai. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Man, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what the Sect Master says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Last Watch
quests.summary: A final watch is kept over the pagoda through the night before the journey east begins.

objectives.text: Examine the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three legs, two handles, and a rim of ancient script: the bronze ding is older than the hall that shelters it.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
Compare notes with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Splendid. A footnote in history, at the very least. Possibly a whole paragraph.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Void Shards for the Road
quests.summary: Elder Bai insists on packing a reserve of void shards for the journey, in case the rifts follow you east.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me void shards from the mountain road.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: What Ling Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the mountain road
Go back to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: Xiao Man, stop feeding the golden carp.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He looked hungry! He always looks hungry!

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three herbs today! Well. Three that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (hiding behind Xiao Man) Oh.

quests.title: Steward Qian's Ledger for the East
quests.summary: Steward Qian, despite claiming not to care, has prepared an extremely detailed ledger of everything sent to the Iron Scale.

objectives.text: Find Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've itemized every chest. Every herb. In case they ever ask what a grudge costs to set down. It costs quite a lot, it turns out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Xiao Man. The immortal always is. Mostly.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Noted, Steward Qian. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wei Tong has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even the Sect Master agrees. It must be true.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

quests.title: East
quests.summary: At dawn, the cart for the Iron Scale leaves the sect gate. You walk beside it. Xiao Shi's map is rolled up in your pack.

objectives.text: See what Xiao Shi wants

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The map, copied small. So you can find the rifts. I drew the gaps too. Read the gaps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Sect Master. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: East, to the Iron Scale. Through the bamboo. The Iron Scale's border starts at the forest's far edge. We'll meet Ruan there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Border Melts
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao meets you at the forest's far edge. Behind him, the hills are fading into purple nothing.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the far forest gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest's far edge ends in fog, and the fog ends in nothing. Where the Iron Scale's hills should be, there's only a purple haze.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

objectives.text: Join Ruan Jingtao at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You came. My father said you would. I said nobody comes when it's this bad. I was wrong. I've been wrong about you a lot.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The southern peak is gone. Three hundred disciples got out. Forty didn't. Something is walking out of where it was.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Disciples Lost in Nothing
quests.summary: Some of the forty came back. They are wrong now, lost in nothing, and they don't know their own sect.

objectives.text: Hear Ruan Jingtao out

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Those are ours. The ones who didn't get out. They came back like this. They don't know us. Don't kill them. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: What Yan Tie said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Break the void-lost disciples at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths regrouping
Report back to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're asleep. Not dead. Asleep. You did something with your soul. The purple left them. They're ours again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ha. Han Xue's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Iron Scale disciples is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Ruan Hai's Grief
quests.summary: Ruan Hai, master of the Iron Scale, has aged ten years in a month. He lost a peak, and forty children, and he blames himself.

objectives.text: Speak with Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Forty. Forty children, on my southern peak. I built that peak. I chose who trained there. I sent them there.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Is this what your Gu Hanshan felt? Every day? No wonder he broke.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Some of them are coming back, Sect Master Ruan. The void holds them. It doesn't eat them. We're bringing them home.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Some. Then some is what I'll hold on to.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Ye Wuming is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Giant's Footprints
quests.summary: Something enormous has walked out of the southern peak's nothing. It leaves footprints that fill with purple fog.

objectives.text: Search the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the lookout, you see footprints the size of ponds crossing the forest, each one filling with purple fog.

objectives.text: Stop the hollow stone at the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the footprints cross the grove, hollow stone things crawl out of the fog, broken pieces of a mountain that's gone.

objectives.text: Gather shards from the hollow stone
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Pieces of the southern peak. Walking around. Hollow. The giant's made of the peak. It's made of their mountain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Well done. I don't say that often. Ask my son. Actually, don't.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Sect Master Ruan. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Rung Beneath the Giant
quests.summary: In soul sight, the giant is tied to something: a thread, red, going east. A Rung is steering it.

objectives.text: Head to the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The giant stands at the edge of the clearing, a mountain on legs, hollow, purple fog pouring from every crack.

objectives.text: Trace the giant's red thread with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A red thread from the giant's back, running east, far beyond the forest. At its end, faint, someone hollow, holding the thread and smiling.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow. Kong Yi. The Fourth Rung. He steers things that are empty. He's steering a mountain. He's showing off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (whispering to Ye Wuming) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

quests.title: Filling the Hollow
quests.summary: The hermit's lesson from the spring: you can't dam nothing with stone. But you can fill hollowness with something.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The giant's hollow. Empty. That's what the Rung steers. What if it wasn't empty?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then he couldn't steer it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

objectives.text: Prepare your soul to fill the hollow giant

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You gather your soul like breath before a shout. Everything the Iron Scale remembers about their peak: training, laughter, names. You hold it.

objectives.text: Meet Ruan Jingtao at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father's telling me stories about the southern peak. All of them. He says you asked. He's been crying for an hour. Good crying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Ruan Jingtao does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Han Xue.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The Hollow Giant
quests.summary: The Iron Scale's southern peak, hollowed out and walking, steered by a Rung from far away. It is a mountain. It does not stop.

objectives.text: Make your way to the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Hollow Giant steps into the clearing. The ground shakes. Purple fog pours from its chest where the peak's heart used to be.

objectives.name: The Hollow Giant
objectives.text: Bring down The Hollow Giant

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Together! Iron Scale and Azure Cloud! For the southern peak! Fill it with everything!

objectives.text: Pour the Iron Scale's memories into the giant

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The giant stops. Its hollow chest fills with light: laughter, drills, names. It kneels, and settles, and becomes a hill again.

objectives.text: Talk with Sect Master Ruan at the tiger ridge

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: A hill. In your forest. Made of my southern peak. The Iron Scale will visit it. Every year. We'll call it Remembering Hill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Ye Wuming. A poor master.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's hoard holds spirit stones stolen from Qingshi.

choices.text: Return every stone to Qingshi

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Give it all to the sect treasury

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep a share for yourself

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Bringing the Forty Home
quests.summary: With the giant stilled, the rifts on the Iron Scale's border shrink, and some of the forty come walking out of the fog.

objectives.text: Answer Ruan Jingtao's summons

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're walking out. Some of them. Out of the fog. Nineteen. Nineteen of forty. Help me bring them in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: I'll carry anything heavy. Heavier than a tree, I'll need a friend.

objectives.text: Guide the lost disciples out of the fog
Bring word to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Nineteen. The rest are still in there, frozen. We'll get them out. When the fold opens. Like Iron-Fang's family.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ha. Zhao Kang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Ruan Jingtao, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale will march with you when it opens. All of us. Not for debts. For them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Hai offers you the Iron Scale's sacred manual in thanks.

choices.text: Decline it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Accept it formally, for the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Accept it for yourself

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

quests.title: The Iron Scale Remembers
quests.summary: Ruan Hai makes a speech on Remembering Hill. It's short. The Iron Scale doesn't do long speeches.

objectives.text: Report to Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale remembers. Our peak. Our lost. And the Azure Cloud, who came when asked. That's all. That's the speech.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Zhao Kang, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came east too. We shouted the whole way. It helped nobody. It felt wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Ye Wuming. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Fourth Rung's thread went east. Toward nothing. He'll steer something else soon. Something with a body. That's what he wants. Bodies.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Sect Master Ruan. Sect Master Ruan's survived worse.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Void-Lost Disciples, the Second Wave
quests.summary: More void-lost Iron Scale disciples wander out of the fog, needing the same gentle soul-work as the first.

objectives.text: Tend the pill furnace at the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Defeat the void-lost disciples at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Void-lost disciples ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Gather blood lotus at the poison marsh
Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The Iron Scale disciples left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

quests.title: Medicine for Remembering Hill
quests.summary: The nineteen returned disciples need medicine and rest before they can properly rejoin their sect.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me medicine bundles from the old bridge, would you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Zhao Kang. And the time before.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the old bridge
See Yan Tie again

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Any Iron Scale colours among them? Tell me honestly. I would rather know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a long story. The short version: yes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's New Respect
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao, once openly dismissive of the Azure Cloud, admits he was wrong about you in front of his own disciples.

objectives.text: See what Ruan Jingtao wants

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I called you soft, once. At the banners. I was wrong. Soft doesn't fill a hollow mountain with a sect's whole memory. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: See? Even Sect Master Ruan agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Speak with Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Sect Master Ruan is right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Scales do not rust. Neither do grudges. I am trying to let mine.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Ruan Jingtao. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Hollow Stone, the Last Fragments
quests.summary: A few fragments of hollow stone still crawl at the clearing's edge, remnants of the giant that hasn't fully settled.

objectives.text: Inspect the sealed coffin at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Something shifts inside the sealed coffin when you touch it. Then it is still again, very deliberately.

objectives.text: Drive the hollow stone from the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hollow stone spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Collect medicine bundles around the spider hollow
Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Giant's Heart
quests.summary: The stilled giant's chest, now Remembering Hill, sheds rune fragments worth studying for Elder Bai's archive.

objectives.text: Hear Sect Master Ruan out

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me rune fragments from the buried temple.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Find the rune fragments at the buried temple
Return to Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Yan Tie says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly. I am too old for riddles and too tired for lies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rune fragments came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Kong Yi's Old Name
quests.summary: Ye Wuming digs through his ledger and finds a fragment about Kong Yi's life before the Blood Moon hollowed him out.

objectives.text: Scout the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sect's forest watchpost stands on stilts above the bamboo, a lantern hung at every corner.

objectives.text: Read the map table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Kong Yi was a puppeteer once. A real one, with strings and wood. The Patriarch just gave him bigger puppets to pull.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Clean tracking. You'd make a decent hunter, if you ever stop being a hero.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Well! That's one way to do it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Han Xue's Worry, Spoken Plainly
quests.summary: Han Xue, usually the steady one, admits how frightened she is of what Kong Yi and the Patriarch actually want.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A body heaven can't refuse. Yours. I've known that for months and I still can't say it without my hands shaking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Sect Master Ruan.

objectives.text: Meet Ruan Jingtao at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. We're both very proud of that.

objectives.text: Talk with Sect Master Ruan at the charcoal kilns

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows faster than I cut. I've made my peace with it. The bamboo hasn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Scales do not rust. Neither do grudges. I am trying to let mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Sect Master Ruan mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Void Wraiths, Following the Giant's Trail
quests.summary: A trail of void wraiths follows the path the Hollow Giant once walked, drawn by its lingering emptiness.

objectives.text: Hurry to the giant bamboo grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Giant bamboo towers over the grove, thick as pillars. Something heavy has been chewing through the stems.

objectives.text: Clear the giant bamboo grove of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the giant bamboo grove
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ye Wuming. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Border Rifts
quests.summary: The Iron Scale's melting border leaves void shards scattered for miles, worth gathering before the journey home.

objectives.text: Go and see Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me void shards from the misty lake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Yan Tie, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the misty lake
Go back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Well done. I don't say that often. Ask my son. Actually, don't.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. Sect Master Ruan's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Elder Yan's Long Walk Home
quests.summary: Elder Yan, having shouted the entire way east, promises to shout the entire way home too, for symmetry.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Consistency matters! If I shouted coming, I shout going! Thunder Peak has PRINCIPLES!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Yan Tie says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

objectives.text: Find Sect Master Ruan at the waterwheel

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the waterwheel. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm standing right here, you know.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly. I am too old for riddles and too tired for lies.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the rope bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the rope bridge.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Ye Wuming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heh. Knew it.

quests.title: Brother Hollow's Taste
quests.summary: Ye Wuming says what Kong Yi, Brother Hollow, wants most: bodies to live in. Han Xue goes pale.

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow. He lives in empty things. Mountains. Puppets. People who've given up. He wants a body. A good one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A body heaven can't refuse. That's what the Patriarch wants. Brother Hollow would be the one to... fit it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're going home. Now. And you're going to learn to make your body impossible to borrow. Whatever that takes.

objectives.text: Go to the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Split bamboo is stacked in pale towers around the woodcutters' camp. A saw pit yawns beside a cold fire.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the forest crossroads. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heh. Knew it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Stitch
quests.summary: Qing Luan wants the last rift on the isles stitched shut before they close again. It's the one on the cloud gate.

objectives.text: Investigate the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A single rift hangs in the cloud gate's arch like a torn curtain. Through it, the tribulation peak, faint and far.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: One last stitch. The cloud gate. Then the isles close properly, and I get some peace, and you get a body.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A body. I mean the next stage. Sorry. I've been alone too long. I say things strangely.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Silk From the Pines
quests.summary: The last stitch needs the best cloud silk, from the highest pines on the Isle of Winds.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The highest pines. The best silk. The wind there is rude, even to guests. Be polite back. It confuses it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Han Xue. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Gather silk from the highest pines
Fight off the storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves nest in the highest pines, and they don't want to share their silk.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the Southern Gate of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I was polite to the wind. It pushed me off a branch. Politely. I've learned nothing today. It's been lovely.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: See? Even Qing Luan agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the cloud silk you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Stitching the Gate
quests.summary: You stitch the last rift closed with silk and soul, standing on the nothing inside it.

objectives.text: Stitch the cloud gate's rift closed

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You stand inside the rift, on nothing, and stitch it shut around you, and step out as the last stitch pulls tight.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You stitched yourself in and out of a rift. Nobody's done that. I'm going to put it in my chart. It deserves a star.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (nods slowly to Qing Luan) A careful answer.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: The Tribulation Peak
quests.summary: Qing Luan takes you to where you can see the tribulation peak, and the black rings where cultivators were answered.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Across the gap, the tribulation peak: a summit altar scorched black in rings. Each ring is someone who stood there and was answered.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

objectives.text: Read the star chart of the peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chart shows the peak, and above it, four red stars still bright. Three dark. And a thin line from the Abyss, rising toward the summit.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's where your lightning will come. And that's where he'll be waiting. Not yet. Years yet. But that's where.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan offers to show you the Patriarch's path through the peak: a secret of her order.

choices.text: Refuse. Keep her oath intact.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Accept. It may save lives.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Insist. You're owed it.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: What Comes After the Void
quests.summary: Qing Luan tells you what the next stage is. Void Refinement. She says it's the part most cultivators hate.

objectives.text: See what Qing Luan wants

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Void Refinement. The void between soul and body, refined away. They become one thing. Can't be separated. Can't be borrowed. Can't be worn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Qing Luan thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Han Xue. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It hurts. Every bone remembers everything that ever hurt it. Most cultivators stop there. You won't. You're very stubborn.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Can't be worn. That's the answer. To Brother Hollow. To the Patriarch. Make the body impossible to borrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Scribe Shu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It hurts? Good. I'll hold your hand. Don't tell anyone.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: The Isles' Last Visitors
quests.summary: As the isles begin to close, the last void wraiths try to slip through before the stitches hold.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Last visitors. Trying to get out before the door shuts. I know the feeling. I'm not letting them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the rainbow bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Hold the sun altar against more celestial sentinels
Join Qing Luan at the chain isles

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's the last of them. The isles are closing. Properly. For a while. You'll be back. Everyone comes back to me eventually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. The Sect Master is not wrong. The Sect Master is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: A Face Remembered
quests.summary: Before you go, Qing Luan tells you she remembered her face. Han Xue's description helped.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I remembered my face. A star on my forehead, and a frown at everyone like they've disappointed a constellation. The sword girl was right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Qing Luan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Han Xue?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Tell her thank you. Tell her I'm frowning at her fondly.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell her I'm frowning back. Fondly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Four Red Stars
quests.summary: One last look at the chart before the isles close: four red stars left, and one of them has started to move.

objectives.text: Watch the moving red star

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One of the four red stars is sliding across the chart, slowly, toward the mountain where the Azure Cloud sits. Brother Hollow's star.

objectives.text: Search the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside it, very faint, a fifth line is drawn in red: a cleaver. The Fifth Rung, the Butcher, is following him.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They're moving toward your mountain. Toward you. Go home, lotus child. And become impossible to borrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Qing Luan, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Sect Master. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Isles' Last Pack
quests.summary: A last pack of storm wolves tests the closing isles, reluctant to leave before the gate seals.

objectives.text: Browse the scroll rack at the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dust lies thick on the scroll rack, except on one shelf, where a hand has been reaching often and recently.

objectives.text: Stop the storm wolves at the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit pills near the elixir spring
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Han Xue will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Thunder Crystals, Before the Gate Seals
quests.summary: The isles' spirit vein offers one last harvest of thunder crystals before the gate closes for the season.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me thunder crystals from the thunder isle.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

objectives.text: Collect thunder crystals around the thunder isle
Report back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A star just blinked. It was about you. I'm almost certain.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Star Chart, Copied
quests.summary: Qing Luan has Bai Ling's counterpart on the isles copy the star chart one final time before the closing.

objectives.text: Head to the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the crane isle a hundred cranes turn their heads to look at you at once. It is unsettling.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A copy for your pagoda. So Elder Bai can watch the stars too, even when the isles are shut. Sixty years is a long time to watch alone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes bowed to you. They bowed to the last immortal once, then took it back.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Warden He says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, Settling
quests.summary: The palace sentinels, agitated by the closing rifts, need calming before they settle back into their long watch.

objectives.text: Look behind the jade screen at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
