dialogue.text: Light passes through the jade screen and throws a pattern on the floor: a map, if you stand just right.

objectives.text: Defeat the celestial sentinels at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The celestial sentinels come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find the cloud silk at the palace court
Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the Immortal Palace gate isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Qing Luan. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Void Shards, the Isles' Last Harvest
quests.summary: The closing rifts shed a final harvest of void shards, worth gathering for Elder Bai's ongoing study.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me void shards from the cloud harbour. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Qing Luan said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the cloud harbour
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Qing Luan. Qing Luan won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (tugging Zhao Kang's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Report to His Great-Grandfather
quests.summary: Zhao Kang writes one more letter home, this time about stitching rifts shut instead of sewing the sky.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Grandfather's reply: 'You've done more with a needle in a year than I did in sixty. Come home and teach the children to sew clouds.'

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Han Xue is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That is the sect I want. Thank you for being it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Han Xue's Question About Pain
quests.summary: Before the breakthrough, Han Xue asks Qing Luan directly how bad the coming pain will actually be.

objectives.text: Make your way to the waterfall isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the waterfall isle. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look carefully. Old places keep their secrets in the corners.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Right. Eyes open, everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We'll go carefully.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: How bad? Truly. Not comforting. True.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Truly? Worse than anything before it. And she'll do it anyway. That's not comfort. That's just what's true.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Message
quests.summary: A crane arrives from Yun Zhi, confirming the tempering baths are ready and that Elder Hua is, in fact, cheerful about the pain to come.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hua says 'tell them it builds character.' I told her character is overrated. She said so is comfort. I don't know who's winning that argument.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Qing Luan. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the sky ship wreck

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Sect Master. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan at the lantern isle

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars disagree. The stars often disagree. I side with you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Final Stragglers
quests.summary: A final handful of void wraiths tries to slip through the almost-sealed gate before the isles close completely.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks at the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the thunder isle

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Gather phoenix feathers at the phoenix nest
Share your findings with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Han Xue. We were attentive.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Cloud Silk, the Isles' Farewell Gift
quests.summary: Qing Luan sends one last bundle of cloud silk down the mountain, a gift for whatever the tempering baths will need.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (does not smile) {player}. The righteous path has a narrow gate. Mind you still fit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Zhao Kang. A poor master.

objectives.text: Pick up cloud silk near the cloud harbour
See the Sect Master again

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the cloud silk you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Still Water, Empty Sky
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, with the isles closing around you, you let your spirit severing reach its Great Perfection.

objectives.text: Bring your spirit severing to perfection

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Still water. Empty sky. Your soul is as deep as the void and as calm. Great Perfection of Spirit Severing. Next, the body. Next, the pain.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came up to bring you home. The isles are closing. Brother Hollow is coming to us. We'll be ready. You'll be ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Qing Luan?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hua has prepared the tempering baths. She says they'll hurt. She says it cheerfully. That woman frightens me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Down the Cloud Road
quests.summary: The cloud road dissolves behind you for the last time in years. Below, your mountain, and somewhere on it, the Great Azure Formation, glowing.

objectives.text: Scout the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road dissolves behind you. Above, the isles fade into sky. Below, the formation glows blue, steady, patient.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Home. Void Refinement next. It hurts, the star-gazer says. I'll complain for you. It's the least I can do. It's the most I can do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Fan Rui. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Zhao Kang) Oh.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Puppets Walk
quests.summary: Wei Tong wakes you at midnight. The training puppets are standing up by themselves and walking toward the dormitories.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The puppets are walking! By themselves! Toward the dormitories! My twelve are in there! Come on!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Man. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Wei Tong says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

objectives.text: Examine the puppet frame at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The training ground is empty. A trail of wooden footprints leads toward the dormitories, and every step leaves a curl of purple mist.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The puppet frame creaks as you test it. The joints are oiled, the wood is new, and the runes are older.

objectives.text: Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hollowed. Something's inside them. Something that likes empty things. Brother Hollow. Ye Wuming warned us.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a scratch? Let me check. Hm. One scratch. I'll allow it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Hollow Wood
quests.summary: The hollowed puppets reach the dormitories. Wei Tong's twelve new disciples are awake, and very brave, and very small.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Twelve disciples, twelve puppets! Nobody fights alone! Lead with your feet, not your elbows!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhong Ming. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

objectives.text: Clear the arena stands of hollowed puppets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hollowed puppets spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of hollowed guardians
Hear what Liu Er has to say

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I fought one! With a broom! Qiu Hua fought one with a chicken! The chicken won! Is it always like this here?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: What Yan Tie said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: What Was Inside
quests.summary: In the broken puppets you find what hollowed them: a thread of purple nothing, still twitching, leading east.

objectives.text: Hurry to the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In each broken puppet, a thread of purple nothing twitches like a severed nerve, all pointing east.

objectives.text: Follow the threads with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: East, far, a hollow man sitting cross-legged in a hollow tree, his eyes closed, smiling. He opens his eyes. He waves.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He waved. Everyone in the Ladder waves at you. It's the most irritating thing about them, and there's a lot of competition.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Old Qiu. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: The purple thread is still twitching. Elder Hua wants it studied; Han Xue wants it burned.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Seal it for Elder Hua

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep a piece, secretly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Elder Hua's Baths
quests.summary: Elder Hua has been preparing the tempering baths for a month. She describes them with terrifying cheerfulness.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Tempering baths. Nine herbs, three minerals, thunder water and one very rare lizard. You'll soak for nine days. It'll hurt. Every bone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Hua is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: When it's done, your body and soul will be one thing. Nobody will be able to wear you. Isn't that wonderful? It's going to be awful.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I've been gathering the herbs for a month. I only dropped the lizard twice. It's fine. It's a very forgiving lizard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Take a cup first. Tea steadies the hand and cools the head.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Auntie Ruo. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Thunder Water
quests.summary: The baths need thunder water: rain that fell during a lightning strike, caught at the cliff edge.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Hua's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thunder water. Rain from a lightning storm, caught at the cliff. There's a storm tonight. Stand out in it. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Old Qiu has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Catch thunder water at the cliff edge
Talk with Yan Tie at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You stood on the cliff in a thunderstorm with buckets. Thunder Peak is so jealous. We've been trying to do that for years. The buckets always melt.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Fan Rui. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm! Sensible! Loudly sensible!

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (tugging Yan Tie's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The First Day
quests.summary: The first day in the tempering bath. It is exactly as bad as Elder Hua promised.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (does not smile) {player}. The righteous path has a narrow gate. Mind you still fit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: In you go. Don't scream on the first day. Save it for the fourth. The fourth is the worst. Then it gets worse again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Old Bao, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Endure the first day of tempering

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bath is cold, then hot, then neither. Every bone in your body remembers every blow it ever took, all at once, very loudly.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You didn't scream. Hmph. Mo would have said adequate. I'll say it for him. Adequate. Eight more days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: The third kiln sneezed again. I lost an eyebrow. It'll grow back. Last time it did.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Kiln-Mistress Tao. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Sensible. Drink some water.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. A careful choice.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (muttering, to Elder Hua) That was cold.

quests.title: Hollow Men at the Wall
quests.summary: On the fourth day, while you soak, Brother Hollow's hollowed things come for you. The sect has to hold without you.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hollowed guardians at the wall! Coming for you! In the bath! We're not letting a hollow man see you in the bath!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Zhao Kang, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Sect Master. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.text: Ward the tempering bath

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Through the pain, you raise a ward over the bath. Outside, you hear your friends fighting, and it's the best sound in the world.

objectives.text: Fight off the hollowed guardians

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These hollowed guardians fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Finish the hollowed puppets at the sect gate
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Held. All of them. Han Xue broke three by herself. She says it was two. It was three. I counted. I always count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Liu Er's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (beaming at Zhao Kang) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: The Worst Day
quests.summary: The fourth day is the worst. Han Xue sits beside the bath and doesn't say anything. It helps.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'm not going to say anything. I'm just going to sit here. That's all. Don't talk. Breathe. In for four.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...You're doing well. That's all. I said I wouldn't talk. I'm bad at promises today.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Nine days. On the ninth, walk to the cliff edge in the storm. Hua says the lightning finishes what the bath starts.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'll be there. The whole sect will be there. We'll stand in the rain like idiots. For you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Brother Hollow Writes
quests.summary: On the eighth day a letter arrives, written in a hand that looks like it was borrowed. It is from Brother Hollow.

objectives.text: Read Brother Hollow's letter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dear heir. Your body is a house. I am looking to rent. Soon, I think. When you're tired. Everyone gets tired. Kong Yi, the Fourth Rung.

objectives.text: Go to the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The paper crumbles as you finish it, hollow inside, like everything he touches.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A hollow man wrote you a letter? About renting you? I'm going to burn the gate. No. I'm going to guard the gate. Harder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm... not going to tell anyone about that one.

quests.title: Hollowed Guardians, the Ninth Day's Test
quests.summary: As the ninth day approaches, more hollowed guardians test the mountain's defenses, probing for weakness.

objectives.text: Investigate the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great bronze cauldron smoulders. Someone has written 'donations welcome' on it in chalk.

objectives.text: Break the hollowed guardians at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: More hollowed guardians? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the outer dormitories
Show Liu Er what you found

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Back, and breathing evenly. That's all a healer asks for, and so rarely gets.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Elder Hua. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Liu Er, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Liu Er) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the Final Soak
quests.summary: Elder Hua wants a final batch of spirit herbs added to the bath before the ninth day's lightning.

objectives.text: Hear Liu Er out

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the spirit peach orchard. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the spirit peach orchard
Bring word to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says I have to be polite to immortals. Hello, immortal!

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Liu Er) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Liu Er) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Vigil
quests.summary: Wei Tong takes a shift sitting by the bath, insisting on it despite Han Xue's system of shifts already covering it.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I know Han Xue's got a shift schedule. I'm ignoring it. I'm sitting here anyway. Overlapping vigils. It's fine. It's very fine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan would have sent a servant for this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan's servants would have eaten my lunch.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Fan Rui.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Han Xue has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hm. Wei Tong is not wrong. Wei Tong is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. The Sect Master is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Training Puppets, Hollowed Again
quests.summary: A second batch of training puppets is hollowed overnight, and Wei Tong's twelve handle it themselves this time.

objectives.text: Tend the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill furnace breathes out heat like a sleeping beast. Inside, a batch of pills turns slowly in the glow.

objectives.text: Stop the hollowed puppets at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Recover lantern oil from the outer pines
Talk it over with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Hua. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Medicine for the Sixth Day
quests.summary: The sixth day brings a new wave of pain, and Elder Hua wants medicine on hand for after, not during.

objectives.text: Go and see Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Wei Tong said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the medicine valley
See Yan Tie again

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (hiding behind Yan Tie) Oh.

quests.title: The Seventh Day's Quiet
quests.summary: The seventh day is unexpectedly quiet, and Zhao Kang, suspicious of quiet, keeps watch anyway.

objectives.text: Search the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old blades stand in the rock of the sword tomb like a field of iron grass, each one a disciple's last oath.

objectives.text: Grip the sword in the stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sword in the stone is cold and humming. For a moment you hear its last owner's oath, word for word.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Quiet's worse than screaming. Screaming means you're still fighting it. Quiet means I don't know what's happening in there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Lizard Update
quests.summary: Xiao Man provides a lengthy, unnecessary update on the rare lizard's wellbeing after the bath's preparation.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Man's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The lizard's fine! It's eating well! It seems to like being famous now! I've named it Adequate, after Elder Mo!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Old Bao. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Xiao Man) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Sect Master. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Eighth Night
quests.summary: On the eighth night, void wraiths gather at the pavilion's ward, drawn by the coming breakthrough's power.

objectives.text: Read the ledgers at the abacus desk at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ledgers on the abacus desk balance to the last copper, which is exactly what makes them suspicious.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the contribution pavilion
Tell Xiao Man what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The crane roost is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Zhao Kang. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says I'm improving. She said it with her eyes closed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

quests.title: Thunder Crystals, the Cliff's Reserve
quests.summary: A reserve of thunder crystals is planted at the cliff edge ahead of time, ready for the ninth day's lightning.

objectives.text: Report to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me thunder crystals from the sect gate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: No, Wei Tong. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Collect thunder crystals around the sect gate
Return to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says I have to be polite to immortals. Hello, immortal!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Vow
quests.summary: Yun Zhi vows, in front of the assembling crowd, that the whole sect will stand in the storm for the ninth day, no exceptions.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone. In the rain. No exceptions, no umbrellas. If it hurts them to watch, let it. Watching is the least we owe them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Xiao Man. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Void Refinement
quests.summary: On the ninth day, you walk from the bath to the cliff edge in a thunderstorm. The whole sect stands in the rain to watch.

objectives.text: See what Elder Hua wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Ninth day. Walk to the cliff. Let the lightning in. It will finish what the bath started. It will also hurt. Last time, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: No, Liu Er. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Plant thunder crystals on the cliff
Refine the void between body and soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lightning comes down and doesn't stop at your skin. It runs through bone and soul alike and finds no seam between them, because there isn't one.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You are one thing now. Body, soul, qi, all one. Nothing could wear you. Nothing could fit.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Void Refinement

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spiral turns the colour of a bruise. Lightning walks inside it, looking for the gap between body and soul.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Void Refinement. The whole sect in the rain, cheering. Wei Tong is crying. I'm crying. It's the rain. Welcome back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Let the hollow man come now. There's no room in you for anyone but you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Invitation
quests.summary: Yan Tie invites you to the Thunder Peak forge. He's been waiting years to ask. He asks very loudly.

objectives.text: Hear Yan Tie out

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's lightning forge! We temper swords there! Once a generation, we temper a person! It's your turn! Say yes! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Yan Tie is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

objectives.text: Head to the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's disciples line the path up to their summit, shouting encouragement at nothing in particular.

objectives.text: Go back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The forge is at the top of the peak, where the lightning lands. Thunder wolves live there. They like the lightning too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. Fan Rui's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Wolves of the Peak
quests.summary: The thunder wolves that live around the forge are not void-touched. They're just very big and very fond of lightning.

objectives.text: Make your way to the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves with sparks in their fur lounge around the forge path, sunbathing in a thunderstorm.

objectives.text: Drive the peak thunder wolves from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't kill them! They're Thunder Peak's wolves! Just convince them to move! Thunder Peak convinces loudly!

objectives.text: Gather the sparks the wolves shed
Compare notes with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Convinced. They'll come back tomorrow. They always come back. We named the big one Rumble. He's a very good boy.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Sect Master. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Yan Tie, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

quests.title: The Lightning Forge
quests.summary: The forge is a ring of star-iron anvils around a pillar of black glass, where lightning has struck for a thousand years.

objectives.text: Scout the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A ring of star-iron anvils surrounds a pillar of black glass. The air smells of rain and burnt metal. Your hair stands on end.

objectives.text: Lay your hand on the lightning forge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The glass pillar hums. Your integrated body hums back. Somewhere above, the storm notices, and begins to gather.

objectives.text: Show Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: It noticed you. The forge never notices anyone. It noticed me once, when I was twelve. I fell off. You didn't fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Tempered Like a Sword
quests.summary: Thunder Peak's secret: an integrated body can be struck by lightning on purpose, and it gets stronger each time.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stand on the forge. Let it hit you. Integrated bodies don't break. They get denser. Like steel. Very painful steel.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yan Tie, lower your voice. The mountain is asleep.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: THE MOUNTAIN LIKES ME, ZHAO KANG.

objectives.text: Temper your body on the lightning forge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lightning hits you. It doesn't hurt the way the bath hurt. It hurts the way a hammer hurts iron: usefully.

objectives.text: Report back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Eleven strikes! The record's nine! Thunder Peak's going to carve your name on the forge! We don't carve names! We'll start!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Well? Is it true what they're saying? Which part? All the parts. I need all the parts.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (beaming at Yan Tie) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Forge's Old Guardians
quests.summary: The forge has guardians older than Thunder Peak. They wake when the record is broken, to see who broke it.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The forge guardians are awake! Nobody told me the forge had guardians! Nobody tells me anything about Thunder Peak!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Yan Tie said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Clear the martial stage of forge guardians

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Cut down the forge guardians that follow
Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: They only wake when the record's broken! They've been asleep for three hundred years! You broke a three-hundred-year sleep!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Zhao Kang. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Yan Tie) That was cold.

quests.title: What Thunder Peak Shouts
quests.summary: Thunder Peak holds a feast for the record-breaker. The feast is very loud. Yan Tie tells you why Thunder Peak shouts.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Why do we shout? Because the first master of Thunder Peak was deaf. He shouted so he could feel his voice. We shout so he'd hear us.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Also it's fun. Mostly it's fun. But it started with him.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came for the feast. Thunder Peak's food is terrible. Loud, but terrible. I brought dumplings. I'm a hero here now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Old Qiu. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Thunder Peak's forge-masters offer a banned tempering. Faster, and more dangerous.

choices.text: Refuse

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Accept, but only on yourself

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The Law Hall's going to write you a very long letter.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: HA! Thunder Peak would do exactly that!

choices.text: Accept, and have the juniors test it first

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: An Integrated Spar
quests.summary: Han Xue wants to test your new body. She has been waiting for a fair fight for years. This one still isn't fair.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Spar. You and me. Your new body against my old sword. It won't be fair. I don't care. I want to see.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Fan Rui.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Spar with Han Xue's Frost Sword disciples first

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sparring disciples ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You didn't even move your feet. My disciples bounced off you. This isn't the sparring match you owe me. That one I'll win.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Han Xue, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Sect Master. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Star Iron for a Blade
quests.summary: Your ugly practice blade from Elder Mo cracked on the forge. Thunder Peak offers to reforge it with star iron.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Elder Mo's blade cracked. Thunder Peak can fix it. Star iron from the forge anvils. Elder Mo would want it fixed, not replaced.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yan Tie has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

objectives.text: Gather star iron from the old anvils
See Yan Tie again

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Reforged. Still ugly. Stronger. We didn't change a thing about how it looks. We didn't dare. He'd haunt us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Han Xue. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more star iron than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Hollow Wolves
quests.summary: Brother Hollow tries again: he slips into the thunder wolves while they sleep, and sends them against the forge.

objectives.text: See what Yan Tie wants

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Rumble! Rumble's eyes are purple! The hollow man's in the wolves! In my good boy! Get him out!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

objectives.text: Ward the lightning forge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises over the forge. The lightning in it answers yours. The hollowed wolves hit the ward and yelp.

objectives.text: Fight off the peak thunder wolves

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Peak thunder wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Stop the peak thunder wolves regrouping
Return to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Rumble's eyes are yellow again. He licked my face. Brother Hollow's gone from him. Thunder Peak will never forgive that hollow man.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Tang Ling. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Yan Tie will leave out. There is always a part.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Yan Tie's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Forge Guardians, Resettling
quests.summary: The forge's guardians, woken by the broken record, need a second calming before they'll return to sleep.

objectives.text: Stoke the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Break the forge guardians at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Find the star iron at the outer dormitories
Talk it over with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Did anything bite you? Sting you? Look at you strangely? Tell me everything.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for Rumble's Recovery
quests.summary: Yan Tie asks for spirit stones to help Rumble recover fully from being hollowed, just to be safe.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the laundry stream. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the laundry stream
Go back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
