dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Thunder Peak Opinion
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, still processing Thunder Peak's volume, offers a considered opinion on the sect's culture.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're insane. Wonderful, but insane. I'm going to visit more. Don't tell them I said wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Sect Master. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the core disciples' court. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Yan Tie agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the Sword Peak path.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Old Qiu. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Peak Thunder Wolves, One More Test
quests.summary: A handful of thunder wolves, curious about your tempered body, challenge you to a friendly chase.

objectives.text: Read the ledgers at the abacus desk at the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run the beads of the abacus desk. The accounts come out one sum short, every month, for years.

objectives.text: Stop the peak thunder wolves at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the outer pines
Share your findings with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. The Sect Master does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Thunder Crystals From the Forge Ring
quests.summary: The forge's ring of anvils sheds thunder crystals after every strike, worth gathering for the sect's reserves.

objectives.text: Go and see Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me thunder crystals from the spirit peach orchard, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Pick up thunder crystals near the spirit peach orchard
Report back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yan Tie, lower your voice. The mountain is asleep.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: THE MOUNTAIN LIKES ME, ZHAO KANG.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Deaf Master's Bell
quests.summary: Yan Tie shows you the original founder's bell, cracked and silent, kept as a memorial at the forge's edge.

objectives.text: Hurry to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the spirit beast garden is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Tell Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: His bell. He couldn't hear it either. He kept it anyway. Said it was for us, not him. Thunder Peak's whole philosophy in one cracked bell.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Wei Tong. Wei Tong won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Dumpling Diplomacy
quests.summary: Wei Tong's dumplings are such a hit at the feast that Thunder Peak asks him to teach a cooking class.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Me! Teaching Thunder Peak to cook! They shout their recipes! I shout back! It's the best class I've ever taught!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Elder Hua. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Hollowed Wolves, a Second Attempt
quests.summary: Brother Hollow tries the wolves again, more carefully this time, testing the ward's limits.

objectives.text: Go to the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great bronze cauldron smoulders. Someone has written 'donations welcome' on it in chalk.

objectives.text: Defeat the peak thunder wolves at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Collect lantern oil around the outer pines
Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Sect Master. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hmph. Reasonable. Annoyingly.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Star Iron, the Forge's Overflow
quests.summary: The forge produces more star iron than the sect currently needs, and Steward Qian asks for the overflow collected properly.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me star iron from the medicine valley. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, did you eat? You never eat. Here, half a bun. The bigger half.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...Thank you. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

objectives.text: Find the star iron at the medicine valley
Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more star iron than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Han Xue's Promised Match
quests.summary: Han Xue reminds you, pointedly, that she's still owed a real, fair sparring match, integrated body or not.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You owe me a match. A real one. When Qingshi's sorted. I'm keeping count. I'm always keeping count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Yan Tie. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to Elder Hua) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Risky. Like my better remedies.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: East Again
quests.summary: A crane from Constable Du: people in Qingshi are going hollow. Not puppets. People. The ones who've given up.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Constable Du writes: people in Qingshi are going hollow. Sitting in doorways, eyes purple, smiling. The ones who've lost hope.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Go. You're the one body on this mountain he can't enter. Take Liu Er. It's his town.

objectives.text: Meet Liu Er at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: My town? People are going hollow in my town? I'm packing. I'm packing now. I'm packing a broom.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Listen to Elder Hua. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Liu Er) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Purple Eyes in Doorways
quests.summary: Qingshi's main street is quiet. In a dozen doorways, people sit smiling with purple eyes, doing nothing at all.

objectives.text: Investigate the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In a dozen doorways, townsfolk sit very still, smiling, eyes purple. A child tugs at her father's sleeve. He doesn't move.

objectives.text: Talk with Constable Du at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Eleven so far. The ones who'd given up. The man who lost his farm. The woman whose son died in the siege. Now they just sit.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They're not dead. They're not asleep. They're... rented out.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Kindly done. The town remembers kindness.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: Liu Er Comes Home
quests.summary: Liu Er comes home in blue robes and finds his mother standing guard over the neighbours with a bucket.

objectives.text: Hear Widow Liu out

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My son! In blue robes! No, don't hug me, I'm guarding the Chens. They're hollow. I throw water on them. It doesn't help. It makes me feel better.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, I'm a cultivator now. Sort of. A small one. I brought a broom.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: A broom. My son climbs nine thousand steps and comes back with a broom. I've never been so proud.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Er, stand up straight. You're talking to an immortal.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, it's only {player}!

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

objectives.text: Join Constable Du at the post station

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Liu Er. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: By the law. That's all I ever ask.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

quests.title: What Hollow Looks Like
quests.summary: You look at a hollow townsman with soul sight. There's almost nothing left inside. Just a thread, and someone holding it.

objectives.text: Search the humpbacked bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Chen sits in his doorway, smiling. In soul sight he is nearly empty: a flicker of self, and a purple thread running east.

objectives.text: Look inside a hollow townsman

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Deep inside, very small, Old Chen is still there. He's sitting in a corner of himself, very tired, waiting for someone to say he matters.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're still in there. Hiding in the corners. Brother Hollow moved in because they moved out. Make them want to come back.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Magistrate Zhou.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Reasons to Come Back
quests.summary: You sit with Old Chen and tell him why he matters. Not grand reasons. Small ones. His neighbours help.

objectives.text: Speak with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Tell him about the plums. He grows the best plums on the street. Every summer, he gives the children the ripe ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

objectives.text: Remind Old Chen why he matters

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Plums. The children. The way he whistles. Slowly, the purple fades from his eyes, and Old Chen looks at you, and asks why everyone's crying.

objectives.text: Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: It works! You have to remind them! We can do that! I can do that! I know everyone on this street!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Er, stand up straight. You're talking to an immortal.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, it's only {player}!

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Chen's son wants the hollowed kept locked up until they are cured.

choices.text: Refuse. They heal among neighbours.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Agree, as the magistrate ordered

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Lock them up, and charge their families

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Plums and Reasons
quests.summary: Liu Er organises the town: everyone brings something that reminds a hollow neighbour they matter.

objectives.text: Go and see Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Everyone bring one thing! Something that reminds them! Plums for Old Chen! Ribbons for Mei's mother! Anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Madam Fang. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Gather reminders from the townsfolk
Hear what Madam Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eleven hollow people, and the whole town carrying plums and ribbons and old songs. I've never seen Qingshi like this.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Madam Fang says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Brother Hollow Pushes Back
quests.summary: When his tenants start leaving, Brother Hollow sends his shades to keep them.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shades! Pouring out of the alley! Coming for the ones who woke up! Iron-Fang's men, form a line! With brooms!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Drive the hollow shades from the back alley

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These hollow shades fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Hold the night market against more hollow shades
See Iron-Fang again

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Brooms. We fought shades with brooms. Liu Er's idea. My men have never been so embarrassed or so effective.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

quests.title: The Last Hollow
quests.summary: The last hollow person in Qingshi is the one nobody expected: Magistrate Zhou.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The magistrate. The last one. He's sitting in the yamen, smiling, purple. He gave up, and none of us noticed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Captain Lei. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Magistrate Zhou. Your speech at the tide. One word. Hold. The whole town held because you said it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: ...Hold. I said hold. I did, didn't I. The town held. I held. ...Why am I sitting in the dark? Somebody light a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: The Thread East
quests.summary: With the last tenant evicted, all of Brother Hollow's threads in Qingshi pull back east at once. You feel which way.

objectives.text: Head to the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven purple threads snap back east at once, like fishing lines reeled in. In soul sight they all end in the same place.

objectives.text: Follow the snapped threads with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: East, then south. Not beyond the Iron Scale. The Abyss. The blood pools. He's hiding where the body-tempering water is.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The blood pools. Where you'd go to temper your body further. He knows. He's waiting where you'd go next. He's clever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Iron-Fang's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Plum Wine for the Returned
quests.summary: Qingshi throws a small feast for the eleven who came back. Old Chen brings last summer's plum wine.

objectives.text: Find Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Old Chen's plum wine! He's been saving it for a wedding. He says this is better than a wedding. I'm paying for the noodles. Don't argue.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Han Xue! Manners!

objectives.text: Gather plums from Old Chen's trees
Pour the plum wine at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven people who came back, and the whole street around them, drinking plum wine. Old Chen whistles. The children cheer.

objectives.text: Talk with Old Pan at the bell pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years in this town. Never seen it hold together like this. You did that. The boy with the broom did that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Scholar Ouyang.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Sensible. My mother would've done the same.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, Testing the Recovering Town
quests.summary: A band of rogue cultivators, hearing Qingshi was weakened, tests the town's defenses during the celebration.

objectives.text: Beat the war drum at the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The skin of the war drum is tight and ancient. One beat, and your heart falls into step with it.

objectives.text: Clear the pottery kilns of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The rogue cultivators have found you first.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the dye yard
Share your findings with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: I'll weave it into the autumn bolt. A little gold line, for you.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Qiao Niang.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Incense for the Returned
quests.summary: The town lights incense for each of the eleven who returned, a small ritual Widow Liu insists on for luck.

objectives.text: See what Liu Er wants

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me incense bundles from the pottery kilns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: No, Merchant Jin. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Liu Er) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Gather incense bundles at the pottery kilns
Return to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Old Pan. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Liu Er) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Zhou's Quieter Speech
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou, still shaken by his own hollowing, gives a second, quieter speech, this one just for the eleven.

objectives.text: Hear Magistrate Zhou out

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I gave up without noticing I'd given up. If it happened to me, it can happen to anyone. Watch each other. That's the whole speech.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the boat yard

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Join Merchant Jin at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Iron-Fang. Let the immortal work.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Retreating Watch
quests.summary: A handful of demon cultivators, sent to observe Brother Hollow's failed harvest, retreat toward the Abyss.

objectives.text: Check the medicine cabinet at the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The medicine cabinet is almost bare. Someone has been emptying it faster than it can be filled.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the dye yard
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Did you fly? Did you use a sword? Can I hold the sword? Just for a moment?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: I'll weave it into the autumn bolt. A little gold line, for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: weaver_qiao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Medicine for the Long Recovery
quests.summary: The eleven returned townsfolk need medicine for weeks, not days, as their bodies relearn how to want things.

objectives.text: Speak with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the brewery. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Merchant Jin. {player} has never let us down.

objectives.text: Collect medicine bundles around the brewery
Go back to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Constable Du. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Old Pan) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Old Chen's Whistle
quests.summary: Old Chen, fully returned, teaches the tune he whistles to a group of children, saying it's what brought him back.

objectives.text: Make your way to the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Chen says the tune isn't magic. It's just a thing worth doing, and things worth doing are what pull people back from hollow.

objectives.text: Taste the wine jars

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tap the wine jars one by one. Full, full, full, and one that answers hollow.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the north gate. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Captain Lei. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Broom Brigade
quests.summary: Iron-Fang, delighted by his men's broom-fighting success, formally names them the Broom Brigade over loud objections.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The Broom Brigade. It's staying. My men hate it. I love it. Iron-Fang's earned the right to name one thing badly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'm watching you, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good. Somebody should. I'm very watchable now.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Not now, Iron-Fang. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Immortals drink like fish and tip like cats.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Huo Da.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Old Pan) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Alley's Last
quests.summary: A last cluster of void wraiths hides in the back alley, missed in the fight against Brother Hollow's shades.

objectives.text: Sound the war drum at the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the war drum. The boom rolls out across the land and comes back from the hills, twice.

objectives.text: Break the hollow shades at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The hollow shades come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the back alley
Show Magistrate Zhou what you found

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: Remarkable. I'll set it as an essay question. The students will hate you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I have not slept since spring.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for Old Chen's Trees
quests.summary: Old Chen's plum trees, drained by his hollowing, need spirit herb fertilizer to bear fruit again next summer.

objectives.text: Answer Merchant Jin's summons

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me spirit herbs from the temple fair.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the temple fair
Report back to Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Business is business. I'm told friendship is also business, but warmer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Fair. Fair's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Liu Er's Broom, Retired
quests.summary: Liu Er, having used his broom to fight shades and organize a town, decides it deserves a place of honor rather than storage.

objectives.text: Report to Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: It's not just a broom anymore. It's the broom. I'm hanging it by the door. Mother agrees. Mother never agrees with me. This matters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: What Magistrate Zhou said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the yamen. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Thank you, Liu Er, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Talk with Merchant Jin at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the county granary.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (beaming at Merchant Jin) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (hiding behind Merchant Jin) Oh.

quests.title: Liu Er Stays a Night
quests.summary: Liu Er asks to stay one night in Qingshi before going back up the mountain. His mother has made eleven meals.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: One night. Mother made eleven meals. She's still counting in elevens. I'll be back at the sect tomorrow. Wei Tong will understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Listen to Madam Fang. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Find Widow Liu at the City God temple

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He reminded eleven people they mattered. He reminded me too. Take care of him up there. He's very small in those big robes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Liu Er! Manners!

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Warning
quests.summary: Ye Wuming meets you at the rim, grim. The Fourth Rung has been seen at the pools, wearing someone.

objectives.text: Scout the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rim is quiet. Ye Wuming waits at the canyon mouth, arms folded, and his children are nowhere to be seen.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I sent the children away. Brother Hollow's at the pools. He's wearing someone. A Blood Guard captain, big and strong and empty.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He can't wear you now. So he wants you to watch him wear someone else. He wants you to feel sorry for them.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

quests.title: Hollow Guards
quests.summary: The Blood Guards at the pools are all hollowed, and they move together like fingers on one hand.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They all move at once. Like a puppet show. One puppeteer. I hate puppet shows. I've always hated puppet shows.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ye Wuming.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: More Blood Guards? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of hollow shades
Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's testing how many he can hold at once. Twelve. He's getting stronger. Every body he fills, he learns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Tempering in the Pools
quests.summary: Between fights you temper your body in the purified blood pools, the way Elder Hua told you. It hurts differently.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hua said the purified pools finish what the bath and the forge start. I'll watch the rim. Temper. Don't argue.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Shi. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Temper your body in the purified pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pool water is warm and clean now, pink as dawn. It sinks into your integrated body and finds the last seams, and seals them.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You glow. Pink. It's very undignified. It's also, I'm told, how cultivators look before a stage breaks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: The Captain He Wears
quests.summary: At the obelisk ring, a Blood Guard captain stands alone, smiling. His eyes are purple. His voice isn't his.

objectives.text: Hurry to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A Blood Guard captain, huge, scarred, smiling with a stranger's smile. His voice, when it comes, is soft and hollow.

objectives.text: Look inside the hollowed captain

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside, in a corner, the captain is still there: a boy taken from a village, forty years ago, who never stopped wanting to go home.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I knew him. Forty years ago. We were in the cages together. His name was Tan. He cried every night for his mother.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Ye Wuming does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Get Brother Hollow out of him. Please. Tan deserves to go home. Even now. Especially now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Brother Hollow wears Tan's body. Tan may still be in there, somewhere.

choices.text: Try to save Tan

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: End it cleanly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Leave Tan hollow, as a lure

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: Gu Knew Tan
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, has come to the rim. He knew the captain too. He brought him to the Abyss.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tan. I brought him. Forty years ago, as a boy. I thought I was saving him. I was selling him.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: If there's a way to reach him, it's his mother's village. Willow Creek. The same village you came from.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. My village.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. He was your mother's cousin. I'm sorry. I've been carrying that one a long time.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the ghost village

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

quests.title: Willow Creek Memories
quests.summary: To reach Tan, you need something from Willow Creek. You have one thing: your mother's pendant, and the memories in it.

objectives.text: Study the bronze mirror at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hold the pendant. In soul sight it glows with Willow Creek: a willow, a creek, a woman singing, a boy called Tan laughing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back of the bronze mirror is carved with a lotus. The front shows the room behind you, and one extra shadow.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow feels the memory. His hollow guards come, fast, to stop you.

objectives.text: Gather the lotus that grows where the memories fell
Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Blood lotus, pink now. Growing where your memories touched the pool. Your village grows here now. That's strange and beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Twelve Fingers
quests.summary: Brother Hollow sends everything he's wearing at once. Twelve bodies, one mind, all smiling.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's here! Twelve of them! One of me! I like those odds! Actually, you're here too. I like them more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Guards from the bone throne

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Guards at the sulphur vents
See Iron-Fang again

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They fell like puppets with cut strings. Because that's what they were. Poor sods. We'll bury them properly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha! Now you're talking like the old road.

quests.title: Singing to Tan
quests.summary: You go to the hollowed captain with the pendant, and do the only thing that makes sense. You sing the song from Willow Creek.

objectives.text: Go to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The captain stands at the obelisk ring. You sing the only song you remember from Willow Creek, the one your mother sang. Badly.

objectives.text: Sing Willow Creek's song to Tan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The captain's purple eyes flicker. Deep inside, a boy called Tan lifts his head. Mother? he says. The purple drains away.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Tan's back. Forty years in the cages and the Guard, and he's back, crying for his mother. He's asking your name.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow's thread snapped. He felt it. He's angry now. Angry and empty is a very dangerous thing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Pink Water, Iron Bones
quests.summary: Before Brother Hollow comes, you finish tempering in the pools. Tan sits on the rim, watching, wrapped in Ye Wuming's cloak.

objectives.text: Finish tempering in the purified pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your bones feel like iron. Your soul feels like water poured into them. They are one thing. Middle stage of Body Integration.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Tan wants to go home to Willow Creek. I said I'd take him. I know what it's like, the first hour after the door opens.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Zhao Kang. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

quests.title: Corrupted Wolves, the Pools' Edge
quests.summary: Corrupted wolves gather at the purified pools' edge, agitated by the clean water they can no longer stand.

objectives.text: Polish the bronze mirror at the cave of echoes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze mirror is dark with age. When you breathe on it, words appear in the mist and fade.

objectives.text: Clear the cave of echoes of corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the cave of echoes
Compare notes with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the slave mines isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: You're still alive. That's worth more than anything I'm selling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.choice_prompt: The corrupted wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

reply.speaker: broker_ku
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Blood Lotus, the Second Bloom
quests.summary: A second bloom of pink blood lotus grows where more of your memories touched the pool, worth gathering carefully.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Gu's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me blood lotus from the poison garden.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Gu says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue. Now, where was I.

objectives.text: Pick up blood lotus near the poison garden
Return to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more blood lotus than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it started, for me.

quests.title: Tan's First Question
quests.summary: Tan, newly freed, asks the only question that matters to him: whether his mother is still alive in Willow Creek.

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I don't know, Tan. It's been forty years. But Xiao Shi will take you to find out. That's more than most of us ever got.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the lava falls

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
