dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the lava falls

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (grinning at Zhao Kang) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, Following the Hollow Threads
quests.summary: The snapped threads from Brother Hollow's fallen puppets draw void wraiths, agitated by the broken connection.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the beast pens

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Fight off the hollow shades

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Collect demon cores around the beast pens
Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Twelve Fingers
quests.summary: The twelve fallen hollowed guards leave demon cores behind, worth gathering before the Abyss reclaims them.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me demon cores from the soul forge.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut it, Han Xue.

objectives.text: Find the demon cores at the soul forge
Go back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Go on.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the demon cores you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Gu's Memory of Willow Creek
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, prompted by Tan's rescue, recalls more details about Willow Creek and who else he took from it.

objectives.text: Investigate the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tower of skulls stands on its spur of rock, thousands of empty eyes turned toward the canyon.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tan wasn't the only one. There were two others. I don't remember their names. I should. I'm sorry I don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Zhao Kang Buries the Fallen
quests.summary: Zhao Kang leads the burial of the fallen hollowed guards, insisting they deserve names even if nobody knows them.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We don't know their names. So we mark the graves 'someone's son.' All of them. Every single one was someone's son.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Iron-Fang. And the time before.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: No, Iron-Fang. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Xiao Shi, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Rim's Last Watch
quests.summary: A final watch of blood guards, not yet hollowed, tests the rim before retreating toward the fold.

objectives.text: Mark the map table at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Blood Guards ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the watch spire
Share your findings with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Iron-Fang) That was cold.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Obelisk Ring
quests.summary: The obelisk ring, disturbed by Brother Hollow's presence, sheds void shards worth studying before the confrontation ahead.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Gu out

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me void shards from the ash plains.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Elder Gu is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the ash plains
Report back to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: As you like.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Han Xue's Glow, Explained
quests.summary: Han Xue, still teasing about the pink glow, admits she's actually relieved to see a stage break without screaming this time.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No screaming this time. Just glowing. Undignified, but quiet. I'll take quiet. We don't get much of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Iron-Fang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the soul forge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Han Xue. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the Blood Moon shrine

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

quests.title: The Hollow Man Comes Himself
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the snapped threads. Brother Hollow has stopped sending bodies. He's coming himself.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's stopped sending puppets. He's coming himself. East, to the forest. He wants to fight where there are empty things to use.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The bamboo forest. Hollow bamboo. Thousands of empty stalks. He'll have an army of them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Of course he will. Everyone always wants to fight us in the bamboo. Let's go.

objectives.text: Search the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hooded traders murmur in the shadow market, selling pills, poisons and souls by the jin.

objectives.text: Search the wine jars

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jars are sealed with clay and stamped. One seal is fresh, though the jar is very old.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the bone bridge

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Ye Wuming. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Bamboo Stands Up
quests.summary: The hermit's crane says the bamboo is standing up. Not growing. Standing. And walking.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo stood up at dawn. The hollow stalks. They pulled themselves out of the ground and started walking. Come quickly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Head to the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest path is lined with bamboo men: stalks woven into bodies, purple mist in their hollows, all turned toward you.

objectives.text: Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ten thousand stalks. Ten thousand hollow bodies. My forest. He's wearing my forest. I am very, very angry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to the hermit, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

quests.title: Bamboo Men
quests.summary: The bamboo men come at you in waves, clattering, hollow, very light and very many.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bamboo men! They're light! They go down easily! There are a LOT of them! Dumpling, I'm sorry again!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Big Shu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Stop the bamboo men at the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bamboo men spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Cut down the bamboo men that follow
See Wei Tong again

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I've cut down about a hundred bamboo men. I'm going to dream of bamboo. I'm going to eat bamboo shoots for a year out of spite.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha. Han Xue's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Where He Lives
quests.summary: Brother Hollow isn't in any one stalk. He's in all of them. But in soul sight, one hollow is fuller than the others.

objectives.text: Make your way to the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the whole forest is threaded with purple. But in the clearing, one old stalk glows brighter, full of someone.

objectives.text: Look into the fullest stalk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A man sitting cross-legged in the hollow of a single bamboo, smiling, eyes closed. He opens them. He waves. Of course he waves.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That's him. His real self. He hides in the smallest hollow and wears the largest. Break that stalk, and he has to come out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

quests.title: The Hermit's Plan
quests.summary: The hermit has a plan. It involves the Heart Sutra, the spirit spring, and filling ten thousand hollows at once.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: He lives in hollows. So we fill them. Water from the spring, with the sutra in it. Every stalk. All at once.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It'll take the whole spring. It'll take everything I have. It's my forest. I'll give it everything.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Shi at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'll carry water. I'm good at carrying things. I carried hope for a year in a cage. Water's lighter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: See? Even the hermit agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit's plan means drowning a bamboo grove where spirit foxes den.

choices.text: Move the foxes first, whatever it costs

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Follow the plan

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Drown them all

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Spring Water for Ten Thousand
quests.summary: Everyone carries spring water to the bamboo: you, Xiao Shi, Wei Tong, Ye Wuming, even Zhao Kang, complaining.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Water carrying. The Zhao clan heir. Carrying water. For bamboo. My great-grandfather would faint. I'm going to tell him. In detail.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to the hermit. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Carry sutra-water from the spirit spring
Defeat the bamboo men at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bamboo men at the spring try to stop you. Water hisses on them like it's too honest to touch.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough. Stand back. I'm going to sing. Loudly. It's been three hundred years since I sang this loudly. Cover your ears. Don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Hermit Sings
quests.summary: The hermit sings the Heart Sutra, all three verses, while you pour the water. The forest fills.

objectives.text: Pour your qi into the hermit's song

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. The hermit's voice fills the forest, and the water fills the stalks, and one by one the purple goes out of them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ten thousand hollows, filled with something that isn't empty. There's nowhere left for Brother Hollow to live but himself.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Blossom. I sang the blossom. I've never reached it before. Compassion. Even for him. That's what filled the stalks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Wei Tong has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Kong Yi, Brother Hollow
quests.summary: With nowhere else to hide, the Fourth Rung steps out of his stalk: a thin man, very tired, smiling out of habit.

objectives.text: Scout the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thin man steps out of a bamboo stalk and stands in the clearing. Without borrowed bodies he is small, and grey, and smiling from habit.

objectives.name: Kong Yi, Brother Hollow
objectives.text: Defeat Kong Yi, Brother Hollow

dialogue.speaker: rung_kong
dialogue.text: You filled my forest. With compassion. How rude. I was so comfortable. I am empty. It's very restful. Let me rest in you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: There's no room, Kong Yi. I'm full.

dialogue.speaker: rung_kong
dialogue.text: Then I'll have to make room. The old-fashioned way.

objectives.text: Stand over the fallen Fourth Rung

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Kong Yi lies in the grass. For a moment, before the end, he looks full: of surprise, of something like relief. Then his star goes out.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Four stars out. Three left. The Butcher is next. He was always Brother Hollow's shadow. He'll be coming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Pei Yuan.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemy's belongings: a manual of a forbidden blood technique.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Seal it in the Scripture Pagoda

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Keep it. Study it. Quietly.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Clearing the Last Stalks
quests.summary: Some of the bamboo men are still walking, confused, without anyone steering them.

objectives.text: Hurry to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A few bamboo men wander near the wolf den, bumping into trees, lost now that no one is inside them.

objectives.text: Drive the bamboo men from the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bamboo men! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Gather the fallen stalks for replanting
Compare notes with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Replant them. They're bamboo. They'll grow. They'll forget. Bamboo is very good at forgetting. It's why it's so old.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Answer Xiao Shi, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Four Stars Out
quests.summary: The hermit lies on his back in the clearing, exhausted, looking up at the sky through ten thousand healthy stalks.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I reached the blossom. Three hundred years. My masters would laugh. It took a hollow man to teach me compassion.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Go home. I'm going to lie here for a week. Tell Bai I'll be late for his lecture. Tell him the blossom's real.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the rope bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Four down. Three left. The Butcher, Lady Silk, and the one nobody's seen. We're more than halfway up his ladder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Hermit. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Spirit Wolves, Returning to the Healed Forest
quests.summary: With the purple gone from the bamboo, spirit wolves return to the forest, cautious but curious about the change.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The loom clacks once as you touch it, as if the weaver had only stepped out for a moment.

objectives.text: Clear the giant bamboo grove of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Pick up star iron near the old battlefield
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The fishing jetty is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Xiao Shi. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging Wei Tong's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Void Shards From the Fallen Stalks
quests.summary: The bamboo men's fallen forms leave void shards behind, worth gathering before the forest reclaims the clearing.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me void shards from the giant bamboo grove, would you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Collect void shards around the giant bamboo grove
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Later. Over tea. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Water-Carrying Count
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, methodical as ever, reports the exact number of trips it took to fill ten thousand hollow stalks.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Two hundred and eleven trips. I counted. It's a good number. It means we did enough and not one drop more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Hermit.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Bamboo Men, the Deepest Grove
quests.summary: A few bamboo men in the forest's deepest grove never got word that Brother Hollow fell, and keep marching.

objectives.text: Go to the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Children in the bamboo village stop their game to stare at your robes, then bow all at once and giggle.

objectives.text: Fight off the bamboo men

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the herb grove
Talk it over with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs From the Healed Clearing
quests.summary: The clearing, filled with the hermit's compassion-song, grows unusually potent herbs overnight.

objectives.text: Answer Ye Wuming's summons

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me spirit herbs from the mushroom ring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Walk upwind. Whatever's out there has a better nose than you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Meng Sanniang. Meng Sanniang's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the mushroom ring
Go back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Clean tracking. You'd make a decent hunter, if you ever stop being a hero.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Fair's fair.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Kong Yi's Old Puppets
quests.summary: Among Kong Yi's belongings, hidden in the fullest stalk, you find real wooden puppets from his life before the Blood Moon.

objectives.text: Investigate the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Smoke curls from the hunter's lodge. Antlers and wolf skulls grin down from the eaves.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Real puppets. Wood and string. He was a puppeteer, like I said. He kept these for forty years. Even hollow men keep something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Zhao Kang's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Ye Wuming does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Zhao Kang Writes About Bamboo
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, true to his word, writes a very detailed letter to his great-grandfather about carrying water for bamboo.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I told him everything. The water. The singing. The bamboo men. He wrote back: 'Your grandmother would have loved this. Keep going.'

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: I'll carry anything heavy. Heavier than a tree, I'll need a friend.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Big Shu. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the giant bamboo grove. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows faster than I cut. I've made my peace with it. The bamboo hasn't.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Big Shu. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the lake pavilion.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhao Kang. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the hermit) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Grove's Last
quests.summary: A last handful of void wraiths, drawn by the fight's aftermath, lingers at the grove's edge.

objectives.text: Search the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sun pools in the herb grove. Spirit herbs glow faintly among the ferns, like embers in green ash.

objectives.text: Break the hollow shades at the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs at the herb grove
Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sorry I worried you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Fallen Rung
quests.summary: Kong Yi's fallen form leaves rune fragments behind, worth studying for clues about how the Rungs are bound to the Ladder.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me rune fragments from the buried temple.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Hermit. Doesn't change anything.

objectives.text: Pick up rune fragments near the buried temple
Report back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more rune fragments than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Ye Wuming) That was cold.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Bamboo Vow
quests.summary: Wei Tong, true to his spiteful vow, orders bamboo shoots for dinner, and regrets it within one bite.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I said I'd eat bamboo shoots out of spite. I take it back. Spite has consequences. Somebody get me literally anything else.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Ye Wuming.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the waterwheel

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: The Butcher's Calling Card
quests.summary: On the way home, you find a calling card nailed to a tree: a butcher's cleaver, and a price list. Your name is on it.

objectives.text: Leave an offering at the offering table at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nailed to a stalk: a butcher's cleaver, and a price list in neat characters. Cultivators, by the jin. At the bottom, your name. Price: everything.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The dust on the offering table has been disturbed. Beneath the incense bowl lies a folded note.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A price list. With you on it. Everything, it says. I'm insulted on your behalf. You're worth more than everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...That came out wrong. Or right. I don't know. Let's go home.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: An Offer for Merchant Jin
quests.summary: Merchant Jin writes to the sect: someone has offered him a partnership. In meat. The meat is cultivators.

objectives.text: Hear Merchant Jin out

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then thinks better of it) Heavens. You feel like weather now, did you know?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A man came to the guild. With a cleaver. He offered me a partnership. In meat. Cultivator meat. By the jin. I said no.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Not now, Iron-Fang. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Then I said yes, so I could find out where his market is. Then I wrote to you. Was that brave? I feel sick.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the guild warehouse, Merchant Jin sits on a crate, very pale, holding a contract written in a butcher's neat hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The abacus desk is covered in neat figures. Between them, in a smaller hand, someone has written a name.

objectives.text: Bring word to Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The market's beneath the old guild warehouse. The one on stilts. Where the pale man hid his crates. They reuse everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Constable Du. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Butcher's Contract
quests.summary: The contract lists prices. Outer disciples: cheap. Inner disciples: more. Elders: very dear. At the bottom: one special order.

objectives.text: Read the butcher's contract

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Special order: one body, integrated, Verdant Lotus blood, undamaged. For the Master. Price: whatever the Master's hand pays.

objectives.text: Head to the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath, in red: failing that, bodies of close kin will serve for fitting. Collect the heir's friends.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close kin. Your friends. He's going to try to take us to... practise. I'm going to be very rude to him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin was offered the Butcher's contract. He wants it burned before anyone sees his name.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Take it to the magistrate as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep it, to hold over Jin

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Down Beneath the Stilts
quests.summary: Merchant Jin leads you to the market as his 'partner's' newest buyer. Nobody in the market is surprised to see a cultivator buying.

objectives.text: Taste the wine jars at the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the old warehouse on stilts, stairs lead down into a cellar cut into the riverbank. It smells of ice and old blood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The smell from the wine jars is sweet and strong. Beneath it is something sharper, and not wine at all.

objectives.text: Stop the market guards at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The market's guards check faces at the alley entrance. One of them recognises you. That's the end of the disguise.

objectives.text: Search the abacus desk at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the warehouse: a market. Stalls. Scales. And ice, purple and humming, with shapes frozen inside it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ledgers on the abacus desk balance to the last copper, which is exactly what makes them suspicious.

objectives.text: Show Merchant Jin what you found

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I've been a smuggler. I've been a coward. I've never seen anything like this. I'm going to need a lot of honest years to forget it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Anything on the far bank? Lanterns? Faces? I still dream about the lanterns.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Frozen in Void-Ice
quests.summary: Not all the shapes in the void-ice are dead. Some of them are breathing, very slowly.

objectives.text: Make your way to the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the void-ice, a cultivator in Iron Scale green. Her chest rises, once, very slowly. She's alive.

objectives.text: Defeat the rogue cultivators at the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These rogue cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Break open the void-ice

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ice cracks. A young woman in Iron Scale green falls out, gasping. One of the forty from the southern peak. Alive.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Iron Scale. One of Ruan's forty. The butcher bought her from the void. We have to tell Ruan. We have to find the rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Names? Faces? Anything I can write down, cultivator?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A fine piece of business. I mean that as the highest praise I know.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Zhao Kang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Madam Fang's Kitchen
quests.summary: The rescued Iron Scale disciple is taken to the Drunken Crane. Madam Fang feeds her, and Iron-Fang dries the dishes and listens.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Soup. Three bowls. She ate them like a wolf. She says there are more. Frozen. In another market. Further in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Merchant Jin. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The Butcher. I've heard the name. He used to buy bandits who died in raids. Iron-Fang's men, some of them. Before I knew.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want a word with him. A long word. With brooms and without.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: The Butcher's Guards
quests.summary: The Butcher's market guards come looking for the woman who escaped their ice.

objectives.text: Go and see Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Guards from the underground market! Coming up through the warehouse! Looking for the girl! I've got a new spear and a bad mood!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Thank you, Captain Lei, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Drive the market guards from the boat yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The market guards have found you first.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards regrouping
See Constable Du again

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Nine of them. All wearing butcher's aprons over their armour. Who does that? Who dresses like that on purpose?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Not now, Zhao Kang. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Constable Du, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: I'll write it down. I write everything down, cultivator.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's... not in the book. I'll invent a page.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Constable Du) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Butcher's Ledger
quests.summary: In the market's back room, the Butcher's ledger: every body bought, every body sold. And where the best ones go.

objectives.text: Scout the riverside tavern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back room is spotless. A cleaver on the wall, a set of scales, and a ledger in the same neat hand as the price list.

objectives.text: Read the Butcher's ledger

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The best bodies go to 'the larder': the caves beneath the old wolf den in the bamboo. The Butcher keeps them there, fresh, for fitting.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The wolf den. Where the blood seal wept. Where the grotto opened. Where everything happens. I'm starting to hate that den.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Liu Er's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Warm Blankets for the Frozen
quests.summary: If there are more frozen people in the larder, they'll need warmth. Madam Fang raids the whole town for blankets.

objectives.text: Answer Madam Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Blankets! Every blanket in Qingshi! I've taken the magistrate's. He doesn't know yet. He'll be very brave about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

objectives.text: Gather blankets from the market
Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I carried forty blankets. Mother made me take a coat too. Wei Tong says that's what heroes' mothers do. Is it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Madam Fang. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Liu Er) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Iron-Fang Knows the Road
quests.summary: Iron-Fang says the Butcher's carts to the larder use the old bandit roads through the bamboo. He knows every one.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The old bandit roads. I cut half of them myself. The Butcher's using them to move his meat. My roads. For that.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I'll show you. Every road. Every hide. Every trick. Iron-Fang pays his debts. This one I'll pay with interest.

objectives.text: Hear what Merchant Jin has to say

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild will pay for the carts to bring the frozen ones home. All of them. At no cost. I'm getting good at no cost.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Iron-Fang. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, Fleeing the Market
quests.summary: A handful of rogue cultivators who worked as market appraisers flee when the guards fall, and must be run down.

objectives.text: Search the scroll rack at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You work along the scroll rack scroll by scroll. One is shelved in the wrong place, on purpose.

objectives.text: Clear the night market of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: More rogue cultivators? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Collect lantern oil around the night market
Tell Merchant Jin what you found

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Mind the crates. The stamps are imported.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

quests.title: Spirit Stones From the Ledger's Payments
quests.summary: The Butcher's back room holds spirit stones marked as payment for bodies, worth confiscating for the rescued.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me spirit stones from the back alley.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Trouble? Tell me. I'll write it down. Then I'll deal with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the back alley
Return to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Constable Du) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Fair enough. Noted.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: The Iron Scale Disciple's Name
quests.summary: The rescued disciple finally gives her name, and asks that someone tell her family before she's strong enough to travel.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Her name is Wen Shu. She asks that a crane go to the Iron Scale first, before anything else. She's afraid to hope too soon.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run your fingers along the threads of the loom. One colour runs through every bolt, like a signature.

objectives.text: Meet Constable Du at the north gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Constable. I've come to report myself for being useful.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted, Iron-Fang. You're still on my list.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Talk with Madam Fang at the brewery

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Madam Fang, your gossip is faster than my runners.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My gossip is paid in wine, Constable. Your runners aren't.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the watermill

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Constable Du. {player} has never let us down.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Old Pan) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Market's Reserve
quests.summary: A reserve of blood guards, kept off the market floor for emergencies, finally engages when the alarm spreads.

objectives.text: Open the medicine cabinet at the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A hundred little drawers line the medicine cabinet, each labelled. One label is in a different hand.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Guards spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the market square
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
