dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Cracked Ice
quests.summary: The broken void-ice sheds shards worth studying, hoping to learn how to free the frozen safely and quickly.

objectives.text: See what Iron-Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The soft-hearted immortal. Still alive. Surprises me every time.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Bring me void shards from the pottery kilns. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the pottery kilns
Go back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Ledger's Older Pages
quests.summary: Older pages in the Butcher's ledger show he's been operating for over a decade, far longer than anyone suspected.

objectives.text: Hurry to the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hundreds of little drawers line the great pharmacy, each labelled in a neat, anxious hand.

objectives.text: Open the medicine cabinet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You open drawer after drawer of the medicine cabinet. Ginseng, liquorice, and one drawer that smells of blood lotus.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ten years. This market's been running for ten years. How did nobody notice? How did we not notice?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Captain Lei. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Merchant Jin's Confession
quests.summary: Merchant Jin, still shaken, confesses he'd suspected something was wrong with his supply chain for months before acting.

objectives.text: Hear Merchant Jin out

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I told myself it was smuggling. Ordinary smuggling. I didn't want to know. I'm sorry it took this long to look.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Merchant Jin says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: There. Han Xue agrees. Settled.

objectives.text: Join Madam Fang at the guild master's manor

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wine, noodles or gossip? The gossip is free. The rest, you pay for.

objectives.text: Speak with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Listen to Madam Fang. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. It has opinions.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Old Pan) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Market Guards, the Back Tunnels
quests.summary: A last cluster of market guards holds the back tunnels, delaying the rescue of anyone still frozen below.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shuttle of the loom has stopped mid-row. The half-finished pattern is a map, if you know how to read it.

objectives.text: Break the market guards at the night market

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Pick up cloud silk near the dye yard
Talk it over with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: We're done at the dye yard. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: I'll weave it into the autumn bolt. A little gold line, for you.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Qiao Niang. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wipe your boots! This floor has seen a tax collector.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: weaver_qiao
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Letters From the Larder's Manifest
quests.summary: A shipping manifest found in the ledger names every cart sent to the larder, worth copying before the roads are lost again.

objectives.text: Speak with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Bring me sealed letters from the pottery kilns. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Gate closes at dusk. Always has. Always will.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the pottery kilns
Report back to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Anything on the far bank? Lanterns? Faces? I still dream about the lanterns.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Kindly done. The town remembers kindness.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Constable Du, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Wen Shu's Warning
quests.summary: Before you leave for the larder, Wen Shu warns you the Butcher himself sometimes visits, and he doesn't fight like anyone else.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wen Shu says the Butcher weighs his opponents before he fights them, like they're already meat. It's meant to unsettle you. It works.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the lower docks

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

quests.title: Up the Bandit Roads
quests.summary: At dawn, you follow Iron-Fang out of Qingshi onto roads that don't appear on any map.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No map has these roads. I burned the maps. I'm the map now. Follow me. Don't step where I don't step.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A bandit chief leading us through his old roads to rescue frozen cultivators from a butcher. Elder Mo would have liked this.

objectives.text: Go to the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The open-air opera stage is hung with painted cloths. A drum waits at its side for the next performance.

objectives.text: Examine the puppet frame

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tighten the cords of the puppet frame. It twitches, tries a stance, and looks at you expectantly.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the north gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the north gate isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Liu Er. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (hiding behind Han Xue) Oh.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The First Road
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's first road runs from the river to the old bridge, hidden under a canopy of bent bamboo.

objectives.text: Investigate the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the old bridge, a path you've never noticed: bent bamboo, a tunnel of green. Cart ruts, fresh. Iron-Fang kneels and reads them.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Two carts, heavy. Last night. Void-ice leaks cold; see the frost on the ruts? Frozen people, going to the larder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I robbed forty caravans on this road. I'm going to try to make up for one of them today.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Carters on the Road
quests.summary: The Butcher's carters are moving the next load. Iron-Fang knows exactly where to catch them.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here. The bend. They always slow down at the bend. I know because I made them slow down, years ago, with a fallen tree.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Iron-Fang is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Right.

objectives.text: Stop the Butcher's carters at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Butcher's carters come on in silence.

objectives.text: Hold the misty lake against more rogue cultivators
Bring word to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: One cart. Three frozen. Iron Scale green. We'll take them to the hermit. The spring warms people. It warmed me once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The earth god will hear of this. Loudly. We'll light the big incense.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Frost on the Cart
quests.summary: The cart is full of void-ice. The people inside are breathing, barely.

objectives.text: Search the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three blocks of purple ice on a cart. Inside, three Iron Scale disciples, breathing once a minute.

objectives.text: Defeat the rogue cultivators at the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rogue cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Break the void-ice on the cart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ice breaks. Three Iron Scale disciples tumble out, blue with cold. You wrap them in Madam Fang's blankets and hold on.

objectives.text: Share your findings with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bring them to the spring. The water's warm today. It knows. Springs always know when someone's cold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Ye Wuming is not wrong. Ye Wuming is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Tie Hu's Confession
quests.summary: At the hermit's fire, Iron-Fang tells you what he did on the second road, years ago.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The second road. I burned a village there. Willow Creek. Twenty years back. For the Blood Moon, for my sister's life.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. That's my village.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not this time, Headman Kuang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...I know. I figured it out years ago. I didn't tell you. Iron-Fang pays his debts. This one I can't pay. I'm sorry.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You were paying for your sister. So was I, in a way, paying for my mother. We'll bring your sister home, Tie Hu.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...You're a fool. The biggest fool I've ever met. Thank you. I don't know what else to say.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The village is grateful. The village is also very nervous. Mostly nervous.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Worry later, Headman Kuang. Move now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang confesses that years ago he sold men to the Butcher.

choices.text: Forgive him

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: He must face the magistrate after the war

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Hold it over him, so he obeys you

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: The Second Road
quests.summary: The second road leads toward the wolf den. It's guarded now, by wolves the Butcher feeds.

objectives.text: Head to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The second road ends at the wolf den. Wolves pace the entrance, fat and slow, fed on things you don't want to think about.

objectives.text: Drive the spirit wolves from the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather the carters' dropped tallies
Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The tallies say forty bodies in the larder. Twenty-one breathing. The rest... the rest are what the Butcher keeps for fitting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Warming the Frozen
quests.summary: The three rescued Iron Scale disciples are still cold. The spring's warmth isn't enough. Your integrated body might be.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The void-cold is in their bones. Your body is one thing now. Share its warmth. Hold their hands. Let your qi flow into them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

objectives.text: Warm the frozen disciples with your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi runs into them like warm water into cold stone. One by one, they stop shaking. One of them says thank you in Iron Scale dialect.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'll take them home to the Iron Scale. The first hour after the door opens, you need someone to walk with you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: The Butcher's Hide
quests.summary: On the third road, Iron-Fang finds one of his old hides. The Butcher's been using it. There's a letter inside.

objectives.text: Make your way to the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind the lookout rock, a hide dug into the hill, shored with bamboo. Iron-Fang dug it twenty years ago. Someone's been living in it.

objectives.text: Search the Butcher's hide

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A cleaver-sharpening stone, a set of scales, and a letter: The heir's friends. Start with the loud one. Iron-Fang.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Start with the loud one. That's me. He's coming for me first. Good. I've been waiting twenty years to pay somebody back properly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Butcher Comes for Iron-Fang
quests.summary: That night, the Butcher's men come for Iron-Fang at the hermit's fire. They don't get him.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They came for Iron-Fang! With nets! Nets! Like he's a fish! He's not a fish! He's a very large, very angry bandit!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Iron-Fang. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Raise the hermit's ward around the fire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ward flares green around the hermit's fire. Nets hit it and burn. Iron-Fang is laughing, which is somehow the most frightening part.

objectives.text: Clear the spider hollow of Butcher's carters

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of rogue cultivators
Meet Iron-Fang at the charcoal kilns

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Nets. For me. I haven't been this insulted since the sect brat spared my life. Let's go to the larder. Now. Tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Probably, Zhao Kang. Doesn't change anything.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Iron-Fang) That was cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

quests.title: Bones Like Iron Roads
quests.summary: Before the larder, you sit on the old bandit road and let everything settle: the frozen, the confession, the roads.

objectives.text: Temper your body on the old bandit road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your body remembers the lightning, the pools, the bath. It settles into itself like a road into a valley. Late stage of Body Integration.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You look like you're made of iron. And water. And stubbornness. Mostly stubbornness. Ready? The larder's under the den.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Xiao Shi.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Practical. I like practical.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That makes sense.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's my kind of justice. The quick kind.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, the Third Road's Guard
quests.summary: A pair of rogue cultivators guard the third road's approach, hired muscle who don't know what they're guarding.

objectives.text: Mark the map table at the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Fight off the rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The rogue cultivators have found you first.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the poison marsh
Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Told you, Pei Yuan.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (hiding behind Iron-Fang) Oh.

quests.title: Medicine for the Three Warmed Disciples
quests.summary: The three rescued Iron Scale disciples, though warmed, need medicine before the journey home can begin.

objectives.text: Hear Iron-Fang out

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Look at you. Wearing the sect's robes and the bandit's heart. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The soft-hearted immortal. Still alive. Surprises me every time.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the echo cave. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the echo cave
See Iron-Fang again

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Han Xue's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Works.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Han Xue's Question for Iron-Fang
quests.summary: Han Xue asks Iron-Fang, gently, whether he's told his sister about Willow Creek, if she's ever freed.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. I don't know how. 'I burned your friend's village' isn't a sentence I know how to start. Maybe I'll never have to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The village is grateful. The village is also very nervous. Mostly nervous.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

quests.title: Spirit Wolves, Fed and Slow
quests.summary: The wolves at the den, fed on the Butcher's leavings, are sluggish but must still be cleared before the rescue.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Break the spirit wolves at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the poison marsh
Talk it over with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Qu Wanqing.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (muttering, to Iron-Fang) That was cold.

quests.title: Spirit Stones From the Hide
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's old hide holds a cache of spirit stones, forgotten for twenty years, worth recovering for the rescue effort.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: (grins without warmth) You've been busy. The wrong kind of busy.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The soft-hearted immortal. Still alive. Surprises me every time.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me spirit stones from the spirit spring. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the spirit spring
Return to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: The Tallies, Cross-Referenced
quests.summary: Xiao Shi cross-references the carters' tallies against Wen Shu's memory of the larder's layout.

objectives.text: Scout the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A bored sentry leans over the watchpost railing, straightening hurriedly when he sees your robes.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Twenty-one breathing, and I think I know which cave each one's in. Wen Shu remembers the sound the ice makes. Every cave sounds different.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Ye Wuming. Ye Wuming won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Nets
quests.summary: Zhao Kang keeps one of the Butcher's nets as a trophy, insisting it's the least dignified attack he's ever survived.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A net. They tried to net me. I'm keeping this. I'm hanging it somewhere everyone can see it and laugh at the Butcher forever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Iron-Fang. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the ruined shrine. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Xiao Shi is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the charcoal kilns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

reply.speaker: woodcutter_shu
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

quests.title: Bandits, the Fourth Road
quests.summary: A fourth road, one Iron-Fang had forgotten, turns up guarded by carters moving one last shipment before the raid.

objectives.text: Search the medicine cabinet at the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The medicine cabinet is almost bare. Someone has been emptying it faster than it can be filled.

objectives.text: Stop the Butcher's carters at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Butcher's carters spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Collect wolf fangs around the tiger ridge
Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. Han Xue's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: The bandits left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Letters From the Fourth Road's Cart
quests.summary: The fourth road's cart carries letters between the Butcher and a buyer whose name is written only as 'the Master's hand.'

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me sealed letters from the smugglers' trail.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Find the sealed letters at the smugglers' trail
Go back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (tugging Ye Wuming's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Hermit's Warning
quests.summary: Lan Jue, still recovering from the bamboo, warns that the Butcher fights like he's already won, and that's dangerous.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A man who's already decided he's won fights carelessly and cruelly at once. Don't mistake his calm for weakness.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the giant bamboo grove

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: I'll carry anything heavy. Heavier than a tree, I'll need a friend.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Probably, Hermit. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: Under the Den
quests.summary: Iron-Fang says the larder is under the wolf den, in the caves where the grotto used to open. The Butcher keeps it cold.

objectives.text: See what Iron-Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Under the den. Where the grotto was. The Butcher found the old caves and filled them with void-ice. It's his larder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Bamboo grows faster than I cut. I've made my peace with it. The bamboo hasn't.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Twenty-one breathing, the tallies say. We bring all twenty-one out. Then we find him. Then I say something to him.

objectives.text: Hurry to the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Pelts dry on racks outside the hunter's lodge, and a row of traps hangs by the door like teeth.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the rope bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The rope bridge is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Xiao Shi. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao Arrives
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao arrives at the wolf den with twenty Iron Scale disciples. His people are in that larder.

objectives.text: Hear Ruan Jingtao out

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Twenty of us. Nineteen of the forty are in there, the ledger says. Breathing. I'm going in. I'm not asking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Ye Wuming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Go to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wolf den breathes cold. Frost rims the cave mouth. Deep inside, something hums, like a thousand bees made of ice.

objectives.text: Report back to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father wanted to come. His knees won't manage the cave. He gave me his sword. It's very heavy. I'm going to use it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Ruan Jingtao does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Han Xue.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Larder Guards
quests.summary: The larder's guards are waiting. The Butcher knew you'd come. He wants you here.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Guards at the cave mouth. And ice golems. The Butcher's been preparing. He wants us inside.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Iron-Fang. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Defeat the larder guards at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The larder guards come on in silence.

objectives.text: Finish the ice golems at the tiger ridge
Join Iron-Fang at the giant banyan

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: He wants us inside. So we go inside. That's what bandits call a trap. That's what heroes call Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

quests.title: Rows of Ice
quests.summary: Inside the larder: rows of void-ice, humming, each with a shape inside. Twenty-one are breathing.

objectives.text: Investigate the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rows of purple ice, humming. Inside each, a shape. Iron Scale green. Moon-Well white. Farmers. Twenty-one chests rising, very slowly.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the stream

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Break open the breathing ice

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one the ice cracks. One by one, people fall out, gasping, into Iron Scale arms and Madam Fang's blankets.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Nineteen of ours. All nineteen. And two Moon-Well nuns. And farmers. Twenty-one. All breathing. All going home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Nineteen Who Aren't Breathing
quests.summary: The other nineteen blocks of ice hold people who aren't breathing. The Butcher kept them for fitting. For practice.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: These nineteen are gone. He kept them for practice. For fitting a soul into a body that isn't its own.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: We take them home too. To be buried. Not left for him. Everyone out. Xiao Shi's rule.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I'll sing for them. At the spring. The blossom verse. They deserve compassion more than anyone who's still breathing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nineteen frozen cultivators. Thawing risks their lives; leaving them risks the Butcher using them.

choices.text: Thaw them slowly, whatever it costs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Wait for Elder Hua's order

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Destroy them. It's safer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: The Fitting Room
quests.summary: At the back of the larder, a room with a stone table, and a diagram on the wall: a body, and a soul, and the seams between them.

objectives.text: Search the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the back of the larder, a stone table. On the wall, a diagram drawn in careful red: a body, a soul, and seven points where they meet.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Somebody's been using this place. Recently. Carefully.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Quietly, then.

objectives.text: Study the fitting diagram

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seven points. Seven rungs. The Ladder isn't just for climbing. It's to hold the Patriarch's soul in a body while heaven's lightning tries to burn him out.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Seven anchors, holding him in a stolen body while the lightning burns. Four are gone. He'd only have three now. Would three be enough?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not for a long fitting. For a short one... maybe. Let's not find out. Let's break them all.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The sect never did tame {them}.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Carrying the Frozen Out
quests.summary: Everyone carries someone. Iron Scale disciples, bandits, a hermit, an heir. Twenty-one living, nineteen gone.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone carry someone. Living first. Then the gone. Iron-Fang carries two. Iron-Fang always carries two.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Ye Wuming. Ye Wuming's survived worse.

objectives.text: Carry the frozen out of the larder
Hear what Ruan Jingtao has to say

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: All forty. Out. Living and gone. The Iron Scale remembers who carried them. We'll carve it on Remembering Hill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: No, Ye Wuming. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Butcher's Welcome
quests.summary: As you carry the last of them out, the Butcher's ice golems come to take back what's his.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ice golems! Coming out of the walls! He wants his larder back! He can't have it! It's a cave now! Just a cave!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

objectives.text: Clear the spider hollow of ice golems

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ice golems spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Just a cave. Just a stupid cave. I'm going to have nightmares about that cave. I'm going to write them down. For my great-grandfather.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ah. The kettle can stop worrying. It has been worrying since you left.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Any Iron Scale colours among them? Tell me honestly. I would rather know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

quests.title: Singing for Nineteen
quests.summary: At the spring, the hermit sings for the nineteen who didn't come back breathing. You sit with him.

objectives.text: Sit with the hermit as he sings for the dead

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blossom verse. The hermit's voice is old and steady. Nineteen names, read by Ruan Jingtao, one by one, between verses.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the giant banyan

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Nineteen names. Sung. The Butcher kept their bodies. He never had their names. We keep those now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what the hermit says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue. Now, where was I.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

quests.title: Where the Butcher Went
quests.summary: The Butcher wasn't in his larder. His ledger's last entry says where he's gone: the Abyss rim, to the Master's door.

objectives.text: Head to the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the empty larder, pinned to the fitting table with a cleaver, a note: Gone to wait at the Master's door. Bring the loud one. Wen Tu.

objectives.text: Pull the cleaver from the table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cleaver comes free. It's warm. On its blade, very small, seven notches. Four of them have been scratched out.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Bring the loud one. He wants me at the rim. At his master's door. Good. I'll bring myself. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut it, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: And your heart, while you did it? Still? Or thrashing like a fish?

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Ice Golems, the Larder's Last
quests.summary: A last handful of ice golems, forgotten in the larder's deepest cave, must be cleared before the site is safe.

objectives.text: Free the soul in the soul lantern at the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You open the soul lantern. A breath of cold escapes, and a whisper that sounds like thank you.

objectives.text: Fight off the ice golems

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the echo cave
Share your findings with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's my kind of justice. The quick kind.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Broken Ice
quests.summary: The twenty-one broken blocks of void-ice leave shards worth studying for Elder Bai's ongoing catalogue.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me void shards from the waterwheel. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the waterwheel
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more void shards than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Wen Shu Reunited
quests.summary: Wen Shu, the first disciple rescued, is reunited with the nineteen from Remembering Hill's roll call, and finally weeps.

objectives.text: Read the map table at the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wen Shu says she counted every day in the ice, certain no one was coming. She stops counting today.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the carved buddhas

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Noted, Iron-Fang. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the smugglers' trail

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the forest crossroads

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (hiding behind Han Xue) Oh.

quests.title: Larder Guards, the Retreating Few
quests.summary: A few larder guards, cut off from the main fight, try to slip out through the forest with stolen supplies.

objectives.text: Taste the wine jars at the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tap the wine jars one by one. Full, full, full, and one that answers hollow.

objectives.text: Break the larder guards at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The larder guards have found you first.

objectives.text: Pick up blood lotus near the poison marsh
Tell Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Qu Wanqing.
