objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen bandits: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

quests.title: Spirit Stones From the Fitting Room
quests.summary: The fitting room holds a small store of spirit stones, used to power the diagram's grim purpose, now repurposed for good.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me spirit stones from the spirit spring, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll light the watch lantern for you. If you see it go out, run.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not this time, Pei Yuan.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the spirit spring
Return to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll log it. 'Disciple returned. Victorious. Somewhat muddy.'

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: The Diagram, Copied
quests.summary: Elder Bai, reached by crane, insists the fitting diagram be copied exactly before the cave is sealed, to understand the Ladder fully.

objectives.text: Make your way to the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the woodcutters' camp, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He wants a copy of the worst thing I've ever seen, for research. I understand why. I still don't like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Ruan Hai's Gratitude, by Crane
quests.summary: A crane arrives from Ruan Hai himself, too frail to travel, thanking the sect before his son even returns home.

objectives.text: Hear Ruan Jingtao out

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father's crane got here before I did. He never waits for news. He always trusts it'll be good, now. Since you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Ye Wuming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Worry later, Zhao Kang. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Cave's Echo
quests.summary: An echo of void wraiths lingers in the larder's deepest chamber, feeding on the grief the diagram represents.

objectives.text: Free the soul in the soul lantern at the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pale flame flickers inside the soul lantern, and in the flame, for an instant, a face.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the echo cave

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the echo cave
Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Medicine for the Journey Home
quests.summary: Twenty-one rescued cultivators need medicine and supplies for the journey back to their own sects and villages.

objectives.text: Speak with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the old bandit camp. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the old bandit camp
Go back to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Practical.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Hermit's Second Verse
quests.summary: Lan Jue sings a second verse at the spring, this one for the twenty-one who lived, a counterpart to the nineteen names.

objectives.text: Go and see the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The root verse, for the living. Growth, not grief. Both matter. Both deserve a song. I have three hundred years of songs left to give.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Ruan Jingtao. I asked who would go.

objectives.text: Meet Ruan Jingtao at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Ye Wuming. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It... reconsiders.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the sacred spring

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: To the Rim
quests.summary: Iron-Fang, Ruan Jingtao and you set out for the Abyss rim. The Butcher is waiting at the fold.

objectives.text: Answer Ruan Jingtao's summons

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale comes too. He froze our people. We're going to watch him fall. It's not revenge. It's closure. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: It's a bit revenge. It's fine. A bit revenge is healthy. Ask anyone. Ask the hermit. Don't ask the hermit.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the mushroom ring

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Iron-Fang has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: If anything smells sweet in there, hold your breath. Sweet is how poison says hello.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the hermit) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Sound of Sharpening
quests.summary: At the rim, you can hear it before you see it: the long, patient sound of a cleaver on stone.

objectives.text: Scout the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Down in the canyon, a slow, steady sound: steel on stone, over and over, patient as a heartbeat.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's at the obelisk ring. Sharpening. He's been sharpening for three days, the children say. Waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: And for Iron-Fang. He's very specific. The Butcher is always very specific.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hunted.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: The Butcher's Hands
quests.summary: The Butcher's hands, men in bloody aprons over their armour, hold the bone field.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Aprons over armour. I've seen them before. They came to my old camp, twenty years ago, to buy the dead. I let them in. I let them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Iron-Fang is right.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: (to Iron-Fang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Defeat the butcher's hands at the corpse forest

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards regrouping
Report back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I let them in, once. Never again. Iron-Fang says never again, and means it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Told you, Zhao Kang.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

quests.title: Gu Knew the Butcher
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, has come to the rim again. He knows Wen Tu. He sold him bodies, once.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Wen Tu. I sold him the bodies of the dead from the Qingshi siege. He paid in silver. I sent the silver to the families. I told myself that made it clean.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He weighs everything. Fear especially. Don't be afraid of him. It makes him heavier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not afraid of him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No. I can see that. You're afraid for Iron-Fang. That weighs nothing. That's very good.

objectives.text: Speak with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Ruan Jingtao thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fair. I have my doubts too.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. We're both very proud of that.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the abyss depths. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Seven Notches
quests.summary: At the edge of the obelisk ring, the Butcher's cleavers hang from a rack. Each has seven notches. Five scratched out.

objectives.text: Hurry to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A rack of cleavers stands at the edge of the obelisk ring. On each blade, seven notches. Four scratched out. The fifth half-scratched.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I don't like this. It's too quiet. Quiet means someone is listening.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Then let's be quieter than they were.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I see it too. Let's find out what it means.

objectives.text: Examine the Butcher's cleavers

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fifth notch is his. He's been scratching it out himself, slowly, as if he knows. As if he's already weighed himself.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: He knows he's going to lose. And he's waiting anyway. What kind of person waits to lose?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: One who was built to. The Rungs were children once. Taken. Weighed. Like my children. Like me.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Heh. Knew it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Fold Drips
quests.summary: The fold is leaking again, heavier now, since four Rungs fell. Wraiths spill out around the obelisk ring.

objectives.text: Cleanse the blood altar at the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fold ripples. Purple wraiths drip out of it like rain off a roof, and drift toward the obelisk ring and the sharpening sound.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blood altar pulses like a sick heart. You press the Lotus Key to it, and it goes still.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather the fold's leaking shards
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fold's weaker. Every Rung that falls, it leaks more. When they're all gone, it might just... open.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Iron-Fang. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's either the best news I've heard in years, or the worst. It's both. It's always both.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Weighing Nothing
quests.summary: Before the fight, you sit at the rim and do what Gu said: let your fear for Iron-Fang weigh nothing.

objectives.text: Let your fear weigh nothing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe. The fear is there, but light, like a feather. Your body and soul hold it without effort. It weighs exactly nothing.

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You look calm. Too calm. Don't be calm for my sake. Be angry for my sake. No. Calm. Calm's better. I'm confused.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. No arguing with it.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Wen Tu, the Butcher of Wen
quests.summary: The Fifth Rung puts down his whetstone, picks up his cleaver, and weighs you with his eyes.

objectives.text: Go to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A huge man in a bloody apron stands among the obelisk stumps, cleaver in hand. He looks at you the way a butcher looks at a carcass: fairly.

objectives.name: Wen Tu, the Butcher of Wen
objectives.text: Face Wen Tu, the Butcher of Wen at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: rung_wen
dialogue.text: Wen Tu. Fifth Rung. Meat is meat. I weigh cultivators by the jin. You're very heavy, heir. All that iron in your bones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Weigh me, Butcher. Iron-Fang. Twenty years ago you bought my dead. I'm here to settle the account.

dialogue.speaker: rung_wen
dialogue.text: Ah. The loud one. Two at once. Good. Good. I've already scratched my notch. Let's see if I was right.

objectives.text: Stand over the fallen Butcher

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wen Tu lies among the obelisk stumps. He looks up at Iron-Fang. You were heavier than I weighed, he says. His star goes out.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Account settled. I thought I'd feel something. I feel tired. And hungry. Is that what winning feels like? It's disappointing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Iron-Fang is right.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's followers throw down their weapons and kneel.

choices.text: Let them go home

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring them to face the sect's judgement

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Make an example of them

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Five Stars Out
quests.summary: Five stars out. Two left. The fold ripples, weaker, and for a moment, through it, you see the black gate clearly.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Five out. Two left. Lady Silk, and the one nobody's seen. The Patriarch's own shadow. The Seventh Rung.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Through the fold, just now. The gate. Clearer than ever. It's closer. It's getting closer.

objectives.text: Find Ruan Jingtao at the lava falls

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale will be at the rim when it opens. All of us. Remembering Hill will be empty that day. We'll all be here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: See? Even Ye Wuming agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: The Butcher's Last Ledger
quests.summary: The Butcher kept a last ledger. Every body he ever bought. Every name he ever knew. Iron-Fang wants to read it.

objectives.text: Hear Iron-Fang out

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: His last ledger. Every body. Every name. I want to read it. I want to find my men's names. The ones I let him buy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Iron-Fang does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

objectives.text: Gather the pages of the Butcher's ledger
Bring word to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Eleven of my men. Twenty years ago. Names, here, in his hand. I'm going to carve them somewhere. Somewhere clean.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Butcher's ledger names every buyer. Some are respected elders of other sects.

choices.text: Publish every name

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: No argument here.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Hand it to the alliance court

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blackmail the elders

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Butcher's Hands, the Last Aprons
quests.summary: A last handful of the Butcher's hands, leaderless now, must be cleared from the bone field before the rim is safe.

objectives.text: Check the seals of the sealed coffin at the bone throne

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Paper seals cross the sealed coffin, written in blood gone brown. One of them has been torn and pasted back.

objectives.text: Clear the bone throne of butcher's hands

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These butcher's hands fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Gather demon cores at the bone throne
Tell Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Zhao Kang.

objectives.choice_prompt: The bandits left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Fallen Butcher's Guard
quests.summary: The Butcher's fallen guards leave demon cores behind, worth gathering before the Abyss reclaims the field.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me demon cores from the corpse forest.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Elder Gu is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Pick up demon cores near the corpse forest
See Elder Gu again

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Enough, Iron-Fang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more demon cores than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Tally
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao, methodical like his father, keeps a tally of every name recovered from every Rung's fall so far.

objectives.text: Go and see Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Nineteen from the larder, eleven from the ledger, and the ones from the wall of names. Someone should add them all up eventually. Not today.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the black barracks

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the black barracks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Han Xue's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Han Xue is right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Rim's Weakened Watch
quests.summary: With the fold leaking more since the Butcher's fall, a weakened watch of blood guards is easily driven back.

objectives.text: Study the map table at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Guards come on in silence.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the watch spire
Compare notes with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: We're done at the chain bridge. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Told you, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (grinning at Iron-Fang) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Weeping Fold
quests.summary: The fold, weaker with each fallen Rung, sheds more void shards than ever, worth gathering for study.

objectives.text: Answer Ye Wuming's summons

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Bring me void shards from the obsidian spires. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Find the void shards at the obsidian spires
Return to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Ye Wuming) That was cold.

quests.title: Gu's Accounting
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, given a page of the Butcher's ledger, cross-references it against his own memory of who he sold and when.

objectives.text: Investigate the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the deep mine shaft not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Examine the chain anchor

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You test the chain anchor. It holds, groaning, and rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Show Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Three names here I sold him myself. I didn't know they'd end up frozen. I told myself silver was enough. It was never enough.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hm. Clean work. I'd have been faster. Not by much.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Mercy. I forgot how it looks.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Question About Weighing
quests.summary: Zhao Kang asks Han Xue, half-joking, half not, how heavy she thinks his own fear would weigh on the Butcher's scale.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Would I have weighed heavy? Light? I need to know if I'm brave or just loud.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Both. You're both. It's not a competition, Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Hear what Ruan Jingtao has to say

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Zhao Kang. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Ruan Jingtao, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the seal stones

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Ye Wuming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Ring's Aftermath
quests.summary: The obelisk ring, disturbed by the Butcher's fall, sheds a final cluster of void wraiths before settling.

objectives.text: Search the sulphur vents

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ground near the sulphur vents is warm and crusted yellow. It crunches like old sugar.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the sulphur vents

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Void wraiths spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the sulphur vents
Talk it over with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Ye Wuming. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Letters From the Cleaver Rack
quests.summary: Behind the rack of notched cleavers, more letters turn up, addressed to Rungs who never got to read them.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me sealed letters from the beast pens.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the beast pens
Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Quiet Hour
quests.summary: Before carving the names, Iron-Fang asks for one quiet hour alone at the rim, and everyone, without being asked, gives it to him.

objectives.text: See what Iron-Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Just an hour. To think about eleven men and what I owe them. Then I'll carve. Then I'll be loud again. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Ye Wuming. Ye Wuming's survived worse.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Iron-Fang.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the obsidian spires

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Elder Gu is right.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

quests.title: Carving Names
quests.summary: Iron-Fang carves eleven names on a flat stone at the rim, above the fold. It takes all night. Nobody helps. Nobody leaves.

objectives.text: Hear Iron-Fang out

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Eleven names. Carved. Above the fold. When it opens, they'll be the first thing anyone sees. That's something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Probably, Ku the Broker. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. This one's paid. Now there's just my sister. Get strong. Get stronger. Break the last two.

objectives.text: Join Elder Gu at the palace of the elders

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Doctor's Orders
quests.summary: Elder Hua has prescribed rest. A whole week. She has written it on a scroll and pinned it to your door.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Rest. One week. Written, sealed, pinned to your door. Doctor's orders. The last stage of integration is being a person in your body.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Mind the smoke from the east kilns. It's thicker than it looks and ruder than it smells.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a weapon. Not a key. A person. Eat. Sleep. Walk. Let your friends be annoying. That's the medicine.

objectives.text: Head to the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The herb terraces are green and ordinary. Somewhere a bird is singing badly. For once, nothing is on fire.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says I have to make sure you rest. I'm going to follow you everywhere. With soup. And a hat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Xiao Man, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Sect Master. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Being a Person
quests.summary: Being a person turns out to be harder than being a weapon. Everyone has opinions about how to do it.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Being a person? Easy. Eat. Nap. Eat again. Complain about the weather. Eat. That's the whole technique.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Zhong Ming.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Being a person means letting people be rude to you and being rude back. It's very relaxing. Try it. You're terrible at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: See? Even Tang Ling agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Zhao Kang says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Being a person means sitting still without planning anything. I can't do it either. Let's not do it together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: A Picnic at the Pond
quests.summary: Xiao Man organises a picnic at the lotus pond, under Elder Mo's peach trees. The whole sect comes. Nothing is on fire.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Man's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (bows three times, then a fourth to be safe) {senior}! Sorry. You're very high up now. It's hard not to bow.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: A picnic! Under the peach trees! By the green lotus! Everyone's invited! Nobody's allowed to talk about Rungs!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's been feeding me since dawn. Please rescue me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're too thin! Thin brothers get cold!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Gather peaches from Elder Mo's orchard
Lay out the picnic beneath the peach trees

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole sect on the grass by the pond. The green lotus. The first peaches from Elder Mo's saplings. Nobody talks about Rungs for three hours.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The first peaches. From his trees. Elder Hua cried. Wei Tong cried. I cried. The carp looked very embarrassed for all of us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Liu Er. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Teaching the Twelve
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve are not so new any more. They want you to teach them what an integrated body can do. Carefully.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My twelve want a lesson. From you. Integrated body. Carefully. Qiu Hua has a new chicken. Don't hit the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Liu Er. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Teach Wei Tong's twelve with the puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: More training puppets? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You hit a puppet and it didn't break, it just... sat down. Politely. How do you make a puppet sit down politely?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Liu Er said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Liu Er) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Hermit's Lecture
quests.summary: The hermit gives his first full lecture on the Heart Sutra in the pagoda. The whole sect squeezes in. Bai weeps.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root: patience. Stem: forgiveness. Blossom: compassion. I reached the blossom in a bamboo forest, fighting a hollow man. Take notes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The hermit is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The sutra says a body is a lotus: it grows in mud and isn't stained. You're all very muddy. That's the point.

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Three hundred disciples in my pagoda. Listening to the Verdant Lotus sutra. My grandmother would have fainted. I'm going to faint.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Yan Tie is not wrong. Yan Tie is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Gift
quests.summary: Thunder Peak has carved your name on the lightning forge. Yan Tie wants you to see it, and bring back a stone from it.

objectives.text: See what Yan Tie wants

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your name! On the forge! First name we've ever carved! Bring back a stone from the forge for your room! Thunder Peak insists!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

objectives.text: Gather a stone from the lightning forge
Report back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: It hums! The forge stone hums! It'll hum on your windowsill forever! Thunder Peak thinks that's a very good present!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Yan Tie will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You did it! I knew you would. The carp knew too. They told me. With bubbles.

objectives.choice_prompt: The humming forge stone was chipped from Thunder Peak's sacred anvil without their elders' leave.

choices.text: Return it quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Keep it. It was a gift.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Sell it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (hiding behind Yan Tie) Oh.

quests.title: Visitors From Nothing
quests.summary: On the sixth day of rest, void wraiths come up the back path. Elder Hua says fighting counts as rest if you enjoy it.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Hua out

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Wraiths on the back path. Go. Fighting counts as rest if you enjoy it. Enjoy it. That's an order from your doctor.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Two leaves and a bud, disciple. Take only what you need, whatever you're picking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Listen to Auntie Ruo. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Ring the alarm at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings over the sea of clouds. On the hidden path, purple shapes pause, then keep climbing, slower now, less sure.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

objectives.text: Hold the inner sect gate against more void wraiths
Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was relaxing. Was it relaxing? I think it was. I'm learning to be a person. It's very violent.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Tang Ling.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Zhao Kang) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Gift
quests.summary: The Sect Master gives you something on the last day of rest: a key to the main hall. Nobody but her has ever had one.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A key. To the main hall. Nobody but the sect master has ever had one. Now you do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Elder Hua. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Not because you'll be sect master. Because you'll need somewhere quiet, one day, and I want you to have it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, I don't know what to say.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Say nothing. That's what the main hall is for. Nothing, in quiet. Go and try it.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Thunder Wolves, a Friendly Visit
quests.summary: Rumble and his pack visit the sect gate, drawn by the smell of Wei Tong's picnic leftovers.

objectives.text: Read the rim of the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the rim of the bronze ding by touch. It lists the names of those who made an oath around it.

objectives.text: Defeat the thunder wolves at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The thunder wolves spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Pick up incense bundles near the sect gate
Share your findings with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the ancestral tombs isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for Elder Hua's Rest Kit
quests.summary: Elder Hua assembles a proper rest kit for future integration cases, and asks for the right herbs to fill it.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the medicine valley
Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Old Qiu's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Bai Ling's New Course
quests.summary: Inspired by the hermit's lecture, Bai Ling proposes a new pagoda course: comparative sutra studies, taught by both scholars.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Bai's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The hermit and I, co-teaching. Verdant Lotus and Azure Cloud sutras, side by side. I've never been more excited about a syllabus.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

objectives.text: Talk with Liu Er at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Liu Er is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: See? Even Tang Ling agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Seventh Day
quests.summary: A last wave of void wraiths tests the sect on the seventh day of rest, weaker than the sixth, easily turned back.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill furnace breathes out heat like a sleeping beast. Inside, a batch of pills turns slowly in the glow.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the outer dormitories
Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Old Bao?

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Elder Bai) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find a book with turtle soup stains on it, it's mine. Return it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Irregular! Marvellously irregular. Unrecordable, even.

quests.title: Incense for the Main Hall's Key
quests.summary: Before receiving the key, tradition asks for incense lit at the hall's threshold, a small rite Elder Hua insists on.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me incense bundles from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Zhong Ming said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

objectives.text: Recover incense bundles from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
See Wei Tong again

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

objectives.choice_prompt: The incense bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Right. That works.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Liu Er's Quiet Question
quests.summary: Liu Er, visiting during the rest week, asks quietly whether being a person ever stops feeling like homework.

objectives.text: Make your way to the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the mission hall the air changes, heavy with qi and something older underneath.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Wei Tong makes it look easy. Is it ever easy? Or does everyone just get better at pretending?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Both, a little. You'll see.
