dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Ignore Fan Rui. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to Liu Er) That was amazing.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Nine Peaches
quests.summary: Xiao Man corrects the record: it wasn't nine peaches, it was eleven, and she has the pits to prove it.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Eleven! I counted the pits! Wei Tong's exaggerating downward for once! Somebody give him a medal for modesty!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the scholar rock. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Xiao Shi, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the spirit peach orchard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Take a cup first. Tea steadies the hand and cools the head.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: No, Auntie Ruo. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

quests.title: Training Puppets, the Twelve's Final Exam
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve face a final exam against the puppets before he'll call them properly trained.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Clear the training ground of training puppets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The training puppets come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Old Bao says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to the hermit, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Medicine for the Rest Week's End
quests.summary: Elder Hua restocks the infirmary before the rest week ends, expecting everyone to immediately overdo it again.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (guarded) {player}. People are saying things. I'm not asking. Yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Liu Er. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the medicine valley
Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about food, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about your clan, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Elder Yan's Farewell Shout
quests.summary: Elder Yan gives a farewell shout to the rest week itself, personifying it as a worthy opponent now defeated.

objectives.text: Hear Yan Tie out

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Rest week! You tried to make us sit still! You LOST! Thunder Peak returns to shouting at full volume starting NOW!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Old Qiu. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Han Xue. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Man. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The carp know my name now. They're very polite about it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: One Body, One Soul
quests.summary: In the quiet of the main hall, with the founder's tablet and the faded green lotus beside it, integration completes.

objectives.text: Meditate in stillness on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: No lightning. No pain. Only breath, and a body that is entirely yours, and a soul that fills it to the edges. Great Perfection of Void Refinement.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feel everyone on the mountain, faintly, the way you feel your own fingers. That, the hermit says later, is the start of Body Integration.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Great Perfection. Hua says you rested well. Wei Tong says you ate nine peaches. Both, apparently, count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Elder Bai has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: What Comes Next
quests.summary: Qing Luan's last crane before the isles sealed said something you only now understand: the next stage isn't yours alone.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Body Integration. Not only your body: everyone's. A stage you can't reach alone. You carry others, and they carry you. It's the sutra's blossom, as a realm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Lady Silk is the next Rung. She spins webs between people. Between sects. The answer to a web is not a sword. It's a vehicle.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A vehicle. All the sects, together. The Iron Scale, the Zhao clan, the Moon-Well, Qingshi. That's what she'll try to cut. Let's not let her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Hermit. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Not Alone
quests.summary: The Sect Master stands on the formation plaza and says something no Azure Cloud master has said in three hundred years.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When the fold opens, we cannot march alone. Three hundred years ago we had the Verdant Lotus. Now we need everyone.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'm calling a conclave. Every orthodox sect. On our mountain. The first in three centuries. Lu Ping, prepare the cranes.

objectives.text: Activate the seal at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The formation glows under the Sect Master's feet. Every disciple on the plaza goes very quiet, and then starts talking at once.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the lines of the seal with your qi until they glow clean.

objectives.text: Join Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Cranes! Hundreds of cranes! I've never folded hundreds of cranes! I've folded eleven, and three of them flew into walls!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Wei Tong. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: The Hermit Explains the Body of Many
quests.summary: The hermit explains the next realm over tea in the pagoda. It's not what you expected.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Body Integration. The body of many. Every realm before this was about you. Your qi, your core, your soul, your body. This one isn't.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One day I'll think of a comeback. Today is not that day.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You carry others. Their hopes, their fears, their weight. And they carry you. You can't reach it alone. You never could.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: How do I cultivate carrying people?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You carry them. Literally, sometimes. Start small. Start with the ones already on your back.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Sect Master. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Paper for a Thousand Cranes
quests.summary: Lu Ping needs paper for a thousand cranes. Elder Bai's pagoda has paper. Elder Bai has conditions.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Paper! For cranes! From my pagoda! My good paper! ...For a conclave of sects. Fine. Take it. Take the second-best paper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Xiao Shi has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

objectives.text: Gather crane paper from the pagoda
Meet Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Second-best paper. Still better than anything I've ever folded. I'm going to fold my best crane ever. It's going to fly perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Shi. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (hiding behind Lu Ping) Oh.

quests.title: Folding a Thousand Cranes
quests.summary: Everyone on the mountain folds cranes. Some are beautiful. Wei Tong's look like dumplings. They fly anyway.

objectives.text: Scout the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole sect sits on the plaza folding paper cranes. Children, elders, the hermit, the Sect Master. Wei Tong's cranes look like dumplings.

objectives.text: Breathe life into the thousand cranes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe qi into the pile. A thousand paper cranes rise, circle the mountain once, and scatter east, west, north and south.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My dumpling cranes flew! They flew! One of them flew into Elder Bai. He kept it. He said it was the most honest crane he's ever met.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Wei Tong's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Carrying Wei Tong
quests.summary: The hermit said start with the ones already on your back. Wei Tong volunteers. Literally. He wants to be carried.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Carrying people? Start with me! Carry me around the training ground! I carried you once, when the wolf king got me! Your turn!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

objectives.text: Fight the puppets while carrying Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Faster! Left! There's a puppet on the left! I'm very heavy! I've been eating for this moment all week!

objectives.text: Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You carried me and fought four puppets. I'm going to tell everyone. I'm going to tell my twelve. I'm going to tell the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Tang Ling. Tang Ling won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Wei Tong) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (hiding behind Wei Tong) Oh.

quests.title: What Everyone Carries
quests.summary: You ask people what they carry. Everyone has an answer, and none of them are small.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What do I carry? Frost Sword Peak. Thirty disciples who think I'm frightening. I am. It's on purpose. It keeps them alive.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Xiao Shi.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I carry the map. And the cages. And my sister, who carries everyone. I'm getting better at carrying her back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Xiao Shi thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Han Xue.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Every patient I've ever lost. And forty years of peaches. The peaches are lighter.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A disciple confesses he hates carrying anyone but himself.

choices.text: Tell him that's honest, and it's fine

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Remind him of the sect's oath

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

choices.text: Tell him the weak deserve no carrying

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (stops mixing) I don't have a pill for that, {player}.

quests.title: Wraiths Follow the Cranes
quests.summary: Some of the cranes are followed. Void wraiths slip out of rifts and drift after them like moths.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Wraiths following the cranes! They want to eat the invitations! I'm not letting a wraith eat my great-grandfather's invitation!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Shi. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

objectives.text: Ward the cranes' flight path from the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises over the cliff like a shield. The cranes fly through it. The wraiths don't.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: All the cranes made it out. Every single one. Even the dumpling ones. Especially the dumpling ones. They're very determined.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Han Xue. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Carrying the Mountain
quests.summary: The hermit asks you to sit on the formation and feel the whole mountain at once. Every person on it.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit on the formation. Feel everyone on the mountain. Every breath. Not to watch them. To hold them. Gently.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Xiao Shi has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

objectives.text: Feel everyone on the mountain at once

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three thousand breaths, all at once. Wei Tong snoring. Xiao Man humming. The Sect Master worrying. You hold them, and they're light.

objectives.text: Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You're smiling. Everyone who first feels it smiles. Then they cry. Then they get up and carry things. That's Body Integration.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Elder Bai. We were attentive.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the hermit) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: The First Answers
quests.summary: The first cranes come back within a week. Every sect you've ever helped has answered.

objectives.text: Go and see Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Answers! From the Iron Scale! The Zhao clan! The Moon-Well! Qingshi's yamen! And... sects I've never heard of! Dozens!

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Lu Ping is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The Silk Pavilion. The Cinder Cloud. The Hundred Wells. I didn't even know there were that many sects. There are loads!

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone's coming. Everyone we've helped, and everyone who heard we helped. You did this. You said yes too often.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Deacon Shen. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That is the sect I want. Thank you for being it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Second Flight
quests.summary: A second wave of cranes needs escorting, and a fresh batch of void wraiths tries to follow them.

objectives.text: Hurry to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The long refectory smells of rice, ginger and a hundred disciples who trained since dawn.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the outer pines
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Tang Ling. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (beaming at Han Xue) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

quests.title: Incense for the Conclave Tents
quests.summary: Steward Qian prepares incense for every guest tent, insisting a good host thinks of comfort before politics.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me incense bundles from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall, would you?

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The hermit is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

objectives.text: Find the incense bundles at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Well? Is it true what they're saying? Which part? All the parts. I need all the parts.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The incense bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind the hermit) Oh.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Guest List Anxiety
quests.summary: Wei Tong, put in charge of guest lodging, panics gently about where to seat sects who dislike each other.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale and the Zhao clan don't get along. Neither do the Moon-Well and half the smaller sects. Where do I even put everyone?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore the Sect Master. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Sect Master looks tired. More tea?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your tea could wake the dead, hermit. Not tonight.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhao Kang. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, Testing the Roads
quests.summary: Demon cultivators test the mountain roads ahead of the conclave, probing for a way to disrupt the gathering.

objectives.text: Go to the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great bronze cauldron smoulders. Someone has written 'donations welcome' on it in chalk.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the mountain road
Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The stone bridge is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Splendid. A footnote in history, at the very least. Possibly a whole paragraph.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. Elder Bai's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the Welcome Feast
quests.summary: Elder Hua and Madam Fang, working together for once, need spirit herbs for a welcome feast worthy of every sect.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Xiao Shi said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs at the medicine valley
Return to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Bai Ling's Seating Chart
quests.summary: Bai Ling, delighted to have a real logistics problem, draws up an elaborate seating chart based on old alliances.

objectives.text: Investigate the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit beast garden smells of hay and ozone. Something in the far pen is chewing on a thunderbolt.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I've mapped every feud back three generations! Nobody sits next to an old enemy! This is the best project I've ever had!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Answer Lu Ping, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Lu Ping's Best Crane
quests.summary: Lu Ping proudly shows off the one crane he folded perfectly, insisting it be the one that carries the Sect Master's personal invitation.

objectives.text: See what Lu Ping wants

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: This one. My best one. It's going to the Zhao clan patriarch himself. I practiced folding it forty times.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Ling Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang's scared. Look, his ears are red.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My ears are red because it's cold, you boiled dumpling.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's cheating. Brilliant cheating. Teach me later.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Training Puppets, Hollowed by Nerves
quests.summary: A training puppet, left unattended amid the conclave prep chaos, gets accidentally reactivated by a nervous disciple.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You close your hand on the hilt of the sword in the stone. It hums, weighs you, and decides to stay where it is.

objectives.text: Defeat the training puppets at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The training puppets have found you first.

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the outer dormitories
Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Old Bao?

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Jade Slips for the Conclave's Record
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants every word of the coming conclave recorded on jade slips, insisting history deserves accuracy.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Hua out

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me jade slips from the laundry stream.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Noted, Deacon Shen. Overruled, but noted.

objectives.text: Collect jade slips around the laundry stream
Go back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Recorded, sealed and posted. Three hundred points, and my personal nod.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the jade slips you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

quests.title: Han Xue's Worry About Crowds
quests.summary: Han Xue, more comfortable with thirty disciples than three hundred strangers, admits the conclave makes her nervous.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I know how to protect thirty people I know. I don't know how to protect everyone who's about to show up. That scares me more than wraiths.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Han Xue, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Sect Master.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Fan Rui. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. The hermit does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Han Xue?

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Body Integration
quests.summary: On the eve of the conclave, with every answer in, the hermit asks you to sit at the pond and carry them all at once.

objectives.text: Go and see the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Every answer. Every sect. Every person who said yes because you said yes first. Carry them. All of them. Tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The hermit has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Gather the returned cranes by the pond
Carry every sect in your cultivation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale, Zhao, Moon-Well, Qingshi, and dozens more. You carry them all, and they carry you. It's the lightest you've ever felt.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside you the green lotus opens wider than it ever has. Beneath the water, something like a vehicle made of light begins to take shape.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Body Integration

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The clouds cover the whole sky. Every bolt that falls will test whether your body is truly one thing.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Body Integration. A body of many. The first in the Azure Cloud since the founder. Tomorrow the sects arrive. Carry them well.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Tang Ling. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Green Banners Again
quests.summary: The Iron Scale arrive first. This time, the green banners bow at the gate.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Green banners! The Iron Scale! They're bowing! At the gate! The Iron Scale doesn't bow! I'm going to faint on my own boots!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Sect Master Ruan. And the time before.

objectives.text: Search the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale green fills the processional way. At the gate, Ruan Hai stops, and bows. Every Iron Scale disciple behind him bows too.

objectives.text: Hear what Sect Master Ruan has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale answers. Remembering Hill sends its greetings. We brought tea. The good tea. For the Cinder Peak incident.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Father insisted on the tea. He's been practising his bow for a week. Don't tell him it was slightly crooked.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Zhao Clan Arrives in Gold
quests.summary: The Zhao clan arrives in gold palanquins. Zhao Kang pretends not to be waiting at the gate. He's been there since dawn.

objectives.text: Report to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan answers. With gold, naturally. And with three hundred disciples, and my great-grandson's monthly letters, framed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Framed? You framed my letters? The one about the dumplings? The one where I said 'love'?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Especially that one. It's in the ancestral hall. Next to your brother's stone.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...I need a moment. Behind the gate. Alone. Don't follow me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Ancestor Zhao. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: The Moon-Well Arrives Singing
quests.summary: The Moon-Well Nunnery comes up the steps singing. The girl from the cage, Lian, leads the song.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well answers. We sing on the steps. Lian's idea. So we know we're here. It's become a tradition. Traditions start small.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Lu Ping. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Abbess Jing's sleeve) Is that allowed?

objectives.text: Test the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A young nun with bright eyes bows to you. Lian. She doesn't say anything. She sings one line of the song, only for you, and walks on.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rust flakes from the sword in the stone as you touch it. The blade beneath is still bright, and still sharp.

quests.title: Space for Everyone
quests.summary: Steward Qian needs somewhere to put two thousand guests. The mountain has flat stones. Not enough.

objectives.text: See what Steward Qian wants

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Two thousand guests! Where do I put them? The plaza? The terraces? The roof? I've put forty on the roof! It's a very nice roof!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue, but it's cultivator's work.

objectives.text: Mark out camp spaces across the plaza
Report back to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Everyone has a flat stone. Some of them have flat stones on the roof. Nobody's complained. Well, the Zhao clan complained. Politely.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Fair. Fair's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Who Goes First
quests.summary: The Cinder Cloud and the Hundred Wells argue about who should enter the main hall first. The argument becomes a brawl.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Cinder Cloud and the Hundred Wells are fighting! About who goes through the door first! It's a very big door! They could both fit!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you have crumbs on your sword.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're lucky crumbs. Dumpling likes them.

objectives.text: Separate the brawling sect disciples

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Rowdy sect disciples ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You carried two brawling disciples off the training ground, one under each arm. They're friends now. They bonded over being carried.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Ruan Jingtao. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: The two brawling sects look to you to say who enters the main hall first.

choices.text: The smallest sect first

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: By seniority, as tradition says

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Whoever pays the most

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: The Silk Pavilion
quests.summary: A small sect nobody has heard of arrives last: the Silk Pavilion. Its envoy is a woman in pink silk who smiles at everyone.

objectives.text: Head to the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A single palanquin of pink silk arrives at the gate. The woman who steps out is beautiful, gracious, and bows to everyone, including the gate.

objectives.text: Read the Silk Pavilion's credentials

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Credentials in perfect order. A small sect, far to the south. Envoy: Lady Si Rou. The seal is flawless. It is almost too flawless.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Lady Si Rou. She smiled at me. Nobody smiles at me. I'm frightening on purpose. I'm going to watch her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ruan Jingtao. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Wraiths at the Camp
quests.summary: Two thousand guests means two thousand people who might grieve, fear, or hope. The wraiths come to feed.

objectives.text: Speak with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Wraiths in the Iron Scale camp! We've fought them before! On Remembering Hill! We know how! Kind of!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: What Deacon Shen said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the long stone stairway
See Ruan Jingtao again

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Iron Scale and Azure Cloud, fighting side by side. Again. It's becoming a habit. A good habit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Ruan Jingtao) That was cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: The Night Before the Conclave
quests.summary: On the night before the conclave, the whole mountain is lit by two thousand lanterns, and nobody sleeps.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Two thousand guests. Forty sects. One mountain. Tomorrow I have to speak to all of them. I've never been so frightened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you've faced the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. The Sect Master is right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ruan Jingtao. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon doesn't ask questions after your speech. Forty sect masters do. Sit with me. Don't say anything. Carry me a bit.

objectives.text: Talk with Ruan Jingtao at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the outer sect hall. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Ruan Jingtao. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

objectives.text: Find Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the contribution pavilion.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Deacon Shen. I asked who would go.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Lanterns for Forty Sects
quests.summary: Every sect hangs a lantern on the formation's nine pillars. Forty colours. It's the most beautiful thing on the mountain.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Forty lanterns! On nine pillars! Some pillars have five! The Zhao clan's is gold! Of course it's gold!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Carry the forty sects' lanterns
Hang the last lantern on the ninth pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty lanterns on nine pillars. Blue, green, gold, white, pink. The formation glows beneath them, and the mountain looks like a festival of stars.

objectives.text: Join Abbess Jing at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Forty sects. Three hundred years of quarrels. One mountain of lanterns. Whatever happens tomorrow, tonight was worth it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Wei Tong has earned the right to say it.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Rowdy Disciples, a Second Brawl
quests.summary: The Cinder Cloud and Hundred Wells, now friends, accidentally start a second brawl with a third sect over lantern placement.

objectives.text: Open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Clear the Hundred-Chi Waterfall of rowdy sect disciples

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rowdy sect disciples spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Medicine for the Camp's Minor Injuries
quests.summary: Two thousand guests and one lantern-hanging festival produce a steady trickle of minor injuries for Elder Hua to treat.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhong Ming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the medicine valley
Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Old Grudge, Set Down
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao finds Zhao Kang at the lantern-hanging and formally apologizes for the coldness between their sects at the banners.

objectives.text: Find Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I was cold to you, at the banners. Pride, mostly. Remembering Hill taught me pride is expensive. I'm sorry, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Ruan Jingtao said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lu Ping.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Apology accepted. Also, help me carry this lantern, it's heavier than it looks.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Zhao Kang says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.text: Hear what Lu Ping has to say

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Give me an hour.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's going in my stories. The good ones.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Camp's Second Night
