quests.summary: A second wave of wraiths tests the crowded camp, drawn by the mix of hope and old grief among two thousand strangers.

objectives.text: Check the notice board at the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Most of the notice board is chores and grudges. One slip, pinned upside down, is meant for someone who knows to look.

objectives.text: Fight off the void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The void wraiths come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the outer pines
Tell Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Well done. I don't say that often. Ask my son. Actually, don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Formation's Extra Load
quests.summary: Powering forty lanterns on nine pillars strains the formation, and Steward Qian asks for more spirit stones to compensate.

objectives.text: See what Lu Ping wants

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Listen to Sect Master Ruan. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the spirit peach orchard
Go back to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Excellent. I shall mention you in my monthly letter. It is very long. You'll be in paragraph nine.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha. Ancestor Zhao's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

quests.title: Lady Si Rou's Twelfth Visit
quests.summary: Han Xue tracks Lady Si Rou to a twelfth camp, the smallest sect present, and watches what she says there.

objectives.text: Make your way to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rolls out of the refectory kitchens. Somewhere inside, a ladle strikes a pot like a gong.

objectives.text: Examine the bronze ding

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense smoke curls out of the bronze ding. Beneath the ash, something that is not incense glints.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She didn't cause an argument this time. She just asked questions. About alliances. About who trusts whom. She's mapping us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Han Xue) That was cold.

quests.title: Lian's Second Song
quests.summary: Lian, the young nun, sings a second time, this time for the whole mountain, and even the Zhao clan patriarch stops talking.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lian's voice carries over two thousand lanterns and forty sects. For one song, nobody argues. Nobody plots. Everyone just listens.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Fan Rui. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the ancestral tombs

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.text: Find Sect Master Ruan at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Sect Master Ruan said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Scales do not rust. Neither do grudges. I am trying to let mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Sect Master Ruan asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: Iron Scale Disciples, Testing the New Recruits
quests.summary: A friendly sparring match between Iron Scale disciples and Wei Tong's twelve turns rowdier than intended.

objectives.text: Stoke the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Break the Iron Scale disciples at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale disciples spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the outer pines
Show Steward Qian what you found

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Well done. I don't say that often. Ask my son. Actually, don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is not a well. It is a very small cup.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Iron Scale disciples is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: Incense for the Sect Master's Speech
quests.summary: Yun Zhi asks for incense lit at the main hall before tomorrow's speech, a small steadying ritual before the biggest one of her life.

objectives.text: Hear Sect Master Ruan out

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Bring me incense bundles from the laundry stream. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll prove you wrong. Politely.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly. I am too old for riddles and too tired for lies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Find the incense bundles at the laundry stream
Report back to Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Abbess Jing says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Rehearsal
quests.summary: Late at night, Yun Zhi rehearses her speech to an audience of exactly one: you, sitting quietly, carrying her the way she asked.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me if it's terrible.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's not terrible. It's honest. That's better.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Fan Rui?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Honest. Yes. Let's go with honest. I don't have the energy left to be anything else.

objectives.text: Join Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Wei Tong. The immortal always is. Mostly.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Sect Master. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Pink at the Edges
quests.summary: Late at night, Han Xue finds you. She's been watching Lady Si Rou. She has something to show you.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Lady Si Rou. She visited eleven camps tonight. Eleven. She smiled at everyone. And after each visit, someone started arguing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Iron Scale with Zhao. Moon-Well with Cinder Cloud. Always after she left. I'm going to keep watching. You keep carrying.

objectives.text: Scout the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Disciples crowd the mission hall's boards, arguing over which chores pay the most contribution for the least mud.

objectives.text: Hear what Lu Ping has to say

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: We're done at the drum tower. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ignore Ruan Jingtao. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (muttering, to Lu Ping) That was cold.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Abbess's Test
quests.summary: Abbess Jing has a condition for the Moon-Well's support: a week of service, anonymous, in the town below.

objectives.text: Answer Abbess Jing's summons

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well will stand with you. On one condition. A week in Qingshi. Serving the poor. Nobody may know who you are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Great Vehicle is carrying people who don't know your name. Anyone can carry people who cheer.

objectives.text: Check the notice board at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You walk into Qingshi in a plain grey robe, hood up. The gate guard doesn't look twice. It's the strangest feeling in the world.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Slips flutter on the notice board, three deep. Under a request for firewood, one note is newer, and written in a hurry.

objectives.text: Meet Madam Fang at the bell pavilion

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: A new dishwasher? Iron-Fang needs help. He's getting old. Don't tell him I said that. What's your name? No name? Fine. Dishes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Scholar Ouyang.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Dishes at the Drunken Crane
quests.summary: Your first task: dishes, at the Drunken Crane, beside Iron-Fang, who doesn't recognise you with your hood up.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: New dishwasher? Good. Stack them by size. Rinse twice. Don't talk. Dishwashing is a sacred silence.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Worry later, Liu Er. Move now.

objectives.text: Wash the Drunken Crane's dishes
Bring word to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You're good. Very good. Where'd you learn? ...Wait. I know that stance. Sect brat? No. Don't tell me. I won't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Water for the Well
quests.summary: Widow Liu is too old to carry all the water now. A hooded stranger offers to help.

objectives.text: Find Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Help? From a stranger? Well. My arms aren't what they were. Twenty buckets to the old houses on the hill. Thank you, stranger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Not now, Iron-Fang. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

objectives.text: Talk with Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You carry water the way someone I know carries it. Straight-backed. ...I won't ask. Heaven keeps its accounts. So do I.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Rogues in the Poor Quarter
quests.summary: Rogue cultivators are shaking down the poor quarter. The hooded dishwasher happens to be passing.

objectives.text: Hurry to the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the back alley, three rogues are taking coppers from an old man who hasn't got any. The old man is crying. The rogues are laughing.

objectives.text: Stop the rogue cultivators at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The rogue cultivators have found you first.

objectives.text: Return the stolen coppers
Talk it over with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Someone beat three rogues in the back alley and gave all the coppers back. A stranger in grey. Nobody knows who. I'm writing it down as 'grey'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Will there be a report? A written one? With dates? I love a report with dates.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogues you beat were disciples once, expelled for being poor.

choices.text: Give them work and a second chance

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Kindly done. The town remembers kindness.

choices.text: Hand them to the constable

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Recruit them as your own enforcers

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Rice for the Hill Houses
quests.summary: The old houses on the hill have no rice this winter. The guild warehouse has plenty. Merchant Jin has a new policy.

objectives.text: See what Merchant Jin wants

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Rice for the hill houses? The guild has a new policy. Anyone who asks gets rice. It's a terrible policy. I love it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Madam Fang.

objectives.text: Open the guild's rice sacks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sacks of rice, stamped with the guild's seal and a new mark underneath: a small lotus, in green. Jin's added it. Nobody asked him to.

objectives.text: See Merchant Jin again

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The lotus? It's for... someone. Who saved the town. Who I nearly sold. Carry the rice, stranger. Don't ask about the lotus.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Anything on the far bank? Lanterns? Faces? I still dream about the lanterns.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: Liu Er Doesn't Recognise You
quests.summary: Liu Er is home on leave. He's teaching the town children to stand straight. He asks the hooded stranger to demonstrate.

objectives.text: Hear Liu Er out

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Stranger! Can you stand straight? Show the children? Like this. Back straight. A crooked spine makes a crooked meridian. My teacher's teacher said that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Like this?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Exactly like that. Perfect. You stand like... never mind. You stand very well, stranger. Thank you.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing at the City God temple

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: Wipe your feet when you come back. Heroes track in the worst mud.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Listen to Matron Bi. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Join Madam Fang at the brewery

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Not now, Huo Da. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Madam Fang offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Night in the Poor Quarter
quests.summary: Wraiths come to the poor quarter at night, where people are cold and afraid and have given up. The stranger in grey is there.

objectives.text: Speak with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Shades in the old houses! Drawn to the cold ones! The poor ones! Someone ring the bell!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Iron-Fang. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Ring the dock bell to wake the quarter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Lamps flare in the old houses. People come out, and a hooded stranger stands between them and the purple dark.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the execution ground

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Return to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The stranger in grey. Standing in the street all night. Nobody knows who. I know who. I'm not saying. Forty years. I can keep a secret.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Qingshi owes you again. I'm running out of ways to write that in the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Magistrate Zhou.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine. You're well in credit, child.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Carrying Without Being Seen
quests.summary: On the sixth night, you sit in the temple, hood up, and carry the whole town the way you carried the mountain. Nobody knows.

objectives.text: Carry the town in silence

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole town, breathing. Nobody knows who's holding them. They don't need to. They're held. It's lighter than being cheered.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: A stranger has been helping everyone this week. The yamen would like to honour them. We can't find them. It's very frustrating. It's wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: Everyone Knew
quests.summary: On the seventh day, you find out that everyone knew who you were. Nobody said. The whole town kept the secret.

objectives.text: Go and see Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Everyone knew. From the first day. Iron-Fang knew by the stance. Widow Liu knew by the water. We decided not to say.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: actress_yu
dialogue.text: Tonight I die of heartbreak. Tomorrow, of poison. Sundays I rest.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Yu Hongxiu.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: You wanted to carry us without being seen. So we let you. That's what a town does for someone it loves. It pretends.

objectives.text: Hear what Abbess Jing has to say

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: They all knew. And they let you carry them anyway, and carried your secret. That's the Great Vehicle. Both directions. You've passed.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Abbess Jing) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Bandits, Testing the Quiet Week
quests.summary: A small band of bandits, hearing Qingshi's usual defenders are distracted, tests the town's edges during the anonymous week.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table at the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You leave an offering on the offering table and bow. The candle flames bow back.

objectives.text: Drive the bandits from the execution ground

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the dye yard
Share your findings with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm trying to learn which things shouldn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The bandits left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Medicine for the Hill Houses
quests.summary: The old houses on the hill need medicine as much as rice, and the hooded stranger makes one more supply run.

objectives.text: Answer Old Pan's summons

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the hill graves. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Listen to Huo Da. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the hill graves
Go back to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Huo Da. Heaven bless {them}.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Old Pan, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Old Chen's Recognition
quests.summary: Old Chen, the plum farmer, claims he recognized the hooded stranger by their whistle, which they'd apparently unconsciously picked up from him.

objectives.text: Study the map table at the militia barracks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Chen says the stranger whistled his tune while carrying water. He didn't say anything. He just started whistling back.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Meet Abbess Jing at the town temple

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the town temple isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood.

objectives.text: Talk with Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Widow Liu. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Immortals drink like fish and tip like cats.

objectives.text: Find Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Widow Liu is right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Every face that passes, I look twice. Old habit.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Poor Quarter's Second Night
quests.summary: A second night of wraiths tests the poor quarter, and the hooded stranger stands watch again without complaint.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The loom clacks once as you touch it, as if the weaver had only stepped out for a moment.

objectives.text: Clear the night market of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Pick up incense bundles near the night market
Tell Magistrate Zhou what you found

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not now, Old Pan. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for Elder Hua's Quiet Shipment
quests.summary: Elder Hua sends spirit herbs to Qingshi anonymously too, matching the spirit of the stranger's own quiet work.

objectives.text: Report to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me spirit herbs from the pottery kilns. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted. Written down. Now it's official.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the pottery kilns
Report back to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Merchant Jin's Second Policy
quests.summary: Merchant Jin, inspired by the rice policy's success, quietly extends free credit to anyone the hooded stranger vouches for.

objectives.text: Go to the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Students recite the classics in the county academy, their voices rising and falling like a slow sea.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I don't ask who the stranger vouches for. I just extend the credit. It's worked out well so far. Suspiciously well.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Iron-Fang.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Liuer's Growing Class
quests.summary: Liu Er's posture class for the town's children has grown to twenty students, all copying the hooded stranger's stance exactly.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Twenty kids now! All standing like you! I didn't tell them who to copy! They just picked the best stance in the room!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Constable Du. And the time before.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the tannery. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the yamen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Iron-Fang. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Order! Ah. It's already orderly. Carry on.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (hiding behind Magistrate Zhou) Oh.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, a Second Shakedown
quests.summary: The rogue cultivators from the back alley return with reinforcements, testing whether the grey stranger got lucky the first time.

objectives.text: Investigate the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The temple orphanage looks exactly as it should, which is what makes you uneasy.

objectives.text: Fight off the rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Find the cloud silk at the dye yard
Show Abbess Jing what you found

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A fine piece of business. I mean that as the highest praise I know.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Incense for the Temple's Quiet Nights
quests.summary: The temple where you carry the town in silence needs incense, a small comfort Zhou insists on providing anonymously in turn.

objectives.text: See what Merchant Jin wants

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me incense bundles from the temple fair.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Recover incense bundles from the temple fair
Bring word to Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Will there be a report? A written one? With dates? I love a report with dates.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Merchant Jin) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the incense bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Widow Liu's Thanks, Unspoken
quests.summary: On the last day, Widow Liu leaves a small gift on the doorstep of the room the stranger stayed in, and says nothing about it.

objectives.text: Light incense at the offering table at the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A folded blanket, still warm from the hearth, with no note. You don't need one to know who left it, or why.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fruit, rice and a cup of wine wait on the offering table. Someone set out one bowl more than there are gods.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Thank you, Merchant Jin, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Talk with Merchant Jin at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Merchant, your barges keep scraping my ferry.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Old Pan, your ferry keeps being in the way of my barges.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Up the Mountain Again
quests.summary: You walk back up the nine thousand steps without the hood. At the gate, Abbess Jing bows to you. The Moon-Well is with you.

objectives.text: Hear Abbess Jing out

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well stands with the Azure Cloud. Not because you asked. Because a whole town kept your secret for a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Captain Lei, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Welcome back. Lady Silk visited thirty camps while you were gone. Thirty arguments. The conclave starts tomorrow. It's going to be a mess.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Abbess Jing said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Sect Master Speaks
quests.summary: The conclave opens. The Sect Master stands before forty sect masters and speaks for three minutes. Nobody moves.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Three hundred years ago two sects sealed a monster. One gave everything. The other forgot. When the fold opens, we cannot forget again.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'm not asking you to follow the Azure Cloud. I'm asking you to walk beside it. That's all. That's the speech.

objectives.text: Pay respects at the ancestral tablets at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sect masters sit in the main hall in silence. Then Ruan Hai stands and bows. Then the Zhao ancestor. Then everyone at once.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ancestral tablets stand in silent rows. You read the names aloud, softly, because someone should.

objectives.text: Join Lu Ping at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Three minutes! Everyone stood up! I cried! Wei Tong cried! A Hundred Wells elder cried! The Zhao ancestor pretended not to!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Lu Ping is right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: The First Argument
quests.summary: The standing ovation lasts three minutes. The first argument lasts three hours. It's about who marches in front.

objectives.text: Go and see Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale marches at the front. We have the most to avenge. Forty of our children in the ice.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan marches at the front. We have the most gold. Gold marches very well.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well marches wherever we're needed. That's usually the back. Where the wounded are. Nobody argues about the back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Ancestor Zhao. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Pink Silk in the Hall
quests.summary: Lady Si Rou sits quietly through the argument. Each time she whispers to someone, the argument gets worse.

objectives.text: Search the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lady Si Rou leans over and whispers to the Cinder Cloud's master. He stands up and shouts at the Hundred Wells. She smiles.

objectives.text: Watch Lady Si Rou with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, silk threads run from her fingers to eleven sect masters. Thin, pink, almost invisible. Each tugs, gently, toward anger.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Threads. On eleven sect masters. She's puppeteering the conclave. She's the Sixth Rung. Lady Silk. Qing Luan's chart said silk.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Ancestor Zhao. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Han Xue, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We can't accuse an envoy in the middle of a conclave. Nobody would believe us. They'd think we're the ones pulling strings.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Cutting Threads Quietly
quests.summary: You can't accuse her. But you can cut threads, quietly, one sect master at a time, by carrying them.

objectives.text: Answer Sect Master Ruan's summons

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan. You lost forty. We'll get them out. Together. The front doesn't matter. Getting them out matters.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Yes. Yes, you're right. I don't know why I was shouting. It felt like someone else's anger. I'll march at the side.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

objectives.text: Hear what Ancestor Zhao has to say

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The side is fine for the Zhao clan too. Gold looks good from any angle. I don't know why I was so angry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Sect Master Ruan has earned the right to say it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Disciples Brawl
quests.summary: The sect masters calm down. Their disciples, who have been drinking in the camps, do not.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The disciples are brawling! Forty sects' worth! In the camps! Someone started a rumour that the Iron Scale cheated at the banners!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Bai. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

objectives.text: Break the quarrelling disciples at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These quarrelling disciples fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Stop the Iron Scale disciples regrouping
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Everyone's calm. Mostly. I found out who started the rumour. A servant in pink. Silk Pavilion. Of course.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: The drunk brawlers sober up. The side that started it is your oldest ally.

choices.text: Punish the side that started it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Break it up and punish nobody

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Side with your allies regardless

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hmph. Reasonable. Annoyingly.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

quests.title: Collecting the Threads
quests.summary: Now you know what to look for, you can see Lady Silk's threads everywhere in the camps. You gather them.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Threads everywhere. On tents. On banners. On teacups. She's woven the whole camp. Cut them. Quietly. Before she notices.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Han Xue is right.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Gather the pink threads from the camps
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Forty threads. Cut. She'll notice. She'll be angry. Angry is good. Angry makes people careless. Even spiders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Bai's Research
quests.summary: Elder Bai has been researching the Silk Pavilion. It doesn't exist. It never has.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Silk Pavilion. Far to the south. I've read every map. There's nothing there. A lake. A very pretty lake. No sect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Noted, Sect Master Ruan. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Compare the Silk Pavilion's seal with the Blood Moon records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Silk Pavilion's seal, under magnification, has a tiny crescent woven into its border. Seven threads. Six still bright.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Blood Moon. The Sixth Rung. In our conclave. In my pagoda, borrowing books. She borrowed three and returned them on time. I'm furious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Excellent. I shall mention you in my monthly letter. It is very long. You'll be in paragraph nine.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ancestor Zhao says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Irregular! Marvellously irregular. Unrecordable, even.

quests.title: Telling the Sect Master
quests.summary: You tell the Sect Master. She listens, and smiles, and it's the most frightening smile you've ever seen.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A Rung. In my conclave. Pulling my guests' strings. In my hall.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Very funny.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We don't accuse her. We let her pull, and we cut, and we carry, and when she's tired, we ask her to leave. Politely. With swords.

objectives.text: Meet Abbess Jing at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well saw the threads too. We said nothing. We've been cutting them since the first day. Quietly. We're very good at quiet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhong Ming. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Conclave's Second Day
quests.summary: On the second day, the threads are gone and the sect masters agree on everything. Lady Silk's servants try something louder.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Fire in the Cinder Cloud camp! And the Hundred Wells camp! Both at once! Blamed on each other! Both sects are drawing swords!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ignore Ruan Jingtao. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Raise the formation over both camps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Great Azure Formation rises over the camps like a hand. Blue light, and under it, both fires go out.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: More Blood Moon cultivators? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Hold the inner sect gate against more Blood Moon cultivators
Talk with Ruan Jingtao at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Servants in pink. Both fires. The Cinder Cloud and the Hundred Wells are embracing. Crying. It's very awkward. It's lovely.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Listen to Deacon Shen. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Camp's Retreat
quests.summary: The demon cultivators who set the fires scatter into the outer pines, and Thunder Peak insists on running them down.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Moon cultivators come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The plum garden is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Lu Ping. Lu Ping won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Zhao Kang will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Jade Slips for the Conclave's Second Record
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants the second day's proceedings recorded as carefully as the first, threads and all.

objectives.text: Go and see Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Bring me jade slips from the laundry stream. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Pick up jade slips near the laundry stream
Report back to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
