dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more jade slips than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering to Abbess Jing) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: The Cinder Cloud and Hundred Wells, Formalized
quests.summary: The two sects, embracing after the fire, formally announce a permanent alliance on the spot, much to Lu Ping's delight.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: An alliance! Forming right in front of me! I get to write it down! This is the best conclave I've ever attended! It's the only one!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Bai. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Sect Master. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I have read everything in the pagoda twice, and the recipes three times.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Sparring Disciples, Celebrating Too Hard
quests.summary: The newly allied sects celebrate with a sparring exhibition that gets slightly out of hand.

objectives.text: Test the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sword in the stone is cold and humming. For a moment you hear its last owner's oath, word for word.

objectives.text: Drive the quarrelling disciples from the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Collect lantern oil around the outer pines
Tell the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Ancestor Zhao. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Oh good, you're back. I had a story ready about your tragic death. It was very moving.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Incense for the Formation's Long Day
quests.summary: The Great Azure Formation, strained from a full day of shielding camps, needs incense offerings to steady it overnight.

objectives.text: Report to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me incense bundles from the medicine valley, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries, and in gold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Find the incense bundles at the medicine valley
Bring word to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Hm. Lu Ping is not wrong. Lu Ping is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the incense bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: The Threads, Recounted
quests.summary: Han Xue does a final count of Lady Silk's cut threads, cross-referencing which sects were targeted and why.

objectives.text: Head to the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tea pickers move along the terraces with baskets on their backs, singing a song about a lazy dragon.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She targeted the sects with the most to lose and the least trust in each other. Efficient. I almost respect it. Almost.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Well done. I don't say that often. Ask my son. Actually, don't.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Ruan Hai's New Ease
quests.summary: Ruan Hai, freed from Lady Silk's tugging, admits he hasn't felt this calm in a conclave hall in decades.

objectives.text: Find Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I don't know if it's you or just not being pulled at anymore. Probably both. Thank you, either way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Lu Ping?

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: What Sect Master Ruan said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master Ruan. Now, where was I.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Iron Scale Disciples, the Late Watch
quests.summary: A late watch of Iron Scale disciples, still wound up from the day's excitement, spar off their energy against the puppets.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Clear the arena stands of Iron Scale disciples

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale disciples spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the outer dormitories
Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Tang Ling. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the shelves. They're older than your grandmother and less forgiving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Iron Scale disciples left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (beaming at Elder Bai) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Letters for the Absent Sects
quests.summary: A few invited sects never arrived, and Lu Ping wants letters sent checking on them, just in case Lady Silk reached them first.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Bring me sealed letters from the outer dormitories. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Great-grandson, you're slouching.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I am standing heroically, Ancestor.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Bai.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Acceptable.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Growing Suspicion
quests.summary: Bai Ling, cross-referencing more records, grows suspicious that Lady Silk's threads reach further than the conclave alone.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai out

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I think she's been pulling strings outside this mountain too. For months. Maybe years. I need more books. I need more time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Sect Master Ruan. I asked who would go.

objectives.text: Meet Sect Master Ruan at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Zhong Ming?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Scales do not rust. Neither do grudges. I am trying to let mine.

objectives.text: Talk with Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Noted, Deacon Shen. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My grandson has your stubbornness. Regrettably, he had it first.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Carrying Forty
quests.summary: At the end of the second day, you sit on the formation and carry forty sects. It's heavier than a mountain. It's lighter than you feared.

objectives.text: Carry the forty sects on the formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, two thousand breaths. Somewhere among them, a woman in pink, holding her breath, very angry. You carry her too.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Middle stage of Body Integration. Your vehicle has room for more than you thought.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're carrying her too, aren't you. Lady Silk. I can see it on your face. You're carrying the spider.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Han Xue said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's either very foolish or very wise. The hermit would say both. I say be careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Old Question
quests.summary: On the third day of the conclave, someone asks who should hold the Lotus Key. The room goes cold.

objectives.text: Speak with Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale gave up that question at the banners. We don't raise it. But forty sects didn't give it up. They're asking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

objectives.text: Pay respects at the ancestral tablets at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The main hall is silent. Forty sect masters look at you. Somewhere at the back, a woman in pink silk is very still.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You bow before the ancestral tablets. Names in gold and faded red go back further than anyone alive can count.

objectives.text: Join Ancestor Zhao at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a fair question. The key opens the seal. The seal holds the Patriarch. Should one young person carry all of that?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Enough, Wei Tong. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I ask as an old man who likes you. Not as a Zhao. Answer honestly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: An Honest Answer
quests.summary: You answer honestly. It's not the answer anyone expected.

objectives.text: Search the notice board at the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. One person shouldn't carry it. That's the mistake the founders made. The Verdant Lotus gave everything and everyone forgot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll carry the key. You carry me. All of you. When the fold opens, I walk in front, and you walk beside me. That's the only answer.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the notice board from corner to corner. Someone has crossed out a name and written a warning beside it.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well accepts that answer. Carry the key. We'll carry the carrier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Afterwards, a small sect's master asks you privately to argue for his seat.

choices.text: Promise to argue fairly for everyone

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Argue for him; small sects need a voice

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Ask what it's worth to him

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: The Last Thread
quests.summary: Lady Silk's last thread is on the one sect master who hasn't answered. The Cinder Cloud's master stands, eyes glazed.

objectives.text: Make your way to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Cinder Cloud's master stands. His eyes are glazed pink. He says, in a voice not quite his own: the key should go to the Silk Pavilion.

objectives.text: Trace the last thread with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One thread, thick as rope, from the Cinder Cloud master to the woman in pink. She's pulling with everything she has.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She's pulling hard. Too hard. She's exposed herself. Everyone felt that. Everyone's looking at her now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Ancestor Zhao. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Spider Runs
quests.summary: Exposed, Lady Silk doesn't fight. She runs, and her servants cover her escape with fire and pink smoke.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: She's running! Pink smoke everywhere! Her servants are throwing fire! In the main hall! That's the founder's tablet in there!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: See? Even Sect Master Ruan agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators
Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The founder's tablet is safe. The faded green lotus beside it is safe. Lady Silk is gone. Down the back path. Toward Qingshi.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Abbess Jing. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: The Conclave Decides
quests.summary: With Lady Silk gone, the conclave decides in an hour what it couldn't decide in three days.

objectives.text: Answer the Sect Master's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The key stays with its bearer. Forty sects walk beside the bearer when the fold opens. The Great Vehicle. All in favour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you carry too much alone.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: So I'm told, Abbess. Usually by people carrying more.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Hear what Sect Master Ruan has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. In favour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Sect Master Ruan. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan. In favour. In gold.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. In favour. Singing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Sect Master Ruan mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (tugging Sect Master Ruan's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Signatures on One Scroll
quests.summary: Forty sects sign one scroll. It takes a long time. Some sects have very long names.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Forty signatures! On one scroll! The Hundred Wells has a very long name! It took them ten minutes! The scroll's going to need an extension!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ignore Elder Bai. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Collect the forty sects' seals
Meet Elder Bai at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The scroll of the Great Vehicle. Forty seals. I'm putting it in the pagoda. On the top shelf. Above the turtle soup. Where it belongs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: No, Lu Ping. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more sealed letters than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (hiding behind Elder Bai) Oh.

quests.title: Where Silk Goes
quests.summary: Lady Silk fled toward Qingshi. The hermit says spiders always go where they've already spun.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Spiders go home to their webs. She's spun in Qingshi before. Many times, I'd guess. Look for the places where people quarrel too easily.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Deacon Shen has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to the hermit) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Read Madam Fang's crane about Qingshi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A crane from Madam Fang: the town's been quarrelling for months. Over nothing. Neighbours who've been friends for forty years. It started last spring.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Last spring. When the Silk Pavilion's envoy first 'visited' the region. She's been weaving Qingshi for a year. We didn't notice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Webs on the Mountain
quests.summary: Before you go after her, you have to clear the webs she left on the mountain. They're in the camps, the hall, the pagoda.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Pink threads everywhere! On my twelve! On the chicken! She threaded the chicken! That's a new low!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

objectives.text: Cut the threads from Wei Tong's disciples

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one the threads snap. Wei Tong's twelve blink, shake their heads, and stop glaring at each other.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the crane roost
Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The chicken's free. The chicken's fine. Qiu Hua's crying. The chicken isn't. Chickens don't cry. The chicken has seen too much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan would have sent a servant for this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan's servants would have eaten my lunch.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Carrying a Web
quests.summary: The hermit says: to unravel a web, you have to hold every thread at once. Only a body of many can do that.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hold every thread at once. Every quarrel she started. Carry them all, and they'll untangle, because you'll be too heavy to pull.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Zhao Kang. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. The hermit is right.

objectives.text: Hold every thread of the web at once

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thousand quarrels. You hold them all, and they hang slack, because nobody is pulling any more. Some of them snap. Some of them become friendships.

objectives.text: Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The mountain's free of her. Now the town. Go. Take someone who's good with gossip. Actually, the town has someone better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Answer Wei Tong, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, Silk's Rearguard
quests.summary: A handful of demon cultivators left behind to cover Lady Silk's escape make a final stand near the outer pines.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill furnace breathes out heat like a sleeping beast. Inside, a batch of pills turns slowly in the glow.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the outer dormitories
Tell the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Old Bao says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Jade Slips for the Scroll's Archive Copy
quests.summary: Elder Bai insists on a full archive copy of the Great Vehicle scroll before the original ever leaves the pagoda.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me jade slips from the spirit peach orchard.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Abbess Jing, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Collect jade slips around the spirit peach orchard
Bring word to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Any Iron Scale colours among them? Tell me honestly. I would rather know.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the jade slips you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Chicken, Debriefed
quests.summary: Wei Tong holds a solemn debriefing with the chicken, insisting it deserves to know it survived a Rung's web intact.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You were threaded by a Sixth Rung and you didn't even blink. Elder Drumstick, you're the bravest chicken in this sect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

objectives.text: Talk with Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ancestor Zhao has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries, and in gold.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (grinning at Abbess Jing) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Iron Scale Disciples, Working Off Anger
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao's disciples, furious on his behalf, work off their anger against the training puppets before the journey to Qingshi.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Defeat the Iron Scale disciples at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The Iron Scale disciples have found you first.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
Compare notes with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Well done. I don't say that often. Ask my son. Actually, don't.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: (to the hermit, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Iron Scale disciples is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: (to the hermit, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the Journey Down
quests.summary: Elder Hua packs spirit herbs for the trip to Qingshi, insisting a hunt for a Rung is no excuse to travel unprepared.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. The hermit is right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Recover spirit herbs from the medicine valley
See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part the hermit will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Answer the Sect Master, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

quests.title: The Cinder Cloud Master's Apology
quests.summary: The Cinder Cloud's master, freed from Lady Silk's thread, apologizes to the whole hall for nearly derailing the vote.

objectives.text: Scout the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He says it felt like watching himself from outside his own body. Forty sect masters nod. More than one of them knows that feeling now.

objectives.text: Show Ruan Jingtao what you found

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ha. The Sect Master's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Tianlu's Elder Abuse Complaint
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu formally files a complaint about elder abuse with Steward Qian, entirely for comedic effect, and Qian plays along.

objectives.text: Report to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Complaint received. Filed under 'Zhao clan nonsense.' We have a very thick folder for that category.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Steward Qian thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Han Xue.

objectives.text: Join Abbess Jing at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the sunrise terrace. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhong Ming. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the sword-washing pool.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't break anything that belongs to the sect. I will know. I always know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Han Xue, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Void Wraiths, Drawn to the Broken Web
quests.summary: The unraveling of Lady Silk's web across the mountain draws a small cluster of void wraiths to feed on the loose threads.

objectives.text: Grip the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You close your hand on the hilt of the sword in the stone. It hums, weighs you, and decides to stay where it is.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the mountain road
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the sword-washing pool. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Abbess Jing. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Letters for the Sects Heading Home
quests.summary: Several sects begin the journey home after the conclave, and Lu Ping wants farewell letters sent with each one.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me sealed letters from the outer dormitories.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhong Ming. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the outer dormitories
Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: Nice work.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Zhong Ming says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more sealed letters than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Web Diagram
quests.summary: Bai Ling draws a full diagram of every thread Lady Silk spun on the mountain, hoping the pattern reveals where she'll strike next.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It's the same pattern as Qingshi. Old friendships, frayed slowly. She doesn't create hate. She just removes the trust holding peace together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Elder Bai does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Han Xue?

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Down to Qingshi
quests.summary: The conclave agrees to wait while you go after Lady Silk. Ruan Jingtao and Zhao Kang insist on coming.

objectives.text: Hear Ruan Jingtao out

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale comes. She threaded my father. Nobody threads my father.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan comes. She threaded my great-grandfather. He's a hundred and twelve. That's elder abuse.

objectives.text: Hurry to the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great bell hangs silent in its tower on the east ridge, green with age and heavy as a promise.

objectives.text: Sound the bronze bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Talk with Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Ruan Jingtao, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Town That Quarrels
quests.summary: Qingshi's main street is full of people not speaking to each other. The silence is louder than shouting.

objectives.text: Go to the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Neighbours cross the street to avoid each other. The noodle seller and the tea seller have put up a fence between their stalls.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Nobody's talking. The magistrate and I had a row about a lost chicken three months ago. We haven't spoken since. It was a chicken.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Constable Du is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: It feels like someone else's anger. I don't know how to explain it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Madam Fang and Iron-Fang
quests.summary: Madam Fang and Iron-Fang have argued. Over a dish. They're both miserable. Neither will apologise.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: He broke my favourite dish. On purpose, I said. By accident, he said. We haven't spoken in a month. The inn's very quiet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I didn't break it on purpose. I'd never. I love that dish. She loves that dish. I just... couldn't say it. Something stopped me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Madam Fang's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted. Written down. Now it's official.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: There's a thread on both of you. Pink. Lady Silk's. Let me cut it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...I love that dish. I love this inn. Madam Fang, I'm sorry. I'll wash every dish forever. I was going to anyway.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Threads Across the Town
quests.summary: In soul sight, the whole town is laced with pink threads, and they all lead to one place.

objectives.text: Investigate the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the watchtower, in soul sight: pink threads across every street, every house, every friendship. They all lead to the temple.

objectives.text: Follow the threads with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The temple. Hong's old temple, where the Rust Monk prayed. At its heart, a knot of pink, pulsing, and someone sitting in it, weaving.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The temple again. That temple has had a terrible few decades. I'm going to donate to it. Heavily. After we clear the spider out.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Constable Du's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: By the law. That's all I ever ask.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Mending Friendships
quests.summary: Before you face her, the hermit's advice: carry the town. Cut the threads one friendship at a time.

objectives.text: Go and see Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The noodle seller and the tea seller. Forty years they shared a stall. Now there's a fence. Help me take it down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Ruan Jingtao. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Take down the fences in the market
Go back to Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: They're sharing tea and noodles again. The noodle seller cried into the tea. It's fine. It's salty tea now. People like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Magistrate and the Constable
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou and Constable Du haven't spoken in three months. Over a chicken.

objectives.text: Answer Magistrate Zhou's summons

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Constable Du lost my chicken. My prize chicken. Three months ago. He said it wasn't his fault.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: It wasn't my fault. It was the fox. The one from the judgement. It came back. I should have said so. Something stopped me.

objectives.text: Hear what Magistrate Zhou has to say

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: ...The fox? The clever one? Oh. Oh, Du. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'll buy a new chicken. We'll guard it together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: The classics say a wise man walks around a river. The classics never had to cross this one.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Listen to Scholar Ouyang. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

objectives.choice_prompt: Silk set the magistrate and the constable at each other's throats. The town wants one gone.

choices.text: Reconcile them, whatever it takes

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Let the law decide

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Back whoever owes you more

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Silk Servants
quests.summary: As the threads snap, Lady Silk's servants come out of hiding, desperate to reweave what's breaking.

objectives.text: Report to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Servants in pink! Everywhere! They're trying to reweave the threads! Stop them before they tie anyone back up!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Old Pan. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Clear the main street of silk servants

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Cut down the rogue cultivators that follow
Report back to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're gone. The town's talking again. Loudly. I've never heard so many apologies at once. It's deafening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Jin's Guild Pigeons
quests.summary: Merchant Jin's guild pigeons have been carrying messages for Lady Silk for a year. He didn't know. He's horrified.

objectives.text: Find Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: My pigeons! My guild pigeons! Carrying her messages! For a year! Through my loft! I didn't know!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Search the guild's pigeon loft

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tiny scrolls, tied to pigeon legs, all in pink silk. Orders. Quarrels to start. Friendships to cut. And one scroll: the heir's friends are next.

objectives.text: Bring word to Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I'm going to burn the loft. No. I'm going to keep the pigeons and send honest messages. Forever. Just to spite her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: We all were, Widow Liu. We all were.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

quests.title: The Heir's Friends Are Next
quests.summary: The last scroll said the heir's friends are next. Lady Silk's threads reach up the mountain, toward everyone you love.

objectives.text: See what Madam Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Your friends! Up the mountain! She's threading them! Han Xue! Wei Tong! The Xiao children! Go! Go!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Send your soul up the mountain along the threads

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul runs up the pink threads like fire up a fuse. On the mountain, Han Xue, Wei Tong and the Xiao children blink, and the threads fall away.

objectives.text: Fight off the silk servants

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths regrouping
Meet Zhao Kang at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You cut the threads on the mountain from down here? With your soul? That's Body Integration? I'm going to need to sit down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Merchant Jin.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the constable hear.

quests.title: The Town Carries Back
quests.summary: Qingshi, freed from the web, does something unexpected: the whole town gathers in the square and holds hands. For you.

objectives.text: Hear Constable Du out

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The whole town. In the square. Holding hands. The magistrate's idea. He said the immortal carries us. We should carry back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Constable Du is right.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

objectives.text: Stand in the circle of the town

dialogue.speaker: narrator
