dialogue.text: A thousand hands, and you in the middle. The town carries you. It's the lightest you've ever been. Your vehicle grows wider.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the bell pavilion

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've never held so many hands. I'm going to make a speech. One word. Hold. We held. I held. We all held.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not now, Scholar Ouyang. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Sensible, that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, the Temple's Guard
quests.summary: A handful of rogue cultivators guard the temple's approach, hired by Lady Silk before her web began to unravel.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run your fingers along the threads of the loom. One colour runs through every bolt, like a signature.

objectives.text: Break the rogue cultivators at the temple fair

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the temple fair
Tell Old Pan what you found

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the canal walk isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Light some incense tonight, Zhao Kang. For luck.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Old Pan) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Old Pan, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Medicine for the Reconciled Town
quests.summary: A year of quarreling left plenty of small wounds, physical and otherwise, and Elder Hua's traveling stock needs restocking.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (nervously) W-what can I do for you, immortal? Anything. Anything at all.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me medicine bundles from the pottery kilns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Huo Da.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the pottery kilns
See Madam Fang again

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Wine, noodles or gossip? The gossip is free. The rest, you pay for.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Fair. Fair's all anyone asks.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Madam Fang) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Madam Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Old Pan's Apology Tour
quests.summary: Old Pan, freed from a thread nobody noticed he carried, goes around apologizing to everyone he'd quietly avoided all year.

objectives.text: Go and see Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I don't even remember what I was upset about. I just remember being upset. I'm sorry. To everyone. All at once. Efficient, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: There. Magistrate Zhou agrees. Settled.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou at the examination cells

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Widow Liu.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: The classics say a wise man walks around a river. The classics never had to cross this one.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen is open to all petitions. Between the second and fourth bell.

objectives.text: Join Widow Liu at the canal walk

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Pan. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The water's sweet this season. Take a cup.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Pigeon Loft's Guard
quests.summary: A pair of demon cultivators guarding Merchant Jin's pigeon loft try to destroy the evidence before it's fully searched.

objectives.text: Beat the war drum at the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The war drum speaks in a voice like thunder. Every head turns. Somewhere, someone starts running.

objectives.text: Stop the silk servants at the east gate

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These silk servants fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Recover cloud silk from the dye yard
Compare notes with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not now, Zhao Kang. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the Market's Mended Stalls
quests.summary: The noodle seller and tea seller, reconciled, ask for spirit herbs to properly restock their shared stall.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The sect hasn't tamed you. Good.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me spirit herbs from the market square.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs at the market square
Return to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Fox, Vindicated
quests.summary: Constable Du tracks down the clever fox from the chicken judgement, hoping to clear its name once and for all.

objectives.text: Search the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Wang pharmacy smells of liquorice root and ginseng. A clerk grinds something that crunches.

objectives.text: Open the medicine cabinet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A hundred little drawers line the medicine cabinet, each labelled. One label is in a different hand.

objectives.text: Show Constable Du what you found

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: It wasn't even the fox's fault this time, probably. I just wanted to see it again. It's become something of a town mascot, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Unlawful, strictly. Effective, though.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (to Constable Du, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Donation
quests.summary: True to his word, Zhao Kang makes a heavy donation to Hong's old temple, insisting it deserves a better history than it's had.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: New paint, new roof, new everything. This temple's been a rust monk's prayer spot and a spider's web. It deserves better next.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: The children ask about you, you know. Don't make me tell them anything sad.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

objectives.text: Speak with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: Wipe your feet when you come back. Heroes track in the worst mud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher.

objectives.text: Hear what Merchant Jin has to say

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Business is business. I'm told friendship is also business, but warmer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Town's Last Grief
quests.summary: A last cluster of void wraiths, fed on a year of quiet resentment, lingers near the temple even after the web breaks.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table at the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The dust on the offering table has been disturbed. Beneath the incense bowl lies a folded note.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the temple fair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the temple fair
Talk it over with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Constable Du. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Old Pan) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Letters From the Pigeon Loft's Archive
quests.summary: Merchant Jin's loft holds a year of Lady Silk's correspondence, worth archiving before he makes good on burning it.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Look at you. Wearing the sect's robes and the bandit's heart. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The soft-hearted immortal. Still alive. Surprises me every time.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me sealed letters from the county granary.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the county granary
Go back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the sealed letters you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Town Visit
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao, having never properly visited Qingshi before, is quietly moved by how thoroughly the town has healed itself.

objectives.text: See what Ruan Jingtao wants

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: A whole town, mended in an afternoon, by people who just needed permission to stop being angry. I want the Iron Scale to learn that too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: My students fear the examination. I fear my students. Nobody fears the classics any more.

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the pawnshop

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Merchant Jin is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the manor garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Merchant Jin.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Spider in the Temple
quests.summary: Lady Silk has nowhere left to spin. She's in the temple, at the centre of a web that's falling apart. And then she isn't.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table at the town temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The temple is empty. At its heart, a knot of pink silk, unravelling, and a note in a beautiful hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You leave an offering on the offering table and bow. The candle flames bow back.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the public bathhouse

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I came down. I'm not threaded any more. She left a note. It says: come to the conclave's last night. I'll be the guest of honour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She's going back up the mountain. Into the middle of forty sects. For one last trick.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Feast
quests.summary: The conclave's last feast. Forty sects on the formation plaza. Every lantern lit. Every guard watching. One empty seat.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty sects, one feast, one empty seat. She said she'd come. She will. Spiders keep their appointments.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Lu Ping. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

objectives.text: Activate the seal at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Long tables on the plaza, lanterns on every pillar. At the head table, one seat is empty, draped in pink silk.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press your palm to the seal. Green light answers the pendant at your chest.

objectives.text: Join Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The empty seat's got pink silk on it! Nobody put it there! It was just there! I'm not sitting near it! I'm sitting near Wei Tong!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm... not going to tell anyone about that one.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Watching Every Face
quests.summary: At the feast, everyone watches everyone. It makes for very awkward conversation.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone's watching everyone. Nobody's eating. It's the worst feast ever. I'm eating. Somebody has to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhong Ming. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well sings when it's nervous. We're about to sing. I apologise in advance.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: No, Wei Tong. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

objectives.text: Hear what Ancestor Zhao has to say

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: At my age, every feast might be the last. This one might actually be. I'm going to have the duck.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Elder Bai. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: The Wine
quests.summary: Halfway through the feast, you notice the wine. Every cup on every table has a thread of pink in it.

objectives.text: Head to the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every cup of wine on every table has a single pink thread floating in it, curled like a question mark.

objectives.text: Pull the threads from the wine with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two thousand threads rise out of two thousand cups at once and drift together, twisting, into a single silk rope above the empty seat.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Silk in the wine. If everyone had drunk it... forty sects, threaded at once. She'd have had the whole alliance on a string.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: The feast wine is threaded with silk. Announcing it means panic; silence means someone may drink.

choices.text: Announce it at once

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to Elder Bai) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Swap the wine quietly, as protocol says

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Let the enemy's guests drink it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Elder Bai) Oh.

quests.title: Servants at the Tables
quests.summary: When the threads leave the wine, Lady Silk's servants, disguised as serving staff, drop their trays.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The servers! Half of them are hers! Trays down, knives out! Protect the sect masters!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Ruan Jingtao. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Drive the silk servants from the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: More silk servants? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Hold the arena stands against more silk servants
Meet Ruan Jingtao at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father hit one with a duck. A whole roast duck. He says it's the best thing he's done in years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Han Xue. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Guest of Honour Arrives
quests.summary: The silk rope above the empty seat twists, and becomes a woman in pink. The guest of honour has arrived.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: She's here! In the seat! She came out of the rope! I'm ringing the bell! I'm ringing it so hard!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Raise the formation around the feast

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Great Azure Formation rises, blue, around every table. Two thousand guests inside it. One woman in pink, outside, smiling.

objectives.text: Clear the inner sect gate of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths
Talk with the Sect Master at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone's inside the formation. She's outside it, alone. Go. The whole alliance is watching. Carry them into this fight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Wei Tong. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That is the sect I want. Thank you for being it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging the Sect Master's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Lady Silk Speaks
quests.summary: Lady Silk speaks to you from outside the formation, very politely, as if you were old friends.

objectives.text: Report to Lady Silk

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: Si Rou. Sixth Rung. Every alliance is a web, heir. I merely spin faster. You untangled mine. How rude. How impressive.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stand behind me, {player}. No? Fine. Beside me, then.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: Five of my brothers and sisters gone. My thread is the last strong one before the Shadow. Come and cut it, if you can.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not coming alone, Lady Silk.

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: No. I see that. Forty sects. What a heavy vehicle. Let's see if it breaks.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Two leaves and a bud, disciple. Take only what you need, whatever you're picking.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Auntie Ruo said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

objectives.text: Join Ruan Jingtao at the core disciples' court

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ignore Zhao Kang. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Sixth Rung Falls
quests.summary: On the formation plaza, before forty sects, you face Lady Silk. She fights with thread and knife and smile.

objectives.text: Make your way to the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lady Silk steps onto the plaza. Silk unspools from her sleeves like water. Two thousand people watch from behind the formation's light.

objectives.name: Si Rou, Lady Silk
objectives.text: Bring down Si Rou, Lady Silk

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: Such lovely manners. Such soft throats. Let's see how much you can carry, heir, when I cut the straps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Everything. They're carrying me too.

objectives.text: Stand over the fallen Sixth Rung

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Si Rou lies on the plaza. Her silk unravels around her. You carried them, she says. I only pulled. I never learned to carry. Her star goes out.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Six. Six stars out. One left. The Shadow. The one nobody's seen. Forty sects watched you do it. They're cheering. Listen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Zhao Kang. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's hoard holds spirit stones stolen from Qingshi.

choices.text: Return every stone to Qingshi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give it all to the sect treasury

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep a share for yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Feast, Properly
quests.summary: With Lady Silk gone, the feast begins again. Properly this time. Wei Tong makes sure of it.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Feast! Properly! No threads! No knives! Just duck and noodles and forty sects being ridiculous! Eat! Everyone eat!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

objectives.text: Carry dishes to all forty tables
Raise a cup to the alliance

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two thousand cups, raised together. No threads in any of them. The Moon-Well sings. The Iron Scale shouts. Thunder Peak shouts louder.

objectives.text: Hear what Abbess Jing has to say

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Great Vehicle. Forty sects in one feast. Three hundred years since anyone saw this. Enjoy it. It won't come again for a while.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Fan Rui?

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Carrying Two Thousand
quests.summary: After the feast, you sit on the empty plaza and carry everyone who was at it. Two thousand people. It's light.

objectives.text: Carry the whole alliance in stillness

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two thousand breaths, and more beyond them: towns, villages, mountains. Your vehicle is vast now, and still light. Late stage of Body Integration.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You carried her too. At the end. Lady Silk. I saw it. She died being carried. That's more than most Rungs get.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Be careful, {senior}!

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Fan Rui. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. The hermit is right.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to the hermit) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind the hermit) Oh.

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Feast's Last Guard
quests.summary: A last handful of blood guards, sent to disrupt the feast's aftermath, are turned back by the sects working together.

objectives.text: Test the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rust flakes from the sword in the stone as you touch it. The blade beneath is still bright, and still sharp.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Guards come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Ancestor Zhao is not wrong. Ancestor Zhao is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Knowledge is like tea. Too hot, and it scalds. Too cold, and nobody wants it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The chronicles are full of cruelty. Thank you for a better page.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Irregular! Marvellously irregular. Unrecordable, even.

quests.title: Incense for the Fallen Sixth Rung
quests.summary: Ye Wuming, reached by crane, asks that incense be burned for Si Rou too, whatever she was, wherever she ends up.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me incense bundles from the laundry stream, would you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Lu Ping. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Recover incense bundles from the laundry stream
Report back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Excellent. I shall mention you in my monthly letter. It is very long. You'll be in paragraph nine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Second Helping
quests.summary: Wei Tong, having personally ensured the feast happened properly, awards himself a second helping as a service fee.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I earned this duck. I organized an entire feast during and after a Rung's assassination attempt. This duck is mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the ancestral tombs

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the ancestral tombs. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Wei Tong. That was very... something.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the drum tower.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm telling the whole gate! Twice! With improvements!

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Ha! I'd have lost money on that. Nobody saw it coming!

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Plaza's Last
quests.summary: A last cluster of void wraiths, drawn by the fight's aftermath, lingers at the plaza's edge before dispersing.

objectives.text: Scout the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Notice boards cover every wall of the mission hall, sect tasks pinned three deep and fluttering in the draught.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the outer dormitories
Compare notes with Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The outer dormitories is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd have grunted and looked away. That's how he said proud. I'll just say it. Proud!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My grandson has your stubbornness. Regrettably, he had it first.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Ancestor Zhao) That was cold.

quests.title: Medicine for the Feast's Minor Wounds
quests.summary: The servant-fight left a handful of minor injuries among the guests, and Elder Hua's stock needs restocking again.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Han Xue said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the medicine valley
Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Abbess Jing. Abbess Jing won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Silk Sample
quests.summary: Bai Ling collects a sample of Lady Silk's unraveled thread for study, hoping it reveals something about how the Rungs are made.

objectives.text: Hurry to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the spirit beast garden. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Open the cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It's not natural silk. It's woven from something that used to be a person's will. I need to sit with that thought for a while.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Sect Master. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Tianlu's Duck Story
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu retells the story of hitting a demon cultivator with a roast duck to every sect master who'll listen, embellishing more each time.

objectives.text: Go and see Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: By the fifth telling it was three ducks and a whole roast pig. Nobody's corrected me yet. I'm not going to correct myself either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Ancestor Zhao, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Sect Master?

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Last Servants
quests.summary: A final pair of Lady Silk's disguised servants, still holding trays, finally drop the act and are dealt with.

objectives.text: Go to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great pill kilns glow in their yard like sleeping dragons, and the air shimmers with heat.

objectives.text: Stop the silk servants at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Collect incense bundles around the outer pines
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Letters of Thanks From Forty Sects
quests.summary: Every sect at the feast sends a letter of thanks in the following days, and Lu Ping insists on cataloguing every one.

objectives.text: Answer the hermit's summons

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me sealed letters from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Tang Ling has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

objectives.text: Find the sealed letters at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Fan Rui is not wrong. Fan Rui is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (tugging the hermit's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Jing's Song for the Alliance
quests.summary: Abbess Jing composes a new song on the spot, one meant to be sung whenever the Great Vehicle sects meet again.

objectives.text: Report to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: A song for the alliance. Simple enough for forty sects to learn in an evening. That's the whole trick to a good anthem.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Hear what Lu Ping has to say

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Lu Ping is right.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Abbess Jing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I was meditating. With my eyes closed. Loudly.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Bai says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find a book with turtle soup stains on it, it's mine. Return it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: One Left
quests.summary: Qing Luan's last crane before the isles sealed said the seventh star was different. Now you understand why.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One star left. The Seventh Rung. The Patriarch's Shadow. Nobody's ever seen them. Gu doesn't know. Ye Wuming doesn't know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Whoever it is, they're closest to him. When they fall, the Ladder is gone. And the fold, Qing Luan said, will have to open.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One left. Tomorrow, the alliance swears its oath. Then we get ready. For the Shadow. And for the sky.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Old Qiu. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Carving the Oath
quests.summary: The oath is to be carved on a new stele beside the Nine Precepts at the gate. Forty sects, forty lines.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A new stele. Beside the Nine Precepts. Forty lines, one for each sect. The oath of the Great Vehicle. Carve the first line.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly and strike plainly. Clever is for people who can afford to lose.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Sect Master Ruan. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Investigate the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A new stele stands beside the old one at the gate. The Nine Precepts on the left. On the right, blank stone, waiting for forty lines.

objectives.text: Carve the first line of the oath

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You carve: when the fold opens, we walk together. The Azure Cloud. Then you hand the chisel to Ruan Hai.

objectives.text: Find Sect Master Ruan at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. We walk together. And we remember. I'll carve that. My hands are shaking. Old hands. Good hands.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Sect Master Ruan) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Forty Lines
quests.summary: Each sect carves one line. Some are solemn. Some are not. All of them are true.

objectives.text: Hear Ancestor Zhao out

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan. We walk together, in gold. I've carved it very neatly. I've been practising calligraphy for a century.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Fan Rui. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Join Abbess Jing at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. We walk together, singing. Lian carved it. Her hand was steady. Mine wouldn't have been.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: If anything with fur looks at you sideways, stand still and look bored. It works on most beasts.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Ling Qiu has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The Hundred Wells carved theirs and it took twenty minutes! The Cinder Cloud carved a joke! About the Hundred Wells! Everyone laughed! Even the Hundred Wells!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ignore Fan Rui. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Hm. Sound. Go.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to Lu Ping) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

quests.title: A Ledger of Forty Letters
quests.summary: Steward Qian insists on a system: every sect writes monthly. He will keep the ledger. He's never been so happy.

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Monthly letters! Forty sects! A ledger! I'll track every letter! Every reply! Every late one! This is the best day of my career!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Abbess Jing. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I have seen this kind of errand before. It had teeth. Mind them.

objectives.text: Collect the sects' first monthly letters
Return to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty letters. All on time. Well, thirty-nine. The Zhao clan's was early. Of course it was. Gold is always early.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: We all were, Zhao Kang. We all were.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more sealed letters than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Farewell
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao leaves with the Iron Scale. He wants a spar before he goes. It's how the Iron Scale says goodbye, apparently. Also the Zhao clan.

objectives.text: Go and see Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: A spar before I go. The Iron Scale says goodbye with swords. So does the Zhao clan, Zhao Kang says. Everybody says goodbye with swords except the Moon-Well.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well says goodbye with songs.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Ruan Jingtao said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Maybe we should all try songs. After the spar. Pick up a sword.

objectives.text: Spar with Ruan Jingtao's escort

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale disciples spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Go back to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Draw. Obviously. Draws are the only honest ending between friends. See you at the fold. I'll be the one in green, shouting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Ruan Jingtao will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Iron Scale disciples is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

quests.title: The Tide Goes Out
quests.summary: As the sects leave, the wraiths that followed them come with them, drifting after the last banners down the steps.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wraiths trailing the last banners. Like gulls after boats. Clear them before they follow anyone home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Ancestor Zhao.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the crane roost
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The steps are clear. The last banners are gone. The mountain's quiet. I miss the noise. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ruan Jingtao. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Zhao Ancestor's Last Words
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu stays a day longer than the others. He's a hundred and fourteen. He wants to say something.

objectives.text: Report to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm a hundred and fourteen. I may not be alive when the fold opens. My great-grandson will march in my place.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then come and watch.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Look after him. He's very bad at being looked after. He complains. Let him. It's how he knows he's loved.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He said that? About me? To you? ...He's going to live forever, that old man. He's too stubborn to die. Like me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Great-grandson, you're slouching.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I am standing heroically, Ancestor.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao asks you to hide his failing health from his clan.

choices.text: Keep his secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Acceptable.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (nods slowly to Zhao Kang) A careful answer.

choices.text: Tell Zhao Kang. He has a right to know.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Use it for the alliance's advantage

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: An Empty Mountain
quests.summary: With the sects gone, the mountain feels empty. The hermit says the Great Vehicle includes carrying absence.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
