dialogue.text: Empty mountain. Two thousand people gone home. Carry them anyway. They're still there, on their own mountains. Carry the distance too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Tang Ling?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

objectives.text: Carry the departed sects from the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, forty mountains, scattered across the land. You carry them all, even from here. The distance is light.

objectives.text: Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You're getting good at this. Too good. Heaven will notice soon. It always notices people who carry too much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to the hermit) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down his cup) That was not the lotus way.

quests.title: Qing Luan's Last Crane
quests.summary: A crane arrives from the closed Sky Isles, dim and flickering. Qing Luan's voice, very faint.

objectives.text: See what Lu Ping wants

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A crane! From the isles! They're closed! How did it get out? It's very dim! It's saying your name!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Lu Ping. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Lu Ping, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Listen to Qing Luan's faint crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lotus child. Six stars out. The seventh is moving. Toward the Abyss. And heaven is leaning down to look at you. Your tribulation is coming.

objectives.text: Share your findings with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your tribulation. Heaven's noticed. Years yet, maybe. But it's started. The last stage before the sky: Tribulation Transcendence.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you carry too much alone.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: So I'm told, Abbess. Usually by people carrying more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: What Comes After the Body
quests.summary: The Sect Master explains the stage beyond: not a realm you reach, but a sky you survive.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mahayana first. Then Tribulation Transcendence. You don't reach that one. Heaven sends it. Nine bolts, and the ninth is the heart. You survive it, or you don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The Sect Master thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. The Sect Master is right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Nobody from the Azure Cloud has faced it in three hundred years. Your founder did. She survived. Barely. She never talked about the ninth bolt.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Years yet. We'll prepare. We'll break the last Rung. We'll open the fold. Then the sky. In that order. Nobody skip ahead.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Sect Master. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Empty Mountain's Edge
quests.summary: With fewer people on the mountain, void wraiths test the quieter edges more boldly than before.

objectives.text: Check the accounts at the abacus desk at the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You run the beads of the abacus desk. The accounts come out one sum short, every month, for years.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the mountain road
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Ruan Jingtao. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the New Stele
quests.summary: The freshly carved oath stele needs spirit stones set into its base, a small warding tradition Elder Bai insists on.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, then a fourth to be safe) {senior}! Sorry. You're very high up now. It's hard not to bow.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me spirit stones from the spirit peach orchard.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you, by the way. I always bet on you. I've bought four hats.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the spirit peach orchard
See Lu Ping again

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nobody tells the gate disciple anything. So I listen. Constantly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Twelve, Growing Up
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve, now considerably less new, ask to be sent on their first solo patrol of the quieter mountain.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My twelve want a real patrol. Alone. No me. I said yes. I might have cried a little. They're growing up. It's happening too fast.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Steward Qian.

objectives.text: Talk with Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Sect Master. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name, and all of them are mine.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Ancestor Zhao. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Training Puppets, the Quiet Drill
quests.summary: With the crowds gone, the training ground returns to its normal rhythm, and the puppets get their normal workout.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Clear the training ground of training puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Training puppets ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the outer dormitories
Compare notes with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Lu Ping. Lu Ping won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (hiding behind Wei Tong) Oh.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

quests.title: Incense for the New Precepts Stele
quests.summary: The gate's two steles, old and new, receive incense together for the first time, a small ceremony Steward Qian insists on documenting.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring me incense bundles from the sect gate. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

objectives.text: Collect incense bundles around the sect gate
Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

objectives.choice_prompt: The incense bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Ninth Bolt, Researched
quests.summary: Elder Bai searches every record for what the founder said about the ninth bolt of tribulation. He finds almost nothing.

objectives.text: Search the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the sword tomb the rusted blades hum faintly as you pass, as if some of them still remember a name.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sword in the stone is cold and humming. For a moment you hear its last owner's oath, word for word.

objectives.text: Show Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: She wrote one line, once, and never again: 'the ninth bolt asks a question the others don't.' Then nothing. For the rest of her life.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Any Iron Scale colours among them? Tell me honestly. I would rather know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Han Xue's Training Plan
quests.summary: Han Xue draws up a training plan for the years before your tribulation, ruthlessly practical and slightly terrifying.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Every day between now and your tribulation is accounted for. Yes, including rest days. Especially rest days. Rest is scheduled now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Han Xue is right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Abbess Jing.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

objectives.text: Join Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries, and in gold.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to Abbess Jing) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Sparring Disciples, the New Rhythm
quests.summary: The training ground settles into its post-conclave rhythm, with sparring disciples testing the new normal.

objectives.text: Examine the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three legs, two handles, and a rim of ancient script: the bronze ding is older than the hall that shelters it.

objectives.text: Fight off the sparring disciples

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Sparring disciples! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the spirit peach orchard
Talk it over with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ha. Zhao Kang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Letters for the First Monthly Round
quests.summary: Steward Qian prepares the sect's own monthly letter to send back to all forty allied sects, insisting on excellent penmanship.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring me sealed letters from the medicine valley. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Abbess Jing. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the medicine valley
Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more sealed letters than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Hermit's Question
quests.summary: Lan Jue asks you, quietly, whether you're afraid of the ninth bolt, now that you know it's coming.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Are you afraid?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. But I was afraid of the mirror too. And the bath. And the rings. Afraid hasn't stopped me yet.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good answer. Also true. Both things heaven likes to see.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

quests.title: Letters From Forty Mountains
quests.summary: A month later, forty letters arrive on time. Steward Qian reads them all aloud at dinner. Nobody minds.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian out

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty letters! On time! The Iron Scale's training! The Moon-Well's singing! The Zhao clan's rich! The Hundred Wells has a new well!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Wei Tong. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've never been so happy to count anything. Forty. Every month. For as long as it takes.

objectives.text: Head to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the pill kiln yard is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The beasts were restless all night. Beasts know things before people do.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

reply.speaker: keeper_ling
reply.text: (muttering, to Wei Tong) That was cold.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A School in the Ruins
quests.summary: The hermit has turned the Verdant Lotus ruins into a school. Three hundred young disciples from forty sects. One old man.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred children. Forty sects. One old man. And you. Mostly you. I'm very old. I get tired after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Fan Rui is not wrong. Fan Rui is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.text: Trace the rune pillar at the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins' courtyard is full of children in forty colours, sitting in rows, arguing about which verse of the sutra is best.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl up the rune pillar like ivy made of light. One of them is carved backward.

objectives.text: Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They're arguing. About the sutra. Three hundred years of silence in these ruins and now they're arguing. It's the best sound I've ever heard.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Abbess Jing says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to the hermit) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Teaching Roots
quests.summary: Your first lesson: the root. Patience. Three hundred children are not patient.

objectives.text: Go and see Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm helping teach! I'm teaching roots! Patience! They're very impatient about patience!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Xiao Man. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the waterwheel

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'm teaching them to count breaths. Four in, four out. The Iron Scale children count loudly. The Moon-Well children sing it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Liu Er. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the waterwheel

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I'm teaching herbs. I've only dropped four. The children think dropping is part of the lesson. I'm not correcting them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Hermit. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Old Sentinels, New Students
quests.summary: The ruins' old stone sentinels don't understand children. The children want to fight them. Carefully.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The sentinels woke up when the children arrived. They think it's an invasion. It kind of is. Show the students how. Carefully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Xiao Shi. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Demonstrate on the old sentinels

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The old sentinels come on in silence.

objectives.text: Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The sentinels have sat down. The children are climbing them. The sentinels seem... happy? Can stone be happy? These look happy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: The earth god will hear of this. Loudly. We'll light the big incense.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Headman Kuang. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: headman_kuang
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Sutra Slips for Everyone
quests.summary: Every child needs a copy of the sutra. The hermit has one. The drowned archive has more, if someone will dive.

objectives.text: Report to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The archive under the courtyard. Dry now, mostly. There are copies of the sutra down there. Hundreds. Bring them up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The hermit knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Xiao Shi. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Carry sutra slips up from the archive
See the hermit again

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred copies. For three hundred children. My masters wrote these for a school that died. Now there's a school again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Han Xue. We were attentive.

objectives.choice_prompt: Copying the sutra for everyone breaks the Pagoda's rule against sharing its texts.

choices.text: Share them anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Ask Elder Bai for an exception

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Sell the copies

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Wolves Come to Class
quests.summary: The forest's wolves have come to see what the noise is. The children want to pet them. Some of them shouldn't be petted.

objectives.text: Make your way to the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey wolves at the edge of the clearing, curious. The children are delighted. One wolf has purple eyes.

objectives.text: Break the spirit wolves at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Gather the scared students
Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Void-touched wolves near children. I don't like it. I'll stay with the school. My own children can help. They know about being scared.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Children Teach
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children, once the Blood Moon's, now teach the alliance's children how to tell a trap from a friend.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Spring's teaching. River's teaching. Small Mountain's teaching the youngest ones to hide. He's very good at hiding. It's his gift.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Ye Wuming is right.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They were weapons once. Now they're teachers. That's the whole war, isn't it. Turning weapons into teachers.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well children are learning from Blood Moon children. Three hundred years ago that would have been a war. Now it's a class.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Ye Wuming. I asked who would go.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Teaching the Blossom
quests.summary: The last lesson is the blossom: compassion. The hermit asks you to teach it. He says he only just learned it himself.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The blossom. You teach it. I only learned it last year, from a hollow man. You've been living it since you were a child.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I'll brew something for the road. It tastes like boiled boots, but it works.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Qu Wanqing, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

objectives.text: Teach the blossom to three hundred children

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You don't explain it. You carry them, all three hundred, and let them feel it. One by one, they go quiet. Then they carry each other.

objectives.text: Return to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred children, carrying each other. In my masters' courtyard. I'm going to cry. I'm old. I'm allowed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: alchemist_qu
dialogue.text: I only explode things on purpose. Usually. Don't stand near the blue jar.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Qu Wanqing?

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Neither here nor there. Like me, mostly.

reply.speaker: alchemist_qu
reply.text: (to the hermit) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Unruly. The forest is unruly too, and it thrives.

quests.title: Wraiths at the School
quests.summary: Wraiths come for the school at night, drawn by three hundred young souls. The children stay calm. They were taught.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wraiths at the ruins! Three hundred children! Stay calm! ...They are calm. They're counting breaths. All of them. Together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Wei Tong said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Raise the old Verdant Lotus ward over the school

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ward rises green over the courtyard, stronger than ever, fed by three hundred children counting breaths at once.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came to bring food for three hundred children and walked into a battle. The children are fine. The food is fine. I'm fine. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Wei Tong says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Han Xue agrees. It must be true.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Hermit's Successor
quests.summary: The hermit has been watching one child especially: Qiu Hua, Wei Tong's disciple, the girl with the chicken.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Qiu Hua. The girl with the chicken. She reached the blossom today. Nine years old. It took me three hundred.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Liu Er. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Read Qiu Hua's sutra copy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the margin of her sutra copy, in a nine-year-old's hand: the chicken is also carrying me. Beside it, a drawing of a chicken.

objectives.text: Go back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She'll teach it after me. The Verdant Lotus has a future. A future that brings a chicken to class. My masters would approve.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering to the hermit) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: Old Sentinels, a Second Wave
quests.summary: More of the ruins' old sentinels wake, drawn by the school's activity, and need the same careful handling.

objectives.text: Beat the war drum at the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The skin of the war drum is tight and ancient. One beat, and your heart falls into step with it.

objectives.text: Defeat the old sentinels at the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The old sentinels have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather star iron at the old battlefield
Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: We're done at the ruins gate. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Sometimes the rules are the cage. I know.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Rune Fragments From the Drowned Archive
quests.summary: Deeper in the drowned archive, rune fragments turn up among the sutra slips, worth studying separately.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Bring me rune fragments from the buried temple. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

objectives.text: Pick up rune fragments near the buried temple
Report back to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm standing right here, you know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the rune fragments you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Xiao Man's Chicken Diplomacy
quests.summary: Xiao Man, delighted by Qiu Hua's chicken-inclusive theology, proposes the school adopt a mascot policy.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Man's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Every class should have a chicken! Or a wolf pup! Or something to carry that isn't a person! It's a very good teaching tool!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Liu Er. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Meet Abbess Jing at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the village shrine. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Xiao Man. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the lake pavilion.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Abbess Jing. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Void-Touched Wolves, Gently Handled
quests.summary: The purple-eyed wolf from the clearing needs careful handling, not violence, given how many children are watching.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Drive the spirit wolves from the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Collect blood lotus around the poison marsh
Compare notes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (whispering to Ye Wuming) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the School's Garden
quests.summary: The children want to start a garden of their own at the ruins, and Xiao Man helps them gather the first herbs.

objectives.text: Report to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me spirit herbs from the hidden valley. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the hidden valley
Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) No argument.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Small Mountain Teaches Hiding
quests.summary: Small Mountain's hiding lessons turn out to be more popular than expected, and he asks for help structuring a real class.

objectives.text: Scout the alchemist's cottage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Small Mountain says hiding isn't about disappearing. It's about choosing when to be seen. The children take this more seriously than expected.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Show Liu Er what you found

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the far forest gate isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says I have to be polite to immortals. Hello, immortal!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (hiding behind Liu Er) Oh.

quests.title: Liu Er's Report Card
quests.summary: Liu Er, now an assistant teacher, writes his first report cards, and admits he's more nervous about this than any fight.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Grading children is scarier than bandits. What if I'm too harsh? What if I'm too soft? What if Qiu Hua's chicken grades better than half the class?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Abbess Jing. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing at the village shrine

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Liu Er. That was very... something.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the misty lake

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (tugging the hermit's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Wolves, the School's Curious Regulars
quests.summary: A few wolves have started attending class regularly, technically uninvited, and mostly harmless.

objectives.text: Study the map table at the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Clear the old bandit camp of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Recover wolf fangs from the tiger ridge
Talk it over with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Abbess Jing says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I ran from things like that once. Don't make me run again.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to the hermit, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Jade Slips for the School's Permanent Library
quests.summary: With the school confirmed to stay, Elder Bai wants a proper permanent library built in the ruins, starting with jade slips.

objectives.text: See what Abbess Jing wants

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me jade slips from the ruins gate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Han Xue. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Gather jade slips at the ruins gate
See Abbess Jing again

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Hermit?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more jade slips than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Children, Staying On
quests.summary: Spring, River and Small Mountain ask to stay at the school as permanent teachers rather than return to the sect full-time.

objectives.text: Hear Ye Wuming out

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They asked me first. I said it was their choice. They chose teaching. I think that's the best thing the Blood Moon never got to take from them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Xiao Shi.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Ye Wuming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (grinning at Xiao Shi) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: The School Stays
quests.summary: The alliance decides the school will stay. Every year, forty sects will send children to the Verdant Lotus ruins.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The school stays. Every year. Forty sects' children, in the Verdant Lotus ruins. The Moon-Well will send teachers. And songs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: headman_kuang
dialogue.text: Take one of our boys as a guide. The forest paths move when strangers walk them.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Headman Kuang, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the lake pavilion

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus is a school now. Not a sect. A school. That's better. Sects fall. Schools grow.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Xiao Shi. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to the hermit) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Forty Sects at the Rim
quests.summary: Forty sects' fighters gather at the Abyss rim. It's the largest army the world has seen in three hundred years.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty sects at the rim. Not to march. Not yet. To seal the rifts. To practise walking together. Carry them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The canyon rim is a sea of banners: green, gold, white, blue, and forty more. The fold hums below them like a disturbed hive.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Forty sects. At the rim. My children are crying. They never imagined anyone would come. Now everyone has.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not this time, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Fold-Born Guards
quests.summary: The fold feels forty sects at its edge, and spits out everything it has.

objectives.text: Answer Ruan Jingtao's summons

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're coming out of the fold! Guards made of nothing! Iron Scale, left flank! We practised this! On Remembering Hill!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Wei Tong. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Fight off the fold-born guards

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These fold-born guards fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths regrouping
Return to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Forty sects fighting as one. I've never seen anything like it. Nobody has. For three hundred years, nobody has.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Rift Shards for Forty Wards
quests.summary: Each sect needs a shard from the fold to anchor its ward. You gather them, one for each sect.

objectives.text: Report to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Each sect needs a shard to anchor its ward. Forty shards. Forty wards. One ring around the fold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

objectives.text: Gather forty shards from the fold's edge
Go back to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Forty shards, forty wards. The Moon-Well will sing while we set them. Everyone else will shout. It'll be very noisy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Abbess Jing, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Sect Master. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: Forty Wards Around the Fold
quests.summary: Forty sects set forty wards around the fold at once. You hold them all together.

objectives.text: Hurry to the bone throne

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty wards rise around the fold like a crown of light. Each one flickers. Each one needs someone to hold it steady.

objectives.text: Hold all forty wards at once

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hold them all. Forty sects, forty wards, one ring. The fold shudders, and shrinks, and for the first time since it formed, stops leaking.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It stopped. The fold stopped leaking. Forty sects did that. You did that. We all did that. I'm going to sit down on this bone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Han Xue will leave out. There is always a part.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Gu at the Rim
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, watches the forty wards rise. He asks to say something to the alliance.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I betrayed the Azure Cloud. I fed children to the Abyss. I altered the formation that killed Mo Changfeng.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Sect Master. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: And I am here, in chains, watching forty sects do what I thought was impossible. I was wrong about everything. That's all. Thank you.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the ash plains

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He asked me to let him say it. I let him. Some things should be said in front of everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Iron-Fang, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: The Fold's Guardian
quests.summary: The fold doesn't like the wards. Something enormous climbs out of it: a colossus of nothing, built to guard the door.

objectives.text: Go to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fold bulges. Out of it climbs a colossus of purple stone and nothing, taller than the canyon wall, eyes like holes in the sky.

objectives.name: The Fold's Guardian
objectives.text: Defeat The Fold's Guardian

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's huge! It's very, very huge! Forty sects, one giant! I like those odds! I'm lying! Hit it anyway!

objectives.text: Seal the colossus back into the fold

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The colossus falls, and the forty wards pull it back into the fold, and the fold closes behind it like a mouth closing on a secret.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty sects and a giant. Iron-Fang's men fought beside the Zhao clan. The Zhao clan paid us. In gold. We gave it back. We're honest now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemy's belongings: a manual of a forbidden blood technique.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Seal it in the Scripture Pagoda

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep it. Study it. Quietly.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: What's Left
