quests.summary: With the colossus sealed, the last wraiths wander the bone field, lost. The alliance hunts them together.

objectives.text: Read the map table at the war camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old war camp is overrun with lost wraiths, drifting, purposeless now that the fold has stopped feeding them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map table is pinned with flags and scattered with notes. Someone has marked a route in red, recently.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the war camp

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: More void wraiths? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Gather the demon cores they leave
Tell Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I brought food for forty sects! To the Abyss! It's a very bad place for a picnic! We're having one anyway!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: On the bone field: Blood Moon survivors, old men and women, begging for passage.

choices.text: Take them in

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Register them for the alliance's judgement

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: A Picnic in the Abyss
quests.summary: Wei Tong's picnic for forty sects on the bone field is the strangest meal anyone has ever eaten. Everyone attends.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumplings for forty sects! On the bone field! It's disgusting here! Eat anyway! For morale! For Elder Mo!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Wei Tong is right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Abbess Jing agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Hand out Wei Tong's dumplings
Raise a cup at the rim with forty sects

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, eating dumplings on a field of bones, under a sky the colour of a bruise. Somebody laughs. Then everybody laughs.

objectives.text: Speak with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: A picnic. In the Abyss. The Moon-Well will sing about this for a hundred years. It'll be a very strange song.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Picnic's Uninvited Guests
quests.summary: A handful of void wraiths, drawn by forty sects' worth of laughter, crash the picnic and are politely but firmly removed.

objectives.text: Examine the soul lantern at the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The soul lantern hums with a trapped voice. You break the rune, and the flame goes out, gently.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Pick up demon cores near the skull tower
Compare notes with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Sect Master. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Wei Tong does enough for three.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Bone Field's Edge
quests.summary: The picnic's aftermath leaves demon cores scattered at the bone field's edge, worth a final gathering pass.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Bring me demon cores from the corpse forest. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Noted, Zhao Kang. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Collect demon cores around the corpse forest
Report back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Was anyone hungry, there? Was anyone afraid? Did you notice?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Answer Abbess Jing, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more demon cores than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Toast
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao proposes a toast at the picnic, awkward and sincere, to the strangest meal the Iron Scale has ever attended.

objectives.text: Speak with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: To dumplings, on bones, under a bruised sky, with people I once wouldn't have shared a table with. To the Great Vehicle. Cheers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ignore Iron-Fang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang. Your clan's banner is crooked.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ruan Jingtao. Your sect's mountain is short.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Rim's Final Test
quests.summary: A last handful of blood guards, driven out by the sealed fold, tests the rim's new alliance-held wards.

objectives.text: Examine the puppet frame at the training pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Someone has scratched a tally of defeats into the puppet frame. The puppet is winning.

objectives.text: Defeat the fold-born guards at the training pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fold-born guards spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Find the demon cores at the training pit
Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Don't make a habit of it, Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's my kind of justice. The quick kind.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Sealed Fold's Edge
quests.summary: The freshly sealed fold sheds a final harvest of void shards, worth gathering before it goes fully quiet.

objectives.text: Go and see Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me void shards from the obsidian spires, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Iron-Fang?

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the obsidian spires
Bring word to Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: More or less. Mostly less.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Abbess Jing) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Abbess Jing) That was cold.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Children at the Rim
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children, watching the fold seal for the first time, ask when their families inside might finally come home.

objectives.text: Investigate the cave of echoes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cave of echoes repeats your breathing, then your heartbeat, then something you only thought.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Soon, I hope. Sealed isn't the same as opened. But sealed means it can't get worse. That's something. I'm learning to take something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Any Iron Scale colours among them? Tell me honestly. I would rather know.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Tell it short.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Admission
quests.summary: Zhao Kang admits, over dumplings, that he never expected to feel at home fighting beside people from forty different sects.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A year ago I only knew my own clan and Frost Sword Peak. Now I know Iron Scale disciples' names. Their birthdays, some of them. Strange.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

objectives.text: Talk with Ruan Jingtao at the seal stones

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: No, Sect Master. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It... reconsiders.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the red moon terrace

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Han Xue is right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Last Purposeless
quests.summary: The last of the fold's lost wraiths, wandering without direction, are gently cleared before the alliance heads home.

objectives.text: Check the accounts at the abacus desk at the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The abacus desk is covered in neat figures. Between them, in a smaller hand, someone has written a name.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the sulphur vents

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the corpse forest
Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The corpse forest is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha. Ruan Jingtao's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Medicine for Forty Sects' Journey Home
quests.summary: Forty sects need medicine and supplies for the long walk back to their own mountains and rivers.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the beast pens. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. The Sect Master is right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the beast pens
See the Sect Master again

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Gu's Quiet Thanks
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, still in chains, thanks Yun Zhi privately for letting him speak in front of the alliance.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Nobody had to let a traitor speak. You did. I don't deserve it. I'm grateful for it anyway. That's the whole of what's left of me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No, Ye Wuming. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Elder Gu is right.

objectives.text: Join Abbess Jing at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Ye Wuming. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (to Ye Wuming, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: A Vehicle for Ten Thousand
quests.summary: At the rim, with forty sects around you and the fold sealed below, you carry them all, and your Body Integration reaches Great Perfection.

objectives.text: Carry ten thousand in the stillness of the depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ten thousand souls. Forty sects. Villages beyond them. You carry them all, and far above, heaven's attention settles on you like weather.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Great Perfection of Body Integration. The sky is leaning down to look at you. Your tribulation is gathering.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I felt it. Heaven, looking at you. The whole alliance felt it. Your tribulation isn't years away any more. It's gathering.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Iron-Fang, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Heaven Takes Notice
quests.summary: On the way home, the sky over the sect is strange: clouds turning slowly in a spiral, directly above your room.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The clouds over the sect are spiralling. Directly over your room. Wei Tong says it's weather. It's not weather.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Down here everything has a price. Especially directions. These ones are free. Once.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's heaven. Taking notice. Qing Luan was right. The last stage before the sky is starting. Tribulation Transcendence.

objectives.text: Search the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lanterns of human skin light the shadow market. The haggling is quiet and very polite.

objectives.text: Check the wine jars

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jars are sealed with clay and stamped. One seal is fresh, though the jar is very old.

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the black barracks

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Worry later, Ye Wuming. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Stair Without Waiting
quests.summary: A stair of cloud unrolls over the sect, years early, for no one but you. The whole mountain comes out in its nightclothes again.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The stair! Again! Years early! Everyone's in their nightclothes again! Elder Bai's still got the turtles!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhao Kang. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair of cloud descends from the spiral above your room, step by step, and stops at your feet. Only yours.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the dragon bones

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Heaven opened my isles for you. Without asking me. Rude. Also flattering. Mostly rude. Come in.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You've caught heaven's eye, lotus child. That's either the best thing that can happen to a cultivator, or the last.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Spiral Over the Mountain
quests.summary: From the isles, Qing Luan shows you the spiral in the clouds from above. It is centred exactly on you.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below the isles, a spiral of cloud turns over the Azure Cloud Sect, slow and vast. At its centre, the roof of your room.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Read heaven's spiral on the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chart shows the spiral too, and within it, nine faint rings. Nine bolts. One ring is brighter than the rest: the ninth. The heart.

objectives.text: Tell Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Nine bolts. Like your founder's. The ninth is the heart. She never told anyone what it was. I watched. I didn't understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

quests.title: Storm Wolves Gather
quests.summary: Heaven's attention charges the isles. The storm wolves are crackling, restless, drawn to you like iron to a lodestone.

objectives.text: Draw qi from the spirit stone at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves pace the spirit vein, fur crackling, eyes fixed on you. Every one of them is humming the same note as the clouds.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You rest your hand on the spirit stone. It is warm, and it is humming a very old song.

objectives.text: Clear the spirit vein of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Gather the charged crystals they guard
Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The wolves are following you. The lightning is following you. Everything's following you. I'm following you. It's a parade.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't mind Zhao Kang. He says rude things when he's fond of people.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I say rude things when they're true.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Qing Luan Is Worried
quests.summary: Qing Luan is worried. She never worries. She's a memory. Memories don't worry.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I'm worried. I don't worry. I'm ten thousand years old and I've never worried. It's very uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Qing Luan says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Heaven's early. The Patriarch is waiting. The Seventh Rung is somewhere. And you're very young to be struck by lightning.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we prepare. Crystals. Rods. Training. Everything. Early. Like heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Scribe Shu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: recorder_shu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Standing Where Heaven Looks
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to stand on the isle where heaven's eye is brightest and let it look. Not fight it. Be seen.

objectives.text: Go and see Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Let heaven look at you. Don't hide. Don't fight. Be seen. Heaven hates being hidden from. It punishes that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Qing Luan, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Let heaven look at you

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sky looks at you. Not the clouds. Behind the clouds. Something vast and not unkind, weighing you the way a teacher weighs a student.

objectives.text: Return to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It liked what it saw. I think. Heaven's very hard to read. It frowned. That's good. It frowns at people it's interested in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Zhao Kang. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: Sentinels That Know
quests.summary: The palace sentinels know what heaven's eye means. They come to test whether you deserve it.

objectives.text: Answer Yan Tie's summons

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came up the stair! We're here for the lightning! Where's the lightning? Oh. Sentinels. Also fine!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Qingyi said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Fight off the celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Celestial sentinels ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Hold the jade bridge against more storm wolves
Go back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: They bowed. After we beat them. The sentinels bowed to you. Thunder Peak has never been bowed to by a building.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade
quests.summary: Qing Luan says tribulations leave jade behind: the ground remembers lightning. There are old seams on the peak's slopes.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Tribulation jade. Where lightning struck cultivators before you, the ground turned to jade. It remembers. It can teach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: Walk slowly on the isles. Haste offends the cranes, and the cranes carry grudges for centuries.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to Warden He. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Gather tribulation jade from the old strikes
Report back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hold one. Feel it? That's someone's third bolt, ten thousand years ago. They survived. The jade is proud of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Yan Tie?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: The richest seam of tribulation jade runs under a village shrine on the slope.

choices.text: Leave the shrine alone

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Buy the land properly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Dig it up anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: The Peak From Afar
quests.summary: From the isle of winds, you look at the tribulation peak. It's quiet. Black rings. And someone standing on it.

objectives.text: Head to the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Across the gap, the tribulation peak. Black rings on the summit. And on the highest ring, very small, a figure in dark red, looking back.

objectives.text: Look at the figure through the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chart shows the seventh red star directly over the peak. The figure beneath it waves, once, and steps into a rift, and is gone.

objectives.text: Show Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Seventh Rung. On my peak. Looking at you. The Patriarch's Shadow. Nobody's seen them. Until now. Now they want to be seen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd have grunted and looked away. That's how he said proud. I'll just say it. Proud!

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Wei Tong says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Heaven's Timetable
quests.summary: Qing Luan says she can't tell when the tribulation will come. Only that it's closer than anyone thought.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A year. Two. Less. Heaven doesn't keep calendars. It keeps promises. It's promised you lightning. It'll deliver.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes circled the wrong way this morning. They know weather before heaven does.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Prepare. And before you prepare, break through. You're ready. You've been ready since the Great Vehicle.

objectives.text: Make your way to the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the crane isle, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Han Xue has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even the Sect Master agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Second Gathering
quests.summary: A second, larger gathering of storm wolves arrives, drawn even more strongly by heaven's attention overhead.

objectives.text: Charge the rune pillar at the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune pillar is cracked along one rune. Whoever did it knew exactly where to strike.

objectives.text: Break the storm wolves at the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Storm wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Collect cloud silk around the storm plateau
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A star just blinked. It was about you. I'm almost certain.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Qing Luan. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Cloud Silk for the Coming Storm
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks for cloud silk to be gathered now, before the real tribulation storm makes the isles too dangerous to harvest.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Wei Tong. A poor master.

objectives.text: Find the cloud silk at the cloud harbour
Bring word to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Elder Yan's Excitement
quests.summary: Elder Yan, thrilled beyond words at the idea of a real tribulation, has to be talked out of trying to stand in the lightning himself.

objectives.text: Hear Yan Tie out

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Just once! Just one bolt! For Thunder Peak! ...Fine. Fine. I'll watch. From very close. Very, very close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Qing Luan. That's my job.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the Tree of Ages. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Yan Tie. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the Seal of Heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Scribe Shu. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, Bowing Again
quests.summary: More palace sentinels wake and bow, this time without needing to fight first, recognizing heaven's mark on you.

objectives.text: Examine the bronze ding at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the rim of the bronze ding by touch. It lists the names of those who made an oath around it.

objectives.text: Stop the celestial sentinels at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The celestial sentinels come on in silence.

objectives.text: Recover thunder crystals from the palace court
Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit. Look up. Try not to fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade, a Second Vein
quests.summary: A second vein of tribulation jade turns up on the peak's far slope, older and deeper than the first.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me tribulation jade from the golden lotus lake. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Worry for both of us, if you must.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Gather tribulation jade at the golden lotus lake
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Yan Tie. Yan Tie won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the tribulation jade you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Founder's Old Jade
quests.summary: Among the tribulation jade, one piece is warmer than the rest: it remembers the Azure Cloud's own founder, three hundred years gone.

objectives.text: Scout the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the hall of records not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Tell Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That one's hers. Your founder's third bolt. I felt her survive it. I felt how much it cost her. Hold it gently.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Nerves, Named
quests.summary: Zhao Kang finally admits, out loud, that watching you prepare for tribulation frightens him more than any Rung has.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A Rung, I can hit. Heaven, I can't. I don't know how to protect you from the sky. That's a new kind of scared for me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the floating forest

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the floating forest

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The Sect Master thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Noted, Han Xue. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Charged Vein's Guard
quests.summary: The spirit vein's charged wolves grow bolder as the tribulation approaches, testing anyone who comes near.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks at the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Defeat the storm wolves at the thunder isle

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Pick up thunder crystals near the sword isle
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes bowed to you. They bowed to the last immortal once, then took it back.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Warden He's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Isles' Wards
quests.summary: Qing Luan wants the isles' old wards reinforced with fresh spirit stones before the tribulation storm arrives in full.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me spirit stones from the crystal isle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Zhao Kang, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the crystal isle
Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hmph. Reasonable. Annoyingly.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Han Xue's Question About the Ninth Bolt
quests.summary: Han Xue asks Qing Luan directly what she thinks the ninth bolt actually asks, since the founder never said.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I don't know. Ten thousand years and I don't know. But I know it asks something, not just hurts something. That's different, and worse.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Scribe Shu has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the peach garden

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Yan Tie. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Scribe Shu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: recorder_shu
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Mahayana
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, under heaven's eye, you take the last step before the sky: preparing to transcend.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Mahayana. The Great Vehicle, as a realm. Everyone you carry, carrying you. Sit at the gate. Let heaven's eye fill you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Qing Luan has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

objectives.text: Set tribulation jade around the gate
Open yourself to heaven's eye

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Heaven's eye settles on you, and you don't flinch. Qi, soul, body, vehicle: everything you are rises to meet it, and holds.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Far above, very faint, the first rumble of a storm that has been gathering for ten thousand years, and is gathering for you.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Mahayana

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The storm is vast and oddly quiet. It falls on everyone you carry, and through them, on you.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mahayana. The first in three hundred years. The storm's gathering. So are we. Come home. We've work to do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Qing Luan. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Bai's Delta
quests.summary: Elder Bai has read every book on tribulations. His plan: split the lightning like a river delta, with crystals.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Split the lightning! Like a river delta! Crystals on the summit, drawing off the bolts! Your founder did it! I think! The page is smudged!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Old Qiu. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals. The strongest. From the isles. Go. I'll draw the delta. On my ceiling. Next to Xiao Shi's map.

objectives.text: Draw qi from the spirit stone at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit vein glitters with crystals, blue and humming. You'll need ninety-nine. There are, at a guess, ninety-eight.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit stone drinks your qi and glows, then gives it back doubled, like an honest merchant.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine? Your librarian is an optimist. The vein will give what it can. Ask nicely. It remembers the rust.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: No, Yan Tie. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Asking the Vein Nicely
quests.summary: The spirit vein remembers the Rust Monk, and you, who healed it. It gives its crystals freely.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It remembers you healed it. It's giving you its best. Take them gently. They're very old and very proud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

objectives.text: Harvest crystals from the grateful vein
Go back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Forty. The vein gave forty of its best. It's never given anyone more than three. It likes you. Everything likes you. It's exhausting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more thunder crystals than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

quests.title: Shadows at the Vein
quests.summary: Shadow-born things step out of rifts at the vein, grabbing crystals. The Seventh Rung wants them too.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Shadows! Out of the rifts! Grabbing crystals! Whoever the Seventh Rung is, they want your delta broken before you build it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Qing Luan. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of shadow-born
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They took three. Only three. We'll need more. The Seventh Rung is playing a very long game. So are we.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

quests.title: Storm Wolf Crystals
quests.summary: The storm wolves carry crystals in their fur. They'll let them go, if you're faster than lightning.

objectives.text: Hurry to the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves race across the Isle of Winds, crystals glittering in their fur like frost. They're very fast. So are you now.

objectives.text: Clear the Isle of Winds of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Gather the crystals the wolves shed
Show Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You outran a storm wolf! Thunder Peak has been trying for three hundred years! We're carving it on the forge! Next to your name!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Zhao Kang. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Crystal Heart
quests.summary: At the vein's deepest point, beneath the ruins, lies a crystal heart that can charge all the others at once.

objectives.text: Go to the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the ruins, a cavern of blue light. At its centre, a crystal the size of a house, beating slowly, like a heart.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Over there. See? Someone tried to hide their tracks and did it badly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. And they wanted it found. That worries me more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Stay close. Both of you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

objectives.text: Gather the shards around the crystal heart
Charge the crystals at the heart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You set the crystals around the heart. It beats faster. Each crystal brightens with its pulse until they all beat together.

objectives.text: Fight off the celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The heart's ancient guardians stir on the old serpent's isle, and come to see who woke it.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The charged crystals hum in your pack like a hive of lightning. Ninety of them. Nearly enough.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

quests.title: The Jiao Remembers
quests.summary: A shadow passes over the isles: a great serpent, storm-grey, circling. The Jiao you freed has come back.

objectives.text: Go and see Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Jiao! It's come back! It remembers you! Look, it's carrying something in its claws!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Zhao Kang, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.
