reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Jiao circles once and drops nine crystals at your feet, each as large as a fist and humming with stored storm. Then it bows its great head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, great one. We're even now.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Jiao rumbles, which might be a laugh, and sinks into the clouds.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

quests.title: Ninety-Nine
quests.summary: Ninety crystals from the vein and the wolves, nine from the Jiao. Ninety-nine. Exactly what Elder Bai asked for.

objectives.text: Count the ninety-nine crystals

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals, each humming a different note. Together they sound like the sky clearing its throat.

objectives.text: Investigate the dragon bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the humming, faint, one crystal is off-key. A shadow is curled inside it, very small, listening.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A shadow in a crystal. Listening. The Seventh Rung put a spy in our delta. Crush it. No. Wait. Let it listen. Let's tell it lies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Lies for a Shadow
quests.summary: Han Xue has a plan: let the Seventh Rung's spy hear a false plan. Wei Tong is terrible at lying. That's why it'll work.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Talk near the crystal. Loudly. Say the delta goes on the eastern slope. It'll go on the western one. The shadow will report east.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The delta goes on the EASTERN slope! The EASTERN one! Definitely not the western one! I've never heard of the western one!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's perfect. That's the worst lie I've ever heard. They'll believe it completely.

objectives.choice_prompt: To fool Xue Chen's shadows, you must lie to your own disciples too.

choices.text: Lie, and apologise afterwards

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Tell them the truth and trust them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair. Fair's good. Can we eat now?

choices.text: Use them as unknowing bait

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Wei Tong) That was cold.

quests.title: Carrying Crystals Down
quests.summary: Carrying ninety-nine charged crystals down the cloud stair, with shadows snapping at your heels.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals down a staircase made of cloud with shadows chasing us. I've had worse days. I can't remember when.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the rainbow bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Finish the storm wolves at the Immortal Palace gate
Talk with Qing Luan at the moon isle

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Down you go. Keep them dry. Keep them humming. And tell your librarian the delta was a good idea. It was your founder's, too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Wei Tong has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: Walk slowly on the isles. Haste offends the cranes, and the cranes carry grudges for centuries.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: warden_he
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Vein's Last Guard
quests.summary: A last cluster of shadow-born things lingers near the drained vein, reluctant to give up the search for crystals.

objectives.text: Touch the crane statue at the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Cranes circle the crane statue and settle on it one by one, as if it were their elder.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the cloud harbour

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

objectives.text: Find the tribulation jade at the sword isle
Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We're done at the sun altar. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Tribulation Jade From the Crystal Cavern
quests.summary: The cavern around the crystal heart holds tribulation jade too, worth gathering before it's sealed again.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me tribulation jade from the crystal isle.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak always says hello loudly, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Recover tribulation jade from the crystal isle
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the tribulation jade you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Elder Bai's Delta Diagram
quests.summary: Elder Bai insists on showing you his full delta diagram before the crystals go in the ground, checking every angle personally.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine points, each one calculated from the smudged page and a lot of guessing. If I'm wrong, I'm wrong beautifully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The isles have been restless. Even the rice leans away from the wind now.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Qingyi. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the waterfall isle

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Elder Bai.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the mirror lake

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Yan Tie. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars disagree. The stars often disagree. I side with you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, the Ruins' Guard
quests.summary: A pair of celestial sentinels, disturbed by the crystal heart's awakening, need calming before the harvest is complete.

objectives.text: Draw qi from the spirit stone at the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You rest your hand on the spirit stone. It is warm, and it is humming a very old song.

objectives.text: Defeat the celestial sentinels at the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These celestial sentinels fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Gather thunder crystals at the crystal isle
Tell Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Wei Tong does enough for three.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Star Iron From the Heart's Chamber
quests.summary: The chamber around the crystal heart holds star iron deposits, worth harvesting while the guardians are calm.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me star iron from the sky ship wreck.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

objectives.text: Pick up star iron near the sky ship wreck
See Qing Luan again

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Wei Tong says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes bowed to you. They bowed to the last immortal once, then took it back.

objectives.choice_prompt: The star iron came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Qing Luan, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Jiao's Old Wound
quests.summary: Before it leaves, the Jiao shows you an old scar on its flank, from the storm wolf king's fight years ago.

objectives.text: Search the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Jiao's scar has healed clean. It nudges your hand with its huge head, once, and you understand it's saying thank you, still, after all this time.

objectives.text: Search the scroll rack

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The scroll rack creaks under a century of learning. The scroll you need is behind the scroll everyone takes.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the peach garden isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. Qingyi's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak says hello. Loudly. It always does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the rules! Clean as a duel!

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Wild! I like it. Don't tell the elders I said so.

quests.title: Yan Tie's Carving Request
quests.summary: Elder Yan formally requests that outrunning a storm wolf be added permanently to the forge's carved achievements.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: It's official now! Carved in stone! 'Outran a storm wolf, Thunder Peak witnessed it personally'! History has been made!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Delta's Test
quests.summary: A final test: storm wolves circle the crystal cache, checking whether the ninety-nine can hold against real lightning.

objectives.text: Head to the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Light breaks into colours across the crystal isle. Your shadow is a rainbow here.

objectives.text: Drive the storm wolves from the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: More storm wolves? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Collect thunder crystals around the crystal isle
Show Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Pagoda's Crystal Shelf
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants a proper shelf built for the ninety-nine crystals, reinforced with spirit stones so they don't roll off in his excitement.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (does not smile) {player}. The righteous path has a narrow gate. Mind you still fit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me spirit stones from the thunder isle.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Wei Tong. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I have read everything in the pagoda twice, and the recipes three times.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the thunder isle
Return to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A star just blinked. It was about you. I'm almost certain.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Spy Report
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, inspired by Wei Tong's terrible lying, writes an equally terrible fake report to leave where a shadow might find it.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I wrote that the delta has a hundred crystals, not ninety-nine, and one is cursed. Completely made up. Very convincing, I think.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Qing Luan. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yan Tie, lower your voice. The mountain is asleep.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: THE MOUNTAIN LIKES ME, ZHAO KANG.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Yan Tie says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Qing Luan said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Crystals in the Pagoda
quests.summary: Elder Bai stores the ninety-nine crystals in the pagoda, under the ceiling map. The pagoda hums all night.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals! In my pagoda! Humming! I can't sleep! I don't want to sleep! I'm going to read by them!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Elder Bai said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The eastern slope! I told the shadow the eastern slope! Did it work? Han Xue says it worked. I'm a spy now. A terrible spy. The best terrible spy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Zhong Ming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Shadows Drinking at the Rim
quests.summary: Ye Wuming sends Spring with a message: shadows are drinking blood from the fold's edge, and something is watching them.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shadows at the rim. Drinking from the fold's edge. The Seventh Rung's. And something's watching them drink. Someone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Iron-Fang. Iron-Fang's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

objectives.text: Make your way to the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the rim, shadow-born things crouch at the fold's edge, lapping at the dark. Something else watches from the obelisk ring. Very still.

objectives.text: Go back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Forty sects' wards held the fold for a year. The shadows are wearing them thin. Drinking them. Someone taught them how.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Xiao Shi.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. The road taught you that.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Shadow-Born
quests.summary: The shadow-born things are made of the Patriarch's own darkness. They're faster than wraiths, and they don't fear light.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: These don't flinch at wards! These don't flinch at anything! These are new! I hate new!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Han Xue. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

objectives.text: Clear the sacrificial pit of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Guards that follow
Join Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're made of him. The Patriarch. His own shadow, cut into pieces. The Seventh Rung isn't just his servant. They're his shadow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Watcher at the Ring
quests.summary: At the obelisk ring, a young man in dark red sits on a stump, watching. He doesn't wave. He bows.

objectives.text: Scout the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A young man in dark red sits on an obelisk stump. Red eyes. A face that looks almost familiar. He stands, and bows, very correctly.

objectives.text: Look at the young man with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight he is two things at once: a young man, frightened, and a shadow cast by something enormous behind the fold.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Xue Chen

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: Xue Chen. Seventh Rung. The Patriarch's Shadow. I was born in his shadow. I've never been anywhere else. I wanted to see you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep your hands where I can see them. All of them.

dialogue.speaker: acolyte_hei
dialogue.text: Your friends are loud. The Abyss likes loud things. They echo so nicely.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: You're the one who writes back. And gives rain. And carries spiders. He's very curious about you. So am I.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I've heard you. Now hear me: no.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Mercy. How exhausting it must be, being you.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Rules. The Patriarch had rules too. Ask his victims how they helped.

reply.speaker: acolyte_hei
reply.text: Obedient little heir.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Oh, you'd have done well in the Abyss. Think about it.

quests.title: Willow Creek
quests.summary: Xue Chen says a name that stops your heart: Willow Creek. He was born there, too. Before he was taken.

objectives.text: Hear Xue Chen out

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. I was born there. Taken at three. My mother was a cousin of yours, I think. Everyone there was someone's cousin.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I know your kind. I used to take your money. Talk fast.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: The Patriarch raised me in his shadow. I've never seen the sun properly. It's very bright. I don't like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could leave his shadow.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...No. I'm the last rung. Without me, he falls. He's the only father I've ever had. I'll see you at the peak, cousin.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the ruined sect gate. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the lava falls.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Iron-Fang. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Mercy. I forgot how it looks.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: The Shadow Leaves
quests.summary: Xue Chen steps into a rift, and his shadow-born cover his escape.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: He's gone! Into a rift! His shadows are everywhere! Iron-Fang's men, hold the rim!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

objectives.text: Fight off the shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping
Report back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: A boy. The last rung is a boy. Taken at three. Like my men's children. Like Ye's children. I don't want to hit a boy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging Iron-Fang's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Gu Knew Him
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains at the rim, says he knew Xue Chen as a child. He tried to save him. He failed.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Xue Chen. I saw him once, when he was five. In the Patriarch's shadow. I tried to take him out with Lan's soul. I failed at both.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Elder Gu thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Han Xue. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He's not evil. He's never been anywhere else. The Patriarch is his whole world. Breaking him will break a child.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the soul forge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I was that child. Once. Nobody broke me. Somebody stole me back. Maybe that's the answer. Not breaking. Stealing.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Iron-Fang. Doesn't change anything.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Shadow's Trail
quests.summary: Xue Chen's shadow-born leave a trail of drained blood lotus toward the heart mirror. He's been visiting it.

objectives.text: Look into the bronze mirror at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Heart Mirror lies still and black. Around it, drained blood lotus, grey and brittle. Someone sits here often, looking in.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You look into the bronze mirror. Your face looks back, then, a moment later, a face that is not quite yours.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Gather the drained lotus around the mirror
Share your findings with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: He comes here to look at himself. In the mirror. I know that. I used to look at myself in puddles in the cage, to remember my face.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ye Wuming. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's what you did for me. Thank you. Again.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: What the Shadow Sees
quests.summary: You look into the Heart Mirror where Xue Chen sits. It shows you what he sees there.

objectives.text: Hurry to the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mirror shows a boy of three, in Willow Creek, holding his mother's hand, laughing. The mirror shows it over and over.

objectives.text: Look at Xue Chen's reflection

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: That's what he comes to see. Not a monster. Not a rung. A boy in a village by a creek, with his mother, before the shadow.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He comes to see himself before. Every day. That's the saddest thing I've ever heard. Don't cry. I'm not crying either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Iron-Fang. Iron-Fang won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Steal Him Back
quests.summary: Ye Wuming says it again, on the way back: not breaking. Stealing back. Like someone stole him.

objectives.text: Answer Ye Wuming's summons

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When the time comes, try to steal him back. Before you break him. Like someone stole me. If it can't be done, then break him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: But try. Please. For the boy in the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll try, Ye Wuming. For the boy in the mirror.

objectives.text: Go to the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the deep mine shaft the air changes, heavy with qi and something older underneath.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Xiao Shi. I would not send {them} otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: Stealing the shadow back needs a relic from a Willow Creek grave.

choices.text: Ask the villagers' permission

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Borrow it at night and return it after

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Take it and keep it

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, Guarding the Mirror
quests.summary: A cluster of shadow-born things guards the approach to the Heart Mirror, protecting Xue Chen's private grief.

objectives.text: Check the wine jars at the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The smell from the wine jars is sweet and strong. Beneath it is something sharper, and not wine at all.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-born spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Recover blood lotus from the poison garden
Compare notes with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Rim's Watch
quests.summary: The fallen shadow-born and blood guards leave demon cores behind, worth gathering before the Abyss reclaims them.

objectives.text: Report to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me demon cores from the corpse forest, would you?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Gather demon cores at the corpse forest
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the demon cores you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Han Xue's Doubt
quests.summary: Han Xue asks whether stealing Xue Chen back is even possible, given how deep the Patriarch's shadow runs in him.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming was stolen back as a child, before the shadow set fully. Xue Chen's grown in it his whole life. I don't know if that's different. I hope not.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Down here everything has a price. Especially directions. These ones are free. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Ku the Broker. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the black barracks

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the blood river

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Shi. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering to Zhao Kang) That was amazing.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging Zhao Kang's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Fold's Reinforced Watch
quests.summary: The fold's watch has grown since Xue Chen's visit, reinforced blood guards testing the rim's defenses.

objectives.text: Mark the map table at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the map table. Three places are circled twice, and one has been scratched out so hard it tore.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Guards come on in silence.

objectives.text: Pick up demon cores near the watch spire
Show Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The red moon terrace is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Iron-Fang?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Shadow's Trail
quests.summary: The trail of drained lotus and shadow residue leaves void shards worth gathering for Elder Bai's study.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me void shards from the ash plains.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Collect void shards around the ash plains
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Gu's Old Attempt
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan describes, in painful detail, exactly how he tried and failed to steal the young Xue Chen away, hoping it helps this time.

objectives.text: Investigate the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wind whistles through the skull tower, and for a moment it sounds like thousands of people breathing.

objectives.text: Examine the soul lantern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You open the soul lantern. A breath of cold escapes, and a whisper that sounds like thank you.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I got as far as the outer camp. Lan's soul-shield held for one night. Then the Patriarch noticed. I ran. I've regretted running every day since.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Answer Ye Wuming, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Elder Gu does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Vow
quests.summary: Zhao Kang vows, quietly, that if it comes to a fight, he'll try to pull his blows, for a boy who never had a choice.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'll hit him if I have to. But I'll hit him like I'd hit a friend who's lost his mind, not an enemy. There's a difference. I'll find it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Ye Wuming. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Ring's Last Guard
quests.summary: A last watch of demon cultivators, left to guard the obelisk ring, retreats when the rim's defenders press forward.

objectives.text: Sort the scroll rack at the forbidden library

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dust lies thick on the scroll rack, except on one shelf, where a hand has been reaching often and recently.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the forbidden library

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Find the jade slips at the forbidden library
Share your findings with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Blood Lotus, the Mirror's Garden
quests.summary: More drained blood lotus grows around the mirror's edge, worth gathering to study what feeds and drains it.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me blood lotus from the poison garden.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

objectives.text: Recover blood lotus from the poison garden
Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Anyone try to buy you off? They always do. What did they offer?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a long story. The short version: yes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more blood lotus than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Own Mirror
quests.summary: Xiao Shi admits she understands Xue Chen's need to look at who he was before, since she once did the same with puddles.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I stopped looking, eventually. Not because it stopped hurting. Because I found people worth looking at instead. Maybe he needs that. People, not a mirror.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: See? Even Ye Wuming agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the red moon terrace

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Enough, Ye Wuming. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Elder Gu knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (hiding behind Elder Gu) Oh.

quests.title: Thinking of Willow Creek
quests.summary: At the rim, you sit and remember Willow Creek. The creek. The willows. A cousin you never knew you had.

objectives.text: Remember Willow Creek in the depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A creek, a willow, a woman singing. Your mother. And somewhere, a cousin's child, laughing, three years old, before the shadow came.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. The village I burned. Twenty years ago. His mother might have... I don't know. I'll carry that too. Iron-Fang carries two.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not this time, Xiao Shi.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Stray Lightning
quests.summary: Elder Bai explains the danger: the tribulation strikes you, but the storm is enormous, and stray bolts can burn the sect.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Bai's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The tribulation strikes you. But the storm around it is vast. Stray bolts. Your founder's tribulation burned half a forest. We have a sect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Yan Tie. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Lightning rods. Nine. Around the mountain. Star iron and crystal. Thunder Peak knows how. Ask them. Don't let them shout at you.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spiral of cloud over the sect is lower today. The air tastes of metal. Somewhere far above, heaven is clearing its throat.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Lightning rods! Thunder Peak has been waiting for this day for three hundred years! We have designs! Very loud designs!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: What Elder Bai said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Qian's Budget
quests.summary: Steward Qian has costed nine lightning rods. He is crying. He is also, strangely, smiling.

objectives.text: Report to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Nine rods. Star iron. Crystal caps. Thunder Peak's labour, which is loud. It's the most expensive thing the sect has ever built.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steward, I need a new lantern for the gate.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You needed a new lantern last month, Lu Ping. What did you do with it?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: And I don't care. For the first time in my life, I don't care what it costs. It protects everyone. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steward Qian said 'I don't care what it costs'! Out loud! I heard it! I'm writing it on the gate!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Even Qian's tears won't cover nine lightning rods. The rest must come from somewhere.

choices.text: Cut your own allowance first

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm telling the whole gate! Twice! With improvements!

choices.text: Levy the town, as the charter allows

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Squeeze Merchant Jin until he pays

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Star Iron for Nine Rods
quests.summary: Nine rods need star iron. The Thunder Peak forge has old anvils. They'll have to be melted. Yan Tie is heartbroken and proud.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The old anvils. Melted. For rods. Three hundred years of anvils. Thunder Peak weeps. Thunder Peak also says yes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Carry the forge's old anvils
Go back to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Nine anvils. Nine rods. Thunder Peak's history, protecting everyone. That's what history's for. We'll carve new anvils. Louder ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. Steward Qian's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the star iron you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart first, fist second. Just like the peak teaches!

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Wolves Want the Iron
quests.summary: The peak thunder wolves love star iron. They follow the anvils down the mountain, hopefully.

objectives.text: Search the Hundred-Chi Waterfall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder wolves follow the anvil carts down the path, tongues out, crackling, like dogs following a butcher's cart.

objectives.text: Clear the Hundred-Chi Waterfall of peak thunder wolves

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Peak thunder wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Gather the sparks the wolves shed
Tell Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Rumble followed us all the way down! He wants to help! He's licking the rods! It's actually charging them! Good boy!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Old Qiu. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Raising the First Rod
quests.summary: The first rod goes up at the cliff edge, where the lightning always strikes first. You set its crystal cap.

objectives.text: Head to the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A rod of star iron, twice the height of the main hall, rises at the cliff edge. It hums as the spiral above turns.

objectives.text: Set the crystal cap on the first rod

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystal cap clicks into place. Above, a single thread of lightning reaches down from the spiral, touches the rod, and runs harmlessly into the earth.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It works! The first rod works! The delta will work! The founder's plan works! My grandmother's turtle soup recipe works!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Did you spend anything? Lose anything? Borrow anything from anyone who writes things down?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Elder Bai, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Shadows Against the Rods
quests.summary: The Seventh Rung's shadow-born try to tear down the rods before they're finished. The eastern slope has twice as many. Wei Tong's lie worked.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're attacking the eastern slope! Twice as many there! My lie worked! I'm a genius! A terrible genius!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

objectives.text: Fight off the shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Hold the martial stage against more shadow-born
Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Eastern slope, overrun, empty. Western slope, rods standing. The shadow believed Wei Tong. I'm never going to let him forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, did you eat? You never eat. Here, half a bun. The bigger half.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...Thank you. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Nine Rods Around the Mountain
quests.summary: Eight more rods, around the mountain. Every disciple helps carry. Even the twelve. Even the chicken.

objectives.text: Hear Liu Er out

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Every disciple carries! The twelve! Me! The chicken! Qiu Hua insisted! The chicken is carrying a very small piece of crystal!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Elder Bai. Probably. Mostly.
