objectives.text: Carry the rods to their places
Meet Xiao Man at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Nine rods. Around the mountain. I dropped one. Only one. It bounced. Rods bounce. Who knew?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Yan Tie. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Singing With the Rods
quests.summary: The nine rods hum in the storm. Yan Tie says Thunder Peak's tradition is to shout back. You try humming instead.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak shouts back at the storm! It's tradition! Try it! No? Humming? Fine! Hum! Hum loudly!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Yan Tie. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Hum with the nine rods in the storm

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hum. The rods hum. The storm above hums back. For a moment, heaven and the mountain and you are one very long note.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Middle stage of Mahayana. The storm is closer. You are readier.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Nine rods. The sect is safe from stray lightning. Now it's only you the sky wants. That's a sentence I never wanted to say.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Yan Tie. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That is the sect I want. Thank you for being it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Map, Updated
quests.summary: Xiao Shi adds the nine rods to his ceiling map. Beside them, the fold. And a red line where the moon rises.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Nine rods on the map. And the fold. And look: the moon's path. It passes directly over the fold and the peak. Every month, a little redder.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One day I'll think of a comeback. Today is not that day.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The moon's turning red. Slowly. The old books say the last blood moon comes when the Ladder is almost gone. We're almost there.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The last blood moon and your tribulation. The books never said they'd be the same night. But they might be. I don't like that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Thunder Wolves, Guarding the Rods
quests.summary: The peak thunder wolves, having helped charge the rods, appoint themselves unofficial guards and challenge anyone who approaches.

objectives.text: Make your way to the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mission hall looks exactly as it should, which is what makes you uneasy.

objectives.text: Break the peak thunder wolves at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the outer pines
Show Xiao Man what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Steward Qian.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Rods' Foundations
quests.summary: Each of the nine rods needs its foundation reinforced with spirit stones before the real storm arrives.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me spirit stones from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Lu Ping. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the medicine valley
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Han Xue) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (tugging Han Xue's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Wei Tong's Terrible Genius, Confirmed
quests.summary: Wei Tong, insufferably proud of his successful lie, demands a formal title from the Sect Master to commemorate it.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Terrible Genius of the Eastern Slope. That's my title now. I've decided. Somebody tell the Sect Master. Tell her it's official.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you've eaten your ration and mine.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm training, Old Bao! Training is hungry work!

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Steward Qian has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Elder Bai) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Speak with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Wei Tong.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Steward Qian) That was cold.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Western Slope's Last
quests.summary: A last handful of shadow-born, realizing the deception too late, retreats from the correctly-fortified western slope.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the outer dormitories
Talk it over with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Old Bao?

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Star Iron for the Tenth Rod
quests.summary: Elder Bai, reading the smudged page again, insists on a tenth backup rod, just in case his math was off by one.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Bring me star iron from the medicine valley. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: No, Sect Master. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Find the star iron at the medicine valley
Bring word to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the star iron you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Bai's Recalculation
quests.summary: Elder Bai recalculates the delta a third time, muttering about smudged ink and a founder who apparently had terrible handwriting.

objectives.text: Scout the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit deer lift their heads in the beast garden's pens. A fat golden carp watches you from its pond.

objectives.text: Break open the cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals, nine rods, one very smudged page. If this works, I'm naming a room after myself. A small room.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A kindness worth a footnote. Several footnotes.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

quests.title: Liu Er's Rod Duty
quests.summary: Liu Er, assigned to guard the eastern rod overnight, takes the job with the same seriousness he brought to guarding a chicken.

objectives.text: See what Liu Er wants

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Nobody touches this rod. Nobody. I've got a broom and a very stern expression. Both are fully deployed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Lu Ping. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Hear what Lu Ping has to say

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Xiao Man. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Xiao Man said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Stone Golems, Disturbed by the Rods
quests.summary: The rods' humming disturbs a few dormant stone golems near the formation, who wake confused and mildly annoyed.

objectives.text: Open the pill furnace at the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone golems at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stone golems spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the outer pines
Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Elder Bai will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Answer the Sect Master, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for Xiao Shi's Updated Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi's expanding ceiling map needs more spirit stones to properly mark the moon's reddening path.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian out

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the mountain road. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Do you know what that costs? I do. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the mountain road
See Steward Qian again

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Fan Rui! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Sign here. And here. And here. No, the other here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Can't say fairer than that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Steward Qian) Oh.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Worry About the Moon
quests.summary: Xiao Man, staring at the reddening moon through Xiao Shi's map, admits it frightens her more than any Rung has.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: A Rung you can fight. The moon just... comes. On its own schedule. Nobody asked it to. Nobody can stop it either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Bai at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the Cliff of Reflection. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Elder Bai says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the shelves. They're older than your grandmother and less forgiving.

objectives.text: Find Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the incense cauldron.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Xiao Man. The immortal always is. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is not a well. It is a very small cup.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (tugging Steward Qian's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Farewells Early
quests.summary: The Sect Master says something that makes everyone go quiet: it's time to start saying goodbyes. Not because you'll die. Because you'll climb.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Start saying goodbye. Not because you'll fall. Because you won't. When you transcend, the stair opens. Most who climb don't come back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Be careful, {senior}!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Say what you need to say to the people you love. Early. So there's no rush at the end. Start with Qingshi. They'd want to be first.

objectives.text: Hurry to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The long refectory smells of rice, ginger and a hundred disciples who trained since dawn.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Be careful, {senior}!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Heaven's Warning Shot
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane arrives crackling. Heaven is sending a lesser tribulation. Three bolts. Tonight. On the isles.

objectives.text: Answer the Sect Master's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A crane from the star-gazer. Crackling. A lesser tribulation. Three bolts. Tonight. Go. We'll watch from the mountain. Everyone's watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: The golden carp is two hundred years old and still insufferable. We get along.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Ling Qiu. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: keeper_ling
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Decipher the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isles are dark and humming. Overhead, a small spiral of black cloud turns directly above the Isle of Winds.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Speak with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Three bolts. A warning. Heaven checking you're serious. Most die. You won't. Probably. I'm cheerful. I'm very cheerful. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. The Sect Master has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Crystals on the Isle
quests.summary: You plant thunder crystals around the Isle of Winds, a small delta for a small storm.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Crystals around the isle. A small delta. Practice for the big one. Plant them where the wind is strongest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

objectives.text: Plant thunder crystals around the isle
Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came to watch! We brought a banner! It says 'strike harder'! Is that helpful? Thunder Peak isn't sure!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yan Tie is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thank you, Qing Luan.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Yan Tie is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more thunder crystals than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The First Bolt
quests.summary: The first bolt comes down white. Your body takes it the way the forge taught you: usefully.

objectives.text: Endure the first bolt

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: White. Everything white. Your integrated body takes the bolt and doesn't break. It hums. The crystals around you split the rest into the sea of clouds.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the chain isles

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: One. Good. You didn't die. I'm less cheerful now. The second is worse. The third is the heart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Balanced, like a scale nobody is watching.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Qing Luan) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Storm Wolves in the Lightning
quests.summary: The lesser tribulation charges the storm wolves. They come howling out of the pines, crackling, mad with lightning.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Storm wolves! Drunk on lightning! Between bolts! Heaven's warning shot has brought friends! Rude friends!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Drive the storm wolves from the chain isles

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of storm wolves
Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Cleared. The second bolt's coming. I can feel my hair standing up. I have very good hair. This is a tragedy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Second Bolt
quests.summary: The second bolt is purple. It goes through your body and into your soul, looking for seams. There aren't any.

objectives.text: Endure the second bolt

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Purple. The bolt goes through body and into soul, searching for a seam where it could split you. It finds none. It goes away, disappointed.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the Immortal Palace gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Two. The third is the heart. Your heart demon will flicker in it. It'll look like you. It'll know you. Don't be kind to it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to Qingyi. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: No. Be kind to it. That's how you won last time. I'm confused. I'm frightened. Be yourself.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (hiding behind Qing Luan) Oh.

quests.title: The Flickering Shadow
quests.summary: The third bolt comes down black, and out of it steps a shadow wearing your face, flickering like a candle in wind.

objectives.text: Go to the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The third bolt hits the ruins and doesn't vanish. It stands up, black, wearing your face, flickering in and out like a bad lamp.

objectives.name: The Flickering Shadow
objectives.text: Face The Flickering Shadow at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Hello again. Heaven sent me. A little piece of you, to test the rest. Every time you win, I come back stronger. See you at the ninth.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Every time you come back, so do I.

objectives.text: Let the third bolt pass through you

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow fades into the bolt, and the bolt fades into you, and you're still standing. The lesser tribulation is over.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan at the chain isles

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Three. You survived a lesser tribulation. The first in three hundred years. Your founder was the last. She'd be proud. I'm proud. I'm crying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's followers throw down their weapons and kneel.

choices.text: Let them go home

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Bring them to face the sect's judgement

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Make an example of them

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars dim a little when someone does that. I've counted.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Everyone Watched
quests.summary: The whole sect watched from the mountain. The whole alliance, their cranes say. They all saw the three bolts fall.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We watched from the cliff. Three bolts. Three. The whole sect cheered. Wei Tong fainted. Then he got up and cheered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Yan Tie agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the phoenix nest

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I didn't faint. I sat down very suddenly. And lay down. Briefly. For morale.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If he offers you a bun before a fight, refuse. He'll share it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone fights better with a bun, Senior Sister. It's science.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's banner said strike harder. Heaven listened. We're very sorry. We're making a new banner. It says 'please don't'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Wei Tong. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: The disciples watched you nearly die in the lightning. They're frightened.

choices.text: Tell them the truth: it will be worse

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair. Fair's good. Can we eat now?

choices.text: Tell them it didn't hurt

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm! Sensible! Loudly sensible!

choices.text: Tell them fear is for the weak

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to Yan Tie) That was cold.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade, Fresh
quests.summary: Where the three bolts struck the isle, the ground has turned to fresh jade. Your jade.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your jade. Where you stood. Fresh. Take some. Someday, someone will find the rest and feel your three bolts and be proud of you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Scribe Shu has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Gather your own tribulation jade
Go back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Give some to the people you love. Tribulation jade is warm forever. They'll have something of you when you climb.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the tribulation jade you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Ninth Ring
quests.summary: Qing Luan reads the chart after the lesser tribulation. The ninth ring is brighter. Closer. And red.

objectives.text: Read the star chart after the storm

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine rings on the chart. The ninth is red now, not white. The seventh star sits right on it. The Patriarch's Shadow, on your heart bolt.

objectives.text: Investigate the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath it, in Qing Luan's hand, fresh ink: the last blood moon and the ninth bolt. Same night. Same hour. Oh no.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Same night. The last blood moon and your heart tribulation. He's planned it. For three hundred years. He'll ride your heart bolt.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Zhao Kang is not wrong. Zhao Kang is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Aftermath
quests.summary: The lesser tribulation leaves storm wolves scattered and lightning-drunk across the isle, needing one last calming pass.

objectives.text: Search the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial cranes stalk the shallows of their isle, white as snow, their crowns red as a seal.

objectives.text: Clear the storm plateau of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Pick up cloud silk near the elixir spring
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We're done at the elixir spring. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha. Yan Tie's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

quests.title: Cloud Silk From the Storm's Edge
quests.summary: The lesser tribulation's storm leaves unusually potent cloud silk in the pines, worth harvesting while it's fresh.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring me cloud silk from the sky ship wreck. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Qing Luan. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

objectives.text: Collect cloud silk around the sky ship wreck
Report back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Yan Tie. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Right. That works.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Hm! Sensible! Loudly sensible!

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Hair Tragedy
quests.summary: Zhao Kang mourns his lightning-frizzed hair with the same gravity most people reserve for actual tragedies.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Three hundred years of good hair in my family, ruined in one bolt. I survived a tribulation and lost to static electricity.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Yan Tie said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The isles have been restless. Even the rice leans away from the wind now.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Qingyi. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the golden lotus lake

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Qingyi. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (whispering to Wei Tong) That was amazing.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (hiding behind Wei Tong) Oh.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, Checking the Damage
quests.summary: A pair of celestial sentinels inspect the ruins after the third bolt, curious rather than hostile for once.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks at the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Fight off the celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These celestial sentinels fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Find the star iron at the sword isle
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Han Xue) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Isle's Recovery
quests.summary: The isle's spirit vein, drained by the lesser tribulation, needs spirit stones to recover its usual glow.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me spirit stones from the crystal isle. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the crystal isle
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Fainting, Reconsidered
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on a formal re-examination of whether 'sitting down very suddenly' technically counts as fainting.

objectives.text: Head to the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the crane isle a hundred cranes turn their heads to look at you at once. It is unsettling.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I was conscious the whole time! Mostly! I remember most of it! That's not fainting, that's a dignified reaction!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Zhao Kang. You said so. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Elder Yan's New Banner
quests.summary: Thunder Peak unveils its apologetic new banner, which somehow manages to be even louder than the last one.

objectives.text: Report to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: 'PLEASE DON'T', in letters this big! Heaven can't possibly misread it now! Unless it wants to! Heaven does what it wants!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the mirror lake

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Very funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the sun altar

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Yan Tie.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, One Last Pack
quests.summary: A final pack of storm wolves, still crackling from residual lightning, needs clearing before the isle settles.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks at the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Break the storm wolves at the thunder isle

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: More storm wolves? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Gather star iron at the sky ship wreck
Tell Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the sky ship wreck isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It's restful, mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade for the Alliance
quests.summary: Qing Luan suggests sending a piece of your tribulation jade to each of the forty allied sects, as both gift and warning.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me tribulation jade from the waterfall isle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhao Kang. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Pick up tribulation jade near the waterfall isle
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the tribulation jade you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Han Xue) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Han Xue's Jade
quests.summary: Han Xue receives her piece of warm jade quietly, holding it for a long moment before saying anything at all.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's warm. Really warm. Like you're still in it, a little. I'm going to carry this every day until you come back down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Yan Tie. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Warm Jade
quests.summary: You carry pieces of warm tribulation jade down the stair. Everyone you love will get one.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Go. Give out your jade. Say your goodbyes early. And come back up when the sky calls. I'll be at the gate. Frowning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Yan Tie?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Warm jade for everyone. You're giving away pieces of your own tribulation. That's the most you thing you've ever done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Qing Luan agrees. It must be true.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Down the Steps With Jade
quests.summary: You walk down the nine thousand steps with a bag of warm jade. Qingshi sees you coming from the watchtower.

objectives.text: Read the notice board at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qingshi's gate is open. The whole town is waiting in the street. Somebody saw you from the watchtower and rang the bell, very gently.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Most of the notice board is chores and grudges. One slip, pinned upside down, is meant for someone who knows to look.

objectives.text: Meet Constable Du at the bell pavilion

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The watchtower saw you coming. We rang the bell soft. Not an alarm. A welcome. We've never had a bell for that. We do now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Constable Du does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Not now, Han Xue. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Constable Du) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: I'll write it down. I write everything down, cultivator.

quests.title: Madam Fang's Bowl
quests.summary: Madam Fang has kept a bowl of noodles hot for you since the Crimson Road. Every day. She's not going to stop.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Your bowl. Kept hot. Every day since the Crimson Road. I'm not going to stop when you climb. I'll keep it hot forever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Madam Fang. For you. Tribulation jade. It stays warm forever too.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There. Magistrate Zhou agrees. Settled.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: ...Warm forever. Like the bowl. Oh, you terrible child. Now I'm crying into the noodles. Eat them anyway. They're salty now.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Listen to Widow Liu. We've lived here a long time.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I have not slept since spring.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the watermill

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Madam Fang. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. It has opinions.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Old Pan, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Dishes
quests.summary: Iron-Fang is washing dishes. He doesn't look up. He's been expecting this. He doesn't want it.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Goodbyes. Early. The Sect Master's idea. I don't like it. Iron-Fang doesn't say goodbye. Iron-Fang says see you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: See you later, Tie Hu. At the black gate.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Probably, Captain Lei. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...At the black gate. Yes. That's a see-you-later I can say. Give me the jade. I'll keep it with my sister's ribbon.

objectives.text: Join Constable Du at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Constable. I've come to report myself for being useful.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted, Iron-Fang. You're still on my list.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed in town, cultivator. Mostly.

objectives.text: Speak with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Thank you, Iron-Fang, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Order! Ah. It's already orderly. Carry on.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (whispering to Magistrate Zhou) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (hiding behind Magistrate Zhou) Oh.

quests.title: Water for the Last Time
quests.summary: Widow Liu asks you to carry water with her, one last time, to the old houses on the hill. Liu Er comes too.

objectives.text: Answer Widow Liu's summons

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Carry water with me. To the hill houses. One more time. My son too. The three of us. Like a family.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, can I go too? Please?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: No, and don't ask again. ...Carry the water first.

objectives.text: Carry water up the hill with the Lius
Hear what Liu Er has to say

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother cried the whole way. I cried the whole way. You didn't cry. You carried twice as much. That's how you cry, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: No, Merchant Jin. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine. You're paid in full. Forever. Take care up there.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Shadows in the Town
quests.summary: The Seventh Rung's shadows have followed you down. They want to see who you love. They're taking notes.

objectives.text: Report to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Shadows! In the street! Following you! Watching who you talk to! The town's not having that!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Captain Lei. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Constable Du. More sense there than in half this town.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Finish the rogue cultivators at the market square
Return to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Gone. The whole town chased them. With brooms. Liu Er taught everyone. Qingshi's the best-armed town in the world. With brooms.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Back. Good. I looked twice at every face on the road until it was yours.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. The magistrate will sleep better.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Magistrate's Speech
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou has written a speech. It's nine pages. He reads one word of it.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've written a speech. Nine pages. I'm going to read one word. It's the best word I know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.
