dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Han Xue! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Hold.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: ...That's it. That's the speech. Hold. Whatever happens up there. Hold. Qingshi will. For you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Jade in the Qing River
quests.summary: Old Pan takes you out on the river, one last time. He doesn't charge a fare. He never did, after the siege.

objectives.text: Make your way to the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Pan's ferry slides out onto the Qing River. The town lights shine on the water. He rows slowly, very slowly.

objectives.text: Drop a piece of jade into the river

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade sinks, glowing, into the river. Old Pan nods. Now the river remembers you too, he says. Forty years, it's never lied.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. I've carried everyone. You were the only one who ever carried me back. Mind the third plank. Always.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine. You're well in credit, child.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Widow Liu.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: Merchant Jin's Ledger
quests.summary: Merchant Jin has closed his books for the day, to give you something: the guild's ledger, with a new last page.

objectives.text: See what Merchant Jin wants

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild's ledger. The last page. Every debt the town owes you. I've written them all. It's a very long page.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Merchant Jin says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Come back and tell me everything, or I'll have to make it up. My version is worse.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: And at the bottom, in my own hand: paid in full, by a town that learned to be honest. I'm framing it. In the warehouse.

objectives.text: Talk with Widow Liu at the City God temple

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the City God temple. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er at the east gate

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the east gate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Er, stand up straight. You're talking to an immortal.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, it's only {player}!

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin wants to forgive the town's debts in your name. It's a fortune.

choices.text: Forgive them in his name, not yours

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Let the debts stand. Contracts are contracts.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take the credit, and a share

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Temple, One Last Time
quests.summary: You sit in the town temple, clean now, where you cleansed Hong's defilement years ago, and carry the whole town.

objectives.text: Carry Qingshi in the temple's quiet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole town, breathing. Madam Fang humming. Iron-Fang scrubbing. Widow Liu counting in elevens. You hold them, and then you let them hold you.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I came down to walk you home. I watched you carry the whole town. From the temple steps. Every face in the street was crying.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Old Pan. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fine. Moving on.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, the Town's Last Test
quests.summary: A handful of rogue cultivators, testing the town's grief-weakened watch, are met by the whole street armed with brooms.

objectives.text: Read the old stele at the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

objectives.text: Defeat the rogue cultivators at the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The rogue cultivators come on in silence.

objectives.text: Collect incense bundles around the main street
Show Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (beaming at Iron-Fang) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Incense for Every Doorstep
quests.summary: The town lights incense on every doorstep for you, a tradition Widow Liu insists on starting that evening.

objectives.text: Hear Merchant Jin out

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Bring me incense bundles from the hill graves. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Mind the third plank. And the fifth. The whole world is planks, if you think about it.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

objectives.text: Find the incense bundles at the hill graves
Go back to Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Not now, Liu Er. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Mind the crates. The stamps are imported.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Qiu Hua's Chicken, Farewelled
quests.summary: Qiu Hua brings Elder Drumstick down from the mountain specially so the chicken can say its own goodbye.

objectives.text: Scout the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chicken regards you with the profound indifference of a creature that has survived a Rung's web and several battles. You take it as affection.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Madam Fang.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed until it's needed. Then don't keep it sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Meet Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Madam Fang. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Widow Liu, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Watchtower's Alarm
quests.summary: A pair of demon cultivators tests the watchtower's new gentle-bell system, and get the town's full, un-gentle response.

objectives.text: Examine the puppet frame at the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The puppet frame creaks as you test it. The joints are oiled, the wood is new, and the runes are older.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the north gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the dye yard
Talk it over with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Did you fly? Did you use a sword? Can I hold the sword? Just for a moment?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Later. Over tea. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: weaver_qiao
dialogue.text: I'll weave it into the autumn bolt. A little gold line, for you.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Every face that passes, I look twice. Old habit.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: weaver_qiao
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: Medicine for the Road Ahead
quests.summary: Elder Hua, reached by crane, asks that Qingshi send a final supply of medicine up the mountain with you.

objectives.text: Speak with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (kneels in the road) Immortal one! Ah, sorry, it's you. Sorry. Habit. You shine a bit now.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me medicine bundles from the pottery kilns, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher. But for you, only very high.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Old Pan.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Trouble? Tell me. I'll write it down. Then I'll deal with it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the pottery kilns
Report back to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Liu Er! Manners!

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Any losses? Any damages? Anything the guild should be quietly paying for?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you. I'll write that down too.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (pen stops) That goes in the book. The bad page.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: The Third Plank
quests.summary: Old Pan explains, in more detail than strictly necessary, the exact history of the loose third plank on his ferry.

objectives.text: Hurry to the county academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ink stains every step of the academy. A scholar walks past reading a scroll and colliding with nothing, somehow.

objectives.text: Search the scroll rack

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You work along the scroll rack scroll by scroll. One is shelved in the wrong place, on purpose.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty-one years old, that plank. Replaced twice. Still loose. Some things are loose on purpose. Keeps you paying attention.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Heaven bless the immortal, Huo Da. Heaven bless {them}.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Old Pan) Well! That's one way to do it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Old Pan, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Liu Er's Broom, Passed On
quests.summary: Liu Er, preparing to return to the sect for good, passes his famous broom to the next child who'll need it.

objectives.text: Go and see Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: It's not just my broom anymore. It's the town's broom. Whoever needs it next gets it. That's how legends work, right?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Captain Lei. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

objectives.text: Talk with Old Pan at the watermill

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Merchant Jin, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

objectives.text: Find Merchant Jin at the county granary

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Merchant, your barges keep scraping my ferry.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Old Pan, your ferry keeps being in the way of my barges.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm trying to learn which things shouldn't.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (to Merchant Jin, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Temple's Last Watch
quests.summary: A last cluster of void wraiths tests the temple's wards even as the town gathers for its farewell.

objectives.text: Light incense at the offering table at the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fruit, rice and a cup of wine wait on the offering table. Someone set out one bowl more than there are gods.

objectives.text: Clear the temple fair of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

objectives.text: Pick up tribulation jade near the temple fair
Tell Iron-Fang what you found

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The City God temple is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Told you, Han Xue.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade for the Whole Town
quests.summary: There isn't enough jade for every household, so the town agrees to keep one piece in the temple, shared by all.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me tribulation jade from the temple fair. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An honest magistrate sleeps poorly. I haven't slept since spring. It's a very honest spring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Collect tribulation jade around the temple fair
Bring word to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Iron-Fang. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: The tribulation jade came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Zhou's Ninth Page
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou, asked what the other eight pages of his speech said, admits he never actually wrote them.

objectives.text: Report to Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: There were no other pages. I just wanted it to sound like I'd prepared more than one word. Hold is easier to believe with a prop.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Merchant Jin.

objectives.text: Join Old Pan at the canal walk

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'll take the militia round the back. They're not good, but they're loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Old Pan) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: River's high. Fares are higher.

objectives.text: Speak with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Business is business. I'm told friendship is also business, but warmer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: See You Later
quests.summary: You leave Qingshi at dusk. The whole town lines the road. Nobody says goodbye. Everybody says see you later.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: See you later. That's what Iron-Fang says. So that's what the town says. See you later. At the gate. On the stair. Later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Captain Lei. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Hear what Liu Er has to say

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: See you later, Senior Brother. Senior Sister. Whichever. See you later. I'll be the loudest one at the gate. After Thunder Peak.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: What Han Xue said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Senior Sister Asks
quests.summary: Han Xue asks for something. She never asks for anything. She asks very stiffly.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I need to break through. Nascent Soul. I've been close for a year. I didn't want to while you needed guarding.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You guarded me once, in your head. When you broke through, I stood guard in the plum garden. Now it's your turn. Please.

objectives.text: Read the ribbons on the wishing tree at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The plum garden is quiet. The same stone where you established your foundation, years ago. Han Xue sits on it. Very straight.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Red ribbons crowd the branches of the wishing tree. One wish is written in a child's hand and names you.

objectives.text: See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breakthroughs attract trouble. Heart demons, jealous juniors, very curious elders. And shadow-born. Keep them away. That's all.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Lu Ping's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Curious Elders
quests.summary: The first trouble is Elder Hua, Elder Bai, Wei Tong, Zhao Kang and Lu Ping, all of whom want to watch.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is she breaking through? Can we watch? Everyone wants to watch! Elder Bai brought a notebook! Wei Tong brought snacks!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Wei Tong. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Ward the plum garden against visitors

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises gently around the plum garden. Outside it, a crowd of well-meaning people press their noses to the light.

objectives.text: Fight off the shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Not all the visitors are well-meaning. In the pines, shadow-born are gathering, drawn by a soul about to form.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow
Meet Wei Tong at the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Shadow-born, trying to get at her while she's breaking through. I've been waiting all year to hit one of those for her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Lu Ping. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Wei Tong does enough for three.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Han Xue's Heart
quests.summary: Halfway through, Han Xue speaks without opening her eyes. Her heart demon is flickering. She's telling you about it.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: My demon's here. It says I only follow you because I'm afraid to lead. It says I'll be your senior sister forever and nothing else.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're the one who walked me into the Abyss, Senior Sister. You lead. I follow you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...It went quiet. It didn't like that. Keep talking. About anything. Tell me about the chicken.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore Yan Tie. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Han Xue's Shadow
quests.summary: Han Xue's heart demon steps out of the plum trees: a copy of her, sword drawn, cold eyes. You won't let it reach her.

objectives.text: Test the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A figure in Frost Sword blue steps out of the plum trees. Han Xue's face. Han Xue's sword. Eyes like a frozen lake.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You close your hand on the hilt of the sword in the stone. It hums, weighs you, and decides to stay where it is.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-born spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born regrouping
Join the Sect Master at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-Han falls apart like frost in sunlight. Behind you, the real Han Xue breathes out, long and slow, and smiles with her eyes closed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sliver of Han Xue's shadow is left, cold and humming. It would feed a cultivator's soul.

choices.text: Let it melt away

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give it to the hermit to seal

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Absorb it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: Guarding the Stone
quests.summary: Han Xue's soul is forming. You sit beside her on the stone and hold the ward, and wait, and don't talk about the chicken.

objectives.text: Hold the ward beside Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Plum petals fall. Han Xue's breath slows. In soul sight, a tiny figure is forming in her chest: a small, straight sword, with her face.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul. It's a sword. Of course it is. With my face. Frowning. Of course it is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you. For guarding. For the plum garden. For everything. That's all. Don't make it weird.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Everyone Comes In
quests.summary: The ward comes down, and everyone who has been waiting comes in at once, with snacks.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul! Han Xue! I brought snacks! Everyone brought snacks! We've been waiting for hours! The snacks are cold! Eat them!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Shi. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Let me see your wrist. Hm. Steady. Very steady. Stubborn pulse. Like someone else I know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Elder Hua is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thank you, Zhao Kang. Now, where was I.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Congratulations. Now you're only three realms behind the heir instead of seven. I'm eight behind. I'm going to be very dramatic about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Hua. That's my job.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (stops mixing) I don't have a pill for that, {player}.

quests.title: Plum Blossoms for a New Soul
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on a tradition he invented just now: plum blossoms for a new soul.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: New tradition! Plum blossoms for a new soul! I invented it just now! Everyone gather blossoms! Throw them at her!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you have crumbs on your sword.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're lucky crumbs. Dumpling likes them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Gather plum blossoms for Han Xue
Talk with Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone's throwing plum blossoms at me. I'm going to have petals in my hair for a week. I'm going to allow it. Once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Sparring Match
quests.summary: Han Xue reminds you, as she always does, that you owe her a sparring match. Now she has a soul to match yours.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You owe me a proper sparring match. Remember? From the rim, years ago. Now I've got a soul. Now it'll be closer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When, Senior Sister?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Xiao Shi.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: After. When this is done. After the gate, and the sky. You don't get to ascend without paying your debts. That's my rule.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the medicine valley

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: If it's hot, don't touch it. If it's glowing, don't even look at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Kiln-Mistress Tao has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Elder Hua said. I was listening. Mostly.

objectives.text: Join Lu Ping at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: No, Han Xue. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's going in my stories. The good ones.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (grinning at Lu Ping) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: A Gift of Jade
quests.summary: You give Han Xue a piece of your tribulation jade. She holds it for a long time.

objectives.text: Give Han Xue your tribulation jade

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She holds the jade in both hands. It's warm. She doesn't say anything. She puts it inside her robe, over her heart, next to her new soul.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Warm forever, the star-gazer said. Good. I get cold on the Frost Sword Peak. I'll wear it. Always. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Zhao Kang. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Plum Garden's Last
quests.summary: A last handful of shadow-born, drawn by the breakthrough's afterglow, tests the plum garden's edges overnight.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Find the spirit herbs at the outer dormitories
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, nervously) Should we... say something?

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: Medicine for the New Nascent Soul
quests.summary: Elder Hua insists a fresh nascent soul needs a specific tonic, and Xiao Man is dispatched to gather the herbs.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: See? Even Yan Tie agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the medicine valley
Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (beaming at Wei Tong) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Blossom Tradition, Formalized
quests.summary: Wei Tong petitions the Sect Master to make plum-blossom-throwing an official sect tradition for every future breakthrough.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Official! In the sect rules! Right after 'no fighting near the tea sets'! I'm very serious about this!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Hua.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the plum garden. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Elder Hua. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the herb terraces.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Wei Tong. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: The third kiln sneezed again. I lost an eyebrow. It'll grow back. Last time it did.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Unorthodox treatment. It may even work.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (stops mixing) I don't have a pill for that, {player}.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Outer Watch
quests.summary: A pair of demon cultivators, drawn by the same afterglow as the shadow-born, test the outer wall's watch.

objectives.text: Go to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rolls out of the refectory kitchens. Somewhere inside, a ladle strikes a pot like a gong.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Moon cultivators come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the spirit peach orchard
Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Back, and breathing evenly. That's all a healer asks for, and so rarely gets.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for Han Xue's New Sword Style
quests.summary: Han Xue, adjusting to her new soul, asks for spirit herbs to support the more demanding forms she can now attempt.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit herbs from the medicine valley. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Xiao Shi, and declined. Kindly.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the medicine valley
Go back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Back already? I was about to shout for you. From here. You'd have heard.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit herbs came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Measured. Sensible.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly, for once) That was ugly. I remember being ugly.

quests.title: Elder Bai's Notebook
quests.summary: Elder Bai, having watched the whole breakthrough from outside the ward, reveals pages of surprisingly detailed notes.

objectives.text: Investigate the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the pill kiln yard. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Stoke the pill furnace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pill furnace breathes out heat like a sleeping beast. Inside, a batch of pills turns slowly in the glow.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I recorded everything! The ward's exact shade of green! The timing of the plum petals! Science demands rigor, even at a distance!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Wei Tong. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at Elder Bai) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Wager
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, prompted by the Sect Master's comment, formally wagers Wei Tong that he'll form his own nascent soul within the year.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One year. If I don't do it, I owe Wei Tong a hundred buns. If I do, he owes me a spar he can't win. Deal?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Deal! I like this bet either way! Buns or a spar! I win regardless!

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Elder, the third kiln sneezed again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then feed it less charcoal and more patience, Hongyu.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

objectives.text: Talk with Lu Ping at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Oh. Oh, that's not a story I'm telling.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, a Second Test
quests.summary: The shadow-born return once more that night, testing whether the ward holds without the breakthrough's power feeding it.

objectives.text: Search the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Disciples crowd the mission hall's boards, arguing over which chores pay the most contribution for the least mud.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the training ground

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Collect tribulation jade around the outer pines
Tell Lu Ping what you found

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: HA! That's how it's done! Thunder Peak salutes you! Loudly!

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A gentle hand. That's the best medicine there is.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Tribulation Jade for Zhao Kang's Wager
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, motivated by his new wager, asks for a small piece of jade to keep as incentive during his own cultivation push.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me tribulation jade from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, did you eat? You never eat. Here, half a bun. The bigger half.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...Thank you. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Find the tribulation jade at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Ha! I'm telling everyone. I'm telling them twice, with improvements.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Lu Ping's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more tribulation jade than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Congratulations
quests.summary: Xiao Shi, ever precise, calculates exactly how many days it's been since Han Xue first mentioned being close to her breakthrough.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Shi's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Three hundred and eleven days of waiting. I kept count because someone should appreciate patience properly. Congratulations, Senior Sister.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ignore Zhao Kang. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Mind the smoke from the east kilns. It's thicker than it looks and ruder than it smells.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Kiln-Mistress Tao. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: kiln_tao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Two Souls on the Mountain
quests.summary: That night, from the cliff edge, you can see two souls glowing on the mountain: yours, and a small, straight sword.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Two nascent souls younger than thirty on my mountain. Three hundred years since that happened. The last two founded the sect.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell on your way out. It bit a deacon this morning. It seemed pleased.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is next, he says. He's been saying it for a year. He's very close. He needs a push. Maybe a wager.

objectives.text: Head to the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the tea terraces is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Sect Master. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'll pretend I was looking the other way.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) The elders will hate that. I love it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Palanquin
quests.summary: The gold palanquin climbs the nine thousand steps one last time. The Zhao ancestor has something to say.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The gold palanquin! Again! The bearers are older now! One of them is crying again! It's the same one!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Ancestor Zhao.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Lu Ping says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

objectives.text: Make your way to the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The palanquin sets down at the gate. The ancestor steps out, slower than last time, leaning on a cane of gold.

objectives.text: Hear what Ancestor Zhao has to say

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: A hundred and fifteen. I've climbed these steps for the last time. I've come to name my heir. Where is he? Hiding?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Ancestor Zhao is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Zhao Kang Hides Again
quests.summary: Zhao Kang is hiding. Behind the turtle soup books again. Elder Bai has given up and brought him tea.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I don't want to be clan head. I want to be here. At the gate. When it opens. With you. And then I want to fight you, when you come back down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang's scared. Look, his ears are red.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My ears are red because it's cold, you boiled dumpling.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He'll say I have to. The clan needs me. I know the clan needs me. I just... need something first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What do you need, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A wager. With you. Like when we were idiots. One last idiotic wager. Then I'll be clan head. Then I'll be an adult. Ugh.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about food, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about your clan, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Wager
quests.summary: The wager: if Zhao Kang can reach the golden core's peak before your tribulation, you owe him a bout when you come back down.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The wager. If I reach the peak of Core Formation before your sky falls, you owe me a proper bout when you come back down. Properly.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What Tang Ling said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If I don't, I... I'll be clan head without complaining. For a month. That's the stakes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're on. Though I'd have given you the bout anyway.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I know. That's why it has to be a wager. So it's earned. Zhao clan standards. Low ones, but standards.

objectives.text: Find Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Noted, Zhao Kang. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My grandson has your stubbornness. Regrettably, he had it first.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Ancestor Zhao. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang's clan offers you a fortune to make sure he loses the wager.

choices.text: Refuse

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell Zhao Kang

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Accept

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Training for the Wager
quests.summary: Zhao Kang trains for a month. Day and night. You help. So does everyone. He complains the whole time. It works.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Train! Now! Puppets! Harder puppets! Wei Tong, tune them to furious! I want furious!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Zhong Ming.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Help Zhao Kang train on furious puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Furious puppets! For Zhao Kang! I've never tuned them this high! One of them is growling! Puppets can't growl!

objectives.text: Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One month. Every day. I've never trained this hard. I've never complained this hard. It's the best month of my life.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
