dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Zhong Ming. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: bell_zhong
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Clan Champions
quests.summary: The Zhao clan's champions want to test their future head. They're very polite about it, and very hard to beat.

objectives.text: Go and see Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My champions. They want to test the boy. The old way. You'll stand beside him. The Zhao clan's test always has a friend in it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Wei Tong. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Stand beside Zhao Kang against the champions

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Zhao clan champions ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: See Ancestor Zhao again

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: He beat them. With you beside him, but he beat them. His brother did the same. The Zhao clan is in good hands. Stubborn ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Ancestor Zhao, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Sect Master?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Peak
quests.summary: On the last night of the month, Zhao Kang sits at his brother's stone, and reaches for the peak.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sit with me. At Ming's stone. I'm going to try. If I don't make it, don't tell anyone I cried.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Sit with Zhao Kang as he reaches for his peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense for Zhao Ming, twisting over the sea of clouds. Zhao Kang's golden core burns brighter and brighter, like a lantern with a crack in it, letting the light out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Peak of Core Formation. And beside him, your own cultivation rises with his: late stage of Mahayana.

objectives.text: Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Peak. I made it. I won. You owe me a bout. When you come back down. I'm going to win that too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Great-grandson, you're slouching.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I am standing heroically, Ancestor.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: The Ancestor's Blessing
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu names his great-grandson head of the clan, in front of the whole sect. Zhao Kang doesn't hide.

objectives.text: Report to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang. Head of the Zhao clan. Who will lead it from the Azure Cloud, because that's where his heart is. The clan agrees. I agree.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...Thank you, Great-Grandfather. I'll write monthly. With love. In gold ink. Because we're the Zhao clan.

objectives.text: Speak with Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Gold ink. Of course. You've learned something after all. Now I'm going home to die in comfort. In about twenty years. Out of spite.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Hm. Lu Ping is not wrong. Lu Ping is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Ancestor Zhao) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (hiding behind Ancestor Zhao) Oh.

quests.title: Jade for the Zhao Clan
quests.summary: You give Zhao Kang a piece of your tribulation jade. He gives you something back: the small copy of his brother's stone.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your jade. Warm. I'll keep it with the monthly letters. And here. Ming's stone. The small one. Take it up the stair with you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't break anything that belongs to the sect. I will know. I always know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: So a Zhao climbs to heaven too. First out of the grotto. First up the stair. Ming would've liked that.

objectives.text: Gather the Zhao clan's farewell gifts
Hear what Steward Qian has to say

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Gifts from the Zhao clan. Gold. For the treasury. For the march. I'm not going to faint. I've grown. I've grown so much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Watch the left. Everyone forgets the left.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Steward Qian) That was cold.

quests.title: Shadows at the Palanquin
quests.summary: The Seventh Rung's shadows come for the palanquin on its way down, to hurt someone you love. They find Zhao Kang waiting.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows! At Great-Grandfather's palanquin! On MY steps! I'm clan head now! Nobody touches the palanquin!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Tang Ling.

objectives.text: Clear the inner sect gate of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Hold the crane roost against more void wraiths
Go back to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Clan head for one day and I've already defended the palanquin. Great-Grandfather says I'm too dramatic. He's smiling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Wait until the dormitories hear this. I'll add a dragon. Nobody checks.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Fan Rui. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (beaming at Zhao Kang) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Zhao Kang) Oh.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

quests.title: Sparring Disciples, the Champions' Rematch
quests.summary: The Zhao clan champions, freshly beaten, demand an immediate rematch to save face before heading home.

objectives.text: Light incense in the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense smoke curls out of the bronze ding. Beneath the ash, something that is not incense glints.

objectives.text: Fight off the Zhao clan champions

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Recover tribulation jade from the mountain road
Compare notes with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Letters for the Zhao Clan's Return Journey
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu's palanquin bearers need letters delivered to the clan estate ahead of the ancestor's return.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian out

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me sealed letters from the outer dormitories.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Steward Qian is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the outer dormitories
Report back to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Well? Is it true what they're saying? Which part? All the parts. I need all the parts.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Sensible, that.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Hm. Yes. Probably right.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Furious Puppets, Retired
quests.summary: Wei Tong formally retires the 'furious' puppet setting, admitting it was probably too dangerous to use again.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: One of them actually growled. Real growling. I'm putting that setting away forever. Or at least until the next wager.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore Han Xue. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries. And in gold. Mostly in gold.

objectives.text: Meet Ancestor Zhao at the contribution pavilion

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Deacon Shen. I asked who would go.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries, and in gold.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the sword-washing pool

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Steps' Last Guard
quests.summary: A last watch of void wraiths tests the nine thousand steps as the palanquin prepares to descend.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rust flakes from the sword in the stone as you touch it. The blade beneath is still bright, and still sharp.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the long stone stairway

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the spirit peach orchard
Show the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We're done at the spirit peach orchard. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Back safe. Sit. Your face needs a cup more than your cultivation does.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Auntie Ruo says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd have grunted and looked away. That's how he said proud. I'll just say it. Proud!

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Clan's Gift
quests.summary: Steward Qian, still processing the Zhao clan's gold, asks for it to be properly counted and stored before anything else happens.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhong Ming. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Collect spirit stones around the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I hear the bell in my sleep. I hear it when it isn't ringing. It's a calling.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Zhong Ming. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Han Xue's Read on Zhao Kang
quests.summary: Han Xue, watching Zhao Kang accept his new title, offers her assessment of how much he's actually changed.

objectives.text: Scout the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Notice boards cover every wall of the mission hall, sect tasks pinned three deep and fluttering in the draught.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A year ago he'd have run from that title all the way to the Iron Scale. Now he just complained loudly and did it anyway. Growth, Zhao-clan style.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Steward Qian's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Han Xue) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to Han Xue) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Han Xue's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Tianlu's Parting Joke
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu, before boarding his palanquin for the last time, leaves one final joke at his great-grandson's expense.

objectives.text: Answer Ancestor Zhao's summons

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Gold ink for monthly letters. I expect at least one poem. Bad poetry runs in this family. Don't break the streak.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the gate post. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Steward Qian.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Give me an hour.

objectives.text: Join Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the incense cauldron.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: In my day we sent servants for this kind of thing. We had wonderful servants.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fair. I have my doubts too.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Steward Qian) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name, and all of them are mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (whispering to Steward Qian) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

quests.title: Training Puppets, One Last Round
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, still buzzing from his breakthrough, insists on one more round against the puppets before the wager is truly settled.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Stop the training puppets at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
Share your findings with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Steward Qian will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Go on. The whole town will want to know anyway.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Do you know what that costs? I do. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade for Zhao Ming's Stone
quests.summary: A small piece of jade is set into Zhao Ming's memorial stone, so his memory carries a little of your tribulation too.

objectives.text: Report to Ancestor Zhao

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me tribulation jade from the laundry stream.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Wei Tong. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My grandson has your stubbornness. Regrettably, he had it first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Recover tribulation jade from the laundry stream
See Ancestor Zhao again

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries, and in gold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the tribulation jade you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Lu Ping's Palanquin Count
quests.summary: Lu Ping, having watched the gold palanquin arrive and leave several times now, keeps a running tally of every visit.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Fourth time! I've seen the gold palanquin four times! I'm going to miss counting it! No, wait, they'll be back for the march!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Lu Ping said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Zhao Kang. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.text: Hear what Steward Qian has to say

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My great-grandson says you're stubborn. He says it with admiration. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Oh, hush, Ancestor Zhao. Let the immortal work.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: When You Come Back Down
quests.summary: Zhao Kang walks you to the cliff edge. He says the thing he's going to say again, years from now, at the ruins.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: When you come back down, we fight. Properly. Promise. Not see-you-later. A promise. Zhao clan standards.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When I come back down, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Lu Ping. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good. Hmph. Go and be struck by lightning. I'll be here. Complaining. Forever.

objectives.text: Hurry to the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Disciples crowd the mission hall's boards, arguing over which chores pay the most contribution for the least mud.

objectives.text: Meet Ancestor Zhao at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the Cliff of Reflection isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Zhao Kang. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My grandson has your stubbornness. Regrettably, he had it first.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Chart Read Whole
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane says only: come. I've read the whole chart. It's worse. Bring the sword girl. And the nameless one.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The star-gazer's crane. 'Come. Read the whole chart. Worse.' Take Han Xue. And Ye Wuming. She asked for him. By description.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Old Qiu. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isles are dim. Above, the moon hangs full and dark red, like an eye that's been crying.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You came. Good. Sit. Don't sit. Stand. This is standing news. I'm not cheerful. I'll never be cheerful again. Look at the chart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: The Whole Chart
quests.summary: On the star pavilion's jade floor, the whole chart, read at last. The ladder, the moon, the ninth bolt, and the stair.

objectives.text: Go to the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seven red stars in a ladder. Six dark. The seventh bright, over the peak. The moon's path crossing it. The ninth ring, red. And the stair.

objectives.text: Read the whole star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last blood moon rises. The fold opens. The Patriarch falls, or seems to. His soul climbs the seventh rung to the peak, and rides the ninth bolt into you.

objectives.text: Tell Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's his plan. Three hundred years. Your body, cleaned by heaven's own lightning, with him inside it. Walking up the stair.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Qingyi says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Unless the seventh rung falls first. Then he has nothing to climb. Then he has to jump. Jumping is much harder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars disagree. The stars often disagree. I side with you.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Reads It Too
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the chart. He's quiet for a long time. Then he says what he's decided.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The seventh rung. Xue Chen. The boy in the mirror. If he falls before the moon, the Patriarch has to jump. He might miss.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Ye Wuming thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll prove you wrong. Politely.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Ye Wuming. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll try to steal him back. Before. If I can't, you'll have to break him. I'm sorry. I wish there were a third way.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the mirror lake

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There's always a third way. We just haven't found it yet. We'll look. Until the moon rises. Then we'll do what we have to.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Ye Wuming said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Shadow-Born on the Isles
quests.summary: The shadow-born have followed the red star to the isles. They're guarding the peak, waiting for their master's son.

objectives.text: Go and see Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows! On the isles! Guarding the peak! I followed you up the stair! Obviously! I'm clan head! I do what I want!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the rainbow bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These shadow-born fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of shadow-born
Return to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're guarding the peak for Xue Chen. For the night of the moon. We should break their guard now. So it's broken then.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Qing Luan. Qing Luan won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Peak's Guardians
quests.summary: The shadow-born have taken the tribulation peak's slopes. You can't let them hold it until the moon.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born crouch on the peak's lower slopes, among the ruins, in a ring. They're drawing something on the stones. A ladder.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You trace the words of the old stele one by one, and the hair on your arms rises.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: More shadow-born? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Gather the stones they drew on
Compare notes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: A ladder, drawn on the slopes. Seven rungs. Six scratched out. The seventh fresh. They're making sure he knows the way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Kinder than the road ever was to me.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Watching the Red Moon
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to watch the red moon rise with her. She says it helps to look at what's coming.

objectives.text: Answer Qing Luan's summons

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Watch it rise. The red moon. Every month, redder. The last one will be the colour of the Patriarch's robes. Look at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Watch the red moon rise

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The moon rises red over the sea of clouds. Beneath it, the fold is a dark smudge on the earth. Above it, heaven's spiral turns. All three, lining up.

objectives.text: Go back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Months. Not years. Months. The moon, the fold, the stair and your lightning. All one night. I've never seen stars this certain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Stargazers could warn the towns early, but the alliance fears a panic.

choices.text: Warn the towns

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Follow the alliance's decision

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Sell the warning to the rich

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Qing Luan's Promise
quests.summary: Qing Luan makes a promise: on the night, she'll be at the cloud gate. Whatever happens.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: On the night, I'll be at the cloud gate. When the Patriarch's soul crosses my bridge, I'll see it. I'll tell you. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Qing Luan does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Qing Luan, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ten thousand years I watched the stair and did nothing. Not this time. This time I'll shout.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the rainbow bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You'll shout. I'll hold the bridge. Zhao Kang will complain. Ye Wuming will hold the abyss. Everyone has a job. Good.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ignore Qing Luan. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Han Xue has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Crystals for the Peak
quests.summary: Before you leave, you plant the first of Elder Bai's ninety-nine crystals on the peak's lower slopes. The delta begins.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Plant the first crystals now. On the lower slopes. Let them settle in. Crystals like to get to know a place before they work.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Plant the delta's first crystals
Report back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Forty on the slopes. The rest on the night. The delta's begun. Your founder's plan, in your hands. She'd be glad.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder crystals came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Xue Chen at the Peak
quests.summary: As you leave, you see him again: Xue Chen, on the summit, alone, looking at the red moon. He doesn't wave. He doesn't bow.

objectives.text: Sound the bronze bell at the temple of the four winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the summit, a young man in dark red, alone, looking up at the moon. He doesn't wave. He looks tired. He looks three years old.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Watch Xue Chen through the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Through the chart, his star flickers. Not bright and certain like the others were. Flickering. Like someone who isn't sure.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's not sure. His star's flickering. Nobody in the Ladder ever flickered. There's a door there. A small one. We'll try it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Han Xue's got a point.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Ye Wuming will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Peak's Lower Slopes
quests.summary: Storm wolves gather on the peak's lower slopes, agitated by the crystals and the shadow-born both.

objectives.text: Read the stone tablets at the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the stone tablets one after another. Together they make a sentence none of them says alone.

objectives.text: Clear the storm plateau of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Gather spirit pills at the elixir spring
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Cloud Silk for the Delta's Second Batch
quests.summary: Elder Bai wants more cloud silk gathered now, to bind the delta's crystals together before the night arrives.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour, would you?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Ye Wuming says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

objectives.text: Pick up cloud silk near the cloud harbour
Bring word to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (to Ye Wuming) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Job Assignment
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, having appointed himself to hold the bridge, insists on knowing exactly what that job entails before the night comes.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hold the bridge. Against what? How many? For how long? I like specifics. Specifics help me complain accurately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Qing Luan. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, the Peak's Watch
quests.summary: A pair of celestial sentinels, still loyal to the old palace, join the effort to hold the peak against the shadow-born.

objectives.text: Look behind the jade screen at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade screen is carved with a mountain, a river and a very small figure climbing. Behind it, a hidden niche.

objectives.text: Fight off the celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The celestial sentinels have found you first.

objectives.text: Collect cloud silk around the palace court
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade From the Drawn Stones
quests.summary: The stones the shadow-born drew their ladder on hold traces of tribulation jade, worth gathering and studying.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me tribulation jade from the peach garden.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Ye Wuming. And the time before.

objectives.text: Find the tribulation jade at the peach garden
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the tribulation jade you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Han Xue's Plan for the Bridge
quests.summary: Han Xue, newly a nascent soul cultivator, drafts a formation plan for holding the jade bridge against whatever comes.

objectives.text: Investigate the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the jade terraces, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Check the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Frost Sword forms, Iron Scale positions, and me in the middle being frightening. It'll work. It has to work.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Ledger, Updated
quests.summary: Ye Wuming adds a final entry to his private ledger: Xue Chen's flickering star, and the small door it might mean.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Forty years hunting monsters. The last entry in my book might be about saving one instead. I like that better as an ending.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the star observatory

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Sect Master. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the star observatory

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Delta's Guard
quests.summary: A cluster of shadow-born tests the newly planted delta crystals, probing whether they can be pulled up before they take root.

objectives.text: Touch the crane statue at the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You touch the neck of the crane statue. It is cool and smooth, polished by generations of wishes.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Recover phoenix feathers from the phoenix nest
Compare notes with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I bow to no one. Except Senior Sister Han. Occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Occasionally is correct.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (coldly) I expected better. That's new for me.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Star Pavilion
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks for spirit stones to reinforce the star pavilion itself, expecting the chart to be watched constantly until the night.

objectives.text: Answer Ye Wuming's summons

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me spirit stones from the floating forest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the floating forest
Return to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The Sect Master's got a point.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Countdown
quests.summary: Yun Zhi begins a quiet countdown on the main hall's wall, one mark for every day until the moon is expected to turn.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I don't know the exact night. Nobody does. But a countdown gives people something to do with their hands while they wait.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Scribe Shu has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the lantern isle

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Zhao Kang is not wrong. Zhao Kang is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Down to the Last Preparations
quests.summary: You go down the stair. Months, not years. Everyone on the mountain looks up at the moon every night now.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Months. We prepare. Everyone. Forty sects, one mountain, one moon. And one boy on a peak who isn't sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Qingyi. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest while you can. Say your goodbyes. And one day soon, the moon will be the colour of his robes.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Ye Wuming, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: To the Foot of the Stair
quests.summary: Qing Luan meets you at the cloud gate with a lantern, though it's day. She says the stair likes lanterns.

objectives.text: See what Qing Luan wants

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A lantern. The stair likes them. Don't ask me why. Ten thousand years and I still don't understand it. Follow me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Old Qiu has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Search the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qing Luan walks ahead with a lantern in broad daylight, humming. The isles are quiet. The red moon is a pale ghost in the day sky.

objectives.text: Go back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stair. Nobody's stood at its foot since your founders. I want it to meet you. Before the night. So it knows your face.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Wei Tong. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to Qing Luan) That was cold.

quests.title: The Stair's Sentinels
quests.summary: The stair has its own sentinels, older than the palace's. They don't want anyone near. Qing Luan tells them to move.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Move! I was a sage when your stones were still stars! Move! ...They won't move. Hit them. Gently. They're very old.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Qing Luan has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master. Now, where was I.

objectives.text: Stop the celestial sentinels at the sun altar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The celestial sentinels spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Finish the celestial sentinels at the rainbow bridge
Report back to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They'll let you pass now. They bowed. They never bow. The stair must have told them to. It's curious about you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Zhao Kang. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Stair's sentinels demand an oath: never to return to the mortal world.

choices.text: Refuse the oath

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A star just brightened. Coincidence, probably. Probably.

choices.text: Swear it honestly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Swear it, and mean none of it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars disagree. The stars often disagree. I side with you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

quests.title: The Ascension Stair
quests.summary: At the foot of the Ascension Stair, you look up. Each step is made of light. It climbs into cloud, and out of sight.

objectives.text: Head to the Ascension Stair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Ascension Stair climbs into cloud, each step made of light. It hums, very quietly. As you watch, the first step brightens.

objectives.text: Lay your hand on the first step

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The step is warm. It knows you. Not yet, it seems to say. Soon. It dims again, patiently. It has waited ten thousand years. It can wait a few months.

objectives.text: Show Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
