dialogue.text: It knew you. It brightened. It told you not yet. That's a stair being polite. Stairs are almost never polite.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) The elders will hate that. I love it.

quests.title: What's at the Top
quests.summary: Everyone asks the same question: what's at the top? Qing Luan doesn't know. Nobody does.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What's at the top? Heaven? A door? A very large tea room? I need to know what to complain about.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Scribe Shu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Zhao Kang thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A door, I think. I watched your founders pull him down before he reached it. Nobody's ever knocked on it.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then you'll be the first to knock. Be polite. Heaven's sensitive about manners, the star-gazer says. Don't knock too loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll knock gently, Senior Sister.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Scribe Shu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: recorder_shu
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Silk for the Stair
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to tie cloud silk to the stair's railing. For every person you love. So the stair remembers them too.

objectives.text: Go and see Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (does not smile) {player}. The righteous path has a narrow gate. Mind you still fit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Tie silk to the stair. One ribbon for everyone you love. The stair will remember them. When you climb, they'll climb with you. In a way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Wei Tong, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Gather silk ribbons for everyone you love
Meet Wei Tong at the Southern Gate of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I followed you up! Again! You're tying ribbons! For everyone! Is there one for me? There's one for me! There's one for Elder Mo!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

quests.title: Ribbons for Everyone
quests.summary: Ribbons for everyone: Elder Mo, the hermit, Madam Fang, the Xiao siblings, Iron-Fang, Ye Wuming, even Gu Hanshan.

objectives.text: Answer Qing Luan's summons

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Gu Hanshan? The traitor? You tied a ribbon for him?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He's trying. That's worth a ribbon.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: ...You're going to be a very strange immortal. Heaven's going to have no idea what to do with you. I'm delighted.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo's ribbon is blue. And straight. I tied it very straight. He'd want it straight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If he offers you a bun before a fight, refuse. He'll share it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone fights better with a bun, Senior Sister. It's science.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Shadows on the Stair
quests.summary: Shadow-born try to climb the stair's lowest steps, testing it for their master. The stair burns them.

objectives.text: Make your way to the Ascension Stair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born claw at the stair's lowest steps. Each time they touch it, they burn, and shriek, and try again.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the floating forest

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather the ash of the burned shadows
Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stair burns anything that isn't its own. Anything carrying something that isn't theirs. The palace inscription said so. A stolen body. A stolen heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Qingyi says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (tugging Qing Luan's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Sitting at the Stair
quests.summary: You sit at the foot of the stair for an hour, and let it get to know you. It hums. You hum back.

objectives.text: Sit at the foot of the Ascension Stair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair hums a note too low to hear. You hum it back. For an hour, you and the stair are alone on the isles, getting acquainted.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It likes you. The stair likes you. I've never seen it like anyone. It liked your founder, a little. It likes you more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Wei Tong?

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

quests.title: The Sect Master Comes Up
quests.summary: The Sect Master comes up the cloud road to see the stair herself. She's never seen it. She's never had time.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Ascension Stair. I've been sect master for eleven years and never seen it. I never had time. I'm taking time.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When you climb it, I'll be at the cloud gate. I'll bow. I'll try not to cry. I'll fail.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you said I don't have to go.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You don't. But you will. Because someone should see what's up there. That's what I'd say. That's what you'll say.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the waterfall isle

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Sect Master. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the waterfall isle. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Unorthodox. My grandfather would faint. I'm delighted.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Stair's Curious Watchers
quests.summary: Storm wolves gather at a respectful distance from the stair, watching it burn shadow-born with obvious approval.

objectives.text: Study the stone tablets at the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stone tablets are carved with names and dates. The last one is blank, waiting.

objectives.text: Drive the storm wolves from the thunder isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The storm wolves come on in silence.

objectives.text: Pick up cloud silk near the sword isle
Share your findings with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The sword isle is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. The Sect Master does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Han Xue. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The thunder wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Star Iron From the Stair's Foot
quests.summary: The ground at the stair's foot holds star iron, warmed by ten thousand years of proximity to something vast.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me star iron from the sword isle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Han Xue, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

objectives.text: Collect star iron around the sword isle
Bring word to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Zhao Kang is not wrong. Zhao Kang is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars do not lie. They merely exaggerate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the star iron you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Ribbon Request
quests.summary: Zhao Kang asks, only half-joking, whether the stair would burn a ribbon tied for a person who's still deciding who they want to be.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Tie one for me too. I know I'm already here. Tie it anyway. In case the stair needs reminding I exist.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Han Xue. That's my job.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the peach garden.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Qing Luan agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the golden lotus lake

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Don't fall off the isle. Falling takes much longer than you'd think up here.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, Escorting the Sect Master
quests.summary: A pair of celestial sentinels, now respectful of the sect's connection to the stair, escort Yun Zhi's visit personally.

objectives.text: Study the stone tablets at the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rows of stone tablets stand in order. One is out of its place, and the gap is the message.

objectives.text: Clear the thunder isle of celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial sentinels spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Find the cloud silk at the elixir spring
Tell the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell me the truth. Did you hesitate at any point? Where?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Answer Han Xue, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (muttering, to the Sect Master) That was cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: Cloud Silk for Every Remaining Ribbon
quests.summary: A few more ribbons are needed: for Bai Ling, for Lu Ping, for the twelve outer disciples, for the chicken.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan would have sent a servant for this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan's servants would have eaten my lunch.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Recover cloud silk from the cloud harbour
See Wei Tong again

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Qing Luan. Qing Luan won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: The Second Step
quests.summary: Curious, you touch the stair's second step. It's colder than the first, and doesn't brighten at all.

objectives.text: Scout the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial cranes stalk the shallows of their isle, white as snow, their crowns red as a seal.

objectives.text: Examine the crane statue

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crane statue stands on one leg, its bronze feathers green with age. Its beak points somewhere specific.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The second step doesn't know you yet. Only the first does. That's how far you've earned. The rest, you earn on the night.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hm. Clean work. I'd have been faster. Not by much.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (grinning at Qing Luan) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Ribbon Placement
quests.summary: Wei Tong spends an inordinate amount of time deciding exactly where on the railing his and Elder Mo's ribbons should sit.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Next to each other. Close, but not touching. He'd say touching ribbons is sentimental. He'd be lying, but he'd say it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about food, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about your clan, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Wei Tong. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the Seal of Heaven

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

reply.speaker: recorder_shu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Garden's Last Test
quests.summary: A final handful of shadow-born tests the immortal garden's approach to the stair before retreating, burned and defeated.

objectives.text: Read the ribbons on the wishing tree at the peach garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among the ribbons on the wishing tree is a strip of black cloth, knotted with a Blood Moon sigil.

objectives.text: Fight off the shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Gather spirit herbs at the peach garden
Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Qing Luan.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Tribulation Jade From the Burned Ash
quests.summary: The ash left by the stair's burning shadow-born crystallizes into a strange form of tribulation jade, worth studying.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bring me tribulation jade from the storm plateau. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore Zhao Kang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Wei Tong, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Pick up tribulation jade near the storm plateau
Return to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A star just blinked. It was about you. I'm almost certain.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Qing Luan. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more tribulation jade than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Good! Good. Elder Mo would grunt. That's a yes.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Han Xue's Ribbon
quests.summary: Han Xue watches you tie her ribbon last, closest to your own hand's reach, and doesn't comment on it, which says everything.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Closest to your hand. I noticed. I'm not going to make it weird. I'm just going to notice, quietly, forever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the Tree of Ages

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Qing Luan has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit. Look up. Try not to fall off.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Qing Luan. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Moon Is Almost Red
quests.summary: On the way down, the moon rises, and it's almost the colour of the Patriarch's robes. Almost.

objectives.text: Report to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Almost red. One more month. Maybe two. Go home. Get ready. I'll be here. Frowning. Fondly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. Qing Luan thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Noted, Han Xue. Overruled, but noted.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One more month. Then everything, all at once. I'll hold the bridge. You hold everything else. Like always.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to Han Xue) The precepts would object. The precepts are not here.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Redder Every Night
quests.summary: The moon rises over the sea of clouds, and it is the colour of rust. Tomorrow it will be the colour of blood.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the bell tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The moon rises over the sea of clouds, the colour of rust. The whole sect is on the walls, watching it, not speaking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rust tonight. Blood soon. Qing Luan's crane says weeks. The fold is breathing. The wards are straining. It's time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Han Xue has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everything we've prepared for since the Heart Mirror. It's time. Go and see Steward Qian. His ledger has become a war.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: A Ledger of Armies
quests.summary: Steward Qian's ledger of monthly letters has become a ledger of armies. Forty sects. How many each. When they'll arrive.

objectives.text: Find Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty sects. Eleven thousand fighters. Supplies for a month. I've counted it all. I've never counted anything so important.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Steward Qian is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Read Steward Qian's ledger of armies

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale, three thousand. Zhao clan, two thousand, in gold. Moon-Well, five hundred healers. Qingshi: forty guards, one magistrate, one very old ballista.

objectives.text: Go back to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The ballista. Qingshi's sending the ballista. It's older than me. It's never hit anything. They insist. It's for morale.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Not now, Lu Ping. Later. Over wine.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Last Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi has drawn one last map: the Abyss, as it will be when the fold opens. Every path. Every door.

objectives.text: See what Xiao Shi wants

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The last map. The Abyss when the fold opens. Every path. Every door. Every cage. I remember them all. I drew them all.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The cages are here, past the gate. Iron-Fang's sister is in that one. I remember her. She shouted at the guards every day.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Bai at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It's beautiful. Accurate. Terrible. I've made eleven copies. One for every commander. And one for my ceiling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Elder Bai is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Thank you, Zhao Kang. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: No precedent for that at all. How exciting.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (grinning at Elder Bai) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Medicine for Eleven Thousand
quests.summary: Elder Hua and Xiao Man have been making medicine for months. It's still not enough. It's never enough.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Hua out

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Eleven thousand fighters. I've made four thousand bundles. Xiao Man's made four thousand more. The Moon-Well brings the rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Elder, the third kiln sneezed again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then feed it less charcoal and more patience, Hongyu.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I've only dropped two hundred! Out of four thousand! That's a record! A good record! Help me pack the last ones!

objectives.text: Pack the last medicine bundles
Report back to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Eight thousand bundles. Every one with a note inside. Xiao Man's idea. Most say 'come home'. Some say 'eat this, idiot'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: Good. I'll fire a pill in your honour. Well, in the honour of whoever eats it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

objectives.choice_prompt: There's medicine for ten thousand, not eleven. Who goes without?

choices.text: The sect's own disciples

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Whoever enlisted last

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: The bandits

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Shadows Under the Red Moon
quests.summary: Under the rusting moon, the shadow-born grow bold. They climb the back path in the open now, not bothering to hide.

objectives.text: Speak with Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Shadows on the back path! Not even sneaking! Just walking up! Under the red moon! I'm ringing everything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Lu Ping, did you hear about the Refectory?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I heard it first, Fan Rui. I always hear it first.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: I felt the bell hum last night, with nobody touching it. Old bells know things.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow
Find Zhao Kang at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're not even hiding any more. The red moon makes them brave. Or stupid. Same thing, in shadows.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Zhao Kang said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Thank you, Lu Ping.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Twelve Want to March
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve, not new any more, want to march with the army. Wei Tong says no. They ask you.

objectives.text: Go and see Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My twelve want to march. To the Abyss. They're not ready. They're so ready. I don't know. You decide. You're scarier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Xiao Shi. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Test Wei Tong's twelve on the puppets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The training puppets spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Bring word to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're ready. Of course they're ready. I trained them. With Elder Mo's words. They'll march behind me. Right behind me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Did anything bite you? Sting you? Look at you strangely? Tell me everything.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

quests.title: Forty Hands, One Promise
quests.summary: Forty sects' last monthly letters arrive at once. Every one says the same thing, in forty different hands.

objectives.text: Answer Steward Qian's summons

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty letters. All at once. All the same. We're coming. In forty hands. The Zhao clan's is in gold ink. Of course it is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Sect Master.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty sects. Coming. Three hundred years ago, two sects stood at the Abyss. This time, forty-one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Fan Rui?

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Forty-one. Plus a town. Plus a bandit's army. Plus a traitor in chains. Plus a chicken. We're a very strange army.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Steward Qian. ...It was a little funny.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Bold. Don't tell the constable.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Han Xue) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Under the Rusting Moon
quests.summary: You sit at the cliff edge under the rusting moon and carry everyone who'll march. Eleven thousand. Light.

objectives.text: Carry eleven thousand under the red moon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven thousand fighters, and the towns behind them, and the families behind the towns. The moon is red. You carry them, and it's light.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You looked peaceful, up there. Under that moon. I've never seen anyone look peaceful under a blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Can't argue with that. I tried.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (grinning at the Sect Master) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Fold Breathes
quests.summary: A crane from Ye Wuming at the rim: the fold is breathing. In and out. Every breath, the black gate comes a little closer.

objectives.text: Report to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A crane from Ye Wuming! He says the fold's breathing! In and out! And every time it breathes, the gate gets closer!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Read Ye Wuming's crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gate drifts closer with every breath. The children can see it now, from the rim, like a ship through fog. Come soon. Ye.

objectives.text: Talk it over with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Weeks. Maybe less. Iron-Fang has asked for time to gather his men. Go and help him. He says they need washing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That is the sect I want. Thank you for being it.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Back Path's Bold Ones
quests.summary: The shadow-born, emboldened by the red moon, need a second clearing pass on the back path before the army musters.

objectives.text: Hurry to the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old blades stand in the rock of the sword tomb like a field of iron grass, each one a disciple's last oath.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the arena stands

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The shadow-born come on in silence.

objectives.text: Collect sealed letters around the outer dormitories
Share your findings with Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Old Bao.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the War Chest
quests.summary: Steward Qian's ledger of armies needs a matching ledger of spirit stones, and he asks for one last collection round.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai, you've been in the pagoda for three days. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I had a very nourishing scroll.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
See Elder Bai again

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The chronicles are full of cruelty. Thank you for a better page.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Eleven Copies
quests.summary: Elder Bai personally delivers his eleven map copies to each commander, adding a small hand-written note to every one.

objectives.text: See what Elder Bai wants

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Eleven notes. Eleven commanders. Each one says the same thing at the bottom: come back and tell me if the map was right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: No, Lu Ping. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Meet Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Lu Ping is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: See? Even Elder Bai agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I was meditating. With my eyes closed. Loudly.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the treasure tower

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, Testing the Wards
quests.summary: A handful of demon cultivators test the sect's wards under the red moon, probing for weakness before the war.

objectives.text: Go to the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The long refectory smells of rice, ginger and a hundred disciples who trained since dawn.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the Sword Peak path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the medicine valley
Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Han Xue, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: kiln_tao
dialogue.text: The third kiln sneezed again. I lost an eyebrow. It'll grow back. Last time it did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Letters for the Last Muster
quests.summary: Forty sects need one final letter confirming muster points and timing, and Lu Ping insists on writing every one personally.

objectives.text: Hear Lu Ping out

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me sealed letters from the mountain road. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Lu Ping, did you hear about the Refectory?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I heard it first, Fan Rui. I always hear it first.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Gather sealed letters at the mountain road
Return to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Tang Ling.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You have ink on your nose, {player}. At least I hope it's ink.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you, by the way. I always bet on you. I've bought four hats.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Measured. I would have chosen the same.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (tugging Lu Ping's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Qiu Hua's Question
quests.summary: Qiu Hua, now one of Wei Tong's senior twelve, asks whether the chicken can march too, for morale.

objectives.text: Investigate the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash drifts across the pill kiln yard. A kiln door opens with a roar, and a disciple ducks a gout of flame.

objectives.text: Tend the pill furnace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soot and bitter smoke pour from the pill furnace as you open it. Something in the last batch was not meant to be there.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The chicken has survived a Rung's web. The chicken has earned it. Elder Drumstick marches. That's final.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Wei Tong will leave out. There is always a part.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I didn't see anything. Nobody saw anything.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Wei Tong) That was cold.

quests.title: Han Xue's Wall Assignment
quests.summary: Han Xue finalizes who holds which wall, which gate, and which flank, in a plan even Zhao Kang admits is flawless.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Every gap covered. Every flank guarded. I've been planning this for a year. I'm allowed to be a little proud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the laundry stream

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Old Bao, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Xiao Man says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Man) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Mountain's Last Sweep
quests.summary: One final sweep clears void wraiths from every corner of the mountain before the muster truly begins.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Shadow-born ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the mountain road
Show the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (whispering to the Sect Master) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (hiding behind the Sect Master) Oh.

quests.title: Medicine for Iron-Fang's Men
quests.summary: Word arrives that Iron-Fang's men will need medicine too, and Elder Hua packs a separate bundle just for them.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Do you want a pill? I made it. It's probably a pill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Collect medicine bundles around the medicine valley
Go back to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd have grunted and looked away. That's how he said proud. I'll just say it. Proud!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three herbs today! Well. Three that I know of.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Xiao Man's Notes
quests.summary: Xiao Man insists every medicine bundle for Iron-Fang's men get a note too, even though they're strangers to her.

objectives.text: Answer Xiao Man's summons

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Strangers who are marching to save people they love. That's not a stranger. That's family I haven't met yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's been feeding me since dawn. Please rescue me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're too thin! Thin brothers get cold!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Hua is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Drink this. No, it doesn't taste good. That's how you know it works.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the sunrise terrace. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Sect Master is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Hua. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: Heaven Answers the Red Moon
quests.summary: Under the red moon, the storm that has watched you for a year finally turns its eye. Tribulation Transcendence will not wait for the war.

objectives.text: Report to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The clouds over the cliff. They're turning. Like an eye. It's yours, isn't it? Go. We'll hold the walls. We're good at walls.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Old Qiu. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

objectives.text: Break through beneath the red moon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, a town, a bandit army, a mountain of friends. You carry them all, and the sky, at last, answers.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Tribulation Transcendence

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The red moon hangs behind the storm like an eye behind a veil. Heaven has been waiting for this for years.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tribulation Transcendence. Under a blood moon. Mo would have said adequate and gone to cry somewhere private. So will I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's crane came. He needs soap. For forty bandits. I'm bringing soap. And dumplings. Everybody needs dumplings.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Old Camp, Full Again
quests.summary: The old bandit camp is full again, for the first time since you burned it. This time, the bandits are waiting for you.

objectives.text: Pry open the chest at the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old bandit camp is full: forty men, rough and grey-bearded and very dirty, sitting around fires, polishing farm tools into weapons.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lid of the chest groans open. Inside: dust, a moth, and exactly what you were looking for.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the stream

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty. My old men. Farmers now, mostly. All of them have someone behind that gate. All of them want to march.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They're also filthy. A bandit camp's no place to wash. Your hermit has a spring. I'm told springs are for washing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

quests.title: Soap for Forty
quests.summary: Wei Tong has brought soap. A lot of soap. The hermit's spring has never seen so many bandits at once.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Soap! For forty! And towels! And dumplings for after! I've planned this very carefully! Everyone into the spring!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Hermit.

objectives.text: Hand out soap at the spirit spring
Find the hermit at the waterfall gorge

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Forty bandits. In my spring. With soap. The lotus is very confused. So am I. But they're very clean now. Cleaner than me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.
