reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) Soft. Soft wins more than people think.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Washed
quests.summary: Forty bandits, washed. They look at each other, clean for the first time in years, and don't recognise anyone.

objectives.text: See what Iron-Fang wants

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They don't recognise each other. Twenty years of dirt, gone. Old Bao's got a face under there. Who knew. He's very handsome.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Iron-Fang said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Right.

objectives.text: Search the chest at the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: An old bandit touches his own clean face and laughs. Then cries. Then laughs again. The others do the same. It's contagious.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You pry open the chest. Whoever packed it did so in a hurry, and in fear.

objectives.text: Report back to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Washed. Now fed. Then trained. Then we march. Iron-Fang's army. Clean for the first time in twenty years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Told you, Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Fed
quests.summary: Wei Tong feeds forty bandits. It takes all day. It's the happiest you've ever seen him.

objectives.text: Hear Wei Tong out

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Forty bandits! Forty appetites! This is the best day of my life! Dumplings! Noodles! More dumplings! Nobody leaves hungry!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ignore Iron-Fang. Everyone else does.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

objectives.text: Carry Wei Tong's dumplings to the fires
Serve the first bowl to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang takes the first bowl. He eats slowly. Around the fires, forty washed and fed men eat, and talk about their families, and laugh.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the spider hollow

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty of them. Clean. Full. Laughing. I've never seen them like this. Neither have they. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? I don't want to eat your share of dinner. I'll do it, but I won't enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Worry later, Wei Tong. Move now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Practical. I like practical.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Trained
quests.summary: Washed and fed, Iron-Fang's men need training. With real weapons. They've only ever fought with farm tools and desperation.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They fight like farmers. Desperate farmers. Brave, stupid, messy. Teach them to fight like people who want to come home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Train Iron-Fang's recruits

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I came to help teach! With a broom! The broom is a very good teacher! Everyone in Qingshi agrees!

objectives.text: Bring word to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Better. They're still messy. But they fight like they want to come home. That's the most important stance there is.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut it, Liu Er.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: The constable would weep. Proper tears.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Practical. I like practical.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Oh. Okay. I think that makes sense.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Shadows in the Camp
quests.summary: The shadow-born come for Iron-Fang's camp at night. They want the bandits scared. The bandits are fed now. It's harder.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shadows! At the camp! Forty clean men, form a line! With farm tools! With brooms! Liu Er, show them!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

objectives.text: Clear the old bandit camp of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shadow-born! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born regrouping
See Iron-Fang again

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Held. My men held. First fight in years where nobody ran. They said they didn't want to get dirty again. Best reason I've heard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Ye Wuming's got a point.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Careful. I know where that road ends.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's my kind of justice. The quick kind.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) The sect never did tame {them}.

quests.title: The Names Behind the Gate
quests.summary: Around the fire, each of Iron-Fang's men says one name: the person waiting for them behind the black gate.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Around the fire, forty men, one name each. A wife. A son. A mother. A brother. Iron-Fang goes last.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Tie Mei. My sister. She's mid-shout, the heir says. Frozen, mid-shout. She was always shouting. I'd give anything to hear it.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: Go by the woodcutters' path. The other one has a saw pit, and the saw pit is hungry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Iron-Fang) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: My children listened to every name. They're going to find every cage. They promised. They keep promises. I taught them that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not the time, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

objectives.choice_prompt: Some of Iron-Fang's men still owe old blood debts to Qingshi families.

choices.text: Settle their debts from your own purse

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Have the magistrate record them for after the war

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Tell the families to take it out of their hides

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: The Old Map
quests.summary: Iron-Fang has an old map, from when the Blood Moon used him: the fortress, the gate, and the guard changes.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Look at you. Wearing the sect's robes and the bandit's heart. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The soft-hearted immortal. Still alive. Surprises me every time.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon used me for twenty years. I learned things. When the guards change. Where the gate's weakest. Here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: I'll carry anything heavy. Heavier than a tree, I'll need a friend.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not this time, Big Shu.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: woodcutter_shu
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Study Iron-Fang's old fortress map

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A map drawn in charcoal on leather: the black gate, the court, the cages. A note in Iron-Fang's hand: the gate opens only from inside. Or with a token.

objectives.text: Return to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: A token. Like the blood-red one I lost. The one your Elder Gu took. Wonder what happened to it. Probably melted. The Law Hall melts everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Clean tracking. You'd make a decent hunter, if you ever stop being a hero.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Iron-Fang, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Forty Men by the Fire
quests.summary: The night before Iron-Fang's army leaves the forest, you sit by their fire and carry them. Forty. Plus the forty behind the gate.

objectives.text: Carry Iron-Fang's army by the fire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty washed, fed men, snoring by the fire. Forty frozen people behind a gate, mid-word, mid-shout. You carry both. They weigh the same.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You're carrying my men. I can tell. They're sleeping better than they have in years. Thank you, sect brat. Sect hero. Whatever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Ye Wuming. Ye Wuming's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: No argument.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Rogue Cultivators, Testing the March
quests.summary: A band of rogue cultivators, hoping to pick off stragglers before the muster, test Iron-Fang's newly trained men.

objectives.text: Examine the loom at the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shuttle of the loom has stopped mid-row. The half-finished pattern is a map, if you know how to read it.

objectives.text: Fight off the rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the old battlefield
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the old battlefield. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Hermit. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Bandits' Weapons
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's men need proper weapons to replace the farm tools, and spirit stones fund the forge work.

objectives.text: Find the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bring me spirit stones from the spirit spring. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Recover spirit stones from the spirit spring
Go back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to the hermit) That was cold.

quests.title: Old Bao's Handsome Face
quests.summary: Old Bao, still adjusting to being recognizably handsome, gets teased mercilessly and clearly loves every second of it.

objectives.text: Sound the war drum at the forest watchpost

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Bao poses dramatically by the fire. Twenty years of dirt hid a face that, it turns out, was worth seeing all along.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the war drum. The boom rolls out across the land and comes back from the hills, twice.

objectives.text: Meet Liu Er at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Iron-Fang. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the lookout rock.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the fishing jetty

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Iron-Fang. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The Law Hall's going to write you a very long letter.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's my kind of justice. The quick kind.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Spring's Edge
quests.summary: A cluster of void wraiths lingers at the spirit spring's edge, drawn by forty men's worth of relief and hope.

objectives.text: Search the hunter's lodge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Smoke curls from the hunter's lodge. Antlers and wolf skulls grin down from the eaves.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather wolf fangs at the tiger ridge
Share your findings with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the tiger ridge isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: huntress_meng
dialogue.text: Clean tracking. You'd make a decent hunter, if you ever stop being a hero.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: huntress_meng
reply.text: (to the hermit) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The old rules, kept well. My masters would have smiled.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

quests.title: Spirit Herbs for the March's Rations
quests.summary: Forty men need rations for the march to the rim, and Lan Jue helps gather spirit herbs from the healed forest.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me spirit herbs from the hidden valley, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit herbs near the hidden valley
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Iron-Fang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: Liu Er's Broom Lessons, Continued
quests.summary: Liu Er formally trains three of Iron-Fang's men in proper broom technique, which turns out to be surprisingly effective.

objectives.text: Head to the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the bamboo village not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Tell Liu Er what you found

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Grip low, sweep wide, don't overthink it. It's basically a sword with better morale. They're naturals.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ye Wuming. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Children, Watching
quests.summary: Spring and River, visiting from the school, watch the bandits' transformation with quiet fascination.

objectives.text: Make your way to the woodcutters' camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring says the bandits look like her, a little. People who were made into weapons, slowly turning back into people. She's right.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the mushroom ring

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Liu Er. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Hermit. Doesn't change anything.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: Nothing to report all week, then everything at once. I hate it when it's everything at once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Pei Yuan. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: watcher_pei
reply.text: (whispering to Han Xue) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Bandits, a Friendly Sparring Round
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's newly trained men spar against each other in a friendly round, testing what they've learned.

objectives.text: Taste the wine jars at the bamboo village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You tap the wine jars one by one. Full, full, full, and one that answers hollow.

objectives.text: Stop the Iron-Fang's recruits at the sunken courtyard

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Collect spirit herbs around the poison marsh
Compare notes with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The forest noticed. So did I. We are both very old and very hard to impress.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't only me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Iron-Fang does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I'll allow it. Once.

quests.title: Medicine for the March Ahead
quests.summary: Elder Hua sends a final medicine shipment to the bandit camp before the long march to the rim begins.

objectives.text: Hear the hermit out

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the old bandit camp. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Wei Tong. That was very... something.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the old bandit camp
Bring word to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Did anyone follow you back? Look again.

objectives.choice_prompt: The medicine bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the hermit) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Goose Song
quests.summary: Wei Tong, having learned the entire bandit song about stealing a goose, performs it with tragic sincerity.

objectives.text: Speak with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It's actually about loss and redemption! The goose represents innocence! ...Or it's just about a goose. Either way, it's a bop.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Be careful, all right? Mother lights incense for you. It's expensive incense.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Liu Er. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the cliff path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Han Xue says that to everyone. She told me my breathing was sloppy. I was asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It was sloppy, Wei Tong. Even asleep.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Talk with Liu Er at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Han Xue. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says I have to be polite to immortals. Hello, immortal!

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Liu Er) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Liu Er) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (grinning at Liu Er) You didn't see that. I didn't see that.

quests.title: March to the Rim
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's army marches out of the bamboo toward the Abyss rim, clean, fed, and singing a very bad bandit song.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: We'll camp at the rim. Near the fold. Near our families. We'll wait for your sect. Don't be late. The moon won't wait.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: watcher_pei
dialogue.text: I'll light the watch lantern for you. If you see it go out, run.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Pei Yuan.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the fishing jetty

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're singing! A bandit song! It's about stealing a goose! It's terrible! I'm learning it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Three Requests
quests.summary: The Sect Master summons you. Gu Hanshan has asked for three last requests, and asked that you escort him.

objectives.text: Answer the Sect Master's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Gu has asked for three last requests. He asked that you escort him. He won't say why they're last. I think we both know.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll come back. I always do.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Grant them. All three. Whatever they are. He's earned three.

objectives.text: Join Elder Gu at the spirit peach orchard

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Three. The cliff where Mo's ashes lie. The Law Hall, once more. And my daughter's letters. I'd like to burn them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Two leaves and a bud, disciple. Take only what you need, whatever you're picking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Then I'll be ready. For whatever the moon brings. Thank you for escorting me. I know you'd rather not.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

quests.title: The First Request
quests.summary: The first request: the cliff edge, where Elder Mo's ashes were scattered. Gu Hanshan kneels.

objectives.text: Scout the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Gu Hanshan kneels at the cliff edge, chains clinking. The sea of clouds is red under the rusting moon.

objectives.text: Kneel beside Gu at the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Mo, he says. I altered your formation. You died fixing my mistake. I don't ask you to forgive me. I just wanted you to know I know.

objectives.text: Show Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He'd have said something grumpy. Hmph. Adequate apology. More than adequate. I can hear him. I can hear him saying it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Back safe. Sit. Your face needs a cup more than your cultivation does.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Auntie Ruo says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Good. I was about to go looking myself, and I would have got lost on the second floor.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Rules broke me too. From the other side.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Well! That's one way to do it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

quests.title: Wei Tong at the Cliff
quests.summary: Wei Tong has followed. He's been angry at Gu for years. He's not sure what he is now.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I followed you. I don't know why. I've been angry at him for years. For Elder Mo. I wanted to hit him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Hermit. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He knelt. He apologised to Elder Mo. Elder Mo would have... Elder Mo would have said adequate. I'm not going to hit him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. He was proud of you. He told me once, before. He said you'd be a better teacher than him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...He told YOU? He told the paper and he told YOU? That old man. That stubborn, stubborn old man.

objectives.text: Speak with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the hermit said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Just so.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Tea is steeping. It will be ready when you are. Possibly sooner. Possibly next spring.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Hermit?

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that road. I walked it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: The Second Request
quests.summary: The second request: the Law Hall, empty for years. Gu Hanshan sits in his old chair, once.

objectives.text: Hurry to the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Law Hall is empty and dusty. Gu Hanshan sits in his old chair, very straight, and looks at the empty chairs where his disciples sat.

objectives.text: Watch Gu sit in the Law Hall one last time

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He takes a brush and writes one line on a fresh slip, and leaves it on the desk: fill this hall with someone kinder than me.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than my grief. I wrote that once. Now I'll write this. Kinder. Someone kinder. That's all the law needs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Answer Wei Tong, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Shadows at the Law Hall
quests.summary: The shadow-born come for Gu in the Law Hall. The Patriarch knows he's planning something.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows! Coming for Gu! The Patriarch must know he's up to something! Protect the traitor! I never thought I'd say that!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Hold the long stone stairway against more Blood Moon cultivators
See Zhao Kang again

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan protected Gu Hanshan. My brother would laugh. Or cry. Both. The Zhao clan does both at once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Zhao Kang and Gu
quests.summary: Zhao Kang asks Gu Hanshan one last question. It's not the one anyone expected.

objectives.text: See what Zhao Kang wants

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I asked you once why you sent my brother. You told me. I've got a different question now. Did he suffer?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...No. It was quick. He was brave. He was protecting a caravan. He died between them and the bandits. Standing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Standing. Good. That's... good. Thank you. That's all I needed. Go and finish your requests.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Be careful, {senior}!

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Fan Rui. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Letters to a Dead Girl
quests.summary: The third request: twenty years of unsent letters to Gu Lan. He wants to burn them, the way you burned Luo Hui's.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Gu out

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The letters. To Lan. Twenty years. You burned the First Rung's letters. You sent them, you said. Send mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Deacon Shen. I asked who would go.

objectives.text: Gather Gu's letters to his daughter
Burn the letters at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letters burn. The ash rises over the sea of clouds and goes up, and up. Gu watches it until it's gone. He doesn't cry. He smiles.

objectives.text: Return to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Delivered. Twenty years late. She had better manners than me. She'll read them anyway.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Did anything bite you? Sting you? Look at you strangely? Tell me everything.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You gave me water once, on the bone field, when the rules said no. I never thanked you. Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Before the last letter burned, you read one line: the name of Gu Lan's poisoner, alive in another sect.

choices.text: Let it lie. Gu has forgiven.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Send it to that sect's Law Hall

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Hunt him down yourself

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

quests.title: The Sect Master and the Traitor
quests.summary: At the end, the Sect Master comes to the moon gate. She and Gu Hanshan talk for the first time in years.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty years, Hanshan. I trusted you with our law and our children.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: And I broke both. Qingyao. I have a way through the black gate. When the moon rises, I'll use it. Don't stop me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: ...I won't. Come back, if you can. That's not a request. It's what I say to everyone. I'm saying it to you too.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: I copied the old records on that place. The second page is useful. The first is mostly complaints.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What Tang Ling said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the cave behind the waterfall. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to the hermit) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Sitting With the Traitor
quests.summary: On the last night of his requests, Gu Hanshan asks you to sit with him at the moon gate. He doesn't want to be alone.

objectives.text: Go and see Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit with me. Just sit. I've been alone for twenty years, even in company. Tonight I'd like not to be.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Deacon Shen has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Sit with Gu Hanshan at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit with the man who betrayed everything, under a red moon, in silence. It isn't forgiveness. It's company. It might be the same thing.

objectives.text: Go back to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Thank you. For the sitting. For everything. You'd have made a good Law Hall elder. You listen twice. Go and sleep.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a scratch? Let me check. Hm. One scratch. I'll allow it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law, kept. It matters more than I let it.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) By every precept I know. Note it in the record.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Sensible. Neither the soft road nor the hard one.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. The Law Hall would have your hide.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Moon Gate's Watch
quests.summary: A last handful of shadow-born tests the moon gate's wards overnight, drawn by the traitor's quiet reckoning.

objectives.text: Go to the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the tea terraces the air changes, heavy with qi and something older underneath.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-born spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Recover incense bundles from the sect gate
Share your findings with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Deacon Shen. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

quests.title: Incense for Gu's Vigil
quests.summary: Elder Hua sends incense to the moon gate, a small comfort for a man sitting with twenty years of guilt.

objectives.text: Answer the Sect Master's summons

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me incense bundles from the sect gate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what the Sect Master says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Han Xue. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Gather incense bundles at the sect gate
Report back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Wei Tong?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more incense bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: The proper way! Very proper. I'd have done it improperly.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (muttering, to the Sect Master) That was cold.

quests.title: Elder Bai's Cold Ledger
quests.summary: Elder Bai, ever the archivist, reads Gu's original trial record aloud, not to condemn him further but to make sure history remembers accurately.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Every fact, in order. Not to punish him again. So nobody forgets what happened, or pretends it was simpler than it was.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder, I finished copying the third annal.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Adequately? ...No. Well. Very well.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Noted, Zhao Kang. Overruled, but noted.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Hua is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold out your wrist. Hm. Your pulse is stubborn. Like you.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Zhao Kang. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Law Hall's Old Guard
quests.summary: A pair of demon cultivators, sent to watch the emptied Law Hall, are driven off before they can report anything useful.

objectives.text: Light incense in the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three legs, two handles, and a rim of ancient script: the bronze ding is older than the hall that shelters it.

objectives.text: Clear the summit of Sword Peak of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Moon cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Pick up sealed letters near the outer dormitories
Tell the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The outer dormitories is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Old Bao. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The lotus grows in mud and is not stained. You remembered.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to the hermit) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The bamboo bends. So did you. It is not always wrong.

quests.title: Jade Slips for the Law Hall's New Note
quests.summary: Elder Bai copies Gu's final note - 'fill this hall with someone kinder than me' - onto a permanent jade slip.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Bring me jade slips from the laundry stream. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Take a rice ball. Two. You look like somebody who forgets to eat until they fall over.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Old Bao, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

objectives.text: Collect jade slips around the laundry stream
Bring word to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Wei Tong's been here three times today. It's not even noon. He calls it training.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Old Bao?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell. It bites, and it holds grudges.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the jade slips you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (stops mixing) I don't have a pill for that, {player}.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Second Thought
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, walking back from the Law Hall, admits the answer about his brother's death didn't hurt the way he expected.

objectives.text: Investigate the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Notice boards cover every wall of the mission hall, sect tasks pinned three deep and fluttering in the draught.

objectives.text: Read the ledgers at the abacus desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ledgers on the abacus desk balance to the last copper, which is exactly what makes them suspicious.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I thought knowing would break something open again. Instead it just... closed something. Quietly. I didn't expect quiet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha! Knew it! I bet Lu Ping a bun you'd be back before dusk. That's my bun.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Wei Tong's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Unfinished Anger
quests.summary: Wei Tong admits he's still not sure he's forgiven Gu, and that maybe that's allowed too.

objectives.text: See what Wei Tong wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I don't hate him anymore. I don't forgive him either. Elder Hua says that's a real place to be, not just a stop on the way somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hmm. The bamboo would bend first. But you are not bamboo, are you?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Hermit.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The young one is right. I have been wrong for three hundred years. I can tell.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Fan Rui. That was very... something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (whispering to the hermit) That was amazing.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Orderly. The bamboo approves. It likes straight lines.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to the hermit) That was cold.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Cliff Edge's Last
quests.summary: A last cluster of void wraiths tests the cliff edge where Gu made his first request, drawn by old grief.

objectives.text: Listen to the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sword in the stone is cold and humming. For a moment you hear its last owner's oath, word for word.

objectives.text: Fight off the shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The shadow-born come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
Show the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Letters for the Sect's Own Record
quests.summary: Lu Ping asks to keep copies of Gu's burned letters' addresses, so the sect remembers a daughter's name too.

objectives.text: Hear Elder Bai out

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me sealed letters from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

objectives.text: Recover sealed letters from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
See Elder Bai again

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm standing right here, you know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Knowledge is like tea. Too hot, and it scalds. Too cold, and nobody wants it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) Sensible. Boring, but sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (takes off his spectacles) I didn't see that. I refuse to have seen that.

quests.title: Han Xue's Quiet Understanding
quests.summary: Han Xue, watching from a distance, tells you she understands why you sat with him, even if she wouldn't have.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wouldn't have sat with him. I understand why you did. Those are both true, and neither one is wrong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The ground remembers footsteps, and so do the things beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to the hermit. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the cave behind the waterfall

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No, Elder Hua. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.text: Join Elder Gu at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: That task isn't on any board. If it isn't on a board, officially, it doesn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I did not ask whether it was wise, Deacon Shen. I asked who would go.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Mercy. I forgot how it looks.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Gu, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Elder Gu, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Hermit's Blessing
quests.summary: The hermit comes to the moon gate at dawn and blesses Gu Hanshan with the Heart Sutra. Gu weeps, at last.

objectives.text: Go and see the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. Even for you, Gu Hanshan. Especially for you. Compassion doesn't choose who deserves it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...I'm crying. I haven't cried since Lan. Thank you, Verdant Lotus. Your sect was always kinder than ours.

objectives.text: Search the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit beast garden looks exactly as it should, which is what makes you uneasy.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Be careful, child. I have outlived too many brave people.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Shadows Over Qingshi
quests.summary: A crane from Constable Du: shadows over Qingshi at dusk. Hundreds. And a young man in red, standing on the watchtower.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A crane from Constable Du. Hundreds of shadows over Qingshi. And a young man in red on the watchtower. Xue Chen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.
