dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What Old Qiu said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

objectives.text: Search the notice board at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qingshi's gate is shut. The sky above the town is thick with drifting shadow-born, circling like crows over a field.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Slips flutter on the notice board, three deep. Under a request for firewood, one note is newer, and written in a hurry.

objectives.text: Hear what Constable Du has to say

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Hundreds of them. Circling. Not attacking. Waiting. The boy on the tower's waiting too. He hasn't moved in an hour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Constable Du does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Not now, Han Xue. Later. Over wine.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: The Town Knows What to Do
quests.summary: Qingshi knows what to do. It's held before. Everyone takes their place without being asked.

objectives.text: Report to Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Children in the cellar with the wine. Again. They've never touched the wine. Well. Once. That boy. He's a guard now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes. The magistrate concurs. Formally. I'll have it written up.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the tannery

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's men came back from the rim to help. Clean ones. Fed ones. They know this town. They tried to burn it once. Now they'll hold it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Do it lawfully, if you can. And if you can't, do it quietly.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the examination cells

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've written a speech. One word. You know the word. Everyone knows the word.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Noted. Written down. Now it's official.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: There. Constable Du agrees. Settled.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: The Boy on the Tower
quests.summary: Xue Chen stands on the watchtower, looking down at the town. He isn't giving orders. He's watching the children.

objectives.text: Head to the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Xue Chen stands on the watchtower. Below him, children run to the inn cellar. He watches them. He looks like he's trying to remember something.

objectives.text: Look at Xue Chen with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the thread from him to the fold is thick and red. And somewhere in it, very small, a boy from Willow Creek, pulling the other way.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's pulling against his own thread. Very weakly. But pulling. There's a door there. A small one. Let's knock.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Good. That's one less entry in my book. My book thanks you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Ye Wuming) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. The road taught you that.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Shadows Fall
quests.summary: At full dark, the Patriarch pulls the thread, and every shadow-born over Qingshi falls on the town at once.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They're coming down! All of them! Everyone to your places! Magistrate, the word! Say the word!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen will cover what it can. The yamen can cover very little.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: {player} will be all right, Magistrate Zhou. The immortal always is. Mostly.

objectives.text: Ring the town bell

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. The magistrate shouts one word from the yamen steps. Hold. Every door in Qingshi slams, and every hand picks up something.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the night market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Guards
Find Magistrate Zhou at the post station

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Hold! I said hold! They held! We held! I'm going to say it again! Hold!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I'd rather handle it by the book. The book is thin, though. And the town is big.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Constable Du.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Take water. The well's sweet this season. Heaven keeps its accounts, but it forgets thirst.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou, nervously) Should we... say something?

quests.title: The River Assault
quests.summary: The shadows come up the river too, where Old Pan's ferry is still crossing with the last farmers.

objectives.text: See what Old Pan wants

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Shadows on the water! My ferry's out there! Full of farmers! Forty years! I'm not losing a passenger now!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Han Xue. Leave it to them.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eat before you go. Nobody ever fought well on an empty stomach and a full head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Old Pan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: More shadow-born? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the terraced fields
Return to Old Pan

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Every farmer across. Every one. I hit a shadow with an oar. It felt the same as the wolf. Wonderful. Every time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Liu Er! Manners!

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Xue Chen Watches
quests.summary: Through the fighting, Xue Chen doesn't move from the tower. When the shadows falter, he speaks to you, from far away.

objectives.text: Hear Xue Chen out

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: They're holding. A town of mortals, holding against the shadow of the Patriarch. With brooms. Why?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because they carry each other. Come down, cousin. Carry something with us.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I've sold to the Blood Moon and I've bled for it. I know which I prefer. Speak.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: acolyte_hei
dialogue.text: The moon is watching you, heir. It's very fond of you. Hungrily fond.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...I can't. He's pulling. He's my father. He's the only thing I've ever had. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everything has a price. I'm learning which things shouldn't. It's very expensive, learning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not laughing. I'm breathing strangely.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Listen to Iron-Fang. More sense there than in half this town.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

objectives.text: Speak with Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, can I go too? Please?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: No, and don't ask again. ...Carry the water first.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The water's sweet this season. Take a cup.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Blood for the Moon
quests.summary: The shadows aren't trying to win. They're trying to spill blood, anywhere, for the moon. Some of it has already soaked the graves.

objectives.text: Read the ancestral tablets at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the hill graves, shadow-born are drawing a circle in blood, the old way, Hong's way. They've nearly finished.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense ash lies fresh before the ancestral tablets. One name has been touched so often its gilding is gone.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Gather the blood-soaked earth before the moon drinks it
Share your findings with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: The circle's broken! I broke it with the broom! The broom is a hero! Everybody's going to hear about the broom!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xue Chen's captives are tied at the river. Freeing them now weakens the gate.

choices.text: Free them now

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Hold the gate, as ordered

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Use the captives as a shield

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: The Last Wave at the Gate
quests.summary: The last wave of shadows hits the town gate. Constable Du holds it with his ugly new spear.

objectives.text: Speak with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Last wave! At the gate! My spear's ugly! It's the best spear in the world! Everyone with a spear, with me! For Qingshi!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: (laughs despite herself) Oh, Liu Er.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: If you need anything bought, sold or quietly moved, you know where the warehouse is.

objectives.text: Ward the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises over the gate. Constable Du's ugly spear catches the light. Behind him, forty clean bandits and a town full of brooms.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Guards from the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The Blood Guards have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the shadow-born that follow
Go back to Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Held. Qingshi held. Again. I'm going to write it down. In the good ink. Then I'm going to sleep for a week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Light some incense tonight, Han Xue. For luck.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: The Empty Tower
quests.summary: When the last shadow falls, the watchtower is empty. Xue Chen is gone. He left something on the rail.

objectives.text: Make your way to the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The watchtower is empty. On the rail, a small carved horse, very old, the kind a child might carry from a village by a creek.

objectives.text: Pick up the carved horse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Carved on its belly, in a child's scratches: Chen. Willow Creek. He left it for you. Or for himself. Or both.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He left the only thing he brought from home. That's not a threat. That's a boy asking someone to hold his toy while he does something terrible.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Gossip is free. Wine, noodles and advice are not. This is gossip.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not the time, Madam Fang.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Market's Last
quests.summary: A final cluster of shadow-born, cut off from the retreat, is cleared from the market square at dawn.

objectives.text: Check the medicine cabinet at the Wang pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You open drawer after drawer of the medicine cabinet. Ginseng, liquorice, and one drawer that smells of blood lotus.

objectives.text: Clear the night market of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather lantern oil at the brewery
Compare notes with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this river and I've never seen it look so pleased.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Did you fly? Did you use a sword? Can I hold the sword? Just for a moment?

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Medicine for the Held Town
quests.summary: A night of fighting leaves plenty of small wounds, and Elder Hua's supply run arrives just after dawn.

objectives.text: Go and see Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me medicine bundles from the night market.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: No, Captain Lei. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Look at you. Like a cat who found the fish and the knife at once.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Pick up medicine bundles near the night market
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Captain Lei. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: There you are. The noodles were getting cold, and so was my temper.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Men, Proud
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's clean, fed, trained men hold a small private celebration, having fought their first real battle since reforming.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: First fight since the farms. We held. Nobody ran. Nobody died. Best outcome a bandit could ask for.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Boatmen talk after the third cup. Buy the third cup, not the first.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

objectives.text: Hear what Constable Du has to say

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: The militia will hold the street. The militia will mostly hold the street.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Thank you, Captain Lei, but it's cultivator's work.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Mind yourself. Every mother in Qingshi counts you as half a son now.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the examination cells

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: scholar_ouyang
dialogue.text: The classics say a wise man walks around a river. The classics never had to cross this one.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Listen to Scholar Ouyang. We've lived here a long time.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: scholar_ouyang
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) Proper. Very proper. The magistrate will be pleased.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (wiping away tears) Most of your kind wouldn't have bothered.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Blood Guards, Fleeing the River
quests.summary: A handful of blood guards, driven from the river assault, flee toward the farmland and are run down.

objectives.text: Sound the war drum at the opera stage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The war drum speaks in a voice like thunder. Every head turns. Somewhere, someone starts running.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Collect lantern oil around the brewery
Show Magistrate Zhou what you found

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: A round on the house! No. Half a round. A quarter. Here, have a cup.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Magistrate Zhou) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (pales) Of course. Of course.

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Magistrate Zhou, whispering) Don't look at them. Just nod.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Town's Repairs
quests.summary: Qingshi's gate and walls need repair after the night's fighting, and Merchant Jin funds the work without complaint.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me spirit stones from the night market.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Should my men go first? They're very brave. From a distance.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Find the spirit stones at the night market
Bring word to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: captain_lei
dialogue.text: Good work, cultivator. I'll have the lads cheer. They're good at cheering.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Please stop. My ears are turning red.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: captain_lei
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) By the law. That's all anyone asks.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Carved Horse, Studied
quests.summary: Bai Ling, reached by crane, asks for a description of the carved horse, hoping it holds a clue to reaching Xue Chen.

objectives.text: Scout the silk workshop

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the silk workshop. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Check the thread on the loom

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The loom clacks once as you touch it, as if the weaver had only stepped out for a moment.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: A toy from before the shadow. That's not nothing. That's a thread heavier than any red one the Patriarch ever spun.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: We were not worried, Iron-Fang. We were attentive.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Widow Liu's Wine Thimble
quests.summary: Widow Liu insists on personally pouring the children's celebratory thimble of wine, treating it like a solemn ceremony.

objectives.text: Find Widow Liu

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: One thimble. Measured carefully. Bravery deserves exactly one thimble, no more. I'm very precise about this.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Is this wise? I'm asking as a merchant. We are professionally cautious.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Merchant Jin. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

objectives.text: Talk with Merchant Jin at the pawnshop

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Merchant Jin says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Just so, just so.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the canal walk

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the canal walk. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Ye Wuming. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Graveyard's Remnant
quests.summary: A remnant of demon cultivators, left behind after the blood circle broke, is cleared from the hill graves.

objectives.text: Examine the offering table at the temple orphanage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The dust on the offering table has been disturbed. Beneath the incense bowl lies a folded note.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the pottery kilns

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the brewery
Share your findings with Magistrate Zhou

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: And the others? Did everyone come home? Tell me everyone came home.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us everything.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen is open to all petitions. Between the second and fourth bell.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate himself couldn't fault it.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

quests.title: Void Shards From the Broken Circle
quests.summary: The broken blood circle leaves void shards behind, worth gathering before the graves are properly tended again.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me void shards from the hill graves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The water's restless. When the water's restless, I tie the boat twice.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Old Pan.

objectives.text: Gather void shards at the hill graves
See Ye Wuming again

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Works.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Zhou's Repeated Word
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou, still riding the adrenaline, keeps saying 'hold' to anyone who'll listen, well past the point it's needed.

objectives.text: Hear Magistrate Zhou out

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Hold! ...Sorry. Force of habit. We're fine now. Everyone can stop holding. Except emotionally. Hold that too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Not now, Liu Er. Later. Over wine.

objectives.text: Join Widow Liu at the City God temple

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the City God temple.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: matron_bi
dialogue.text: The children ask about you, you know. Don't make me tell them anything sad.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Don't frighten the immortal, Matron Bi.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine.

objectives.text: Speak with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: Fights outside, singing inside, paying always. You'd be amazed who forgets the third one.

dialogue.speaker: tavern_huo
dialogue.text: My mother lights incense for you. She says it's the least she can do.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

reply.speaker: tavern_huo
reply.text: (to Liu Er) Well! That's one way to do it.

quests.title: Qingshi Holds, Again
quests.summary: Dawn over Qingshi. The town is scarred, tired and whole. Madam Fang opens the cellar. The children still haven't touched the wine.

objectives.text: Speak with Madam Fang

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The children didn't touch the wine. Not one sip. I'm so proud. I'm going to give them some. Just a thimble. For bravery.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: We've no one else to ask, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Hear what Widow Liu has to say

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. So do I. Qingshi owes you everything. We're square. You owe us nothing. Come back anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Have some faith, Iron-Fang. {player} has never let us down.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: That's the law, that is.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Widow Liu) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (says nothing, very carefully)

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Setting the Rung Early
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane arrives on fire: Xue Chen is on the peak, setting his rung, a week early. Come now.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (does not smile) {player}. The righteous path has a narrow gate. Mind you still fit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Her crane was on fire. Xue Chen, on the peak, setting his rung early. Go. Han Xue and Zhao Kang are already at the stair.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Ye Wuming. A poor master.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isles are dark. The moon is nearly red. On the tribulation peak, a thread of red light rises into the sky like smoke from a fire.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old stele is cold under your palm. The carving is older than the sect, older maybe than the mountain.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He's on my peak. Setting his rung. Tying the ladder to the sky. If he finishes, the Patriarch has seven steps to climb your lightning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Break it. Before the moon. Before he finishes. Go. I'll shout. I'm shouting now. GO.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness. The stars notice more than they let on.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: Shadows on the Bridge
quests.summary: The shadow-born hold the jade bridge, the way to the peak. Han Xue says she'll hold it for you. Not yet. Soon.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Shadows on the bridge. I'll hold it. Not tonight, the real night. Tonight we just go through. Together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Han Xue is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: See? Even Qing Luan agrees. It must be true.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Shadow-born! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born regrouping
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Through. The bridge is ours. On the night, I'll stand right here. Nothing crosses. I've decided. It's my bridge now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Zhao Kang. Zhao Kang won't sleep otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Delta Holds
quests.summary: The forty crystals you planted on the peak's lower slopes are holding off Xue Chen's thread. The shadows are trying to smash them.

objectives.text: Study the stone tablets at the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the lower slopes, your forty crystals glow, bending the red thread away from the summit. Shadows claw at them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the stone tablets one after another. Together they make a sentence none of them says alone.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the hall of records

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Plant fresh crystals to strengthen the delta
Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The delta's holding. Your founder's plan. Bai's ceiling. Thunder Peak's anvils. All holding. Now go up there and talk to your cousin.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Qingyi's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Soft-hearted. It's a village thing. I'm... getting used to it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (hiding behind Zhao Kang) Oh.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

quests.title: The Rung on the Peak
quests.summary: On the summit, Xue Chen kneels in the black rings, weaving a thread of red into the sky. He's crying.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the temple of the four winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the summit, in the black rings of old tribulations, Xue Chen kneels, weaving a red thread into the sky. His face is wet.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the bronze bell. The note rolls out across the land, and far away, something answers.

objectives.text: Watch the rung through the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seventh star flickers. Bright, dim, bright. He's setting it. And un-setting it. Over and over. He can't decide.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He can't decide. He's setting it and pulling it out. He's been doing it for hours, the star-gazer says. He's breaking himself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shut it, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Talking to the Shadow
quests.summary: You call across the gap to Xue Chen. He hears you. He doesn't stop weaving, but he answers.

objectives.text: Report to Xue Chen

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Cousin! Xue Chen! You left me your horse. I've got it. I'll keep it safe. Come down and take it back.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: Keep it. I can't come down. If I stop, he'll pull me. If I finish, he'll climb you. Every choice is someone falling.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mind your tongue before the heir. My patience is older than your master's grudge.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: I'm going to the mirror. The Heart Mirror. Where I can see myself before. Come find me there. When the moon's almost red.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the hermit's isle

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If anything feels wrong, turn back. Pride heals slower than bruises.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Worry later, Han Xue. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the mirror lake

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Ye Wuming. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xue Chen asks whether you would spare him, if he gave up his rung.

choices.text: Yes. I would.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: The alliance court would decide

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: No. Never.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Storm Wolves on the Peak
quests.summary: When Xue Chen steps into a rift, his thread snaps, and the whole peak crackles. The storm wolves go wild.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He's gone! The thread snapped! The peak's crackling! The storm wolves are going mad! Of course they are!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Qing Luan.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Drive the storm wolves from the crystal isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The storm wolves spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Hold the rainbow bridge against more celestial sentinels
Join Qing Luan at the chain isles

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The seventh star is still lit. But it's not tied to the peak any more. He left it loose. On purpose, I think. He's giving you a chance.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came out to look at the clouds. The clouds can wait. Go on, Qing Luan, I'm only listening.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Sect Master?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the thunder wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Storm Wolves, the Peak's Second Wave
quests.summary: A second wave of maddened storm wolves tests the summit's approach before the delta fully stabilizes.

objectives.text: Charge the rune pillar at the storm plateau

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You lay your palm on the rune pillar. It drinks your qi, hums a note, and passes it to its neighbours.

objectives.text: Clear the storm plateau of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Pick up tribulation jade near the storm plateau
Show the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We're done at the cloud harbour. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why are you like this?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the thunder wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade From the Black Rings
quests.summary: The summit's black rings shed fresh tribulation jade, stirred loose by Xue Chen's abandoned weaving.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've asked three people already. Two ran. Bring me tribulation jade from the thunder isle, would you?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Ye Wuming is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good. We're all agreed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Collect tribulation jade around the thunder isle
Go back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A star just blinked. It was about you. I'm almost certain.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Qing Luan.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more tribulation jade than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Worry for the Boy
quests.summary: Zhao Kang, watching the snapped thread, admits he's more worried about Xue Chen than he expected to be.

objectives.text: Hear Zhao Kang out

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A boy who'd rather break himself than finish the job. I know that feeling. I ran from being clan head for years. I get it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ignore Qing Luan. Everyone else does.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming has my full confidence. Also my full attention, which is rarer these days.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Ye Wuming has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You bend rules like the wind bends pines. Mind you don't snap one.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: We will speak of this again, and you will not enjoy it.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, the Summit's Guard
quests.summary: A pair of celestial sentinels, unsettled by the loose seventh star, need calming before they'll let anyone near the rings.

objectives.text: Read the armillary sphere at the star observatory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rings of the armillary sphere spin by themselves for a moment, then point, all together, down.

objectives.text: Fight off the celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Find the thunder crystals at the star observatory
Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Han Xue will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Star Iron From the Peak's Slopes
quests.summary: The peak's lower slopes, disturbed by the delta's activity, yield star iron worth gathering before the night.

objectives.text: Speak with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen carefully, because I'll only say it twice. Bring me star iron from the sword isle.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd go myself. The Sect Master thinks you're ready. I'm... inclined to agree. Don't gloat.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Recover star iron from the sword isle
Report back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: May I record it? Every life is a line in a book. Yours is getting rather long.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Answer Scribe Shu, and then answer me. In that order.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the star iron you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: recorder_shu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: Han Xue's Bridge Plan, Finalized
quests.summary: Han Xue walks the jade bridge one last time, marking exactly where she'll stand on the real night.

objectives.text: Hurry to the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit servants tend the jade rice terraces, their sleeves rolled, their feet never quite touching the water.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here. Dead center. Nothing crosses on either side of me. I've measured it twice. I'm not leaving this spot for anything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Clean. You didn't waste a step.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ye Wuming. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Rules. Hm. It was the right call.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Hope
quests.summary: Ye Wuming, watching the loose seventh star, allows himself something he rarely does: open hope.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: A star that isn't tied down. A boy who'd rather hurt himself than hurt someone else. That's not nothing. That's the door I was looking for.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. Zhao Kang's got a point.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the star observatory

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I will pretend I did not hear where you are going. A sect master should not have to worry about everyone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Sect Master. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the star observatory

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order, fairly kept. That is all I ever ask of anyone.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Delta's Edge
quests.summary: A cluster of void wraiths tests the delta's edge crystals, probing for any weakness before the real storm.

objectives.text: Examine the crane statue at the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Cranes circle the crane statue and settle on it one by one, as if it were their elder.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the thunder isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The shadow-born come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk at the phoenix nest
Tell the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the phoenix nest isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (to the Sect Master, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Cloud Silk for the Peak's Wards
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks for cloud silk to reinforce the peak's old wards before the tribulation and the moon arrive together.

objectives.text: Answer Zhao Kang's summons

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a small task. Small tasks are how big trouble introduces itself. Bring me cloud silk from the cloud harbour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: No, Ye Wuming. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Pick up cloud silk near the cloud harbour
Bring word to Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang, stop posing. Nobody's painting you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Somebody should be. The light is excellent.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Let's not do that again soon.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Acceptable.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Faith
quests.summary: A crane from Yun Zhi arrives, short and certain: whatever happens at the mirror, the sect trusts your judgment completely.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Whatever you decide about the boy, I trust it. You've never once carried someone wrong. Not once. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Noted, Ye Wuming. Overruled, but noted.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the mirror lake

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Ye Wuming does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the lantern isle

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It's restful, mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

quests.title: Standing on the Black Rings
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to stand on the summit's black rings, where your tribulation will fall, and let the peak learn you.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Stand on the rings. Where you'll stand on the night. Let the peak learn your weight. It should know who it's holding up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: Walk slowly on the isles. Haste offends the cranes, and the cranes carry grudges for centuries.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Warden He has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Let the tribulation peak learn you

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The black rings hum under your feet: ten thousand years of cultivators who stood here and were answered. They're curious about you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fifth layer of Tribulation Transcendence. Halfway to the sky.

objectives.text: See Qing Luan again

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Peak. You're ready. The sky's ready. The moon's nearly ready. Only the Shadow isn't. Go to the mirror. Go and find your cousin.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Answer Zhao Kang, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Tidy. The heavens adore tidy.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Warm Jade for Qing Luan
quests.summary: Before you go, you give Qing Luan a piece of tribulation jade. She has never been given anything.

objectives.text: See what Qing Luan wants

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: For me? Jade? Warm forever? I'm a memory. Memories don't get gifts. Nobody's given me anything in ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: warden_he
dialogue.text: The cranes circled the wrong way this morning. They know weather before heaven does.

objectives.text: Gather silk to wrap Qing Luan's jade
Return to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Wrapped in silk from my own pines. It's warm. I can feel it. Memories can't feel warmth. I can. You broke a rule of the universe.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Zhao Kang is not wrong. Zhao Kang is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Qing Luan, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. That is the kind of disciple the founders hoped for.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Qing Luan, low) We should talk about that. Later.

quests.title: See You on the Night
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, Qing Luan says goodbye, of a sort. She says she'll see you on the night. She'll be the one shouting.

objectives.text: Hear Qing Luan out

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: On the night, I'll be here. At the gate. When his soul crosses my bridge, I'll see it. I'll shout. Loudly. Finally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ten thousand years I watched and said nothing. This time I'll shout so loudly the Patriarch will hear it in the lightning.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And I'll be on the bridge. Nothing crosses. See you on the night, star-gazer. Frown at me fondly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Always, sword girl. Always.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Down to the Mirror
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the snapped thread. Xue Chen has gone to the Heart Mirror, at the bottom of the world, to wait for you.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The mirror. He's at the mirror. Looking at himself before. Waiting for you. Or for courage. Maybe both.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: One day I'll think of a comeback. Today is not that day.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The fold's opening. The gate's nearly back. When you go to the mirror, the whole Abyss will be waking. Be quick. Be kind. If you can.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hm. Ye Wuming is not wrong. Ye Wuming is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars disagree. The stars often disagree. I side with you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Proper as a magistrate.
