choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Holiday
quests.summary: The Sect Master stands on the plaza and declares one last holiday. No training. No war. Only an evening.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One evening. No training. No preparations. No war. Tomorrow the moon turns red. Tonight, we're a sect. Just a sect. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

objectives.text: Charge the rune pillar at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lanterns everywhere. On the pillars, the eaves, the trees. The formation glows blue beneath them. Somebody is already singing, badly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl up the rune pillar like ivy made of light. One of them is carved backward.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: One evening. I've been cooking for three days. Dumplings. Every kind. Every kind that exists. Some that don't. Come and eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Listen to Wei Tong. And then listen to your own heart, which is louder and usually wrong. Choose carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen to the Sect Master. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You've got the look you get before doing something heroic. It's a very silly look.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hey. That's not... we don't do that, do we?

quests.title: Dumplings for Everyone
quests.summary: Wei Tong's dumplings, for the whole mountain. Every kind. The twelve serve. The chicken supervises.

objectives.text: Answer Wei Tong's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumplings! Pork! Cabbage! Lotus root! Peach! Peach dumplings are new! Elder Mo's peaches! In dumplings! He'd hate it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Mind the old places. Old places have long memories and short tempers.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Elder Bai. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Carry Wei Tong's dumplings around the plaza
Leave a peach dumpling on the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A peach dumpling on the hall steps, beside the morning's cold tea, where Elder Mo stood. Everybody who passes bows to it.

objectives.text: Go back to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd hate the peach dumpling. He'd eat three. I'm leaving him three.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha. Steward Qian's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I bet on you. I always bet on you. I've won four hats and a very confused duck.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (nervously, to Wei Tong) Is it safe to talk in front of them?

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Everyone Talks
quests.summary: The whole mountain wants to talk to you tonight. Everyone has something to say. Nobody says goodbye.

objectives.text: Report to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill. It's probably a pill. It's for luck. Or indigestion. Take it anyway. I only dropped it once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Zhao Kang. Probably. Mostly.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's crying. I'm crying. We're both very happy. It's a strange night. Thank you. I'll keep saying it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take a medicine pouch, {player}. No, two. Heroes always think one is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: What Elder Hua said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I've finished copying Elder Mo's manual. Every 'no'. I've added one at the end. In my hand. It says: adequate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai, you've been in the pagoda for three days. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I had a very nourishing scroll.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: No precedent for that at all. How exciting.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Lanterns on the Cliff
quests.summary: Lu Ping has organised a lantern release from the cliff edge, like the examination, years ago. Everyone writes a wish.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Lanterns! From the cliff! Like the examination! Everyone writes a wish! I've written mine already! It says 'win the betting book'!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Listen to Zhao Kang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Every spirit stone has a name. I'm naming the next one after your expenses.

objectives.text: Gather lanterns for the whole sect
Release your lantern over the sea of clouds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thousand lanterns over the sea of clouds. Yours says the same as it did years ago: to be strong enough to protect people.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside it, Zhao Kang's lantern. It says: to beat you. And underneath, smaller: when you come back down.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the inner sect gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't read other people's lanterns. It's still the worst manners in the sect. What did yours say? No. I know what it said.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Zhao Kang said. I was listening. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The lantern oil came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hmph. Reasonable. Annoyingly.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: The Hermit's Song
quests.summary: The hermit sings the Heart Sutra on the plaza, all three verses, and three hundred disciples who learned it in the ruins sing with him.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. Everyone who learned it in my masters' courtyard. Sing it with me. Loudly. The whole mountain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Keep receipts. For everything. Even for heroics. Especially for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Listen to Steward Qian. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Read the rim of the bronze ding at the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three hundred voices, then a thousand, then the whole mountain. The green lotus in the pond opens as wide as it can. The carp bow.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the rim of the bronze ding by touch. It lists the names of those who made an oath around it.

objectives.text: Report back to the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My masters sang this while the water rose. I ran. Tonight the whole Azure Cloud sings it. They hear. I know they hear.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look at {them}, all serious. Smile, {junior}! It confuses the enemy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough, Wei Tong. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Elder Bai called my handwriting adequate. I cried. Then I framed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Kindness is slow tea. Worth the wait.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (whispering to the hermit) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

quests.title: Uninvited to the Last Evening
quests.summary: The shadows come on the last evening, as they always do. The sect doesn't stop singing while it fights them.

objectives.text: Hear Yan Tie out

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Shadows on the back path! Thunder Peak's got it! We're shouting the sutra at them! It's working! It's very loud!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Old Qiu. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Ring the cliff bell over the singing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Nobody stops singing. Thunder Peak shouts the sutra. The twelve sing it. The shadows, confused, retreat from a mountain that won't be afraid.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These shadow-born fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators
Bring word to Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: They ran from singing! Thunder Peak has never won a fight by singing! We're adding it to the forge! Next to your name!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Old Qiu. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie, softly) The founders chose well, whoever chose {them}.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Frenzy made me do worse. You had no excuse.

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Say nothing. My silence will say enough for both of us.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: HA! Thunder Peak would do exactly that!

reply.speaker: warden_qiu
reply.text: (to Yan Tie) Unorthodox. I suppose we were young once.

quests.title: Han Xue on the Bridge
quests.summary: Han Xue finds you on the stone bridge. She wants to say something. She says it very stiffly.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the moon. Then the gate. Then the sky. I'll hold the bridge on the isles. Nothing crosses. I promised.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying: the bigger they are, the louder you shout. I'll shout for you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Yan Tie. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And the sparring match. You still owe me. I'm going to keep saying it until you pay, so you have to come back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: After, Senior Sister.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: After. Good. That's all. Don't make it weird. ...Thank you. For the plum garden. Both times. That's all.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the chain bridge. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Yan Tie says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

objectives.text: Hear what Liu Er has to say

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the chain bridge.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I'll watch the road for you. With my eyes open, this time. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says I have to be polite to immortals. Hello, immortal!

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to Liu Er) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

quests.title: The Main Hall, Quiet
quests.summary: Late at night you use the key the Sect Master gave you: the main hall, quiet, with the founder's tablet and the faded green lotus.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness beneath the lanterns

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Silence, lanterns and the pond. You carry the whole mountain one last time as a disciple. Tomorrow you carry it as something else.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You found the quiet. Good. I came to find it too. Let's share it. Say nothing. That's what it's for.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. The Sect Master is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Zhao Kang. Now, where was I.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy from strength. The founders would be proud.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

quests.title: Steward Qian's Account
quests.summary: At midnight, Steward Qian finds you with the empty account he opened in your name years ago. He wants to close it.

objectives.text: Go and see Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Your account. Opened before the descent. I said I don't open accounts for people who don't come back. It's still empty.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That's sound, that is.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I'm not closing it. I'm keeping it open. Forever. You'll fill it. When you come back down. I don't make bad investments.

objectives.text: Talk with Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Is this going to cost the treasury anything? It always costs the treasury something.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Yan Tie, lower your voice. The mountain is asleep.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: THE MOUNTAIN LIKES ME, ZHAO KANG.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Don't break anything that belongs to the sect. I will know. I always know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian's last account shows a surplus nobody knows about.

choices.text: Give it to the war widows

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Return it to the treasury

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper! I'd shout about it but it seems improper.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Keep it for after the war

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Yan Tie) That was cold.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Singing's Second Test
quests.summary: A second, smaller wave of shadow-born tests the mountain's resolve, and finds it just as unshaken as the first.

objectives.text: Go to the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the pill kiln yard is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the mountain road

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: More shadow-born? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Collect tribulation jade around the mountain road
Compare notes with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you for watching my back.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Can you describe it exactly? I'm writing it down. How exactly? More exactly than that.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Tang Ling. Tang Ling won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Lantern Oil for the Second Release
quests.summary: The lantern release proves so popular that Lu Ping organizes a second round, needing more oil before dawn.

objectives.text: Answer Elder Bai's summons

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Your help again, {junior}. Bring me lantern oil from the outer pines.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

objectives.text: Find the lantern oil at the outer pines
See Elder Bai again

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Hm. Yes. Relief is permitted. Briefly.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more lantern oil than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (beaming at Elder Bai) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Peach Dumpling Count
quests.summary: Wei Tong reports, with great satisfaction, exactly how many peach dumplings were left on the hall steps overnight.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Three, this morning. Someone ate them. I like to think it was him. I like to think a lot of things tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wei Tong, you have crumbs on your sword.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're lucky crumbs. Dumpling likes them.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll call if I need you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hit first, apologise later. Actually, don't apologise. They were trying to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Drink this. No, it doesn't taste good. That's how you know it works.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come back. I owe you a life and a rematch. I can't pay either to a ghost.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find a book with turtle soup stains on it, it's mine. Return it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Bai) The elders will hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I shall not write that down. Some things should not be copied.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Outer Wall's Watch
quests.summary: A pair of demon cultivators, testing the wall during the celebration, are met by disciples who'd rather not stop singing to fight them.

objectives.text: Grip the sword in the stone at the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You close your hand on the hilt of the sword in the stone. It hums, weighs you, and decides to stay where it is.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Show Elder Hua what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Not bad. For someone without a family crest. Actually, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang says it louder than I would. I mean it just as much.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (to Elder Hua, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Elder Hua) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Proper, like a correct dose.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: That's a wound that won't show. The worst kind.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (muttering, to Elder Hua) That was cold.

quests.title: Medicine for the Long Night Ahead
quests.summary: Elder Hua uses the last quiet hours to pack every remaining bundle of medicine for tomorrow's march.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley. And keep your eyes open. Things have been strange lately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll come! Thunder Peak never misses a fight. We only miss breakfast, and that was once.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Yan Tie. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the medicine valley
Return to Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Was it scary? Tell me it was scary. I need a good story for dinner.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the medicine bundles you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Very proper. I'd bet on you for proper.

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (to Lu Ping) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: fan_rui
reply.text: (hiding behind Lu Ping) Oh.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Final Addition
quests.summary: Bai Ling shows you the very last page of Elder Mo's copied manual, where she's added her own note beside his.

objectives.text: Investigate the pill kiln yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great pill kilns glow in their yard like sleeping dragons, and the air shimmers with heat.

objectives.text: Stoke the pill furnace

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feed a little qi into the pill furnace. The flame steadies from angry red to patient gold.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Under his 'adequate,' I wrote 'more than adequate, always was.' I hope that's allowed. Historians get opinions too, sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll record it. In ink, even. That's how impressed I am.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Just so. Fairness first, feelings after.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The chronicles are full of cruelty. Thank you for a better page.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Bold. Very bold.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Pill, Explained
quests.summary: Xiao Man finally admits, laughing, that she genuinely doesn't know if the pill she gave you does anything at all.

objectives.text: See what Xiao Man wants

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: It might be candy. I lost the recipe halfway through. Take it anyway. Belief counts for something. I believe in you a lot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If the way is barred, use my name. It opens most doors and closes a few mouths.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hit with the whole body. Heart first, then fist. That's how we do it on the peak.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: What Yan Tie said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Be careful. If you die, who'll make my gossip interesting?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Be careful! If you come back hurt, Elder Hua will make me roll the bandages again.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Unorthodox treatment. It may even work.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the book. Books keep healers from killing people.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Elder Hua's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Void Wraiths, the Cliff's Last
quests.summary: A last cluster of void wraiths drifts near the cliff edge, drawn by a thousand lanterns' worth of hope.

objectives.text: Read the notice board at the mission hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You read the notice board from corner to corner. Someone has crossed out a name and written a warning beside it.

objectives.text: Clear the Sword Peak path of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Pick up lantern oil near the spirit peach orchard
Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: auntie_ruo
dialogue.text: Back safe. Sit. Your face needs a cup more than your cultivation does.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ha. Auntie Ruo's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's the {player} I'd share my last bun with. Half of it.

reply.speaker: auntie_ruo
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) The whole street will hear of this kindness.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are like recipes. You followed it exactly.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade for the Whole Mountain
quests.summary: In the small hours, you distribute the last of your tribulation jade to anyone on the mountain who hasn't received a piece yet.

objectives.text: Hear the Sect Master out

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Bring me tribulation jade from the mountain road. Don't make that face; it builds character.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

objectives.text: Collect tribulation jade around the mountain road
Go back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You have dirt on your face and pride in your eyes. Keep the second one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Splendid. A footnote in history, at the very least. Possibly a whole paragraph.

objectives.choice_prompt: The tribulation jade came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: As the precepts ask. Good.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) The Law Hall could not have ruled better.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Elder Yan's Singing Victory
quests.summary: Elder Yan formally declares singing a legitimate Thunder Peak combat technique, effective immediately and forever.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Singing! Official! Alongside shouting! Thunder Peak's arsenal grows! We are UNSTOPPABLE and also QUITE MELODIC!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'll come! I'll bring buns. Fighting is better with buns. Everything is better with buns.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: No, Wei Tong. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: A blade is only a blade until someone makes it a promise. Mind which promises you carry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan would have sent a servant for this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan's servants would have eaten my lunch.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the summit of Sword Peak

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hold still. You have the face of someone about to do something brave and stupid.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Elder Hua. That's my job.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (to Han Xue) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Dawn, and the Moon
quests.summary: At dawn the whole sect is still awake. The moon sets. When it rises tonight, it will be red. Tomorrow, the Abyss.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tonight it rises red. We go to the rim at dusk. Every sect meets us there. First, Ye Wuming asked for you. At the mirror. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling is ready. My sword, not my lunch. Although my lunch is also ready.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Wei Tong. That was very... something.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the drum tower

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go. Find your cousin. Be kind. Come back for breakfast. I'm making more dumplings. I'm always making more dumplings.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Alone? Hm. I will allow it. I will also send someone to watch the road.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Sect Master. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: tang_ling
dialogue.text: Wei Tong is right. I checked the annals. Twice.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: tang_ling
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Fortress Returns
quests.summary: At the rim, the fold is opening like a hand unclenching. Out of it, slowly, the black fortress drifts back into the world.

objectives.text: Study the old stele at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below the rim, the fold unclenches. The black fortress drifts out of nothing and settles onto the Abyss floor with a sound like a mountain sighing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You brush dust from the old stele. The old characters are worn, but they still say what they mean.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well. That's not something you see every day. I'd rather not see it again.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Whatever happens, we stay together.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's back. The gate. The court. The cages. Exactly where it was. As if it never left. As if nobody waited years for it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The cages. My sister. She's there. Frozen, mid-shout. I can see the cage from here. Iron-Fang is very calm. Iron-Fang is not calm.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Heh. Cold. The road teaches that.

quests.title: The Fortress Wakes
quests.summary: With the fortress back, its guards wake. They've been frozen too. They don't know how long.

objectives.text: Answer Ruan Jingtao's summons

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Blood Guards! Out of the fortress! They don't know how long they've been gone! They look confused! Confused is good!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Listen to Ye Wuming. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the training pit
Report back to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale's vanguard is here. Three thousand more at the teleport array. Remembering Hill came to the Abyss. We remember.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Xiao Shi. Xiao Shi won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: The Gate, Shut
quests.summary: The black gate stands shut, carved with a moon swallowing a sword. It only opens from inside, or with a token.

objectives.text: Search the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the obelisk ring, the black gate stands shut. Taller than the main hall. Silent. Carved with a moon swallowing a sword.

objectives.text: Look at the gate with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gate is sealed from inside. Nothing will open it from here. Not qi, not soul, not forty sects. Only someone the gate thinks is its own.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: It opens from inside. I know. I have a way. Tomorrow, under the moon, I'll use it. Don't ask what. You'll see.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Children Take Their Places
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children, grown now, take their places at the obelisk ring. They've been waiting for this their whole lives.

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Spring. River. Small Mountain. All of them. Grown. They'll hold the obelisk ring tomorrow. They know every path. They were born to them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not this time, Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.text: Head to the blood river

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring bows to you. River hums the Moon-Well song. Small Mountain, very tall now, says nothing, and salutes.

objectives.text: Bring word to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: My name. It's very close. Tomorrow, maybe. When he falls. I think I'll remember it when he falls. I'll tell you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming's children want to fight at the front. The youngest is barely grown.

choices.text: Send the youngest to the rear

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (beaming at Ye Wuming) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Let each of them choose

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The sect never tamed you, did it.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

choices.text: Put them all at the front

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Shadows at the Mirror Path
quests.summary: The path down to the Heart Mirror is thick with shadow-born, guarding the way to their master's son.

objectives.text: Make your way to the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path past the blood pools to the depths is crowded with shadow-born, standing very still, like mourners at a gate.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Gather void shards from the guarding shadows
Compare notes with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know the path. I drew it. I'll lead you as far as the depths. Then you go alone. That's what he asked for. Alone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. Both of us are proud of that for no good reason.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ignore Ruan Jingtao. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (nodding hard) Yes. The rules. Good.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Iron-Fang at the Rim
quests.summary: Iron-Fang stands at the rim looking at his sister's cage. His forty men stand behind him, washed and fed, silent.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Tomorrow. The gate opens tomorrow. Then the cages. Then my sister shouts at me for twenty years of being late.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That means more than you know.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Go and find your cousin, sect brat. Be kind to him. He's someone's sister's son too. Everyone is.

objectives.text: Hear what Ruan Jingtao has to say

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: What Iron-Fang said. I was about to say it. Slower.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the chain bridge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: The Depths
quests.summary: At the bottom of the Abyss, the last shadows gather in the depths, around the path to the mirror.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I came down. Obviously. I'll hold the depths while you go to the mirror. Go. Alone. That's what he wanted.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Why {them}? I'm right here. I'm better dressed and nearly as good.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Shadow-born ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Guards that follow
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The depths are clear. The mirror's waiting. He's waiting. Go and be kind. Or go and win. Whichever you have to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Iron-Fang. The head's big enough already.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

quests.title: Before the Mirror
quests.summary: At the edge of the depths, before you go to the mirror, you sit and remember Willow Creek. You want to bring it with you.

objectives.text: Remember Willow Creek before the mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A creek, a willow, a woman singing. A cousin you never met, three years old, laughing. A carved horse in your hand.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the wailing cliffs

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You're taking the village with you. Good. Show it to him. Show him what the mirror shows him. Maybe it'll be enough.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale would do it differently. Not better, necessarily. Differently.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Ruan Jingtao. Doesn't change anything.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested
Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. The road taught you that.

quests.title: Medicine at the Rim
quests.summary: While you prepare, the Moon-Well's healers arrive at the rim with Xiao Man's medicine bundles. Eight thousand notes saying 'come home'.

objectives.text: Hear Xiao Shi out

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's bundles. Eight thousand. Every one says come home. Or eat this, idiot. Take one. For the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

objectives.text: Take a medicine bundle for the mirror
Return to Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The note in yours says: come home, cousin-finder. She knew. My sister always knows. She drops things. She knows things.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Yes, tell us. All of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Oh. I... thought you were different.

quests.title: Blood Guards, Waking Confused
quests.summary: More of the fortress's frozen guards wake in confusion, and the vanguard clears them before they can regroup.

objectives.text: Break open the cage at the beast pens

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the beast pens

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Blood Guards! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the beast pens
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon shrine is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Back in one piece. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he doesn't like losing creditors.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You weren't worried, Iron-Fang. You said so. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Fortress Guard
quests.summary: The fallen fortress guards leave demon cores behind, worth gathering while the vanguard secures the rim.

objectives.text: Speak with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Bring me demon cores from the corpse forest. If anyone asks, you volunteered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Ye Wuming. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Recover demon cores from the corpse forest
Go back to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I owe you. Don't tell anyone; debts are embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've dirt on your robe. The Zhao clan could lend you a tailor. At a friendly rate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Very funny.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. We're both very proud of that.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the demon cores you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Vanguard Report
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao reports the Iron Scale's full vanguard is in position, three thousand more waiting at the teleport array.

objectives.text: Go and see Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Everyone's here. Everyone's ready. My father sends his love and a very stern instruction not to be a hero. I'm ignoring the second part.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. I hate saying it, but listen.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the ruined sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the ruined sect gate. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Maybe. Go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.text: Join Iron-Fang at the slave mines

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the slave mines.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Camp's Last Watch
quests.summary: A last watch of demon cultivators, guarding the demon camp's approach, is cleared before nightfall.

objectives.text: Study the jade slip at the forbidden library

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade slip glows faintly. Someone wanted this found, by the right person.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the forbidden library

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the forbidden library
Talk it over with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Correct again. It's exhausting, isn't it?

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Did that sit right with you? It didn't with me.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Awakened Fortress
quests.summary: The fortress, freshly returned from the fold, sheds void shards worth gathering before the real fight begins.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good, you're here. Bring me void shards from the ash plains. Quickly, before the day gets any older.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Noted. Carefully noted.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Pick up void shards near the ash plains
Report back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's that, then. You've grown, {junior}. I keep noticing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Gu's Silent Preparation
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, still in chains, prepares something quietly at the obelisk ring, refusing to say what until the moon rises.

objectives.text: Scout the cave of echoes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Water drips in the cave of echoes. Every drop comes back as a whisper of your name.

objectives.text: Polish the bronze mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back of the bronze mirror is carved with a lotus. The front shows the room behind you, and one extra shadow.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You'll see tomorrow. It's the last thing I have to give. Let me have this one secret. It's the last one I'll ever keep.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Any Iron Scale colours among them? Tell me honestly. I would rather know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A fair question. I would like to hear the answer too.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: (to Elder Gu, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Mercy. I forgot how it looks.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Spring's Salute
quests.summary: Spring, taking her place at the obelisk ring, salutes you formally, the way Small Mountain always has.

objectives.text: Break the blood altar at the sacrificial pit

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring says she learned it from watching Small Mountain do it for years. She says today felt like the right day to finally do it herself.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dark channels run across the blood altar. You break them one by one until nothing flows.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang. Your clan's banner is crooked.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ruan Jingtao. Your sect's mountain is short.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

objectives.text: Meet Ruan Jingtao at the seal stones

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're thinking like the road.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Mirror Path's Second Guard
quests.summary: A second line of shadow-born guards the mirror path, thicker than the first, testing the vanguard's resolve.

objectives.text: Hurry to the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the shadow market, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Clear the Heart Mirror of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Collect blood lotus around the poison garden
Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha. Iron-Fang's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's done. For now.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Even the Zhao clan has lines. You just stepped over one.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering) That was amazing. And terrifying.

quests.title: Medicine for Iron-Fang's Forty
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's men receive one last round of medicine and supplies before the gate opens and everything changes.

objectives.text: Report to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I don't like the feel of it, {player}. Bring me medicine bundles from the deep mine shaft.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ye Wuming.

objectives.text: Find the medicine bundles at the deep mine shaft
Bring word to Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I knew you'd manage. I told everyone you'd manage. I lied about being sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Just doing my part.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Ruan Jingtao) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Last Instruction
quests.summary: Xiao Shi gives you one final piece of guidance about the depths before you go to the mirror alone.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Left at the third fork, always left. The Abyss remembers who's kind to it. I learned that surviving it. Trust the map, and trust yourself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll go now, while the light holds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do small talk. Xiao Shi does enough for three.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: {player} will manage, Zhao Kang. I would not send {them} otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Want company? No? Good. I have forms to practise. Call if you need me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Xiao Shi. Someone has to guard the buns.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Han Xue) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Alone to the Mirror
quests.summary: Ye Wuming walks you to the last turn of the path. Then he stops. The rest you walk alone.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This is as far as I go. He asked for you alone. Be kind to him. He's what I would have been, if nobody had stolen me back.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It reconsiders. I reconsider. Ye Wuming is right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Then I'll go.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: And if you can't steal him back... end it quickly. For him. Not for the ladder. For him.

objectives.text: Go to the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somebody was here at the deep mine shaft not long ago. The grass has not finished standing up.

objectives.text: Test the chain anchor

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chain anchor is bolted into the living rock. Old blood has rusted into its links.

objectives.text: Join Ruan Jingtao at the deep mine shaft

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
