dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: What Ye Wuming said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go around, not through. Only peasants go through. Heroes flank.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Boy at the Mirror
quests.summary: Xue Chen sits cross-legged at the edge of the Heart Mirror, looking into it. In it, a boy of three is laughing by a creek.

objectives.text: Look into the bronze mirror at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Xue Chen sits at the mirror's edge. In the black water, a boy of three holds his mother's hand by a creek, laughing, over and over.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze mirror is dark with age. When you breathe on it, words appear in the mist and fade.

objectives.text: Speak with Xue Chen

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: You came alone. Thank you. Sit. Look. That's me. Before. I come here every day. It's the only place I'm not his.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Keep talking. I'm counting the ways this ends badly for you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: acolyte_hei
dialogue.text: As the Rung says. As the moon wills.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Obedient little heir.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Soft hands. They'll break on the Ladder.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: No rules. Careful. That's how it starts.

quests.title: Two Cousins
quests.summary: You sit beside him and look into the mirror together. It shows you both: two children from the same village.

objectives.text: Hear Xue Chen out

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. I was born there too. My mother sang by the creek. Your mother might have heard her.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...The mirror's showing both of us now. Two children. Same creek. One taken at three. One not. Why you and not me?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know. Luck. A mother who ran. Nothing I earned. Come with me, Chen. Leave his shadow. There's still time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Say one more word about {their} blood and you'll be picking up your teeth.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Please stop talking, Iron-Fang.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Gu at the ghost village

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Xiao Shi has earned the right to say it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: The Thread
quests.summary: In soul sight, the thread from Xue Chen to the fold is so thick it's a chain. And it's pulling.

objectives.text: Investigate the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A red chain runs from Xue Chen's back into the dark, toward the fortress. It tightens as you speak. Something at the other end has noticed.

objectives.text: Touch the red chain with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the other end of the chain, on a throne of fused bone, something that was once a man opens one eye. Mine, it says. My shadow. Mine.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Xue Chen

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: He felt you touch it. He's pulling. He's going to make me fight you. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I tried. Keep the horse.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Big words. Your master used to say those too. Look where he is.

dialogue.speaker: acolyte_hei
dialogue.text: Kneel now, heir. It hurts less later. I would know.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Rules. The Patriarch had rules too. Ask his victims how they helped.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: No rules. Careful. That's how it starts.

reply.speaker: acolyte_hei
reply.text: Almost one of us.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: There it is. The thing your elders pretend you don't have.

reply.speaker: acolyte_hei
reply.text: Oh, you'd do well down here.

quests.title: Shadows of the Shadow
quests.summary: The Patriarch pulls, and Xue Chen's own shadow-born pour out of the mirror's dark edges.

objectives.text: Search the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born pour out of the mirror's edges, faceless, silent. Xue Chen screams at them to stop. They don't. They never listened to him.

objectives.text: Fight off the shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards regrouping
Catch your breath with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I said I'd hold the depths. I'm holding them. Ye Wuming's here. Iron-Fang's here. You're not alone. You never were. Finish it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We all were. Some of us hide it better.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Hm. Kind. Don't let it make you slow.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Tries
quests.summary: Ye Wuming comes to the mirror after all. He can't stay away. He tries to steal Xue Chen back.

objectives.text: Speak with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Chen. I was you. Forty years ago. A shadow's child. Someone stole me back. Let me steal you. Let go of the chain.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: I can't. It's not a chain. It's him. He's inside it. If I let go, I let go of... everything I've ever been.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Then let go of that. Be something new. I did. It hurts. It's worth it. Please.

objectives.text: Talk with Xue Chen at the palace of the elders

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...I'm trying. I'm trying. He won't let me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (voice shaking) We're not afraid of you. Well. I'm a little afraid. But we're not moving.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: acolyte_hei
dialogue.text: Your friends are loud. The Abyss likes loud things. They echo so nicely.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xue Chen makes you an offer: a rung on the Ladder, and power without waiting.

choices.text: Refuse

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Soft hands. They'll break on the Ladder.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (whispering to Xue Chen) I want to be like that when I'm older.

choices.text: Refuse, and report the offer to the Sect Master

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Obedient little heir.

choices.text: Say you'll think about it

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Oh, you'd have done well in the Abyss. Think about it.

quests.title: The Seventh Rung Breaks
quests.summary: The Patriarch pulls the chain with all his strength, and Xue Chen rises, eyes red, sword drawn, weeping. The last Rung fights.

objectives.text: Head to the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Xue Chen rises. His eyes are red now, all the way through. His sword is drawn. His face is wet. His voice is someone else's.

objectives.name: Xue Chen, the Patriarch's Shadow
objectives.text: Bring down Xue Chen, the Patriarch's Shadow

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: I was born in his shadow. I will die in yours. Forgive me, cousin. The moon is almost full.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I forgive you, Chen. Now let's break his chain together.

objectives.text: Break the red chain as Xue Chen falls

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chain snaps. The red drains from Xue Chen's eyes. He falls into your arms, light as a child. Willow Creek, he says. I remembered.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: His star goes out. The Patriarch's Ladder has no rungs left. Far away, on a throne of bone, something howls.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the ash plains

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He died free. In your arms, not his. That's stealing him back. The only way that was left. I'm going to cry now. Let me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Ye Wuming says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's hoard holds spirit stones stolen from Qingshi.

choices.text: Return every stone to Qingshi

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give it all to the sect treasury

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Keep a share for yourself

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

quests.title: Seven Stars Out
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane finds you at the bottom of the world. It's shouting, and crying, and shouting again.

objectives.text: Make your way to the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A crane of cloud, burning at the edges, shouts in Qing Luan's voice: seven stars out. Seven. The ladder's gone. He'll have to jump.

objectives.text: Join Elder Gu at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No ladder. His power has no root now. Only what he carries in himself. Tomorrow, under the moon, he'll be weaker than he's been in three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Your offer is noted, Iron-Fang, and declined. Kindly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: And more desperate. Desperate is dangerous. I know. I was desperate once.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Terrible bandit, that one. A compliment.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

quests.title: Lotus for a Cousin
quests.summary: Where Xue Chen fell, blood lotus grows, pink and pale. You gather it to bury with him.

objectives.text: Go and see Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Pink lotus. Where he fell. Like where Tan was freed, at the pools. Your village grows wherever you go now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.text: Gather the pink lotus where he fell
Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: We'll bury him at the rim. Next to my men's names. He was Willow Creek. My men burned Willow Creek. I'll carry that. Iron-Fang carries two.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

objectives.choice_prompt: The alliance wants Xue Chen's body hung at the black gate, as a warning.

choices.text: Bury him at the rim, with the lotus

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Give him to the alliance

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Hang him yourself

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. That's how the hungry years start.

quests.title: Burying a Cousin
quests.summary: At the rim, under a moon that is almost red, you bury Xue Chen with his carved horse and a handful of pink lotus.

objectives.text: Bury Xue Chen at the rim

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A small grave at the rim, next to Iron-Fang's eleven carved names. A carved horse. Pink lotus. Chen, of Willow Creek. Free.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the moon. Tonight, rest. Everyone's coming. The whole sect. Forty sects. We march at dusk. Go home. Sleep. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Ye Wuming. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that. Once.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, Dispersing
quests.summary: Without Xue Chen to command them, the remaining shadow-born scatter in confusion, easily cleared from the mirror's edge.

objectives.text: Check the wine jars at the shadow market

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jars are sealed with clay and stamped. One seal is fresh, though the jar is very old.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the sulphur vents

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

objectives.text: Recover demon cores from the corpse forest
Show Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You walk like a sect disciple. Loud, and proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Hm. Ye Wuming is not wrong. Ye Wuming is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The enemies left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: (to Elder Gu) Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Demon Cores From the Scattered Shadows
quests.summary: The dispersing shadow-born leave demon cores behind, the last harvest from the Seventh Rung's fall.

objectives.text: Answer Han Xue's summons

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Bring me demon cores from the corpse forest. I would do it myself, but my knees have filed a formal complaint.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Listen to Iron-Fang. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Han Xue knows the way of these things. I trust that. I don't trust much.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Gather demon cores at the corpse forest
See Han Xue again

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well done. I'll remember this, and so will the ledger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Any time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the demon cores you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Of course you did. You always do. It's infuriating.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (her jaw tightens) We'll talk about that later. Alone.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Grief and Relief
quests.summary: Iron-Fang, helping dig the grave, admits he feels both grief for a boy he never met and relief that the Ladder is finally gone.

objectives.text: Report to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Both at once. Grief and relief. Never felt that combination before. It's uncomfortable. It's also, somehow, exactly right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave the worrying to me for once.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No. Stay out of sight, Xiao Shi.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Gu at the blood river

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Listen to Xiao Shi. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the soul forge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Have a little faith, Iron-Fang.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Ha. I'd have done that too, if I were brave.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) The sect never did tame {them}.

quests.title: Blood Guards, the Depths' Last
quests.summary: A last handful of blood guards, cut off from the fortress, is cleared from the depths before the burial.

objectives.text: Scout the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the bottom of the abyss the darkness is so thick it feels like weather.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Guards spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Pick up blood lotus near the abyss depths
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: We're done at the chain bridge. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You came back. People who go out don't always. I'm glad you did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I missed you too.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hunted.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Mirror's Edge
quests.summary: The Heart Mirror, quieter now that its most frequent visitor is gone, sheds void shards worth one last gathering.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I need someone steady. Bring me void shards from the obsidian spires, and come straight back.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No, Iron-Fang. You have your own duties, and I need you where you are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Don't trust the quiet. It lies.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Collect void shards around the obsidian spires
Return to Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Every day you surprise me a little less. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close your mouth, {junior}. You look like a carp waiting for crumbs.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Gu's Unspoken Plan
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, walking back up with you, almost reveals his plan for the gate before catching himself and staying silent.

objectives.text: Hurry to the skull tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tower of skulls stands on its spur of rock, thousands of empty eyes turned toward the canyon.

objectives.text: Examine the soul lantern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pale flame flickers inside the soul lantern, and in the flame, for an instant, a face.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I almost told you. I want it to be a surprise. Not a good one. But a useful one. Trust me one more time, {junior}.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. Well done indeed.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You've got the look now. I used to have it. Careful.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft saved my people. I'm not laughing.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it started, for me.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Almost-Name
quests.summary: Ye Wuming, sitting by Xue Chen's grave, says he can almost remember his birth name now, closer than he's ever been.

objectives.text: See what Ye Wuming wants

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It starts with a sound. Not a word yet. A sound. Tomorrow, maybe. When he falls. I think it'll come all at once, like a door opening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Probably, Iron-Fang. Doesn't change anything.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the slave mines

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: broker_ku
dialogue.text: I don't take sides. But if I did, I wouldn't take that one. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Shi at the lava falls

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll watch the ridge. You won't see me. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: No, Ye Wuming. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Sometimes the rules are the cage. I know.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Rim's Last Watch
quests.summary: A final watch of demon cultivators, abandoned when the Ladder fell, is cleared from the rim before nightfall.

objectives.text: Mark the map table at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map on the map table shows paths that are not on any other map. Some of them lead down.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the watch spire

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Moon cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Find the sealed letters at the watch spire
Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's twice this month you've made me proud. Stop it. It's unsettling.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Told you. Soft as a steamed bun. Don't tell {them} I said so.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The proper way. I like proper. Proper has doors that open.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Blood Lotus for Every Grave
quests.summary: More blood lotus is gathered, enough for Xue Chen's grave and every unmarked one nearby that deserves flowers too.

objectives.text: Hear Ye Wuming out

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Bring me blood lotus from the poison garden. Take care. I've grown used to you being in one piece.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe in for four before you go. Your qi runs hot when you hurry.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Listen to Han Xue. Han Xue's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I drew a map of that place. It's rough, but the walls are in the right spots.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Recover blood lotus from the poison garden
Go back to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That settles one worry. Only a hundred left.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha! Clean work. My old crew would have taken twice as long and stolen the silverware.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I had help.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't pacing. The ground needed flattening.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more blood lotus than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That was the right thing. I'll deny saying so.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: The Patriarch would have liked that. Think about it.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Last Map Entry
quests.summary: Xiao Shi adds one final mark to her map: a small grave at the rim, labeled simply 'Chen, free.'

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Every place matters. Even a grave. Especially a grave. Someone should always be able to find it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's a trap. They're always traps. Go anyway, lotus-bearer, but go sideways.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You said the same last time, Ye Wuming. And the time before.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. Sounds like the kind of job I'd have set up as an ambush. Just saying.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Heh. The sect never did tame you.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the slave mines. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Count the ways out before you go in. I always do now. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Good advice. Free, too. Rare.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the ghost village.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: If it feels like a cage, it is one. Get out fast.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Worry later, Xiao Shi. Move now.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My boys owe you. Point them at something and they'll shout at it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Kinder than the Abyss would have been.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Home for the Night
quests.summary: You go home for one night. The moon is almost full, almost red. Tomorrow at dusk, the Azure Cloud marches.

objectives.text: Go and see Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll stay at the rim. With the children. And him. Tomorrow at dusk. We'll be at the obelisks. My name's very close now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming, say something useful for once.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...Left.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Gu at the burned hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I'll come back up with you. In chains. The Sect Master will want me at the gate tomorrow. I have a way. You'll see.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Worry is a fine servant, Ye Wuming. A poor master.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Forty Sects on the Steps
quests.summary: From dawn, the nine thousand steps are full: Iron Scale green, Zhao gold, Moon-Well white, and forty more colours, climbing.

objectives.text: Answer Lu Ping's summons

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Forty sects! On the steps! All at once! It's the longest line in history! I'm counting! I've lost count! I'm starting again!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right. Deep breath. Going.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My sect owes yours. I'd rather pay in sword work than in words.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're staying here, Ruan Jingtao. Someone has to guard the buns.

objectives.text: Ring the bronze bell at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The processional way is a river of banners. Eleven thousand fighters, climbing. At the gate, they bow to the two steles: the precepts, and the oath.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bronze bell booms. Birds explode from every roof, and every head turns.

objectives.text: Talk with Ruan Jingtao at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. Three thousand. My father's leading. He brought his crooked bow. He's very proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Yes. Definitely. Whatever Ruan Jingtao said. I was listening. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: See? Even Lu Ping agrees. It must be true.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. Five hundred healers. We're singing on the steps. Lian's leading. We're here.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You and the precepts. A love story.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (tugging Ruan Jingtao's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Battle Plan
quests.summary: The Sect Master spreads Xiao Shi's map of the Abyss on the plaza and makes her plan in front of forty sect masters.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The war camp, the obelisk ring, the black gate. Every sect has a place. I'll give the plan at the rim, where they can all hear it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If it can be done, I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: bell_zhong
dialogue.text: If you need the mountain awake, ring twice. Once is dinner. Three times is a very bad day.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yes. Do that. Zhong Ming has earned the right to say it.

objectives.text: Study Xiao Shi's map with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map shows every path, every door, every cage. At the black gate, the Sect Master has drawn a single character: Gu.

objectives.text: Report back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You go through the gate, to the throne. I'll be behind you. I'll give the full plan at the rim. Now go and say see you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well? Details! How many? How big? Did anybody scream? Was it you?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Answer Lu Ping, and then answer me. In that order.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (to the Sect Master) Are we allowed to do that? I'm not telling anyone.

quests.title: Not Goodbye
quests.summary: Everyone says see you later. Nobody says goodbye. It's the rule now.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: See you later. I've made you a bundle. It says come home, idiot. In big letters. I didn't drop it. Not once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Xiao Man is right, and I say so as someone who has read everything and agrees with very little.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: See you later. Hold out your wrist. Hm. Stubborn pulse. Good. Come back and let me take it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Is this a meeting? Nobody told the pagoda. The pagoda likes to be told.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Elder Bai?

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: See you later. I've written the whole saga down. Every chapter. I'm saving the last page. You'll write it.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (sighs) Thank you, Liu Er. That was very... something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (tugging Elder Bai's sleeve) Is that allowed?

quests.title: The Hermit Stays
quests.summary: The hermit won't march. He's too old, he says. He'll stay and teach the children who are too young to go.

objectives.text: See what the hermit wants

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I won't march. I'm too old, and someone has to sing to the ones who stay. I'll be in the pagoda. With Qiu Hua. And the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is that the famous {player}? The juniors at the gate want a signature. On a bun.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hm. Lu Ping is not wrong. Lu Ping is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: Did you hear? No? Well, I did. I'll tell you later. I'll tell everyone later.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. You've grown all three. Go and finish what my masters started. And come back. The tea will be steeping.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: fan_rui
dialogue.text: The juniors are betting you'll come back with a new scar. I bet two. Don't let me down.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Leave {them} alone, Fan Rui. That's my job.

objectives.text: Hear what Liu Er has to say

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your stance is better. Still wrong, but better. I owe you a rematch, you know.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Ignore Yan Tie. Everyone else does.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (eyes shining) That was so kind.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: Properly done! I'm writing that down.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Treasury Opens
quests.summary: Steward Qian opens the treasury for the march. All of it. He doesn't count what leaves. He counts who does.

objectives.text: Hear Steward Qian out

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is open. All of it. I'm not counting stones tonight. I'm counting people. I'm going to count every one of you back in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know the way. More or less.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: You'll do no such thing, Liu Er. Leave it to them.

objectives.text: Carry the treasury's supplies to the array
Bring word to Steward Qian

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Everything's at the array. Every stone. Every pill. I've never been so poor. I've never been so proud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: You came back with your heart intact. That is the harder victory.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: That's the truth, Abbess Jing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: There's not enough of the treasury's best for everyone who marches.

choices.text: Arm the weakest first

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The whole street will hear of this.

choices.text: Arm by rank

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Steward Qian) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take the best for yourself

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Steward Qian, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: The Last Shadows
quests.summary: The Patriarch sends everything he has left at the gathering army. It's not much, now. It's still something.

objectives.text: Speak with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Shadows! The last ones! Thunder Peak's got the gate! We're shouting the sutra! Everyone's shouting the sutra!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it mine.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The old swords were humming this morning. They only hum when trouble is walking.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the crane roost

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: More shadow-born? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Hold the inner sect gate against more Blood Moon cultivators
See Yan Tie again

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The last shadows! Gone! Forty sects shouting the sutra at once! You could hear it from the isles! The star-gazer probably did!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: warden_qiu
dialogue.text: The swords are quiet again. That means they approve. They rarely approve.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Old Qiu. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Was there anyone else there? Anyone who needed help? You'd tell me?

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: THAT'S the spirit! Thunder Peak salutes kindness! Loudly!

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) The guards in the cages said things like that.

quests.title: Iron-Fang and Gu
quests.summary: Iron-Fang and Gu Hanshan meet at the teleport array. The bandit and the traitor. Both waiting to pay a debt.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Traitor. You took my token, years ago. The blood-red one. From my strongbox. What did you do with it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I kept it, Iron-Fang. You'll see. Tomorrow. Your sister will see too. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...A traitor's promise. I've heard worse. I've made worse. Fine. See you at the gate, traitor.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good timing. Another minute and I'd have gone looking for you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If they run, let them. If they come back, don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. Truly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the outer sect hall

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You look like someone with questions. I may even have answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Sign the task off at the mission hall when you're done. Unsigned heroics earn no contribution.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it started, for me.

quests.title: The Last Stillness
quests.summary: An hour before dusk, you sit on the teleport array and carry everyone: forty sects, eleven thousand, a town, a mountain.

objectives.text: Carry the whole army in stillness

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven thousand breaths. Forty sects. A town with brooms. A mountain with lanterns. A chicken. You carry them all, and they carry you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sun touches the sea of clouds. Far to the west, the moon begins to rise. It is exactly the colour of the Patriarch's robes.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The moon. It's red. Properly red. I'm not afraid. I'm terrified. It's fine. Terrified is fine. Elder Mo was always terrified. He said so once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about food, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Must you always talk about your clan, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The well reflects the moon. It does not argue with it. Wei Tong is right.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your core hums when you stand still. Did you know? It's very distracting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Wei Tong) That's the {player} I know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Hm. Fine.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Hmph. Reasonable. Annoyingly.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Oh. Oh, I didn't like that. My stomach didn't like that.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: (to Wei Tong, quietly) I did not like that. I will remember it.

quests.title: The Array Wakes
quests.summary: At dusk the teleport array wakes, every rune blazing, the route to the Abyss rim open. The Azure Cloud goes to war.

objectives.text: Go to the teleport array

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The teleport array blazes. Eleven thousand fighters wait in rows. The Sect Master stands at the front, crown on, sword drawn.

objectives.text: Light the teleport array for the march

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The runes catch. The air smells of rain. One by one, the sects step onto the array, and vanish, toward the Abyss and the red moon.

objectives.text: Compare notes with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Remember the wager. I'm not saying goodbye. I'm saying I'll see you up there, complaining. It's better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Did you use the move I showed you? The one with the elbow? Tell me you used the elbow.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I wasn't here and neither were you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's going to cause trouble. Good trouble. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (muttering, to Zhao Kang) That was cold.

quests.title: Shadow-Born, the Array's Last Guard
quests.summary: A final handful of shadow-born tests the teleport array as the last sects prepare to cross.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Clear the Sword Peak path of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones at the outer dormitories
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the plum garden isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother says immortals don't need to eat. You eat more than me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the enemies is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (beaming at Zhao Kang) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Zhao Kang) Properly done! Somebody write it down!

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (tugging Zhao Kang's sleeve) Is that allowed?

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Spirit Stones for the Array's Power
quests.summary: The teleport array, carrying eleven thousand fighters, draws more power than ever, and Steward Qian feeds it the last reserves.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Look at you. Wearing the sect's robes and the bandit's heart. Careful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Kind, and still breathing. You're rarer than spirit stones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: One more thing on a long list. Bring me spirit stones from the Hundred-Chi Waterfall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: I have four thousand task slips and one brush. The brush and I are no longer friends.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fine. Iron-Fang is right. Write that down, nobody will believe it later.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (to Iron-Fang, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.text: Pick up spirit stones near the Hundred-Chi Waterfall
Return to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Done already? Good. The sect notices these things, even when it pretends not to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I learned a lot, actually.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: Recorded, sealed and posted. Three hundred points, and my personal nod.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Told you, Deacon Shen.

dialogue.speaker: deacon_shen
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

reply.speaker: deacon_shen
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) Remember this one, when the next choice is harder.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Last Dumpling Batch
quests.summary: Wei Tong hands out one final batch of dumplings before the crossing, insisting nobody fights an apocalypse on an empty stomach.

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Eat! Before the array! Elder Mo always said fight better fed! I don't know if he said that but he would have!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could come. Not because I'm worried. The Zhao clan simply enjoys being present at victories.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No, Zhao Kang. You'd just get in the way. Lovingly.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the sunrise terrace

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You found me. Good. I've been turning something over and I want another pair of eyes on it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I have time. Go on.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fight for him too, {junior}. Elder Mo would say adequate. I'll say it louder.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You and your precepts. One day you'll bow to a door for being properly shut.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Gu

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit a moment. The day's been long, and it isn't over yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old Bao gave me three rice balls for luck. I ate the luck. I feel very lucky.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Why do I let you near serious conversations, Wei Tong?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

quests.title: Training Puppets, the Last Warm-Up
quests.summary: A few disciples too young to march get one last training session against the puppets before the army departs.

objectives.text: Investigate the sword tomb

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the sword tomb the rusted blades hum faintly as you pass, as if some of them still remember a name.

objectives.text: Fight off the training puppets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The training puppets come on in silence.

objectives.text: Collect tribulation jade around the outer dormitories
Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We did what we could.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm telling everyone! Well, I'm telling Mother. She'll tell everyone.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Ha. Liu Er's right. That was good.

dialogue.speaker: cook_bao
dialogue.text: Back? Then you're eating. Heroes eat first. That's the refectory rule. I made it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: You didn't have to. That's why it matters.

reply.speaker: cook_bao
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) Heaven bless the immortal. Truly.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Good. Rules mean someone comes looking for you.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (to Xiao Shi) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (steps back) Right. Yes. Of course.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade for the March
quests.summary: The last pieces of tribulation jade are distributed to commanders, a small warm reminder in every pocket.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Bring me tribulation jade from the medicine valley. You'll know what to do when you get there. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: When I grow up I'm going to climb the nine thousand steps. Maybe eight thousand. Then rest.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (half a step back) I'll be good, {senior}. I'm always good.

objectives.text: Find the tribulation jade at the medicine valley
Go back to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Thank you. Some things can only be done by walking there and doing them.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Well struck. At the Nine Banners I'd have paid money to see that.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Don't encourage {them}, Ruan Jingtao. The head's big enough already.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: People keep thanking me for things you did. It's getting embarrassing.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says I'm improving. She said it with her eyes closed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: That was closer than it looked.

objectives.choice_prompt: The tribulation jade came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Hm. Yes. Probably right.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Bai Ling's Saved Last Page
quests.summary: Elder Bai shows you the blank last page of the saga he's been writing, insisting it's the only page he can't write himself.

objectives.text: Search the refectory

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rolls out of the refectory kitchens. Somewhere inside, a ladle strikes a pot like a gong.

objectives.text: Examine the bronze ding

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense smoke curls out of the bronze ding. Beneath the ash, something that is not incense glints.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Everything up to today. And one blank page. You'll write it, one way or another. I have faith in how it ends.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stand up straight, {player}. You are a disciple of the Azure Cloud, not a question mark.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Enough, Sect Master. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The chronicles are full of cruelty. Thank you for a better page.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correctly done, per article three, subsection nine.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) That was not learned on any righteous mountain.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: Qiu Hua's Farewell
quests.summary: Qiu Hua, staying behind with the hermit, gives you a small drawing of the chicken for luck.

objectives.text: Open the cage at the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drawing shows Elder Drumstick wearing a tiny cape. Underneath, in careful nine-year-old handwriting: fight bravely, like a chicken.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock of the cage snaps. Whoever is inside blinks at you as if you were the sun.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: If you find anything written down, bring it to me. Even a shopping list. Especially a shopping list.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: What Elder Bai said. I was about to say it. Slower.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Your colour is poor. Eat something green before you go. No, not that. That's a moss.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (to Xiao Shi) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Here you are at last. I kept you a seat. And tea. The tea is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I could.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Mercy is a discipline, not a mood. Practise it on the way, whatever you meet.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Listen to Abbess Jing. It is good advice, and rarer than it should be.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Bai at the Cliff of Reflection

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Don't look so worried. Or do. It suits the week we're having.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm listening.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Elder Bai is right. Also, drink water. Everyone always forgets water.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Just so.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill! It's probably a pill. It's round, anyway.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (dryly) Try to break only the rules that deserve it, {player}.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Precedent followed. The shelves approve.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators, the Gate's Last Test
quests.summary: A last handful of demon cultivators tests the sect gate itself, a final, futile gesture before the army departs.

objectives.text: Turn the drying racks at the tea terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The drying racks sag under the day's harvest. Something small and furry has been nibbling the lower rows.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon cultivators at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Recover medicine bundles from the sect gate
Tell Liu Er what you found

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three things today. Well. Three things that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That wasn't funny, Xiao Man. ...It was a little funny.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I know you didn't do it for me. Thank you anyway.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (to Liu Er) That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Medicine for the Whole Army
quests.summary: The Moon-Well's healers make a final check of medicine supplies before stepping onto the array themselves.

objectives.text: See what Xiao Man wants

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The sooner this is done, the sooner I can stop worrying. Bring me medicine bundles from the medicine valley.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: YES. Good plan. I mean, yes. Good plan. Sorry, I get loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then it's settled.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If anyone comes back bleeding, send them to me first, and to the elders second.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The carp know my name now. They're very polite about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Give me until dusk.

objectives.text: Gather medicine bundles at the medicine valley
Report back to Xiao Man

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Excellent. Rest while you can. Heaven never lets anyone rest for long.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Did you spend anything? Lose anything? Borrow anything from anyone who writes things down?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then stops) Heavens. You feel like weather now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Do you want a pill? I made it. It's probably a pill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm going to try that too. The kind thing.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (very quietly) Is that allowed?

quests.title: Han Xue's Last Word Before the Array
quests.summary: Han Xue, waiting for you at the array's edge, says one thing before the crossing that isn't about the plan at all.

objectives.text: Hear Han Xue out

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Whatever happens up there, or down there, I'm glad it was you. I've never said that plainly. I'm saying it now, plainly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Come back, all right? I've buried enough people this year. I don't want to be good at it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop fussing, Wei Tong. You're making {them} nervous. You're making me nervous.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the formation hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Stay a moment. There's something you should hear from me, not from gossip.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: What the Sect Master said. Also, eat first. Nobody wins on an empty stomach.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. Now, where was I.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the martial stage

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Ah, {player}. Walk with me a little. My thoughts go further on foot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Whatever you find there, do not let it make you smaller than you are.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}'ll be fine, Abbess Jing. Probably. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (to Wei Tong, quietly) Watch this one. The eyes have changed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! Dumpling approves. Dumpling is a sword and has no morals.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: Under the Last Blood Moon
quests.summary: The last of the army crosses. Han Xue waits for you at the array's edge. The moon is full and red over the sea of clouds.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone's crossed. The Sect Master's waiting at the rim. Iron-Fang's army. Forty sects. Ye Wuming's children. All of them.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I come? I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Keep it ready. I might.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, to be safe) Sorry, {senior}! It's hard not to bow now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let's go and finish it. Together. Like the letter in the reliquary said. Not alone.

objectives.text: Head to the spirit beast garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit beast garden smells of hay and ozone. Something in the far pen is chewing on a thunderbolt.

objectives.text: Open the cage

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You wrench the cage open. Rust showers down like red snow.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Hundred-Chi Waterfall is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your sleeve is torn. Either you fought a wolf or a thornbush. I'm betting thornbush.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Hm. Han Xue is not wrong. Han Xue is rarely wrong about posture.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: (to Elder Hua, low) Are we sure about this? You've heard what people are saying.
