objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Unorthodox treatment. It may even work.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reckless. It worked. Don't tell me how.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: I'll pretend I didn't see that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Blood Moon
quests.summary: The Azure Cloud Sect marches on the Blood Moon Abyss.

objectives.text: Watch the Azure Cloud Sect gather at the Abyss
Receive the battle plan from the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wei Tong and Zhao Kang break the war camp. Ye Wuming's people take the obelisk ring. Gu will open the black gate.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You go through the gate, to the throne. I'll be behind you, holding the sect together.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Whatever happens, {player}, you are not carrying this alone. Remember the letter in the reliquary.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang at the canyon rim

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men are ready. Forty bandits, washed and fed, which is a first. They're a bit confused about it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Their families are behind that gate. We'll follow you through anything, sect brat. Sorry. Sect hero.

objectives.text: Stand with Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay alive. That's not a request, it's what the Sect Master said, and I'm saying it louder.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And after, when this is done, you owe me a proper sparring match. No holding back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: After, Senior Sister. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And after the sparring match, a banquet. The Zhao clan is paying. I've already sent the letter.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Han Xue) See? That's why I follow {them} into bad places.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Proper as a stele, as always.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Proper. The Zhao clan approves, grudgingly.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Breaking the Line
quests.summary: The Blood Moon army holds the field of bones and the war camp. Break through.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guard line on the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: For Elder Mo! Hey, Elder, are you watching? Watch this one!

objectives.text: Burn the Blood Moon war camp

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Left side's mine, {player}! You can have the right side. It's smaller.

objectives.text: Regroup with Wei Tong at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We did it! The camp's burning, and I've only lost one bun. It was a very brave bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go on. The gate's ahead. Elder Mo would've said something grumpy and encouraging. Pretend I did.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One bun. He's been mourning that bun for an hour. The camp was on fire and he mourned the bun.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Hold the pools, both of you. I'm going for the gate.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Black Gate
quests.summary: The fortress gate can only be opened from inside. Gu Hanshan has a way in.

objectives.text: Meet Gu Hanshan at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Remember the blood-red token you took from Iron-Fang's chest? The one I confiscated? I kept it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: It's a command token. With it, the gate guards will let me in. They don't know yet what I have become.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They'll kill you when they find out.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. I've made my peace with that. It is the first peace I have felt in twenty years.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Gu Hanshan. Whatever happens tonight, you go in as an elder of the Azure Cloud.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Kinder than the Law Hall ever was.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Careful. That is how it starts.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Elder Gu, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

objectives.text: Wait before the black gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gate is black iron, carved with a moon swallowing a sword. It is taller than the main hall. It is utterly silent.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then, from inside, the sound of fighting. One man against many.

objectives.text: Break the gate's last seal

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the seal with the Lotus Key. From the other side, someone pulls the great bar. The black gate groans open.

quests.title: Court of Crimson
quests.summary: Fight through the fortress courtyard, and find the man who opened the gate.

objectives.text: Clear the fortress courtyard
Kneel beside Gu Hanshan at the gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Ah. You came. I held them... as long as I could. I was always better at law than fighting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tell the sect... tell them the Law Hall is empty now. Fill it with someone kinder than me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Lan... is waiting. I think she'll let me apologise. Thank you, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We'll fill it, Elder Gu. With someone kind. I promise you that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Rest now, Elder. You opened the gate.

objectives.text: Break open the last cages

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last locks fall. Mothers, children, old men stumble into the red light, blinking, alive.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the cages

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They're here. All of them. My sister. My men's wives, their children. Alive.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Today, in full. My blade is yours until the Patriarch's head is on the floor.

objectives.choice_prompt: In the last cage, a Blood Guard begs to be freed with the rest.

choices.text: Free him

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. You'd have made a terrible bandit. Best compliment I've got.

choices.text: Leave him for the alliance's judges

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. Fine. They're not always wrong.

choices.text: Leave him to rot

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: I did things like that once. Ask me how that ended.

quests.title: The Shattered Altar
quests.summary: The Altar of Blood still feeds the Patriarch. Destroy it, and let the void teach you what remains.

objectives.text: Defeat the altar's last defenders
Shatter the Altar of Blood

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The altar cracks from top to bottom. Three hundred years of stolen blood pours out and soaks away into the stone.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's done. His power has no root now. Only what he carries in himself.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No root. Good. Then we pull up the rest of the weed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Get the prisoners clear of the altar. It's coming down.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

objectives.text: Still your soul in the silence of the void

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the silence after the altar breaks, you sink inward. Past body, past qi, past soul, to the empty place beneath.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing is there. And nothing is exactly enough. You rise with the stillness of the void in your bones.

quests.title: The Blood Moon Patriarch
quests.summary: Xue Wuji waits on his throne, and he has been waiting for three hundred years.

objectives.text: Cut down the Patriarch's throne guards
Confront the Blood Moon Patriarch
Defeat the Blood Moon Patriarch

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: Come then, little lotus. Show me the body I will wear to heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My body stays mine, Xue Wuji. So does my heart.

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: We shall see how long you hold them both.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: His body is dust. But his remnant soul tore free and fled upward. To the Sky Isles.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Your breakthrough has drawn heaven's eye. Your tribulation is gathering. He means to steal it, and ascend in your place.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I have my name back, {player}. The children have theirs. Go. Finish it. We'll hold the abyss.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we go up after him. The array to the isles still works.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. Hold the Abyss with Ye Wuming, Senior Sister. This part is mine.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. Hm. They kept you clean.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: I was raised on that. I don't recommend it.

quests.title: Pursuit to the Heavens
quests.summary: The Patriarch's remnant has fled to the Sky Isles. Follow it before the tribulation begins.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You're back early. Also, the sky is on fire. I assume those two facts are related.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A remnant soul crossed my bridge an hour ago. It is climbing toward the tribulation peak, possessing everything it touches.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Heaven's lightning is gathering for you, lotus child. Get to the peak before he does.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Heaven is watching, lotus child. It keeps very long records.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The stars disagree. The stars often disagree. I side with you.

objectives.text: Fight through the possessed Blood Guards on the jade bridge
Speak with Han Xue on the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I followed you through the array. Obviously. Did you think I'd let you face the sky alone?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'll hold the bridge. Nothing else crosses. Go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}... you still owe me that sparring match. Don't you dare ascend without paying your debts.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: She did follow you. She argued with my bridge the whole way across. The bridge lost.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, Senior Sister. Hold the bridge.

quests.title: Remnants of the Blood Moon
quests.summary: The remnant has corrupted the immortal garden. Clear the way and prepare lightning rods of thunder crystal.

objectives.text: Purge the possessed cultivators in the garden
Gather thunder crystals to ground the tribulation
Charge the crystals at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystals drink from the vein until they hum. Planted on the summit, they will split heaven's lightning like a river delta.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look at me like that. Of course I came. Someone has to witness your triumph and complain about it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Swear something to me. When you come back down, we fight. Properly. And I win.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When I come back down, Zhao Kang. And you'll lose.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha! That's the spirit. Go. The sky is waiting, and it has terrible manners.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I shall referee. I have always wanted to referee something. Heaven never lets me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: My brother would have done the same. Don't tell anyone I said that.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Proper. The celestial clerks would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (sets down the cup, very carefully) No.

quests.title: The Remnant's Last Guards
quests.summary: The Patriarch's remnant leaves possessed guards behind on the jade bridge, buying itself time to climb.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks at the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bundles of herbs hang from the drying racks, drying in neat rows. One bundle is the wrong herb entirely.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the rainbow bridge

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not explaining your death to the Sect Master.

objectives.text: Pick up tribulation jade near the elixir spring
Compare notes with Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Try to keep up, village brat. Village friend. Friend brat. Whatever you are.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut it, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Somebody raised you right.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

quests.title: The Last Forty Crystals
quests.summary: Elder Bai's delta needs its final forty crystals planted on the summit before the ninth bolt falls.

objectives.text: Go and see Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heaven sends help in odd shapes. Today it's yours. Bring me thunder crystals from the thunder isle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Listen to Qingyi. Qingyi's survived worse.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The little ones tell stories about you, {senior}. Good ones!

objectives.text: Collect thunder crystals around the thunder isle
Bring word to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You came back in one piece. That's my favourite kind of report.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Glad to help.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Heh. Not bad.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Did anyone see you win? Witnesses matter. My grandfather says so.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the thunder crystals you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (to Iron-Fang) {player} and the precepts. Should we leave them alone together?

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: That's the look I used to see in the water.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Name
quests.summary: At the obelisk ring below, Ye Wuming's crane reaches the isles: he has his name back at last.

objectives.text: Make your way to the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the crane isle a hundred cranes turn their heads to look at you at once. It is unsettling.

objectives.text: Touch the crane statue

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You touch the neck of the crane statue. It is cool and smooth, polished by generations of wishes.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ye Chen. My name was Ye Chen. My mother's cousin gave it to me before the moon took me. I remember it now. All of it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tell me the part Ye Wuming will leave out. There is always a part.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Go on.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're late. I wasn't counting. It was a hundred and twelve breaths. I wasn't counting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: ...Good.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Ye Wuming) Kind. Good. Kindness is a harder road than it looks.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: By the book. Fine.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. How very outer-disciple of you.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (very still) I will remember this, {player}. As your sect master.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Sister
quests.summary: A second crane follows: Iron-Fang's sister is free, mid-shout, exactly as frozen as she was taken.

objectives.text: Answer Iron-Fang's summons

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: She's shouting. At me. For being late. Twenty years late. I've never been so happy to be shouted at.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll bring back whatever I find.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It is restful. Mostly. You are not restful.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Not the time, Qing Luan.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Do what Iron-Fang says. It's a sound plan. I checked it for holes.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I wondered when you'd turn up at the Seal of Heaven. Everyone does, sooner or later.

dialogue.speaker: recorder_shu
dialogue.text: Everything is written somewhere. The trouble is finding which somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Good advice. I'll try to take it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the Tree of Ages

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by the Tree of Ages.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You fight like someone who's never been hungry. It shows. It's not a bad thing.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars do not lie. They merely exaggerate.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A crooked road can still arrive. Mind that it does.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Heh. Knew it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: (to Qing Luan) Proper as a magistrate.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Demon Cultivators on the Ruins
quests.summary: A last pocket of demon cultivators, possessed by the fleeing remnant's touch, holds the celestial ruins.

objectives.text: Search the drying racks at the jade terraces

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn the bundles on the drying racks. The smell of mint and bitter root makes your eyes water.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Find the spirit pills at the elixir spring
Talk it over with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Try not to trip over your own sword this time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Enough, Han Xue. Let {them} go with some dignity left.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll feel it tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You'd give away your own sword if someone looked cold.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Properly done. The precepts are older than all of us, for good reason.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We have buried that before.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Unorthodox. I'll pretend I didn't hear the details.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Breathe first, break rules second. You skipped a step.

quests.title: Void Shards From the Possessed Garden
quests.summary: The immortal garden, cleared of possession, leaves void shards behind worth gathering before the storm.

objectives.text: Report to Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There's work, if you want it. Bring me void shards from the immortal garden.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Look up, not down. Down is where the clouds keep their opinions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll treasure that forever.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: Please keep to the paths. The clouds between isles bruise, and they remember who stepped on them.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (studying you) Your soul sits deep now. I can feel it from here.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Recover void shards from the immortal garden
See Ye Wuming again

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm. Better than I expected. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The mountain heard you coming back. So did I. Well done.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Told you, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is everyone all right?

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Heh. Cold. I remember cold.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Gu's Last Gift
quests.summary: A final crane arrives from the abyss: Gu Hanshan's last request, granted by the Sect Master, is read aloud.

objectives.text: Examine the crane statue at the crane isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: His last words, read at the moon gate: tell them the Law Hall is empty. Tell them I opened one gate, at least, before I closed for good.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crane statue stands on one leg, its bronze feathers green with age. Its beak points somewhere specific.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the sun altar

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You wanted to see me?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Hm.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the sun altar

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come, come. I was just thinking about you. Nothing bad. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What is it?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stars say go. The stars also said that sixty years ago, so take it lightly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Listen to Qing Luan. I hate saying it, but listen.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (to Zhao Kang) The juniors want to be like {them}. I find I don't mind.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the hermit's isle

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I heard you were about. News travels fast when you're the one making it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't die. I haven't beaten you properly yet. It would ruin everything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: {player}'ll live, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming is right. The stars agree, grudgingly. They hate being agreed with.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper. You sect people.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Celestial Sentinels, Guarding the Peak
quests.summary: The palace's oldest sentinels form a line at the peak's edge, not to stop you, but to guard the ninth bolt's ground.

objectives.text: Look behind the jade screen at the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You study the carving of the jade screen. One panel has been replaced, and the new jade is a shade too green.

objectives.text: Drive the celestial sentinels from the palace court

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial sentinels spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Gather thunder crystals at the palace court
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My hands are still shaking. Give them a moment.

dialogue.speaker: servant_qingyi
dialogue.text: The terraces sing a little louder. That is how the isles say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ha. Qingyi's right. That was good.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemies: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Heart of a steamed bun, that one.

reply.speaker: servant_qingyi
reply.text: (beaming at Han Xue) I'm going to tell everyone about that!

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the precepts. Good. They're there for a reason.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's not you. Or it didn't used to be.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade, One Last Piece
quests.summary: You gather one final piece of tribulation jade, meaning to leave it at the summit for whoever climbs next.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have the look of someone with nothing to do. Bring me tribulation jade from the storm plateau.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Senior Sister, with respect, I could do this faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: With respect, Zhao Kang, you couldn't.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I wash dishes now. I'm very good at it. Tell no one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll see to it before the next bell.

objectives.text: Pick up tribulation jade near the storm plateau
Return to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you, {player}. Truly. Now sit down before you fall down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Next time, maybe something easier?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One less thing on the list of things that keep me awake. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Law Hall speaks well of you. The Law Hall speaks well of almost no one.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more tribulation jade than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (looks away) Right. Let's go.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (to Han Xue, very quietly) That is how it begins. I have seen it begin before.

quests.title: Before the Ninth Bolt
quests.summary: At the foot of the Ascension Stair, you sit one last time, and carry everyone who carried you, all the way here.

objectives.text: See what Han Xue wants

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'm holding the bridge. Nothing crosses. Go and take the sky, {player}. I'll be right here when you're done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't come back empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He means be careful. He always means be careful.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Still soft. Still alive. Still surprises me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I'll be shouting. Loudly. The whole way up. Go, lotus child. Heaven's waited ten thousand years. It can wait one more minute.

objectives.text: Steady your qi at the golden lotus lake

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi is as still as deep water, and as heavy.

objectives.text: Go back to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Good work. The world is a slightly tidier place, and I can finally have my tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was nothing. Well, it was something.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And what did the sky say while you were there? It always says something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go on, tell Qing Luan. Qing Luan won't sleep otherwise.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Correct. Clean. Like a good stance.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Reasonable. Annoyingly reasonable.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. I would have done much the same.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Heavenly Tribulation
quests.summary: The heavenly tribulation descends on the summit, and the Patriarch's remnant rides the lightning.

objectives.text: Ascend to the tribulation peak
Survive the heart tribulation and destroy the remnant

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: The ninth bolt is the heart tribulation. I will be your heart, little lotus.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Hello again, {player}. He found me in the mirror. He says we can share.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I beat you once. I'll do it as often as it takes.

objectives.text: Survive the nine-times-nine Heavenly Tribulation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine times nine. The storm over the peak is so large it has its own weather. The first volley is already falling.

objectives.text: Endure the nine bolts of heavenly lightning

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lightning comes. First, second, third. Your body breaks and remakes itself. Fourth, fifth, sixth. Your qi burns white.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seventh, eighth. The remnant screams as the lightning finds it, and there is nothing left of Xue Wuji but ash on the wind.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ninth bolt strikes, and it does not hurt at all. It feels like the sky, saying your name.

quests.title: Immortal Ascension
quests.summary: The Ascension Stair has opened. Say your farewells, and climb.

objectives.text: Say farewell to the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The stair has opened for you. Three hundred years, and our sect has its first immortal.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You don't have to go. The heavens will wait. They have nothing but time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If I stay, the stair closes, and nobody climbs it again for a thousand years. Someone should see what's up there.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Go, then. But the sparring match stands. I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Then go, {player}. And look down on us sometimes. We'll be the ones waving.

objectives.text: Say farewell to Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sixty years I waited here for someone worth the climb. It was worth it. Don't tell anyone I said so.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: At the top, you'll find a door. Knock politely. Heaven is very sensitive about manners.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Kindness with a spine. Rarer than any spirit herb.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

objectives.text: Climb the Ascension Stair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Each step is made of light. Below, your friends grow small. Han Xue raises her sword in salute. Zhao Kang pretends not to cry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Mo. Mother. Everyone. Thank you.

objectives.text: Ascend
Epilogue: the Azure Cloud Sect

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Three hundred years ago, the Azure Cloud and the Verdant Lotus sealed a monster beneath the earth, and the world forgot.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Only the Azure Cloud Sect remembers. It keeps its watch on this mountain, above the sea of clouds.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Every spring, its gate opens to those with the talent and stubbornness to climb nine thousand steps.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: This spring, an orphan with nothing but a jade pendant reached the top.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: The Azure Cloud Sect. I made it, Mother.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The teleport array flares, and the mountain is gone. In its place, bamboo, green and endless, whispering in the wind.

shots.speaker: senior_wei
shots.text: First mission outside the walls! Don't wander off, don't eat red mushrooms, and don't pet anything with more than four eyes.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Whispering Bamboo Forest. Spirit herbs grow here, and spirit wolves hunt here. Usually they leave cultivators alone.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Usually.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Qingshi Town. Rice fields, a river, a market, and a temple where the kindly keeper buries the dead.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Every new moon, somebody vanishes. Every morning after, the town pretends not to notice.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Almost everybody.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Visitors from the mountain! How wonderful. May the ancestors bless your journey, young immortals.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: Eyes open, {junior}. Towns that smile this hard are usually hiding something.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Clever children. Too clever. Keeper Hong was such a comfortable face. I wore it for eleven years.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The old man's skin splits like a husk. Beneath it: black and crimson robes, and eyes the colour of blood.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Deacon Hong Lie of the Blood Moon. The Patriarch stirs, lotus-bearer, and he dreams of you.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: Acolytes in the alley! {player}, he's running for the graves!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: North of the wolf dens, where even the bamboo grows quiet, the forest hides something older than any sect alive.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Verdant Lotus Sect. Once it stood beside the Azure Cloud as an equal. Now its name is a footnote.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Its ruins keep their secrets well. But stones cannot be cut out of a book.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: So. The lotus comes home at last. I had hoped to be dead before it did.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Three hundred years ago the Blood Moon Patriarch drowned three kingdoms in blood, reaching for the heavens.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Our sect master and your founder bound him beneath the Abyss. The seal needed two keys, and a price.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: The Verdant Lotus paid it. Every elder gave their life to the seal. The Patriarch's servants hunted the rest of us.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: One disciple fled with the Lotus Key and a baby girl. Her line hid among mortals for three centuries.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Your mother's pendant, child, is that key. And you are the last of the Verdant Lotus.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once every three years, the Azure Cloud Sect raises its banners for the Inner Sect Tournament.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Disciples of the Azure Cloud! Fight hard, fight fair, and whoever breaks the formation tiles pays for them.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: The victor will stand beside me and learn the secrets of the Azure Eye. Show heaven what this sect is made of.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: In the crowd, not everyone is watching the fighters.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Nine to one odds. Lu Ping had better not be wrong about me.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The pagoda doors hang open. Scrolls lie scattered like fallen leaves. And at the heart of the mess stands the Law Hall Elder.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: You were supposed to be watching the final, disciple. Everyone was supposed to be watching the final.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Elder Gu. The token, the missions, the pages, the pills. It was you. All of it.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: I did what a father does. Heaven took my daughter. The Blood Moon offered her back. You would have done the same.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Gu Hanshan! Put down the diagram and kneel, or I will strike you down where you stand.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: Forty years of loyalty, Sect Master, and you never once asked why I stopped smiling. Kill them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Blood Moon Abyss. A wound in the earth, three hundred years deep, where the moon is always red.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once a kingdom stood here. Its people were the Patriarch's first harvest.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: It stinks of old blood. Stay behind me. No. Stay beside me. Where I can see you.

shots.speaker: wanderer_ye
shots.text: Step where I step. Breathe when I breathe. Welcome to the place I was born.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Blood from the broken obelisks still trickles along the channels, up the dais, into the great altar.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: The diagram is delivered, Patriarch. The Azure Eye's design is in your hands. Now keep your promise. Give me my Lan.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: Patience, loyal Gu. When I walk again, you will have everything you deserve. Everything.

shots.speaker: crimson_xuemei
shots.text: Master, the lotus-bearer is here. The little lamb has come to the altar all by itself.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: Disciple. You should not have come. Xue Mei, keep it alive. The Patriarch needs the body intact.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Blood Moon comes to Qingshi on the third night: demon cultivators, blood-fed wolves, and Iron-Fang's bandits beside them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Their banners rise on the graveyard hill, above empty graves the town has only just refilled.

shots.speaker: rival_zhao
shots.text: I count four hundred. Maybe five. I'd count better if they stood still.

shots.speaker: magistrate_zhou
shots.text: People of Qingshi! Last time, we hid. We locked our doors and let a monster feed on our children. Not this time!

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Then we hold. Every street, every house, every wall. Not one more grave.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once every sixty years the clouds part, and the Celestial Sky Isles drift down within reach of mortal arrays.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Here, where immortals once lived, star iron falls like rain and thunder grows in the rocks like crystal flowers.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Everything is floating. The whole world is floating.

shots.speaker: rival_zhao
shots.text: Please stop saying floating. Say resting on very tall air.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And at the highest point, the summit where heavenly tribulation strikes, waits the stair that climbs to heaven.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation stands complete: star iron pillars, thunder crystals, a web of ten thousand runes.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Outer ring. Seventh branch. This rune turns outward. It should turn inward. Why would it turn outward?

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: The Law Hall archive. Thirty years of Gu's hands on every page. Oh, you fool. You poor, grieving fool.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Above the sea of clouds, the moon rises, and for the first time in three hundred years, it rises red.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The water does not ripple. Your reflection rises from it, dripping darkness, wearing your face like a mask.

shots.speaker: heart_demon
shots.text: Hello, {player}. Don't you recognise me? I'm every time you were afraid, and pretended you weren't.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: I know what you are. A heart demon. You feed on doubt.

shots.speaker: heart_demon
shots.text: Then I'll never go hungry. Let me in. I'll carry the key for you. Isn't it heavy? Isn't it so very heavy?

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation roars like a furnace, blood-red, pulling the mountain's qi downward into the dark.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Stay back, all of you! Seven runes. I can turn seven runes. I just need something big enough to push them.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Elder Mo, no! Let me help, I have the Lotus Key!

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: The key is for tomorrow, {junior}. Tonight is for old men. Back straight, now. Crooked spine, crooked meridian.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Elder Mo Changfeng burns his core, his soul and seventy years of cultivation in a single breath. The red light turns blue.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Mo Changfeng. Elder of the Outer Court. You stubborn, stubborn old man.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Under the last blood moon, the Azure Cloud Sect goes to war: elders, disciples, a bandit's army and a traitor in chains.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Three hundred years ago our founders stood here and did not finish the job. We will finish it.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: For Mo Changfeng. For the Verdant Lotus. For everyone this Abyss has swallowed. Azure Cloud, advance!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Beyond the black gate, on a throne of fused bone, something that was once a man opens its eyes.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Xue Wuji, Patriarch of the Blood Moon. Three kingdoms drowned for his ambition. Three centuries of hunger in the dark.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: The last of the Verdant Lotus. Do you know how long I have waited for you? Your great-grandmother's great-grandmother escaped me.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: You broke Gu with grief. You tried to break me with fear. It didn't work.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: Then I will break you the old way. With my hands. Come, little lotus. Show me my new body.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Above the summit, the clouds spiral into a black eye nine miles wide. Heaven has seen you. Heaven is coming.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Nine bolts. Elder Bai said nobody knows what the ninth one is. Wonderful.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: I know, little lotus. The ninth is the heart. And I will be waiting inside it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Ascension Stair opens, step by step, a road of light from the summit into the clouds.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Below, the Sect Master bows. Han Xue raises her sword. Zhao Kang shouts something rude, and wipes his eyes.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: I'll come back. Maybe not soon. But I'll come back.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And {player}, last of the Verdant Lotus, disciple of the Azure Cloud, climbs into the heavens.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation holds. The Blood Moon Abyss is sealed, and this time, the seal will last ten thousand years.

shots.speaker: senior_wei
shots.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! And whoever breaks the puppet buys lunch. For Elder Mo!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: An old hermit teaches the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra in the pagoda. Every morning, more students come.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Xiao Man grows herbs. She only drops some of them. Her brother writes every week.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And on clear nights, above the sea of clouds, one star blinks twice, as if someone up there were waving.

threads.title: The Traitor in the Law Hall

beats.text: The formation array answers Elder Gu's touch a little too well for comfort.
Under tournament banners, on the night of the final, the traitor's mask finally slips.
The Sect Master reads the Crimson Road report twice, then chooses two disciples to follow him down.
At the Heart Mirror, Gu Hanshan confesses everything, as the sky over the sect burns red.
A prisoner for years, Gu Hanshan asks the Sect Master for three last things.
The traitor spends the last thing he has opening the black gate.
A dead mother's jade pendant, and nothing else — but the formation array notices it.
In the ruins of a forgotten sect, the hermit tells the truth: the pendant is the Lotus Key.
A seed planted before the descent into the Abyss finally flowers, green and gold.
The last of the Verdant Lotus bloodline climbs the Ascension Stair, key and all.
Elder Mo starts teaching sword qi before the isles even open, and admits, gruffly, that he's proud.
Nine thousand nine hundred runes checked by hand, and one ring still to go.
Elder Mo burns his own life to turn the lit formation back.
A tea set, a peach orchard, forty years of notes, and a locked box addressed to the heir.
A pale man in a warehouse nobody owns calls himself the First Rung of the Patriarch's Ladder.
The First Rung falls at the obelisk ring, inside a circle of his own ash.
A monk in rotting robes prays rust into every hinge, chain and spear in Qingshi.
Madam Ninefold wears nine faces in one small town, and one of them is close.
Brother Hollow has worn ten thousand bodies. He wants one more, and cannot have it.
The Butcher of Wen weighs cultivators by the jin. He has never weighed one like this.
Lady Silk attends the conclave's last feast as guest of honour, thread in hand.
The Seventh Rung is also blood: a cousin from a village by a creek, wearing red eyes.
Senior Sister Han Xue leads into the Moonlit Grotto, food and grudges in tow.
Han Xue is taken at the obelisks — the first thing broken to get her back.
A year from her own nascent soul, Han Xue finally asks the heir to stand guard the way she once did.
Han Xue holds the bridge at the end of the world.
A forced pairing in the tournament turns rivalry into something like respect.
The Zhao clan wants its heir home. Zhao Kang has never been good at choosing anything but arguments.
Zhao Kang stands sworn brother, not just rival, at the conclave's last feast.
One last wager, for old times' sake, before the sky takes the heir somewhere he can't follow.
A shadow of the self, faced at the Heart Mirror and not yet understood.
The Heart Mirror hums a name outside the fold, still black, still still.
On the ninth bolt, the Patriarch rides the heart demon one last time.
No one climbs alone: the Sect Master calls every orthodox sect to one conclave.
Forty sects swear one oath on the formation plaza, then go home to wait.
The alliance's first joint action seals the rifts leaking from the fold at the Abyss rim.
Forty sects' armies gather at the teleport array for the march that finishes it.
